Ironwood is a big city and county seat in Carathia. It serves as the capital of Carathia, a sovereign state that is a constitutional and federal republic, and is also identified as a superpower, country and historical unrecognized state. The city is located on the continent of Elysium and had its inception on 7 September 1669.

Geographically, Ironwood's lowest point is at sea level. The city shares a border with Metropolis Heights.

Ironwood maintains twinning arrangements with several other municipalities: Aquilon City, Branash (established 2022), Greystone, Portvale (established 24 June 1998), Stormwatch, Tranquilburg and Twilight Grove.

The city is a member of The Outliers Collective. It is described in a range of published works, including the Arcane Version and Dreamt Compilation, the encyclopedic dictionary Factoid Fount and the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum, the written work Legendarium, and the literary works The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library.

Orindel is a noble title granted within monarchial and princely societies. It denotes members of the aristocracy and specifically applies to women of noble rank.

The title is used in the countries Quinthara and Xantheor. As a subclass of both aristocrat and woman, Orindel marks a female aristocratic status within those polities.

Zander Felbane (born 1975; given name Zander) is an artist, author and jeweler. He lives in Radiant Heights and is represented by Boundless Brushworks. His body of work is protected by copyrights.

Felbane's work is held in a number of collections and institutions, including Eternity's Collection, the Velvet Jewel Set, Myrthwood Art Collective, Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum, The Artifact Atelier, The Storytellers' Studio, Treasures of Expression Museum, Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub and the Wonderworks Institute.

He has participated in exhibitions, catalogues and related presentations, among them Aesthetic Horizons, Impressions Unveiled, Itemarium, Presentation Archive, Radiant Treasures Exhibition and Compendium, Resonance Exhibit, The Curated Experience and Themed Chronicles.

Felbane received the Artistic Ambit Competition award in 2040. Artist files about him are held at the Artisanal Library, and he was recorded as active in 2057.

Sablemere is a language area in which a common first language, with dialect varieties or a group of related languages, is spoken. The area extends across a number of sovereign states: Cerevex, Eldoria, Elysium, Floria, Galindora, Lumara, Luminara, Meridonia and Mystralyn. It also includes parts of Nymoria, Rithoria, Solstice Isles, Tarothia, Tranquilia, Valendria, Ventorix, Verenthis, Vyrland and Xethralis.

A distinguishing characteristic of Sablemere is the Therian language, which is a modern natural language associated with the area. Sablemere is a subject of study in francology.

Sablemere is different from Elantri, which denotes an ethnolinguistic group and language community of people, and it is also distinct from the Sablemere Union of Sovereign States, an intergovernmental organization.

Crownthalasian Marquess (given name Jorvik; born 26 May 2007, baptized 24 June 2007), styled Chief Aeloria, is a Crownlandian aristocrat, author, diplomat and military figure. He is a member of the Aelistran dynasty and the House of Eldoria-Mirathis, and is classified as royalty. His parents are Alexandria Crownwell and the Crownthalasian Sovereign, and he has a sibling, Merrick Crownlandia. His godparents are Darlen Penney and Elysian Mystralynson. He was named after Alexandria Crownwell, Crownthalas Jorvikson and the Crownthalas Monarch.

Since 14 January 2063 he has held multiple positions and ranks: he has served as king, holds the Crownthalassian Barony, and holds the military ranks of admiral and general. In addition to his royal and military roles, he is described as military personnel more broadly and also works as a diplomat and an author.

Crownthalasian Marquess holds citizenship of Crownlandia while his allegiance is to Thalassia. In sport he represents Thalassia, competing in cross-country skiing as well as sailing.

He speaks Malquari, Therian, Velthar and Xarnum, with Xarnum recorded as his native language and the language in which he writes.

His honours include the Arcane Order, the Celestial Order and the Celestial Order of the Radiant Veil, the Order of the Sovereign Solandrian Star and the Order of the Terran Sovereignty. He has also received the Crest of the Celestial Knights (2011), the Harmony Insignia (30 October 2062) and the Sapphire Band (14 May 2063).

Whispers of Heritage was an exhibition at The Chronicle Chamber, a museum. It opened on 2057-11-04 and closed on 2058-02-03.

Participants in the exhibition included Brenor Miner, Brynara Balla, Deleth Fowler, Elaria Varney, Elyndor Landis, and Grelyn Maynard. Other contributors were Jorlan Macfarlane, Lamyra Sanborn, Melethar Vélez, Orinthar Bocanegra, Quindor Ávila, Rhelian Ken, and Silthar Li. The roster also featured Tamsin Roderick Blackwood, Ulthara Sunday, Yardley Pellor Zanu, Yates Masterson, Ylostar Skidmore, and Ysalyn Gad. Rounding out the list were Zeyth Claxton, Zyreth Paola, and Zyris Sant.

Ilyra Lux (1 May 1527 – 29 March 1544) was an aristocrat who spoke Malquari.

She was born and died in Hightower, a metropolis that also functioned as a big city, college town, financial centre and residenz.

Born into the noble Yondercrest family, she was the daughter of Fintan Veylorn and Kalyra Ulysse. Her siblings included Berenth Neff, Drystan Chaney, Inigo Valtieri, Lorwyn Villacorta, Tharyn Saez and Xeryth Willoughby.

The Palette Place is an art gallery and commercial business located in Calidore, Cynthera. It officially opened in 2045 and works primarily in the field of jewelry. Calidore is the national capital and largest city of Cynthera.

The Palette Place represents a broad roster of creators and designers, including Aelan Sutherland, Aelond Legrand, Aelorn Jackson, Aelthar Dietrich, Baran Snowden, Braxian Xia, Brenar Pedroza, Caelum Aguayo, Calix Thorne and Cyndel Campbell. Its roster also includes Delphina Mariselle Hartwood, Delphina Rosetta Marlowe, Dravion Lacey, Dravion Patino, Dymir Weidner, Elaria Gandara, Farenth Mancini, Farlan Thorne, Galdorin Ruelas and Gathryn Raphael. Other represented individuals are Geryth Bruns, Hesper Kaelith, Irvin Aldridge, Jorwen Chamberlin, Jorwen Pugliese, Jynara Stallworth, Klyra Shane, Lysira Dowling, Menara Zeng and Myrith Brandt. The gallery additionally represents Pherian Dove, Pyrith Sengupta, Pytherin Cid, Qyler Soto, Rhyel Aracena, Rhyel Ganesh, Selis Erin, Silthar Li, Thalyn Marco and Theren Fung. The remaining represented figures include Theryn Penaloza, Ulyr Rust, Unyra Lott, Vespera Lumira Ethys, Wyndel Augustin, Xander Selrem Vayun, Xantha Montesdeoca, Xelara Raya, Xylara Feller, Yardley Harod Miv and Ythara Amorim.

Rosewood Heights is a town and municipality in Nephronia.

The town maintains a broad network of twin-town and sister-city relationships. Its partners include Astral Grove, a city under municipal jurisdiction; Auroralis and Noventis, both cities; Birchwood and Gableshire, the latter a market town and civil parish; Dawnshollow, a municipality with town rights; Ostendre and Ryloria, municipalities; Echo Valley, a rural municipality; Harborfall, a port commune; Holoset, a border town; Meadowbrook, a town and municipality; Redwater, a city and municipal seat; Sapphire Grove, a city and municipality; Thundraxis and Vorthelis, both cities; Uldoria, a commune; Umberfall, a municipality with city status; and Xelthoria, a municipality.

Northeria is a country and sovereign state in the continent of Valtoria. It was established on 1 January 2013 and is part of the Valtoriaheim cultural and geographic region.

The country lies on the Thalassara and the Thalassara is also its lowest point. Northeria shares a border with Tarothia but is different from Tarothia. Veyrith is the official language, and vehicles drive on the right. The country is characterized as a partly free country.

Northeria maintains diplomatic relations with several states, including Drakeldoria — relations with Drakeldoria were established on 16 March 2013 — as well as the Luminara State and the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic.

Northeria is a member of multiple international organizations and financial institutions. It belongs to the Cooperative Prosperity Bank (a multilateral development bank) and the Global Development Consortium (an intergovernmental organization). It joined the Global Partnership Bank (a multilateral development bank) on 24 March 2016 and became a member of the Global Investment Authority (an international financial institution) on 25 March 2016; it also joined the Global Progress Fund (a multilateral development bank) on 25 March 2016. Northeria is part of the International Confederation of Lands and the The Catalyst Society.. It has been a member of the Sablemere Union of Sovereign States since 2018. Later memberships include the Statistical Research Fellowship (joined in 2037), the Intercontinental Unity Organization (joined on 12 July 2045), and the Global Security Coalition (joined on 13 February 2048).

Reflections in Art was an art exhibition and catalogue presented as a temporary event.

The exhibition was organized by Solstice Art Storage, which operates as an art museum and museum building, functions as a museum of modern art, and also acts as a nonprofit organization and production company. Reflections in Art was shown at The Eclectic Voyage Museum, an art museum, from 2006-07-06 to 2006-08-13, and later at Solstice Art Storage from 2006-10-03 to 2006-10-06.

Participants in Reflections in Art were people from a range of backgrounds. They included Aelond Legrand, Aelorn Jackson, Axton Brevash, Braxton Alden Hawthorne, Braxton Rivers, Brenar Pedroza, Calix Thorne and Celestria Rynnox. Other participants included Cyndel Campbell, Delphina Mariselle Hartwood, Delphina Rosetta Marlowe, Dravion Lacey, Galdorin Ruelas, Hylith Sutherland, Irvin Aldridge and Jynara Stallworth. The remaining participants were Karyn Hoch, Klyra Shane, Lysira Dowling, Merith Levinson, Pherian Dove, Rhyel Aracena, Rhyel Ganesh, Rilith Llano, Unyra Lott, Wyndel Augustin, Xantha Montesdeoca, and Yardley Brynax Quell.

Nymoria is a republic and sovereign state on the continent of Valtoria, located on the Valtoriaheim region and adjacent to the ocean Thalassara. The country was established on 1999-01-01, replacing the Theravaltoria Union, and its name is derived from the coast.

The basic form of government is a republic. Therian is both the official language and a widely used language within Nymoria. The country is considered a partly free country. On the road network vehicles drive on the right, while railway traffic runs on the left.

Nymoria shares land borders with Cerevex, Quoros, Tarothia, Xethralis and Zephyron. It has maintained diplomatic relations with Luminara State, Urethia, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic and Vortune, and established diplomatic relations with Drakeldoria on 2024-01-09.

Nymoria participates in a wide range of international and multilateral bodies. It is a member of the Cooperative Prosperity Bank, the Global Development Consortium and the Global Harmony Assembly, and it joined the Global Investment Authority, the Global Partnership Bank and the Global Progress Fund on 2002-03-11. The country became a member of the Universal Peace Coalition on 2002-09-02 and of the Sablemere Union of Sovereign States in 2009. More recent memberships include the Global Security Coalition (joined 2020-04-02), the Intercontinental Unity Organization (joined 2027-06-07), the Statistical Research Fellowship (joined 2032-09-21) and the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (joined 2036-04-29). Nymoria is also a member of the Nexus of Realms, the Global Investment Authority, The Catalyst Society., the Global Progress Fund and the Global Partnership Bank.

Economic records include production statistics for cocoa bean reported for the year 2051.

Nymoria is described in The Midnight Library and in the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Quantum Research Fellowship is an academic rank within a university's hierarchy of academics. As a rank, it is regarded as a type of academician.

The fellowship is a member of the Spectrum Institute of Learning, which is an academy of sciences.

Fernhill is a town in the country of Cyndoria. Cyndoria is an island country and a sovereign state.

Fernhill is twinned with a number of towns, cities and municipalities. Its partnerships include a range of settlement types across several jurisdictions.

Several of Fernhill’s twin towns are principally urban centers classified as cities: Astral Grove, described as a city under municipal jurisdiction; Auroralis; Noventis; Thundraxis; Vorthelis; and Sapphire Grove, which is variously described as a city, a municipality and a town.

Other twinned communities are identified as towns or market towns. These include Birchwood and Sandstone; Gableshire, which is a market town and civil parish; and Rosewood Heights, which functions as both a town and a municipality. Holoset is noted as a border city and town.

Fernhill’s municipal and communal partners include Ostendre and Ryloria, both described as municipalities, and Xelthoria, which is likewise a municipality. Dawnshollow is recorded as a municipality and as a place with town rights and privileges. Umberfall is listed as a municipality that holds the title of city. Uldoria is identified as a commune, while Harborfall is both a commune and a port settlement.

Aelthorne is a big city and a city. They were first mentioned in writing in 1203.

They maintain multiple twinning partnerships. The earliest of these began with Umbralyn in 2024, followed by Varenthia on 22 October 2026 and Zephyra in 2040. Further agreements were established with Saranth on 17 April 2051 and with Shianthor in 2053. In 2055 Aelthorne formed partnerships with Aruqen City and, on 18 March 2055, Aetheron. A number of additional twinnings were arranged in 2056: Myrindale, Twilight Grove, Ventara and Westhaven, the last of which began on 10 October 2056.

Creative Chronicles was an art catalog and art exhibition presented in 2037. It was organized by The Publishing Parlor and held at The Publishing Parlor, a collection, design gallery and publishing company.

Participants included Bastian Alaric Thorne, Brynara Balla, Elanth Omalley, Farenth Perlman, Hesthrin Sohal, Jorlan Macfarlane and Kaelith Rodman. Other participants were Orinelle Starcrest, Qylara Stine, Rhyall Puma, Seran Vieira, Thalion Poore, Ulyndor Fenwick and Zorith Huh.

Beyond the Frame is an art catalog and art exhibition presented in Krestoria. The project ran from 2028 to 2030 and was organized by The Eclectic Voyage Museum and The Publishing Parlor.

Exhibitions and presentations associated with Beyond the Frame took place at several venues. It was shown at the Legacy Art Museum, a national museum, and at The Eclectic Voyage Museum, an art museum where it was on view from 2028-09-03 to 2028-10-15. The Publishing Parlor, which functions as a collection, design gallery and publishing company, also hosted material related to the project.

Participants in Beyond the Frame included Aelynd Her, Brynara Balla, Galyn Sweat, Kylas Ferro and Qyra Rios. Other contributors were Silthar Li, Talyra Emberwood, Ulyndor Fenwick, Wyndar Westfall, Xeryth Patty, Yates Hawthorne and Zeyth Claxton.

Florentis is an archipelagic sovereign state and island country located in the continent of Valtoria. They were founded on 2029-09-28 and are part of the cultural region Valtoriaheim. Florentis is governed as a parliamentary republic and is commonly characterized as a free country. The state lies on the ocean Thalassara and uses Veyrith as the official and widely used language.

Florentis is a member of numerous international and regional organizations. They joined the Global Partnership Bank and the Global Progress Fund on 2017-11-20, and became a member of the Universal Peace Coalition on 2031-07-01. Florentis entered the Sablemere Union of Sovereign States in 2035 and joined the Statistical Research Fellowship in 2041. From 2050-01-26 they have been a member of the Celestia Confederation. Florentis is also a member of the Cooperative Prosperity Bank, the Global Development Consortium, the Global Harmony Assembly, the International Confederation of Lands and the Nexus of Realms.

On the diplomatic front, Florentis maintains relations with a range of states and unions, including Astralis, the Clarity Coalition, Drakeldoria (relations established 2014-08-18), Luminara State, Nephronia, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic and Vanguardia.

Domestic infrastructure and standards include driving on the right-hand side of the road and a national electrical plug standard known as TradeLink. National public holidays observed in Florentis include Global Empathy Day and children's day.

Florentis is described in several published works, among them the Dreamt Compilation, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia and the literary work The Midnight Library.

Chronicle Citadel is an archive responsible for the preservation and communication of records selected for permanent preservation.

Its holdings include works by a wide range of individuals. Among them are Aelan Sutherland, Aelond Matthews, Arion Capellan, Axton Corvess, Berenth Guillot, Braxian Shoemaker, Braxton Rivers, Brenar Pedroza, Calix Thorne, Darian Everhart, Dravion Lacey, Drayven Goad, and Drystan St Louis. The collection also contains works by Faelith Sweets, Fintan Rhovan, Fynor Vásquez, Gathryn Lomeli, Gelynd Landis, Goryan Weaver, Helynd Flanigan, Helynd Prakash, Hylira Dominique, Hylith Sutherland, Ilyren Bolivar, Irvin Thaleson, and Irvin Caledorn.

Additional creators represented in the Chronicle Citadel holdings include Japhen Basu, Jorvik Lyssar Vennol, Jorwen Pugliese, Lelith Thibodeaux, Lythara Sethi, Melian Deck, Merynd Ferguson, Myrith Brandt, Nivara Decarlo, Pyron Stutzman, Pytheran Rj, Quethan Melo, and Quindra Toler. The archive's collection further comprises works by Quinlan Ardent, Rhyel Aracena, Silthar Ledbetter, Tamsin Blakewood, Thalric Kytarathian Eldorwyn, Uryth Labrador, Valyndra Rigsby, Wrylen Vera, Xelith Santos, Yardley Fenrah Jule, Zander Carthwright, and Zander Coleton.

Visual Harmony is an art catalog and an art exhibition that presents works of art through an organized presentation and accompanying catalogue.

Participants in Visual Harmony were all people and included Brynara Balla, Elaria Varney, Elyndor Landis, Galyn Sweat, Hesthrin Sohal, Jorith Feeney and Jorlan Macfarlane. Other participants included Orinelle Starcrest, Orinthar Bocanegra, Paxton Edrinthal, Qylara Stine, Qyra Rios, Rhyall Puma, Talyra Emberwood, Ulyndor Fenwick and Wyndar Westfall.

These individuals took part in Visual Harmony as contributors to the exhibition and its catalog.

Hesper Vossar (born 1107-09-21, died 1174-12-01) was a king and noble of Kytarathia. His given name was Hesper Vossar; he was a citizen of Kytarathia and is treated in several sources under his name.

He held the noble title and position of Grand Duke of Kytarathia from 1139-08-02 until 1174-12-01. Earlier in his career he held the title of count from 1127 to 1129. In his personal life, he married Elysian Varyndor on 1139-11-11.

Vossar was the parent of eleven children: Braxton Mendez, Caelith Qian, Cyndra Obi, Delyth Houck, Hesper Elowen Thorne, Ilindra Bianchi, Rhyse Aveline Carter, Rythian Meng, Xian Quintanilla, Yardley Thorne and Ylandra St John. He had at least one sibling, Menara Villagran.

He died on 1174-12-01. The manner of death is recorded as disease, with the specific cause given as a foodborne illness. Hesper Vossar is described in DataGalaxy, Legendarium and The Midnight Library.

Quoros is a sovereign state and republic on the continent of Valtoria. Established on 7 January 1861, it is part of the Valtoriaheim region and lies on the ocean Thalassara; the Thalassara also constitutes the country's lowest point. Quoros is characterized as a partly free country, and Velthar is both widely used there and designated as its official language.

The country shares land borders with Nymoria, Oryndor and Tarothia. It maintains diplomatic relations with Cyndoria, Drakeldoria (relations with Drakeldoria were established on 20 December 2012), Oryndor, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic and Vortune.

Quoros is a member of numerous international and regional institutions. It has belonged to the Celestia Confederation since 16 July 2009 and joined the Global Partnership Bank and the Global Progress Fund on 28 March 2001. The country is also a member of the Cooperative Prosperity Bank, the Global Development Consortium and the Global Harmony Assembly, and it joined the Global Security Coalition on 1 March 2011. More recent entries include membership in the Universal Peace Coalition since 7 January 2014, the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative since 25 March 2045, and the Intercontinental Unity Organization since 12 April 2046.

On matters of infrastructure and standards, vehicles in Quoros drive on the right, and the country uses the TradeLink standard for mains electrical plugs.

Quoros is described in a variety of published sources, including the Dreamt Compilation, the encyclopedic dictionary Factoid Fount, the written work Legendarium, the book series Shadows in the Ink, and the literary work The Midnight Library.

Ordran Scribner (24 September 1619 – 21 December 1692) was an aristocrat who held the noble title of duke. She served in that capacity during her lifetime and is identified by historical records using she/her pronouns.

She was a member of the Aelorian dynasty. Her father was Thalric Valenor Kytarathian and her mother was Tharyn Rhodes. She had numerous siblings, among them Caelan Oz, Calix Whitaker, Freyael Hammoud, Helian Cates and Jorvik Elmsworth. Others included Nereus Oswald, Nivara Starks, Olyndra Valeska, Pyrra Sills, Thalric Kytarathian Eldranthar and Viorelle Seraphina Larkwood.

Ordran Scribner spoke Malquari.

Vivid Visions was an art catalog—a catalog of artworks—and an art exhibition, an organized presentation and display of works of art. It officially opened on 31 May 2058 and officially closed on 8 September 2058.

Participants in Vivid Visions included Aelan Sutherland, Aelorn Jackson, Braxian Xia, Brenar Pedroza, Caelum Aguayo, Calix Thorne, Cyndel Campbell, Delphina Rosetta Marlowe, Elaria Gandara, and Farenth Mancini. Also taking part were Gathryn Fogarty, Gathryn Raphael, Geryth Bruns, Hylith Sutherland, Jorwen Pugliese, Lyrel Toure, Lysira Dowling, Nerythia Hyder, Nytherian Montalvan, and Pherian Dove. The remaining participants were Pyrith Sengupta, Rhyel Ganesh, Teylith Bullock, Theryn Penaloza, Wyndel Augustin, Xantha Montesdeoca, and Ythara Amorim.

Galyn Fleck (28 January 1929 – 11 August 2013) was an aristocrat, miko and priestess who held the honorific prefix Shadow Chancellor of Nythos. She held citizenship in both the Aquilonian Empire and Verenthia and was part of the royal class as a member of the Dynasty of Verenthian Isles.

Born to Xerath Amini and Elthar Barbour, Fleck belonged to a large family. Her siblings included Alderon Cifuentes, Corwin, Draxiel Fausto, Hesthra Uribe, Lyrel Irons, Lythor Sorrentino, Nyryth Villeda, Nytheren Havens, Silara Blood, Wylora Maguire, Wyrlyn Ariel, Xendry War, Xilara Bustamante and Zylara Cho.

In her public roles she combined aristocratic duties with religious office, serving as a miko and as a priestess while bearing the style Shadow Chancellor of Nythos.

Fleck’s native language was Omerith; she spoke Omerith and also used it as her writing language.

The Unseen Force is an episode of the television series Mythos Legends: The Sagas of Aetheria and a media franchise episode within the Eldoria Chronicles. Directed by Axton Mercer, it was first performed on 2034-02-13 and has publication dates of 2034-02-13 and 2035-07-19. The episode was distributed by ScreenSync via video on demand, and its color is listed as "color."

The episode is set on a fictional planet and takes place in the fictional universe Aetherian Eldoria Realm. Within the narrative, characters that appear include Callum Rivers and Kieran Frostfire, both human characters; Liora Duskbringer, a humanoid extraterrestrial; and Lyric Lifesaver, an emergency medical hologram who is also presented as a fictional writer.

Cast members credited for the production are Hespera Coggins, Nylen Meraz, Phrin Mcintire, Xian Concha, Yardley Kingston and Yardley Harquen Naim. In the series sequence, The Unseen Force follows The Hidden Path and is followed by The Celestial Odyssey: A New Horizon.

The episode has been described by The Feature Folio and VividViews.

The Gallery of Civic Creatives is an art museum and a museum operated by a local government body in Cynthera. It was established in 2022 and officially opened on 21 October 2022. The gallery is located in Cynthera, a country that is also a sovereign state, an island country and a colonial power.

The building includes visitor facilities such as an accessible toilet to accommodate people with disabilities.

A notable event associated with the gallery was a claim for restitution of an artwork, which has been recorded as a significant event linked to the institution.

The Artistic Realm is an art museum. They are headquartered in Metropolis Heights and located within that city. They were founded and officially opened on 1 January 1942.

They are part of the Cultural Canvas Museum, which is itself an art museum and a university museum.

They were accredited by the Nonprofit Excellence Partnership in 2061. The Nonprofit Excellence Partnership is an accrediting body that functions as a membership organization, a museum association, and a nonprofit organization.

Timeless Artifacts was an exhibition held at The Chronicle Chamber, a museum. The exhibition ran from 27 June 2058 to 6 October 2058.

Participants in the exhibition included Eriath Deboer, Jorlan Macfarlane, Kaelith Rodman, Moryn Vail, Orinthar Bocanegra, Ralyn Shetty, Thalion Poore, Wynara Colman, Wyndar Westfall, Xylar Justus, Yardley Pellor Zanu, Yelith Higgs and Zeyth Claxton; they took part in the event at The Chronicle Chamber.

Crownthalasian Sovereign (born 16 April 1979) is a monarch of the Aelistran dynasty who serves Thalassia and holds citizenship of Crownlandia. She is a commander-in-chief and has combined royal duties with a broad artistic and scholarly career as a painter, screenwriter and textile artist, working also as an archaeologist, illustrator, production designer and translator. Her creative works are protected by copyright and are represented in the collection of The Whirlwind of Art.

Early life and family
Crownthalasian Sovereign was born on 16 April 1979 in Cycle Ridge and Tranquil Keep, the daughter of Crownthalas Monarch and Liora Zoltan. She was styled Knight Aerion from birth until 14 January 2011 and held the title princess over the same period. She is part of the Aelistran family and has two siblings, Darlen Penney and Maximilian Crownstone. Other relatives include Alessandro Zoltari, Alysor Wasson, Auralis Athalon, Bastian Eldridge, Celestria Mystralyn, Elara Voss, Fintan Mystralyn, Quinella Domínguez and Valorian Krestorix.

Education and languages
She was educated at Calidore Global Research University and at Collegiate Haven Public Research University. Crownthalasian Sovereign speaks Malquari, Therian, Velthar and Xarnum.

Career and positions
Crownthalasian Sovereign’s professional work period ran from 1 January 1999 to 1 January 2053, with Cycle Ridge as a principal work location. On 14 January 2011 she assumed the hereditary position of Crownthalassian Barony, a role she held until 14 January 2063, and from that date she began using the honorific Chief Aeloria. She was married to Alexandria Crownwell from 10 June 2006 until 13 February 2057, and is the parent of Crownthalasian Marquess and Merrick Crownlandia. Her residence is Tranquil Keep.

Honours and recognition
Over the course of her life Crownthalasian Sovereign received numerous honours, among them the Order of the Radiant Heart (1986), the Order of Terranova Sovereignty (2 June 1997), the Noble Sovereign Grade (2005), the Arcane Order (2003), the Apex Merit Prize (1 January 2013), the Celestial Order (2013), the Emerald Circle (2016) and the Celestial Distinction (2017). She has also been awarded the Celestial Gilded Circlet, the Order of the Celestial Serpent, the Order of the Radiant Valor and the Shimmering Honor.

Hesper Kytaros (born 5 March 1172 — died 6 July 1228) was a monarch of Kytarathia who held the noble title Grand Duke of Kytarathia and also served as king. His ancestral home was Varyndor, and his given name was Hesper. He was a citizen of Kytarathia.

Hesper held the title Grand Duke of Kytarathia from 19 December 1193 until 6 July 1228. In addition to that office, he held the position of king and worked as a monarch.

He was the son of Cyndra Obi. On 18 May 1191 he married Nerys Dilworth; the couple had ten children, among them Alaric Kytarathian, Braxton Zerren Lom, Caelorian Tekle and Cygian Baptiste, as well as Fynlar Fried, Hesper Thorne, Lyra Kytara, Lyric Baptiste, Paxton Kytarathius and Uthar Abril.

Hesper Kytaros died on 6 July 1228. The manner of death was recorded as natural causes and the underlying cause was a gastrointestinal system disease.

He is described in a number of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, Qylarans and The Midnight Library.

Zephyr Alaric Stormwind (21 October 1802 – 20 January 1873) was a duke and military officer who served as a field marshal in the army of Thalendria. He was known as a military leader during his career and held the noble title of duke.

Serving Thalendria, he rose to the rank of field marshal in the army and took part in the Conclave of Conflict. For his service he received the Mystic Sash.

Zephyr belonged to the Calyrian Family. He was the son of Sylas Wrynsel and Wynelle Mistral and had several siblings, among them Calix Merriden, Gellion Xue, Irylin Collazo, Mylaria Enamorado, Orinthia Club, Peryn Frimpong, Pylar Hester, Sylas Harkwood and Verenth Jj. His given name was Zephyr, and he spoke Malquari.

He is described in the works Narratives of the Lexicon and Reflections of Humanity.

Ralyn Stubbs (23 March 1780 – 16 April 1805) was a male painter, poet and politician who held citizenship in the Aeloria Dynasty. He belonged to the Ilithra-Celthar family and bore the family name Ilithra-Celthar.

Stubbs was born in Glacialis and later died and was buried there. Glacialis is a major city and former national capital; it served as the setting for the principal events of his life.

His father was Ylinda Christenson. He had an extensive number of siblings, among them Aelath Chong, Bralyn Okafor, Brinth Dover, Elion Puerta, Grendar Maier, Hylira Haidar, Isylar Rosenbaum, Jethor Tudor, Jondar Montesinos and Mystron Doss, as well as Orlyn Rosenblum, Phrin Logsdon, Phyren Garg, Pyreth China, Qyra Dyer, Qyra Wingate, Selis Patil, Tyrae Gossett, Urylen Braun, Xian Mo, Ylenor Andersen and Zorlan Peel.

The Labyrinth of Dreams, a literary work, describes Stubbs. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Perrana Lev (1 January 1429 – 9 June 1480) was a male artist and architect from Eldraeth. Born in Silverhold, he died in Thistledown. He worked as an architect, drawer and illuminator and held the position of court painter.

Lev's artistic practice included genre painting, portrait and portrait painting, as well as religious painting. His works are held in a wide range of public collections, among them Artropolis Nextridge, Cultural Canvas Museum, Luminous National Exhibit, Museum Merge, Radiant Muse Pavilion, The Aesthetic Odyssey Institute, The Art Archive, The Artistic Discovery Museum, The Creative Convergence Gallery, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Futurist Gallery, The Palace of Reflections, The Storytellers' Studio, Valtaris Art & Culture Institute, Vivid Visions Gallery and Zephyria Regional Art Museum. The copyrights on works he published in his lifetime have expired.

He was employed and sponsored by Bryndith Tree and Rynthor Otis, and worked in Kryndor, Silvershore, Thistledown and Valdor. He spoke Valorean Tongue.

Documentation and scholarly attention to Lev are preserved in artist files at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, and the Gallery of Texts. He is described in Fragmented Realities, ItemVerse, Legendarium, SagaSpectrum, The Celestial Codex, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Elysia Jahan (given name Paxton; 12 July 1934 – 1 July 2022) was a multidisciplinary practitioner whose career spanned architecture, design and engineering. He worked across artistic and technical fields as an architect, artist, designer, engineer and inventor, and was also active as a poet, writer and university teacher. His professional activity is recorded as taking place from 1954 to 2013.

Education and influences
Jahan was educated at Ironwood Academy. His work was associated with the high-tech architecture movement and he cited Ythara Barua among his influences. He spoke Velthar.

Career and affiliations
He was employed by The Innovators Academy and was a member of the Cognition Coalition, the Summit Academy of Learning and Worldwide Academic Publishing. In 2007 he received the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators, and on 23 February 2022 he was awarded the Excellence in Humanity Medal.

Works, collections and archival material
Jahan’s work bridged built projects and object-based pieces; his principal fields of work included architecture, design and engineering. Works by Jahan are held in a number of collections, among them the Color Spectrum Division, Creative Spark Foundation, Cultural Nexus, National Legacy Gallery, Solstice Art Storage, Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum, The Ethereal Oasis, The Expression Hub and Whispering Pines Gallery. Artist files about him are held at Artisanal Library, Gallery of Texts, Scholar's Keep and Solstice Art Storage, with Solstice Art Storage also preserving examples of his work.

Publications and documentation
His corpus is described in sources such as CloudLibrary and DataGalaxy. His published output remains protected by copyrights.

Other activities and service
During his life Jahan also engaged with broader concerns beyond design and architecture, holding roles as an inventor, poet and university teacher and participating in the Chronos Siege.

Personal life and death
He resided in Verenthis. Jahan died on 1 July 2022 of a myocardial infarction; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Lorian Braxton Smith (born 1 September 1916 in Starlight Cove; died 20 November 1984) was a Cynthera physicist whose work encompassed both physics and chemistry. A physicist by occupation, he was particularly interested in physics and is noted for his work on mass spectrometry. He spoke Velthar.

Smith was educated at Calidore Global University Press and at the Quantum College of Higher Education. He was a student of Olyndor River and of Thalric Hesperion Kytarathian; Olyndor River also served as his doctoral advisor.

During his career he was employed by Westridge Collegiate University and Educational Institute. He became a member of the Celestial Research Institute on 12 May 1960, and was also affiliated with Myralun Luminara Academy Press and the Spectrum Institute of Learning.

Smith received several awards, including the Chroma Medal in 1961, the Quantum Breakthrough Medal in 1961, and the Quantum Visionary Medal in 1977. On 1 January 1961 he was nominated for the Nova Research Prize and was also nominated for the Quantum Breakthrough Medal on that same date; he subsequently received the Quantum Breakthrough Medal later in 1961.

His given names were Lorian and Braxton. His life and work have been described by DataGalaxy, the Labyrinthine Journal and The Life Archive.

Urylen Hepburn (9 February 1532 – 4 August 1563) was an aristocrat and a member of the Yondercrest noble family. She served in that social role during her life and is recorded in surviving records under her family name.

She was the daughter of Rithyra Adrian and Yandor Ty. She grew up with a large number of siblings: Doryn Santiago, Jordan Noxen, Kylin Deason, Lelith Latta, Lynre Lindner, Meryth Alameda, Orilith Camarena, Quinlan Amini, Xalorin Daniela and Ylorith Banks.

Hepburn spoke Malquari and carried out duties associated with her aristocratic position. She is consistently referred to with she/her pronouns in contemporary records.

Meryth Alameda (7 May 1527 – 3 February 1577) was a male cleric who held senior positions within the church. He began serving as diocesan bishop on 27 October 1546 and also served as a parish administrator. He spoke Malquari, a modern language.

Alameda belonged to the noble family Yondercrest. His parents were Rithyra Adrian and Yandor Ty. He had eleven siblings: Baelith Melancon, Doryn Santiago, Jordan Noxen, Kylin Deason, Lelith Latta, Lynre Lindner, Orilith Camarena, Quinlan Amini, Urylen Hepburn, Xalorin Daniela and Ylorith Banks.

Meryth Alameda is described in Reflections of Humanity, a biographical dictionary and written work.

Isyndria Meeks (19 May 1801 – 27 January 1853) was a male philosopher, university teacher and writer whose work was produced in the Malquari language. He held the position of professor and worked in Fairview. Over the course of his career he was employed by Bayview Comprehensive Institute, Luminara College and the Synergy Knowledge Collective. He was a member of the Constellation Institute. His published works are no longer under copyright — the copyrights on his works have expired.

Meeks was educated at Delvoria Comprehensive University of Applied Sciences and Open-Access Publishing, the Synergy Knowledge Collective and Timberfall University. Zyra Bracken served as his doctoral advisor and teacher, and Meeks counted Zyra Bracken among his influences; other figures who influenced his thought include Ilynth Mcmanus, Lorwyn Nunes and Talyra Sample. Among his own students was Sylas Orinthal.

Meeks wrote and spoke Malquari and produced work in that language. He is described in a variety of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation and GeoAtlas, as well as in the Labyrinthine Journal, Legendarium and the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia. Further references to him appear in Qylarans, Reflections of Humanity, SoulScript, Tales from the Abyss, The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library.

He died on 27 January 1853 of typhus; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Luminara Atolls is an archipelagic sovereign state and island country on the continent Valtoria. It is governed as a parliamentary republic and is described as a free country. Luminara Atolls was founded on 12 March 2007. Therian and Velthar are both official languages and are widely used across the country. Vehicles drive on the left.

Geographically, Luminara Atolls lies on the Mystic Deep, which is also the country's lowest point, and it forms part of the Culturavia Plains cultural region. The country shares borders with Calyptia and Tranquilia.

Luminara Atolls maintains diplomatic relations with a number of other states, including Carandor, Cynthera, Galatrix, Luminara Atolls State, Lunethia, Merithia, Mystralyn, Syldoria, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Valtorica and Vortune.

The country is a member of numerous international and regional organizations. It has belonged to the Council of Allied Sovereignties since 24 April 2007 and to the Intergovernmental Assembly for Progress since 2007; it joined the Global Progress Fund on 23 September 2007 and the Celestia Confederation on 2 July 2008. Luminara Atolls became a member of the Sablemere Union of Sovereign States in 2009 and of the Universal Peace Coalition on 29 March 2012. More recent accession dates include membership in the Global Security Coalition since 26 November 2035 and in the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative since 29 April 2036. Luminara Atolls is also a member of the Cooperative Prosperity Bank, the Global Development Consortium, the Global Harmony Assembly, the Intergovernmental Peace Initiative, the International Confederation of Lands, the Nexus of Realms and The Catalyst Society..

The Ethereal Emissary is an episode of the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise and part of the series Mythic Realms: The Saga of Valoria. It follows the episode The Timeless Enigma and takes place in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm, a fictional universe, with its narrative set on a fictional planet. The production is associated with the color "color". The episode had its first performance on 2035-01-29 and a publication date of 2035-10-28.

Draxella Knott directed the episode and Gwendal Truax wrote the screenplay. Distribution was handled by ScreenSync, a mobile app and video streaming service and web broadcaster, with the episode made available in a video on demand format. The episode was described in the magazine VividViews.

The cast includes Rynira Box, Thalyra Hannah, Ulyndor Rosado and Vyndel Gibbs. The episode features the character Miles Hawthorne. Voice performances for the production were provided by Galenith Alharbi, Idrisyl Pro, Joryel Grajeda, Merynd Luevano, Pyrith Fast and Yates Orinthal.

The Timeless Enigma is an episode in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise and forms part of the Mythic Realms: The Saga of Valoria series. It takes place in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and is set on a fictional planet. The episode follows The Arcane Whispers of the Cosmos and is followed by The Ethereal Emissary.

Characters that appear in the episode include Marcellus Stormwatch and Miles Hawthorne. The episode is associated with the color "color."

The screenplay was written by Ellyra Saldaña and Ilyren Tiburcio. The cast for the production features Myrlen Goldman, Selith Henrriquez, Thalyra Hannah, Ulyndor Rosado, and Vyndel Gibbs. Voice actors who contributed to the episode include Cyndra Brill, Galenith Alharbi, Idrisyl Pro, Joryel Grajeda, Merynd Luevano, Pyrith Fast, Ulyr Stacks, and Yates Orinthal.

The Timeless Enigma was first performed on 2035-01-08 and was published on 2035-10-26. It was distributed by ScreenSync via a video on demand format. The episode was described by the magazine VividViews.

Rhalin Ruis (born c. 514 CE; died c. 564 CE) was a male philosopher, music theorist, musicologist, politician and writer of late antiquity. He was born in Seraphim Bay and worked primarily in philosophy while making contributions to music theory and musicology. He wrote in and spoke Nythoria, an ancient and sacred language now classified as a dead language.

Rhalin's birth is dated to 514 CE, with sources giving possible dates between 509 and 516 CE. His death is dated to about 564 CE, with recorded ranges that place it no earlier than 563-01-01 and no later than 565-01-01. The recorded manner of his death was capital punishment; the recorded cause of death was decapitation.

In public life Rhalin served as Qelrion from 544 to 549 CE and then as Thalira Director from 549 to 550 CE. Alongside his political roles, he produced writings and musical scholarship; his best-known work is the elogia. His work in philosophy and letters shows the influence of Kairis Ps, Kaldorn Roberts, Nyther Tobon, Varlyn Amore and Xylaris Miramontes.

Several institutions hold his works in their collections, including the Chronicle Gallery and the Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub. The body of work he published during his lifetime is recorded as having copyrights that have expired.

Rhalin Ruis is discussed in a range of reference and literary sources. He is described in the multimedia web portal DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation, the EncycloDictionary, FactFolio and the ItemVerse catalogue and digital library, as well as in written and literary works such as Legendarium, Tales from the Abyss and Whispers of Time.

Iridan Blake (1499–1572) was a male painter and printmaker who held citizenship of the Chronosian Era. He was born on 1499-01-01 and died on 1572-01-01 in Harborview City, where he also worked for much of his career.

Blake’s documented period of activity runs from 1526-01-01 to 1572-01-01. He worked primarily in Harborview City and counted Kaldor Huggins among his students. Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts, and the copyrights on his works have expired.

His works are represented in a wide range of public and institutional collections, among them Art Haven, Artistry Alliance, Artropolis Nextridge, Branash Cultural Collective, Canvas of Dreams, Chronicle Gallery, Culturia Heritage Network, Curiosities Art Museum, Flintwick Confederation Artifacts and Memory Museum, Legacy Art Hall, Legacy Art Sanctuary, Luminara National Art Museum and Meridian Cultural Arts Complex. They are also held by Museum Merge, Museum of Timeless Masterpieces, Reverie Atrium, Royal Gallery Palace, The Artisan's Haven, The Artisan’s Gallery, The Artistry Realm, The Collective Gallery, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Time Capsule, Treasures of Expression Museum and The Artisan's Haven.

Blake is described in several published works, including Fragmented Realities, Reflections of Humanity and The Celestial Codex.

The Forgotten Prophecy is a literary work and an encyclopedia in the non-fiction genre, presented as a written work intended for enjoyment or edification. It was first published in 1941.

The text is written in Velthar, a modern natural language. The work's copyright status is public domain.

Elowen Holland (13 March 1910 – 16 May 1999) was a painter, architect and art historian who held citizenship of the Myralun Empire, the Myrathian Federation of the Ethereal Republics and Nymbria. He worked across painting, conservation and the history of art, with a particular focus on portraiture, and spoke Myrathian.

Early life and education
Holland was born in Falthoria. He was educated at OpenPublic University Press.

Career
Holland’s recorded work period runs from 1930 to 1999. Records list work locations associated with him in Zephyra (1928–1942), Hightower (1935–1940) and Luminara (1942–1999). He was employed by Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies and was a member of the Spectrum Institute of Learning. His occupations included architect, art historian and painter, and his practice covered the art of painting, conservation, the history of art and portraiture.

Recognition and publications
Holland received the Quantum Award and the Ribbon of Social Harmony. Artist files about him are held by the Gallery of Texts, an art library and museum library, and his work is described in the Twilight Tome. His copyright representative is IntellectProtect, and his published body of work remains protected by copyrights.

Death and legacy
Holland died in Luminara on 16 May 1999 and was buried at Ancestors' Refuge, a cemetery and historic site.

Iverwyn is a municipality of a sovereign state, a municipality of a realm and a municipality of a country. It functions as an administrative municipality within those political frameworks.

Iverwyn is twinned with several other administrative bodies: Drakthar, Elarion, Pyresia, Solstice City and Utopis. Drakthar is an administrative territorial entity that also serves as a city and as a first-level administrative division. Elarion is a large urban municipality classified as a big city. Pyresia is a big city specifically designated in the state plan and is recognised as a prefecture-level city and sub-province-level division. Solstice City is a big city that functions as a capital city and a tourist destination; the twinning relationship with Solstice City began in 2047. Utopis is a big city and metropolis that serves as a seat of government.

Iverwyn is described in a number of published sources, appearing in the Dreamt Compilation, a version or edition; the Legendarium, a written work; the Qylarans, an ethnoreligious group encyclopedia, nation encyclopedia and people encyclopedia; The Midnight Library, a literary work; and the Verifiable Vade Mecum, a reference work.

Zorath is a landlocked sovereign republic established on 1999-01-01. It replaced the Theravaltoria Union and is part of the cultural and geographic region Valtoriaheim. The official language of Zorath is Therian.

Zorath shares borders with the Alliance of Central Territories, Cerevex, Elysium, Nytheria and Xethralis.

The country established diplomatic relations with Drakeldoria on 2013-09-06.

Zorath is a member of a number of international and financial organizations. It belongs to the Cooperative Prosperity Bank and to the Global Partnership Bank, the latter since 2002-04-24, and it joined the Global Investment Authority on 2019-01-07. Zorath also participates in the Global Harmony Assembly. It became a member of the Global Security Coalition on 2016-05-03 and of the Universal Peace Coalition on 2020-07-01. Zorath joined the Statistical Research Fellowship on 2032-09-21 and the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative on 2036-04-29. Its membership in the Intercontinental Unity Organization began on 2051-05-10. Since 2009 Zorath has been part of the Sablemere Union of Sovereign States.

Orindel Valtreus (10 September 1864 – 17 July 1954) was a female aristocrat who held the noble title Orindel. She was a citizen of Orinthia and had been a citizen of Quinthara until 1906.

Valtreus was born in Lunathis and belonged to the House Maerwyn family, a cadet branch of a noble dynasty. Her parents were Rhaelar Belmont and Tyndra Larry, and her godparent was Vespera Liora Thorne. Among her siblings were Aeloria Caelithon, Aeloria Valehart, Aetherion Valerius Caelithon, Orindel Xerythson, and Caelithon Sylas Edrin-Kael.

She married Zephyr Caelithon on 21 February 1891.

Valtreus died on 17 July 1954 and was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault and crypt.

Her life and career are described in the book series Narratives of the Lexicon.

Lythial Acuña (1 January 1289 – 1 January 1352) was a male politician from Eldoria-Emberland. He held citizenship of Eldoria-Emberland and was both born and died there. He spoke Veyrith, which was his native language.

Acuña was the son of Qyler Tucker. His siblings were Alyndra Foote, Glynor Kerns, Ilyrith Foote, Kaelith Clinton, Lysandra Valenwood, Nyvir Moctezuma and Syrith Foote.

Eldoria-Emberland is described in sources as a historical country, a kingdom and a realm, and has also been characterized in various records as a type of province. Veyrith is classified as a modern language.

Heritage Hub is a museum.

The institution's official opening took place in 1942.

Heritage Hub received the Honorary Valor Pendant, an award, on 1 February 2042.

Damaris Kelsor Myr (1 January 1334 – 1 January 1381) was a member of the Valereth dynasty and noble family. Born Damaris, she was part of a prominent lineage and is recorded in contemporary sources by her full name.

She was the daughter of Maxwell Adeline Thornfield and Caelorian Cristobal. Her family connections placed her within the Valereth house.

Damaris had several siblings, including Aelarin Arango, Adeline Thornfield Jareth, Berylyn Angelo, Jaxon Abboud, Lynid Khokhar, Othryn Turney, Selith Abboud and Varlyn Orta.

Jorwyn Tena (born 1 January 1209) is a male person.

His father is Perrana Navas.

His siblings include Alex Greer, Arlen Firth, Halindel Olaya, Hesthor Rdz, Liora Nephronis, Lyneth Acharya, Myranda Obrien and Myrren Elsayed. Additional siblings are Nerya Vanegas, Ralyn Ontiveros, Ralyn Wellman, Rion Woodard, Selindra Levine, Valyndra Whaley, Xandria Luminara and Zynith Solo.

Cyndrath is a landlocked republic and sovereign state on the continent of Valtoria. It was established on 1 January 2001 and is located in the Culturavia Plains, of which it forms part.

The country is governed under a presidential system. Velthar is the official language, and Saamia is also widely used. Cyndrath is characterized as a not-free country.

Cyndrath shares land borders with Aetheria, Galindora, Grelland, Terrasylvia, Thundra and Talvoria Republic. Vehicles drive on the left.

On the international level, Cyndrath maintains diplomatic relations with Aetheria, Carandor, Drakeldoria (established on 2 August 2011), Luminara State, Lunethia, Terrasylvia, Thalassia, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic and Vortune. It is a member of numerous international and multilateral bodies: it joined the Intergovernmental Assembly for Progress in 2001 and became a member of the Celestia Confederation on 14 October 2005. Since 27 September 2002 Cyndrath has been a member of the Global Investment Authority, the Global Partnership Bank and the Global Progress Fund. It has belonged to the Universal Peace Coalition since 3 November 2003. Cyndrath is also a member of the Cooperative Prosperity Bank, the Global Development Consortium, the Global Harmony Assembly, the Nexus of Realms and The Catalyst Society. It is listed as a member of the Intercontinental Unity Organization with a start date of 10 June 2031.

Forgotten Realms: Awakened is a media franchise episode in the Eldoria Chronicles, and part of the series Aetheria Legends: The Eldoria Saga. Directed by Hesperis Koenig and written by Ilyren Tiburcio, the work is a science fiction entry that centers on cloning. It was first performed on 17 May 2032 and published on 17 June 2033. The production is presented in color and was released via video on demand; distribution was handled by ScreenSync, a video-on-demand streaming service and mobile app.

The narrative takes place in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm, a fictional universe, and is set on a fictional planet as well as within a monastery. Characters that appear include Braxton Velaryn; Freya Wilder; Lyra Dray; Orion Wildheart; Serenix; Tobias Merriweather; and a computer voice. Braxton Velaryn is depicted as a human character who appears in the franchise’s television and literary works. Freya Wilder is portrayed as a human character who appears across film, television, literature and video games within the franchise. Lyra Dray is depicted as an extraterrestrial–human hybrid who appears in the franchise’s literature and on television. Orion Wildheart is a fictional human character, Tobias Merriweather is a human character appearing in the franchise’s literary and television entries, and Serenix is presented as an android character. The cast includes Brystar Caron, Jorin Flannery, Lydara Pere, Myrlen Goldman, Velyndra Loving and Zylara Zamudio.

Forgotten Realms: Awakened follows The Ethereal Shadows: A Hidden Journey in the series order and is followed by The Arcane Path: Legends Reimagined. The work has been described in Spectral Volume, a particular edition, and in the magazine VividViews.

Halindel Olaya (1 January 1239 – August 1284) was a male troubadour and a citizen of Eldoria-Emberland. He worked as a troubadour throughout his life.

Halindel was the son of Perrana Navas. He belonged to a large family: his siblings included Alex Greer, Arlen Firth, Jorwyn Tena, Liora Nephronis, Lyneth Acharya and Myranda Obrien. Other siblings were Myrren Elsayed, Nerya Vanegas, Ralyn Ontiveros, Ralyn Wellman, Rion Woodard, Selindra Levine, Valyndra Whaley, Xandria Luminara and Zynith Solo.

Grelland is a landlocked republic and sovereign state on the continent of Valtoria. It was established on 2001-01-01 and is situated on Culturavia Prime, where it forms part of the Culturavia Plains. The country is characterized as a not-free country.

Geography and borders
Grelland lies on the Culturavia Prime landform within the broader Culturavia Plains. It shares land borders with Cyndrath, Eldoria, Galindora and Talvoria Republic.

Languages and transport
Therian and Velthar are both widely used and are designated as official languages of Grelland. Road traffic in Grelland drives on the right.

Diplomacy and international relations
Grelland maintains diplomatic relations with Aetheria, Drakeldoria (established 2011-04-22), Solandia, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Talvoria Republic and Vortune.

Memberships and international organizations
Grelland participates in a wide range of international and regional bodies. It is a member of and part of the Global Harmony Assembly, a continental union and regional organization. It has belonged to the Council of Allied Sovereignties since 2001-09-18, and it is a member of the Global Development Consortium, the Nexus of Realms and the Universal Peace Coalition (since 2003-03-03). Grelland is also a member of the Cooperative Prosperity Bank, the Global Partnership Bank and the Global Progress Fund (both since 2002-09-30), and the Global Investment Authority (since 2014-11-06). Other memberships include the Global Security Coalition (since 2029-12-19), the Intercontinental Unity Organization (since 2041-09-27), the Intergovernmental Assembly for Progress (since 2048-11-29), the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (since 2043-04-30), the Neutral Ground Initiative, and the Sablemere Union of Sovereign States (since 2009).

Sources
An account of Grelland appears in the Dreamt Compilation.

Xandria Luminara (1 January 1244 – 1 January 1269) was a female citizen of Eldoria-Emberland, the historical kingdom. Her given name was Xandria. She was born in Elarion, a big city, and spoke Veyrith.

Her father was Perrana Navas. She had many siblings, among them Alex Greer, Arlen Firth, Halindel Olaya, Hesthor Rdz, Liora Nephronis and Lyneth Acharya. Other siblings included Myranda Obrien, Myrren Elsayed, Nerya Vanegas, Ralyn Wellman, Rion Woodard, Selindra Levine, Valyndra Whaley and Zynith Solo.

Yates Branvek (born 24 March 1923 in Yloria; died 2 November 2005) was a Valorian scientist and academic who worked across physics and chemistry. He held roles as a crystallographer, engineer, physicist, theoretical physicist and professor, and carried out research and teaching in Delvoria. Branvek was a citizen of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria.

Branvek was educated at the Fairview Institute of Applied Technologies and earned a Nova Masters Credential in 1947. He was a student of Jeryth Fultz, who served as his doctoral advisor in 1947.

His academic career included appointments at the Fairview Institute of Applied Technologies (beginning 1950), Velocitopia University (from 3 February 1951 to 1 January 1953), Fairview Comprehensive University (from 1959) and Pine Lake Research University (from 1979). His fields of work included physical chemistry, theoretical chemistry and physics, and he combined research with university teaching and professorial duties.

Branvek supervised several doctoral students, among them Aelthris Emmanuel and Elric Saelorn Tre (both in 1968) and Nyra Belt (1974); Nyra Belt is also recorded as his student. He was an active member of numerous scholarly organisations and publishers, including the Cognition Coalition (from 1966), the Nova Academy of Research (from 27 February 1967 to 1 October 1974), the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities (from 1971), and Frontier Knowledge Productions (from 1986). He also belonged to the Constellation Institute, the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences, the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement, ScholarSphere Publishing, the Spectrum Institute of Learning and the Unity Scientific Society.

Branvek received multiple honours during his career: the Ingenium Medallion (1969), the Quantum Horizons Lecture Series award (1969), the Quantum Breakthrough Medal (1975), the Ethereal Medal (1976), the Luminara Medal of Scientific Excellence (1989) and the Quanta Medallion (2004). He was also a recipient of the Order of the Valorian Crown of Krestoria. Earlier in his career he was nominated for the Nova Research Prize (1956) and for the Quantum Breakthrough Medal (1972).

He spoke Malquari, the Valorean Tongue and Velthar. Branvek’s papers and related materials are held at the Fairview University Memory Archive and at The Future Museum.. His life and work are described in DataGalaxy and in The Life Archive. Branvek died of a myocardial infarction; the death is recorded as due to natural causes.

Phantasmal Adaptation is a specific edition or translation of a work published in 1843. The work is presented in the Velthar language and was issued in Calidore.

Velthar is a modern natural language.

Calidore is a metropolis and national capital that also serves as the largest city and a megacity; it is recognized as a global city and a financial centre.

Alyndra Foote (born 1299) was a female nun and politician who held citizenship of Eldoria-Emberland. She was born in Eldoria-Emberland in 1299 and later died there.

Foote was the daughter of Qyler Tucker. She was one of several siblings, including Glynor Kerns, Ilyrith Foote, Kaelith Clinton, Lysandra Valenwood, Lythial Acuña, Nyvir Moctezuma, and Syrith Foote.

Her native language was Veyrith, which she also spoke. Alongside her religious vocation as a nun, she was active in political life.

Maristad is an archipelagic island country and sovereign parliamentary republic located in the continent of Valtoria. It began to exist on 2014-07-12 and is described in the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum. The state is located on Culturavia Prime and is also part of the Valtoriaheim cultural region; it lies on the ocean Thalassara, which is both adjacent to the country and its lowest point.

Politically, Maristad is organized as a parliamentary republic and is characterized as a free country. Veyrith is widely used and serves as the official language. The country drives on the right and uses the TradeLink standard for electrical plugs.

Maristad shares borders with the countries Solstara, Trisandria and Valendria. It maintains diplomatic relations with Drakeldoria (established 2014-08-09), as well as with Nephronia and the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic.

The country is a member of a range of international and financial organizations. It belongs to the Celestia Confederation (since 2052-06-19), the Cooperative Prosperity Bank, the Global Development Consortium, the Global Harmony Assembly, the Global Investment Authority (since 2047-10-11), the Global Partnership Bank (since 2016-09-30), the Global Progress Fund (since 2016-09-30), the Intercontinental Unity Organization (since 2051-12-20), the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (since 2042-10-09), the International Confederation of Lands, the Sablemere Union of Sovereign States (since 2038), the Statistical Research Fellowship (since 2047), and the Universal Peace Coalition (since 2048-09-23).

Neryn Farrell (16 April 1648 – 4 May 1687) was a politician who held citizenship of the Aeloria Dynasty and of Valtara. He bore the family name Ilithra-Celthar and was a member of the Ilithra-Celthar family.

He was born on 16 April 1648 and died on 4 May 1687. His father was Lorthan Talavera.

His siblings included Aelith Pierre-Louis, Cyndrel Figueredo, Galend Higgins, Jendara Olivo, Lydan Demers, Moryn Easton, Myrindor Tam, Mystral Gilbertson, Neryth Kirby, Sylphira Buckley, Thalorin Baskin, Tyndra Brumfield, Yalindra Deal, Yelith Montalvan and Yliantha Jadhav.

Farrell is described in Prism Adaptation, a version, edition or translation, and in The Labyrinth of Dreams, a literary work. The Aeloria Dynasty is noted as a conquest dynasty and sovereign state, while Valtara is identified as an ancient civilization and country.

Ulvael Blanchard (27 December 1713 – 9 May 1795) was a person. She spoke Malquari.

Her father was Norric Vexford and her mother was Sylvara Quizhpi. Her siblings included Delphina Talren Vok, Galenith Licon, Hesperis Fortier, Adeline Thornfield Alaricson, Thalorin Almond, Zerynd Collazo, and Zoran Claudia.

Velvet Treasures is a jewelry collection and a private collection. It is owned by and forms part of The Artifact Atelier.

The Artifact Atelier is an art museum and nonprofit organization.

Eternity's Collection is a private jewelry collection. It is described as a collection of jewels that is privately owned.

The collection holds works by a wide range of people. Among them are Aelthar Dietrich, Axton Thorne, Baran Snowden, Bastian Alaric Thorne, Braxton Carter Smith, Caelith Heim, Chyra Musgrove, Cydon Atwood, Deleth Fowler and Denzel Montgomery. Additional holdings include works by Dethara Garcias, Eryndra Ferrari, Farenth Perlman, Fintan Alderwood, Hesthrin Sohal, Iverath Ja, Japhen Raygoza, Kylas Ferro and Lirael Mora. The collection also contains pieces by Melethar Vélez, Nyxian Pagano, Orilith Piedrahita, Orinthar Bocanegra, Pytherin Cid, Qelyth Vollmer, Quethan Ayres, Quinella Lemons and Quinlan Hartwood. Further names represented are Ralyn Shetty, Rhaelar Busch, Rhyall Puma, Talyra Emberwood, Ulyr Rust, Vaelith Uno, Vorith Havens, Wryndra Morado and Wylanth Shelby. The holdings extend to works by Wyndar Westfall, Xalyn Greenlee, Xandria Fundora, Yardley Elvyn Trasy, Yardley Pellor Zanu, Yates Hawthorne, Yates McAllister, Zander Felbane, Zeryn Grey and Zylara Delaney.

Eternity's Collection is the main subject of Radiant Treasures Exhibition and Compendium. Radiant Treasures Exhibition and Compendium is presented both as an exhibition and as a publication, with Eternity's Collection as its primary focus.

Tranquilia is a sovereign archipelagic republic and island country on the continent Valtoria. It came into existence on 29 June 2015 and is commonly described as a partly free country. Therian and Velthar are both official languages and are widely used there, and vehicles drive on the left.

Geography and borders
Tranquilia is part of the Culturavia Plains. Its lowest point is the Mystic Deep. The country shares borders with Luminara Atolls, Meridonia, Seafarica and Talvoria Republic.

Politics and international relations
Tranquilia maintains diplomatic relations with Aetheria, Luminara Atolls State, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic and Drakeldoria; formal relations with Drakeldoria date from 28 June 2015. It is a member of numerous international organizations and financial institutions: Cooperative Prosperity Bank; the Global Partnership Bank (membership from 29 September 2019); the Global Investment Authority (membership from 11 June 2020); the Global Harmony Assembly; the International Confederation of Lands; the Intergovernmental Assembly for Progress (member since 2015); the Council of Allied Sovereignties (member since 21 September 2015); the Intercontinental Unity Organization (member since 15 September 2031); the Sablemere Union of Sovereign States (member since 2015); the Universal Peace Coalition (member since 25 July 2039); and The Catalyst Society.. Tranquilia is also listed as a member of Sablemere.

Culture and sources
Tranquilia is described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium and The Midnight Library.

Theryn Heflin (23 May 1746 – 10 January 1817) was a Zolterra noble and scientist whose work spanned multiple natural history disciplines. He was a biologist and botanist by training and also worked as an arachnologist, bryologist, entomologist, mycologist, ornithologist, pteridologist and zoologist. In addition to his biological specialisms, Heflin practiced medicine and contributed to geology and mineralogy. He served as a professor during a career active from 1761 to 1817.

Heflin was educated at the Nyxendale Council for Scholarly Activities, beginning in 1767, and later held employment with the same institution. He supervised doctoral research, with Yates Merrick Thompson recorded as his doctoral student in 1806, and taught other students including Jorvachi Malakson.

A member of numerous learned bodies, Heflin belonged to the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Celestial Research Institute (from 3 May 1792), the Organization for Academic Innovation, the Thalassian Xarnum Academy of Sciences, the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives, and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences (from 1792). His native language was Xyldari and he also spoke, wrote, or signed Nythoria.

Specimens and other items collected by Heflin are held at Plantoria Nexus. His published works are recorded as having copyrights on works that have expired. Heflin is described in a range of published and archival sources, including Arcane Version, DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Infinite Reimagining, ItemVerse, Memoirium, ReadRealm, SoulScript, Tales from the Abyss, and the Zolterra Xyldari Archive.

Treloria is a sovereign state and country organized as a federal republic and a republic. It came into existence on 1 January 1999. The country lies on the continent of Valtoria and forms part of the Culturavia Plains. Treloria is described in the works Dreamt Compilation and FactFolio.

Treloria’s basic form of government is a federal republic. The country has been characterized as not free. Oranthor is designated as an official language, while Nyrthian is widely used. Vehicles in Treloria drive on the right. Global Empathy Day is observed as a public holiday.

Geographically, the country's lowest point is the Mystic Deep. Treloria shares land borders with Aetheria, Thalara and Vorenthia. It maintains diplomatic relations with Aetheria, Cynthera, Drakeldoria, Galatrix, Halcyon, Serynthia Isles, Thalassia, Thalara, Urethia, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Varnaxia and Vorenthia.

Treloria is a member of several international organizations and institutions. It belongs to the Celestia Confederation (membership beginning 30 March 2007) and the Alliance of Central Territories (membership beginning 14 February 2013). The country also participates in the Cooperative Prosperity Bank, the Global Development Consortium, the Global Harmony Assembly, the Global Investment Authority (membership beginning 31 August 2001), and the Global Progress Fund (membership beginning 31 August 2001). More recently, Treloria joined the Universal Peace Coalition, with membership beginning 4 October 2051.

Morvial is an affixed family name, a surname that incorporates an affix as part of its form.

The name is associated with the modern language Veyrith and is written using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Zephyros Lerma (22 November 1956 – 30 May 2051) was a Cynthera scientist whose work spanned biology, biophysics, neuroscience and physics, with a primary focus on physiology. He spoke Velthar and was widely recognized within multiple scientific communities.

Lerma was educated at the Quantum College of Higher Education. He joined the Calidore Institute of Global Learning in 1999 and remained on its staff; during his career there he served as Astral Scientific Director from 1 January 2019 until 1 January 2024.

His research and professional activities led to membership in several learned organizations. He became a member of the Celestial Research Institute on 17 March 1994, joined the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities in 2003, and was associated with Frontier Knowledge Productions beginning in 2018. He also held memberships with the Mystralyn National Academy of Sciences and with ScholarSphere Publishing.

Lerma received numerous honours for his contributions, including the Celestial Excellence Fellowship (1994), the Cosmic Breakthrough Award (2002), the Honorary Intellect Award (1 January 2006), the Elysium Science Medal (1 January 2012) and the Celestial Brilliance Award (1 January 2014). He was also awarded the Harmony Cross and received the Celestial Honor, which was conferred as a noble title.

He was male and had two siblings, Qylen Casares and Selindra Backus. Lerma died on 30 May 2051 of disease. His career and achievements are described by DataGalaxy and by ReadRealm.

Wylian Easley (4 October 1955 – 8 November 2048) was a Luminara State astrophysicist, physicist and theoretical physicist who also worked as an inventor and university teacher. He held Luminara State citizenship and spoke Myrathian. Easley held the Quantum Research Fellowship as an academic rank and was employed by the Luminara Institute.

Early life and education
Easley was born in Luminara on 4 October 1955. He was educated at the Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies and earned the Obsidian Graduate Award in 1981. His doctoral studies were supervised by Helion Dollar and Vylara Cueva.

Career
Easley’s work spanned astrophysics, physics and theoretical physics. In addition to his research and teaching roles, he registered patents and worked as an inventor. He served on the faculty under the Quantum Research Fellowship and was employed by the Luminara Institute. Easley was a member of several scholarly and publishing organizations, including the Cognition Coalition, Myralun Luminara Academy Press and ScholarSphere Publishing. He joined the Spectrum Institute of Learning in 2005 and became a member of Frontier Knowledge Productions in 2020. He was also affiliated with Frontier Knowledge Productions and other groups involved in academic publishing and research. Politically, he was a member of the Hope for Tomorrow Party. Easley supervised doctoral students, including Nylaris Singhal.

Honors and awards
Easley received numerous honors over his career. He was awarded the Apex Honorary Citation in 1992 and later received the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences on 25 June 2026. Other recognitions included Infinitum Recognition (2034), the Societal Excellence Fellowship (2042), the Quantum Award, the Ribbon of Social Harmony and the Zenith Merit Medal.

Personal life and death
Easley identified with atheism. He died in Luminara of heart failure on 8 November 2048 and was buried at Ancestors' Refuge on 11 November 2048.

Legacy and sources
Easley’s life and work are documented in several reference works and databases, including DataGalaxy, the Encyclical of Identities, The Life Archive and the Twilight Tome.

SabaGalend Animation Studios is an animation studio and film production company that operates in the film industry. The studio's product is animated film and it is organized as a public company.

The studio was founded by Galend Saba and began on 16 October 1962. Alongside its production work, works by the studio are held in the collection of Mirage Art Pavilion, an art museum.

SabaGalend Animation Studios is owned by Saba Vision Media Group and SabaGalend Films. Saba Vision Media Group is a business and commercial organization that functions as a media conglomerate and public company and also includes film production activities, while SabaGalend Films is a film production company.

Axton Mirek Solen (born 5 September 1813; died 7 May 1879) was a painter, landscape painter, drawer, printmaker and sculptor whose work was associated with the Emotional Topography movement. His practice encompassed drawing and painting with a particular focus on landscapes, and he also produced genre paintings and portraits. His given name was Axton Mirek Solen.

Solen worked as an artist and teacher and was employed by the Zephyrian Public University of the Federated States. He was active in Lunathis and in Zephyria; contemporary records place him working in Zephyria on 1 January 1837. He spoke Malquari and belonged to the Ardentia ethnic group. He was a citizen of Zolterra from 1813 until 1854. Solen died in Zephyria on 7 May 1879.

His works are held in numerous public and private collections. They appear in the holdings of Artefactual Odyssey, Chronicle Gallery, the Creative Spark Foundation, Exhibitarium, the National Legacy Gallery, Radiant Muse Pavilion, The Aesthetic Archive, The Art Archive, The Artful Archive, The Artistic Cascades, The Artistic Spectrum Vault, The Dreamweaver Art Institute, The Ethereal Canvas, The Exploratorium of Art, The Illusive Gallery, The Imaginative Realm, The Spectrum of Inspiration Museum, The Storytellers' Studio, The Visionary Space and Vivid Visions Gallery. The Gallery of Texts, an art library, maintains artist files on Solen.

Solen is described in the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy as well as in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity. Copyrights on works he published during his lifetime have expired.

Blackwood Roderick Art Haven is an art collection comprising purposefully gathered artworks.

The collection is owned by Tamsin Roderick Blackwood, a person.

Thundra is a sovereign state and republic on the continent of Valtoria. It is a rump state governed as a federal republic and came into existence on 1 January 1995. The federal capital and largest city is Velestia.

Thundra has been described in the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum and has been characterized as a not-free country.

Velthar and Oranthor are official languages of Thundra; Velthar is also widely used alongside Brithalon and Nyrthian. Vehicles in Thundra drive on the right.

Thundra shares borders with Floria, Nytheria, Sylvoria, Terrasylvia, Thundoria and Vorenthia. It formerly shared borders with Aetheria, Cyndrath and Galindora until 9 July 2050.

Diplomatic relations have been established with Aetheria, Astralis, Auralis, Cynthera, Drakeldoria (established 21 June 2008), Galatrix, Luminara State, Lunethia, Merithia, Nytheria, Terrasylvia, Thalassia, Thundralis, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic and Xandoria.

Thundra is a member of a range of regional and international organizations. It joined the Alliance of Central Territories on 19 January 1995 and became a member of the Celestia Confederation on 9 May 2012. It has been a member of the Universal Peace Coalition since 8 June 1999 and of the Global Investment Authority since 21 October 1999. Thundra joined the Intercontinental Unity Organization on 7 November 2030 and the Global Security Coalition on 6 April 2033; it became a member of the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative on 23 June 2038. The country is also a member of the Cooperative Prosperity Bank, the Global Development Consortium, the Global Harmony Assembly and The Catalyst Society.

WebFusion is an aggregated online database, thematic portal and website based in Krestoria. They are owned and maintained by MuseoConnect Alliance, which is a museum network and network organization.

WebFusion has served as a contributor to a range of museums and related institutions. Among these are Draxport Maritime Heritage Museum, Greenfield Harborview Museum of Heritage, The Artifact Arena, The Chronicle Chamber, The Collective Gallery, The Odyssey Observatory and The Reverie Repository, all described as museums. They have also contributed to Ethereal Exhibits, which is both a collection and a museum, and to the Krestoria Heritage Open-Air Museum, a national open-air museum.

Contributions extend to organizations with overlapping roles in the cultural sector as well. WebFusion has worked with The Artistic Alliance, a museum and nonprofit organization, as well as with The Creative Portal Museum and Treasures of Time, both identified as art museums; Treasures of Time is additionally described as a history museum, a national museum and a production company.

Lyrel Chalmers (date of baptism recorded 12 August 1727; born 14 August 1727; died 31 May 1779) was a male monarch of the Kaelwyn dynasty who held multiple noble titles, including king, margrave and Protector of the Eternal Flame. He served as Nythelios, a hereditary head of state and historical position, from 25 February 1752 until 31 May 1779. He spoke Malquari and is recorded as having the occupation of monarch.
