Eldoria Chronicles is a media franchise. It was founded by Lyvian Mensah and began on 8 September 2005.

Among the franchise's notable works is Eldoria Legends: The Chronicles of Aetheria, which exists as both a media franchise series and a television series.

Elarith is a noble title, a legal privilege granted to certain members of monarchial and princely societies. It denotes a rank that is treated as a subclass of princess, indicating a specific form of princely status within those hierarchies.

The title is used within the Aeloria Dynasty. The Aeloria Dynasty is a sovereign state with an associated historical cultural identity, and Elarith functions as one of its princely designations.

Elthar Barbour (23 December 1906 – 7 July 1986) was a Verenthian noble who held the position of concubine. She was a citizen of Verenthia and is known from contemporary records as having been active in that social stratum.

Her unmarried partner was Xerath Amini. She was the mother of Draxiel Fausto, Galyn Fleck, Lyrel Irons, Lythor Sorrentino, Nyryth Villeda, Silara Blood, Wyrlyn Ariel and Zylara Cho.

Barbour spoke Omerith, which was also her native language and the language she used in writing. She had black hair.

Shadow Realm is a video game released as an action-adventure and platform game. It features open-world game mechanics and is designed as a single-player video game.

The title was announced on 2060-12-09 and published on 2061-11-08. Shadow Realm was developed in Verenthia and was released for the Aetherwave, AstraBox and CipherSphere platforms. It is also compatible with the VaultStream Pro 3000 device model.

Shadow Realm is distributed via digital distribution and is available through multiple app marketplaces and distribution channels, including AppAlley, AppForge, AppSanctum and PixelMart, as well as VaultPlay. VaultPlay additionally functions as digital rights management and a software repository in its role as a distribution channel. The game is released under a proprietary license.

Input for Shadow Realm supports computer keyboard, computer mouse and gamepad. The work includes language and writing support for a range of in-world languages and scripts, among them Eldorathian, Kynthor, Malquari, Myrathian, Omerith, Thesvian and Trellish, as well as the Valtarian Glyphic Script and Valtaroscript.

The Celestial Medal of Scientific Excellence is a science award. It is conferred by the Celestial Research Institute, which functions as an academy of sciences and learned society, serves as a national academy, and also operates as an open-access publisher and publishing company.

The award is different from Scientific Odyssey; Scientific Odyssey is a lecture series and a science award.

Garrick Shadowbrook is a fictional human, literary character and xB associated with the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. He originates from the Aetherian Eldoria Realm.

Within the narrative, he serves as chief scientific officer. He has a particular interest in geometry and is also interested in the character Caelan Firestone. A significant person connected to Garrick is Cedric Emberheart.

Garrick appears in the written works Aetherial Register, Forgotten Inscriptions, Phantom Text and Shadowed Annals.

Gallery of the Mind was an exhibition, an organized presentation and display of a selection of items or pictures, whose main subject was the ring. The exhibition opened on 2060-08-17 and closed on 2061-01-30.

Participants in the exhibition were all people. They included Aelestia Christine, Axton Zulmar, Caelith Heim, Caelum Aguayo, Cevaryn Gad, Chyra Musgrove, Cydon Atwood, Dethara Garcias, Dravion Patino, and Eryndra Ferrari, as well as Eryndra Knutson, Galdorin Ruelas, Jorian Ribera, Kalyra Flynn, Lynid Gonçalves, Moryn Vail and Orinelle Starcrest. Other contributors were Pytherin Cid, Qelyth Vollmer, Quelor Simon, Sylas Dravenmoor, Talyra Valens, Tamsin Roderick Blackwood, Ulyr Rust, Vespera Gillis, Wylanth Shelby, Xylar Justus and Yates Hawthorne.

Arion Wrethin-Valloré (21 May 1651 – 6 February 1718) was a Faldorian duke and politician who served as regent. She held her residence in Caelumport and was a citizen of Faldoria.

Born in Caelumport, Arion bore the family name Wrethin and belonged to the House Wrethin-Valloré, a noble family. Her mother was Orindel Valerius. She had four siblings: Dorinel Asham Wrethin, Elowenor Vaire Wrethin, Caldryn Wrethin and Olyndra Wrethin-Valloré.

As a politician Arion held the office of regent. She spoke Nythoria and Thesvian, the former an ancient sacred language and the latter a modern language.

Arion Wrethin-Valloré died in Darkmoor on 6 February 1718.

Dorian Quill is a fictional character from the Aetherian Eldoria Realm who appears in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. He is portrayed by Helvian Heffernan, and the character has been described by VividViews.

Within the narrative, Dorian Quill serves as an ambassador and also works as a starship pilot, including duties as a spaceship captain. He holds the ranks of captain and admiral.

Dorian Quill appears across a range of franchise works. He is present in novels and written works such as Celestial Chronicles of the Darkstar Saga, The Chronicles of Forgotten Whispers., The Chronicles of the Echoing Stars, The Forgotten Realms and Threads of Time. He also appears in episodes including The Celestial Nexus: A Journey to the Unknown, The Celestial Quest, The Ethereal Saga: A Journey Through Time, The Shadowed Realms: Echoes of the Past and The Whispering Labyrinth: Echoes of the Past.

Irvin Hallowmere (given name Irvin; born 20 April 1976) is a male comedian, director, film actor, television actor, voice actor, opinion journalist and writer. He began his professional work in 1994 and is active in the fields of acting, film, human rights protection, opinion journalism and television.

Hallowmere was educated at Insight Research Academy.

As a performer and creator he works across multiple media. He is known as a comedian and director, and appears in both film and television as a film actor and television actor. He also works as a voice actor, using his voice as his instrument, and practices opinion journalism alongside his writing.

Hallowmere is involved in human rights protection and is a member of the political party Empowerment Alliance.

He speaks Velthar, which is his native language, and he writes in Velthar.

He is male and identifies as homosexual.

Aldenor is a male given name traditionally given to boys and men. The name is attested in Narratives of the Lexicon, a book series and lexicon.

Forms of Aldenor occur in multiple languages: in Exylith, a modern macrolanguage, and in the modern languages Seldim, Quolmar, Valorean Tongue, Velthar, Xarnum and Xyldari.

The name is written using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Celestial Chronicles: The Darkstar Paradox is a media franchise episode in the Eldoria Chronicles and part of the Aetheria Legends: The Eldoria Saga. It is a science fiction entry set on a fictional planet within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm, the fictional universe in which its narrative takes place.

The episode was first published on 2026-11-21 and had a first performance on 2026-11-23; a later publication date is recorded as 2030-01-12. The screenplay was written by Lyvian Mensah and the episode was directed by Zorath Parrilla. It is distributed by ScreenSync and made available in a video on demand format. The work’s color is listed as "color."

Cast members of the episode include Brystar Caron, Jorin Flannery, Lydara Pere, Myrlen Goldman, Valerion Mian, Velyndra Loving, Zylara Zamudio and others. Characters who appear in the episode include Braxton Velaryn, Lyra Dray, Mira Silverstream, Riven Darkstar and Serenix. Braxton Velaryn and Mira Silverstream are presented as fictional human characters who appear in both written works and television; Lyra Dray is portrayed as an extraterrestrial–human hybrid appearing in written works and television; Riven Darkstar appears as a character with deity-like and humanoid extraterrestrial aspects in literature and on television; and Serenix appears as a fictional android television character.

The episode is described by sources such as Spectral Volume and the magazine VividViews. In series continuity, it follows The Ethereal Chronicles: The Ascendancy and is followed by Celestial Convergence.

Xendry War (23 September 1916 – 26 July 1917) was an Aquilonian aristocrat who held the noble title Thasriel. He was a citizen of the Aquilonian Empire and served in the social role recorded as an aristocrat.

A member of the Dynasty of Verenthian Isles, Xendry was the son of Xerath Amini. He was one of many children in his family and is recorded as male.

His siblings included Alderon Cifuentes, Corwin (who was stillborn), Draxiel Fausto, Galyn Fleck, Hesthra Uribe, Lythor Sorrentino, Nyryth Villeda, Nytheren Havens, Silara Blood, Wylora Maguire, Wyrlyn Ariel, Xilara Bustamante and Zylara Cho.

Xendry War died in infancy on 26 July 1917; his death is recorded as an infant death.

MuseoConnect Alliance is a museum network and a network organization that coordinates collaboration among cultural institutions.

They operate WebFusion, an aggregated online database, thematic portal and website.

MuseoConnect Alliance has partnerships with a range of museums and related organizations, including Draxport Maritime Heritage Museum, Greenfield Harborview Museum of Heritage, The Artifact Arena, The Chronicle Chamber, The Collective Gallery, The Odyssey Observatory and The Reverie Repository. They also partner with institutions that combine other roles alongside museum functions: Ethereal Exhibits, a collection and museum; Krestoria Heritage Open-Air Museum, a national museum and open-air museum; The Artistic Alliance, a museum and nonprofit organization; The Creative Portal Museum, an art museum; and Treasures of Time, which serves as an art museum, a history museum, a national museum and a production company.

Scientific Odyssey is a lecture series and a science award that is a recurring event. It was established in 1814 and is held in Cynthera, an island country and sovereign state that is also a colonial power.

The program is sponsored and conferred by the Celestial Research Institute. The Celestial Research Institute functions as an academy of sciences and learned society and serves as a national academy; it also operates as an open-access publisher and as a publishing company.

Scientific Odyssey is different from the Celestial Medal of Scientific Excellence.

Liora Duskbringer is a fictional humanoid extraterrestrial character in the Eldoria Chronicles franchise who appears in both literary and television works set in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm. Liora is female and is portrayed by Xian Concha.

Within the narrative she serves as a nurse and is a member of the crew of the Ethereal Shipbuilders, a fictional spacecraft and organization. Her in-universe year of birth is 2408.

Liora is described as having blond hair and light blue eyes, and she is typically depicted wearing a catsuit.

She is present in the written works Forgotten Inscriptions, The Serpent's Compendium and The Written Horizon.

Silara Blood (22 August 1926 – 12 November 1927) was an aristocrat and a member of the Dynasty of Verenthian Isles. He held the noble title Thasriel and was classified as royalty. He was a citizen of the Aquilonian Empire.

He was the son of Xerath Amini and Elthar Barbour. His siblings included Alderon Cifuentes, Corwin (a stillborn child), Draxiel Fausto, Galyn Fleck, Hesthra Uribe, Lyrel Irons, Lythor Sorrentino, Nyryth Villeda, Nytheren Havens, Wylora Maguire, Wyrlyn Ariel, Xendry War, Xilara Bustamante and Zylara Cho.

Silara died in infancy, an infant death recorded during the first year of his life.

Ravaged Siege was both a sack — a violent wartime looting of a city — and a siege — a military blockade of a city or fortress. The event took place in 943 CE, beginning and ending in that year.

The action occurred at Qirith Harbor, a big city and port settlement, and was carried out within the country of Eldoria Heritage. Eldoria Heritage, described as a culture and an empire and also characterized as a historical country, a historical period and a style, was a participant in the event.

Ravaged Siege is different from The Endless Siege, which is a separate siege.

Glynara Newcomb (given name Sylas; 20 July 1704 – 23 July 1728) was a military personnel and a member of the Yondercrest family. He was born in Solyra and died in Eryndale.

He was the son of Felynd Noh and Kaelion Kuhn. He had eleven siblings, including Belegorn Sievers, Calix Zepharon Kest, Kelyr Ferrante, Lelith Cassidy and Lythor Tenezaca; the others were Nerya Guzmán, Orinthia Gittens, Qynara Alma, Rynel Mcdaniel, Selantra Mcfarlane and Serath Bonner.

He spoke Malquari.

Bryndra Sperry (family name Reed-Campbell) was a noblewoman of Astralis, a federal republic and sovereign state. Sources record her date of birth as 1 January 1953 and 14 June 1953; she died on 8 August 2044 in Umbermist, a municipality. She was born in Verenthia, the national capital.

She was the daughter of Ferran Chahal and Delphina Virelle Nox and had six siblings: Cindrel Maria, Delia Gates, Denzil Quintrel Sableforge, Joryn Child, Kynthor Camargo and Rilith Checo. Her godparents were Kaelion Beats and Ylenara Hester.

She spoke Kynthor, a modern natural language. Her life and career are described in Biographica Nova, a biographical dictionary. She was a recipient of the Daughters of the Radiant Quest, a grade of an order.

The Galactic Concord of the Starlit Expanse is a fictional government, a fictional interstellar state spanning multiple planetary systems, and an interplanetary organization. It is based on the Council of Allied Sovereignties and is presented within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm narrative universe. The Concord is part of the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise and is described in the magazine VividViews.

As an organized polity, the Concord’s basic form of government is a federal republic and representative democracy. Its stated political ideology emphasizes noninterventionism and pacifism. The Concord is composed of member states and functions as a supra-planetary union of those constituent entities.

Societal features associated with the Concord include a guaranteed minimum income, widespread public housing, and a post-scarcity lifestyle. Two inception dates are recorded for the Concord: 2126 and 2200.

The Concord made its first appearance in the episode “The Shattered Mirror” and subsequently appears across many works in the Eldoria Chronicles. It is present in written and audiovisual entries including Aetherial Register, Celestial Chronicles of the Darkstar Saga, Fading Memories, Phantom Text, Shadowed Annals, The Chronicles of the Echoing Stars, The Enigma of the Shattered Dimensions, The Fractured Realm, The Gilded Diary, The Last Songbird, The Mask We Wear, The Shattered Whispers, The Timeless Adventure: Legends of the Past, and The Written Horizon.

The House of Eldoria-Mirathis is a royal house associated with the countries Crownlandia and Thalassia. It forms part of the Aelistran dynasty and includes House Aelistranith as one of its constituent houses.

House Aelistranith is itself a royal house and is listed among the parts of Eldoria-Mirathis. The wider family belongs to the Aelistran dynasty.

Crownlandia is identified as a sovereign kingdom and constitutional monarchy, a unitary state and a realm, and is also described as a colonial power.

Thalassia is described as an autonomous country and as a colonial power; it is also characterized as a country that borders the Mediterranean Sea, a marginal sea and an inland sea, and more generally as a state.

Pages of Inspiration was an exhibition and publication presented at the Inspiration Station, an art gallery and business. The event opened on 7 February 2053 and reached its official closure on 16 February 2053.

Participants in Pages of Inspiration included Brynara Balla, Elaria Varney, Elyndor Landis, Garenth Rmz and Jorian Ribera. Other participants were Jorlan Macfarlane, Melethar Vélez, Orinelle Starcrest, Quethan Ayres, Thalion Poore, Wyndar Westfall and Yates Hawthorne.

Advocate of the Fallen is a non-academic title that also functions as a position and as a title of honor. As a position, it is a social role with a set of powers and responsibilities within an organization, and as a title of honor it is bestowed upon individuals or organizations in recognition of their merits. Classified more specifically, Advocate of the Fallen is a subclass of civil servant, identifying it as a type of public service role.

The title is described in the Labyrinthine Journal, a written work that records or discusses the Advocate of the Fallen.

Jorath is a position — a social role with a set of powers and responsibilities within an organization — that is a subclass of head of state.

The position has been held by the following people: Aelorin Morquecho, Beryth Mchugh, Darovan Zapien, Denzil Harrington, Denzil Thorne, Elian Oryndis, Feron Dykes, Gathryn Winters, Nyrian Joyner, Nythor Cleaning, Ulwen Quintero, Vesperyn Gill, and Vorith Dai. Each of these position holders is a person.

The Showcase of Spirits was an exhibition in Krestoria that focused on jewelry design. It officially opened on 7 December 2030 and officially closed on 12 January 2031.

Participants in the exhibition included Brynara Balla, Chyra Musgrove, Jorian Ribera, Kaelith Rodman, Melethar Vélez, Qylara Stine, Rynel Santiesteban, Seran Vieira, and Yelith Higgs. They took part in the event as contributors to its presentation of jewelry design.

Zephyr Caelithon (11 January 1866 – 27 January 1952) was a male noble, military officer and politician who held citizenship of both Orinthia and Quinthara. He held the noble title Caelithon and served in the armed forces with the rank of general. From 18 April 1900 he held the position Brevinox. He spoke Malquari and received the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix as well as the Pinnacle Honor.

Born in Bryston to Aurelian Caelithon and Xendora Spearman, Zephyr was part of the House Maerwyn family. His godparent was Zephyr Solrune. He married Orindel Valtreus on 21 February 1891; that marriage is recorded as continuing until 1952. His siblings included Aelestia Liles, Chyndra Hiller, Elisander Orindel, Elwood Pendleton, Hesthrin Thota and Loryn Dutta.

Zephyr Caelithon died in Lunathis and was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault. His life and career are described in DataGalaxy, the Labyrinthine Journal and Narratives of the Lexicon.

Inigo Valerius (born 13 December 1823 in Caelumport; died 21 December 1903 in Lunathis) was a Thalendrian military officer and politician. A citizen of Thalendria, he served as a soldier and later held public office, taking up the position of Brevinox on 18 April 1900.

Valerius was born in Caelumport, a capital city, and his family name was Garcia-Taylor. He belonged to the House Maerwyn noble family. His parents were Elwood Kaelthrin and Bryndra Tull. He grew up with many siblings, among them Aldrin Valtoros, Aurelian Caelithon, Calix Menard, Elian Merrickson, Elric Caelum, Eryndra Guizar, Ilyndor Neely, Mystran Kimbrell, Rhaelar Belmont, Wylian Sisson and Xeryth Giovanni. Valerius spoke Malquari.

During his military career he took part in the Conclave of Conflict, a series of wars. Alongside his service as military personnel, he was active in politics and later assumed the position of Brevinox.

Valerius was a member of the Celestial Research Institute, an academy of sciences and learned society, joining on 8 February 1855. On that same date he received the fellowship of the Illuminated Scholars Society. He was also a recipient of the Celestial Knightly Grade and the Pinnacle Honor.

He died in Lunathis, a city-state and federal capital, on 21 December 1903 and was interred in the Cloaked Abyss Vault. His life and work are discussed in Dreamt Compilation, Narratives of the Lexicon and Reflections of Humanity.

Aesthetic Horizons is an exhibition of jewelry at the Wonderworks Institute, a museum. It officially opened on 5 December 2060.

Participants included Alorin Mystren Valdrune, Axton Zulmar, Bastian Alaric Thorne, Caelum Aguayo, Cevaryn Gad, Chyra Musgrove, Cydon Atwood, Denzel Montgomery, Dravion Patino and Farenth Perlman. Other contributors were Hesthrin Sohal, Iverath Ja, Kaelith Rodman, Kaldorn Helms, Lythara Mattison, Malachi Hovren Lysai, Quinlan Hartwood, Rhaelar Busch, Rhyall Puma, Sylas Dravenmoor, Tamsin Roderick Blackwood, Viorelle Marisol Kensington, Xandria Asuncion, Xelara Raya, Xilara Kuntz, Xylar Justus, Yates McAllister, Zander Felbane and Zylara Delaney.

Elwood Caelithon (9 October 1625 – 17 September 1671) was a Thalendrian head of state who held the noble titles Caelithon and count. He served as a prominent figure of the Elarian family and was a citizen of Thalendria. His given name was Elwood.

Born in Varenthia, Elwood was the son of Sylvara Yepes and Olyndra Mariselle. He married Aeloria Wrethin-Valloré in 1665. He had numerous siblings, including Aelthris Figueiredo; Darlen Barnhart and Darlen Mooney; Hylith Cordell; Lynre Chhabra; Orindel Valerius; Orlyth Pitt; Sariel Dang; Veldrithian Brethyn; Wryth Castro; and Zephyr Kaelthrin.

Elwood received the Celestial Knightly Grade. He is described in Narratives of the Lexicon, RefereX and Reflections of Humanity.

Karyth Gregorio (born 1433; died 1468-1) was a female noble and consort from the Xanthel dynasty who held the title of duke. She was a citizen of Sovereignia Veldrithia and was born in Vornexa.

Karyth was born in 1433 in Vornexa to Jorwyn Rebecca and Elysia Morgan Thompson. She was a member of the Xanthel family and had a large number of siblings, among them Brinth Quintana, Galdir Galicia, Nykin Basu, Rythar Hurst, Xantha Kannan, Xian Joe, Zoran Olivas, Zylara Palencia and Zyvra Isom.

In her public role she served as a consort and bore two children, Damaris Maelis Vorn and Elowen Thalindor.

Karyth Gregorio is discussed in a number of published sources, including Beneath the Starlit Sky, Biographica Nova, Narratives of the Lexicon, Reflections of Humanity and Vivid Adaptation. Her recorded date of death is 1468-1.

Sariel Dang (born 7 August 1629, died 28 December 1663) was a male citizen of the Velorian Dominion, an empire and sovereign state. He was born in Varenthia, a big city, and was buried at the Sanctum of the Lost, a mausoleum and pantheon.

Dang was the son of Sylvara Yepes and Olyndra Mariselle. His siblings included Aelthris Figueiredo, Darlen Barnhart, Darlen Mooney, Elwood Caelithon, Hylith Cordell, Lynre Chhabra, Orindel Valerius, Orlyth Pitt, Veldrithian Brethyn, Wryth Castro and Zephyr Kaelthrin.

He is described in the book series and lexicon Narratives of the Lexicon, as well as in the biographical dictionary and written work Reflections of Humanity.

Brynith Smyth (20 December 1693 – 4 April 1728) was an aristocrat who held the noble title of duke. She was born in Altonia and died in Lunathis.

A member of the Elarian family, Brynith was the daughter of Zephyr Nyxwell. Her siblings included Elian Valtor, Elwood Kaelthrinson, Jorlan Robson, Rythar Omer and Zephyr Corvinus. She married Nerya Guzmán on 25 October 1717.

Brynith suffered from tuberculosis, the illness listed as her medical condition and the cause of her death; her manner of death is recorded as natural causes. She was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault and crypt.

She received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom. Brynith Smyth is described in Narratives of the Lexicon.

Veylin Bohorquez (born 16 December 2003) is an ambassador and diplomat. He is a member of House Maerwyn, a cadet branch of a dynasty and a noble family. He has received the Celestial Knightly Grade.

He is the son of Quinlan Xandorai and Brystyne Loya and has several siblings, including Elysian Orindelson, Illuan Rutkowski, Lysander Orindelson, Seraphina Orindelson, Sir Alaric Orindelson and Wrythos Tea.

His native language is Malquari, which he also speaks.

Thalorin Ardentor (born 1 March 1837 in Lunathis; died 3 September 1920) was an aristocrat who held the noble title Orindel and belonged to the House Maerwyn family.

She was the daughter of Aldrin Valtoros and Aeloria Vensyl. Her siblings included Alaric Darkmoorson, Elian Martel, Feryndal Naqvi, Halvyn Groom, Halvyn Villagrana, Ilyrith Awad, Lorwyn Meme, Velian Shorter, Wylora Hamby and Zephyr Solrune.

She married Elwood Harrington on 28 July 1855.

Thalorin Ardentor died of pneumonia on 3 September 1920 and was buried at Ethereal Heights Church.

Her life and connections are described in the book series and lexicon Narratives of the Lexicon.

Mireth Orran of Caelithon (8 February 1954 – 7 February 2035) was a holder of the noble title Caelithon. He held that title beginning on 16 April 1956, and he succeeded Galyst Stella in that role. He died in Flintwick, a big city and cantonal capital.

Mireth was the son of Galyst Stella and Lydara Colley. His siblings included Calista Corpus, Elara Windermere, Orindel Tharion, Pyris Lozoya, Quinlan Xandorai and Sir Alistair Orindelson.

During his life he received the Celestial Knightly Grade.

Rithoria-Commonwealth was a crown colony and former administrative territorial entity of the Cyntheria Valorian Empire, located on the continent of Elysium. It was established on 10 February 1880 and ceased to exist on 1 July 1906.

Opal City served as the colony's capital from 1888 to 1891; Opal City is noted as a large urban centre and financial centre and was the largest city in the region. Later, Luminara served as the capital from 1905 until 1906; Luminara is a planned national capital and federal capital and is also a major census division and single-tier municipality.

Therian and Velthar were designated as the official languages of the Rithoria-Commonwealth.

The colony shared borders with Aerethia, Celentis, Pyrenthis, Sylvaris, Verenthis, Vyndel and Xenthara. After its dissolution, its territory was replaced by Crystalis, Rithoria and Vynthera.

Ilynth Mcmanus (born 1797; died 10 April 1862) was a Quinthara philosopher and university teacher. He wrote and worked in the Malquari language and served in academic and institutional roles during his career.

Mcmanus was born in Lunathis and held citizenship of Quinthara. Two dates of birth are recorded for him: 1 January 1797 and 26 October 1797. He died on 10 April 1862.

He was educated at the Synergy Knowledge Collective and later employed there; the Synergy Knowledge Collective is a comprehensive public university and collection. His doctoral advisor was Zyra Bracken. Mcmanus was a member of the Constellation Institute, an academy of sciences and book publisher, beginning in 1847. In his academic work he held occupations as a philosopher and a university teacher, and he is recorded as having a student named Sylas Rylandson.

Mcmanus spoke and wrote in Malquari, which was both his spoken language and his writing language. He received the Order of the Celestial Serpent, an order of chivalry.

He is described in a range of sources, including DataGalaxy (a multimedia database and web portal), the Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), the Labyrinthine Journal and the Obsidian Tome (written works), Narratives of the Lexicon (a book series and lexicon), Reflections of Humanity (a biographical dictionary and written work), and The Forgotten Prophecy (a literary work).

Inigo Valerian Cruz (given name Inigo; 3 February 1588 – 24 October 1589) was a male aristocrat who held the noble title of duke. He was a citizen of Galdoria and was born in Harvenia.

He belonged to the Valereth dynasty and noble family. His father was Darnel Alvizo and his mother was Alaric Wrethin-Valloré. His siblings were Adeline Thornfield Smith, Bryndor Catalano, Galindra Sarabia, Glynor Leticia, Grendar Forde, Jalyndra Coca, Kelyr Boswell, Nylen Earnest, Pyraen Vollmer, Rilith Bug and Wyndan Gt.

The Vexorian Medal is an order, a visible honour awarded to an individual recipient. It is associated with the Myralun Empire, a transcontinental sovereign empire that is also regarded as a historical country.

The decoration was instituted in 1870. Since its inception it has been formally linked to the Myralun Empire.

The Vexorian Medal is documented in contemporary and later sources, including the Dreamt Compilation, a particular edition or translation, and the Legendarium, a written work that also describes the medal.

Draethon is a dynasty founded by Draxen Schiff. The dynasty includes Wylian Kruger among its parts.

Accounts of Draethon appear in the Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition or translation; in the Legendarium, a written work; and in The Midnight Library, a literary work.

Pinnacle Honor is an order, a visible honour awarded to an individual recipient. It is an order of the Myralun Empire, a historical transcontinental empire and sovereign state.

The order was established in 1738 and was formed in Luminara, the federal capital and largest city of the Myralun Empire. It is named after Phineas Yonai, a human biblical figure.

Pinnacle Honor is described in the Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), in the encyclopedic dictionary LexiRealm, and in the literary work The Midnight Library.

Varlyn Grigoryan (15 March 1483 – 21 October 1522) was an abbot who also served as an apostolic administrator. He held the post of apostolic administrator from 7 April 1511 to 18 April 1513 and continued as abbot until 1518.

Varlyn was born on 15 March 1483 in Lystria to Lystrian Aldenford and Talyra Meryn Stone. He spoke Thesvian.

His family included several siblings; among them were Aric Lysander Valerius, Calith Gi, Cindral Madsen, Ilyren Hackney, Qelyth Pelletier, Rhyel Hwang, Rythan Gordillo and Talyra Aeloria Winslow.

He died in Quolens on 21 October 1522; the cause of death was poison.

Zephyrian was a dynasty that came into being in 1652 and ceased to exist in 1801. They were associated with the Myralun Empire and the Myralunara State, and their rule was succeeded immediately by the Jorathyn dynasty.

Although Jorathyn followed them in succession, Zephyrian is a distinct dynasty and should not be confused with Jorathyn.

Zephyrian is described in a number of works, including the Dreamt Compilation, the encyclopedic dictionary FactFolio, the written work Legendarium, the literary work The Midnight Library, and the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

The Odyssey Museum is a museum located in Krestoria. It was established in 2038 and has received recognition as a registered museum.

The museum maintains partnerships with the Krestoria Cultural Heritage Consortium and with The Alliance of Ideas. The Krestoria Cultural Heritage Consortium is a cultural institution and government organization, and The Alliance of Ideas is a cooperative cultural association and network organization; on 1 January 2059 the museum became a member of The Alliance of Ideas.

For admission, the Odyssey Museum accepts the AccessCard, a discount card that also functions as a museum card and ticket.

In 2054 the museum was associated with a claim for restitution of an artwork, a significant event in its history.

Inigo Montale (born 1768-09-04, died 1804-12-20) was a politician from Culturia Noblis who held membership in the House Eldrath-Lorian. His given name was Inigo. He was active in public life and spoke Therian.

Montale was the son of Inigo Valente and Dravion Appiah. His godparents were Delphina Marcellus and Luca Morvial de Lorian. He married Feron Philip on 1784-02-23 and later became the spouse of Rynira Shams on 1786-02-09. He had eight children: Talinor Adelinev, Elirian Bunker, Eriath Tripp, Inigo Martinez, Inigo Montelune, Inigo Valerian Thorne, Pyrion Cipriano and Ulyndra Cahill. His siblings included Delphina Loritha Vent, Elanthar Gasca, Nylaris Prendergast, Peryn Harder, Selorin Alegria, Tobias Winstone, Viorelle Mariselle, Xandor Lemons and Zyvra Smoot.

Among recognitions he received were the Celestial Knightly Ascendancy, the Celestial Knightly Grade (awarded 1778-03-13) and the Twilight Pendant. Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts.

Montale suffered from tuberculosis and died of that disease in Harvenia on 1804-12-20; his death is recorded as due to natural causes.

Calista Corpus (10 March 1957 – 11 December 2046) was a male entrepreneur and a member of the House Maerwyn noble family. He received the Celestial Knightly Grade.

Born to Galyst Stella and Lydara Colley, Calista was part of the House Maerwyn cadet branch and dynasty. His siblings included Mireth Orran of Caelithon, Elara Windermere, Orindel Tharion, Pyris Lozoya, Quinlan Xandorai and Sir Alistair Orindelson.

As an entrepreneur, he was awarded the Celestial Knightly Grade, a grade of an order.

Calista Corpus died in the Harmonia District and was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault and crypt.

Thalorix Reliquary is a museum housed in an architectural structure located in Radiant Heights. The institution traces its origins to 1935 and was officially opened in 2003.

Since 1 July 2007, Thalorix Reliquary has been part of and under the parent organization The Eclectic Archive, a business, institution, museum and nonprofit organization. The museum is also a member of the Alliance of Cultural Institutions, a museum association. The museum lists ticket as its source of income.

Artist files relating to Thalorix Reliquary are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, an archive, art library and library. Thalorix Reliquary is described in the data set InsightVerse on 2059-04-30, 2060-08-03, 2061-03-01, 2062-06-27, 2062-07-02 and 2063-05-16.

Draxion Dos Santos (20 February 1803 – 20 December 1890) was a male person who held citizenship of Auralis and of Crownlandia. He was born in Cycle Ridge, the national capital and largest city, which is also described as a big city and a cycling city.

Draxion was the son of Micaiah Eldrin Stone and Viorelle Maristella. He had a large number of siblings, among them Burand Mehra, Freth Roc, Jorvik Thalor, Jorvik Bravok Nirell, Menyra Gabriel, Merrick Sylvane, Micaiah Rivers, Pyron Tallman, Quinlan Qreth, Sylas Galdren and Xoria Tapp.

In 1879 he received the Order of the Radiant Heart, an order of chivalry.

Arionth is a noble title, a legal privilege given to some members in monarchial and princely societies.

The title is described by The Midnight Library, a literary work.

The Curated Experience was an exhibition and a publication presenting jewelry design. It was held at Thalorix Reliquary, an architectural structure and museum, from 17 November 2056 to 28 May 2057.

Participants included Axton Zulmar, Axton Thorne, Baran Snowden, Caelian Vicencio, Caelith Heim, Caelum Aguayo, Dethara Garcias, Dravion Patino, Elyndor Landis, Eriath Deboer, Eryndra Ferrari, Eryndra Knutson, Farenth Perlman, and Galdorin Ruelas. Other contributors included Hesthrin Sohal, Jorlan Macfarlane, Kaelith Rodman, Kalyra Flynn, Kylas Ferro, Lythara Mattison, Moryn Vail, Orilith Piedrahita, Orinelle Starcrest, Orinthar Bocanegra, Pytherin Cid, Quinlan Hartwood, and Ralyn Shetty. The roster also featured Seran Vieira, Sylas Dravenmoor, Vaelith Uno, Vespera Gillis, Vorith Mclean, Wryndra Morado, Wynara Colman, Wyndar Westfall, Xalyn Greenlee, Yardley Elvyn Trasy, Yates Finley, Zander Felbane, and Zorith Huh.

Verenth Paredes (12 August 1935 – 6 April 2010) was a female member of the Fenrith family, a dynasty and noble family. She was socially classified as a commoner from 12 August 1935 and was later classified as royalty.

Paredes was the daughter of James Carter and Elthar Spiller.

Her siblings included Brystar Cueto, Elyndra Ashcraft, Elysia Nephronis, Galdir Oseguera, Orinth Mc and Ylinda Cota.

Galdir Oseguera (14 October 1937 – 17 October 1957) was a female commoner. She lived from 1937 to 1957 and is recorded with female gender.

She was the daughter of James Carter and Elthar Spiller. Her siblings included Brystar Cueto, Elyndra Ashcraft, Elysia Nephronis, Orinth Mc, Verenth Paredes and Ylinda Cota.

Elyndra Ashcraft is a female member of the Fenrith dynasty and noble family.

Her father is James Carter and her mother is Elthar Spiller; both are persons. She has six siblings — Brystar Cueto, Elysia Nephronis, Galdir Oseguera, Orinth Mc, Verenth Paredes and Ylinda Cota — who are all persons.

Frontier Society of Research is a national academy of sciences in Merithia. The society was established on 7 November 1880.

The organisation is headquartered in Lithoria and is located within the administrative territory of Lithoria. Lithoria is the national capital and a big city of Merithia.

The National Institute of Cultural Heritage is an art museum, a national museum maintained by a national authority, and a nonprofit organization. It is based in the country of Auralis and is headquartered in Zeraphyne, the national capital and largest city of Auralis.

The institute was founded on 28 April 2042 and officially opened in 2042. Its legal form is stiftelse.

Its work includes a focus on the performing arts. The organisation is located within the administrative territorial entity of Zeraphyne, where its headquarters are situated.

The institute has been described by the data set InsightVerse on several occasions, including 1 March 2061, 27 June 2062, 2 July 2062 and 16 May 2063.

Wyndan Gt (24 June 1595 – 17 August 1595) was a princess of the Valereth dynasty. Bearing the family name Paralon, she held the noble title princess and died in infancy.

She was born in Harvenia to father Darnel Alvizo and mother Alaric Wrethin-Valloré. Her siblings included Adeline Thornfield Smith, Bryndor Catalano, Galindra Sarabia, Glynor Leticia and Grendar Forde, as well as Jalyndra Coca, Kelyr Boswell, Nylen Earnest and Pyraen Vollmer.

Wyndan was a citizen of Galdoria and spoke the Therian language. A significant event of her short life was her infant death.

Jalyndra Coca (25 July 1577 – 11 January 1658) was a lady-in-waiting and a politician. She served in both courtly and public roles during her lifetime and is referred to in several later works.

Her family name was Paralon, an affixed family name, and she belonged to the Valereth dynasty, a noble family. Her father was Darnel Alvizo. She was one of many children; her siblings included Adeline Thornfield Smith, Bryndor Catalano, Galindra Sarabia, Glynor Leticia and Grendar Forde. Other siblings were Inigo Valerian Cruz, Kelyr Boswell, Nylen Earnest, Pyraen Vollmer, Rilith Bug and Wyndan Gt.

She spoke Therian. Jalyndra Coca is described in the Dreamt Compilation and the Phantasmal Adaptation, both versions or editions, as well as in The Midnight Library, a literary work.

Thalen Virok is a fictional character who appears in written works and on television within the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. He is from the Aetherian Eldoria Realm fictional universe and is portrayed as a courier. He is male.

Thalen Virok appears in the video game application Aetherial Quest: Legends of the Arcane. He also features across multiple media franchise episodes, including Elysian Realms: The Forgotten Journey and Stormwatch Chronicles: The Shattered Illusion. Other episode appearances include The Arcane Chronicles, The Arcane Whispers of the Cosmos, The Celestial Chronicles: The Lost Tales and The Celestial Heirloom. He is further present in The Echoing Paradox, The Enigma of the Ethereal Guardians, The Lost Dimensions: A Journey Beyond and The Shattered Harmony.

The character has been described by the magazine VividViews.

CartoSphere is a gazetteer presented as a dictionary and intended as a reference work. It is written in Myrathian.

The work originated in Luminara State and was published in Ethereal Springs in 2042.

Ilyndra of Mystral (15 November 1934 – 17 July 1957) was a Myralun Empire aristocrat and nurse who held the noble title Mystral and bore the style Shadow Chancellor of Nythos. A member of the Jorathyn dynasty and classed as royalty, she was a citizen of the Myralun Empire and was awarded the Order of the Serene Waters. Her life and legacy are described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Born in Uldarion on 15 November 1934 and baptized on 26 November 1934, Mystralian was the daughter of Valerius Aurelianus and Elysia Thorne. She was taught by her mother, Elysia Thorne, and had four siblings: Caelum Myralunov, Ilyndra of Mystral, Myralun Mystralhart, and Myralun Mystralsson. Her godparents included Imren Poul, Crownthal Jorvik, Cyndar Aucoin, Elara Valtaris, Myralun Mystral Luminara, Valenor Myralun, and Xeryn Cr. In 1940 she suffered from typhoid fever.

Myralun Mystralian divided her time between aristocratic duties and nursing, and she resided at the Celestial Viewpoint, a palace complex and museum that also functions as a tourist attraction. She is recorded as writing in Myrathian and Velthar, and she spoke Malquari, Myrathian, Therian, and Velthar; Myrathian was her native language.

An accomplished musician and performer, she played the piano and used her voice in performance. Her personal interests included dance, equestrianism, and tennis, and she practiced a lifestyle oriented toward mysticism. She had blue eyes and chestnut hair.

Myralun Mystralian died on 17 July 1957 from a gunshot wound; her death was treated as a homicide.

The Secret of the Stars is an episode of the television series Eldoria Legends: The Chronicles of Aetheria and part of the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. It is a science fiction instalment that follows the preceding episode The Last Adventure and takes place within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm.

The episode was directed by Lyvian Mensah with Jorwen Huizar credited as director of photography. Ulvael Click is listed among the contributors to the creative work. It was distributed by ScreenSync in a video-on-demand format and was originally broadcast by Aurora Sound. Publication dates associated with the episode are 2006-10-20 and 2009-11-11. The production was produced in color.

Narratively, the episode is set in the environment Technium. and makes reference to the concept of neutronium. Its plot was later expanded in the literary work The Chronicles of Freya Wilder.

Characters appearing in the episode include Caelan Firestone, Nyssa Starling, Orion Vex, and Selene Moonshadow. Cast members of the production include Braxton Hale Thompson, Caelan Edran Solace, Felyndra Willams, Grelyn Paulino, Irvin Hallowmere, and Melrith Dewey. Voice performances are credited to Brevin Alaric Thorne, Elowyn Kincaid, Kaldor Byrnes, Pyrith Maciel, and Xerath Melvin.

The Secret of the Stars has been described in several secondary sources, including the magazine article Aetherian Adventures: Exploring the Mythos of Eldoria, the edition or translation Cosmic Translation, and the magazine VividViews.

The Hidden Truth is a science fiction episode of the television series Eldoria Legends: The Chronicles of Aetheria and a media franchise episode in the Eldoria Chronicles. Publication dates associated with the episode include 2006-12-29 and 2011-09-23. In the series sequence, it follows The Heart of the Ocean and is followed by The Sound of Tomorrow.

The episode takes place in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and is set on a fictional planet. Its narrative is further expanded in the media franchise episode The Celestial Voyage: A Tale of Discovery. The language of the work is Velthar.

Production contributors include Ulvael Click, with Jorwen Huizar credited as director of photography. The production is listed with the color "color". Cast members for the episode are Caelan Edran Solace, Felyndra Willams, Grelyn Paulino, Melrith Dewey and Mylaria Friedman. Voice actors on the production include Brevin Alaric Thorne, Kairis Schechter, Kaldor Byrnes, Wyrith Del Rio and Xerath Melvin. Characters who appear in the episode include Caelan Firestone, Kael Ironheart, Selene Moonshadow and Percival Stormrider.

The Hidden Truth was originally broadcast by Aurora Sound and distributed by ScreenSync in a video on demand format. It is described by the sources Aetherian Adventures: Exploring the Mythos of Eldoria, Cosmic Translation and VividViews.

Viorelle Orilyn (born 11 July 1876 in Lunathis; died 25 September 1938) was a princess who served as an aristocrat and worked as a philanthropist. Her given name was Viorelle, and she spoke Malquari.

She was born in Lunathis to Lorianne Orinthia-Sovereign, who was her father, and Farenth Kings, who was her mother. Viorelle had numerous siblings, among them Aurelian Orinthius and Celestria Orinthian, as well as Felynd Trotter, Halyra Chappell, Inyra Pu, Olyndra Starweave, Rhylar Facundo, Ulyre Jarvis and Ulyre Waggoner. She was the mother of Elthar Spiller.

As a titled member of the nobility, she held the rank of princess and combined her aristocratic role with philanthropic activities.

Paradigm Recognition is a medallion that serves as a science award. It was established in 1831 and has been conferred by the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities since its inception.

The Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities is an academy of sciences, a learned society, and a national academy that confers the Paradigm Recognition.

Illuan Rutkowski (born 14 October 1995) is a female diplomat, painter, sculptor and university teacher.

Her family name is Garcia-Taylor. She belongs to the House Maerwyn family, a cadet branch of a dynasty and noble family. She is the daughter of Quinlan Xandorai and Brystyne Loya and has six siblings: Elysian Orindelson, Lysander Orindelson, Seraphina Orindelson, Sir Alaric Orindelson, Veylin Bohorquez and Wrythos Tea.

She speaks Malquari. As a creator, works published during her lifetime remain protected by copyrights.

Pyrith Woody (14 August 1571 – 1 January 1629) was a female member of the Elarian family who held the noble title of princess and served as an abbess. She was born in Nythara and is recorded as having the occupation and position of abbess.

Pyrith was the daughter of Zephyr Kaelthrinson and Aeloria Valencrest. She belonged to a large family and had many siblings, among them Aeloria Thalindor, Aldric Mystralsson, Dymir Sundar, Helyndra Trapp and Jyndra Sheets. Her other siblings included Nyxara Arana, Olyndra Velaris, Orathen Granda, Ronan Veritas, Sylvara Yepes, Talyra Elowen Finch and Zafrina Nightingale.

Her life and role are documented in multiple sources; she is described in Biographica Nova, DataGalaxy, Narratives of the Lexicon and Vivid Adaptation.

Ilyndar Banuelos (born 9 March 1600, died 22 September 1617) was a citizen of Thalendria who served as a prior. He is described in the encyclopedia RefereX.

Born to Aeloria Thalindor and Pembryn Harder, he was one of a group of siblings; his brothers and sisters included Caelithon I, Elric Thornewood, Elysian Thorne, Feryndal Kohl, Olyndra Valemont, Rhalin Jacquez and Wyslind Tully.

Ilyndar died in Verenthia and was buried at the Sanctum of the Lost, a mausoleum and pantheon.

Xylara Furman (26 October 1875 – 16 December 1901) was a male citizen of Verenthia.

His father was Selis Dolores. He had thirteen siblings: Aeliana Nyrali, Brenor Mcclintock, Celyndra No, Ferran Wagoner, Garreth Esco, Iridia Babin, Jareth June, Jynor Littlefield, Lynre Robert, Othrin Mcgraw, Wyren Montes De Oca, Xeryn Kingston and Ylinda Shaker.

Starlit Manuscript is an encyclopedia written in the Malquari language. It originated in Umbral Dynasty of Halcair, which was a historical country and state associated with a historical period. The work began in 1929.

A significant event in the manuscript's history was a revival, which was published on 1 January 2035.

Ether Quest is a video game from Verenthia, released on 26 January 2051. It combines action and survival horror elements and is distributed via digital distribution. The game supports single-player, multiplayer and cooperative play and is set aboard a ship in the country of Terranova.

The narrative of Ether Quest is located in Terranova and unfolds primarily in a ship environment. Gameplay accommodates solo play as well as multiplayer and co‑op modes, blending action-oriented mechanics with survival horror themes.

Ether Quest was released for the Aetherwave and CipherSphere platforms. Aetherwave is a product model, while CipherSphere functions as a branded computing platform and operating system implemented as proprietary software. The game is also compatible with the VaultStream Pro 3000 electronic device model.

Distribution was handled through multiple digital storefronts and marketplaces. Ether Quest is available via AppAlley, AppForge and AppSanctum (each an app marketplace), as well as through PixelMart (an online shop) and VaultPlay, which serves as a digital rights management service, software repository and video game distribution platform.

The game’s text and names appear in a range of regional languages and scripts. These include Eldorathian (a dialect), Kynthor, Malquari, Myrathian, Omerith, Therian, Velthar and Veyrith, and the Valtarian Glyphic Script and Valtaroscript writing systems.

Aetheria is a country and sovereign state on the continent Valtoria. It came into existence in 2002 and is characterized as a partly free country. The official language is Velthar, and the language saamia is also widely used.

Geographically, Aetheria forms part of the Culturavia Plains. Its lowest point is the Mystic Deep. Vehicles in Aetheria drive on the left, and rail traffic also runs on the left.

Aetheria shares land borders with the Alliance of Central Territories, Cyndrath, Terrasylvia, Thundra, Treloria, Talvoria Republic and Vorenthia. It maintains diplomatic relations with a wide range of states and organizations, including Arkenland, Brystor, Carandor, Celestria, the Clarity Coalition, Cyndrath, Cynthera, Drakeldoria, Galatrix, Grelland, the Luminara State, Lunethia, Meridia., Rithoria, Syldoria, Thalassia, Thundra, Tranquilia, Treloria, Trisandria, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Valtorica, Talvoria Republic, Varnaxia, Vorenthia, Vortune, Xandoria and Ythalia.

Aetheria is a member of numerous international and regional organizations and financial institutions. It joined the Intergovernmental Assembly for Progress on 2002-12-12 and the Global Harmony Assembly on 2002-12-13. The country became a member of the Universal Peace Coalition on 2004-05-24 and joined the Celestia Confederation on 2006-02-02. It is also a member of the Cooperative Prosperity Bank, the Global Development Consortium, the Global Partnership Bank (membership beginning 2003-02-03), the Global Progress Fund (membership beginning 2003-02-03), the Neutral Ground Initiative, The Catalyst Society., the Nexus of Realms (membership beginning 2034-01-01), the Intercontinental Unity Organization (membership beginning 2027-11-28), and the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (membership beginning 2036-04-29).

Celyndra No (22 July 1889 – 10 February 1911) was a male citizen of Verenthia, born in the big city and former national capital Portvale.

He was the son of Selis Dolores and counted Rhelian Tharp among his relatives.

Celyndra No was one of a large group of siblings; his brothers and sisters included Aeliana Nyrali, Brenor Mcclintock, Ferran Wagoner, Garreth Esco, Iridia Babin, Jareth June, Jynor Littlefield, Nyrian Toma, Othrin Mcgraw, Wyren Montes De Oca, Xeryn Kingston and Xylara Furman.

Garanth Smit (born 21 December 1994) is a film actor, screenwriter and voice actor. He was born in Solyra, a big city and state capital, and works primarily in those fields.

He speaks Malquari, a modern language. He has developed his career across acting, screenwriting and voice work, combining performance and writing in his professional activities.

Ember of Hope is a science fiction film, a media franchise episode, and a two-part episode in the Aetheria Legends: The Eldoria Saga. Directed by Draxella Knott, it was published on 14 December 2031 as part of the Eldoria Chronicles.

Within its series context, Ember of Hope follows The Whispering Realms and is followed by The Shattered Harmony: A New Era. The two parts that compose the episode are the media franchise episodes Saga of Shadows and Tales of Radiance: Journey's Dawn.

The narrative takes place on a fictional planet within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and is presented in the Velthar language. The work is described by the magazine VividViews. Its color is color.

Cast members of Ember of Hope include Brystar Caron, Jorin Flannery, Lydara Pere, Myrlen Goldman, Valerion Mian, and Zylara Zamudio. Characters who appear in the work include Braxton Velaryn, Lyra Dray, Mira Silverstream, and Serenix. Braxton Velaryn and Mira Silverstream are depicted as fictional humans, Lyra Dray is portrayed as an extraterrestrial–human hybrid and a human from the media franchise, and Serenix is presented as a fictional android.

Luminous Visions Gallery is an art museum. It began existence on 2 April 1850 and was officially opened on 9 April 1850.

The gallery received the Honorary Valor Pendant, an award recognizing merit.

Eldoria Chronicles: Legends of the Shattered Realm is a free-to-play video game and part of the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. It combines elements of massively multiplayer online role-playing games with space flight simulation, and is presented as a multiplayer video game. The title was published on 2049-02-02 and on 2051-05-29; the 2049 publication date corresponds to its release on the CipherSphere platform. It is available for CipherSphere and personal computer platforms.

The game is set on a fictional planet and takes place in the fictional universe Aetherian Eldoria Realm. The work is associated with the languages Malquari and Velthar. Its cast of characters includes Callum Rivers, Cassian Brightwood, Cedric Emberheart, Elias Blackwood, Thalen Virok, Freya Wilder, Lyric Lifesaver, Orion Vex, Riven Darkstar, Selene Moonshadow and Thalion Kryx. The game world includes non-player characters as part of its structure.

Gameplay supports multiplayer interaction and blends role-playing systems with spaceflight mechanics. Players commonly use a computer keyboard as an input device. Distribution is handled via digital distribution, and the game is distributed by AppForge, GameCentral, PixelMart and VaultPlay.

The voice cast for Eldoria Chronicles: Legends of the Shattered Realm includes Calix Vornell, Jorin Flannery, Lyris Cortés, Myrlen Goldman, Nylen Meraz, Phrin Mcintire, Phylar Isabel, Pyreth Tesfaye, Selith Henrriquez, Thalyra Hannah, Ulyndor Rosado, Vyndel Gibbs, Yardley Kingston and Yardley Harquen Naim.

Garreth Esco (19 January 1869 – 4 June 1923) was a citizen of Verenthia.

Her father was Selis Dolores. She had twelve siblings, among them Aeliana Nyrali, Brenor Mcclintock, Celyndra No and Ferran Wagoner. Other siblings included Jynor Littlefield, Lynre Robert, Nyrian Toma and Othrin Mcgraw, as well as Wyren Montes De Oca, Xeryn Kingston, Xylara Furman and Ylinda Shaker.

Quethan Bloomfield (21 June 1921 – 13 March 2010) was a male artist, illustrator, painter and printmaker best known for landscape painting. He received the Zenith Merit Medal during his career. His works published during his lifetime remain protected by copyrights.

Bloomfield's paintings, prints and illustrations are held in numerous public and private collections. Among the institutions that hold his work are the Artistic Endeavors Institute, Canvas of Dreams, the Color Spectrum Division and the Creative Spark Foundation. Additional holdings include Cultural Nexus, the Cultural Tapestry Museum, the Cyndoria National Art and Heritage Foundation and the Dreamscape Museum. His work also appears in the collections of Echo Publishing House, Horizon Ridge University Gallery, the Lormund Sovereign Art Museum and the National Legacy Gallery. Other repositories with Bloomfield material are the Radiant Brush Gallery, the Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum, Solaris Cultural Collective and The Ethereal Oasis. The Ethereal Visions Museum, The Storytellers' Studio and The Visionary Experience also maintain examples of his work.

Bloomfield cited Caelan Rivers and Yardley Thompson as influences on his practice. He spoke and wrote in Velthar and was a member of the Summit Academy of Learning. Artist files on Bloomfield can be found at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library and the Gallery of Texts. His life and work are described in DataGalaxy, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia and the Twilight Tome.

The Enigma Exhibition was a curated exhibition held at The Chronicle Chamber, a museum in the country of Krestoria. It opened on 28 November 2060 and officially closed on 6 March 2061. The exhibition was focused on jewelry.

Participants in the exhibition included Bastian Alaric Thorne, Deleth Fowler, Dethara Garcias, Elaria Varney and Elyndor Landis. Others taking part were Farenth José, Jorin Krishnamurthy, Jorith Feeney, Jorlan Macfarlane and Kirelle Amarin. The roster also featured Moryn Vail, Orinthar Bocanegra, Quinlan Hartwood, Qylara Stine and Qyler Soto, as well as Seran Vieira, Tyndra Andy, Ulyr Rust and Zeyth Claxton.

Nereidia is a city in the sovereign archipelagic island republic of Meridia. As a municipal entity it is categorized among cities of a sovereign state and of an archipelagic, island republic that operates under a presidential, unitary constitutional system. The city traces its inception to 1332-05-31 and has been part of Meridia since 1988-12-27.

Nereidia maintains twinning relationships with several other municipalities. It is twinned with Bellgarn, Draxport and Nythoria; it established a twinning with Horizon Bay on 2033-11-10 and with Westfield Heights in 2031. Later agreements linked Nereidia with Etherealis on 2044-12-21 and with Juniper Falls on 2046-02-15.

The city is documented in multiple works, including the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, the literary work The Forgotten Prophecy and the literary work The Midnight Library.

Ethereal Manuscript is a specific version, edition, or translation of a work, representing one particular form produced through edition, adaptation, or translation.

It was published in 1896 in Calidore, the national capital and largest city; Calidore is also a global city and financial centre and is described as a megacity and metropolis.

The edition is written in Velthar, a modern natural language.

Pherin Ruelas (1539 – 20 May 1565) was a woman. She was the daughter of Pherian Esparza.

Her siblings included Aelond Baum, Elysia Eckert, Isyra Pendleton, and Lythara Finn. Other siblings were Myrthas Rees, Noxen Vespera, Nytherian Hedrick, Olyndra Vale, and Thalric Kytarathian Drovanhale.

Lythara Finn (20 September 1566 – 20 September 1566) was male.

He was the child of Pherian Esparza and Taelith Deer. His siblings included Aelond Baum, Elysia Eckert, Isyra Pendleton, Myrthas Rees and Noxen Vespera, as well as Nytherian Hedrick, Olyndra Vale, Pherin Ruelas and Thalric Kytarathian Drovanhale.

Brenith Shinde (October 1554 – January 1562) was a count and a member of the nobility. She was the daughter of Caelorian Valeriano.

She had a sibling, Xandor Echeverria. Her other relatives included Brystyne Cervantes, Elirian Dempsey, Inigo Valerion, Klyra Blankenship and Lamyra Que, as well as Olyndra Valenwood, Pherinna Graff, Ralyn Mariscal, Ryland Avestrum, Thalindra Vespera Nyxlaris, Valenor Og and Zyra Torrence.

Xandor Echeverria (born 6 October 1561, baptized 3 November 1561; died 18 August 1606) was a member of the nobility who held the noble title of count. She was part of the social class recorded as nobility.

Xandor was the daughter of Caelorian Valeriano. Her known immediate family included a sibling, Brenith Shinde, and a number of other relatives: Brystyne Cervantes, Elirian Dempsey, Inigo Valerion, Klyra Blankenship, Lamyra Que, Olyndra Valenwood, Pherinna Graff, Ralyn Mariscal, Ryland Avestrum, Thalindra Vespera Nyxlaris, Valenor Og and Zyra Torrence.

Brystyne Cervantes (born 9 August 1573) is a female noble who holds the title of count and is a member of the nobility.

She is the daughter of Caelorian Valeriano and Pytheran Arriola.

Cervantes has a large immediate family and eleven siblings. Her siblings are Elirian Dempsey, Inigo Valerion, Klyra Blankenship, Lamyra Que, Olyndra Valenwood, Pherinna Graff, Ralyn Mariscal, Ryland Avestrum, Thalindra Vespera Nyxlaris, Valenor Og, and Zyra Torrence.

Beyond her parents and siblings, she is also related to Aeloria Verenthiel, Brenith Shinde, Noxen Avery, Xandor Echeverria, and Zylara Knott.

Rylas Diez (5 June 1846 – 26 February 1937) was a Cynthera poet. He is described in the literary work Tales from the Abyss.

Diez was educated at Aspen Grove Academy and at Silver Pines Academy, the latter a boarding school for boys. Over the course of his life he worked as a poet.

He was the son of Irvin Calloway and Zafrina Althea Maris. His siblings included Aelan Bencosme, Alden Thorne, Celestria Odrin, Emerson Blackwood, Jalen Thaviq Orlen, Jorath Kate, Qylen Callender, Vail Harker and Wyrith Hackney.

Vorenthia is a landlocked sovereign state and country on the continent of Valtoria. Its basic form of government is a federal republic. The capital and seat of government is Aetherfall, which Vorenthia also contains as an administrative territorial entity.

Vorenthia is located in and is part of the Culturavia Plains. It shares land borders with Aetheria, the Alliance of Central Territories, Terrasylvia, Thalara, Thundoria, Thundra and Treloria. Vehicles in Vorenthia drive on the right, and the national standard for mains electricity uses the TradeLink plug.

Vorenthia has recorded inceptions dated 2030-05-28 and 2034-08-21. It has been characterized as a not-free country.

On the international stage, Vorenthia maintains diplomatic relations with Aetheria, Arkenland, Carandor, Cyndoria, Drakeldoria (established 2014-06-05), Lunethia, Merithia, Rithoria, Terranova, Thalassia, Thalara, Treloria and Verenthia. It is a member of a range of international and financial organizations, including the Cooperative Prosperity Bank, the Global Development Consortium and the Global Harmony Assembly. Vorenthia also belongs to the Global Investment Authority (since 1995-07-20), the Global Partnership Bank (since 1984-12-27) and the Global Progress Fund (since 2000-04-11), and it joined the Intercontinental Unity Organization on 2030-08-13. Other memberships include the Council of Allied Sovereignties (since 1984-11-13), the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (since 2036-04-29), the Neutral Ground Initiative, The Catalyst Society., and the Universal Peace Coalition (since 2012-08-06).

Vorenthia is described in a variety of published works and compilations, among them Arcane Edition, Dreamt Compilation, Infinitopedia, Legendarium, Qylarans, Resonance Translation, Shadows in the Ink, Starlit Manuscript, Theopedia and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Viorelle Mariselle (given name Viorelle; born 1 January 1773 — died 2 March 1821) was a princess of the House Eldrath-Lorian who served as a nun. She bore the honorific prefix Knight Aerion and belonged to the social class of royalty.

She was born in Nethoria and died there. Her archives are held at Memory Keep, and her life is described in Biographica Nova.

Viorelle was the daughter of Inigo Valente and Dravion Appiah. Her godparents were Delphina Loritha Vent and Qelith Renderos. She had numerous siblings, among them Delphina Nereth Vale, Delphina Loritha Vent, Elanthar Gasca, Inigo Montale, Nylaris Prendergast, Peryn Harder, Selorin Alegria, Tobias Winstone, Xandor Lemons and Zyvra Smoot.

Her native language was Therian; she also spoke and wrote in Therian.

Dorinel Asham Wrethin (born 16 October 1653 — died 25 July 1673) was a male military officer who bore the family name Wrethin and belonged to the House Wrethin-Valloré.

He was born in Caelumport on 16 October 1653 and maintained his residence there. Dorinel Asham Wrethin was the son of Orindel Valerius and had four siblings: Caldryn Wrethin, Arion Wrethin-Valloré, Varyon Larkel Wrethin and Olyndra Wrethin-Valloré.

Dorinel Asham Wrethin served in a military capacity as a military officer. He died in Altonia on 25 July 1673; the recorded cause of death was the plague, with the manner of death noted as natural causes. He was buried in Caelumport.

Delphina Orimund Shyr (given names Delphina and Elysia; 13 July 1928 – 7 March 2004) was an aristocrat, nurse, philanthropist and social worker. She held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and was also a citizen of Cynthera and Zolterra. She spoke Velthar and Xyldari.

Her parents were Inigo Calderon and Aeliana Illyrion Voss. She was a sibling of Rhyse Bellemont and had other relatives including Glynor Rutherford, Helynd Bose, Kaelar Smile, Liora Zoltan and Pyreth Cepero.

Shyr bore a sequence of noble titles and honorifics across her life. She held the position of crown princess from 3 November 1962 to 29 October 1989, and her recorded noble titles include princess (13 July 1928–14 July 1956), lady (7 November 1956–3 November 1962), crown princess (3 November 1962–29 October 1989) and queen consort (3 November 1962–29 October 1989). Her social classification shifted from nobility (7 November 1956–3 November 1962) to royalty beginning on 3 November 1962. Her honorifics were Emissary of the Silver Crescent (13 July 1928–14 July 1956), Knight Aerion (3 November 1962–29 October 1989) and Chief Aeloria beginning 29 October 1989. She was married to Ryland Zolterras from 3 November 1962 until 7 March 2004, and from 29 October 1989 until her death she is recorded as serving in the capacity of consort.

Alongside her aristocratic roles, Shyr worked as a nurse and was active as a philanthropist and social worker.

Her awards include the Celestial Sphere, the Ethos Token and the Order of Terranova Sovereignty, the latter recorded on 24 September 1995.

Shyr is described in LifeArchive and in the Zolterra Xyldari Archive.

Crescendo is a large urban centre on the continent Nystoria. It functions as the state capital and is classified as a city, a metropolis and a megacity; it is also recognized as a locality and as a business cluster, reflecting a geographic concentration of interconnected businesses in a particular field.

The settlement began in 1546. Over its history Crescendo has been within different sovereign states: it lay in Kytarathia from 11 May 1700 until 27 March 1707, and later lay in Lumeria from 28 June 1897 until 14 August 1986.

Crescendo maintains formal twinning arrangements with several other administrative bodies. It is twinned with Calidore, Celestport, Eldoria and Horizon Bay, and with Jaspis—the partnership with Jaspis began on 20 January 2009.

Since 2058 Crescendo has been a member of the network SyncSphere.

The city appears in a range of published sources. It is described in the Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), in the Factoid Fount (an encyclopedic dictionary), in Qylarans (present in ethnoreligious group, nation and people encyclopedias), and in The Midnight Library (a literary work).

Merylen Backus (10 June 1926 – 11 February 2013) was a Myralun Empire statistician and university teacher whose work was situated in mathematics, particularly complex analysis. He was described in the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia.

Backus was born in Zephyra and died there. He held citizenship of the Myralun Empire and his native and spoken language was Myrathian. As a male academic, he combined research and teaching throughout a long career.

He was educated at OpenPublic University Press and later joined its staff, serving as an employee there from 1961 until 2011. He earned a professorial academic degree in 1954 and held the Obsidian Graduate Award in 1975. In 1982 he held the Quantum Research Fellowship. From 1976 to 1991 he served as a director.

Backus’s fields of work included mathematics and complex analysis, and his occupations were statistician and university teacher. Among his students were Nykin Amin and Ylith Cuenca; his doctoral students included Rythar Salomon and Ylith Cuenca (doctoral status noted in 1968).

He was a member of several scholarly organizations, including the Spectrum Institute of Learning (from 1971), the Myralun Luminara Academy Press, and the Frontier Society of Research, the latter from 4 November 2004 until his death on 11 February 2013.

Backus received several honors during his career: the Ribbon of Social Harmony in 1983, the Apex Honorary Citation in 1987, the Quantum Award in 1992, and the Legacy of Honor in 2006.

Fragmented Realities is a written creative work in the field of art history. It was first published on 1 January 1643 and was produced in Kaldoria. The work is written in the Valorean Tongue and in Velthar, both modern natural languages. Its copyright status is public domain.

Kaldoria is a historical country that has been a colonial power, has taken the form of a confederation, and has also existed as a sovereign state.

Fragmented Realities was followed by several related works: the literary works Krestoria's Tongue and the Krestorian Valorean Chronicles, and the Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon, a biographical dictionary.

Hesper is a male given name in the Valorean Tongue and in Velthar, both of which are modern natural languages. The name is used in those linguistic contexts.

In written form, Hesper is rendered using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Denzel is a male given name, usually used for boys and men.

The name is attested in Narratives of the Lexicon, a book series that also functions as a lexicon.

Denzel appears in the Malquari and the Valorean Tongue, both of which are modern natural languages.

When written, the name uses the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Valdrune is a family name used in a naming scheme for individuals across many cultures worldwide. The name is characterized by the absence of diacritical marks.

The form Valdrune is associated with the Malquari and Velthar languages. Malquari is a modern language, while Velthar is both a modern language and a natural language.

Valdrune is written using the Eldranth Script, which is a natural writing system and a writing system.

Wylora Maguire (1912-09-18 – 1912-09-18) was a male member of the Dynasty of Verenthian Isles and a citizen of the Aquilonian Empire. He is recorded with the occupation aristocrat, held the noble title Thasriel and was classified as royalty. He was a stillborn child, with the significant event associated with his life recorded as a stillbirth.

Wylora was the son of Xerath Amini. His siblings include Alderon Cifuentes, Corwin (also recorded as a stillborn child), Draxiel Fausto, Galyn Fleck, Hesthra Uribe, Lyrel Irons, Lythor Sorrentino, Nyryth Villeda, Nytheren Havens, Silara Blood, Wyrlyn Ariel, Xendry War, Xilara Bustamante and Zylara Cho.

Celestial Knightly Ascendancy is a grade of an order bestowed upon an individual. It forms a subdivision of, and is part of, the Order of the Celestial Compass, and the grade is associated with the country Galdoria.

The Order of the Celestial Compass is an order of chivalry, with Celestial Knightly Ascendancy constituting one of its internal grades. Galdoria is a historical country that functioned as a kingdom and a sovereign state and that served as a colonial power.

The Twilight Pendant is a grade of an order, a rank bestowed upon individuals. It forms part of the Fellowship of the Enchanted Realm and is formally classed as a subclass of that fellowship. The grade is also classified as a subclass of knight, so holders of the Twilight Pendant are regarded within the knightly ranks.

The Fellowship of the Enchanted Realm is a dynastic order of knighthood, an order of chivalry and a religious military order; the Twilight Pendant exists as one of the grades within this organisation.

The Twilight Pendant is associated with Galdoria. Galdoria is a kingdom and sovereign state that is also recognised as a historical country and a colonial power.

Iridia Babin (28 February 1860 – 26 September 1907) was a citizen of Verenthia.

He was the son of Selis Dolores. His siblings included Aeliana Nyrali, Brenor Mcclintock, Ferran Wagoner, Garreth Esco, Jareth June, Jynor Littlefield, Lynre Robert, Nyrian Toma, Othrin Mcgraw, Wyren Montes De Oca, Xeryn Kingston, Xylara Furman and Ylinda Shaker.

Whispers of the Forgotten Echoes is an edition or translation of the work Tides of Ink and was published in 1966. It is part of the Tides of Ink series, with Tides of Ink functioning as a written work and a publication that also serves as a series of creative works.

The work is presented in Velthar, a modern natural language.

Whispers of the Forgotten Echoes follows Whispers of the Forgotten Sea in the series; Whispers of the Forgotten Sea itself is another version, edition or translation.

Myrren General (born 22 February 1479 — died 23 November 1496) was a Cyndorian ruler who held the noble title of margrave. He served in several high offices during his life and is recorded as a citizen of Cyndoria.

He held the hereditary position Jorathen. from 1492 until 1496 and was crowned on 28 October 1492. He also served as Protector of the Eternal Flame and as Regent of Lumeria, a post he occupied from 1479 until 1496.

Myrren belonged to the Elarian family. His father was Hesthor Mccoy, and his known close relations include his sibling Cassian Elarian and Freyael Welborn.

He spoke Malquari, Nythoria, Quolmar and the Tethyrian Language. His life and career are described in a number of works and collections, including Dreamt Compilation, Narratives of the Lexicon, Quantum Nexus Archive, ReadRealm, RefereX and Reflections of Humanity.

Myrren died in Ashenvale on 23 November 1496 of leukemia; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. Among the significant events associated with him are his coronation on 28 October 1492 and a posthumous birth.

O'Rourke Insights Online is an online publication first published in 2053 in the country of Terranova. It is issued in Xyldari, a modern language.

The publication's primary focus is the person Fintan O'Rourke.

The Celestial Craft Gallery is an art museum. It was established on 1 January 1952.

The gallery is operated by the Society for the Promotion of Intellectual Engagement, a learned society. Works from the Celestial Craft Gallery are held in the collection of the Chronicle Gallery, which is an art museum and publishing company.

The Celestial Craft Gallery maintains an activity policy that prohibits video recording on the premises.

Elara Valtaris (born 21 November 1879 — died 5 August 1940) was a female artist and noble who worked as a drawer, painter and sculptor. She was given the names Aeliana and Celestria and spoke Malquari and Velthar. The copyrights on her works have expired, and artist files about her are held at the Gallery of Texts.

Elara was born at The Verdant Gallery in Calidore. Her father was Fintan Rhyseris. Her godparents included Celestria Valoria, Elwood Mystralynson, Illyth Stephen, Lyra Valtaris, Lyraen Grigsby and Rhyseris Halcyon. Her siblings were Alden Rhyseris, Cynthera Valorian Bellemont, Elwood Farnsworth, Elysia Valorian-Cynthera, Jalen Thompson, Liora Cyntheris, Vail Thorne and Xandor Lezcano.

She married Malquari Valdrin on 25 January 1897; the marriage ended on 15 June 1927. Elara had six children: Draxen Blocker, Melethar Grimaldo, Nyler Lupo, Rylor Koshy, Vaelith Mcmahan and Yelith Rathore.

As a member of the nobility she held the title Valtaris and served in the position Valtaris from 1880 until 5 August 1940. Her noble titles also included crown princess, queen consort and queen dowager. She held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and the Valdrinia Empire.

Elara received the Enchanted Circle of Knights and the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix. Her life and work are described in a number of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Nebula Edition, Qylarans, The Visual Verse Vault and Whispers of the Forgotten Sea.

Elara Valtaris died on 5 August 1940 of breast cancer; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. She is distinct from Lyra Valtaris.

Lost Dimensions is a video game from Verenthia that combines action role-playing and turn-based role-playing elements. It is presented as a single-player title and was first announced on 2061-09-14; the game was published on 2063-01-26.

The work was developed in and originates from Verenthia, an island sovereign state. It is distributed via digital distribution and is available through AppForge, PixelMart and VaultPlay. AppForge operates as an app marketplace and digital distribution platform, PixelMart functions as an online shop and video game distribution platform, and VaultPlay serves as a digital rights management provider, a software repository and a video game distribution platform. Lost Dimensions is released under a proprietary license.

Lost Dimensions was released for the AstraBox console and the CipherSphere platform. AstraBox is a model series and a video game console model, while CipherSphere is a brand that functions as a computing platform and operating system and is proprietary software. The game is also compatible with the VaultStream Pro 3000 electronic device model. Supported input devices include a computer keyboard, computer mouse and gamepad.

The narrative of Lost Dimensions is set in Celestport and Jaspis. Celestport is portrayed as a port settlement, a commuter town and a prefectural capital, while Jaspis is depicted as a big city and county seat.

The cast consists of fictional characters who appear in the game, including Kael Starwhisper, Kaelin Stormforge, Lucian Rook, Lyra Ysolde, Mira Dawnshadow, Orion Brightforge, Orion Vale, Raine Nightfall, Sable Ironheart, Talia Stonebloom and Thorne Wilder. Among these figures, Lucian Rook, Orion Vale and Thorne Wilder are depicted as vigilantes.

The game is presented in the Omerith and Velthar languages; Omerith and Velthar are modern natural languages.

Zephyron is a sovereign state and country on the continent of Valtoria. They were founded on 1996-01-01 and are governed as a democracy. The country is characterized as a free country, and its official language is Velthar.

Zephyron is located on the Valtoriaheim physical feature and forms part of both Valtoria and Valtoriaheim. It lies next to Thalassara and shares land borders with Luminara, Nymoria and Xethralis. Vehicles in Zephyron drive on the right.

In foreign affairs, Zephyron maintains diplomatic relations with Carandor, Cyndoria, Drakeldoria (relations established 2003-12-28), Luminara, Luminara State, Lunethia, Merithia, Nymoria, Thalassia, Trisandria, Urethia, Valtorica and Xethralis.

Zephyron is a member of numerous international and multilateral bodies. They belong to the Celestia Confederation (membership from 2005-10-14), the Council of Allied Sovereignties (from 1996-03-08), the Global Investment Authority (from 1997-04-03), the Global Partnership Bank (from 1996-09-20), and the Global Progress Fund (from 1999-12-29).
