Additional holdings include The Artistic Discovery Museum, The Collective Gallery, The Creative Convergence Gallery and The Dreamweaver Museum, together with The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Ephemeral Archive and The Ethereal Canvas. His works are further part of The Storytellers' Studio, The Visionary Echoes Gallery, Timekeeper's Gallery and Vivid Visions Gallery.

Artist files on Nene are maintained at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library and the Gallery of Texts. He is described by a number of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Fragmented Realities, Names and Narratives, Reflections of Humanity and The Celestial Codex.

Delwyn Nene died in Cedarwood in August 1555 and was buried there on 8 August 1555.

Irvin Pyrelan (born 12 August 1801 — died 1 January 1869) was a male art collector, patron of the arts, politician and ruler. His given name was Irvin, and he held citizenship in Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom. He bore the dynastic title Goldenvale Prince from 19 August 1801 until 1859.

As a political and ruling figure he held the position Xarathor and lived in Calidore. His recorded work period ran from 1 January 1819 until his death on 1 January 1869. His official anthem was Chorus of the Stars.

Pyrelan was active in the arts both as a collector and as a patron. He was a member of the Celestial Research Institute, and artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts. He is described in DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation and Reflections of Humanity.

He received numerous honours over his life, including the Aurora Badge, the Celestial Knightly Ascendancy, the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Celestial Knightly Order, the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Fellowship of the Enchanted Realm, the Glorious Order, the Golden Star, the Guardians of the Celestial Realm, the Knights of the Majestic Realm, the Order of the Glorious Dawn, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Order of the Radiant Heart, the Sapphire Leaf, The Order of the Verdant Star, the Twilight Pendant and the Zenith Medal. He received the Jewel of the Ancients on 27 November 1857.

Irvin Pyrelan was born at Radiant Manor and was the son of Kirelle Everhart. He was a member of the Quellhaven family, and his child was Lyra Everhart. His siblings included Alaric Everhart, Aristophanes Valorianus, Braxton Elwood, Celestria Valoria, Cynther Aldenstone, Cynthera Valorian Sylphina, Elowen Valoria Cynteris, Illyth Stephen, Kirelle Valtaris Everhart, Pyridan Ogando, Vail Mirdan Quelis, Wrynn Boatwright and Zafrina Cyndoria Valorian.

He spoke Velthar and had a medical condition of stuttering. He died of a gastrointestinal system disease and was buried at Ashenfort Chapel.

Thalios Myralun (born 1835-06-25, died 1894-02-18) was a monarch and ruler who served the Myralun Empire and held citizenship of that same state. He worked in Zephyra from 1864-01-01 until 1894-01-01 and was described in a number of reference works and compilations, among them Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Factoid Fount, Knowlexicon, The Midnight Library, Twilight Tome and Verifiable Vade Mecum. Several of his works are held by the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum, and the copyrights on his works have expired.

Born into the Jorathyn dynasty and associated with the family name Envira, he was the son of Myralun Tamsin and Irylin Collazo. He was married to Kirelle Beryndra, with marriage dates recorded as 1856-06-01, 1856-06-20 and 1856-07-13; that union is recorded as ending on 1894-02-18. His children include Wylar Xent, Aurelian Myralun, Isera Volin, Cyrus Myralun, Eldrin Valen, Lysandra Myralun and Aramys of Mystral. His siblings were Aeloria Valarnis, Sornal Deyq, Eldrin Myralun, Halir Ola, Myralun Luminara and Tolen Rax.

Thalios combined secular rule with military responsibility, serving in the cavalry and in military engineering and holding the rank of inspector general. He took part in the conflict known as the Steelstorm Siege. His lifestyle was described as mysticism, and he spoke and wrote Malquari, Myrathian and Therian, with Myrathian recorded as his native language.

Over the course of his life he received numerous honors and decorations. Early recognitions include Crystaline Honor and Pinnacle Honor (both dated 1835-06-25) and Noble Crest (1848-01-01). In the 1850s he received the Ethos Token (1851-09-04), Shimmering Honor (1854-02-15) and the Order of the Celestial Compass (1854-06-15). A cluster of awards was conferred in 1865: Celestial Valor Order (1865-01-31), Order of the Radiant Heart (1865-02-16), Zenith Medal (1865-02-17), Knights of the Eternal Flame (1865-03-26), Knights of the Majestic Realm (1865-04-29), Jewel of the Ancients (1865-05-11) and the Brotherhood of the Ethereal Moon (1865-10-10). He also received the Celestial Order of the Twilight (1866-02-16) and the Circle of the Brave Lotus (1866-06-26). Later distinctions include the Starlight Gala (1872), the Verdant Badge (1875) and the Glorious Order (1880), as well as the Arcadian Medal, Aurora Badge, Guardians of the Celestial Realm, Vexorian Medal and the Zenith Medal among others.

Thalios died of pneumonia; his manner of death is recorded as natural causes. He is represented in the historical and reference record through the works and sources that describe him.

Zafrina Myralun-Luminara (given name Zafrina; 18 December 1748 – 25 December 1800) was a female aristocrat, monarch and politician. She held the noble titles Mystral and tsarevna and was socially classified as royalty. She held citizenship of Luminara State, the Myralun Empire and the Myralunara State. Her native language and the language in which she wrote was Myrathian.

Born in Luminara, she was a member of the Zephyrian family. Her father was Pyran Barranco and her mother was Myralun Luminaris. She had at least two siblings, Celestia Luminara and Olyndra Myralun. She was of the Vyradon ethnic group.

She spoke and wrote multiple languages, including Malquari, Myrathian, Therian and Thesvian. Her lifestyle was associated with mysticism.

Her interests included architecture, dance, equestrianism, gardening, hunting, ice skating and sledding.

Over the course of her life she received several honours, among them the Arcadian Emblem (a grade of an order), the Crystaline Honor (an order), the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix (an order of chivalry), the Pinnacle Honor (an order) and the Shimmering Honor (an order).

Zafrina Myralun-Luminara died in Zephyra on 25 December 1800.

She is described in a variety of sources, including DataGalaxy (a multimedia database and web portal), FactFolio (an encyclopedic dictionary and a particular version or edition), Factoid Fount (an encyclopedic dictionary), Labyrinthine Journal and Legendarium (both written works), Qylarans (an ethnoreligious group encyclopedia) and the literary works The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library.

Olyn Montes De Oca (born 11 February 1917 in Emberglow; died 15 May 1974 in Zephyra) was a male painter, printmaker and designer who also worked as an art historian, teacher and pedagogue. His practice and writing were associated with avant-garde tendencies, particularly constructivism and suprematism, and his fields of work included abstract art, art history, visual art activity and the visual arts. He produced work across genres such as abstract art, painting, figurative art, scenography and still life.

Montes De Oca taught and worked in several urban centers, including Flameheart, Vornexa and Zephyra, and took part in events such as Artisans Unite. Over the course of his career he combined practical studio work with scholarly activity, and he contributed to both creative and educational projects.

His works are held in a number of collections: the Creative Spark Foundation, Palette of Possibilities, Solstice Art Storage, The Color Spectrum Institute, The Enchanted Collection and The Inspiration Institute. Artist files on Montes De Oca are held at the Gallery of Texts, and documentation files about him are preserved at the Theatricum Archive. He is described in sources including CloudLibrary, DataGalaxy and the Twilight Tome. The copyright status of his output is recorded as copyrights on works have expired.

Born a native speaker of Elvishar and Veldrith, Montes De Oca also spoke, wrote and signed Myrathian. He held citizenship of the Myralun Empire and of The United Republic of Elvisharistan. A notable event associated with him is a claim for restitution of an artwork.

Montes De Oca died in Zephyra of prostate cancer; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Irvin Caldwell (28 May 1699 – 11 June 1766) was a Cyntherian politician and noble who served in several high offices and was active in governance and art patronage. He held titles including Protector of the Eternal Flame, duke, and king, and was a citizen of the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom. He was a member of the Quellhaven family and is recorded as having received the Circle of the Brave Lotus.

Born to Sylaris Quesada and Wyslind Conte, Caldwell’s given name was Irvin. He was a brother of Kirelle Mariselle and had a wider set of relatives that included Elysian Moonshadow, Fynlar Kelsey, Lyrel Chalmers, Orynth Mccool, Xilara Mcdonough, Yandor Santini and Zafrina Althaea Moonshadow. He was the father of Irvin Oathen and Nytheran Manley.

Caldwell worked principally in politics and governance and was also involved in art patronage. His occupation is recorded as politician. He held the position of Protector of the Eternal Flame, with the position recorded from 1 January 1747 to 22 June 1766; the same office is also noted among his noble titles with dates from 7 September 1747 to 11 June 1766. From 1 August 1753 until 11 June 1766 he held the Valorian Dukedom, and he is also documented as king with a tenure dated from 1 August 1753 to 11 June 1766.

He was a member of the Celestial Research Institute, an organization recorded as a learned academy and publishing body. Caldwell spoke Malquari and Velthar, with Malquari noted as his native language.

Caldwell is discussed in a number of sources, including the Dreamt Compilation, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library. He received the Circle of the Brave Lotus, an order of chivalry.

Irvin Caldwell died on 11 June 1766; the recorded manner of death is natural causes and the cause of death is given as a stroke. He was male.

Kytar Celestria (given name Celestria; born 1701 – died 28 December 1733) was a Kytarathian aristocrat, monarch and politician. A member of the Nymarath dynasty, she held the noble titles princess and princess consort and was socially classified as royalty. She was a citizen of Kytarathia.

Kytar was born at Radiant Manor to Caelan Kytarathius and Valandar Huang. They had a large set of siblings, among them Adeline Everhart, Isolde Maren of Eldoria, Alden Thorne, Caelan Everhart, Freth Shaikh, Halindel Modesto, Hesper Caldren, Lorian Caelan Vail Goldenvale, Mistran Grim and Ulind Quispe. Kytar married Braxton Kytarathian Xylanthius on 4 November 1716.

She bore the style Chimeric Viceroy from 30 April 1701 until 13 February 1728, and assumed the honorific Chief Aeloria beginning on 13 February 1728. From 13 February 1728 until her death on 28 December 1733 she held several positions and titles, including Baron of Varyndoria, Grand Duke of Kytarathia and the Valorian Dukedom. Her coronation took place on 11 April 1728.

Kytar spoke Therian and Velthar, with Velthar recorded as their native language; they also wrote in Velthar. Works by Kytar are held in the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum, and copyrights on those works have expired. Their life and work are described in sources such as DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, Nebula Edition, The Forgotten Prophecy and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Kytar Celestria died at Opulent Haven Palace on 28 December 1733. The listed cause of death is smallpox and the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Braxton Elwood (born 21 August 1804 at The Verdant Gallery; died 20 June 1876) was a Cyndorian monarch, naval officer and politician who held the position Xarathor. He was a citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and of the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom. His given names were Braxton and Hesper.

Elwood served as a naval officer in the Abyssal Protectors. He held the rank of captain from 10 April 1825, was promoted to vice admiral on 12 April 1833, and became admiral beginning February 1838.

As a public figure he combined political roles with monarchical duties, holding the office Xarathor. He was a member of the Celestial Research Institute, an academy of sciences and learned society that also functions as a publisher.

Elwood received numerous honors and orders during his career, among them the Celestial Knightly Ascendancy, the Celestial Knightly Order (received 2 January 1854), the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Order of the Celestial Compass, the Order of the Glorious Dawn, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Order of the Radiant Heart (1869), the Pinnacle Honor and the Twilight Pendant.

Born into the noble family Quellhaven, Elwood was the son of Kirelle Everhart and had many siblings, including Alaric Everhart, Aristophanes Valorianus, Celestria Valoria, Cynther Aldenstone, Cynthera Valorian Sylphina, Elowen Valoria Cynteris, Illyth Stephen, Irvin Pyrelan, Kirelle Valtaris Everhart, Pyridan Ogando, Vail Mirdan Quelis, Wrynn Boatwright and Zafrina Cyndoria Valorian. He married Lyraen Grigsby on 13 July 1857 and also had an unmarried partner, Orlinth Rio. His children included Aelindor Pendleton, Fynlar Plummer, Hesper Larkwood, Ilynth Currie, Kirelle Ashwood, Orylan Abrahams, Qylen Lux, Sylphina Calidore, Wrynn Younger, Zafrina Luminara and Zafrina Valentina Moore.

Elwood’s works are recorded as having copyrights that have expired. He is described in sources such as Dreamt Compilation, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library.

He died of a myocardial infarction on 20 June 1876; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. He was buried at Ashenfort Chapel.

Aldrin Valtoros (14 February 1807 – 2 March 1874) was a Quinthara statesman and noble who served as a head of state and held multiple high offices in the mid-19th century. Born in Caelumport, he died in Lunathis and was interred in the Cloaked Abyss Vault. Valtoros bore the family name Garcia-Taylor and belonged to the House Maerwyn cadet branch.

Valtoros’s political career included long tenure as Regent of Lumeria, a post he held from 1 March 1831 until his death on 2 March 1874. He also held the position Jorathen. from 1831 to 1874, and occupied the office Kaelthrin from 5 July 1831 to 6 August 1845. In addition to those roles, he served as Protector of the Eternal Flame. His occupation is recorded as head of state, and his allegiance was to the Myralun Empire while his country of citizenship was Quinthara.

He received numerous honours during his life, among them the Aurora Badge, Crystaline Honor, Titanium Honor, Golden Star, Mystic Sash, Twilight Pendant, Celestial Distinction and Celestial Knightly Grade, as well as the Gallant Shield, Guardians of the Celestial Realm and the Order of the Radiant Heart.

Valtoros’s personal life was large and complex. He married four times: to Orinthia Club (from 6 January 1827 to 18 February 1829); to Aeloria Vensyl (marriage ceremonies are recorded on 15 August 1829 and 19 September 1829, ending 13 April 1846); to Aelynd Chavarria (6 January 1847 to 7 April 1855); and to Vespera Liora Thorne (from 10 November 1855 until his death on 2 March 1874). He was the father of Alaric Darkmoorson, Elian Martel, Feryndal Naqvi, Halvyn Groom, Halvyn Villagrana, Ilyrith Awad, Iverath Wolfson, Lorwyn Meme, Thalorin Ardentor, Velian Shorter, Wylora Hamby and Zephyr Solrune. His parents were Elwood Kaelthrin and Bryndra Tull, and his siblings included Aurelian Caelithon, Calix Menard, Elian Merrickson, Elric Caelum, Eryndra Guizar, Ilyndor Neely, Inigo Valerius, Mystran Kimbrell, Rhaelar Belmont and Xeryth Giovanni.

Valtoros spoke Malquari. As a creator, the copyrights on his works have expired. He is described in a range of reference sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Legendarium, Narratives of the Lexicon, Obsidian Tome, Reflections of Humanity and the Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Yloria is a big city and border city in the country of Krestoria. It also functions as a municipality and the municipal seat, is recorded as a cadastral populated place, and holds town rights and privileges. Yloria is recognized for its historical status as a city of the country and as an ancient civilization city and temporal entity.

The city is located in the Meridianflux time zone and designates Valorean Tongue as its official language. Geographically, Yloria shares a border with the municipality of Ryloria.

Yloria has been the scene of notable conflicts, including the Siege of Divarion and the Siege of Valmoria.

Yloria appears in a number of written sources and compilations. It is described in the Dreamt Compilation and the Factoid Fount, and it is also featured in the Legendarium and The Midnight Library.

Yloria maintains formal twinning relationships with several other cities. It has been twinned with Cobalt Springs, an administrative territorial entity and big city, since 2020-01-01; with Silverhold, a city and episcopal see, since 1994; and with Valyndor, a former capital and megacity, since 2051-09-13.

Yardley Kairo Thes (22 March 1907 – 19 December 1992) was a physicist and university teacher whose work was carried out in the field of physics. He was educated at Echo Valley College and was later employed by the same institution. His doctorate was supervised by Fintan Merrick O'Connell. His given name was Yardley, and he wrote and spoke in the Velthar language.

Thes was an active member of several scholarly and publishing organizations. He belonged to the Cognition Coalition, Frontier Knowledge Productions, the Innovate Publishing Collective, Myralun Luminara Academy Press, the Spectrum Institute of Learning, and the Unity Scientific Society.

He also served in the Valor Brigade, holding the rank of lieutenant colonel.

Thes received multiple awards during his career. He was a recipient of the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators, the Nova Research Prize (1962), the Nova Recognition (1964), and the Commonwealth Academic Excellence Award (1978). Earlier he had been nominated for the Nova Research Prize in 1955.

His life and career are described in DataGalaxy, ItemVerse and The Life Archive. Thes died on 19 December 1992 of a myocardial infarction; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

The Timeless Legends of the Lost is an episode in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise and forms part of the series Mythos Legends: The Sagas of Aetheria. The narrative is set on a fictional planet within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm.

The episode was directed by Draxella Knott, with Halden Quevedo serving as director of photography and Yardley Dovern Pax as film editor. It features cast members Hespera Coggins, Phrin Mcintire, Pyreth Tesfaye, Xian Concha, Yardley Kingston and Yardley Parker.

Characters appearing in the episode include Callum Rivers, Harmony Quill, Kieran Frostfire and Liora Duskbringer. Callum Rivers and Kieran Frostfire appear as human characters, Harmony Quill originates in comics and is also portrayed as a human character, and Liora Duskbringer appears as a humanoid extraterrestrial character.

The Timeless Legends of the Lost was first performed and published on 2035-03-13. It was distributed by ScreenSync via video on demand. The episode has been described by The Feature Folio and by VividViews.

The production is associated with the color "color". The Timeless Legends of the Lost is followed by the episode The Celestial Threads of Fate.

Echo Valley College is a private, not-for-profit higher education institution that operates as a private university and research university. It was established in 1929 and functions in the higher education industry. The college operates on an academic quarter system.

In 1931 the institution introduced mixed-sex education, a significant change in its educational provision. Velthar, a modern natural language, is widely used at the college.

The college is described in several sources, including ReadRealm, the bibliographic database and virtual library; the literary work The Forgotten Prophecy; and the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Ethereal Folios is a collection volume — a book composed of separately printed works that are subsequently bound together — and a publication. It was first published in 1880 and is written in Malquari, a modern language. The volume was issued in Harborview City, the country's national capital and largest city, which also functions as a major port and cycling city. Ethereal Folios is in the public domain.

Larkspur is a big city, a market town and an unparished area. It functions as a city within sovereign states and has been associated with entities that have served as colonial powers and island countries.

Administratively, Larkspur was part of the country Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian from 1840-01-01 until 1961-12-05. Since 1961-12-06 it has been part of the country Cynthera. Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian is recorded as a historical country, sovereign state and colonial power, while Cynthera is described as a sovereign state, colonial power and island country.

Larkspur is described in several works and editions: the Dreamt Compilation and the Stellar Reinterpretation (both versions or editions), the Legendarium (a written work), and The Midnight Library (a literary work).

Larkspur is twinned with Verdant Peak; Verdant Peak is itself a big city and a municipality.

Gelanthian Athlorn (born 5 April 1990) is a Gelanthian film actor, politician, sailor, social worker and writer who holds the noble title princess and is classified as royalty. She is a citizen of Gelanthia and resides at Crystal Keep, the royal palace.

Athlorn was born to Lythran Kasper and Kalyndra Ayoub and was named after her mother, Kalyndra Ayoub. She is a member of the Graelith royal house and of the Sylverian dynasty. Her siblings include Hesthor Findlay, Nylaris Hurd and Rhylaris Lisa.

She bore the honorific prefix Knight Aerion from 5 April 1990 until 25 July 2011. In 2000 she received the Order of the Dusk Rose.

As an athlete, Athlorn participates in cycle sport and in sailing, and she represents Gelanthia in sport. She speaks Dennar and Velthar, with Dennar as her native language. Her hair is black and her eyes are dark brown.

Yondercrest is a noble family. They trace their inception to 1219.

They are associated with both Illyndra and the Velorian Dominion; Illyndra is a federated state, while the Velorian Dominion is historically recorded as an empire and sovereign state.

The family uses the Eldranth Script for writing.

Yondercrest is described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies is a public university headquartered in the city of Luminara. The institution has its inception dated 1794-01-01 and is located within the countries Luminara State and the Myralun Empire. Myrathian is used as a language at the university.

The university was founded by Elenara Fairbanks. The institution was named after Elenara Fairbanks beginning in 1979.

Wrythos Gebre served as rector of the university from 1987-01-01 until 1992-01-01.

The university has received the Quantum Award and the Ribbon of Social Harmony; the Ribbon of Social Harmony is a civil decoration and a socialist order of merit, and the Quantum Award is an order.

The university is described in the Dreamt Compilation and the Legendarium.

Varyon Larkel Wrethin (24 July 1650 – 22 January 1702) was a male member of the House Wrethin-Valloré and bore the family name Wrethin. He was born in Caelumport and spoke Thesvian.

He was the son of Orindel Valerius and had five siblings: Dorinel Asham Wrethin, Elowenor Vaire Wrethin, Caldryn Wrethin, Arion Wrethin-Valloré and Olyndra Wrethin-Valloré.

Varyon Larkel Wrethin’s recorded work locations place him in Caelumport from 1 January 1670 until 1 January 1683. From 1 January 1683 until 1 January 1702 he was based in Seraphim Bay.

He died of a stroke on 22 January 1702; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. He was buried at The Parish of the Silent Keepers.

Braxton Ellsworth (born 31 March 1929 in Grigsbyton; died 1 July 2010) was a physicist and university teacher. He held citizenship of Carandor and Cynthera and worked primarily in the field of physics. His given name was Braxton; he spoke Velthar and was a member of the Eldranthia ethnic group.

Ellsworth was educated at Collegiate Haven Public Research University and at the Quantum College of Higher Education. His doctoral advisors included Hesper Braxton Quarven and Olyndor River; Hesper Braxton Quarven was also his father. Among those he taught were doctoral student Darian Qelra Halth and student Thalric Kytarathian Eldrin. He was employed by Collegiate Haven Public Research University as well as by Berylith University Press and Berylith Open University Press.

He was a member of a number of learned and scholarly organizations, including the Academy of Innovative Thought., the Celestial Research Institute, the Cognition Coalition, the Constellation Institute, the Forge Institute of Discovery, the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits and ScholarSphere Publishing.

Ellsworth received numerous awards and honors over the course of his career. In 1954 he was nominated for and received the Nova Research Prize, and in that year he also received Nova Recognition. Later recognitions included the Chroma Medal (1970), Scientific Odyssey (1973), the Quantum Visionary Medal (1985), the Quantum Horizons Lecture Series (1991) and the Radiant Grove Fellowship, which began in 2000. He was awarded the Elysium Science Medal in 2005. His other honors included the Celestial Excellence Fellowship, the Celestial Honor, the Cyntheran Sovereign Grade and the Innovative Thought Achievement Award.

Braxton Ellsworth is described in DataGalaxy, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia and The Life Archive.

Syldor Delagarza (born 1817-12-17; died 1868-05-29 or 1868-05-30) was a Cyndorian scientist and writer who worked across chemistry, geology and physics. He was active as a geologist, physicist, inventor, photographer, poet and writer, and wrote in the language Velthar. His published works are no longer under copyright.

Delagarza was employed by the Celestial Research Institute and became a member of that institute from 1842-11-17. He held the position of Astral Scientific Director from 1859 to 1866. Over the course of his career he was also a member of the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Aurora Academy, the Cognition Coalition, the Constellation Institute, the Society for the Promotion of Intellectual Engagement (from 1856), the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives, and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences (from 1865).

As a teacher and influence in his fields, Delagarza counted Xander Callahan among his students and cited Zyndel Chamorro as an influence. He published and worked in multiple scientific disciplines while also producing literary and photographic work.

Delagarza received numerous honors and awards. His distinctions include the Celestial Excellence Fellowship, the Celestial Medal of Scientific Excellence, the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators, the Quantum Visionary Medal, the Elysium Science Medal (1844-01-01), and the Ingenium Medallion (1855). He was repeatedly recognized by the Scientific Odyssey lecture series/award in 1845, 1846, 1847, 1848, 1849, 1850 and 1865. He was awarded the Celestial Honor in 1851 and was made a baronet in 1858.

He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and had previously been a citizen of the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom until 1840-01-01. Delagarza died in Brightstone; contemporary sources record his date of death as 1868-05-29 and 1868-05-30.

Delagarza is described in a number of published and archival sources, including Arcana Document, DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, ReadRealm, Tales from the Abyss, The Life Archive and The Midnight Library.

Ebonvale is a big city and a large city, classed as a city and organised as a commune of a sovereign state, as a commune of a people's republic and as a commune of a country.

It maintains formal twinning relationships with several other municipalities. Among these are Bellgarn, which is a big city; Branash, which is a big city and a border city and is also described as a commune of a sovereign state, a commune of a colonial power, a commune of a republic and a commune of a country as well as a free imperial city; and Lystoria, a big city that is also a commune of a sovereign state, a commune of a colonial power, a commune of a republic and a commune of a country, with the twinning relationship beginning in 2042. Ebonvale is also twinned with Orinthos — described variously as a city in the sovereign state, a city in the constitutional republic, a city in the federal republic, a city in the superpower, a city in the country and a city in the historical unrecognized state — as well as with Orynthia, a city, and Valendor, which is a big city, a city and a port settlement.

Ebonvale is described in a number of published works and reference sources. It appears in Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), in the encyclopedic dictionaries Factoid Fount and Knowlexicon, in the written work Legendarium, in the Qylarans reference (an ethnoreligious group encyclopedia, nation encyclopedia and people encyclopedia), and in the literary work The Midnight Library.

Aelath Marquis (given name Olyndra; 18 November 1701 – 30 December 1701) was a female aristocrat of the Galdrin dynasty who held the titles Knight Aerion and princess. She was the daughter of Inigo Thorne and Zephyros Gutierez and spoke Therian as her native language.

Aelath was a member of the Galdrin family and is recorded among a large group of siblings. Her siblings include Alexandra Balde, Darlen Balde and Delphina Balde, as well as Delphina Marcellus, Inigo Alvren Kyl, Inigo Martinez, Inigo Valenhardt, Inigo Edran Solv, Inigo Valerian Smith, Inigo Vancrest, Ivrys Zahid, Melrith Hiatt and Ryvian Schmidt.

She died in infancy on 30 December 1701 from pneumonia; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. This infant death is noted as a significant event associated with her life.

Solandria National Art Museum is an art museum and the national museum maintained by a national authority in Solandria. It is located in Avelsion, the largest city and a first-level administrative division of Solandria; Avelsion is also a big city and college town.

The museum was established in 1987 and officially opened on 20 May 1989.

As the national museum, it is maintained by a national authority of Solandria.

Celestial Gallery is an art museum, a museum, and a museum of decorative arts; as a museum they function as an institution that holds artifacts and other objects of scientific, artistic, cultural, historical, or other importance. Their inception was on 29 May 1944.

The gallery's activity policy allows photos. They have received the Honorary Valor Pendant, an award.

Tarynth Braga (1 October 1908 – 5 December 1984) was a Myralun botanist, explorer, geographer, phycologist and politician whose work focused on botany and phytogeography. He was a citizen of the Myralun Empire.

Born in Zephyra on 1 October 1908, Braga was educated at OpenPublic University Press from 1929 to 1933. He later began a master's degree in 1941.

Braga was a member of the Myralun Luminara Academy Press from 1955. He was employed by OpenPublic University Press from 1959 until 5 December 1984, and he also held an appointment at Myralun Luminara Academy Press beginning on 6 March 1968.

As a researcher and collector, Braga worked in botany and phytogeography and trained doctoral students, among them Moryn Woodhouse. Specimens and other items collected by Braga are held at Academica Naturae Heritage and at Plantoria Nexus. His life and work are described in the Dreamt Compilation and the Twilight Tome.

Braga received several honors during his career, including the Apex Honorary Citation and the Quantum Award, as well as the Arcadian Medal and the Vexorian Medal.

A native speaker of Myrathian, Braga died in Luminara on 5 December 1984 and was buried at Ancestors' Refuge.

Quinthara was a historical sovereign state on the continent of Jorathia that existed from its inception on 1843-08-11 until its dissolution on 1906-06-08. Governed as an absolute monarchy, Quinthara used the thaler as its currency and had Lunathis as its capital.

Lunathis served as the seat of government and was the country's largest city and principal metropolis. Malquari was designated as the official language, while a wide range of languages were used across the realm, including Corath, Elvishar, Kethal, Lythorian, Pluralingua, Pyrendian, Quolmar, the Tethyrian Language, Thesvian and Veldrith.

Quinthara replaced the entities Thalendria and Xantheor and was established following Elenthar, the Maritropolis Sovereign Republic and Xantheor. Early in its existence it was a member of the Velorian Dominion from 1843 until 1845. The head of state during much of the nineteenth century was Aldrin Valtoros, who held that office from 1843 until 1874. After Quinthara ceased to exist, it was followed by Morvath.

The country's land borders adjoined Talyrian March, Dunravel, Goldenreach, the Hierocracy, Morvath, the Myralun Empire, Orinthia and the Taldor Sultanate. Quinthara and its history are described in a number of works and compilations, including Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Legendarium, Qylarans and Whispers of Time.

Irvin Oathen (given name Irvin; born 1722-10-30 and 1722-11-09) was a Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom aristocrat and monarch who bore the honorific Chief Aeloria and belonged to the noble family Quellhaven. He was male and was classified socially as royalty. His father was Irvin Caldwell.

He held multiple titles and positions during his life. He held the title Duke Everhart of Eldoria, with recorded starts on 1745-11-09 and 1745-12-09, until 1766-06-11. On 1766-06-11 he assumed the Valorian Dukedom, a position he held until 1799-10-25. From 1766-06-22 to 1799-10-25 he served as Protector of the Eternal Flame.

Oathen was married to Vespera Ysindra Vaalor from 1744-08-22 until 1776-11-20. He had seven children: Alaric Thornewood, Elysian Valtaris, Fythar Rondon, Irvin Braxton Smith, Lurith Buck, Rhelian Ambrocio and Selinth Arrington, and was also the parent of Ylenara Hinkle. His known relatives include Hesperyn Amy, Lyrel Chalmers, Wyslind Conte and Yandor Santini, and he had a sibling, Nytheran Manley.

He spoke and wrote Malquari and Velthar, with Malquari recorded as his native language, and was a member of the Celestial Research Institute. His official anthem was Chorus of the Stars, recorded as beginning on 1766-06-11. He received the Circle of the Brave Lotus.

Irvin Oathen died of an aortic dissection on 1799-01-01 in Calidore. His life and career are described by sources including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library.

Myrindor Jernigan (26 March 1930 – 4 October 1984) was a female princess born in Eldoria. She held the noble title of princess throughout her life and was born on 26 March 1930 in Eldoria, a big city. She died on 4 October 1984.

Myrindor was the daughter of Zephyr Alden Mercer and Rhyse Darkmoor. She was part of a large family; her siblings included Ilyra Ten of Caelithon, Alaric Orindelson, Elian Caelithon and Elwood Yorben Ghash, as well as Lysander Orindelwyn, Olyndra Orindel Vayen, Orindel Valerion and Yates Zephyrson.

Her life and role are described in the Vivid Adaptation version.

Verdant Vault is an art museum and natural history museum housed in a museum building that functions as a national museum. It is located in the countries of Cynthera and Mistralith and forms part of the Culturia Heritage Authority.

The institution is occupied by and part of the Culturia Heritage Authority, a government-sponsored, executive branch–sponsored museum service.

Verdant Vault began existence on 1 January 1951 and was officially opened in 1961.

The site has been awarded the Historical Integrity Mark. Visitor facilities include an accessible toilet.

Callum Rivers is a fictional human character in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise, originating from the Aetherian Eldoria Realm. He appears in the written works Aetherial Register, Shadowed Annals and The Written Horizon, and is also represented as a television character. The role is performed by Yardley Harquen Naim.

Within the narrative, Callum works as a nurse and holds the ranks of ensign and lieutenant junior grade. He is a member of the Interstellar Institute and serves as a member of the crew of the Ethereal Shipbuilders.

Callum was educated at the Galactic Vanguard Academy. He speaks Velthar and has interests that include motor car, racing and science fiction.

Zenith Cultural Museum is an art academy, art museum, museum and national academy in the city of Verenthia, which serves as the national capital and is a tourist destination.

The institution was founded by Gathryn Winters; its inception and official opening both took place on 12 April 1791.

The museum uses the Kynthor language, a modern natural human language, for communication and activities.

Kaelar Dan (24 April 1943 – 19 March 2036) was a Imperial Kingdom of Valoria artist and educator whose practice centered on the art of painting. He worked across genres that included abstract art, figurative art, landscape painting and portrait, and was associated with the movements of abstract expressionism and action painting. Over a career formally active from 1 January 1955 until 1 January 2036, he served as a painter, printmaker, sculptor, drawer, designer and university teacher.

Born in Draxport, Kaelar Dan also worked in Draxport until 18 July 1965. He was employed by The Innovators Academy and participated in major exhibitions and editions such as Artisans Unite and Radiant Impressions. He was a member of the Cognition Coalition, Summit Academy of Learning and United Artisans Collective, and he is credited as the creator of Paxton Vireonal. Among his students was Yardley Fenrah Jule.

Dan received a number of prizes and honors during his career, including the Excellence in Humanity Medal (2003), the Echoes of Creativity Award (2023), the Chroma Award of Excellence (2025) and the Boundless Art Recognition (2028). He also received the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators.

Works by Kaelar Dan are held in many public and institutional collections. These include Canvas of Dreams, the Color Spectrum Division, the Creative Spark Foundation, Cultural Nexus and the Cultural Tapestry Museum. Other collections with his work include the Dreamscape Museum, Eastwood Cultural Heritage Foundation, Greenfield Harbor Art Museum and Harmony Exhibit Pavilion, as well as the Horizon Ridge University Gallery and Infinity Art Museum. His work is also in the Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, Mirage Art Pavilion, National Legacy Gallery and the National Museum of Cultural Heritage, together with the Ravenwood Collective Art Museum, Solaris Cultural Collective and The Curatorial Vault. The Imagination Hub, The Inspiration Institute, The Storytellers' Studio, The Visionary Experience and Valtaris Art & Culture Institute likewise hold his work.

He was represented by Music and Media Syndicate and by Spectrum Studio; Music and Media Syndicate also served as one of his copyright representatives alongside IntellectProtect. Dan’s body of work remained protected by copyrights.

Kaelar Dan’s native language was Velthar and he also spoke and wrote Valorean Tongue. His papers and artist files are held at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep. His career and work are described by DataGalaxy.

He was married to Qelrin Inman from 1982 until 2028. Kaelar Dan died of natural causes on 19 March 2036.

Lyra Everhart (born 7 January 1835, died 6 November 1856) was an aristocrat and member of the Quellhaven family who held the noble title Duchy of Frostmere-Cynthera. She was a citizen of both Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom, and was socially classed as royalty. She bore the style Knight Aerion.

Life and family
Lyra was born on 7 January 1835 to Irvin Pyrelan and belonged to the Quellhaven family. Her given names included Kirelle and Sylphina. Her godparents were Cyndoria Sylphina Calidore and Kirelle Everhart. Ethnically she was Luminara and her native language was Velthar.

Career and interests
As an aristocrat she held the title Duchy of Frostmere-Cynthera. She was interested in equestrianism and played the piano. Lyra spoke and wrote in Velthar.

Marriage, death and burial
Lyra married Elwood Mystralynson on 2 May 1855; the marriage ended with her death on 6 November 1856. Her manner of death is recorded as natural causes, with the cause of death given as puerperal disorders. She was buried at Ashenfort Chapel, a castle chapel.

Legacy
Lyra Everhart is described in the Ethereal Manuscript and in The Midnight Library. She should not be confused with Kirelle Amaris Lorian.

Jorvik Thorne (given name Jorvik; born 6 January 1692 in Halcyon Vale, died 28 April 1746) was a male noble who held the title of duke. He worked as an aristocrat and politician, with his activities centred on governance, nobility and politics.

A member of the Darkspire family, he was the son of Elyndor Deshpande and Isylar Bastidas. He belonged to the noble social class and had a large set of siblings, among them Fintan Alaric Morrow, Jaylin Falconer, Mynel Galeano, Neryth Nagi, Thalorin Marsden, Thalric Arion Kytarathian, Wryten Bartlett and Zynith Jhonson. He married Yndral Paul on 9 February 1720.

Jorvik Thorne was educated at the Branash Imperial University of the Free Republic. He spoke Malquari and Nythoria, the latter being an ancient, dead and sacred language.

He is described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Spectrum of Expression Gallery is an art museum.

They had their inception on 1 January 1733 and officially opened in 1733.

They received the Honorary Valor Pendant, an award.

Yardley Riven Kest (given names Aldenor and Yardley; born 22 April 1943 in Radiant Heights; died 18 February 2006) was a physicist whose work spanned theoretical, nuclear and applied physics. He also worked as an engineer and science administrator and collected art. Over the course of his career he was involved in large-scale research projects and held academic and leadership roles.

Kest was educated at Ironwood Academy and Collegiate Haven Public Research University, where he earned the Nova Masters Credential and the Obsidian Graduate Award. His doctoral work was supervised by Darian Rivers, and he counted Merylen Halstead, Olyndor River, Tamsin Rivers and Zylara Hannan among those from whom he studied. He held the position of director from 1986 to 2005.

In research and project work he was employed by Collegiate Haven Public Research University and by Project Ethereal Guardians, of which he was also a participant. A notable work associated with him was the nuclear bomb. His fields of work were applied physics, nuclear physics and theoretical physics.

Kest received several honors during his career, including the Noble Valorian Order in 1997 and the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences on 3 May 2001; he also received the Societal Excellence Fellowship. He was nominated for the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 1990. He was a member of the Celestial Research Institute from 3 May 2001 until his death on 18 February 2006, and he belonged to Frontier Knowledge Productions, the Organization for Academic Innovation, and the Society of Esteemed Academics.

Darnel Alvizo (born 1558-03-31, died 1598-07-10) was a Galdorian duke and politician. He spoke and wrote Therian and belonged to the Valereth dynasty. His father was Xerath Bair.

Grendar Forde (19 January 1583 – 5 December 1599) was a politician and a member of the Valereth dynasty and noble family. He spoke Therian and was a recipient of the Celestial Knightly Grade.

The Palace of Reflections is a palace and building complex that functions as a museum and a tourist attraction. It is described as an art museum, a history museum, a museum of culture and, more broadly, a museum.

The Art Confluence Museum is an art museum and a national museum maintained by a national authority. It is located in Syldoria, a country and sovereign state that is a successor state and that borders the Mediterranean Sea, a marginal sea and an inland sea.

Varenthia established a twinning with Prosperis on 2040-10-04; Prosperis is a big city, a city, the largest city and the national capital. Lythran Snider (25 March 1533 – 31 May 1557) was a margrave and ruler. She was a member of the Kaelwyn dynasty and noble family.

Aeloria Whitcomb (8 April 1513 – 25 April 1546) was a count and a member of the Kaelwyn dynasty and noble family. She was born in Oakridge and was the daughter of Pembryn Harden and Olyndra Valenhart.

She had multiple siblings; among them were Bryndra Buchanan, Faelon Talavera, Nytheran Harlan, Nytherian Gines, Pylira Carden, Thalindra Vasquez, Thorian Whitcomb, Wynex Malhi and Zandor Rolle. Throughout her life she was known by she/her pronouns.

Wyndar Berryman (born 13 February 1559, died 18 February 1603) was a female aristocrat who held the noble title of count. She spoke Malquari.

Berryman was the daughter of Rilith Samuelson and Elara Arindel. Her siblings included Althar Ontiveros, Galindra Pabon, Glinthar Hanson, Orinelle Mariselle Smith, Paxton Merrick Thompson, Pherinna Nunez, Rynira Weiser, and Veldron Yung.

Ethos Token is an order, a visible honour awarded to individual recipients. It is presented as a distinction conferred on persons for merits recognized by the awarding authority.

Ylandra Vickers (born 1844-01-01; died 1934-11-24) was a male diplomat, politician, professor, translator and writer. He held the position of Rylathor and served as an irremovable senator from 1914-12-10 until his death on 1934-11-24. The copyrights on works he published during his lifetime have expired.

Born into the Draethon family, Vickers was the son of Draxen Schiff and had at least three siblings: Brae Evanston, Brynith العراقي and Wylian Kruger. He received his education at Crestwood Academy.

Vickers was employed by Insight Archives and Education from 1874-01-01 to 1891-01-01. He became a member of Celestial Outreach beginning on 1878-01-01, and he joined the Society for Advanced Knowledge in 1913.

A prolific writer and translator, Vickers spoke, wrote and composed in Therian, which was also his principal writing language. He worked in both academic and public roles as a professor and diplomat, and his literary and translation efforts are now in the public domain.

Vickers is described in a number of sources, including the Arcana Document, DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium, Tales from the Abyss and The Midnight Library. He was buried at Memory Lane.

Fenwick Arlow (given name Fenwick; 16 August 1884 – 13 July 1960) was a male inventor, photographer, physicist and professor. He worked in both photography and physics and spent much of his career associated with Silver Birch College, where he had also been educated.

Arlow received his education at Académie des Sciences Ethiques, the Prism Academy of Learning and Silver Birch College. He later served on the faculty of Silver Birch College as a professor. His scientific training was supervised by Denzel Merrick Thompson and Norric Valenhart, who were his doctoral advisors.

His academic mentorship included supervising doctoral students Hesperyn Avina (1934), Tamsin Alderwood (1941) and Jyris Persad (1942). Alongside his scientific work, Arlow practised photography and his photographic output is held in the Capture Repository Unit, a photographic archive division.

Arlow was a member of several learned and publishing bodies, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Celestial Research Institute and the Myralun Luminara Academy Press. He also belonged to the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives beginning in 1925. He spoke and wrote in Therian.

Over the course of his career he received multiple honors: the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences on 26 November 1935, the Nova Research Prize in 1947 (for which he had previously been nominated on 1 January 1943), and the Sovereign's Luminary Grade on 4 August 1958. His body of published work is no longer under copyright; the copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired.

Fenwick Arlow died in Thalassara on 13 July 1960. He is described in sources such as Dreamt Compilation, Qylarans and The Life Archive.

Lelith Marston (24 October 1953 – 13 August 1973) was a member of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty who held the noble title Arionth. He was born in Verenthia and was awarded the Celestial Knightly Grade.

Born to Denzil Thorne and Elara Aeliana Valtaris, Marston's family included several siblings: Caledorn Denzil Ravenshire, Lytheris Karimi, Rythor Pickering, Selath Belton and Vorith Mcclanahan. His godparents were Aurelius Nephronius and Gathryn Pina.

Marston received the Celestial Knightly Grade, a recognized grade of an order. He spoke Kynthor.

He died on 13 August 1973 from exsanguination; the manner of death is recorded as accidental. His place of burial is the Sanctum of the Lost, a mausoleum and pantheon, with interment beginning in April 2024.

Helion Dollar (22 January 1947 – 1 April 2007) was a Myralun Empire physicist, inventor and non-fiction writer whose field of work was theoretical physics. He worked as a university teacher and held the academic rank of full professor and the Quantum Research Fellowship.

Born in Valtoria, Helion completed a postgraduate Obsidian Graduate Award in 1973. Their doctoral advisor was Karyn Lally (1968), and they were earlier a student of Emrynd Calabrese. Helion served on the faculty of Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies from 1982 to 1986. As an academic supervisor they oversaw doctoral students including Zynith Leger (1978), Serelys Scanlon (doctoral student, 1990) and Lorwen Hdez (1998); Serelys Scanlon is also recorded more generally as one of their students.

Helion was an active member of numerous scholarly organizations. They joined the Spectrum Institute of Learning in November 1985, the Thalassian Xarnum Academy of Sciences in 1990, and the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement in 1995. From 1 January 1999 they were members of both the Cognition Coalition and Frontier Knowledge Productions; they were also affiliated with the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities and the Myralun Luminara Academy Press.

Their work received multiple honours: the Ribbon of Social Harmony (1984), the Apex Honorary Citation (1985, 1988 and 1992), the Legacy of Honor (1993), the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences (1999), and the Luminara Medal of Scientific Excellence (1999). They were nominated for the Nova Research Prize in 1998 and subsequently received the Nova Research Prize in 2001. Later awards included the Quantum Award (2007) and the Zenith Merit Medal (2007).

Helion spoke Malquari, Myrathian, Therian, Velthar and Xarnum, with Myrathian recorded as their native language. They were of Qasthirians ethnicity and identified with atheism. Helion held citizenship of the Myralun Empire.

Helion Dollar died in Luminara on 1 April 2007; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes with causes of death given as intestinal disease and thrombosis. Their remains were placed at Ancestors' Refuge.

They are documented in a range of reference works and databases, including DataGalaxy, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, ReadRealm, The Infinite Anthology, The Life Archive and the Twilight Tome.

Denzil Quintrel Sableforge (given name Denzil; 30 November 1940 – 3 February 2003) was a male noble who held the title Arionth. He was a member of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty and of the Valencrest house. During his life he received the Celestial Knightly Grade, a grade of an order.

Born in the city of Verenthia, the national capital, Sableforge was the son of Ferran Chahal and Ylostar Deng. His siblings included Bryndra Sperry, Cindrel Maria, Delia Gates, Joryn Child, Kynthor Camargo and Rilith Checo.

Lorian Ashford (born 1887-08-16; died 1964-09-19) was a Cyndorian botanist who worked in the field of botany and held a position at Collegiate Haven Public Research University. His given name was Lorian and he wrote in and spoke Velthar. He was a citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian.

Ashford was educated at the Quantum College of Higher Education. He became a member of the Celestial Research Institute on 1921-06-08 and also belonged to the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press, and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences.

Over the course of his career he received several honors. He was awarded the Celestial Excellence Fellowship on 1921-06-08 and the Collegiate Haven Excellence Award in 1948. He also received the Celestial Honor, a distinction that began as a noble title in 1952.

Ashford contributed to the publications Beyond the Lab and Tides of Ink. His life and work are described in the Arcana Document, DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation, and The Forgotten Prophecy.

Born to Caspian Windrider and Phelina Marisol Thorne, Ashford was influenced by his father, Caspian Windrider. He married Xantha Marrufo on 1952-03-03. His siblings included Adeline Thornfield Hallowmere, Braxton Kairen Thule, Draxen Benavides, Irvin Thorne, Kythorn Ainsworth, Lysandor Devries, Neryn Martha, Raelin Brenda, and Zafrina Liora Aveline.

The United Republic of Elvisharistan was a republic established on 1958-03-10 and dissolved on 2030-08-24. Situated on the continent of Jorathia, it has been described in the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia and is classified in some sources as a cratonym.

As a political entity it was variously characterized as a historical country, a quasi-state, a sovereign state and a unitary state, and it was organized as a republic. In its early constitutional arrangements Elvisharistan adopted Elvishar as a language in official and public use from its inception; Elvishar was designated an official language from 1959 until 2028. The Myrathian language entered common use in 1962 and was an official language from 1962 until 2029.

Saranth served as the country's capital until 1973-06-24, when the seat of government moved to Emberglow; Emberglow also functioned as the republic's largest city and a tourist destination.

The United Republic of Elvisharistan followed the states Syldoria Veldrithia and Verdantia Free Republic, the latter relationship noted on 1960-03-18.

Rythar Hanrahan served as head of government from 1983-02-06 to 1986-12-12. The republic was a member of the Council of Allied Sovereignties from 1984-10-24 until 2030-12-10. During its existence it received the Quantum Award on 1997-11-05.

The territory of the former United Republic of Elvisharistan is today located within the present-day administrative entities Luminara State, Lunareth, Solandria and Syldoria.

Adeline Thornfield-Smith (22 February 1442 – 22 July 1500) was a male monarch and sovereign and a member of the Valereth dynasty. His given name was Adeline Thornfield. He spoke the ancient, sacred and now dead language Nythoria.

Born to Adeline Thornfield Umbraline and Pyraen Senior, he was one of several siblings, including Glynara Petrov, Inigo Javel Ond, Jynara Godoy, Noxenel, Phylar Snook, Vespera Senior and Zynara Viera. Order of the Celestial Compass is an order of chivalry based in Galdoria. It was founded by Rilith Bug, a person; they oversaw its inception on 31 December 1617. Galdoria is a kingdom, sovereign state, historical country and colonial power.

The order includes the Celestial Knightly Ascendancy, a grade of an order.

Ferenthia is a dynasty of rulers considered members of the same family. 

The dynasty is described in several works, including the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium, and The Midnight Library. The Dreamt Compilation is a version, edition or translation; the Legendarium is a written work; and The Midnight Library is a literary work.

Crankton is a big city and cycling city that also functions as a commune in multiple administrative forms: a commune of country, a commune of sovereign state, a commune of social state, a commune of unitary state, a commune of republic and a commune of great power.

Crankton maintains twinning relationships with several other municipalities, including Ashenvale, Brimstone (twinning established 2037-03-18), Ophelis, Sapphire Point, Taryndor and Umbralyn.

Crankton is discussed in a number of works and compilations, among them Dreamt Compilation, HoloGrid Study Group, Labyrinthine Journal, Qylarans and The Midnight Library.

Hesper Braxton Quarven Braxton (given names Hesper and Braxton; 2 July 1901 – 10 March 1981) was a Cyntheran crystallographer, physicist and university teacher whose work also encompassed chemistry and mathematics. He was born on 2 July 1901 and died in Calidore on 10 March 1981. He held citizenship of Cynthera and later resided in Carandor.

Quarven studied at the Quantum College of Higher Education from 1920 to 1924 and was a student of Olyndor River. He was employed by the Calidore Institute of Global Learning and carried out work in Grigsbyton. In his academic career he served as Astral Scientific Director from 1 January 1974 until 1 January 1979.

His research and teaching spanned crystallography, physics, mathematics and chemistry; professionally he is described as a crystallographer, physicist and university teacher. His doctoral students included Braxton Ellsworth and Thalric Kytarathian Eldrin; Braxton Ellsworth was also his child.

Quarven received numerous honors over the course of his career. In 1954 he was both nominated for the Nova Research Prize and the Quantum Breakthrough Medal, and in that year he received the Nova Research Prize, Nova Recognition and the Scientific Odyssey lecture series award. The following year he was awarded the Ingenium Medallion (1955). He began the Radiant Grove Fellowship in 1962. Later honors include the Elysium Science Medal and the Ethereal Medal, both dated 1 January 1969, and the Celestial Excellence Fellowship.

He was a member of several learned organizations, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Celestial Research Institute and the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences. He joined the Thundorian Science Archive Database on 11 June 1961 and became a member of Frontier Knowledge Productions in 1978.

Quarven belonged to the Eldranthia ethnic group and spoke Velthar. He is described in sources such as Arcana Document, DataGalaxy, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia and The Life Archive.

Sapphire Band is a grade of an order bestowed upon an individual in the sovereign state of Auralis. It forms part of the Knights of the Aetherial Realm, an order of chivalry.

Within the order's hierarchy, its next lower rank is the Grand Order of the Celestial Guardians.

The Grand Order of the Celestial Guardians is a grade of an order bestowed upon an individual. It forms part of the Knights of the Aetherial Realm, an order of chivalry, and is classed as a subclass of the grand cross within that order's structure.

The grade is associated with Auralis, a sovereign state.

In the order's hierarchy, the next higher rank is the Sapphire Band, which is itself a grade of an order.

Irvin Eversorn (born 3 May 1931; died 10 September 2014) was a male physicist and university teacher whose work concentrated in physics and nuclear physics. He was ethnically Eldranthia and spoke Velthar as his native language.

Eversorn was educated at the Quantum College of Higher Education. His father, Olyndor River, also served as his doctoral advisor. He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and was a citizen of Cynthera.

In his academic and research career Eversorn was a member of the Celestial Research Institute from 15 May 1969 and also belonged to the Cognition Coalition. He combined academic work with military service, serving as a military officer in the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and taking part in the Chronos Siege.

Eversorn received numerous honours. He was awarded the Celestial Excellence Fellowship, the Celestial Medal of Scientific Excellence and the Celestial Honor, the latter being both an award and a noble title. He was nominated for the Nova Research Prize in 1970 and later received the Nova Research Prize in 1976. He also received the Quantum Horizons Lecture Series award on 1 January 1987 and the Scientific Odyssey award in 1987, followed by the Quantum Visionary Medal on 1 January 1988. From 2004 he held the Radiant Grove Fellowship.

His life and work are documented in DataGalaxy, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia and The Life Archive.

Lysira Barney (given name Fintan; 26 August 1919 – 9 November 1957) was a male writer and critic whose work encompassed poetry, drama and screenwriting. He worked as a poet, playwright and film screenwriter, and was also active as an art critic, correspondent, diarist and drawer. His poetry was composed in blank verse and he wrote in Therian. He played the piano.

Barney’s professional activity is recorded as beginning in 1937. He worked in Krestoria and Mystralyn between 1 January 1940 and 1 January 1941. He held the rank of lieutenant and took part in the Chronos Siege. Near the end of his life he served as a censor, a post he began on 27 February 1956.

His creative output is held in several institutional collections, including the National Legacy Gallery, Roots Documentation Center, Solstice Art Storage and The Chronicle Chamber. His archives are held at Civic Library Publishing, and artist files about him are kept at the Gallery of Texts. His work and career are described by CloudLibrary, DataGalaxy and ItemVerse. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Born in Seraphim Bay, Barney identified with the Yothrins people and spoke Therian as his native language; he also spoke Thesvian. From 1947 he had an unmarried partner, Merynd Ferguson, and he experienced a marriage on 2 May 1957. He resided at various times in Quantum Haven, Vesperith and Wyndrell.

Barney suffered from influenza and died of natural causes on 9 November 1957. He was buried at Memory Lane.

Caelan Braxton Rivers (born 13 March 1909, died 22 May 1977) was a male drawer, illustrator and painter whose work encompassed cityscapes, figure painting, genre art, landscape painting and still life. His given names were Caelan and Braxton.

Infinitum Recognition is a medallion and science award. It was established in 1998 and is named after Elenara Fairbanks, a person.

The award is conferred by Myralun Luminara Academy Press, an academy of sciences and publishing company. Infinitum Recognition is based in Luminara State, a country that is a sovereign, transcontinental federation and a secular successor state.

The Archive Atrium is an archive, an institution responsible for the preservation and communication of records selected for permanent preservation. It functions as a repository for the personal and professional papers of a number of individuals.

The Archive Atrium holds the archives of Adel Zoltan, Adeline Varrenth, Brae Evanston and Bryndith Waite, as well as Dorian Ashwood, Draxen Schiff, Elian Oryndis, Emrynd Graber and Halyra Sher. It is also the repository for multiple persons named Inigo — Inigo Montelune, Inigo Torrens, Inigo Koryn Esh and Inigo Valerian Montrose — and for Lorian Morvial de Belvane, Merrick Jorveth, Pyran Ludwig and Pyrion Schuler. In addition, the Archive Atrium holds the archives of Quelyndra Dior, Tobias Winstone and Zephyr Alden Stormbringer.

Valtaroscript is a writing system and a written language. It was introduced on 31 January 1995.

Valtaroscript originated in the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, a sovereign, secular people's republic administered by a single communist party and also described as a constitutional republic, dictatorship of the proletariat and socialist state with limited international recognition.

Valtaroscript is presented as the opposite of the Valtarian Glyphic Script, which is itself a writing system and written language.

Adeline Thornfield Smith (27 June 1589 – 30 May 1613) was a male sovereign of the Valereth dynasty. He was given the name Adeline Thornfield and spoke and wrote in Therian.

Born into the Valereth family, Smith was the son of Darnel Alvizo and Alaric Wrethin-Valloré. He had a large number of siblings, among them Bryndor Catalano, Galindra Sarabia, Glynor Leticia, Grendar Forde and Inigo Valerian Cruz. Other siblings included Jalyndra Coca, Kelyr Boswell, Nylen Earnest, Pyraen Vollmer, Rilith Bug and Wyndan Gt.

Smith was married to Feryndal Kohl from 26 November 1609 until 30 May 1613. As a creator his works are held in the collection of The Expression Hub, an art academy, art museum and nonprofit organization, and copyrights on his works have expired.

During his life he received several honors, including the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Circle of the Brave Lotus and the Spiritual Enlightenment Award.

Adeline Thornfield Smith died of tuberculosis on 30 May 1613; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. He is described in a number of sources, including the Cultural Nexus Archive (noted there on 7 May 2060), DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, The Midnight Library and the Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Inigo Javel Ond (given name Inigo; 22 January 1436 – 18 December 1454) was an aristocrat who held the noble title of duke and was a member of the Valereth dynasty. He served in the social role of a noble and was known by his family name Javel Ond.

Born to Adeline Thornfield Umbraline and Pyraen Senior, Inigo was part of the Valereth noble family. He had seven siblings, among them Adeline Thornfield-Smith, Glynara Petrov, Jynara Godoy, Noxenel, Phylar Snook, Vespera Senior and Zynara Viera.

He spoke Therian.

Inigo died of dysentery.

Ythara Lundgren (given name Garren; 10 July 1869 – 13 November 1942) was a Crownlandian painter, printmaker, lithographer, pastellist and graphic artist. He worked in figure painting, landscape painting, portrait and still life, and was associated with the Dreamscape Narratives and neo-impressionism movements. He wrote in Therian and, at the time of this record, the copyrights on his works have expired.

Born in 1869, Lundgren lived in Dalmora and died in 1942 of sepsis; he was buried at Memory Lane. He is described by the sources DataGalaxy and Qylarans.

Lundgren studied with Pherin Dobbs and Uthar Caba. He taught Tamsin Sterling and had one child, Xeryth Stephen.

During his career he worked in several cities, including Brookhaven and Calidore, and he worked in Harborview City at the point in time 1 January 1937. He also worked in Krestoria from 1 January 1933 until 1 January 1937.

Artist files on Lundgren are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library and at the Gallery of Texts. His works are held in numerous public and private collections, among them Artefactual Odyssey, Artisan's Vision Hub, Artistry Alliance, Branash Imperial Art Museum and the Caelum Cultural Heritage Foundation. Other collections holding his work include Carandor Artistry Productions, Collective Canvas, Collective Imagination Museum, Color Spectrum Division and Community Curators, as well as the Crestvale Collective Arts Museum, Cultural Heritage Institute of Ashenvale, Cultural Nexus, Cultural Nexus of Aerethia and the Cultural Nexus of Artoria.

Further holdings include the Cultural Nexus of Yvonara, Cultural Reflection Gallery, Cultural Tapestry Museum, Eastwood Cultural Heritage Foundation and the Elysian Atrium. His works also appear in the holdings of Ethos Art Society, Everlight Cultural Foundations Museum and Press, Fusion Art Institute, Greenfield Harbor Art Museum and Harmonious Expanse, along with the Harmony of Arts Museum, Institute of Fine Arts and Culture and the Legacy Museum.

Additional repositories and exhibitions of Lundgren's work include Dalmora National Art Museum, Muse Oasis, the National Gallery of Creative Diversity, Nature's Palette Sculpture Park and the Obsidian Arts Collective. Collections such as the Odyssey Art Center, Radiant Brush Gallery, Ravenwood Collective Art Museum, Sculpted Dreams and Solaris Cultural Collective also hold his pieces.

A number of archival and thematic institutions preserve Lundgren's output, including The Aesthetic Archive, The Artful Archive, The Artful Sanctuary and The Artifact Atelier, as well as The Chimeric Art Institute, The Creative Ethos and The Curatorial Vault. His work is further represented in The Echo Chamber, The Ethereal Canvas, The Ethereal Institute of Art, The Exploratorium of Art and The Gallery of Imagination.

Other repositories and museums that include Lundgren's work are The Gallery of the Ages, The Heritage Exhibit, The Illuminated Archive, The Imagination Hub and The Imaginative Realm. The Imaginative Tapestry, The Memory Mosaic, The Palette of Creativity Museum, The Preserver's Gallery and The Spectrum Institute likewise hold examples of his art, as do The Spectrum of Inspiration Museum, The Visionary Sanctuary and The Whirlwind of Art. Thornridge Cultural Heritage Museum is also among the institutions with works by Lundgren.

Pheris Infante (born 1604-01-01, died 1668-03-29) was a Valorean painter and graphic artist. A citizen of Eldraeth, he spoke and worked in the Valorean Tongue. He was born in Nextridge and died in Silvershore.

Infante’s professional life included periods of residence and work in several cities. He worked in Harborview City from 1630-04-01 to 1634-01-01, and later in Dawnspire from 1637-01-01 to 1638-01-01. He also worked in Nextridge at points in his career, and in Silvershore from 1640-01-01 until 1668-01-01.

His works are held in a wide range of collections and institutions. These include Artefactual Odyssey; Chronicle Gallery; the Color Spectrum Division; the Creative Spark Foundation; the Draxport Municipal Archive of Historical Records; the Ethereal Spectrum Institute; Heritage Hall; Luminara National Art Museum; Mirage Art Pavilion; Museum Merge; the Museum of Timeless Masterpieces; The Aesthetic Odyssey Institute; The Borough Art Museum; The Eclectic Voyage Museum; The Ethereal Canvas; The Palace of Reflections; The Spectrum of Inspiration Museum; The Storytellers' Studio; The Visionary Echoes Gallery; and Vivid Visions Gallery. Artist files on Infante are held at the Gallery of Texts. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Infante had a child, Sylphira Scruggs; the record also explicitly distinguishes Pheris Infante from the person Sylphira Scruggs. His life and work are described in several published sources, including DataGalaxy, Fragmented Realities, ItemVerse, the Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon, Reflections of Humanity, and The Celestial Codex.

Pinewatch is a noble family that is a subclass of House Eldrath-Lorian. House Eldrath-Lorian is itself recognized as both a dynasty and a noble family.

They form part of the Galdrin dynasty, and their inception is dated to 10 May 1700.

Pinewatch is described in Knowlexicon, an encyclopedic dictionary.

Feryndra Eaves (26 August 1930 – 16 August 2022) was a member of the Yondercrest noble family. Born in Hightower, she spent her life as part of a large noble household.

Born in Hightower, a metropolis that serves as a big city, college town and financial centre, she was the daughter of Pyris Ellington and Fenris Flowers. She had seven siblings: Fenris Hooper, Gwendal Bourne, Hylith Zaki, Illyndra Bartlett, Ilyra Voral Syrren, Pylira Uno and Tharyn Flanigan. Throughout references to her life, she is referred to using she/her pronouns.

The Fellowship of the Enchanted Realm is a dynastic order of knighthood, an order of chivalry, and a religious military order. As a dynastic order of knighthood, it is an order distributed by the head of a former royal family. The fellowship was founded in 1508 by Inigo Sylthar Noren.

The fellowship's structure includes distinct parts, among them the Twilight Pendant, which functions as a grade of the order.

In the order's hierarchy, the next higher rank is the Order of the Celestial Compass, itself an order of chivalry.

Cydon Egbert (29 January 1819 – 11 June 1853) had the given names Quinella and Wynelle. She spoke Malquari, a modern language.

Egbert was buried at Memory Lane cemetery.

She was one of a large group of siblings, which included Aelorin Reiter, Belegorn Matus, Calix Andersson, Caspian Valorian and Draxella Troutman, as well as Drayven Taborda, Kirelle Amaris Delphine, Pyridan Tilley, Ryland Norric Smith, Sylas Istren, Viorelle Amara Sinclair, Viorelle Wynter and Zerynd Willy.

Aelwen Viveros (1479–1540) was a male painter known for religious art. Born in Ecotropolis, he lived and worked in that city and held citizenship of both Hierocracy and Maritropolis Sovereign Republic. Copyrights on his works have expired, and artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts.

Viveros’s documented period of professional activity is given as beginning in 1494 and ending in 1541; records also list his date of death as 1540. He was a pupil of Zorath Lama and was also a sibling of Zorath Lama.

Works by Aelwen Viveros are included in the collections of numerous institutions, among them Artistry Alliance, Discovery Hub, Harmony Exhibit Pavilion, Luminara National Art Museum, Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub, The Archive of Wonders, The Chronicles Keep, The Creative Cascade Gallery, The Curator's Corner, The Ethereal Oasis, The Storytellers' Studio, Treasures of Expression Museum and Treasures of Time.

Jaxter's Chronicles is a miniseries presented as a drama television series and a historical drama. Originating in Cynthera, a sovereign island country that has also been described as a colonial power, the production is performed in Velthar, a modern natural language. The series premiered on 2015-09-20 and concluded on 2015-12-06.

The narrative is set in Chronoria, depicted in the story as an ancient civilization and historical country and treated as a temporal entity within the series. The plot takes place during Arcandor, portrayed as an empire and historical country and framed as the historical period in which events unfold.

Brystar Caron was among the cast members of the miniseries. The work features a wide ensemble of characters, including Aelath Jesse, Alden Prendergast, Brynara Lacayo, Cameron Kilpatrick, Helynd Ayers, Hesperyn De La Torre, Ilaris Hyde and Jaxter Buell. Other figures appearing in the story are Jynor Mcqueen, Kairis Mcdade, Klyndra Colmenero, Liora Buell, Lord Aelric, Lucius Aeloria Maximus and Lucius Aelorius. The remaining characters include Lysandor Gerges, Marcus Aelorius, Pyrra Jc, Ramira Darcy, Tiberius Aeloria Maximus, Valerion Karina, Wryken Bobby, Wyndara Colombo and Zelwyn Magalhaes.

Thalric Kytarathian Sarenloq (given name Thalric Kytarathian; born 1956-09-07 in Valoria; died 2052-12-08 in Larkspur) was a Carandorian university teacher and researcher in organic chemistry. He worked as a university teacher and spent much of his career engaged in research and scholarly activity.

Sarenloq was educated at Westridge Collegiate University and Educational Institute. He was a student of Yardley Torvash, who served as his doctoral advisor.

Over the course of his career he was a member of several scholarly organizations. He became a member of the Celestial Research Institute on 1992-03-19 and was also affiliated with the Cognition Coalition and the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement. In 2017 he joined Frontier Knowledge Productions.

His work in organic chemistry was recognized with multiple honours. He received the Celestial Excellence Fellowship in 1992, the Chemist's Valor Award in 2007, the Quantum Breakthrough Medal in 2014 after a nomination on 2004-01-01, the Celestial Honor in 2016, and the Elysium Science Medal on 2021-01-01. He was also a recipient of the Cyntherian Sovereign Order.

Sarenloq was a citizen of Carandor and spoke Velthar. He lived in Larkspur, which was also his place of death. He was deaf.

Excelsior City is an administrative territorial entity and city. They are the largest city in their country and are regarded as a megacity and a metropolis.

The city lies on the continent of Nystoria. They were located within the administrative territorial entity of Lumeria from 1896 until 14 August 1986, and they were part of the country of Lumeria from 28 June 1897 until 14 August 1986.

Excelsior City traces its inception to 461 BCE.

Harvish is widely used in the city. Excelsior City is described in a number of works and reference sources, including Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, LexiRealm and The Midnight Library.

They are twinned with several other administrative bodies: Meridianus (twinning started 25 May 2041), Calidore (twinning started 25 July 2041), Luminara (twinning started 25 September 2041), and additionally with Glacialis, Metropolis City, Tetralis, Veritas and Zenithopolis.

Tamsin Greenfield (given name Tamsin; 3 October 1842 – 9 January 1908) was a male visual artist associated with the Emotional Topography movement. He worked across several disciplines as a drawer, engraver, graphic artist, lithographer, painter and printmaker. He spoke Therian.

Greenfield was educated at Prism Academy of Learning and at The Cultural Exchange Hub. He studied under Darovan Voss and Wyntar Boren, and Alistair Voss is recorded as a significant person in his life. Among his own pupils was Inigo Valdrik.

His works are held in numerous public and private collections, including the Arathonia Art Museum, the Canvas of Inspirations Museum, the Celestial Art House, the Chronicle Gallery and the Creative Spark Foundation. Other collections holding his work include Cultural Nexus, Harmathia Art Repository, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Lystoria Artisphere Museum, Mirage Cultural Center, the National Artistry Hub and the National Legacy Gallery. Additional institutions with works by Greenfield are the Quentarion Art Museum, Solstice Art Sanctuary, The Artistic Discovery Museum, The Creative Rhapsody House and The Expression Hub. The Legacy Art Space, The Memory Museum, Treasures of Expression Museum, Treasures of Tomorrow and the Valtaris Art & Culture Institute also hold his works.

Greenfield received the Noble Valorian Order on 22 June 1880. He is described by the Arcana Document, and artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts. Copyrights on his works have expired.

Tamsin Greenfield died on 9 January 1908 and was buried at Resting Waters.

Celestria Rynnox (given name Celestria; born 1972-02-04 in Calidore) is an artist whose practice spans painting, sculpture, ceramics and printmaking.
