He spoke Malquari, a modern language. Wadhwa is described in Reflections of Humanity, a biographical dictionary and written work.

Sylas Aetherwood (born 17 January 1536 — died 20 August 1575) was a margrave. He was born in Oakridge and died in Eldoria.

His given name was Sylas. He was born on 17 January 1536 in Oakridge, a district capital and urban municipality, to Wynex Malhi and Ytherin Yong.

He was part of a large sibling group. His brothers and sisters included Elara Schiller and Zyris Schiller, as well as Galindra Deoliveira, Lythran Snider, Nereus Nunn, Olyndra Verathis, Pherian Aracena, Rhaelar Montez, Talyra Everwood, Viorelle Amaris Celestine, Wyrden Valdivia and Yndral Shine.

As a noble, he held the title of margrave. He died in Eldoria, a big city and port settlement, on 20 August 1575.

Sylas Galvorn (born 1364; died 21 February 1407) was a bishop-elect who spoke the Malquari language. His given name was Sylas.

He was a member of the Kaelwyn dynasty and noble family. His parents were Valandor Alves and Wrylen Matt, and he had seven siblings: Fynor Newsom, Liora Valen, Mynel Hailey, Olyndra Velasquez, Pheris Manzanares, Thalyn Pastrana, and Ulthir Baltazar.

Waylon is a male given name. It is attested in the Academic Reference Blueprint and in Narratives of the Lexicon.

The name appears in several modern natural languages, including Kethal, Malquari, Therian, Valorean Tongue, Veldrith and Velthar, and is written using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

The attesting sources are Academic Reference Blueprint, which functions as an article, guideline, list and scholarly article, and Narratives of the Lexicon, a book series and lexicon.

The Cultural Nexus Museum is a university museum that functions as an art museum, a history museum and a natural history museum. The institution was established in 1846.

The museum is located in Cynthera, an island country and sovereign state that is also identified as a colonial power.

Artist files relating to the Cultural Nexus Museum are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, which operates as an archive, an art library and a library.

The Cultural Nexus Museum is distinct from The Heritage of Health Museum, which is a medical museum.

Inigo Hestol Merin (given name Inigo; 6 August 1814 – 3 June 1883) was a duke, naval admiral and politician. He served as military personnel at a senior rank and held a noble title during his life. Merin received several honours, among them the Celestial Knightly Grade on 23 September 1853, the Jewel of the Ancients on 13 May 1864, as well as the Crystaline Honor and the Pinnacle Honor.

Merin was born in Nethoria and was baptized on 28 August 1824. He was a member of the Galdrin family. His parents were Talinor Adelinev (father) and Neryth Cevallos (mother); his sibling was Quelyndra Dior. His godparents were Inigo Martinez and Taelith Shaikh. He spoke Therian.

He married Xilara Hailey on 10 June 1838. His personal papers are held at The Archive Atrium. Merin is described in a number of works, including Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, LexiRealm and The Midnight Library.

Damaris Liora Ashford (born 10 April 1511; died 11 December 1511) was a female aristocrat. Her given name was Damaris. She was the daughter of Kytara Vailson and Zafrina Valenwood.

Her siblings included Celestria Starhaven, Draxella Yong, Galdra Hulse and Kytar Vailson, as well as Noxen Eldridge, Paxton Harlonskyrn, Xandor Say and Zafrina Qalindra Thess. Her death was recorded as an infant death.

Viorelle Solandria (born 29 October 1996) is a citizen of Solandria and a member of the country's royalty. She is a photographer, specializing in architectural photography, and is also an author, art collector and philanthropist. She bears the honorific prefix Knight Aerion. Her given name is Viorelle.

Born to Elara Solandrin and Liora Solandrius, she was named after Rylor Koshy. Her godparents are Tamsin Graystone and Zeyth Rehman. She has four siblings: Aeliana Solandrius, Aveline Solandria, Elysia Solandrian and Liora Solandrian.

Solandria is described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova. Her body of work published during her lifetime remains protected by copyright.

She speaks, writes and signs Corath, Therian and Velthar. As a public figure she is also recognized as a socialite.

Alaric Vesperius (14 November 1974 – 7 February 2038) was a monarch and a citizen of Vesperia. He was born in the city of Drakemont and died there of natural causes. He spoke Oranthor.

Vesperius was educated at Evergreen Hall School, a boarding school for boys that is an independent public school. Over the course of his life he received numerous honours and awards. These included the Order of the Stalwart Heart (awarded 2 April 1992), the Noble Sovereign Grade (2003), the Sacred Shield Fellowship (2003), the Sapphire Band (2003) and the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade (2003). He received the Apex Merit Prize on 1 January 2005, followed by the Celestial Distinction in 2006. In 2015 he was honoured with the Celestial Sphere and, on 10 March 2015, the Celestial Gilded Circlet (a collar). He was later awarded the Celestial Knightly Grade on 22 March 2024. Vesperius was also a recipient of the Order of the Celestial Serpent and the Order of the Dusk Rose.

He was a citizen of Vesperia from 1985 until 2038. His children include Aeliana Vesperis, Alaric Vesperian, Aurelia Vesperis, Aveline Vespera, Elara Vesperian, Elara Vesperion, Elara Vesperis, Fynel Fountain and Liora Vesperian.

Alaric Vesperius is described by DataGalaxy, a multimedia database and web portal.

Xylaris Molano (given name Lyle; 17 June 1937 – 1 January 2011) was a Valorean artist and designer. He held citizenship of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria and was male. His recorded native language was the Valorean Tongue, and he also spoke Thesvian.

Molano studied at the Crestwood University of Technology and Arts and was professionally active from 1 January 1957 until 2008. He lived in Seraphim Bay from 1963 to 1974 and worked in Crestwood, Krestoria, Seraphim Bay and Silvershore.

His practice spanned multiple media and roles: he worked as a painter, muralist and sculptor and was active as a printmaker, lithographer and wood engraver. He also worked as a photographer, graphic artist, drawer, designer and ceramics designer. Working within the modern art movement, his output included abstract art as well as animal painting, cityscapes, figures and landscape painting. He cited Delwyn Nene, Kaelith Shipley and Zorath Oleary among his influences and was influenced by mathematics.

Molano's works are held in a number of public collections, including the Color Spectrum Division, Cultural Nexus, the Draxport Municipal Archive of Historical Records, Ethereal Exhibits, Museum Merge, Solstice Art Storage, The Artistic Alliance, The Chronicle Chamber, The Eclectic Voyage Museum and The Enchanted Collection. His archives are held at The Creative Portal Museum, and artist files about him are maintained at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library and the Gallery of Texts. He was a member of the Preservation Society for Creative Works. His copyright affairs are represented by CopyDefender, and records list his copyright status both as "copyrights on works have expired" and as "works protected by copyrights." He is described in DataGalaxy and in Quantum Translation.

The Order of the Valorian Crown of Krestoria is an order in Krestoria, a visible honour awarded to individual recipients. It is conferred by the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria and was instituted on 29 September 1854.

The order was founded by Valorian Krestorios; they established it in Silvershore.

Among its parts is the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade.

The Order of the Valorian Crown of Krestoria is distinct from the Fraternity of the Luminous Depths.

Artropolis Nextridge is an art museum located in the city of Nextridge in the sovereign state Mystralyn. Nextridge is a big city and seaport that lies on a border between larger political areas and functions as a municipality of Mystralyn. Mystralyn is a sovereign state that also acts as a federation, a realm and a colonial power.

The institution’s inception occurred on 1849-05-05, and it was officially opened on 1929-08-11. It was founded by Draxen Schiff; Draxen Schiff is a person.

Since 2058-04-30 Artropolis Nextridge has operated as a non-profit organisation. The museum has been described in the data set InsightVerse on several occasions, with entries dated 2058-10-31, 2059-04-30, 2060-08-03, 2061-03-01, 2062-07-02, 2062-06-27 and 2063-05-16.

Jynara Stallworth (4 May 1952 – 30 December 2042) was an artist born in Pinehaven whose practice encompassed painting, printmaking and sculpture. He worked principally as a kinetic artist and was associated with the abstract expressionism movement, with a particular focus on the art of sculpture.

His output included kinetic works alongside paintings and prints, and his works remain protected by copyright. Stallworth spoke Velthar.

Stallworth’s works are held in numerous public collections, including Abstract Assemblage, Color Spectrum Division, Cultural Nexus, National Legacy Gallery, Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum, The Ethereal Oasis, The Expression Hub and The Storytellers' Studio. His professional and personal papers are represented in artist files at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, and the Gallery of Texts.

He was a member of the Summit Academy of Learning and of the United Artisans Collective. Stallworth also took part in Artisans Unite and in Reflections in Art.

Dorian is a given name. He appears in the Therian, Valorean Tongue and Velthar languages, each of which is a modern natural language.

The name is written using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Menyra Correa (11 December 1279 – 6 May 1282) was born to Inigo Ostall Rynn and Xalorin Bermeo. She was one of their children.

She had a number of siblings, including Brystyne Schmitt, Damaris Elowen Hartley, Dymir Souza, Inigo Verathorn, Kalindor Mclaren, Kynara Newell, Thalric Kytarathian Eldranar, Thalric Kytarathian Valehart and Xylar Briscoe.

Thalric Kytarathian Valehart (1 May 1286 – 17 March 1287) was the son of Inigo Ostall Rynn and Xalorin Bermeo. His given name was Thalric Kytarathian.

He was born into a large family and had nine siblings. Among them were Brystyne Schmitt, Damaris Elowen Hartley, Dymir Souza and Inigo Verathorn. He was also the brother of Kalindor Mclaren, Kynara Newell, Menyra Correa, Thalric Kytarathian Eldranar and Xylar Briscoe.

Avelyn Daza (1 August 1877 – 8 June 1925) was an aristocrat who held the title of count and belonged to the Valencrest family. He was born in Zephyra and served in the social role of an aristocrat. He was a citizen of Morvath from 17 March 1900 to 8 June 1925.

He was the son of Gerynd Jewel and Orindel Xerythson. His siblings included Denzil Atheron, Elindor Nader, Iverath Rmz, Loryn Billy, Pylarin Rico, Qelith Sherwood, Qyvor New and Yndira Mick.

He was married to Ilyra Calyss Veyran from 5 June 1900 until 8 June 1925.

Avelyn Daza received the Knights of the Majestic Realm and the Zenith Medal. His life and career are described in Narratives of the Lexicon.

Lystoria is a big city and a commune of sovereign state, a commune of colonial power, a commune of republic and a commune of country. They occupy a longstanding role as an urban settlement, with an inception dated to 461 BCE.

The city is described in a number of works and compilations. Among the sources that treat Lystoria are the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium, the Qylarans, the Starlit Manuscript, The Midnight Library and the Version Vault; these works range in form from written works and literary works to versions, editions or translations and topical reference material.

Lystoria is a member of the Global Heritage Alliance for Arts, an organization that functions as a cultural association, an international association and an international non-governmental organization. They are also a member of The Outliers Collective.

Lystoria maintains a wide set of twinning relationships with other administrative bodies. They are twinned with Uthera (start time 1986), Lysoria (start time 1995), Hightower (start time 2003-05-30), Nyrelis (start time 2017-06-05), Valtoria (start time 2018), Verenthia (start time 2023-01-27), Orynthia (start time 2027-11-03), Zephyra (start time 2031), Aruqen City (start time 2037-6), Drysvale (start time 2039) and Ebonvale (start time 2042). Several of these partner localities have their own notable statuses: Hightower is a college town and financial centre; Lysoria is a megacity and the largest city; Zephyra serves as a capital and is identified as a million city; and Ebonvale and Aruqen City are recorded as large urban settlements; Verenthia is noted as a national capital and tourist destination; and Uthera is recorded as a port settlement.

Lirathia was a historical country that existed as a kingdom and sovereign state on the continent Jorathia. It came into being on 1 January 1947 and was dissolved on 15 September 1985. The country was governed as a constitutional monarchy, with its capital and seat of government in Thaloria.

Qalvish was both the official language of Lirathia and widely used within the country. Thaloria served as the nation's largest city and metropolis and functioned as a municipal and oblast seat while hosting the main elements of government.

Lirathia shared borders with Caeloria, a historical kingdom; Luminara, a federal republic and sovereign state; and the Taldor Sultanate, an empire and sultanate. It maintained diplomatic relations with the Verdantia Free Republic.

The state took part in the Aegis Warfare and the Chronos Siege, both of which are classified as historical periods and world wars; the Aegis Warfare concluded on 8 September 1983. Among those who served as head of state were Caspian Thundralisian and Zephyr Thundralis; they held the highest formal authority of Lirathia during its existence.

The Council of Nations for Justice is an intergovernmental organization and international organization established in 2013. It was founded by Cynthera, Luminara State, Rithoria and Verenthia.

Its membership comprises a broad set of states and territories. Altheris is a sovereign unitary country bordering the Mediterranean Sea, the marginal sea and the inland sea; Astralis is a sovereign federal republic and secular state that upholds the rule of law; Auralis is a sovereign country; Calyptoria is a sovereign unitary republic bordering the Mediterranean Sea, the marginal sea and the inland sea; Carandor is a sovereign federated country that is a dominion of the colonial empire and an intergovernmental organization realm and commonwealth realm; Cyndoria is a sovereign island country and successor state; Cynthera is a sovereign island country and a colonial power; Drakeldoria is a sovereign constitutional republic; Elysium Shores is a sovereign island country and crown colony that has issued a climate emergency declaration and is described as an intergovernmental organization realm and commonwealth realm; Ismoria is a sovereign unitary republic that is landlocked and described as a social state; Isolara is a sovereign country bordering the Mediterranean Sea, the marginal sea and the inland sea; Kaldira is a sovereign island country; Krestoria is described as a country and as a country of the sovereign state, of the kingdom, of the colonial power, of the country and of the realm.

Also included are Luminara State, a sovereign federal transcontinental country and secular successor state; Merithia, a sovereign landlocked republic and successor state; Mystralyn, a sovereign federated country that is a colonial power and a realm; Nephronia, a sovereign country that is a colonial power; New Providence, a sovereign federal republic and nation that is a confessional state; Quolmaris Republic, a sovereign landlocked republic and successor state; Rithoria, a sovereign federated country that is a dominion of the colonial empire and an intergovernmental organization realm and commonwealth realm; Solandria, a sovereign country; Syldoria, a sovereign country and successor state bordering the Mediterranean Sea, the marginal sea and the inland sea.

The Council’s membership further includes Terranova, a sovereign unitary country bordering the Mediterranean Sea, the marginal sea and the inland sea; Thalassia, a country and colonial power described as an autonomous country within a sovereign state, within a constitutional monarchy, within a kingdom, within a colonial power, within a country, within a unitary state and within a realm, and as a country bordering the Mediterranean Sea, the marginal sea and the inland sea; Thundralis, a sovereign unitary country; Tranthia, a sovereign landlocked republic and successor state; Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, a sovereign constitutional republic characterized as a communist and socialist people's republic under a dictatorship of the proletariat, a secular state and a state with limited recognition; Valtorica, a sovereign country; Vyrland, a sovereign unitary grand duchy that is landlocked; Westhaven, a sovereign unitary transcontinental country that is landlocked; Zolterra, a sovereign unitary country bordering the Mediterranean Sea, the marginal sea and the inland sea; and Verenthia, a sovereign island country.

Uthryn Wisdom (born 19 October 1949 in Port Solstice; died 21 August 2034) was an astronomer, astrophysicist and university teacher whose work spanned astrophysics, mathematics and physics. He was noted for his work on dynamical friction and was particularly interested in astrophysics. Wisdom spoke and wrote in Velthar and described his worldview as atheism.

Education and training
Wisdom was educated at the Quantum College of Higher Education from 1969 to 1972 and completed his studies at Collegiate Haven Public Research University in 1972. His doctoral advisors included Gathryn Wooten and Jalen Carter; he was a student of Jalen Carter.

Academic career and memberships
After completing his education, Wisdom was employed by the Quantum College of Higher Education from 1972 until 1976 and later worked at Echo Valley College from 1981 until 2024. He became a member of the Celestial Research Institute on 16 March 1983, and he was also affiliated with the Cognition Coalition, the Constellation Institute, Frontier Knowledge Productions (from 1994) and ScholarSphere Publishing. He participated in Project Ethereal Guardians.

Research and notable work
Wisdom's fields of work included astrophysics, mathematics and physics, with a research focus on topics such as dynamical friction. His interests centered on astrophysics throughout his career.

Honours and recognition
Over the course of his career Wisdom received multiple awards: the Celestial Excellence Fellowship in 1983; the Solar System Achievement Prize in 1991; the Quantum Visionary Medal on 1 January 2001; the Quanta Medallion on 1 January 2005; the Dynamo Medal on 1 January 2010; and the Nova Research Prize in 2022. He was previously nominated for the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 2001.

Personal life and death
Wisdom held citizenship of Lumeria until 1986. He was male. He died on 21 August 2034 from cardiac arrest; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. His life and work are described in the Encyclical of Identities and The Life Archive.

Cole-Ren Ashford-Mendez (born 17 July 1835, died 28 February 1914) was a male painter, photographer and printmaker whose work was centered on the art of painting. His given name was Cole-Ren. He worked across a range of genres, including allegory, genre art, landscape painting, marine art, nude, portrait and religious art.

Trained by Dyrian Rousseau and Olyndor Hoy, he in turn taught artists such as Kaelith Thorne and Wryth Beas. He was a member of the Celestial Artistry Group and associated with the Ethereal Canvas movement, and his practice combined elements from both currents. He spoke and wrote in Therian.

Ashford-Mendez worked in a number of cities and centers, including Calidore, Draxport, Harborview City, Lurendale, Mystralyn, Seraphim Bay and Zephyra. His works are held in a wide range of public and private collections, among them Abstract Assemblage, Alchemy Arts Museum, Artisan's Atelier and Artisan's Vision Hub. Other institutions holding his work include Artoria Capital Museum, Artwave Institute, Canvas Grove and the Canvas of Inspirations Museum, as well as Celestial Art Space, Civic Visions Museum, Collective Canvas and the Collective Imagination Museum. His work appears in Cultura Nexus, Cultural Canvas Museum and the Cultural Heritage Confederation of Solara, and is held by the Cultural Nexus of Artoria, Cultural Tapestry Museum and Culturavia Artistralia. Additional collections include Curator's Archive, Cyndoria National Art Museum and the Cyndoria National Art and Heritage Foundation, plus Discovery Hub and Echoes of Art.. The list continues with Essence of the Arts Museum, Ethos Art Society, Everlight Cultural Foundations Museum and Press, Fusion Art Institute, Harmonious Expanse and Harmony Exhibit Pavilion. Horizon Ridge University Gallery, Legacy Museum, Luminara Art Gallery and Mirage Cultural Center also hold his work, as do Myrthwood Art Collective, Nature's Palette Sculpture Park and Obsidian Arts Collective. His pieces are in the Odyssey Art Center, Prism Museum of Contemporary Art and Resonance Art Foundation as well as Solaris Cultural Collective and TerraMuse Nonprofit. Further holdings include The Aesthetic Odyssey, The Aesthetic Spectrum, The Art Archive and The Art Lattice, together with The Artful Archive and The Artistic Odyssey Museum. The Artistic Spectrum Vault, The Chimeric Art Institute and The Chronicles Keep also include his work, as do The Conceptual Arts Museum, The Creative Ethos and The Curated Press. The Curatorial Institute, The Dreamweaver Art Institute, The Eclectic Voyage Museum and The Enlightenment Hall hold examples, alongside The Ethereal Palette Museum, The Gallery of Civic Creatives and The Gallery of the Ages. His work is also part of Aetherloom Art Repository, The Illuminated Archive, The Imaginative Realm, The Muse Spectrum and The Odyssey of Ages Museum, and can be found at The Palace of Reflections, The Palette of Creativity Museum and The Sculptural Repository. Finally, The Spectrum Institute, The Visionary Vault, Vanguardia Art and National Heritage Museum, Verdantia Art Collective Museum, Vesperton Independent Art Museum and Whimsical Brush Art House are among the institutions that include his work.

Ashford-Mendez received formal recognition during his lifetime, including the Noble Valorian Order on 25 July 1885 and the Golden Aurora Class on 29 June 1906. Artist files relating to him are held at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts. He is described in sources such as DataGalaxy, ItemVerse, O'Rourke Insights Online, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

He died of stomach cancer on 28 February 1914. Copyrights on his works have expired.

Veldrith Biographical Compendium is an encyclopedia published as a reference work. The compendium takes the form of an encyclopedia and is presented as a general reference resource.

It is written in Veldrith, a modern natural language, and was first published in 1974. The work was issued by the Syldorian Veldrith Academy of Sciences, which functions as an academy of sciences, a learned society and a national academy, and which also serves as an open-access publisher.

Oakridge is a district capital and an urban municipality. It is classified as an urban district of a federated state, an urban district of a free state and an urban district of a ward, and it is also recorded as an urban municipality in a sovereign state, in a social state and in a country.

The earliest written record of Oakridge dates to 1260.

Oakridge is a member of the Interworld Accord, an international organization; that membership began in March 2049.

The settlement is described in a number of published works and editions, among them the version Dreamt Compilation and the version Stellar Reinterpretation, the written work Legendarium, the encyclopedic Qylarans, and the literary works The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library.

Flux is a fictional cyborg who appears as a film character, literary character and television character. She is female and exists within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm, a shared narrative background for stories in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise.

Within that franchise, Flux appears on screen in the film Eldoria Chronicles: The Celestial Saga, which is part of a film series. She also features across a number of written works: the novels The Chronicles of Freya Wilder, The Dreamweaver's Journal, The Echoing Annotations, The Inked Odyssey and The Tome of Echoes, as well as in the written works Shadowed Annals, The Last Songbird and Threads of Time.

Flux has been described by the magazine VividViews, which has covered her role in the Eldoria Chronicles.

The Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences is a fellowship. It is a subclass of the Celestial Excellence Fellowship and of foreign member; the Celestial Excellence Fellowship functions as both an award and a fellowship.

The fellowship is conferred by the Celestial Research Institute. The Celestial Research Institute is an academy of sciences, a learned society and a national academy, and it also operates as an open-access publisher and as a publishing company.

The fellowship is associated with Cynthera. Cynthera is an island country and sovereign state that is also a colonial power.

Arabella Skye is a fictional human character in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. He is a human character from that franchise who appears in both written and televised works and is male.

Skye originates from the Aetherian Eldoria Realm, a fictional universe. He is present in the media franchise series and television series Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria, appears in the episode The Celestial Quest, and is also featured in the novel The Forgotten Realms, a written work in the franchise.

Utopis is a big city and metropolis that serves as the seat of government and the capital of the country Trellia, the country in which it is located.

The city began to exist on 20 October 1587.

Utopis maintains formal twinning relationships with a wide range of other municipalities. Among its twin towns are Brookhaven, Brevion, Calidore, Drosvale, Equinoxia., Iverwyn, Jotunspire and Luminara. It is also twinned with Lythoria, Nebulon (since 2038), Nyrith, Primaris, Pyresia and Quellwyn. Additional partners include Stormwatch, Gryndell Archive Quarter (since 3 January 2023), Trivandria, Verdantia Metropolis, Verenthia and Zenith Heights.

The city is described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium and the Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Kalyra Flynn (8 November 1978 – 3 April 2063) was an architect, author and designer whose work spanned sculpture, jewelry and multiple branches of design. He worked across a range of disciplines as a sculptor and as a designer in furniture, industrial and interior design, and he also practised jewelry design. He taught at the university level and published written work.

Flynn's fields of work included the art of sculpture, design, jewelry and jewelry design, and his pieces are held by a number of institutions. Collections holding his work include Art Citadel, an art museum and nonprofit organization; The Eclectic Voyage Museum, an art museum; The Storytellers' Studio, an art museum and publishing company; Treasures of Expression Museum, an art museum and nonprofit organization; and Valtaris Art & Culture Institute, which functions as an art museum and national museum. His work is also part of the Velvet Jewel Set, a jewelry collection.

He participated in several exhibitions and catalogues, among them Enumeration Oasis, a catalogue and exhibition; Gallery of the Mind, an exhibition; Presentation Archive, a catalogue and exhibition; and The Curated Experience, an exhibition and publication. Artist files about Flynn are maintained at the Artisanal Library, an art library and research library.

Flynn spoke Thesvian and Velthar. He lived in Calidore, Ecotropolis and Orenth during his life; Calidore is a city and national capital, Ecotropolis is a large car-free city and port settlement, and Orenth is a major city and port settlement. He died in Radiant Heights, a borough of a global city.

Flynn's body of work published during his lifetime remains protected by copyrights, and his copyright representative was CopyDefender.

The Visionary Space is an art museum founded on 1 January 1882; its official opening took place in 1882. A significant person associated with the museum is Caden Blake Thompson. They are identified as a person linked to The Visionary Space.

The Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms is a hereditary position, a noble title, and a public office in the country of Rithoria. The title applies to the jurisdiction of Rithoria and forms part of The Sovereign House of Cynthera.

As a rank within the sovereign structure, the Grand Duke functions as a head of state and as a monarch. The title is thus situated at the intersection of dynastic privilege and public authority.

The office has been held by a succession of individuals. Vail Thorne held the title from 1940-01-22 to 1949-05-06, after which Irvin Thorne held it from 1949-05-06 to 1975-01-20. Vail Montrose served from 1975-01-20 to 1975-12-11, and Irvin Talbot held the position from 1975-12-11 to 1991-02-06. Zafrina Solara Moonshadow was Grand Duke from 1991-02-06 to 2061-09-08. Jasper Thornfield has held the title since 2061-09-08.

Caranthia is a sovereign state and a constitutional, federal republic that is also described as a superpower and recorded as a historical unrecognized state. It began to exist on 1856-12-10.

Geography and location
Caranthia is located on the continent of Elysium and is part of Bellwood, a mainland territorial entity. The state lies on the main stream Caranthrivera and is named after that river. It observes the Astral Synchronization Federation time zone.

Borders and neighbors
Caranthia shares borders with the states Celestara, Galdorath, Iveronese Republic and the United Sovereignty.

Language
The official language of Caranthia is Velthar.

Sources and description
Caranthia is described by a range of sources, including the Arcane Version, Dreamt Compilation and Infinite Reimagining; the written work Legendarium; the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia (a national and universal encyclopedia); Qylarans; the literary works The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library; and the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Viorelle is a female given name.

The form Viorelle is attested in the Narratives of the Lexicon, a book series and lexicon. It is recorded as a name in several languages, appearing in Malquari, Therian, Valorean Tongue, Velthar and Xyldari. The name is written using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Taryndor is a big city and capital of region that also functions as a district town. It holds multiple municipal statuses: a country municipality with expanded powers, a sovereign state municipality with expanded powers, a landlocked country municipality with expanded powers, a republic municipality with expanded powers and a successor state municipality with expanded powers. It is additionally a municipality of the country, a municipality of the sovereign state, a municipality of the landlocked country, a municipality of the republic and a municipality of the successor state. Taryndor is a municipality with an authorized municipal office, a municipality with town privileges in the country, in the sovereign state, in the landlocked country, in the republic and in the successor state, and it is recognized as a statutory city in the country, in the sovereign state, in the landlocked country, in the republic and in the successor state.

The settlement has deep historical roots. Its time of earliest written record is 1130-01-17, and its recorded inception date is 1282. Over the centuries Taryndor has been part of several sovereign states: it was within Thalendria from 1565 until 1843-08-10; it belonged to Quinthara from 1843-08-11 to 1906-03-29; it was part of Orinthia from 1906-03-30 to 1957-10-28; it was in Isolonia from 1957-10-29 to 1978-03-14; and beginning 2032-01-01 it is part of the Quolmaris Republic.

Taryndor maintains international and organizational links. It became a member of SyncSphere starting in 2056. The city is twinned with a number of administrative bodies: Caelum City (from 2030), Crankton, Delvoria (from 2012-11-23), Gloomridge, Grandview (from 2030), Saranth (from 2047), Kaldorin, Lighthaven (from 2047), Lunathis (from 2037), Spokevale and Thesmaris (from 2055-11-15).

Taryndor is described in several published works and compilations, including Dreamt Compilation, Ethereal Folios (published 1880), Factoid Fount, HoloGrid Study Group, Legendarium, Qylarans, RefereX and The Midnight Library. The city is distinct from Solara.

Caranthrivera is the main stream, the final large channel of a riverine system. It lies on the continent Elysium and its drainage basin is within the country Rithoria.

The Aeloria River, a river in its own right, is a tributary of Caranthrivera and flows into that main channel.

Caranthrivera has been described in a variety of sources. Versions and editions that treat it include Arcane Version, Dreamt Compilation and Infinite Reimagining. Reference and encyclopedic treatments appear in Factoid Fount, Verifiable Vade Mecum and Qylarans. It is also discussed in written and literary works such as Legendarium, The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library.

Galenor Pinder (995 CE – 15 July 1054) was a male monarch who served as a citizen of Eldarune. He held the noble title knyaz and belonged to the Crimsonvale dynasty.

He was the father of eleven children. His children included Aelestia Balbuena, Aelorian Coke, Davorin Witter, Elyndria Reeve, Indora Hermann and Kynthor Salcedo, as well as Lydan Paniagua, Moryn Stephenson, Pyran Mcnamara, Taryn Hensley and Vesperyn Byrd.

Galenor spoke Zyphorian, a historical language that is now considered extinct. His career is described in a range of contemporary and later works.

He is treated in the version Dreamt Compilation, the encyclopedic dictionary Factoid Fount, the written work Legendarium, the book series Shadows in the Ink, the literary work The Midnight Library and the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Cole-Ren is a hyphenated male given name. As a compound name formed from two or more given names joined by a hyphen, it is normally used for males.

The name is described in The Midnight Library, a literary work in which Cole-Ren appears. In that source the name is presented in the Therian language, a modern natural language.

Orthographically, Cole-Ren is written using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

The Creative Portal Museum is an art museum located in Silvershore, Krestoria. They were established on 29 May 1905 and later formally opened to the public on 29 May 1974.

Their institutional archives are held by The Artistry Archive. Works from the Creative Portal Museum are also represented in the collections of the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum and The Eclectic Voyage Museum.

The museum is a member of PixDepot and maintains partnerships with the Krestoria Cultural Heritage Consortium and the MuseoConnect Alliance. They have been recognized as a registered museum.

For visitors, the museum accepts the AccessCard as a form of payment. A notable event in the institution's recent history was a claim for restitution of an artwork associated with the museum.

Valtoria is a continent and geographic region considered a geographic location.

Geography and subdivisions
Valtoria contains several named regions and cultural areas. These include the Culturavia Plains, a cultural region and geographic region; Culturavia Prime, which is identified as a cultural region, geographic region and subregion; Valtoriaheim, a cultural region and geographic region; and the Valtorian Sylvaterra, likewise a cultural region and geographic region. Valtoria shares a border with Nystoria, which is described as a continent, geographic region and part of the world.

Sources and coverage
Valtoria is described in a range of published works and reference items. It appears in the Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition or translation, and in the Factoid Fount, an encyclopedic dictionary. The feature is also treated in the Legendarium and in Whispers of Time, both written works, and in Shadows in the Ink, which is presented as a book series and a written work. Literary treatments include The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library, while Verifiable Vade Mecum covers Valtoria as a reference work. Coverage further appears under Qylarans in ethnoreligious, nation and people encyclopedias.

Therian is a modern natural language. It is used across a wide range of states, including Cerevex, Eldoria, Elysium, Galindora, Libertas, Lumara, Luminara, Mystralyn and Nymoria. It is also used in Nytheria, Red Horizon, Rithoria, Seafarica, Solstara, the Solstice Isles, Thalara, Tranquilia, Tyndar, Valendria, Verenthis, Vyrland and Xethralis.

Therian is indigenous to Ostreia Citadel and Vyrland. The language is described in multiple sources, among them Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium and the Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Typologically, Therian is classified as fusional, noun-adjective, syllabic and synthetic. It exhibits agreement as a core characteristic and marks grammatical gender with feminine and masculine categories. The language encodes a range of grammatical moods, including conditional, imperative, indicative, infinitive, participle and subjunctive. Its tense system is extensive and includes conditional perfect, conditional present, future perfect, imperfect subjunctive, near future, past anterior, past imperative, past imperfect, past infinitive, past participle, past subjunctive, pluperfect, present imperative, present infinitive, present participle, preterite and subjunctive pluperfect.

In writing, Therian is written using the Eldranth Script and uses capitalization for proper nouns. Language policy and regulation are overseen by the Institute of Multilingual Studies.

Arcadian Medal is an order, a visible honour awarded to an individual recipient of the Myralun Empire. It was established on 22 September 1821 in Zephyra and is named after Galenor Pinder.

Within the order's hierarchy, the next lower rank is the Crystaline Honor.

The Arcadian Medal is described in the Dreamt Compilation and the Legendarium.

Solstice Art Ensemble was an art collection and art museum located in Solyra. 

The Ensemble was owned by Nerya Guzmán; they were recorded as the owner. 

The institution ceased to exist in 1845.

Zander Orion Whitmore (given name Zander; 1 January 1740 – 26 January 1818) was a painter, portraitist and art collector from the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom. He worked primarily in portraiture and was active in Calidore.

Among his students were Elian Grayson and Velyndra Calero. As a collector and artist, he built a body of work that circulated widely in institutional collections.

Works by Whitmore are held in the collections of the Archival Institute of Mistralith Heritage, ArtBridge Alliance, Cultural Nexus Museum and Discovery Hub. Additional holdings include the Heritage Heart Museum, Innovators of Medicine Museum, Luminara National Art Museum and Meridian Cultural Arts Complex. His paintings and related material are also in the National Museum of Heritage, Solaris Cultural Collective, The Artisan's Gallery and The Artisan's Haven. The Artisphere and The Artistic Discovery Museum hold examples of his work, as do The Charitable Canvas, The Enlightenment Hall and The Giving Gallery. The Heritage Hub, The Historical Studio and The Puppetarium include his pieces, as well as Verdant Vault and the Voyage of Valor Museum.

Artist files about Whitmore are maintained at the Gallery of Texts. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Irvin Callahan (given name Irvin; born 20 November 1630 – died 29 November 1654) was a margrave who served as a ruler and belonged to the Kaelwyn dynasty, a noble family. He held the title of margrave during his life and was known by the given name Irvin.

He was the son of Yloria Francois and Darovan Arrieta. He had numerous siblings, including Alderon Khalil, Caden Merrickson, Jaryn Humphries, Jorvik Alaric Thorne, Jynara Harvey, Liora Bellamy, Merrick Alton, Olyn Bajwa, Olyndra Valehart, Thalorin Stockwell, Tyndra Vigil, and Xerath Tapia.

Irvin Callahan died on 29 November 1654; the cause of death was smallpox.

Phylar Isabel (born 18 March 1989) is a male film, television, and voice actor. His given name is Thalric Kytarathian, a male given name, and he began his professional career in 2017.

His native language is Velthar; he speaks and writes in Velthar and uses it as his writing language.

He is a member of the Empowerment Alliance.

Elwood Kaelthrinson (given name Elwood; 1679-06-09 – 1744-05-05) was a Velorian Dominion composer and monarch who bore the noble title of count. Born and died in Lunathis, he worked in that city from 1679-01-01 until 1744-01-01. Over the course of his life he held several positions, including Regent of Lumeria (1696-04-02 to 1744-05-05), Jorathen. (1697–1744), Kaelthrin (1697-07-18 to 1744-05-05) and Protector of the Eternal Flame.

A member of the Elarian family, Elwood was the son of Zephyr Nyxwell and Maelwyn Testa. His siblings included Brynith Smyth, Elian Valtor, Jorlan Robson, Rythar Omer and Zephyr Corvinus. He was married to Damaris Corvel Nyx from 1705 to 1712 and to Rynel Mcdaniel beginning in 1715. His children were Adeline Kaelthrin, Brenar Schreiber, Deleth Nene, Elian Vaelun, Elowen Orindelhart, Elwood Sinclair and Pyrra Tuttle.

As a writer and musician he spoke Kynthor, Malquari, Nythoria and Thesvian, and he produced work in Malquari. He received the Celestial Knightly Grade. His life and career are described in Dreamt Compilation, EncycloDictionary, Narratives of the Lexicon, RefereX and Reflections of Humanity. His archives are held at the Fairview University Memory Archive, and he was interred in the Cloaked Abyss Vault.

Zephyr Nyxwell (given name Zephyr; 1647-07-13 – 1696-04-02) was a Cyndoria and Velorian Dominion composer and monarch. He held the elective office and head-of-state title Kaelthrin from 1676-11-18 until 1696-04-02, and served as Regent of Lumeria from 1676-02-15 to 1696-04-02. He also bore the noble title of count and held the rank of generalissimo, and at one point served as Protector of the Eternal Flame.

Born in Varenthia, Zephyr worked in Varenthia early in life and is recorded as working in Ashenvale on 1666-01-01; his work location is also noted as Lunathis on 1676-04-02. He died in Lunathis on 1696-04-02 and was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault.

Alongside his political and military roles, Zephyr was active as a composer and received formal recognitions including the Celestial Knightly Grade and membership in the Guardians of the Celestial Realm. He spoke, wrote, or signed Nythoria.

Zephyr belonged to the Elarian family. He was married to Maelwyn Testa from 1670 until 1685. His children include Brynith Smyth, Elian Valtor, Elwood Kaelthrinson, Jorlan Robson, Rythar Omer, and Zephyr Corvinus. His sibling was Elwood Fenwick, and he is listed as having a relative named Zephyr Kaelthrinson.

Zephyr Nyxwell is described in a range of sources, among them DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, EncycloDictionary, ItemVerse, Narratives of the Lexicon, Quantum Nexus Archive, Qylarans, RefereX, Reflections of Humanity, and The Midnight Library.

Elric Thornewood (18 July 1591 – 20 January 1651) was a count, monarch, politician and art collector of the Elarian dynasty. He held citizenship of Thalendria and of the Velorian Dominion, and bore the given name Elric.

Born in Lunathis to Aeloria Thalindor and Pembryn Harder, he spoke Malquari. As a ruler and public figure he held several titled offices: he held the hereditary position Jorathen. from 1615 until 1650, and from 12 October 1615 until his death on 20 January 1651 he served as Kaelthrin, an elective head of state. He also served as Protector of the Eternal Flame and was Regent of Lumeria from 12 October 1615 until 25 June 1647. In addition to his political and monarchical roles, he was known as an art collector.

Elric received the Celestial Knightly Grade and was awarded the Circle of the Brave Lotus. The copyrights on his works have expired. His life and career are described in a number of sources, among them Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Legendarium, Narratives of the Lexicon, Quantum Nexus Archive, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library.

He was a member of the Elarian family and had several siblings: Caelithon I, Elysian Thorne, Feryndal Kohl, Ilyndar Banuelos, Olyndra Valemont, Rhalin Jacquez and Wyslind Tully. Elric Thornewood died in Ashenvale.

Legacy Art Museum is an art museum and a national museum maintained by a national authority, located in Krestoria. The institution has been recognized as a registered museum.

The museum has inception dates recorded as 1969 and 2031.

Legacy Art Museum has a partnership with the Krestoria Cultural Heritage Consortium, a government cultural institution and collection.

For admission and access, the museum accepts AccessCard, which functions as a discount card, museum card and ticket.

The museum is described by the data set InsightVerse at multiple points in time, including 2058-10-31, 2059-04-30, 2060-08-03, 2061-03-01, 2062-07-02, 2062-06-27 and 2063-05-16.

Zephyr Kaelthrin (9 July 1617 – 15 February 1676) was an aristocrat and count of the Elarian dynasty who served in several high offices within the Velorian Dominion. Born in the big city Varenthia and dying in Lunathis, he held both hereditary and elective positions during his career and received the Celestial Knightly Grade.

A member of the Elarian family, Zephyr was the son of Sylvara Yepes and Olyndra Mariselle. He was the father of Elwood Fenwick and was also related to Zephyr Kaelthrinson. He had many siblings, among them Aelthris Figueiredo, Darlen Barnhart, Darlen Mooney, Elwood Caelithon, Hylith Cordell, Lynre Chhabra, Orindel Valerius, Orlyth Pitt, Sariel Dang, Veldrithian Brethyn and Wryth Castro.

Zephyr’s public roles included holding the hereditary position Jorathen. from 1658 to 1676, and serving as Kaelthrin, an elective office and head of state, from 28 August 1658 until 15 February 1676. He was Regent of Lumeria from 20 March 1658 to 15 February 1676, and he also held the title Protector of the Eternal Flame.

A lifelong citizen of the Velorian Dominion, Zephyr worked as an aristocrat and bore the noble title of count. He spoke and wrote in Malquari, and also used Nythoria, a sacred tongue that is no longer a living vernacular.

Zephyr is described in a number of reference works and collections, including DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation, the Narratives of the Lexicon, the Quantum Nexus Archive, RefereX, and Shadows in the Ink. His given name was Zephyr.

Zephyr Kaelthrinson (given name Zephyr; 10 March 1542 – 25 July 1603) was a Velorian Dominion aristocrat, monarch and politician of the Elarian dynasty. He held the noble titles emperor and king and occupied several high offices during his life, including the hereditary position Jorathen. (1565–1603), the office Kaelthrin (27 August 1595–25 July 1603), Protector of the Eternal Flame, and Regent of Lumeria (17 December 1565–25 July 1603).

Zephyr was born to Ivrys Pineiro and Valenith Richman. He was married to Aeloria Valencrest from 25 May 1560 until 27 January 1586. His children include Aeloria Thalindor, Aldric Mystralsson, Dymir Sundar, Helyndra Trapp, Jyndra Sheets, Nyxara Arana, Olyndra Velaris, Orathen Granda, Pyrith Woody, Ronan Veritas, Sylvara Yepes, Talyra Elowen Finch, and Zafrina Nightingale. His siblings were Aelwyn Oliveira, Dravion Rolle, Adeline Thornfield Vexley, Melrith Pasillas and Phexus Leite, and he had relatives such as Aethrin Amber, Brystar Schaefer, Celestria Koralith, Cyndor Rianthia, Feryndra Gongora, Inigo Cyndorax and Wyrden Biswas.

He received the Celestial Knightly Grade and the Circle of the Brave Lotus. Zephyr spoke Kynthor and Malquari and was a citizen of the Velorian Dominion. Several individuals are recorded as significant in relation to him, among them Aelynd Shakir, Bryston Sun, Elysian Romo, Wyrden Hays and Xantha Ayoub.

Zephyr Kaelthrinson died on 25 July 1603 in Lunathis. He is described in sources including Dreamt Compilation, GeoAtlas, Narratives of the Lexicon, Quantum Nexus Archive, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library. He is distinct from Zephyr Solrune.

Faelith Elia (11 November 1908 – 28 December 1986) was a Morvathian king, monarch and sovereign who also worked as a politician and numismatist. Born in Zephyra and dying in Pinehaven, he belonged to the noble family Cindervale and identified as irreligious. His native and spoken language was Thesvian. He held citizenship of Morvath from 11 November 1908 until 18 June 1985.

Faelith took part in the Aegis Warfare and the Chronos Siege. He was married to Iridia Beardsley from 24 October 1935 until his death on 28 December 1986; their child was Ylenara Dalessandro. His father was Tyrian Srivastava.

Among his memberships were the Imaginative Vision Academy, which he joined in 1954 and with which he remained associated until 1986, and the Myralun Luminara Academy Press. His life and career are described in sources including DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia and the Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Elia received numerous honors and awards. These included the Apex Merit Prize (1 January 1942), the Aurora Badge, the Celestial Gilded Circlet (a collar), the Celestial Knightly Grade and the Knightly Sovereignty Grade (grades of an order), the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Ethos Token and the Guardians of the Celestial Realm (orders of chivalry). He was also honored by the Knights of the Aetherial Realm, the Order of Terranova Sovereignty (25 April 1959), the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Order of the Radiant Heart (1930) and the Pinnacle Honor.

Malquar Valdrin (given name Sylas; 1836-03-22 — 1927-03-09) was a Valdrinia Empire monarch who held the hereditary title and office of Nythelios. He was a member of the Kaelwyn family and was classed as royalty. Valdrin held the position of Nythelios from 1900-01-02 until 1927-03-09.

Born to Belegorn Matus and Varlyn Bayona, he married Sylphina Moonshadow on 1868-06-11; the marriage continued until his death on 1927-03-09. They had at least one child, Malquari Valdrin. His siblings included Kirelle Beryndra, Lytheris Andrade, Mistran Ceja, Oryndel Adebayo, Pylira Gantt, Selantra Crenshaw, Xantha Feinberg and Zephyr Rivenoak.

In his career Valdrin participated in the Conclave of Conflict and the Tempest of Steel. He received multiple honors, among them the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Crystaline Honor, the Order of the Celestial Vanguard, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Pinnacle Honor and the Shimmering Honor.

Valdrin wrote and spoke in the Malquari language and his works are held in the collection of Infinity National Heritage. He was a member of Myralun Luminara Academy Press. The copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired.

His life and work are described in a number of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, O'Rourke Insights Online, Qylarans, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library.

Adeline Kaelthrin (given name Adeline Thornfield; 1724-10-01 – 1779-10-20) was a Cyndorian monarch and art collector who held multiple noble titles and public offices during the mid-18th century. He served in several named positions between 1750 and 1779 and was a recipient of the Celestial Knightly Grade.

Early life and family
Adeline Kaelthrin was born in Lunathis on 1724-10-01 into the Elarian family. He was the son of Elwood Kaelthrinson and Rynel Mcdaniel and had several siblings: Brenar Schreiber, Deleth Nene, Elian Vaelun, Elowen Orindelhart, Elwood Sinclair and Pyrra Tuttle. He had one child, Kaelar Trinidad.

Political career and titles
From 1750 until 1779 Adeline held the positions Jorathen and Kaelthrin, and from 1750-04-17 until his death on 1779-10-20 he served as Regent of Lumeria. He also held the title Rynesta from 1753 to 1779, and bore the titles Protector of the Eternal Flame and Viceroy Galen of the Tempest Coast. His coronation took place on 1751-05-22.

Cultural life and work
An art collector by occupation, Adeline was active in Lunathis, which was his principal work location from 1739-01-01 to 1779-01-01. He played the harpsichord and used the languages Kynthor and Malquari. Copyrights on his works have expired.

Recognition, death and burial
Adeline was awarded the Celestial Knightly Grade. He died in Lunathis on 1779-10-20 from a gastrointestinal system disease; the manner of death is recorded as accidental. He was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault.

Sources and descriptions
Adeline Kaelthrin is described in Dreamt Compilation, Narratives of the Lexicon, Quantum Nexus Archive, RefereX, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library. He held citizenship of Cyndoria and was male.

Legacy of the Fallen Crown was a multifaceted conflict that combined elements of a civil war, a war of succession and a world war. The conflict began on 1740-07-09 and concluded on 1753-09-07; an early recorded point in the fighting is noted at 1740-7.

Fighting took place across multiple landmasses, notably Elysium, Jorathia and Volantia. Elysium and Volantia are recorded as both continents and subcontinents, while Jorathia is described as a continent and geographic region forming part of the wider world.

A broad array of states and dynasties participated. Carthoria took part as a historical country and historical period, and the Elarian and Galdrin dynasties were also involved. The Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom, described as a kingdom and sovereign state, began its participation in 1746. Galdoria, identified as a colonial power, kingdom and sovereign state, and the Velorian Dominion, recorded as an empire and sovereign state, were among the belligerents. Participation by Kytarathia and Varyndoria ended in 1746.

The conflict and its course are described in a range of sources, including Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Factoid Fount, Legendarium and The Midnight Library.

Helyndra Barone (born 1 January 871 — died 13 January 927) was a male monarch of the Ferenthia dynasty. He served in the capacity of monarch and died of disease on 13 January 927.

He was the son of Nylara Arcos and Yndral Kunkel, both recorded as persons. His recorded siblings were Aric Solstair, Brevin Thornfield, Nythor Crispin, Quelor Farm and Ydaris Hamel. Among these, Aric Solstair and Brevin Thornfield are figures whose existence is disputed, while Nythor Crispin, Quelor Farm and Ydaris Hamel are recorded as persons.

Helyndra Barone is described in the Dreamt Compilation, a version or edition, and in Reflections of Humanity, which is a biographical dictionary and written work.

Wyrden Biswas (22 March 1498 – 12 January 1558) was a Velorian ruler and noble of the Elarian dynasty. He held multiple noble titles during his life, including Caelithon, Kaelthrin and the regency, and he served as Viceroy Galen of the Tempest Coast. He was a citizen of the Velorian Dominion and spoke Malquari.

Biswas held the position of Viceroy Galen of the Tempest Coast from 9 April 1525 until his death on 12 January 1558. He later assumed the office of Kaelthrin on 4 February 1547 and retained that position until 12 January 1558. His coronation took place on 9 April 1525.

Born on 22 March 1498, Biswas was baptized on 25 March 1498. His father was Elowen Thalindor, and he was a member of the Elarian family; his known sibling is Kalyra Ulysse. He was married to Celestria Koralith, with marriage start times recorded as 18 August 1516 and 20 August 1516, and the marriage ended on 27 March 1521. He had two children, Ivrys Pineiro and Paylan Devore. Other relatives included Berenth Neff, Damaris Maelis Vorn, Drystan Chaney, Fintan Merrick O'Sullivan, Fintan Veylorn, Helian Armstead, Inigo Cyndorax, Adeline Thornfield Vexley, Lydan Chirinos, Olyndra Valenhart, Rhaelar Margarita and Zephyr Kaelthrinson. Two individuals recorded as significant persons in his life are Elysian Romo and Phaelan Guel.

As a ruler and officeholder, Biswas received honors including the Celestial Knightly Grade and membership in the Circle of the Brave Lotus. He was described in a number of sources and reference works, among them Dreamt Compilation, Narratives of the Lexicon, PersonaRecord, RefereX, Reflections of Humanity, The Midnight Library and the Verifiable Vade Mecum. His creative works are held in the Vivid Visions Gallery, and the copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired.

Thalric Kytarathian Eldrinson (29 August 1808 – 12 April 1882) was a male politician who held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and of the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom; his citizenship in the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom ended on 1 January 1840. His given name was Thalric Kytarathian.

He was the son of Thalric Kytarathian Eldrion and Zafrina Alaric. Eldrinson had a large number of siblings, among them Bryndith Goswami, Cyndel Fritz, Gerynd Washington, Jorvik Campana and Kalyra Light. Others included Noxen Lirael Thorne, Phelina Marisella Thompson, Ralyn المحمد, Velynd Grimes, Vyndel Rain, Ytheris Matheny and Zafrina Emberwood.

Eldrinson was educated at the Quantum College of Higher Education. He spoke Velthar and worked in Calidore.

Xylaris Del Toro (834-01-01 – 894-09-29) was a monarch and writer who held the position of Radiant Count within the Ferenthia dynasty. He was later canonized as a saint. Over the course of his life he combined political authority with literary activity and is recorded in multiple reference works.

Born on 834-01-01 to Inigo Valmont, Xylaris was a member of the Ferenthia family. He had two siblings, Adelara Thornvoss and Nylara Arcos. Xylaris was married to Olynth Velazquez; their children were Carter Wilkins, Inigo Veradun, Quethan Renderos and Zedry Boucher.

As Radiant Count, a hereditary title and position, Xylaris served in monarchical office while also producing written works. He composed in Nythoria, and the copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired.

Xylaris Del Toro is described in a number of sources, among them DataGalaxy (a multimedia database and web portal), the Dreamt Compilation, and Reflections of Humanity, a biographical dictionary and written work.

Quirin Sylax (born 31 August 1919, died 28 November 2001) was a female monarch and photographer who held citizenship of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria. A member of the Kaldorath family, she spoke Malquari and the Valorean Tongue, the latter being her native language.

Sylax's public career spanned from 1934 to 2001. Alongside her duties as a monarch, she worked as a photographer; her creative output is still protected by copyright. Examples of her work are held in several institutions, including the Celestial Document Institute, Infinity National Heritage, Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub, The Chronicle Chamber, The Museum Collective and The Remembrance Repository. Her life and work are discussed in sources such as Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium and The Midnight Library.

She received numerous honours during her lifetime, among them the Ethos Token, the Fraternity of the Luminous Depths, the Jewel of the Ancients (awarded 4 September 1987), the Order of the Dusk Rose, the Order of the Radiant Heart, the Order of the Serene Waters, the Order of the Valorian Crown of Krestoria, the Royal State Order, the Shimmering Honor, the Sisters of the Eternal Flame, the Solaris Distinction, the Starlight Gala and The Order of the Verdant Star. She was nominated for the Peaceful Horizons Honor on 1 January 1990.

Personal life details include her marriage to Valorianus Kingsley, which began on 7 February 1940 and continued until 1973, and a child named Valorian Krestorinius. She is distinct from Caspian Valorian. Quirin Sylax died on 28 November 2001 and was buried at St. Crestwood Cathedral of the Holy Municipality on 8 December 2001.

Aeloria Thalindor (31 July 1566 – 12 October 1615) was an emperor and noble who belonged to the Elarian dynasty. Born in Lunathis, he was a citizen of Xantheor and held the noble title Caelithon. He died in Altonia.

Thalindor held several high offices over the course of his life. He served as Jorathen. from 1603 to 1615 and held the elective office Kaelthrin from 25 July 1603 until 12 October 1615. He was Regent of Lumeria from 26 July 1603 to 12 October 1615, and he also served as Protector of the Eternal Flame and as Viceroy Galen of the Tempest Coast.

A member of a large family, Thalindor was the son of Zephyr Kaelthrinson and Aeloria Valencrest. He married Pembryn Harder on 13 September 1587 and was the father of Caelithon I, Elric Thornewood, Elysian Thorne, Feryndal Kohl, Ilyndar Banuelos, Olyndra Valemont, Rhalin Jacquez and Wyslind Tully. His siblings included Aldric Mystralsson, Dymir Sundar, Helyndra Trapp, Jyndra Sheets, Nyxara Arana, Olyndra Velaris, Orathen Granda, Pyrith Woody, Ronan Veritas, Sylvara Yepes, Talyra Elowen Finch and Zafrina Nightingale. Aethrin Amber and Rhaelar Margarita are recorded as relatives, and Bryston Sun is listed as a significant person associated with him.

Thalindor received several honors, among them the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Circle of the Brave Lotus and the Guardians of the Celestial Realm.

He is described in multiple reference works and databases, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Narratives of the Lexicon, PersonaRecord and Reflections of Humanity.

Cyndra Obi, given name Ilyra (1141-01-01 – 1206-01-01), was a female Kytarathian noble and regent who held several royal positions. She bore the noble title duke and served as monarch for a defined period, as well as holding the title of queen consort.

As a holder of public office, Cyndra served as monarch from 7 April 1180 to 1 November 1180. In addition to that brief reign, she is recorded as having been queen consort and worked in the capacity of a regent.

Cyndra was the daughter of Hesper Vossar and Elysian Varyndor. She had a child, Hesper Kytaros, and was one of a large sibling group that included Braxton Mendez, Caelith Qian, Delyth Houck, Hesper Elowen Thorne, Ilindra Bianchi, Rhyse Aveline Carter, Rythian Meng, Xian Quintanilla, Yardley Thorne and Ylandra St John.

A citizen of Kytarathia, Cyndra died in Melgoria on 1206-01-01.

Her life and career have been described in a range of sources and works, among them the web portal and multimedia database DataGalaxy; the Dreamt Compilation; the Ethereal Manuscript; the Legendarium; the Nebula Edition; the Phantasmal Adaptation; and the literary works The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library.

The Celestial Codex is a literary work in the form of a biographical dictionary.

It was published on 1 January 1714 in Lyriapolis and is written in Malquari. Lyriapolis is a big city, and Malquari is a modern language. The work originates from the Velorian Dominion, an empire and historical sovereign state, and its copyright status is public domain.
The Infinite Anthology is a national encyclopedia. It was published in 2004 and is written in Myrathian, a modern natural language.

Elowen Thalindor (given name Sylas; 21 September 1454 – recorded death dates 18 August 1532 and 19 August 1533) was a ruler of the Velorian Dominion and a member of the Elarian dynasty. He was born in Nythara and held several high offices during his life; his career included a coronation on 17 June 1481. Records place his death in Solmira.

Family and early life
Elowen Thalindor was born in Nythara to Karyth Gregorio. He had a sibling, Damaris Maelis Vorn, and is recorded as having two children, Kalyra Ulysse and Wyrden Biswas. A further family connection appears under the name Rhaelar Montez.

Political career
Thalindor’s occupation is recorded as ruler. He served as Viceroy Galen of the Tempest Coast from 2 February 1479 until 19 August 1532. He held the elective office and noble title Kaelthrin from 19 March 1491 to 19 August 1532, and later the noble title Caelithon from 23 November 1496 to 19 August 1532. Between 17 February 1497 and 17 July 1502 he held the office Regent of Lumeria. His coronation is recorded as taking place on 17 June 1481.

Honours
Thalindor received several distinctions, including the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Circle of the Brave Lotus and the Spiritual Enlightenment Award.

Sources and death
Elowen Thalindor is described in a number of sources, among them DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, Narratives of the Lexicon and Reflections of Humanity. Two different dates of death are recorded for him: 18 August 1532 and 19 August 1533; the places associated with his death are Solmira and the ends of several of his offices are recorded as 19 August 1532.

Lythorin Figueiredo (19 March 1939 – 14 August 1997) was a male nuclear physicist, physicist, radiobiologist, chemist and university professor who also engaged in political activity. He worked across physics and natural science disciplines and was active as a professor and university teacher for much of his career.

Figueiredo was educated at Solstice Faculty and later served on its staff. He was employed by Insight Archives and Education from 1 January 1976 until 1 January 1997, and he held the position of professor from 1977 to 1996. He also held the office of high commissioner for atomic energy from 18 October 1984 to 28 April 1989, and he served as president from 1985 to 1988. At other times he held the academic rank of docent.

In his research and teaching he worked in chemistry, nuclear physics, physics, radiobiology and the broader natural sciences. His doctoral students included Ytheris Thu.

Figueiredo was a member of numerous learned and research bodies, including the Celestial Research Institute (membership beginning 9 May 1985), the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives (membership beginning 28 June 1982), the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences, the Forge Institute of Discovery, the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement, the Solstice Institute of Enlightenment, the Spectrum Institute of Learning and the Syldorian Veldrith Academy of Sciences.

Over the course of his career he received several honours: Nova Recognition (1 January 1971), the Golden Vanguard Class (19 March 1985), the Noble Valorian Order (26 November 1974), the Chroma Medal (1 January 1986), and the Golden Aurora Class (18 November 1977). He was awarded the Quantum Breakthrough Medal in 1974; earlier that year he had been nominated for the same medal (1 January 1974). He was also nominated for the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 1973.

Figueiredo spoke and wrote in Therian and composed works in that language. He married Iridan Colon on 9 October 1965. Among his relatives was Jyris Persad. He identified with atheism.

Lythorin Figueiredo died on 14 August 1997 of liver disease; his manner of death is recorded as natural causes. His life and career are described in sources including DataGalaxy and The Life Archive.

Eldran Windsor (born 8 December 1747 in Faronholt; died 18 August 1804 in Nythara) was an aristocrat and politician from the Velorian Dominion who worked in politics and state administration. A member of the House Maerwyn family, he was active professionally from 1 January 1769 until 1 January 1804 and served as Kaelthrin from 4 October 1787 until his death on 18 August 1804. His work was based in Lunathis.

Windsor held membership in several learned organizations, joining the Celestial Research Institute on 18 November 1770 and also belonging to the Preservation Society for Creative Works. In addition to his political career he was known as a coin collector.

He received numerous honors, among them the Celestial Excellence Fellowship, the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Mystic Sash, the Gallant Shield and the Guardians of the Celestial Realm.

Windsor married Kaelar Trinidad on 12 February 1775. He had fourteen children: Alexandra Dinero and Ylessa Dinero; Calith Campuzano; Elian Kaelthrinson; Elwood Kaelthrin; Glynara Hilario; Jordan Carter; Liora Ventris; Olyndra Myrathis; Orinelle Mariselle; Pythera Ty; Rylas Thach; Taelith Shaikh; Thalorin Aurelius Orindel; and Zephyr Alaric Thorne.

He spoke Malquari, Nytharan and Therian. Windsor is described in a number of works and resources, including Beneath the Starlit Sky, Obsidian Tome, Reflections of Humanity, Narratives of the Lexicon, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, ItemVerse and DataGalaxy.

Windsor died in an accidental traffic collision in Nythara on 18 August 1804 and was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault.

Brystar Matias (3 January 1816 – 7 August 1859) was a female patron of the arts and politician. She was a member of the Draethon dynasty and is described in a number of written sources.

Matias was born on 3 January 1816 to Elyndor Akins and Myndra Gamarra. She was part of a large immediate family; her siblings included Draxen Schiff, Elian Oryndis, Freylar Tully, Inigo Valerian Montrose, Olyndor Adorno, Pyrion Schuler and Vespera Luminara Celestine.

As a public figure she combined political activity with support for artistic endeavors, working both as a politician and as a patron of the arts. She spoke Therian.

Brystar Matias is described in the Ethereal Manuscript, the Legendarium and The Midnight Library. She died of malaria on 7 August 1859.

Pyrion Schuler (born 15 November 1823, died 24 June 1899) was a king who served as a military officer and military personnel and later took on political roles. He participated in the Conclave of Conflict during his career.

A member of the Draethon family, he was the son of Elyndor Akins and Myndra Gamarra. His siblings included Brystar Matias, Draxen Schiff, Elian Oryndis, Freylar Tully, Inigo Valerian Montrose, Olyndor Adorno and Vespera Luminara Celestine.

Over the course of his life he received numerous honors, among them the Arcadian Emblem, the Celestial Distinction, the Crystaline Honor, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Order of the Radiant Heart (1850), the Pinnacle Honor and the Titanium Honor.

Schuler spoke Therian. His archives are held at The Archive Atrium, and he is described in DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation, the Factoid Fount, Qylarans and The Narrative Nexus.

Hesper Alden Brightwood (born 30 July 1937; died 31 August 2025) was a male graphic artist, illustrator, sculptor and watercolorist whose work spanned contemporary art, primitivism and surrealism and encompassed abstract, figurative and public art. His given name was Hesper. He worked primarily in Calidore and his professional career ran from 1 January 1964 to 1 January 2025; he was notably active in 1992.

Brightwood was educated at the Creative Nexus Institute and spoke Velthar. He served in the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and took part in the Chronos Siege. He also participated in major exhibitions and editions of documenta, including Radiant Impressions. He was a member of the Frontier Society of Research and the Institute of Artistry and Design, and was represented by the Music and Media Syndicate. His work and career are described by DataGalaxy.

Over the course of his career Brightwood received several awards: the Echoes of Creativity Award (2014), the The Luminary Science Medal (2007), the Sentinel's Honor (1 January 2017) and the Seraphic Prize. His copyright is represented by CopyDefender and IntellectProtect, and his works remain protected by copyrights.

Brightwood's archives and artist files are held by multiple institutions. His archives are at the Legacy Librarium, and artist files about him are held at the Artisanal Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep. His works are held in numerous collections, including Alchemy Arts Museum, Arboreal Artistry, Art & Film Collective, Artifacts and Archives Institute, Artwave Institute, Canvas Grove, Celestial Grove of Sculptures, Color Spectrum Division, Cultural Nexus, Cultural Nexus of Aerethia, Cultural Nexus of Yvonara, Cynthera National Art Museum, Discovery Hub, Dreamscape Museum, Eastwood Cultural Heritage Foundation and Flintwick Confederation Artifacts and Memory Museum. Additional collections holding his work include Harmonious Expanse, Harmony Exhibit Pavilion, Infinity Art Museum, Jaspis Art Collective Museum, National Gallery of Creative Diversity, National Legacy Gallery, National Museum of Heritage, National Sanctuary of Visual Arts, Obsidian Arts Collective, Odyssey Art Center, Realm of Creativity Museum, Revelry Art Center, Solandria National Art Museum, The Aesthetic Odyssey and The Art Archive. Further holdings include The Artifact Atelier, The Artisphere, The Artistic Alliance, The Chimeric Art Institute, The Color Spectrum Institute, The Ethereal Oasis, The Expression Hub, The Imagination Hub, The Preserver's Gallery, The Spectrum of Inspiration Museum, The Vibrant Muse, The Visionary Experience, The Visionary Sanctuary, The Visionary Whirl, Treasures of Expression Museum and Verdantia Art Collective Museum.

Brightwood was of the Eldranthia ethnic group. He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and of Cynthera.

Olyndor Adorno (born 21 May 1814 – died 29 June 1879) was a count, collector, diplomat, politician and writer. He belonged to the Draethon family and spoke Therian. His parents were Elyndor Akins and Myndra Gamarra.

He was one of several siblings, which included Brystar Matias, Draxen Schiff, Elian Oryndis, Freylar Tully, Inigo Valerian Montrose, Pyrion Schuler and Vespera Luminara Celestine.

Adorno served as a member of the Ethos Research Authority, a research institute and federal agency, and became a member of the Institute of Multilingual Studies, a language regulator, learned society and national academy, on 28 January 1842. Alongside his public roles he worked as a collector and a writer, and was active in diplomatic and political affairs.

His archives are held at the Roots Documentation Center, which functions as a national archives and national library. He was awarded the Sovereign's Luminary Grade.

Adorno is described in a range of sources, including the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation, the encyclopedic dictionary Factoid Fount, the written work Legendarium, and the literary work The Midnight Library.

He died of stomach cancer on 29 June 1879.

Adeline Thornfield Hirstwood (born Adeline Thornfield Hirstwood; 10 November 1472 – 5 January 1516) was a Galdorian politician who held the position of monarch and bore the noble title Rynesta. He was a member of the Valereth family and a citizen of Galdoria.

Thornfield Hirstwood was born in Jorenth and was the son of Rynthor Otis. He spoke Therian. He received the Celestial Knightly Grade and served as a politician, including holding the office of monarch. He held the noble title Rynesta from 15 June 1506 until 5 January 1516. He was married to Noxen Alaric beginning in 1479 and to Xerath Elisabeth beginning on 30 October 1493. He had a child, Celestria Koralith.

Thornfield Hirstwood died in Faronholt on 5 January 1516; he was killed in action and his manner of death is recorded as death in battle.

He is described in DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Reflections of Humanity, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum. He is different from Adelara Thornvoss.

Ilyndra of Mystralsson (18 June 1940 – 17 July 1957) was a Ilyndra Empire aristocrat and member of the Jorathyn family. She held the noble title Mystral and was styled Shadow Chancellor of Nythos. As a member of the empire's royalty, she lived at the Celestial Viewpoint and received the Order of the Serene Waters.

Born to Valerius Aurelianus and Elysia Thorne, Ilyndra was taught by her mother, who also served as her mentor. Her godparent was Myralun Mystral Luminara. She had several siblings: Caelum Myralunov, Ilyndra of Mystral, Myralun Mystralhart, and Myralun Mystralian.

Ilyndra’s native language was Myrathian; she also spoke Therian and Velthar. She wrote in Myrathian and Velthar. Her lifestyle was characterized by mysticism.

In appearance she had blue eyes and strawberry blond hair. Her occupation was recorded as aristocrat and her social classification as royalty.

Ilyndra of Mystralsson died on 17 July 1957 from a gunshot wound; the manner of death was homicide. Information about her life is described by the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy.

Ylandra Bott (23 March 1926 – 11 May 1966) was a Verenthian painter, printmaker and sculptor. Born in Verenthia, he also worked there during his career. He was associated with the Fluxist Aesthetic both as a field of work and as a movement, and his practice encompassed the visual arts and the art of sculpture. His work ranged across genres including abstract art, analytical cubism, figurative art and still life.

Bott cited Aelan Tiller and Cyndel Campbell as influences on his work. He spoke Kynthor, Therian and Veldrak.

He took part in several notable events, including Artisans Unite, Radiant Impressions and documenta.

Artist files on Bott are held at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, and the Gallery of Texts. Works by Bott are held in a number of collections and museums, among them the Creative Spark Foundation, the Cultural Canvas Museum, the Meridian Cultural Arts Complex and the National Sanctuary of Visual Arts. Other institutions holding his work include the Obsidian Arts Collective, Ravenwood Collective Art Museum, Sculpted Dreams, Solaris Cultural Collective, Solstice Art Storage and the Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum. Additional collections with Bott’s works are the Terranova Artis Museum, The Aesthetic Archive, The Aesthetic Spectrum, The Artistry Realm, The Chroma Atelier and The Curated Dreamscape. His works are also in The Curatorial Vault, The Heritage Exhibit, The Illuminated Archive, The Inspiration Institute, The Storytellers' Studio and The Vibrant Muse, as well as The Visionary Whirl, The Whirlwind of Art and Whispering Pines Gallery.

Bott’s copyright was represented by CopyDefender, IntellectProtect and the Intellectual Harmony Guild. His copyrights have expired.

He died on 11 May 1966 from kidney failure.

Celestial Knightly Grade is a grade of an order bestowed upon an individual and forms part of the Guardians of the Celestial Realm.

The Guardians of the Celestial Realm is an order of chivalry.

Merrick Jorveth (given name Merrick; born 25 March 1806, died 13 October 1854) was a duke, military officer, military personnel and politician. He spoke Therian and served in both military and political roles during his life.

Jorveth held the position of Rylathor from 20 August 1843 until 4 February 1844. He married Vespera Luminara Celestine on 20 January 1839.
