Over the course of his career he received several honors, including the Celestial Distinction, the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Crystaline Honor, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix and the Pinnacle Honor.

Jorveth died on 13 October 1854 of a gunshot wound; the manner of death is recorded as capital punishment. He was buried at Memory Lane.

His papers and related materials are held at The Archive Atrium. Jorveth is described in a number of sources, among them DataGalaxy, Factoid Fount, Knowlexicon, Legendarium, Reflections of Humanity, The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library.

Yardley Norik Zyl (13 November 1889 – 3 December 1933) was a Cyndorian writer who worked across multiple literary forms. He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and of Cynthera. Active from 1905 until 1933, he wrote primarily in Velthar and is best associated with adventure novels; his body of work also encompassed children’s literature, essays, novels, poetry, short stories and songwriting. His given name was Yardley, and he wrote in Velthar. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Zyl was educated at the Horizon of Knowledge Institute. His work was influenced by Adeline Thornfield Jr., Elinara Liao and Farenth Giovanni.

Several of Zyl’s works are held in institutional collections and archives. Examples include items in the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum collection, and his archives are held at Eternal Records, Legacy Librarium and Narrative Nexus. He also contributed to the creative work Stellar Reinterpretation. Zyl is described by a range of sources, among them the Cascade Collective, DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Legendarium, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, Tales from the Abyss and The Midnight Library.

Zyl’s native and primary written language was Velthar, which he also spoke. He died on 3 December 1933 from a cerebral hemorrhage; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Brethyn Okoro (born 1640-01-01 in Aquilon; died 1705-01-01) was a noble known by the title Arionth and a citizen of Eldoria-Emberland. She spoke Kynthor and is the subject of entries in several reference works and adaptations.

She was the daughter of Kalyn Ponder and Hylith Cordell. Her siblings included Draxella Wingate, Ilynth Groom, Joryn Prosser, Kynthor Dana, Maelwyn Testa, Orlyn Montanez and Peryn Inzunza. Brethyn was married to Inigo Valerian; records give the marriage start as 1654-11-24 and 1654-11-25, with an end date of 1682-05-14. She had a child, Inigo Thorne.

Brethyn Okoro died of breast cancer; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Accounts of Brethyn Okoro appear in DataGalaxy, Ethereal Manuscript, FactFolio, Legendarium, LexiRealm, Narratives of the Lexicon, Phantasmal Adaptation and The Midnight Library.

Crownthal Jorvik (given name Jorvik; 8 April 1857 – 29 January 1945) was a Crownlandian military officer and monarch who served as king and held the hereditary position of the Crownthalassian Barony. He held the military rank of general and was socially classified as royalty. He spoke Malquari and Xarnum.

Born at Maplewood Manor, Jorvik belonged to the Aelistran dynasty and the House of Eldoria-Mirathis. He was the son of Sylas Thornfield and Cerynd Ayele. He married Delphina Roselle Thorne on 26 May 1881; that union lasted until 29 September 1937. His children included Cecil Crownlandia, Crownthalasian Monarch, Cyndar Aucoin, Elysia Crownhart, Ilaris Tedesco and Sylphira Leung. His siblings were Aldenor Valerius, Alderon Alamilla, Gathorn Blanco, Halyra Chang, Helyndra Angeles, Lythorin Montano, Orylan Doyle, Sylas Everwood and Wynelle Briarwood. Other recorded relatives include Bastian Verenthia, Celestria Valtaris, Crownthalasian Sovereign and Ryniel Luz.

Jorvik’s formal styles and titles changed over his life. He bore the style Emissary of the Silver Crescent from 1857 until 1892, served as Chimeric Viceroy from 1892 until 21 December 1897, held the style and noble title Knight Aerion from 21 December 1897 until 15 November 1902, and used the honorific Chief Aeloria from 15 November 1902 until his death on 29 January 1945. He was king and held the Crownthalassian Barony from 15 November 1902 to 29 January 1945.

His public duties were centered in Cycle Ridge, where he worked from 1 January 1902 until 1 January 1945. Over the course of his life he received numerous awards and honors, among them the Order of the Radiant Heart (1882), the Ethos Token (1887), the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade (1 May 1905) and the Apex Merit Prize (1 January 1943). He was also a recipient of the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Knightly Sovereignty Grade, the Knights of the Eternal Flame, the Order of the Celestial Serpent, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Pinnacle Honor, the Starlight Gala and the Verdant Gem.

Crownthal Jorvik died of natural causes at Tranquil Keep on 29 January 1945. His life and career are described in Dreamt Compilation, O'Rourke Insights Online and The Midnight Library. He was a citizen of Crownlandia.

Crownthalas Monarch (born 11 March 1938; died 14 January 2011) was a Crownlandian monarch, conductor and musician who held the hereditary title of Crownthalassian Barony. He served as a prominent public figure in Crownlandia and held the military rank of admiral.

Early life and education
His given names were Jorvik and Xander. He was born into the House of Eldoria-Mirathis and was the son of Crownthalas Jorvikson and Alaric Crownston. He was educated at Cycle Ridge Public Research University and spoke Xarnum.

Public roles and titles
Crownthalas Monarch held the position of Crownthalassian Barony from 20 April 1986 until his death on 14 January 2011. From his birth on 11 March 1938 until 20 April 1986 he was styled Knight Aerion; from 20 April 1986 until 14 January 2011 he was styled Chief Aeloria. In addition to his monarchical duties he worked as a conductor and musician and held the rank of admiral.

Honors and awards
Over the course of his life he received numerous honors, among them the Apex Merit Prize (1 January 1996), the Ethos Token (1956), and the Order of the Radiant Heart (1951). He was also awarded the Order of Terranova Sovereignty (7 October 1965), the Celestial Sphere, the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Crystaline Honor, the Emerald Circle, the Grand Cross of the Celestial Flame, the Knightly Sovereignty Grade, the Order of the Celestial Serpent, the Order of the Stalwart Heart, the Pinnacle Honor and the Verdant Gem.

Personal life
He married Liora Zoltan on 24 May 1974. His children are Crownthalasian Sovereign, Darlen Penney and Maximilian Crownstone. His godparents included Crownthal Jorvik, the Crownthalasian Monarch, Sylphira Leung, Vail Thorne, Valentina Zolterran and Valerius Aurelianus.

Death
Crownthalas Monarch died in Cycle Ridge on 14 January 2011 of pneumonia; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Elwood Kaelthrin (given name Elwood; family name Garcia-Taylor; 5 May 1786 – 1 March 1831) was a Velorian politician and noble who served in several high offices. A citizen of the Velorian Dominion, he spoke Thesvian and held the noble title Kaelthrin as well as the titles Rynesta and king. He belonged to the House Maerwyn family and was known by the noble honorific Kaelthrin.

Kaelthrin held a number of positions of state. He served as Jorathen. from 1829 to 1831, and he held the office of Kaelthrin from 6 October 1829 until 1 March 1831. He was Regent of Lumeria from 15 November 1829 to 1 March 1831, and he also held the title Protector of the Eternal Flame. For his service he received the Celestial Knightly Grade and the Mystic Sash.

Born in Lunathis to Eldran Windsor and Kaelar Trinidad, he married Bryndra Tull on 5 August 1804. He and Bryndra had twelve children: Aldrin Valtoros, Aurelian Caelithon, Calix Menard, Elian Merrickson, Elric Caelum, Eryndra Guizar, Ilyndor Neely, Inigo Valerius, Mystran Kimbrell, Rhaelar Belmont, Wylian Sisson and Xeryth Giovanni. He was one of many siblings, including Alexandra Dinero, Calith Campuzano, Elian Kaelthrinson, Glynara Hilario, Jordan Carter, Liora Ventris, Olyndra Myrathis, Orinelle Mariselle, Pythera Ty, Rylas Thach, Taelith Shaikh, Thalorin Aurelius Orindel, Ylessa Dinero and Zephyr Alaric Thorne.

Elwood Kaelthrin died of natural causes in Lunathis on 1 March 1831. He was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault and crypt.

He is described in several works and compilations, including Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, Narratives of the Lexicon and Reflections of Humanity.

Montanez Academy of Creative Arts is an art academy headquartered in Harborview City, the national capital of Krestoria. The academy was founded in 1963 and is named after Xalyn Montanez.

The institution's archives are held at the Krestoria National Research Archive, an academic archive and online database. Works associated with the academy are included in the collection of the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum.

The academy had a partnership with ArtSphere, an organisation that functions as an art collection, art gallery, business and research center, from 2043-06-12 to 2044-07-01.

Myrren Ferrante (15 January 1916 – 9 November 1992) was a Xandorian monarch, statesperson and military figure. Born in Falmare, he was a member of the Lorianth family and held citizenship in Xandoria. His field of work was politics and his occupations included military personnel, politician, statesperson and monarch. Oranthor was his native language and he spoke Oranthor.

Ferrante served Xandoria in both political and military capacities. He held the rank of wazir from 1940 to 1960 and then served as commander-in-chief from 1960 until 1992. In recognition of his service he received the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade in 1975. Outside of his official duties he was associated with the equestrian sport.

He was married to Xyra Hallmark. They had a large family, with children including Aelan Gatlin, Alaric Thorne Xandor, Alaric Valtoria, Aythor Morataya, Brystyne Provost, Cygian Mcgregor, Cyrus Xandoriamar, Dethara Bobby, Faryn Kraft, Glinthar Loza, Gwendal Kruger, Halyra Hernan, Hesthra Estime and Hestira Avitia. Other children were Inyra Rauda, Irylin Nancy, Jalyndra Almendares, Jaxor Boykin, Jorvik Brooks, Jyleth Benitez, Jynara Callaway, Kaelthas Raines, Lorwyn Ferrel, Lythorin Toussaint, Nyxara Lv, Olvyn Mccartney and Orinthar Trotman. His remaining children included Pheris Pico, Pyran Fried, Pyras Carl, Pytheran Seymour, Quinthas Durham, Qyra Spangler, Qyrel Candia, Rythar Haque, Syldor Kerrigan, Taelith Gonsales, Verenth Tome, Xantha Holloman, Ylinda Ting, Yndira Heil, Zephyra Curbelo and Zephyra Stidham.

Ferrante died on 9 November 1992 of a myocardial infarction; his death was classed as due to natural causes.

Kaldor Byrnes (21 February 1968 – 17 November 2036) was a male television actor and voice actor. He worked in both on-screen television and voice performance during his career.

Byrnes performed as a television actor as well as a voice actor, combining those occupations in his professional life. He spoke Malquari, a modern language.

He died on 17 November 2036 of cancer, a disease; his death was recorded as due to natural causes.

Paxton Rivers (born 20 July 1843; died 18 December 1931) was a Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian scientist and writer. His given name was Paxton. His work spanned paleontology and zoology, and his occupations included anatomist, biologist, paleontologist, university teacher, writer and zoologist. He wrote in Velthar and also spoke Velthar. Rivers made his residence in Xylanthia and died in Calidore.

Rivers was educated at the Horizon of Knowledge Institute. He served as a museum director and was employed by The Heritage of Health Museum. His personal and professional papers are held at the Archival Institute of Mistralith Heritage.

He belonged to a number of learned bodies and organizations: Astral Academy of Knowledge, Aurora Academy, Cognition Coalition, CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences, Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, Therian Institute of Scientific Archives and Zephyrian Academy of Sciences. He became a member of Zephyrian Academy of Sciences in 1878, joined the Thundorian Science Archive Database on 7 December 1884, and became a member of Frontier Knowledge Productions in 1904.

Rivers received multiple awards and recognitions, among them the Celestial Excellence Fellowship, the Quantum Visionary Medal (1885), the Scientific Odyssey (1883), the Elysium Science Medal (1890) and the Honorary Intellect Award (1890). He was later awarded the Quantum Scholar Recognition in 1927 and was a recipient of the Seraphic Prize.

Paxton Rivers is described in a range of published and compiled sources, including Arcane Edition, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Labyrinthine Journal, Legendarium, ReadRealm, Tales from the Abyss and The Midnight Library.

Zephyr Thundralis (born 26 February 1900 in Lunathis; died 10 September 1987) was a Thundralian naturalist, military leader and writer. His given name was Zephyr. Over the course of his life he worked in Thaloria and held citizenship of Thundralis.

Born in Lunathis to Rhalin Mackey, he married Braxian Ordóñez on 20 April 1932 and was the parent of Caspian Thundralisian. His native language was Malquari and he also spoke Qalvish. He lived according to a lifestyle of mysticism.

Thundralis pursued a wide-ranging career in the natural sciences: he worked as a botanist, entomologist, zoologist, zoological collector and ornithologist, and he published works as a writer. Alongside his scientific activities he served as a military officer, reaching the rank of general field marshal, and he acted as a ruler.

He was a member of the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences and the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities. His awards and honours include the Arcadian Medal, the Aurora Badge, the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Gallant Shield, the Guardians of the Celestial Realm, the Knights of the Eternal Flame, the Order of the Radiant Heart, the Order of the Stalwart Heart, the Pinnacle Honor, the Sovereign Medal and the Sovereign's Luminary Grade.

Thundralis's life and work are described by DataGalaxy and in the Dreamt Compilation.

Unyra Lott (born 27 October 1962 in Pyrenthis; died 29 September 2036 in Radiant Heights) was a male artist, designer and maker whose work was associated with pop art and the still life genre. He trained at Lumina Arts Academy and was a student of Quindra Toler. He worked and lived in Obsidian City.

Lott's practice encompassed a wide range of roles: painter, printmaker, lithographer, sculptor, graphic artist, jewelry designer, scenographer and designer. He also taught at university level, serving as a university teacher from 1996 to 1999. In addition to his artistic career, he served in the Valor Brigade and participated in the Aegis Warfare.

His work was shown in and contributed to numerous exhibitions and publications, including Evocative Ephemeris, Object Odyssey., Reflections in Art, The Display Anthology and The Exhibition of Echoes. Lott was a member of the Cognition Coalition, Seraphim Art House and Summit Academy of Learning, and he received the Chroma Award of Excellence.

Works by Lott are held across many institutions: Aesthetica Museum, ArtBridge Alliance, Artistic Endeavors Institute, Artistry Alliance and the Celestial Grove of Sculptures. Further holdings include Chronicle Gallery, Creative Spark Foundation, Cultural Canvas Museum, Dreamscape Museum and Expressions of Our Community. His pieces are also in the collections of Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, National Legacy Gallery, Nexus of Literary Inquiry, Revelry Art Center and Solstice Art Sanctuary. Additional repositories with his work include The Artifact Atelier, The Color Spectrum Institute, The Curatorial Vault, The Eclectic Voyage Museum and The Ethereal Canvas. The Ethereal Oasis, The Ethereal Visions Museum, The Evolution Gallery, The Imagination Hub and The Inspiration Institute likewise hold his work, as do the Varyndor Cultural Heritage Network and Whispering Pines Gallery.

Artist files about Lott are held at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep. His work and rights are managed by IntellectProtect, and his published output is noted as works protected by copyrights. He is described by the source DataGalaxy. Lott spoke Velthar and had black eyes. He died of pneumonia in Radiant Heights.

Ryniel Luz (1 August 1932 – 25 October 1959) was a politician and a member of the Aelistran dynasty. He lived a lifestyle characterized by mysticism and was active in public life during his lifetime. Over the course of his career he received several honors, including Celestial Distinction, Celestial Knightly Order, the Order of the Celestial Vanguard, the Starlight Gala and the Verdant Gem.

Luz was the son of Jorwyn Thorpe and Rylor Koshy. His siblings included Baelith Napier, Elenara Elrod, Naryn Amini and Tamsin Graystone.

He died on 25 October 1959 of sepsis; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Fendril is a province located in the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic on the continent of Nystoria. It is a provincial-level division variously classified as a province of a sovereign state, a socialist state, a secular state, a constitutional republic, a people's republic, a communist state, a province under a dictatorship of the proletariat, and a province of a state with limited recognition.

The provincial capital is Etherealis, which serves as the seat of government. Fendril contains the administrative subdivisions Etherealis and Feralis; Etherealis is a large metropolitan center classified as a big city, megacity, metropolis and prefecture-level city, while Feralis is also a major urban center described as a big city, city specifically designated in the state plan, global city, megacity, prefecture-level city and a special economic zone.

Fendril shares borders with Mercuria, Pendoria, the Solara Archipelago and Zephyra. Mercuria and Zephyra are city-states and dependent territories noted as global cities and special administrative regions; Zephyra is additionally identified as a tourist destination. Pendoria is a province with classifications comparable to Fendril, and the Solara Archipelago is an autonomous region.

Historically, Fendril was part of the Aeloria Dynasty from 1675 until 1951-02-12. It has been part of the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic since 1985-10-01 and is located within that sovereign state, which is described as a communist state, constitutional republic, people's republic, socialist and secular state, a dictatorship of the proletariat and a state with limited recognition.

Valtarian Luntrish, Valtarian Luntru and Ytheris are languages widely used in Fendril.

Fendril maintains twinning relationships with several administrative bodies: Auronis (a province) since 2056-04-24, Novarun (a port settlement and legislature) and Aurethyn (a province) with a twinning relationship beginning in 2034.

The province is described in multiple sources, including Dreamt Compilation, Olyndra and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Solara Archipelago is an autonomous region of the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic. It was established on 5 March 1997 and is administratively located within the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic.

Geography and borders
The archipelago shares borders with the provinces of Fendril and Pendoria, as well as with Tharavon, a first-level administrative division of the same state.

Languages
Several languages are widely used across the Solara Archipelago, including Jorith, Valtarian Luntrish, Valtarian Luntru, Valtaric Standard Communication, Xyndir, and Ytheris.

Sources and description
The Solara Archipelago is described in the works Dreamt Compilation and Olyndra. Olyndra is characterized as a leishu, and Dreamt Compilation is recorded as a version, edition, or translation.

Alysor Wasson (born 2 June 1979, died 10 January 2062) was a male monarch and sailor from House Aelistranith. He held citizenship of both Caeloria and Crownlandia, and was socially classified as royalty. He served as monarch from 6 March 2003 until 1 June 2012 and thereafter used the honorific prefix Chief Aeloria from 6 March 2003 until his death; earlier in life he used the style Knight Aerion from 2 June 1979 until 6 March 2003.

Wasson received numerous honours and awards during his life, among them the Crest of the Celestial Knights (2001), the Sapphire Band (2003), the Ethos Token, the Fraternity of the Luminous Depths, the Grand Cross of the Celestial Flame, the Guardians of the Celestial Realm, the Knightly Sovereignty Grade, the Knights of the Aetherial Realm, the Starlight Gala and the Verdant Gem.

Educated at Collegiate Haven Public Research University, he was described in the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia. He represented Caeloria in sport and participated in karate and sailing; he was also interested in equestrianism, squash and swimming. He took part in the Celestria Alysor Union on 18 September 2003.

Wasson was the son of Tamsin Graystone and Myrindor Chevez. He was married to Darlen Penney from 18 September 2003 until 10 January 2062. His children were Liora Gaventh, Crownlandian Sovereign Realmington, Quinella Domínguez and Zenith Poon. His siblings included Wryndor Bassett and Zeyth Rehman, and his other relatives included Aelorin Morquecho, Alaric Valthorne, Braxian Melgoza, Braxton Goldenvale, Burand Kidwell, Grendar Poulin, Liora Solandrian and Ulthir Davison. At least in 2040 his residence was recorded as Cynthera.

Wasson spoke Pyrathen and Velthar, with Pyrathen noted as his native language. He died on 10 January 2062 of natural causes, with stroke and multiple organ dysfunction syndrome given as causes of death. He was buried or cremated on 16 January 2062.

Galyth Zor (born 1767; death recorded 6 July 1801 and 7 July 1801) was a monarch who held citizenship of the Myralun Empire and resided in Zephyra. He was known for a lifestyle oriented around mysticism and spoke Myrathian.

He belonged to the Aelorian and Jorathyn families. His mother was Olyndra Myralun. He married Noxen Myralun Luminara on 1 September 1784, and they had a child, Myralun Tamsin.

The manner of his death is recorded as homicide. Over the course of his life he received several honors, including the Crystaline Honor, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Pinnacle Honor and the Shimmering Honor.

Galyth Zor is described in a range of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, ReadRealm, Reflections of Humanity, The Life Chronicle and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Calista Roblero (given name Lyle; born 7 March 1911, died 1 February 1983) was a Valorean artist whose work was centred on the art of painting. A citizen of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria, he worked as a painter and also practiced as a drawer, etcher, illustrator and furniture designer. His active work period ran from 1 January 1932 until 1 January 1983, and he worked in Calidore as well as in Harborview City.

Roblero was associated with multiple artistic movements and groups. He was a member of Envisioned Forms and of the United Artisans Collective, and his practice is linked with Envisioned Forms, Temporal Idealism and post-impressionism. He participated in events and editions including Artisans Unite, Radiant Impressions and documenta.

His paintings and graphic work range across several genres, including abstract art, allegory, figure, landscape painting, portrait and still life. Roblero cited influences such as Cyndel Campbell and Olwen Lafleur, and drew on Fluxist Aesthetic and anthroposophy in his approach. His native language was Valorean Tongue; he also spoke Therian.

Roblero's works are held in numerous public and institutional collections. Among them are Aesthetica Museum, Art & Film Collective, ArtBridge Alliance, Artistry Nexus and Canvas of Illusions Gallery, as well as the Creative Spark Foundation and Cultural Nexus. Other holding institutions include Curiosities Art Museum, Dreamscape Museum, Ethereal Spectrum Institute and the Flintwick Confederation Artifacts and Memory Museum. His work is also in the collections of Harmony Exhibit Pavilion, Legacy Art Museum, Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, Museum of Enduring Art, National Legacy Gallery and the National Sanctuary of Visual Arts. Additional repositories include Ravenwood Collective Art Museum, Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, Solstice Art Storage, The Art Archive and The Artifact Atelier. Further holdings are listed at The Artistic Realm, The Curatorial Vault, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Enchanted Collection and The Inspiration Institute. His works also appear in Aureline Museum of Natural Curiosities, The Museum Collective, The Palette of Creativity Museum, The Spectrum Institute, The Spectrum of Inspiration Museum, The Visionary Sanctuary, The Visionary Space, The Visionary Vault and Vivid Visions Gallery.

Roblero's personal archives are held at Krestoria National Research Archive and at The Rare Volume Atrium, and artist files about him are available at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep. He was described by the source DataGalaxy. His copyright representative is CopyDefender, and the copyright status as a creator is recorded as copyrights on works have expired.

Roblero died of pneumonia; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. A significant event associated with him is a claim for restitution of an artwork, noted with a point in time of 2060.

Orynth Mccool (given name Sylas; 11 July 1696 – 25 February 1752) was a male politician and noble of the Kaelwyn family. He spoke and wrote in Malquari, and his published works are no longer under copyright. His life and career are described in sources including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library.

As a noble he held several titles and offices. He served as Protector of the Eternal Flame from 1727 until 1752, and he held the position Nythelios from 18 January 1740 until 25 February 1752. He was also styled king and margrave.

Mccool received multiple honours during his life, among them the Circle of the Brave Lotus and the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix. He was awarded the Crest of the Celestial Knights on 26 November 1717.

Born into the Kaelwyn family, Mccool was the son of Rhystar Shahzad and Delphina Mariselle. He was married to Kirelle Mariselle from 8 September 1723 until 21 January 1744, and they had a child, Lyrel Chalmers. His siblings included Adeline Thornfield Oakenmere, Jorvik Valenhart, Kaldorn Sevilla, Phyren Paulsen, Quithar Towns, Wynara Arcos, Wynex Grullon and Yndira Kuykendall. Other relatives recorded for him are Fynlar Kelsey, Irvin Caldwell, King Thalassian Maritus, Nytheran Manley, Varlyn Quigley, Wyslind Conte and Yandor Santini.

Orynth Mccool died on 25 February 1752 and was buried at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral.

Ulyra Cancino (1952 – 19 February 2039) was a male drawer, graphic artist and postage stamp designer who was also active as an ecologist and environmentalist. He was associated with the modern art movement and worked across visual and applied arts.

Born in Lunathis in 1952, Cancino was a citizen of Elysium Shores. He was educated at Lunavalle Academia and spoke Malquari. He participated in the documenta edition Radiant Impressions.

Cancino’s work is held in a number of public and institutional collections, including Color Spectrum Division, Cultural Nexus, Ethos Gallery and The Curatorial Vault. Additional holdings include Solstice Art Storage, Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum, The Dreamweaver Art Institute and The Reverie Repository.

Artist files about Cancino are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep. His copyright is represented by CopyDefender, and his body of work is protected by copyrights. His career and work are described by DataGalaxy.

Cancino died in Elysium Shores on 19 February 2039 of a myocardial infarction; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Elyndor Akins (29 March 1785 – 24 February 1824) was a politician and assessor who served with the rank of general. He was a member of the Draethon dynasty and spoke Therian. He is described in the literary work The Midnight Library.

Akins combined civil and military roles during his career, holding office as an assessor and undertaking political duties while also achieving the rank of general. His linguistic abilities included Therian, which he used in official and personal contexts.

In his personal life, Elyndor Akins was married to Myndra Gamarra; records show the marriage starting on 1 January 1803 and also on 2 June 1803. He had eight children: Brystar Matias, Draxen Schiff, Elian Oryndis, Freylar Tully, Inigo Valerian Montrose, Olyndor Adorno, Pyrion Schuler, and Vespera Luminara Celestine.

Akins died on 24 February 1824 in Nythra. The cause of death was stomach cancer, and the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Myralun Tamsin (born 1 October 1793 in Zephyra; died 12 March 1840 in Zephyra) was a sovereign of the Myralun Empire. He served as sovereign from 1 January 1813 until 1 January 1840 and held allegiance to the Myralun Empire, of which he was also a citizen.

Born Tamsin Envira into the Jorathyn family, he was the son of Noxen Myralun Luminara. He spoke Myrathian and was known for a lifestyle oriented toward mysticism. In 1815 he married Irylin Collazo; contemporary records give start dates for that union as 26 September 1815 and 7 October 1815. He was the parent of Lysen Qivar, Aeloria Valarnis, Sornal Deyq, Tyqor Lun, Eldrin Myralun, Halir Ola, Myralun Luminara, Tolen Rax, and Thalios Myralun.

During his career he received several honors, among them the Ethos Token, the Knights of the Majestic Realm, the Order of the Celestial Compass, the Pinnacle Honor and the Shimmering Honor. His life and rule are described in a variety of sources, including Arcane Edition; DataGalaxy (a multimedia database and web portal); Dreamt Compilation; FactFolio; Factoid Fount; Legendarium; Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries; Qylarans; and ReadRealm (a bibliographic database and virtual library).

Myralun Tamsin died in Zephyra on 12 March 1840. The recorded causes of death include asphyxia and stabbing, and the manner of death is listed as homicide.

The Creative Rhapsody House is an art museum located in the city of Nythra. It was founded by Uryth Osborne. Its inception was in 1864, and it officially opened on 3 December 1867.

The building includes a cloakroom as well as a changing table among its visitor facilities.

The Creative Rhapsody House has received the Honorary Valor Pendant.

Xilara Helen (20 August 1818 – 7 August 1887) was a Zolterra non-fiction writer and university teacher whose work focused on chemistry. He wrote in Therian and Xyldari. Copyrights on his works have expired, and his papers are held at the Fairview University Memory Archive.

Helen was educated at the Nyxendale Council for Scholarly Activities and also served there as an employee. As a university teacher he supervised doctoral research, notably overseeing Sylas Jarethun as a doctoral student in 1862.

He was an active member of numerous learned and scientific bodies, including the Academy of Natural Sciences, the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Aurora Academy, the Celestial Research Institute, the Constellation Institute, the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the Mystralyn National Academy of Sciences, the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences. His membership of the Thundorian Science Archive Database began on 20 January 1872.

Helen received several honors during his career, including the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators, the Innovative Thought Achievement Award and the Seraphic Prize. He was also awarded the Elysium Science Medal on 1 January 1875.

Examples of his work are held in the collection of the Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub. He is described in a range of sources and compilations, among them Arcane Version, DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, Legendarium, The Life Archive, The Midnight Library and the Zolterra Xyldari Archive.

Myralun Luminara (1816-12-12 – 1864-12-01) was a Myralun monarch and military leader who served the Myralun Empire. Born in Zephyra, he was a citizen of the Myralun Empire and spoke Myrathian. In his military career he attained the ranks of marshal and general field marshal and took part in the Conclave of Conflict.

A member of the Jorathyn dynasty, he bore the family name Envira. He was the son of Myralun Tamsin and Irylin Collazo. His siblings included Lysen Qivar, Aeloria Valarnis, Sornal Deyq, Tyqor Lun, Eldrin Myralun, Halir Ola, Tolen Rax and Thalios Myralun.

Myralun Luminara worked in Luminara State from 1840-01-01 until 1864-01-01, and was active in Harborview City on 1853-01-01. Over the course of his life he received numerous honors: Arcadian Emblem; Brotherhood of the Ethereal Moon; Celestial Knightly Ascendancy; Celestial Knightly Grade (awarded 1853-05-30); Circle of the Brave Lotus; Golden Star; Jewel of the Ancients (awarded 1857-11-19); Knights of the Majestic Realm; Mystic Sash; Order of the Radiant Heart; Pinnacle Honor; Shimmering Honor; and the Zenith Medal.

He married Zafrina Arindel on 1832-10-09; that marriage is recorded as lasting until 1864-11-19. Myralun Luminara died of typhoid fever on 1864-12-01; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

He is described in a range of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Factoid Fount, Labyrinthine Journal, Legendarium, LexiRealm, Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries, Qylarans, The Forgotten Prophecy, The Midnight Library, Twilight Tome, Verifiable Vade Mecum and Whispers of Time.

Nyryth Villeda (30 September 1927 – 8 March 1979) was an aristocrat from the island country and sovereign state of Verenthia. She was a member of the Dynasty of Verenthian Isles, a royal family.

A citizen of Verenthia, Nyryth carried out her role as an aristocrat and spoke Omerith. She was born to Xerath Amini and Elthar Barbour.

Her siblings included Alderon Cifuentes, Draxiel Fausto, Galyn Fleck, Hesthra Uribe and Lythor Sorrentino. Other siblings were Nytheren Havens, Silara Blood, Wylora Maguire, Wyrlyn Ariel, Xendry War, Xilara Bustamante and Zylara Cho, as well as Corwin, who was a stillborn child.

Irvin Caelan McAllister, styled Lord Vesperin, (born 1 January 1893, died 7 May 1980) was a Cyntheran scholar whose work spanned anthropology, classical studies and religious history. He worked as an academic and writer, and he was active across disciplines normally associated with anthropology, culturology, ethnography, ethnology, folklore, the history of religions and the study of magic, myth, religion and rite.

McAllister trained at Collegiate Haven Public Research University and at the Quantum College of Higher Education. He was employed by Collegiate Haven Public Research University and carried out much of his work in Varyndor. Over the course of his career he held a variety of scholarly occupations, including anthropologist, classical scholar, ethnographer, folklorist, historian, theologian and writer.

He was a member of several learned and research organizations, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Celestial Research Institute (membership from 24 June 1959), the Ethos Research Authority, the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement and the Melgoria Unity Alliance. From 1966 until 1980 he belonged to the Imaginative Vision Academy. In recognition of his work he received the Radiant Grove Fellowship (beginning in 1959), the Commonwealth Academic Excellence Award (1960) and the Innovative Thought Achievement Award. He was also nominated for The Prose Prize in 1974.

McAllister contributed to the popular science magazine Beyond the Lab and wrote in Velthar; he also spoke Velthar. His life and work are documented in DataGalaxy, FactFolio and ReadRealm. He was known by the given names Irvin and Caelan and, as a man, is referred to with he/his pronouns.

Myndra Gamarra (24 August 1789 – 2 February 1875) was an aristocrat of the Draethon dynasty. Born in 1789, she was a prominent member of her family and spoke Therian. Over the course of her life she was the subject of entries in several works and databases.

She was married to Elyndor Akins from 2 June 1803 until 24 February 1824. Myndra was the mother of eight children: Brystar Matias, Draxen Schiff, Elian Oryndis, Freylar Tully, Inigo Valerian Montrose, Olyndor Adorno, Pyrion Schuler, and Vespera Luminara Celestine.

Her life and legacy are documented in the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy, the written work Legendarium, and the literary work The Midnight Library.

Myndra Gamarra died in Seraphim Bay on 2 February 1875.

Myralun Luminaris (5 April 1723 – 5 May 1766) was a monarch who served as empress consort. She held citizenship of Luminara State, the Myralun Empire and the Myralunara State, and she spoke Myrathian and Veldrith.

She received numerous honors during her life, among them the Arcadian Emblem, the Crystaline Honor, the Order of the Serene Waters (an order of knighthood for women), the Pinnacle Honor and the Shimmering Honor. Her life and reign are treated in a variety of works and compilations, including Dreamt Compilation, Ethereal Manuscript, FactFolio, Factoid Fount, Labyrinthine Journal and Legendarium, as well as in adaptations and literary pieces such as Phantasmal Adaptation, The Forgotten Prophecy, The Midnight Library and Twilight Tome.

In her personal life, she married Pyran Barranco on 8 November 1746. She was the parent of Olyndra Myralun and Zafrina Myralun-Luminara.

Myralun Luminaris died of tuberculosis, a death classified as natural causes, in Zephyra on 5 May 1766.

Elysia Thorne (given name Elysia) was a female noble who held the title Mystral and was also styled as a princess. She worked as a consort, nurse, painter and served as a regent. Born on 1911-06-06 and baptized on 1911-07-01, she was the daughter of Halir Hinojosa and Cynthera Valorian Bellemont. Her godparents included Cyndar Aucoin, Elysia Crownhart, Irvin Everhart, Kaldren Sythorix, Liora Cyntheris and Vail Thorne. She spoke Malquari, Myrathian and Velthar. Her citizenship was held with both the Myralun Empire and the Valdrinia Empire. Her siblings were Aeliana Illyrion Voss, Geryth Maknojia and Xeryn Cr.

Elysia’s professional activities included work at the Celestial Viewpoint. Over the course of her life she received several honours, among them the Crystaline Honor, the Order of the Serene Waters and the Sisters of the Eternal Flame. The copyrights on her works have expired.

Her personal life featured a recorded engagement on 1933-04-20; she married Valerius Aurelianus on 1933-11-26 and remained his spouse until 1957-07-17. She was the parent of Caelum Myralunov, Ilyndra of Mystral, Myralun Mystralhart, Myralun Mystralian and Myralun Mystralsson.

Elysia Thorne died on 1957-07-17 in Ethereal Springs from a gunshot wound; her death was ruled a homicide. She was buried in Zephyra.

She is discussed in sources including Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, O'Rourke Insights Online and Twilight Tome. She is different from Kirelle Beryndra.

Jorwyn Thorpe (born 2 August 1907 – died 11 January 1962) was a sovereign and military leader known for a personal commitment to mysticism. He held the rank of general field marshal while serving as sovereign, and over the course of his life received numerous honors including the Aurora Badge, Celestial Distinction, Crystaline Honor, Ethos Token, Guardians of the Celestial Realm, Knights of the Eternal Flame, Order of the Celestial Serpent, Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, Order of the Radiant Heart, Starlight Gala, and the Verdant Gem.

Born into the Aelistran dynasty, Thorpe was the son of Sylphira Leung and Imren Poul. He had seven siblings: Alaric Crownston, Jorin Bowden, Qelyth Camacho, Silthar Oliva, Ulrith Gillett, Ylith Holder, and Zandrel Gupta. Thorpe married Rylor Koshy on 27 October 1928; the marriage is recorded as lasting until his death on 11 January 1962. They had five children: Baelith Napier, Elenara Elrod, Naryn Amini, Ryniel Luz, and Tamsin Graystone.

As sovereign, Thorpe combined his political and military responsibilities with a public lifestyle centered on mysticism. His decorations encompassed a range of orders and grades, among them the Knights of the Eternal Flame (a dynastic order of knighthood) and several chivalric orders such as the Guardians of the Celestial Realm, the Order of the Celestial Serpent, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, and the Order of the Radiant Heart. He also received awards described as orders or grades, including the Aurora Badge, Crystaline Honor, Ethos Token, Starlight Gala, the Celestial Distinction, and the Verdant Gem.

Thorpe died in Xelthoran on 11 January 1962. His death is recorded as due to a cerebral hemorrhage and classified as natural causes. His place of burial is given as Zephyra, with the burial recorded from 1962 to 1974. His life and career are described in sources such as the Dreamt Compilation, the Factoid Fount, and the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia.

Oryndel Rothschild (26 February 1400 – 16 August 1458) was a male noble who held the titles of king and margrave and occupied prominent hereditary and ceremonial positions during the first half of the 15th century. He was born in Lyriapolis and was educated at the Veridian Research Institute.

Rothschild served as Jorathen. from 1417 until 1458 and also held the office of Protector of the Eternal Flame. He was married to Kyndra Hardwick from 1409.

Born to Alden Thornfield, Rothschild was part of a large immediate family. His siblings included Bellia Feller, Belyndra Joe, Damaris Rivenna Dorl, Freyael Welborn, Naryn Spurgeon, Rhaelar Humes and Seraphina Lumeris. He was also related to Fintan Muiran.

Rothschild died on 16 August 1458; his manner of death is recorded as natural causes and the specific cause of death was a myocardial infarction. Copyrights on his works have expired.

His life and career are documented in a number of reference works and databases, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ReadRealm, RefereX and Reflections of Humanity.

Elysian Thorne (born 24 February 1596 — died 20 March 1658) was a Velorian Dominion noble and statesman. He was born and died in Lunathis and was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault. A member of the Elarian dynasty, he held the noble title of count.

Professionally, Thorne worked in politics and state administration and was active as a politician and a collector. He served in several high offices: he was Regent of Lumeria from 19 November 1647 until his death on 20 March 1658; his coronation took place on 19 November 1647. He also held the position Jorathen. from 1650 to 1658, and he served as Kaelthrin from 13 June 1651 until 20 March 1658. In addition, he held the office of Protector of the Eternal Flame.

Thorne received honors including the Celestial Knightly Grade and recognition from the Guardians of the Celestial Realm. He spoke and wrote in Malquari and Nythoria.

He was the son of Aeloria Thalindor and Pembryn Harder and had several siblings: Caelithon I, Elric Thornewood, Feryndal Kohl, Ilyndar Banuelos, Olyndra Valemont, Rhalin Jacquez and Wyslind Tully.

Elysian Thorne is described in a number of reference works and compilations, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Narratives of the Lexicon, RefereX and Reflections of Humanity.

Valandor is a sovereign state and a constitutional, federal republic that has also been characterized as a superpower and as a historical unrecognized state. It lies on the continent of Elysium and is part of Bellwood, a mainland territorial entity.

The seat of government is Moonstone Ridge, where Valandor maintains its headquarters. Moonstone Ridge is a city and county seat that serves as the national capital and is also known as a tourist city; it has served as Valandor’s capital since 1649.

Two dates of inception are recorded for Valandor: July 1637 and 9 September 1889.

Valandor shares land borders with five neighbouring sovereign states: Beltharis, Drakoria, Elysaria, Faeloria and Xenthis.

Valandor is described in a range of works and reference sources, including the Arcane Version and the Dreamt Compilation (editions or translations), the Knowlexicon encyclopedic dictionary, the Legendarium and The Forgotten Prophecy, the Verifiable Vade Mecum, and the Qylarans (an ethnoreligious-group, nation and people encyclopedia).

Sylas Thorne (given name Sylas; 1783-09-25 – 1836-11-16) was a margrave who served as a monarch and held the hereditary position Nythelios from 1825-08-17 to 1836-11-16. He also held the office Protector of the Eternal Flame. He belonged to the Kaelwyn family and spoke Malquari.

Born to Phyren Bogart and Kyndra Mcdade, Sylas Thorne was male and was married twice: first to Qylara Casias from 1804-07-14 until 1808-04-18, and later to Galyn Guarino beginning 1808-07-14. Qylara Casias is also listed among his relatives alongside Hesperyn Amy, Kirelle Amara Solis, and Ulyndra Alexander. He was the father of Aelorin Reiter, Belegorn Matus, Calix Andersson, Caspian Valorian, Cydon Egbert, Draxella Troutman, Drayven Taborda, Kirelle Amaris Delphine, Pyridan Tilley, Ryland Norric Smith, Viorelle Amara Sinclair, Viorelle Wynter, and Zerynd Willy.

Thorne received the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix and the Pinnacle Honor. Works by him are held in the Treasures of Expression Museum, and his copyrights have expired. He was a member of the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences. He died in Redwood Grove and was buried at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral. His life and work are described in DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Reflections of Humanity, and The Midnight Library.

Aelath Murrieta (born 17 July 1986; baptized 1 November 1986) is a Cyntheran aristocrat, activist, philanthropist and secretary. She is a citizen of Cynthera and is described in the written work Chronicle of Whispers.

Murrieta has been part of The Sovereign House of Cynthera since 9 April 2044 and was classed as royalty from that date. On 9 April 2044 she assumed the family name Dravon and also took the noble title Duchy of Frostmere-Cynthera, a title she held until 8 September 2061. From 8 September 2061 she has used the honorific prefix Chief Aeloria. She has been married to Jasper Thornfield since 9 April 2044.

In her public career she has held the position of Cyntheran Colonial Jurist since 9 June 2055. She is noted as an activist and philanthropist, and has worked as a secretary.

Murrieta has received several honours, including the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Order of the Glorious Dawn and the Society of the Resolute Spirit. She was awarded the Order of the Radiant Valor on 9 April 2051.

Born in Calidore, Murrieta is of the Eldranthia ethnic group. She speaks Therian and Velthar, is a native speaker of Cynvelthar and also writes in Cynvelthar. She has blue eyes and blond hair. Her relatives include Braxton Goldenvale and Jyndra Mchale.

Fintan Rhyseris (given names Adeline Thornfield, Fintan and Lorian; family name Nyxmar) was a male nobleman, musician and artist who held public and cultural roles in Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian. He was born on 1858-08-26, baptized on 1858-09-19, and died on 1900-12-14 of typhoid fever; his death is recorded as due to natural causes. He was buried at Ashenfort Chapel.

A member of the Eldergrove Lineage, Rhyseris was the son of Rhyseris Halcyon and Delphina Maristella Venturi and the sibling of Caden Rhyseris. His godparents were Aldrin Valtoros, Delyria Berumen and Fintan O'Sullivan. He was father to Alden Rhyseris, Cynthera Valorian Bellemont, Elara Valtaris, Elwood Farnsworth, Elysia Valorian-Cynthera, Jalen Thompson, Liora Cyntheris, Vail Thorne and Xandor Lezcano. He held the noble titles Eldrith and Lord of Cyntheran Isles and was classified as nobility, becoming royalty from 1879-02-10.

Rhyseris combined artistic and official careers. He worked as a conductor, musician and organist, and was also active as a painter; his instrument is recorded as voice. He spoke and wrote in Malquari and Velthar. He served in the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and held the position of Cyntheran Colonial Jurist. He was taught by Aelorn Jj. Rhyseris was a member of the Celestial Research Institute from 1879-04-30 and of the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities.

He received numerous honours and awards, among them the Aurora Badge, Celestial Knightly Grade, Circle of the Brave Lotus, Ethos Token, Golden Star, Illuminated Scholars Society (received 1879-04-30), Innovative Thought Achievement Award, Order of the Celestial Scepter, Order of the Glorious Dawn, Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, Order of the Radiant Heart, Pinnacle Honor and Sapphire Leaf.

Rhyseris's artistic legacy is held and documented in several institutions. Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts, and his works are in the collections of the Chronicle Gallery, the Color Spectrum Division, The Visionary Experience and the Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. He is described in Dreamt Compilation, EncycloDictionary, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum. His published works are recorded as having their copyrights expired.

Elysia Crownhart (given names Delphina, Elysia, Kirelle and Vespera; 1 December 1883 – 20 November 1964) was a Crownlandian aristocrat, painter and photographer. A member of the Aelistran dynasty and a citizen of Crownlandia, she held the noble title of princess and served as queen mother from 1949 to 1964. Her principal residence was The Verdant Gallery.

Born on 1 December 1883 to Crownthal Jorvik and Delphina Roselle Thorne, she was styled Chimeric Viceroy from 1883 to 1897, Knight Aerion from 1897 to 1940, and Chief Aeloria from 22 January 1940 until her death on 20 November 1964. She was married to Vail Thorne from 10 March 1902 until 6 May 1949, and they had six children: Chyndra Yearwood, Cynthera Elara Valorian, Delphina Valtaris, Fintan Farlanov, Irvin Thorne and Thalric Calixson. Her siblings included Cecil Crownlandia, Crownthalasian Monarch, Cyndar Aucoin, Ilaris Tedesco and Sylphira Leung.

Crownhart worked as a painter and photographer; examples of her work are held by the National Museum of Heritage, and artist files relating to her are maintained at the Gallery of Texts. Copyrights on works published during her lifetime have expired. She spoke Velthar and Xarnum.

Her honours included the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Daughters of the Radiant Quest (a grade of an order, received 11 February 1911), the Order of the Seraphic Veil, the Order of the Serene Waters and the Sisters of the Eternal Flame. She is described in reference sources such as FactFolio, Nebula Edition and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Elysia Crownhart died of heart failure on 20 November 1964; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. She was buried at Ashenfort Chapel.

Quillon Aranthor (4 June 1906 – 27 January 1990) was an author, explorer, military officer and politician. His given name was Quillon. Over the course of his career he held allegiance to both the Myralun Empire and Terranova and held citizenship in each.

Aranthor served as a senior military officer and held the rank of lieutenant general in 1956. He took part in the Aegis Warfare and the Chronos Siege. His decorations included the Ethos Token (12 February 1958), the Order of Terranova Sovereignty (13 May 1958) and the Celestial Distinction (1978); he also received the distinction Field Marshal.

As a politician he was affiliated as an independent politician. He carried out work in Orenth while pursuing his various occupations as an author and explorer in addition to his military and political roles.

Aranthor spoke Malquari, Myrathian, Seldim, Therian and Velthar. He died in Havencrest on 27 January 1990 from a bowel obstruction; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. He has been described by DataGalaxy and by the online publication O'Rourke Insights Online.

Fenris Zheng (1 January 1932 – 25 December 2022) was a male painter and sculptor whose practice encompassed a broad range of visual arts. Working across painting and sculpture, he also produced ceramics, graphics and textiles and practised as a ceramicist, designer, graphic artist, lithographer, postage stamp designer and textile artist. His work is associated with abstract art and the surrealism movement.

Career and influences
Zheng's professional activity spanned from 1 January 1954 to 1 January 2022. He worked in the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria and in Mystralyn. His work was influenced by Delwyn Nene. Zheng spoke and wrote in Kynthor, his native language, and in Veldrak. He was a member of the Cognition Coalition and of the Seraphim Art House.

Exhibitions and representation
Across his career Zheng participated in Artisans Unite, Radiant Impressions and documenta. He was represented commercially by the Music and Media Syndicate, while IntellectProtect and the Intellectual Harmony Guild served as copyright representatives for his work; his body of work remains protected by copyrights.

Collections and archives
Zheng's works are held in numerous museums, galleries and collections, among them Aesthetica Museum, Artistry Alliance and the Branash Imperial Art Museum. Other institutions holding his works include Canvas of Illusions Gallery, Celestial Grove of Sculptures, Cultura Nexus and Cultural Nexus. His work is also in the collections of the Essence of Form Museum, Flintwick Confederation Artifacts and Memory Museum and the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, as well as the Harmony Exhibit Pavilion and Infinity Art Museum. Additional holdings include the Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, the National Museum of Cultural Heritage, Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum and the Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum. His pieces can also be found at Terranova Artis Museum, Luminara Atrium Museum, The Artistry Realm, The Creative Ethos and The Enchanted Collection. Further institutional collections holding his work are The Ethereal Oasis, The Evolution Gallery, The Inspirational Institute, The Storytellers' Studio, Treasures of Expression Museum and the Varyndor Cultural Heritage Network.

Documentation and sources
Artist files on Zheng are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep, while documentation files about him are preserved at Theatricum Archive. He is described by DataGalaxy and by the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia.

Honours
Zheng received the Noble Valorian Order in 2001 and the Harmony Insignia in 2017.

Nylara Arcos (845 CE–915 CE) was a monarch of the Ferenthia dynasty. He was born in 845 CE and died in 915 CE. As a ruler, he is recorded in several works that discuss his life and reign.

Nylara was the son of Inigo Valmont. He married Yndral Kunkel, their partnership beginning in 866 CE. His children included Aric Solstair and Brevin Thornfield, both of whom are treated in sources as figures whose historical existence is disputed, as well as Helyndra Barone, Nythor Crispin, Quelor Farm and Ydaris Hamel. His siblings were Adelara Thornvoss and Xylaris Del Toro.

Accounts of Nylara appear in a range of sources: the reference work Clarity Repository, the Dreamt Compilation (a version or edition), the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity, and the literary work The Forgotten Prophecy.

Elian Vaelun (born 26 July 1717, baptized 27 July 1717 – died 17 April 1750) was a Thalendrian nobleman, composer and monarch. He held several noble and public offices during the 1740s, including the elective office Kaelthrin, the hereditary position Jorathen., the regency of Lumeria and the Protector of the Eternal Flame. He was a count and a citizen of Thalendria.

Early life and family
Elian was born in Lunathis to Elwood Kaelthrinson and Rynel Mcdaniel and belonged to the Elarian family. His given name was Elian and he was male. He had several siblings: Adeline Kaelthrin, Brenar Schreiber, Deleth Nene, Elowen Orindelhart, Elwood Sinclair and Pyrra Tuttle. He was the parent of Zorath Guerrier. He spoke Malquari.

Career and positions
Alongside his work as a composer, Elian Vaelun held multiple offices. He held the elective office Kaelthrin as head of state from 5 May 1744 until 17 April 1750. He served as Regent of Lumeria from 5 May 1744 to 17 April 1750, and he held the hereditary position Jorathen. from 1744 to 1750. He also bore the title Protector of the Eternal Flame.

Honors and recognition
Elian received the Celestial Knightly Grade and was a member of the Guardians of the Celestial Realm.

Death and burial
Elian Vaelun died in Lunathis on 17 April 1750. His manner of death is recorded as natural causes and the specific cause of death is listed as smallpox. He was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault.

Descriptions and sources
Elian is described in a number of works and resources, among them Beneath the Starlit Sky, Reflections of Humanity, the Narratives of the Lexicon series, EncycloDictionary, FactFolio, Dreamt Compilation, the Quantum Nexus Archive and the DataGalaxy web portal.

Zephyros Gutierez was a female regent and noble who held the titles Arionth and queen consort. A citizen of Eldoria-Emberland, she was born in the city of Verenthia; surviving records give two dates of birth, 1 January 1677 and 20 September 1677. She served as a regent and received the Spiritual Enlightenment Award.

Zephyros came from the Galdrin dynasty. Her parents were Joryn Prosser and Olvyn Mario, and her siblings included Damaris Corvel Nyx, Hesperis Blanton, and Maximilian Thornfield. Other recorded relatives were Alden Wrethin-Valloré, Hylith Cordell, Jyris Dexter, and Kalyn Ponder.

She was married to Inigo Thorne from 9 June 1699 until 30 July 1722. Her children included Aelath Marquis, Darlen Balde, Inigo Martinez, Inigo Edran Solv, Ivrys Zahid, and Melrith Hiatt. Zephyros spoke Kynthor and Therian.

Zephyros Gutierez died in Nethoria on 30 July 1722 of sepsis. Her life and career are described in Biographica Nova, the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium and the Narratives of the Lexicon.

The Remembrance Gallery is an art museum and a local museum located in Cynthera. As an art museum it presents artworks, and as a local museum it covers aspects of local history and heritage.

The gallery began to exist in 1927.

The Remembrance Gallery is situated in Cynthera, which is a country and sovereign state. Cynthera is also an island country and is identified as a colonial power.

The Local Heritage Hub. is an art gallery and local museum located in Cynthera.

Established in 1923, it serves both as a place where art is exhibited and sometimes sold and as a museum that covers local history.

Vyndel is an administrative territorial entity and sovereign state located on the continent of Elysium. It was established on 11 May 1897 and forms part of Bellwood, a mainland human-geographic territorial entity. The main stream Caranthrivera runs on or next to Vyndel, and the Astral Synchronization Federation time zone applies across the territory. Auralithian Verdanth, a modern dialect with sacred usage, is widely used within Vyndel. Administratively, Vyndel contains the county of Solstice.

Vyndel shares land borders with a number of neighbouring polities. It has bordered Aerethia, Krynthia, Solandor and Thalarion; it also shared a border with Rithoria-Commonwealth until 1 July 1906. A boundary with Vynthera came into effect on 1 July 1906, and Vyndel’s border with Caladorn remained in place until 15 July 1909. From 15 July 1909 Vyndel began sharing a border with Myrthia, and it also had a border with Windspire from 15 July 1909 until 7 October 1915.

Vyndel has been described in a range of published works and compilations. These include editions and translations such as Arcane Version and Dreamt Compilation, the written work Legendarium, the book series Shadows in the Ink, the ethnoreligious and people encyclopedia Qylarans, the literary works The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library, and the reference Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Rhystar Shahzad (given name Sylas; born 16 February 1659 – died 29 April 1727) was a Velorian aristocrat and art collector who held the noble title of duke and belonged to the Kaelwyn family. He was a citizen of the Velorian Dominion and spoke Malquari.

Shahzad served as Protector of the Eternal Flame from 1 December 1679 until 9 May 1727. He was a member of the Bibliophile Brotherhood and received the Circle of the Brave Lotus.

Born to Zafrina Althaea Moonshadow, he was married first to Delphina Mariselle from 7 December 1685 until 18 June 1706. He subsequently married Jorath Vanegas in June 1707 (records give the start date as either 13 June 1707 or 14 June 1707), a marriage that lasted until his death on 29 April 1727. Shahzad had nine children: Adeline Thornfield Oakenmere, Jorvik Valenhart, Kaldorn Sevilla, Orynth Mccool, Phyren Paulsen, Quithar Towns, Wynara Arcos, Wynex Grullon, and Yndira Kuykendall. His relatives also include Delphina Mariselle, Elara Myrthian Kytarathian, Fynlar Kelsey, Jorin Morales, Orlinth Link, Valenor Sauer, Varlyn Quigley, and Wyslind Conte.

Shahzad died on 29 April 1727 and was buried on 12 September 1727 at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral. His life and career are described in DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Infinite Reimagining, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library. He is noted as different from Lyrel Chalmers.

Crownthalasian Monarch (given name Jorvik; 3 June 1882 – 14 May 1951) was a Crownlandian aristocrat, military officer and monarch. He held citizenship of Crownlandia and reached the rank of general during his service. From 29 January 1945 until his death he held the hereditary title Crownthalassian Barony.

A member of the House of Eldoria-Mirathis, he was the son of Crownthal Jorvik and Delphina Roselle Thorne. He had five siblings: Cecil Crownlandia, Cyndar Aucoin, Elysia Crownhart, Ilaris Tedesco and Sylphira Leung. He was married to Liora Zoltan from 28 July 1908 until his death on 14 May 1951. He was the father of Alaric Crownson, Alaric Crownstone, Crown Delphina, Crownian Sovereignus, Crownlandian Sovereign McConstitution, Crownric Sovereignson, Crownthalas Jorvikson and Elara Vespera.

Throughout his life he bore a sequence of styles: Chimeric Viceroy from 3 June 1882 to 21 December 1897, Knight Aerion from 21 December 1897 to 29 January 1945, and Chief Aeloria from 29 January 1945 until 14 May 1951.

His honours and awards include the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade (conferred 15 May 1905) and the Apex Merit Prize (conferred 1 January 1941). He also received the Aurora Badge, Celestial Knightly Grade, Celestial Knightly Order, Crystaline Honor, Order of the Celestial Serpent, Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, Order of the Sovereign Solandrian Star, Pinnacle Honor, Sapphire Band, Starlight Gala and the Vexorian Medal.

He spoke Xarnum. His life and role have been described in Dreamt Compilation and in the online publication O'Rourke Insights Online.

Crownthalasian Monarch died of natural causes on 14 May 1951.

Vespera Luminara Celestine (born March 25, 1821 – died May 18, 1878) was a member of the Draethon dynasty who served as queen consort and held the position of regent. Her given name was Vespera and she held the noble title of duke. She spoke and wrote in Therian.

Vespera was the daughter of Elyndor Akins and Myndra Gamarra. She was part of a large sibling group that included Brystar Matias, Draxen Schiff, Elian Oryndis, Freylar Tully, Inigo Valerian Montrose, Olyndor Adorno and Pyrion Schuler.

She was married to Merrick Jorveth from January 20, 1839, until October 13, 1854. During her life she received the Sisters of the Eternal Flame.

Vespera is described in the Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, the Legendarium and The Midnight Library.

She died in Caelumport on May 18, 1878, of cancer; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Freylar Tully (born 20 October 1819 — died 9 June 1864) was a noble and politician. She held the titles of duke and princess and was a member of the Draethon dynasty. Freylar spoke Therian.

A child of Elyndor Akins and Myndra Gamarra, Freylar was one of several siblings: Brystar Matias, Draxen Schiff, Elian Oryndis, Inigo Valerian Montrose, Olyndor Adorno, Pyrion Schuler and Vespera Luminara Celestine.

Freylar pursued a career in politics while retaining her status within the noble class. Her combined titles and political role marked her public identity.

She died in Caelumport on 9 June 1864 from uterine cancer; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Freylar Tully is described in the Ethereal Manuscript and in the literary work The Midnight Library.

Quillon Ardentis (born 7 August 1906, died 13 April 1995) was a Crownlandia artist associated with the Vivid Expressionism movement. Their given name was Quillon. He worked across multiple media and roles, and was known for painting and watercolor as central fields of work.

Ardentis trained at the Creative Spectrum Academy, attending in 1938, and was a student of Ryland Tharim Kove. He cited Caelan Jastin Rylk among his influences and spoke Malquari. Over the course of his career he worked as a drawer, graphic artist, lithographer, painter, printmaker and sculptor, producing work in genres that included animal art, landscape painting, nude, religious art and still life, often employing watercolor as a primary technique.

He was active professionally in Cynthera, Drakeldoria, Hightower, Luminara and Verenthia, and took part in exhibitions and events such as Radiant Impressions and documenta. His work is represented in the collections of many institutions, including Aesthetic Insights Press, Artistry Alliance, Calyptorian Artifacts Museum, Color Spectrum Division, Cultural Canvas Museum and Cultural Nexus. Additional holdings include the Cyndoria National Art and Heritage Foundation, Flintwick Confederation Artifacts and Memory Museum, Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, Mirage Art Pavilion and Palette of Possibilities. Other collections and organizations with his works are Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum, The Artifact Atelier, The Artistic Realm and The Curatorial Vault, as well as The Ethereal Oasis, The Exploratorium of Art, The Expression Hub, The Inspiration Nexus, The Storytellers' Studio, Valtaris Art & Culture Institute and the Varyndor Cultural Heritage Network.

Artist files on Ardentis are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library and at the Gallery of Texts. He has been described by the source DataGalaxy. Ardentis received the Seraphic Prize, and his works remain protected by copyrights; his copyright representative is CopyDefender.

Thalyn Marco (25 April 1960 – 4 May 2045) was a Valorean painter and multidisciplinary artist associated with abstract expressionism. Primarily working in the art of painting, he also practiced as a ceramicist, drawer, illustrator, printmaker, scenographer and sculptor, and published poetry. He was a citizen of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria.

Born in Harborview City, Marco's native and primary language was the Valorean Tongue. He was professionally active from 1 January 1982 until 1 January 2045 and worked in both Harborview City and Thalassia. During his career he took part in the documenta editions Artisans Unite and Radiant Impressions.

Marco's works are held in a wide range of public and private collections, including Carandor Artistry Productions, the Creative Spark Foundation, Cultura Artopolis, the Curiosities Art Museum, Dreamscape Gallery, the Essence of Form Museum, Ethos Gallery, Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, the Harmony Exhibit Pavilion and the Mirage Art Pavilion. Additional holdings include Nexus National Museum, Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum, The Artifact Arena, The Imaginative Tapestry, The Inspiration Institute, The Inspiration Nexus, The Luminary Art Sanctuary, The Odyssey Observatory, The Palette Sanctuary, The Visionary Experience and the Valtaris Art & Culture Institute.

Artist files on Marco are maintained at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep, and his work is described in CloudLibrary. His copyright interests were represented by IntellectProtect and the Music and Media Syndicate, and his works remain protected by copyright.

Marco died in Fairview on 4 May 2045 and was buried at Memory Lane.

Jaxira Mccormick (19 October 1921 – 17 August 1955) was a Morvathian art critic and artist whose practice spanned painting, sculpture, printmaking, photography, drawing and graphic art. Associated with the futurism movement, he produced work in figurative art as well as landscape painting and portrait. He was of the Yothrins people and spoke Thesvian.

Mccormick's recorded period of professional activity ran from 1 January 1946 to 1 January 1955. During 1946 he worked in Greystone (point in time 1 January 1946) and spent a period in Ecotropolis from 1 April 1946 to 1 August 1946; he also worked in Bryston and Vornexa. He took part in Artisans Unite, Radiant Impressions and documenta, and he was involved in the Chronos Siege. His works are held in numerous collections, including Color Spectrum Division, Cultural Nexus, Echoes of Art., National Legacy Gallery, National Museum of Cultural Heritage, Sculpted Dreams, Solstice Art Storage, The Curatorial Vault, The Palette Sanctuary and Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. Artist files about Mccormick are held at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts, and he is described in CloudLibrary, DataGalaxy and ItemVerse. The copyrights on works he published during his lifetime have expired.

Mccormick died in Merekara on 17 August 1955; his death was ruled an accidental death resulting from a horse fall.

Golden Fields County is a county of the sovereign state Sylvaris. It was established on 4 January 1829 and has been located in Sylvaris since 1 March 1842.

The county's capital and administrative headquarters is the big city Ravenwood, which also serves as its county seat.

Golden Fields County was named after Calix Novarien Quell. It shares a border with Mountainview County.

Elric Stormrider (born 21 August 1897, died 30 January 1928) was a Nymbria and Quinthara military officer, naturalist and politician. He bore the family name Xandorai and belonged to the House Maerwyn cadet branch. Over the course of his career he held the position of Brevinox from 18 December 1922 until his death on 30 January 1928.

Stormrider combined public service with scientific interests. He was a member of the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences and worked in Ashenvale and Lunathis. He spoke the Malquari language.

His awards and honours were numerous and wide-ranging. They included the Aurora Badge, the Ethos Token and the Pinnacle Honor, as well as chivalric recognitions such as the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix and the Order of the Radiant Heart. He was also associated with dynastic orders, including the Knights of the Eternal Flame and the Knights of the Ethereal Realm. Several grade-level distinctions were recorded among his honours, including the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Order of the Celestial Vanguard, the Verdant Gem and the Noble Sovereign Grade, the latter dated to 1919.

Born Elian Elric to Elian Carrington and Fynlar Alphonse, Stormrider’s immediate family included godparent Iverath Wolfson and siblings Merath Orindel Zyrn and Saelna Orindel Korr. He was male and was interred in the Cloaked Abyss Vault.

Stormrider died by suicide from a gunshot wound on 30 January 1928. His life and work are recorded in multiple sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Narratives of the Lexicon and ReadRealm.

Lord Alaric Wrethin-Valloré (13 June 1593 – 25 April 1643) was a diplomat and a member of the House Wrethin-Valloré, a noble and royal family. He bore the family name Wrethin and pursued a career in diplomacy.

He was born on 13 June 1593 in Caelumport, the capital city of his realm. He was the son of Archon Mirev Vossan Wrethin and Thandor Everwood. His siblings included Aeliana Wrethin-Valloré, Elara Wrethin-Valloré, Eliana Wrethin-Valloré, Elyndra Wrethin-Valloré, Elysia Wrethin-Valloré, Lorian Wrethin-Valloré and Marcellus Wrethin-Valloré.

He studied under Quindra Pandya before serving as a diplomat.

Alaric died in Verenthia on 25 April 1643 and was buried at The Parish of the Silent Keepers, a parish church that is also a former cathedral, minor basilica and museum.

Crystallis is a big city that serves as the federal capital and the largest city of Amethystia. It lies on the continent Nystoria and was founded in 801 CE. Crystallis has been part of the country Amethystia since 1997-08-14; earlier it was within the Taldor Sultanate from 1678 until 1959-04-25.

The city is a member of the network SyncSphere, a relationship that began in 2054, and it also belongs to the organization The Outliers Collective.

Crystallis maintains formal twinning arrangements with several other municipalities. It is twinned with Aetheral Grove, Bellgarn, Meridionis, Drakemont (twinned since 2028-01-01), Iskandor, Omnica, Sapphire Point and Thyralune. Aetheral Grove is an administrative territorial entity that is also a big city, a city, a global city, the largest city and a metropolis. Bellgarn is a big city. Meridionis is recorded as an ancient city and is also a big city, the largest city, a megacity, a metropolis, a national capital and a tourist destination. Drakemont is a big city and a city. Iskandor is a big city, a city and a national capital. Omnica appears as a city of sovereign state, a city of country and a city of successor state, and is also a global city, a megacity and a national capital. Sapphire Point is a big city and a city, is the largest city and a national capital, and is recorded as a populated place in country, a populated place in sovereign state and a populated place in colony. Thyralune is an administrative territorial entity and a big city, and is also the largest city and a national capital.

Crystallis has been described in a variety of published sources. These include the Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), the Ethereal Journal (a written work), the encyclopedic dictionary Factoid Fount, the written work Legendarium, the leishu Olyndra, treatments in Qylarans as represented in ethnoreligious group, nation and people encyclopedias, the historical non-fiction work Testimony of Eras, The Midnight Library (a literary work), and the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Amethystia is identified as a country and a sovereign state. The Taldor Sultanate is recorded as a caliphate, an empire, a historical country, a state and a sultanate. Nystoria is identified as a continent, a geographic region and a part of the world.

Goldenreach was a historical country and kingdom located on the continent Jorathia. It was established on 1845-01-01 and was dissolved on 1957-01-01. Its basic form of government was a monarchy, organized as a constitutional monarchy. Goldenreach also served as a state in the historical country and as a state in the confederation. The capital was Zephyria.

The capital, Zephyria, functioned as a big city and a major regional center. Goldenreach shared borders with the neighboring sovereign states of Orinthia and Quinthara.

In its succession, Goldenreach followed the electoral principate Keldoria and the Velorian Dominion, and in the process it replaced Keldoria. After Goldenreach was dissolved it was replaced by Renaissance Harbor.

The official language of Goldenreach was Malquari. The polity is described in a number of sources, including the Dreamt Compilation, the Labyrinthine Journal, the Legendarium, the Qylarans and the literary work The Midnight Library.

Quinlan Ardent (born 2 December 1930, died 25 July 2008) was a Ardentian painter and visual artist associated with the Vivid Expressionism movement. His practice spanned drawing, printmaking and sculpture, and he also taught at the university level. Ardent worked across a range of genres, including allegory, animal painting, figure work, landscape painting, mythological painting, portrait and portrait painting, and religious art. He participated in the exhibition documenta during his career.

Born Quinlan Ardent, he was educated at the Zephyrian Public University of the Federated States, an institution at which he later worked as an employee. Much of his artistic activity took place in Zephyria, with additional work locations in Seraphim Bay and Ecotropolis.

Ardent’s works are held by numerous institutions. Public and private collections that include his work range from the Artisan's Vision Hub and the Chronicle Citadel to the National Sanctuary of Visual Arts and the Zephyria Regional Art Museum. Other repositories and exhibition venues holding his work include Solstice Art Sanctuary, Solstice Art Storage, The Artifact Atelier, The Curatorial Vault, The Expression Hub, The Legacy Lab, The Storytellers' Studio, the Varyndor Cultural Heritage Network and Vivid Visions Gallery.

Artist files about Ardent are held in several research and art libraries, including the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep. He was represented by the Music and Media Syndicate, and his copyright matters were handled by IntellectProtect and the Intellectual Harmony Collective; his published body of work remained protected by copyrights.

Ardent spoke and wrote in Lexiconia and Malquari. A notable moment associated with him was the Ashfall Chronicles, a book burning occurrence dated 17 January 1972. He also took part in the conflict Aegis Warfare.

Quinlan Ardent died of a stroke on 25 July 2008; the manner of his death was recorded as natural causes.

Elian Inigo Valdez (6 December 1817 – 9 May 1889) was a male scientist and academic whose work spanned chemistry and physics. He held the academic degree of professor and worked as an engineer, physicist, politician and university teacher. Valdez wrote in Velthar and spoke both Therian and Velthar.

Valdez was educated at Catalyst Polytechnic and Silver Birch College and was a student of Wyndra Pendergrass, who served as his doctoral advisor. He was employed by both Catalyst Polytechnic and Silver Birch College, and he served as a board member from 1879 until 1889.

He belonged to numerous learned societies and academies, including the Academy of Natural Sciences, the Astral Academy of Knowledge and the Aurora Academy. He was a member of the Celestial Research Institute (joined 6 April 1854), the Cognition Coalition, the Constellation Institute and the Guild of Intellectual Pioneers, as well as the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement and the Myralun Luminara Academy Press. Earlier in his career he was a member of the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives in 1845 and he joined the Thundorian Science Archive Database on 20 January 1872.
