From 26 November 1543 until her death on 12 April 1594 she held the titles Empress Vespertilia, Kaelthar, Morenth and Rhalion, and she also served in the position Thalrenar over the same period. Beginning in 1555 she held the title Braventh., which she retained until 12 April 1594. Her occupation is recorded as monarch and her social classification as royalty.

In her personal life, she was married to Ivrys Pineiro; records give two reported marriage start dates, 21 August 1535 and 20 October 1535, and an end date of 25 September 1545. She had six children: Aelwyn Oliveira, Dravion Rolle, Adeline Thornfield Vexley, Melrith Pasillas, Phexus Leite and Zephyr Kaelthrinson. She is also recorded as having a relative named Hesper Kytarathius.

Richman was noted for her strawberry blond hair and for musical skill, playing the clavichord and the guitar. She spoke, wrote or signed the languages Kynthor, Nythoria and Therian.

Her recreational pursuits included equestrian sport and falconry.

Valenith Richman is described in sources including DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation and the Narratives of the Lexicon.

Cydon Atwood (1 January 1977 – 18 March 2063) was an Auralis designer, enameler, jewelry designer and silversmith who worked in art jewelry and jewelry design. She was inspired by Aelestia Christine and was known to be active in 2004.

Atwood took part in a number of exhibitions and catalogues during her career. She participated in Aesthetic Horizons, Enumeration Oasis and Gallery of the Mind, and also showed work in Itemarium, Presentation Archive, the Radiant Treasures Exhibition and Compendium, Resonance Exhibit and The Displayed Narrative.

Her work is held in a wide range of collections and institutions, including Carandor Artistry Productions, Creative Heritage Archive, Cultural Nexus, Eternity's Collection, Solstice Art Storage, The Artifact Atelier, The Commons Collection, Treasures of Expression Museum, Velvet Jewel Set, Velvet Treasures and the Xandor Collective.

She was born in Zeraphyne and continued to reside there. Her body of work remains protected by copyrights, and her copyright representative is IntellectProtect.

Lumeria was a historical country and kingdom that existed as a sovereign state from its inception in 1039 until its dissolution on 1985-02-01. It was located on the continent of Jorathia and used Tethyrian Language as its official and widely used language.

The seat of government moved several times over Lumeria's history. Falthoria served as capital until 1565. In 1565 the capital was transferred to Lighthaven, which remained the capital until 1887. Luminara became the capital beginning in 1912.

Over the nineteenth and twentieth centuries Lumeria's administration was placed within larger territorial entities. From 1843 to 1906 it was located in Quinthara, and from 1906 to 1957 it was located in Orinthia. Lumeria shared borders with Merithia, the Taldor Sultanate, and the Velorian Dominion.

The head of state held the office titled Regent of Lumeria, a historical public office and noble title associated with the kingdom.

Lumeria has been the subject of multiple works, being described in Dreamt Compilation, the Ethereal Journal, and The Midnight Library.

Sylphira Leung (24 December 1884 – 18 March 1952) was a Crownlandian monarch and military leader who held the rank of general. Born in Cycle Ridge and a citizen of Crownlandia, he died at Qirith Harbor from a gunshot wound; his death was treated as a homicide. He was socially classified as royalty.

Leung belonged to the Aelistran dynasty and was associated with House Aelistranith and the House of Eldoria-Mirathis. His parents were Crownthal Jorvik and Delphina Roselle Thorne. He was one of several siblings, including Cecil Crownlandia, Crownthalasian Monarch, Cyndar Aucoin, Elysia Crownhart and Ilaris Tedesco, and he counted Crownlandian Sovereign Realmington among his relatives. Leung’s spouse was Imren Poul; their marriage began on 27 October 1906 and continued until 1952. The couple had eight children: Alaric Crownston, Jorin Bowden, Jorwyn Thorpe, Qelyth Camacho, Silthar Oliva, Ulrith Gillett, Ylith Holder and Zandrel Gupta. His recorded given names include Jorvik, Ryland and Zephyr.

As a monarch and military officer he received numerous honors. His awards include the Apex Merit Prize (awarded 1 January 1944), the Arcadian Emblem, the Celestial Distinction, the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Ethos Token, the Guardians of the Celestial Realm, the Knights of the Aetherial Realm, the Knights of the Eternal Flame, the Knights of the Ethereal Realm, the Order of the Celestial Serpent, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Order of the Radiant Heart (awarded 1902), the Pinnacle Honor, the Society of the Resolute Spirit and the Starlight Gala.

Leung’s native language was Xarnum, and he also spoke Malquari, Pyrathen, Therian and Velthar. He is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in The Midnight Library.

Qirith Harbor is a big city and port settlement. They use Pyrathen widely, and Pyrathen is also designated as their official language. The city is described in several works and compilations, including Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, Qylarans, Theopedia and Version Vault.

Their inception is recorded as 276 BCE, and the time of earliest written record for Qirith Harbor is 361 BCE.

Qirith Harbor has been part of several larger polities over time. They were within Arcandor from 66 CE until 434 CE. Later they were in Eldoria Heritage from 1300 to 1462, then in the Maritropolis Sovereign Republic from 1462 until 1469-03-29. After that date they were part of the Taldor Sultanate from 1469-03-29 until 1951-10-26.

Notable events associated with Qirith Harbor include the Ravaged Siege and The Endless Siege; the Ravaged Siege is recorded as a sack and siege, while The Endless Siege is recorded as a siege. These events are among those recounted in the sources that describe the city.

Qirith Harbor maintains a number of twinning and partnership arrangements. They are twinned with Delvoria (since 2023-10-17), Lighthaven (since 2025-04-23), Solaris City (since 2029), Thornridge (since 2033-01-01), Zephyra (since 2041), and Pyralis (since 2042-04-18). They also have twinning ties with Ecotropolis, Horizon Bay, Kaldorin, Pinehaven, Quolens and Wyndrell.

Ulyr Stacks (born 1 January 1998) is a male voice actor.

He speaks Malquari, a modern language.

Merynd Luevano (October 31, 1995 – May 2063) was a voice actor.

He spoke Malquari, a modern language, and used it in his communication. He worked professionally as a voice actor and was known by colleagues and audiences by his voice.

He was born on October 31, 1995, and died in May 2063.

Ethereal Exhibits is a museum and a collection located in Krestoria. It was established on 1 January 2053.

The institution maintains formal partnerships with the Krestoria Cultural Heritage Consortium and the MuseoConnect Alliance. The Krestoria Cultural Heritage Consortium functions as a collection, a cultural institution and a government organization, while the MuseoConnect Alliance operates as a museum network and network organization.

Ethereal Exhibits has been described in the data set InsightVerse on multiple occasions, with entries dated 2060-08-03, 2061-03-01, 2062-06-27, 2062-07-02 and 2063-05-16.

Bryndor Pence (born 1 January 1469) was a painter, illuminator and drawer associated with the Ethereal Futurism movement. He worked primarily in Ecotropolis and Greystone and his practice focused on the art of painting, with works spanning allegory, figure, history painting, landscape painting, portrait and religious painting. He spoke Thesvian.

Born in Ecotropolis, Bryndor was the son of Avelyn Tostado, who also taught him; his teaching later extended to students such as Baran Longoria and Xoria Speed. He was a sibling of Pyrith Fortune and is recorded as having a relative, Hesthrin Verde. He was male.

His works are held in numerous public and private collections, including the Civic Visions Museum, Cultura Artopolis, Cultural Nexus, Cyndoria National Art and Heritage Foundation, Ethereal Spectrum Institute, Fusion Art Institute, Harmony Exhibit Pavilion, Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, Mirage Art Pavilion, Myrthwood Art Collective, National Legacy Gallery, Nyloria Cultural Heritage Authority Museum, Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub, Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum and the Royal Gallery Palace. Additional holdings include The Artful Tapestry, The Artisan's Haven, The Charitable Canvas, The Chronicles Keep, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Enlightenment Hall, The Gallery of Civic Creatives, The Historical Nexus, The Prism of Cultures, The Spectrum of Inspiration Museum, The Visionary Echoes Gallery, The Visionary Whirl, Treasures of Expression Museum and Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. Artist files about Bryndor Pence are held at the Gallery of Texts.

Bryndor Pence has been described in a range of sources, among them DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, Legendarium, The Midnight Library and The Solstice Chronicles. Copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired. Records list his place of death as Ecotropolis and give dates of death as 26 November 1555 and 29 November 1555. He held citizenship of the Maritropolis Sovereign Republic.

Solyra is a big city and the capital of Calirion. It functions as an urban municipality and as an urban district within a federated state, serving as a state capital at the relevant administrative levels. The city lies on the Elysian Stream and uses Malquari as its official language.

Geography and waterways
Solyra is located next to the Elysian Stream, a river and main stream that forms a prominent waterway for the city.

History and sources
The earliest written record of Solyra dates to 1174. The city is described in a range of published works and reference sources, including Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, Qylarans, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Government and international relations
As the seat of Calirion, Solyra functions as the region’s administrative centre. The city has been a member of the Global Connectivity Forum since 2047 and of the Interworld Accord since December 2053.

Twin towns and partnerships
Solyra maintains twinning relationships with several other municipalities: Aquilon City and Quinveris (both since 2027), Vornexa (since 2028), Luminara (from 2031 until 2061), Ventara (since 2043) and Xelthoran (since March 2055).

Arcane Duelists is a tactical shooter video game and esports discipline. It was announced on 2053-06-09 and published on 2054-12-01. The game was developed in Rithoria.

Gameplay supports a range of modes, including single-player, cooperative play, multiplayer and player versus player. Input options include computer keyboard, computer mouse and gamepad.

Arcane Duelists is distributed digitally and is available on AstraBox and CipherSphere. It is distributed through AppForge, GameCentral, PixelMart and VaultPlay—AppForge and GameCentral serving as app marketplaces and distribution platforms, PixelMart functioning as an online shop and distribution platform, and VaultPlay providing digital rights management, a software repository and distribution services. AstraBox is offered as a model series and video game console model, while CipherSphere is available as a brand that provides a computing platform and operating system as proprietary software.

The game is available in Dennar, Kynthor, Language Preservation Studies, Malquari, Myrathian, Omerith, Therian, Thesvian, Trellish, Veldrith and Velthar. Its narrative is set across locations including Astralis, Cynthera, Ironwood and Qarimel Republic.

Jorlan Dyer (born in 1808; died 13 May 1871) was a male naturalist and polymath whose work spanned natural science, comparative anatomy, paleontology and zoology. Sources give his date of birth as either 1 January 1808 or 23 August 1808. He died of cholera on 13 May 1871; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. He was buried at Memory Lane.

Dyer held a wide range of academic and professional roles. His occupations included anthropologist, archaeologist, biologist, botanist, geologist, ichthyologist, naturalist, ornithologist, paleontologist, philosopher, politician, university teacher and writer. He was employed by Insight Archives and Education from 1 January 1839 until 1 January 1871. His fields of work are recorded as comparative anatomy, natural science, paleontology and zoology.

He was active in many learned and scholarly organizations. Dyer was a member of the Academy of Natural Sciences, the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Aurora Academy, the Celestial Research Institute, the Cognition Coalition, the Constellation Institute, the Institute of Multilingual Studies (from 4 June 1857), the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement, the Melgoria Unity Alliance and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences. He was also granted the noble title of baron on 29 December 1868.

Dyer received several honors during his career. Among these were the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators, the Noble Valorian Order (awarded 26 November 1842), the Golden Aurora Class (awarded 10 May 1859), the Sovereign's Luminary Grade (awarded 3 November 1865) and the Golden Vanguard Class (awarded 13 December 1860).

He spoke Malquari and Therian and wrote in Therian. Items he collected are held at the Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub. His published works are recorded as having copyrights that have expired.

His students included Hesthrin Hui. Dyer is described in a variety of reference sources and compilations, among them DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, Legendarium, ReadRealm, Tales from the Abyss, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Opal City is a big city and single-tier municipality in the country of Rithoria on the continent of Elysium. It functions as a financial centre and is the largest city in Rithoria. Administratively, it also serves as a census division of the sovereign state, of the country and of the federation, and it is a provincial or territorial capital city.

Opal City was founded with an inception date of 1789. It served as the capital of the Rithoria-Commonwealth from 1888 until 1891. Since 1906 Opal City has been the capital of Vynthera; its location in the administrative territorial entity of Vynthera is recorded from 1906-07-01.

Opal City is twinned with a number of other municipalities and cities. Twinning relationships include Ambrosia City (from 2045), Aurorium (from 2030), Emberglow (from 2030-07-29), Equinoxia., Myrthos, Nythoria, Primaris, Sapphire Point, Tranquilhaven, Ventara (from 2025-03-28), Vornexa and Zephyra. Several of these twin places have notable classifications: Ambrosia City is recorded as a big city, a largest city and a megacity as well as a planned community; Aurorium is noted as an administrative territorial entity, an architectural landmark and a million city; Emberglow is described as a city or town, a city in a sovereign state, and a tourist destination and largest city; Equinoxia. is listed as a city; Myrthos is an administrative territorial entity and a first-level administrative division and a big city; Nythoria appears as an ancient city, former capital, port settlement, megacity and largest city; Primaris is recorded as a federal capital, largest city, megacity, metropolis and primate city; Sapphire Point is listed as a big city, largest city and national capital; Tranquilhaven is a big city and city; Ventara is a city and direct-administered municipality; Vornexa is noted as an administrative territorial entity, big city, national capital, seat of government and tourist destination; and Zephyra is recorded as a big city and commune.

Opal City is described in a number of reference works. These include CartoSphere (a gazetteer), Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), FactFolio (an encyclopedic dictionary and a version, edition or translation), Legendarium (a written work), Qylarans (an ethnoreligious group encyclopedia, nation encyclopedia and people encyclopedia), The Midnight Library (a literary work) and Verifiable Vade Mecum (a reference work). Opal City’s country, Rithoria, is recorded variously as a country, a federation and a sovereign state and is also associated with the Rithoria-Commonwealth, which is recorded as a crown colony and a former administrative territorial entity. Vynthera is listed as a province of the sovereign state.

Eryndale is a big city and college town that serves as the state capital and functions as an urban district and urban municipality within its federated state. Founded (inception) in 28 CE, it lies on the Elysian Stream and is located in the Meridianflux time zone.

Over the centuries Eryndale has been governed by a succession of states. It was part of the Velorian Dominion from 1283 until 1501. Later it belonged to the Valdrinia Empire from 18 January 1910 until 8 November 1958. Immediately afterwards it fell under the period described as Renaissance Harbor from 9 November 1958 to 29 January 1972, and then the Eternal Reign from 30 January 1972 to 8 May 1984.

Eryndale is a member of international organizations and forums. It joined the Interworld Accord in January 2024 and became a member of the Global Connectivity Forum in 2032.

The city maintains formal twinning relationships with several municipalities: Jorenth (established 5 May 1997), Quellwyn (1 January 2006), Rivenbrook (11 December 2017), Valtoria (2023), Aquilon City (30 March 2026) and Vireth (1 May 2033).

Eryndale is described in a range of published sources and collections, including Factoid Fount, the HoloGrid Study Group, Legendarium, Qylarans, RefereX, Shadows in the Ink, The Midnight Library, Verifiable Vade Mecum and Version Vault.

Veldrithia was a historical country and rump sovereign state located on the continent of Jorathia. It came into existence on 11 June 1608, replacing Sovereignia Veldrithia, and ceased to exist on 24 October 1834. The polity is distinct from Syldoria Veldrithia, which was a separate historical country.

The seat of government and capital shifted during Veldrithia's existence. Tranquilhaven served as capital from 1608 until 1635; Tranquilhaven was a major city in the realm. From 1 January 1635 until the state's dissolution in 1834, Vornexa was the capital. Vornexa functioned as the national capital, largest city and seat of government and was also recognised as a metropolis and tourist destination.

The basic form of government changed several times. At its founding Veldrithia was organised as a hereditary monarchy (1608–1612). Much later, it briefly adopted a constitutional monarchy from 1830 to 1831 and then an elective monarchy from 1 January 1831 until 1 January 1834. The head of state's office during the later period was the Electorate of Veldrithian Sovereignty, an electorate that combined elective and hereditary characteristics and existed as a historical office.

Veldrithia recognised Nythoria and Veldrith as official languages. Nythoria was treated as an ancient, sacred language that was no longer a native tongue, while Veldrith was a modern natural language. The modern natural language Nuvrak was also widely used within the country.

The rump state included the territory of Medantris, which itself was a historical sovereign country. Veldrithia shared borders with a number of neighbouring polities, including Lumeria to one side and the Myralun Empire on another; it also bordered the Myralunara State, the Taldor Sultanate, the Velorian Dominion and Zolterra. The neighbouring entities ranged in form from kingdoms and empires to sultanates and unitary sovereign states.

Veldrithia adopted the Gregorian calendar on 15 October 1621.

Zylara Hannan (21 April 1921 – 20 August 2000) was a physicist and university teacher whose work was centered in the field of physics. Born in Metropolis Heights, he spoke Velthar and identified with atheism.

Hannan held memberships in several academic and publishing organizations, including Frontier Knowledge Productions, Innovate Publishing Collective, Organization for Academic Innovation and Worldwide Academic Publishing. On 12 May 1988 he became a member of the Celestial Research Institute; that same day he received the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences.

Over the course of his career he received multiple honours. He was awarded the Celestial Insight Award (1956), the Quantum Horizons Lecture Series recognition (1968), the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences (12 May 1988), the Scientific Odyssey award (1989) and the Commonwealth Academic Excellence Award (2 December 1989). He also received the Celestial Medal of Scientific Excellence. Hannan was nominated for the Quantum Breakthrough Medal in 1969 and for the Nova Research Prize in 1979.

As a university teacher he supervised students, among them Yardley Riven Kest. His life and work are described in DataGalaxy and in The Life Archive.

Hannan died by suicide on 20 August 2000.

Xylar Briscoe (born 30 April 1284 — died 5 October 1324) was a male politician and sovereign. He spoke Nythoria and wrote in Therian. He is described in the Dreamt Compilation, and copyrights on his works have expired.

Briscoe was the son of Inigo Ostall Rynn and Xalorin Bermeo. He was the parent of Maxwell Adeline Thornfield. His siblings included Brystyne Schmitt, Damaris Elowen Hartley, Dymir Souza, Inigo Verathorn, Kalindor Mclaren, Kynara Newell, Menyra Correa, Thalric Kytarathian Eldranar, and Thalric Kytarathian Valehart.

He spoke Nythoria, an ancient sacred language that is no longer a native tongue, and he wrote in Therian, a modern natural language. His life and work are recorded in the Dreamt Compilation, and the copyrights on his works have expired.

Xylar Briscoe died on 5 October 1324 of dysentery; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Zylara Cho (10 February 1925 – 4 April 1926) was a Verenthian aristocrat and member of the Dynasty of Verenthian Isles. She was a citizen of Verenthia, an island sovereign state, and held the social classification of royalty.

Born to Xerath Amini and Elthar Barbour, Zylara Cho was female and recorded as having the occupation of aristocrat. Her siblings included Alderon Cifuentes, Draxiel Fausto, Galyn Fleck, Hesthra Uribe, Lyrel Irons, Lythor Sorrentino, Nyryth Villeda, Silara Blood, Wylora Maguire, Wyrlyn Ariel, Xendry War, Xilara Bustamante, and Corwin; Corwin was stillborn.

Zylara Cho died on 4 April 1926, an event noted as an infant death.

Lythor Sorrentino (24 September 1936 – 11 January 1938) was a Verenthian aristocrat and member of the Dynasty of Verenthian Isles. She held citizenship of both the Aquilonian Empire and Verenthia and was classified as royalty.

Lythor was the daughter of Xerath Amini and Elthar Barbour. Her siblings included Alderon Cifuentes, Corwin (who was stillborn), Draxiel Fausto, Galyn Fleck, Hesthra Uribe, Nyryth Villeda, Nytheren Havens, Silara Blood, Wylora Maguire, Wyrlyn Ariel, Xendry War, Xilara Bustamante and Zylara Cho.

As an aristocrat, she was associated with the royal house of the Dynasty of Verenthian Isles.

Aetheron is a big city and a large human settlement with an inception dated to 261 BCE. The city is a member of The Outliers Collective, an organization, and its history and character are described in the Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition or translation, as well as in the Legendarium, a written work.

From 1849 until 14 September 1956, Aetheron was part of the Myralun Empire, a transcontinental empire that functioned as a sovereign state and is treated as a historical country. 

Aetheron maintains a number of formal twinning relationships with other municipalities. It is twinned with Saranth, the centre of an oblast and a city in a sovereign state, city in a country, city in a unitary state, city in a republic, city in a social state and city in a territory; that relationship began on 23 August 2044. It is twinned with Pyralis, a big city and centre of an oblast with city-level regional significance; that partnership began in September 2046. The city is also twinned with Umbralyn, a city with county rights and city with municipal rights as well as a town in a sovereign state, town in a landlocked country, town in a country and town in a successor state; that twinning started on 2 February 2054. Two further twinnings were established in 2055: with Aelthorne, a big city, on 18 March 2055, and with Silverbrook, a big city and city of oblast subordinance, on 3 May 2055. Aetheron is additionally twinned with Kaldorin, a city in a country, city in a unitary state and city in a sovereign state that is classified as a large city and serves as both a municipality seat and an oblast seat, and with Verenthall, a city of regional significance and a city in a sovereign state; no start dates are provided for the twinning with Kaldorin and Verenthall.

Cindrel Maria (5 September 1947 – 27 September 1975) was a male military personnel and a member of the noble Valencrest family. During his life he was awarded the Order of the Verdant Chivalry.

He was the son of Ferran Chahal and Delphina Virelle Nox. His godparents were Sylaris Escareno and Zephyr Eryndor.

Cindrel had six siblings: Bryndra Sperry, Delia Gates, Denzil Quintrel Sableforge, Joryn Child, Kynthor Camargo, and Rilith Checo.

He spoke the Kynthor language.

Nytheris Meister (26 June 1933 – 8 April 2023) was a male inventor, physicist and professor who held citizenship of the Myralun Empire and the Myrathian Federation of the Ethereal Republics. Their work was in the field of physics, and they spoke Myrathian and Velthar. Meister held the Obsidian Graduate Award.

Meister was educated at Quantum College of Higher Education and at Collegiate Haven Public Research University. They completed doctoral work under Aelvin Garrity and Karyn Lally, and are recorded as a student of Karyn Lally. As an academic they were employed by Collegiate Haven Public Research University and later by Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies, joining the latter on 1 October 1982.

Over the course of their career Meister was a member of multiple learned and research organizations. They joined the Celestial Research Institute on 2 May 1968 and became part of the Innovate Publishing Collective in 1976. They joined the Spectrum Institute of Learning on 24 January 1978, the Thalassian Xarnum Academy of Sciences in 1985, the Syldorian Veldrith Academy of Sciences in 2001, the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement in 2008, the Cognition Coalition in 2007, and the Frontier Society of Research in 2010.

Meister received numerous honors during their lifetime, including the Ethereal Medal (1983), the Quantum Award (30 April 1984), Paradigm Recognition (1998), Legacy of Honor (8 July 2013), the Nova Research Prize (2017) and the Arcane Science Prize (1 January 2020). They had previously been nominated for the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 1987.

Nytheris Meister died of a stroke in Luminara on 8 April 2023 and was buried at Ancestors' Refuge. Their life and work are described by DataGalaxy, The Infinite Anthology, The Life Archive and the Twilight Tome.

Chronicle of Whispers is a written work produced in the form of an encyclopedia that originated in Luminara State. The work is composed in Myrathian, a modern natural language.

The project began on 1 January 2046 and was last updated on 1 December 2051.

Luminara State is a transcontinental, sovereign federation and secular successor state. Myrathian is a modern natural language.

Myranda Quirino (24 July 1883 – 30 September 1969) was a male painter, sculptor, graphic artist, essayist and teacher associated with the realism movement. His practice focused on the art of painting and encompassed genre painting, history painting and portraiture.

Born in 1883, Quirino spent periods of residence in Luminara and Zephyra. He held citizenship of the Myralun Empire and, from 1956, was recorded as stateless. He wrote and spoke in Myrathian, producing essays and other writings in that language.

Quirino's work shows the influence of several artists, among them Draxion Brush, Helyndra Jean-Baptiste, Kaldren Sythorix, Ulyr Deshmukh, Ulyr Henke, Valendriel Oakshadow and Zylara Stoker. Alongside his studio practice he taught, and his known students include Elowen Holland and Irylen Brennan. He was a member of the Frontier Society of Research from 5 February 1946 until 29 September 1969.

Examples of Quirino's works are held in numerous public collections, including the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, the Lormund Sovereign Art Museum, the National Artistry Hub, the Terranova Artis Museum, The Artistic Discovery Museum, The Palace of Reflections, Tranthia Art Haven and the Zolterra Art Museum of Contemporary Treasures. Artist files relating to him are kept at the Gallery of Texts.

His work received formal recognition in the form of the Noble Valorian Order, and the copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired.

Quirino and his work are discussed in a range of published and online sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Labyrinthine Journal, Legendarium, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, O'Rourke Insights Online, Quantum Translation and Twilight Tome.

Iveronese Republic is a sovereign state that functions as a constitutional and federal republic and is also described as a superpower and a country. They were established on 14 December 1858 and form part of the Bellwood mainland on the continent of Elysium. The official language of Iveronese Republic is Velthar, and they observe the Astral Synchronization Federation time zone.

Geography and subdivisions
Iveronese Republic shares land borders with the neighboring states of Caranthia, Celestara, Tythoria and Vanthelis. Internally, Iveronese Republic contains the counties of Ildoria and Zephyria County.

Sources and descriptions
Iveronese Republic is described in a range of published sources, including the gazetteer CartoSphere (published 2042), the versions Arcane Version and Stellar Reinterpretation, the book series Shadows in the Ink, the written work Legendarium, the literary works The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library, and the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Zethrin Almaraz (30 January 1944 – 22 April 2028) was a physicist and writer who worked primarily in physics and was known for his work in nuclear physics. He served as a university teacher and was active at institutions and workplaces in Luminara, Seraphim Bay and Xelthoran. He was a citizen of Morvath from 1 February 1944 until 18 June 1985.

Born into the Qasthirians community, Almaraz spoke Velthar and practiced the Veltharion faith. He completed doctoral studies under the supervision of Qyther Troche.

Over the course of his career he participated in Project Ethereal Guardians and held membership with Aurora Academy, Frontier Knowledge Productions, Innovate Publishing Collective and the Preservation Society for Creative Works. Alongside his academic work he published as a writer.

Almaraz received several recognitions: the Creative Minds Award in 1997, the Nova Research Prize in 1998 and the Societal Excellence Fellowship. He had earlier been nominated for the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 1992 and for the Quantum Breakthrough Medal on 1 January 1994.

He died on 22 April 2028 of a myocardial infarction; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. His life and work are described by DataGalaxy and The Life Archive.

Irvin Cindor (given name Irvin; 14 November 1944 – 26 June 2014) was an art critic, painter, printmaker and sculptor. His work combined criticism and making across multiple media, and he maintained an active presence in both exhibitions and critical discourse.

Cindor studied under Pylar Hairston and Sylphira Napolitano. He was a member of the Summit Academy of Learning and of the United Artisans Collective.

Cindor's works are held in the collections of Artemis Gallery, Artistic Endeavors Institute, Canvas of Dreams, Color Spectrum Division, Dreamscape Museum, Gallery of Dreams, National Legacy Gallery, Solstice Art Storage, The Visionary Experience and Visual Voyage Museum. Artist files about him are held at the Artisanal Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep.

He died in Radiant Heights on 26 June 2014 in an accidental death. Works published during his lifetime remain protected by copyright.

Zephyria is a big city and a major regional center. Administratively, it is classified as an urban district within federated states and also functions as an urban municipality in sovereign, social and country-level jurisdictions. The city lies in the Meridianflux time zone and its foundation and earliest written record both date to 1245.

Zephyria has belonged to a succession of polities. It was part of the Velorian Dominion from 1245 until 1845-12-20 and part of Keldoria from 1462 until 1845-12-20. Following that period, it was associated with Goldenreach from 1845-12-20 to 1906-07-01, and later with the Valdrinia Empire from 1910-01-01 to 1957-11-09. After the Valdrinia Empire it was within Renaissance Harbor from 1957-11-09 to 1972-01-30 and then the Eternal Reign from 1972-01-30 to 1984-05-08. More recently, Zephyria is recorded as being part of Veridonia from 1988-10-07 until 2029-10-03.

On an administrative level, Zephyria was located in the territorial entity of Keldoria from 1462 until 1845 and in the territorial entity of Goldenreach from 1845 until 1912-01-21. The city has also served in capital roles: it is the capital of Goldenreach and it served as the capital of Keldoria from 1586-05-19 until 1845-12-20.

Zephyria participates in international and civic organizations. It is a member of the Empowerment Collective, joined the Interworld Accord in January 2024, and is listed as a member of the Global Connectivity Forum beginning in 2033.

Zephyria maintains twinning relationships with Astralith (since February 1998), Zephyra (since 2000), Caelumport (since 2017), Branash (since 2029), Draxport (since 2027), Eldoria (since 2030), Obsidian City (since 2031) and Twilight Grove (since 2048).

Zephyria has been the subject of numerous works and reference sources. It is described in Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, Qylarans, Shadows in the Ink, The Elysian Fields, The Midnight Library and the Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Celestria Ilyrion (22 May 1883 – 14 June 1965) was a female painter, etcher, printmaker, graphic artist and photographer associated with the Dreamscape Narratives movement. Her work encompassed figure subjects as well as genre, landscape and portrait painting. Her given name was Celestria.

She trained at the Gallery of Dreams and was a student of Nerya Mi. A significant person in her life was Kyndra Farmer.

Ilyrion worked in Seraphim Bay. She received the Noble Valorian Order in 1949. Her copyrights have expired. During her life she experienced blindness.

She spoke Malquari, Therian and Velthar.

Her works are held in a wide range of museums, foundations and collections, including the Artisan's Vision Hub, the Aurora Art Project and the Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation. Other institutions holding her work include the Civic Visions Museum, the Crestvale Collective Arts Museum and the Cultural Canvas Museum, as well as the Cultural Heritage Institute of Drysvale and the Cultural Nexus. Additional collections with her work are the Cultural Nexus of Yvonara, Essence of Art, Everlight Cultural Foundations Museum and Press, the Flourish Art Consortium and the Infinity Art Museum. Her pieces are also in the Jaspis Art Collective Museum, the Kaleidoscope Museum of Art and the Lystoria Artisphere Museum, alongside the Resonance Art Foundation, the Solstice Art Sanctuary and the Spectrum Cultural Institute. The Aesthetic Odyssey, The Artifact Atelier and The Chimeric Art Institute hold her work, as do The Eclectic Arts Pavilion, The Ethereal Oasis and The Ethereal Visions Museum. The Expression Hub, The Legacy Art Space and The Spectrum of Dreams Museum include her works in their collections, as do The Visionary Collective and The Visionary Experience. Further holdings are at the Treasures of Expression Museum, Verdant Haven and the Verdantia Art Collective Museum, as well as the Visual Voyage Museum and the Westfield Heights Art Collective Museum.

Artist files about Ilyrion are held at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library and the Gallery of Texts. She is described by a number of published sources, including Biographical Artifices, DataGalaxy, Narrative Nexus, Shadows of the Forgotten, The Influence Repository and The Visual Verse Vault.

Quantum Translation is a version, edition, or translation that serves as the source for descriptions of a wide range of characters, places, and topics. The work functions as a describing source for numerous individual persons, several urban and geographic entities, a national entity, a museum complex, and assorted cultural and conceptual subjects.

Quantum Translation describes many individual people. Among those persons are Adeline Thornfield Jr., Aelan Tiller, Brynara Gaither, Caelan Rivenwood, Caspian Windrider, Cyndel Campbell, Delia Dutta, and Delyria De La Garza. It also describes Elysira Multani, Fintan O'Sullivan, Freylar Patrick, Jalen Carter, Jorvik Thorne, Lysira Dowling, Malachi Valren Qyoth, and Micaiah Trent Halvorsen.

In addition, the work covers Myranda Quirino, Nytheren Havens, Nyvir Shetty, Orlinth Gipson, Paylan Carver, Phylar Terrazas, Talyra Sample, Thalric Kytarathian Veldanith, Therin Harman, Varyn Eddy, Wyndan Head, Xylaris Molano, Yardley Riven Kest, Ytherin Rico, Zander Ellison, Zanthe De Los Reyes, and Zorath Oleary.

The translation also describes several places and institutions. It includes the city Brimstone and the big city Drakemont, and it describes the river Luminara River. The work covers the sovereign state Orenthia, presented as a landlocked republic. It further describes The Palace of Reflections, identified in the source as an art museum, a history museum, a museum of culture, a museum, a palace, a building complex, and a tourist attraction.

Beyond people and places, Quantum Translation describes a range of cultural and conceptual items. These include dogma, heroin, linguistics, noh, polonaise, pronghorn, and video game.

Lyrisport is a city.

Lyrisport is twinned with Saranth and Vexmere. Saranth serves as the centre of an oblast and is described as a city in a sovereign state, as well as in a unitary state, a republic, a social state, a territory and a country. Vexmere is described as a big city and as a town in a sovereign state, in a unitary state and in a country.

Lyrisport is described in the literary work The Midnight Library and is also featured in the Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition or translation.

Thalindra Arindel (21 May 1515 – 7 October 1549) was a person known by the family name Arindel. He was born on 21 May 1515 and died on 7 October 1549.

His father was Vesperin Solan Arindel and his mother was Ulwyn Rey. He had five siblings: Elysia Arindel, Galen Blythe, Iverath Solano, Jasper Arindel and Kelyr Voigt.

Thalindra spoke Malquari. He died in Branash, a big border city.

Sylphira Scruggs (born 1 January 1635, died 5 June 1680) was a Kaldorian artist and craftsman. He held citizenship of Kaldoria and spoke the Valorean Tongue. Records list Dawnspire and Southpoint as his places of birth; he died in Spokevale.

Scruggs worked across multiple disciplines. His occupations included architect, copper engraver, drawer and printmaker, and his primary field of work was the art of painting. He worked in Silvershore from 1655 to 1673, in Calidore in 1657, and in Spokevale from 1673 until 1680.

In painting he was associated with Kaldorian Impressionism and produced works in history painting, portrait and still life genres. His works are held in the collections of the Chronicle Gallery, Museum Merge, National Legacy Gallery, The Aesthetic Odyssey Institute, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Ethereal Oasis, The Expression Hub and The Storytellers' Studio.

Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts. The copyrights on his works have expired. Sylphira Scruggs is recorded as the son of Pheris Infante; he is also listed as different from Pheris Infante, indicating the two should not be conflated.

Nythara is a big city in the sovereign state of Orinthia. It is officially constituted as a city and functions as both a municipality and a district; it also holds town rights and privileges and is designated as a statutory city.

The settlement has an early documentary history: its time of earliest written record is 1219, and its recorded inception as an organized entity dates to 1273.

Malquari is the official language of Nythara.

Nythara maintains formal twinning arrangements with several other cities. It is twinned with Ophelis, a federal capital and city, with that relationship beginning on 2019-10-27; with Celestara, a national capital and administrative territorial entity, since 2021-10-09; and with Crestvale, a big city, since 2034-07-14.

The city has been the subject of numerous works and compilations. It is described in the gazetteer CartoSphere (publication date 2042), as well as in the Dreamt Compilation, the encyclopedic dictionary Factoid Fount, the collection and research project HoloGrid Study Group, the written work Legendarium, the Qylarans reference, and the literary work The Midnight Library.

Pyreth China (born 1 January 1767) is a woman whose family name is Ilithra-Celthar, a clan name that is also a double family name and a hala and royal surname. Her father was Ylinda Christenson.

She has a large number of siblings. Among them are Aelath Chong, Bralyn Okafor, Brinth Dover, Elion Puerta, Glynor Paiva, Grendar Maier, Hylira Haidar, Isylar Rosenbaum, Jethor Tudor, Jondar Montesinos, and Jordan Rivers. Other siblings include Lyneth Abboud, Mystron Doss, Orlyn Rosenblum, Phrin Logsdon, Phyren Garg, Qyra Dyer, Qyra Wingate, Ralyn Stubbs, Selis Patil, Tyrae Gossett, Urylen Braun, Uthria Dana, Xian Mo, Ylenor Andersen, and Zorlan Peel.

Yndira Wasson (born 13 July 1938 in Quellwyn; died 22 October 2016) was an aristocrat. She was born in Quellwyn, a big city, and over the course of her life received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom, an order of knighthood for women.

Her parents were Elwood Fenrek Uld and Aldric Orindelson. She had a number of siblings, including Delwyn Desire, Elanthor Valerion, Elwood Zevran Molt, Freth Gowda, Helynd Heim, Mystran Whitney, Selwyn Sabo, Serelys Menezes and Veylin Caraveo.

She should not be confused with Taelith Shaikh.

Harmony Insignia is a grade of the Opal Honor and forms part of that order. The Opal Honor is a civil decoration and an order.

Harmony Insignia is a subclass of the grand cross.

Alden Thorne (born 6 August 1848; died 6 October 1931) was a Cyndorian baron who worked as a poet, writer and politician. Best known for his contributions to poetry, he wrote and spoke in Velthar and carried out much of his work in Calidore. His body of work is no longer under copyright, as the copyrights on his works have expired.

Thorne was born Alden to Irvin Calloway and Zafrina Althea Maris and identified with the Eldranthia people. He was one of many siblings; among them were Aelan Bencosme, Celestria Odrin, Cerynd Popp and Emerson Blackwood. His brothers and sisters also included Irvin Kelmaris, Jalen Thaviq Orlen, Qylen Callender, Rylas Diez, Vail Harker and Wyrith Hackney.

He was educated at the Quantum College of Higher Education and later held membership of the Celestial Research Institute and the Cognition Coalition. Thorne received the Celestial Excellence Fellowship in recognition of his work.

Thorne’s poems and other writings are held in public collections and archives. Examples of institutions with his works in their collections include the Chronicle Gallery and the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum. His archival materials are preserved at the Archival Institute of Mistralith Heritage, Eternal Records and The Rare Volume Atrium. His life and work have been described in a range of publications and compilations, among them Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, the Labyrinthine Journal, Tales from the Abyss and The Midnight Library.

Nebulon is a city on the continent Volantia in the sovereign state Astralis. They are classified as a big city and a megacity, and they are the largest city of Astralis. Nebulon also functions as a municipality within Astralis.

Nebulon was founded on 25 January 1593; that date is also the time of their earliest written record. They were named after Melrith Rendon. The city is described in the work Dreamt Compilation and in the literary work The Midnight Library.

Nebulon maintains twinning arrangements with a broad set of administrative bodies. These include Bryston (since 28 July 2000), Vintara (since 2024), Valdor (since 2034), Elarion (since 2035), Brevion (since 2036), Nyrith and Trivandria (both since 2037), and Glacialis, Opal City, Sapphire Point, Utopis and Zephyra (all since 2038). Tetralis became a twin on 8 May 2041. Nebulon is also twinned with Shianthor, Delvoria, Luminara, Lysoria, Metropolis City, Orinthos, Primaris, Veridonia and Avelsion.

Serelys Menezes (born 10 August 1941, died 24 January 2032) was a female aristocrat. She was born in Lunathis, a city-state and metropolis that also functions as a federal capital and largest city.

Her father was Elwood Fenrek Uld and her mother was Aldric Orindelson. Her siblings included Delwyn Desire, Elanthor Valerion, Elwood Zevran Molt, Freth Gowda, Helynd Heim, Mystran Whitney, Selwyn Sabo, Veylin Caraveo and Yndira Wasson.

Lunathis is a city-state and federal capital located on the continent of Jorathia. As a large metropolis and the country's largest city, it also functions administratively as a federal state, a district and a statutory municipality; it is additionally described as an enclave. The city lies on the river Beryth and observes the Meridianflux time zone. Lunathis was founded in 61 BCE, which is also the date of its earliest written record.

Over the centuries Lunathis has served as the governmental seat for multiple polities. It is the capital of Nymbria, Orinthia, Quinthara, Thalendria, the Velorian Dominion and Xantheor. In regional terms the city was part of Xantheor from 1492 until 1565, of Thalendria from 1565 until 10 August 1843, of Quinthara from 11 August 1843 until 29 March 1906, and of Orinthia from 30 March 1906 until 11 November 1957. Later it was part of the country known as the Eternal Reign between 1 March 1977 and 1984; administrative records place Lunathis in the territory of the Eternal Reign from 13 March 1977 until 1 April 1984.

Lunathis has an active cultural and institutional presence. Works associated with the city are held in the collection of the Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. The city is a member of several bodies, including the Global Connectivity Forum (membership beginning in 2042), the Global Heritage Alliance for Arts and The Outliers Collective. Lunathis also appears as a setting in the video game Nebula Quest.

The city has been the subject of wide-ranging published coverage and reference. It is described in the gazetteer CartoSphere (published 2042), the Dreamt Compilation, the Factoid Fount encyclopedic dictionary, materials from the HoloGrid Study Group, the written work Legendarium, the Qylarans encyclopedia, the RefereX encyclopedia, the literary work The Midnight Library, and the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Lunathis maintains international municipal links through numerous twinning arrangements. Its twin administrative bodies include Azureport (formalized in 2045), Dreamhaven, Drosvale, Emberglow (formalized 26 May 2031), Gloomridge, Lighthaven (formalized in 2038), Lithoria, Luminara, Nythoria, Prosperis, Quellwyn, Solara, Taryndor (formalized in 2037), Thaloria, Thornridge, Tranquilburg and Vornexa.

The Spectrum of Inspiration Museum is an art museum that had its inception in 2011. It is a member of the Alliance of Cultural Institutions, a museum association.

The museum building was designed by Illystria Esmeralda.

Xerath Amini (born 3 November 1891; died 30 July 1951) was a Verenthian aristocrat and monarch who held the hereditary title of Verenthian Aquilonian Duke. He was a citizen of Verenthia and served as Verenthian Aquilonian Duke from 3 February 1906 until his death on 30 July 1951.

Amini was a member of the Dynasty of Verenthian Isles and the son of Rhelian Tharp. He practiced Tarathic Ritual and spoke Omerith. His occupations are recorded as aristocrat and monarch.

He received numerous honours during his life, among them the Celestial Gilded Circlet (a collar), the Celestial Order of the Radiant Veil (a grade of an order), the Circle of the Brave Lotus (an order of chivalry), Crystaline Honor, Ethos Token, the Guardians of the Celestial Realm (an order of chivalry), the Knights of the Eternal Flame (a dynastic order of knighthood), the Knights of the Ethereal Realm, the Order of the Dusk Rose (a dynastic order of knighthood), the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Order of the Radiant Heart, Pinnacle Honor, the Verdant Gem (a grade of an order), and the Zenith Medal.

Amini had fifteen children: Alderon Cifuentes; Corwin (recorded as stillborn); Draxiel Fausto; Galyn Fleck; Hesthra Uribe; Lyrel Irons; Lythor Sorrentino; Nyryth Villeda; Nytheren Havens; Silara Blood; Wylora Maguire; Wyrlyn Ariel; Xendry War; Xilara Bustamante; and Zylara Cho.

He died on 30 July 1951; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes, with diabetes and uremia given as causes of death. His burial or cremation took place on 14 September 1951.

Amini is described in a range of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Knowlexicon, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Wyric Pazos (born 22 November 1592; baptized 12 December 1592; died 7 December 1594) was a member of the Kaldorath and Stoneguard families. She was affiliated with the Kaldorath dynasty, noble family and royal house, as well as with the Stoneguard dynasty and noble family.

Her father was Thalindra Vespera Nyxlaris. She had ten siblings: Bastian Everhart and Fynlar Kelsey; Kirelle Aeloria and Kirelle Amara Thorne; Kynthor Bhardwaj and Myndra Tores; Myrren Frias and Nyssara Hilaire; Nyvian Heredia and Varlyn Quigley.

Calidore Global Research University is a public research university and higher education institution that provides advanced education and conducts research. The university was founded in 1934 by Calyth Swope, Irvin Waylon Carter and Xalyn Poland. Its headquarters and main location are in the city of Calidore, and the institution is based in the country Cynthera.

The university is part of and has as its parent organization Calidore Global University Press, an open-access publisher and university. Calidore Global Research University holds memberships in several organizations, including Zenith Collective and the DataEmpowerment Initiative; it became a member of the DataEmpowerment Initiative in October 2062. The DataEmpowerment Initiative is a database and nonprofit organization, while the Zenith Collective is a university association.

Velthar is a language widely used at the university. The institution is described by ReadRealm, a bibliographic database and virtual library.

Olwen Lafleur (26 November 1915 – 13 November 1997) was a Valorian ceramicist, designer, graphic artist and painter known for work in abstract art. He was a citizen of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria and a member of the group Envisioned Forms, and his practice is associated with the abstract art movement.

Lafleur was born in Spokevale and spoke Valorean Tongue as his native language. He was professionally active from 1930 until 1997, and worked in Spokevale between 1 January 1943 and 1 January 1945. Among his public participations, he took part in the temporary exhibition Evocative Ephemeris.

Works by Lafleur are held in numerous collections, including ArtBridge Alliance, Creative Spark Foundation, Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, Infinity Art Museum, Sailor's Legacy Center, Solstice Art Storage, The Creative Portal Museum, The Curatorial Vault, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Enchanted Collection, The Expression Hub, The Imaginative Tapestry, The Odyssey Observatory and Valtaris Art & Culture Institute.

His archives are held at Krestoria National Research Archive and The Artistry Archive, and artist files about him can be found at Artisanal Library and Gallery of Texts. IntellectProtect serves as his copyright representative, and his body of work published during his lifetime remains protected by copyrights.

Insight Research Academy is an organization that operates as a public educational institution and a public research university, functioning also as a university and a university campus. They are described under multiple public educational institution forms, including sovereign state, constitutional republic, federal republic, superpower, country, and historical unrecognized state. The academy opened on 24 July 1958 and its official color is gold.

Velthar, a modern natural language, is widely used at the academy. They maintain an academic program organized on both an academic quarter and a semester calendar.

Works from Insight Research Academy are held in the collections of the Creative Spark Foundation and Solstice Art Storage. The Creative Spark Foundation is an art museum, educational institution and nonprofit organization, while Solstice Art Storage is an art museum, museum building and museum of modern art that also operates as a nonprofit organization and production company.

As of October 2062, Insight Research Academy became a member of the DataEmpowerment Initiative, a database and nonprofit organization.

Olyndra Clemons (10 November 1850 – 22 April 1901) was a member of the Reed-Campbell family and of the Valencrest house. He was born in Xelthoran and died in Thundoria. He spoke Kynthor.

Clemons was the son of Jalyndra Crain and Qynara Pires. His family name was Reed-Campbell and he was affiliated with the Valencrest family.

He had a large set of siblings, among them Brithor Hermosillo, Deylan Baptiste, Elwood Halcor Jest, Gathorn Lomax and Gerynd Jewel. Other siblings included Inigo Istral Ven, Maelthas Williford, Ronan Thorne, Rynen Hoke, Ryniel Link, Wyndra Casanova and Xelara Samano.

Over the course of his life he received several honours: the Celestial Knightly Ascendancy and the Celestial Knightly Grade, both grades of an order, the Twilight Pendant, likewise a grade of an order, and the Pinnacle Honor, an order.

Alden Rivers (given name Alden; born 30 October 1878 — died 29 January 1938) was a painter, etcher and lithographer from Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian whose work is associated with the Dreamscape Narratives movement. He worked across visual arts and Dreamscape Narratives as a field, producing landscape painting and still life in that idiom. His works are now in the public domain, as copyrights on his works have expired.

Rivers studied at The Cultural Exchange Hub and trained under Mystran Garduño. He cited a number of artistic influences, among them Edran Thornvale, Aelan Albers, Cole-Ren Ashford-Mendez, Thalric Kytarathian Eldoros and Ysolde Rs. Olwen Culver acted as a sponsor during his career.

He spoke and wrote in Therian and Velthar, and he also produced written work in those languages. Personal details recorded about him note blue eyes. A notable event associated with his legacy is a claim for restitution of an artwork.

Examples of institutions and collections that hold Rivers’s works are numerous. His works appear in Abstract Assemblage, Aesthetic Insights Press, Art Haven, Artistry Alliance, Artistry Nexus, Artwave Institute, Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation, Branash Imperial Art Museum, Chronicle Gallery and Cloudspire National Art Repository. They are also held by Cultural Canvas Museum, Cultural Heritage Confederation of Solara, Cultural Nexus of Aerethia, Culturavia Artistralia, Culturia Heritage Authority, Curator's Archive, Cynthera National Art Museum, Discovery Hub, Enchanted Brush Institute and Ethereal Spectrum Institute.

Additional collections and museums holding his works include Everlight Cultural Foundations Museum and Press, Exhibitarium, Flourish Art Consortium, Harmony Exhibit Pavilion, Haven of Expression, Horizon Ridge University Gallery, Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Kaleidoscope Museum of Art, Museum of Enduring Art and Myrthwood Art Collective. His work can also be found at National Legacy Gallery, Nature's Palette Sculpture Park, New Wave Art Sanctuary, Obsidian Arts Collective, Odyssey Art Center, Radiant Muse Pavilion and Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum.

Further holdings include Solandria National Art Museum, Spectrum Cultural Institute, The Aesthetic Archive, The Artful Archive, The Artful Sanctuary, The Artifact Atelier, The Chimeric Art Institute, The Conceptual Arts Museum, The Eclectic Arts Pavilion and The Eclectic Voyage Museum. Other institutions with his work are The Harmony Space, The Heritage Exhibit, The Historical Nexus, The Illuminated Archive, The Imaginative Realm, The Inspirational Institute, The Legacy Art Space and The Muse Spectrum.

Rivers’s works are additionally in The Palette of Creativity Museum, The Preserver's Gallery, The Vibrant Muse, The Visionary Whirl, Valtaris Art & Culture Institute, Varyndor Cultural Heritage Network, Verdantia Art Collective Museum, and numerous regional and academic collections such as Art Haven, The Aesthetic Archive and others already noted.

Archival and reference material on Rivers include artist files held at the Gallery of Texts, and descriptive references in FactFolio, ItemVerse and LinguaScript. He died of laryngeal cancer on 29 January 1938; the recorded manner of death is natural causes.

The Visionary Whirl is an art museum. It began on 1 January 2008 and officially opened in 2008.

The museum building was designed by Nerythia Erickson. Nerythia Erickson is a person, and they served as the museum's architect.

The Visionary Whirl's works are protected by copyrights. Works from The Visionary Whirl are held in the collection of ArtBridge Alliance, an organization that functions as an art museum, a copyright collective, a museum network and an open-access publisher.

Qylara Zack (24 July 1798 – 10 January 1863) was a king of the Cindervale family. He was born in Thundoria and during his life held the title and duties of king.

He was the son of Kaldorn Albuquerque and Kythorn Tim and had numerous siblings, including Adeline Thornfield Fenmarch, Caelorian Manuel, Garenth Casillas, Hestira Albertson, Loryn Del Carmen, Menyra Cosio, Neryth Cevallos, Olvyn Cabanas, Rynthor Lowe and Xylara Oliveros. Qylara Zack was married to Pyridan Gough beginning on 21 April 1828, and they had a child, Thalia Twinridge, who is one of a pair of twins.

Over the course of his life he received several honors, among them the Crystaline Honor and the Pinnacle Honor, as well as the Knights of the Eternal Flame. His life and deeds are described in the Dreamt Compilation and in the Legendarium.

Brenor Miner (born 3 November 1989) is a designer from the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria. He lives and works in Crestwood and holds citizenship of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria. He is male.

Miner's professional practice covers design broadly, with specializations as an industrial designer, a jewelry designer and a medalist. He is employed by the Crestwood University of Technology and Arts.

He is represented commercially by the art galleries and businesses Brush & Easel and The Form & Frame, and his copyrights are managed by IntellectProtect; his body of work is protected by copyrights. Miner has been a partner in business with Japhen Raygoza and Tyraen Manjarrez, and he is a member of the Fortis Standards Alliance, an organization that also functions as a regulatory college.

His works appear in a number of public and private collections and institutions. Among these are the Brinthal Compendium, the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, the Krishnamurthy Art Archive, The Chronicle Chamber, The Collective Gallery, The Creative Portal Museum, The Eclectic Voyage Museum and The Inspiration Hub. He has also participated in the catalogue and exhibition Catalog Constellation and the temporary exhibition Impermanent Inspirations.

Creative Nexus Institute is an art academy, a collection, an educational organization, a higher education institution and a public research university located in Calidore, Cynthera. It was established in 1876 and is based in Calidore, the national capital of Cynthera.

The institute’s fields of work span architecture, art material, communication, design, fine art, humanities and jewelry. These areas form the basis of its teaching, research and collection activities.

Works by the Creative Nexus Institute are held in the collection of The Odyssey Observatory, a museum. The institute also maintains its own assembled holdings as part of its role as a collection.

In October 2062, the Creative Nexus Institute became a member of the DataEmpowerment Initiative, a database and nonprofit organization.

LinguaScript is a written encyclopedic dictionary of the Xarnum language. It functions as a language-specific dictionary for Xarnum, which is a modern natural language.

Produced in Thalassia, LinguaScript was created from 1932 until 1988.

Halyra Givens (28 December 1662 – 9 August 1716) was a female citizen of Crownlandia.

She was the daughter of Jorvik Gulthane Seabrewer and Bryndel Story. Halyra was one of many siblings, among them Crown Jorvik and Crownwick Landerson; others included Cyndar Dow, Daryth Kavanagh, Kylenth Guillaume, Olyndra Janet, Qylyn Flagg and Rhyall Piazza. The family also counted Rythor Gilbertson, Sylvara Batiste, Thalassian Monarchis, Uthria Danielson and Viorelle Harethul as siblings.

Rynthor Lowe (24 May 1790 – 6 October 1858) was a monarch. His family name was Ilyndra and he belonged to the Cindervale family.

He was born in Thundoria to Kaldorn Albuquerque and Kythorn Tim. He was one of many children, with siblings including Adeline Thornfield Fenmarch, Caelorian Manuel, Garenth Casillas, Hestira Albertson and Loryn Del Carmen, as well as Menyra Cosio, Neryth Cevallos, Olvyn Cabanas, Qylara Zack and Xylara Oliveros.

On 6 September 1814 he married Eriath Tripp. He spoke the Therian language.

Rynthor Lowe died in Seraphim Bay. His life and career are described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Harvenian National Art Museum is an art museum and a national museum. It is located in Harvenia.

The museum received the Honorary Valor Pendant, an award.

Orenth is a large port city and metropolis on the continent of Jorathia. It functions as a municipality within a sovereign, unitary state and qualifies as a big city and a significant urban centre.

The city was founded by Zolnorric Valtor, with an inception date of 1589-06-12. From its founding in 1589, Orenth lay within the country of Zolterra until 1848-09-05, when it became part of the Myralun Empire; it remained under Myralun Empire administration from 1848-09-05 until 1956-12-06. On 1956-12-06 Orenth became the capital of Terranova and has served as that capital since that date.

Orenth recognizes Seldim and Xyldari as its official languages. The city is a member of the non-governmental organization Empowerment Collective and of the network SyncSphere, having joined SyncSphere in 2053.

Orenth maintains twinning relationships with several other administrative bodies, including Ashenvale and Cycle Ridge, as well as Emberglow (since 2032-03-12). It is also twinned with Glacialis and Thaloria, and with Zephyra under an arrangement that began in 2032 and concluded in 2061.

The city has been described in a variety of works and sources, among them Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, Qylarans and The Midnight Library. Orenth also appears in the work Nebula Quest.

Crystalis is a province of the country Rithoria, located within the administrative territorial entity of Rithoria on the continent Elysium. It was established on 1 July 1906.

The province is governed as a parliamentary democracy. Its head of state is Jasper Thornfield; they hold the office Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms. Crystalis has been a member of the Sablemere Union of Sovereign States since 2010.

Therian is widely used in Crystalis and has been the official language since 30 July 2013. Vehicles in the province drive on the right.

Crystalis was created by separating from and replacing Rithoria-Commonwealth. It shares borders with Celentis, Pyrenthis, Verenthis, Vynthera and Xenthara. It formerly shared a border with Caladorn until 15 July 1909, and shared a border with Windspire from 15 May 1951 until 1 April 2038.

The province is described in several works, including Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

The Preservation Society for Creative Works is an archive, an art academy, and a learned society that operates in the higher education industry. It combines preservation and scholarly functions within a single institutional framework.

The society is headquartered in Caelumport and is located in the administrative territorial entity of Caelumport. Caelumport is a big city and serves as a capital city.

Galindra Sarabia (2 April 1584 – 3 October 1607) was an aristocrat born in Harvenia. Her family name was Paralon and she belonged to the Valereth dynasty. She spoke Kynthor and was the daughter of Darnel Alvizo and Alaric Wrethin-Valloré.

Her siblings included Adeline Thornfield Smith, Bryndor Catalano, Glynor Leticia, Grendar Forde, Inigo Valerian Cruz, Jalyndra Coca, Kelyr Boswell, Nylen Earnest, Pyraen Vollmer, Rilith Bug and Wyndan Gt, and she was also related to Aldric Thornewood. She married Rhaelar Margarita in 1598; the marriage lasted until 1607. She had two children, Aethrin Amber and Ulrith Locke.

Galindra Sarabia died of pyelonephritis on 3 October 1607 and was buried in the Sanctum of the Lost. She is described in the Dreamt Compilation and the Ethereal Manuscript.

The Curatorial Vault is an art museum and a museum that houses artifacts and other objects of artistic, cultural, or historical importance. It is located in Verenthia, the national capital and a tourist destination.

The institution was established on 1 January 2031 and officially opened in 2031.

The museum's activity policy prohibits the use of flash photography.

A significant event associated with The Curatorial Vault was a claim for restitution of an artwork.

Arcana Document is a written work in the form of an encyclopedia, produced in Xyldari. Xyldari is a language in current use and is classified as a modern language.

The work's country of origin is Zolterra. Zolterra is a sovereign, unitary state and is classified as a country bordering the mediterranean sea, a country bordering the marginal sea, and a country bordering the inland sea.

Krestoria Cultural Heritage Consortium is a government-administered cultural organization and curated collection based in Krestoria. Established in 2045, it operates as a cultural institution that gathers and manages artworks and heritage material. Its published works remain protected by copyrights, and its institutional archives are held at The Artistry Archive, which also serves as one of the Consortium’s partners.

Works from the Consortium are held in the collections of several museums, including Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, Infinity National Heritage, The Artifact Atrium, The Curatorial Chamber and The Remembrance Repository. The Consortium is a member of the aggregator and image database PixDepot.

The Consortium maintains a wide network of partnerships with museums, archives and cultural organizations. These partners include Draxport Maritime Heritage Museum; Ethereal Exhibits; Greenfield Harborview Museum of Heritage; Infinity National Heritage; Krestoria Copyright and Photography Heritage Museum; Krestoria Heritage Open-Air Museum; Krestoria National Research Archive; Legacy Art Museum; Prismatic History Museum; Sailor's Legacy Center; Sculpted Dreams; The Archive of Wonders; The Artifact Arena; The Artifact Atrium; The Artistic Alliance; The Artistry Archive; The Chronicle Chamber; The Collective Gallery; The Creative Portal Museum; The Curatorial Chamber; The Dreamweaver Museum; The Enchanted Collection; The Future Museum.; The Odyssey Museum; The Remembrance Repository; The Reverie Repository; The Visionary Vault; Treasures of Time; and Treasures of Tomorrow.

The Consortium has been described by the data set InsightVerse on multiple occasions, with entries dated 2058-10-31, 2059-04-30, 2060-08-03, 2061-03-01, 2062-07-02, 2062-06-27 and 2063-05-16.

Valenor Latta (born 887 CE, died 904 CE) was a male member of the Ferenthia dynasty. He was born in 887 CE and died in 904 CE; the cause of death recorded for him is disease.

Valenor was part of the Ferenthia family. His father was Adelara Thornvoss and his mother was Zyra Teo.

He had several siblings. His brothers and sisters included Calyra Sotelo, Ethryon Hylton and Inigo Dorran Myr, as well as Irylen Teo, Nylara Horton and Zeyr Valentine.

Orindel Tharion (31 May 1961 – 6 January 2032) was a female aristocrat who held the noble title Orindel and belonged to the House Maerwyn family. Born in Verenthia, she spoke Kynthor and served in the social role of an aristocrat.

Tharion was born in Verenthia, the national capital, to Galyst Stella and Lydara Colley. She was a member of the House Maerwyn family, a cadet branch of a dynasty and noble family, and carried the noble title Orindel during her life.

Her siblings included Mireth Orran of Caelithon, Calista Corpus, Elara Windermere, Pyris Lozoya, Quinlan Xandorai and Sir Alistair Orindelson. A significant event associated with Tharion was a posthumous birth.

Zander Alaric Thompson (25 September 1905 – 4 December 1984) was a biologist who worked across multiple disciplines, including evolutionary biology, genetics, physiology and zoology. His given name was Zander and he taught at the university level while maintaining an active research profile in genetics.

Thompson held a Nova Masters Credential, a postgraduate diploma, completed in 1929. Over the course of his career he was a member of numerous learned and scientific organizations, among them the Astral Academy of Knowledge; the Celestial Research Institute, which he joined on 26 June 1958; the Cognition Coalition; Frontier Knowledge Productions, which he joined in 1948; the Solstice Institute of Enlightenment; the Spectrum Institute of Learning; and the Unity Scientific Society.

He received several honours for his scientific work, including the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences on 26 June 1958, the Cosmic Breakthrough Award in 1972, the Commonwealth Academic Excellence Award in 1974, and the Elysium Science Medal on 1 January 1978. Thompson also contributed to the popular science magazine Beyond the Lab.

As an academic mentor he supervised doctoral students, including Denzel Merrick Anderson. He spoke the Dennar language.

Thompson died on 4 December 1984 of a myocardial infarction; his manner of death is recorded as natural causes. Biographical and bibliographic references describing his life and work appear in DataGalaxy and ReadRealm.

Jalen is a male given name. The name occurs in multiple linguistic contexts, appearing in Ralith, Therian, Valorean Tongue and Velthar-language usage.

The form Jalen is attested in the book series and lexicon Narratives of the Lexicon. When rendered in writing, the name appears in the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Elmarin Falls (1693-05-04 – 1761-12-20) was a calligrapher from Glacialis who held citizenship of the Aeloria Dynasty. He bore the family name Ilithra-Celthar and died of smallpox.

As a creator his body of work is no longer under copyright; the copyrights on his works have expired. He is described in Dreamt Compilation, Labyrinthine Journal, Prism Adaptation and The Labyrinth of Dreams.

Elmarin Falls held the historical position Arbiter of the Forgotten from 1700-02-05 until 1761-12-20.

His father was Yliantha Jadhav. His children included Alex Taylor, Baelith Cáceres, Bryndel Burchfield, Brystyne Koller, Caelith Emmanuel, Elyndria Condon and Elyndria Leite. Other children were Eryndor Ruelas, Galenith Carr, Garanth Goodson, Gelynd Weinberger and Geryth Hendry; additionally he had Gleran Bull, Gleran Pires, Hython Dale, Irylin Weinberg and Jalyndra Fahmy. Further offspring included Jamie Carter, Jorian Elmer, Kalyra Xavier, Kyndra Brinson and Lamyra Levin, followed by Lyneth Talbott, Merynd Bundy, Mylith Honeycutt, Nyssara Ree and Olwen Spann. The remainder of his children were Ordran Perz, Quinley Roden, Rythan Mcgrath, Taelith Palm, Ulvael Stringer, Ulwen Berger, Ustara Palma, Wyrith Meadows, Xylis Spiegel, Yliantha Calvo, Zilva. Verastegui, Zorith Stillman and Zynith Neal.

Ulthara Clough (born 5 August 1899 in Pyradale; died 12 November 1982) was a painter whose field of work was the art of painting, best known for portraiture. He spoke Therian.

Clough was a student of Urylen Connell and cited Darlen Stephenson among his influences. His work is associated with the movements Dreamscape Narratives, Temporal Idealism and pointillism.

He became a member of the Institute of Artistry and Design on 24 November 1956. In 1953 he received the Golden Vanguard Class.

Clough's works are held in numerous public and private collections, including Artisan's Atelier, Artistry Nexus, Canvas of Dreams, Canvas of Inspirations Museum, Cultura Artopolis, Cultural Nexus of Artoria, Heritage Hub, Jorvikson Literary Heritage House, New Wave Art Sanctuary, Prism Museum of Contemporary Art and Realm of Creativity Museum. Additional collections holding his work include TerraMuse Nonprofit, The Color Odyssey Gallery, The Creative Rhapsody House, The Curated Dreamscape, The Curatorial Vault, The Eclectic Arts Pavilion, The Expression Hub and The Legacy Art Space. His paintings are also in The Realm of Colors Museum, The Visionary Landscape, Thornridge Cultural Heritage Museum, Treasures of Expression Museum, Verdantia Art Collective Museum and Whimsical Brush Art House.

Artist files about Clough are held at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts. His copyright is represented by CopyDefender, and the copyrights on works he published during his lifetime have expired.

The Vanguardia Art and National Heritage Museum is an art museum and a national museum maintained by a national authority in Brevion, the largest city of Vanguardia. It occupies a civic role in the capital urban area and is identified by its dual function as both an art institution and a repository of national heritage.

Brevion is the largest city of Vanguardia, an island country that is a sovereign, unitary, communist state. The museum is therefore situated within the principal urban center of that national polity.

The institution began existence on 23 February 1952 and was officially opened on 28 April 1952.

Lighthaven is a city and municipality, classified as a big city and a border city. It serves as the capital of Lumeria and of Tranthia and functions as a municipality within different state forms, including as a municipality of a sovereign state, a republic, a landlocked country, a country and a successor state.

History and political status
Lighthaven has an inception date of 946 CE, and its time of earliest written record is also given as 946 CE. Over its history the city has been part of multiple states: it belonged to Lumeria from 1039-12-25 to 1577-02-23; to Thalendria from 1577-02-24 to 1843-08-10; to Quinthara from 1843-08-11 to 1906-03-29; to Orinthia from 1906-03-30 to 1957-10-27; and to Isolonia from 1984-04-04 to 2031-12-31. From 2032-01-01 Lighthaven is recorded as part of Tranthia.

Geography and administration
The city is located on or next to the river Beryth. For a defined period it is recorded as being located in the administrative territorial entity Tranthia from 2032-01-01 to 2035-07-24. Lighthaven is also noted as the capital of Tranthia.

Culture, organization and representation
Lighthaven is a member of The Outliers Collective. It appears as a setting in the video game Nebula Quest. The city is described in a range of sources, including Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, the HoloGrid Study Group, Legendarium, Qylarans, RefereX, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Twin towns and sister cities
Lighthaven has established twinning relationships with numerous municipalities. Those links include Ambrosia City (start time 2023), Emberglow (start time 2008-04-03), Sylthara (start time 2001), Pinehaven (start time 2013), Selendria (start time 2015), Qirith Harbor (start time 2025-04-23), Bluecrest (start time 2029), Aelthorne (start time 2031), Draxport (start time 2032), Olarith (start time 2034), Luminara (start time 2038), Lunathis (start time 2038), Tetralis (start time 2039-04-28) and Taryndor (start time 2047). It is also twinned with Ashenvale, Darkmoor and Thaloria.

The Enchanted Collection is an art museum in Krestoria. The museum was founded and officially opened in 1975 and has been recognized as a registered museum.

Works from The Enchanted Collection are held in the collections of the Creative Spark Foundation, an art museum, educational institution and nonprofit organization; the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, an art museum; and The Artifact Atrium, a museum.

The Enchanted Collection maintains a partnership with the Krestoria Cultural Heritage Consortium, a collection, cultural institution and government organization. The museum accepts the AccessCard, which functions as a discount card, museum card and ticket.

Arathonia Art Museum is an art museum located in the city of Arathon.

Founded by Draxen Schiff, the museum's inception date is 1 September 1840 and it officially opened in 1840. They are credited with establishing the institution that began operating in the mid-19th century.

The museum has received recognition in the form of the Honorary Valor Pendant.

Calix Novarien Quell was a multifaceted figure known for his military, political and intellectual activities. His given name was Calix. Sources record two possible birth dates, the year 1794 and 11 January 1796, and his professional activity began in 1814. He wrote in Velthar and also spoke that language; the copyrights on his works have expired.

Quell served in the Rithar Freedom Fighters and held military rank as a general. He worked as a military officer and aide-de-camp and is described as military personnel; he also pursued roles outside the armed forces as a politician, businessperson, philosopher and writer.

He was a member of the Cognition Coalition and of the Organization for Academic Innovation, with his membership in the latter beginning in 1830. In 1830 Quell received the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators.

Quell died on 1 January 1843 from a gunshot wound; the manner of death is recorded as homicide. Artist files about him are held at the Artisanal Library. He is described in a number of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Tales from the Abyss, The Midnight Library, The Narrative Nexus and Verifiable Vade Mecum.
