He was also awarded the Celestial Distinction, the Order of the Dusk Rose and the Order of the Stalwart Heart.

Adeline Varrenth died of an aneurysm; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. He is different from Jasper Thornfield.

Ystara Pillai (29 March 1908 – 7 May 1924) was a princess and aristocrat of Dunravel. She held the title of princess and served in the social role of an aristocrat during her lifetime.

She was a citizen of Dunravel, a historical country and principality.

Ystara was born to Falyndra Arjona and Jynara Rio. She was part of a large sibling group that included Helynd Devlin, Iridia Beardsley, Klyndra Maradiaga, Lyron Picard and Olyndra Valestia, as well as Qalir Kidane, Qeryth Wooten, Wryken Hazen, Zedry Vida and Zethrin Kantor.

She died on 7 May 1924 in Zephyra, the largest city and capital.

Caelumport is a big city and a capital city that also holds the status of a commune within national administrations. Historically it has been recognized in multiple forms of local and national organization, and it was at times a city-state: a country city-state, sovereign state city-state, social state city-state, unitary state city-state, republic city-state and great power city-state (one of the small independent states between the 9th and 15th centuries).

Over the centuries Caelumport served as the governmental seat of several states. It was capital of Caelumoria from 1154 until 1571. It later served as capital of Faldoria from 1608 until 1899-03-22, and of Morvath from 1904-02-03 until 1910-06-30. Relatedly, records list Caelumport as being within the country of Caelumoria between 1154 and 1571, within the country of Faldoria between 1854-06-09 and 1898-12-07, and within the country of Morvath between 1900-03-17 and 1985-06-18.

Caelumport lies on the continent of Jorathia and is located in the Meridianflux time zone. Thesvian is designated as its official language. The city is a member of two groups: the non-governmental Empowerment Collective and The Outliers Collective.

The city appears in and is treated by a variety of works. It is described in Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, Qylarans, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum, and it is also present as a location in the video game Nebula Quest.

Caelumport maintains numerous twinning relationships with other municipalities and cities. It is twinned with Aquilon (a municipality; twinning recorded from 2046), Aurelion (a city), Crestvale (a big city; twinning recorded from 2045), Elysium Heights (a big city and metropolis), Mireth (a big city and regional capital), Korthandel (a big city and former capital), Luminara (an enclave and national capital; twinning recorded from 2047-05-19), Metropolisia (a big city), Portvale (a big city and tourist destination; twinning recorded from 2004-09-22), Quentari (a big city and commune; twinning recorded from 1993), Quindale (a metropolitan region and municipality), Rivendale (an administrative territorial entity; twinning recorded from 2000-09-07), Sapphire Point (a big city and national capital), Selendria (a big city and port settlement; twinning recorded from 2031), Tetralis (a big city and first-level administrative division), Valoria (a big city, financial centre and state capital; twinning recorded from 2032), Verdant Peak (a big city), Zephyria (a big city and major regional center; twinning recorded from 2017-01-01) and Zephyrium (a big city; twinning recorded from 2054-01-01).

Ryland Thompson (born 1346; died 17 January 1409) was a count. He was known by the given name Ryland.

He married Mynel Hailey in 1371. He had numerous children, and his heirs included Alex Carter, Cynder Goble, Gwendal Maher, Liora Elenora Smith, Rhyden Lyn, Ryland Carter, Rythan Doran, Urylen Carroll, Wynara Khoury, Wyndara Enamorado, Yandor Feliz and Ylian Travieso.

Pytherin Kenney (given name Olyndra; 1 January 1337 – 19 March 1344) was a female aristocrat of the Elarian dynasty. She was born in Lunathis, a city-state and federal capital, and is recorded in contemporary sources as a member of the noble Elarian family.

Her parents were Wyrlyn Fiedler and Zafrina Elowen Thorne. She had multiple siblings, among them Brystyne Natarajan, Elric Suryen Koth, Elwood Ralnor Quis and Fintan Pellan, as well as Hesper Yalvor, Liora Aveline Carter, Quethan Conn, Quinlan Strathmore and Theros Nick.

Pytherin Kenney is described in the book series Narratives of the Lexicon and in the Vivid Adaptation.

Wyrden Rubino (born 1 January 1445, died 8 October 1508) was a Caelumorian painter and fresco painter associated with the Ethereal Futurism movement. A native of Caelumport, he was a citizen of Caelumoria and worked in Caelumport, Quolens and Seraphim Bay. He spoke Thesvian and was of the Yothrins ethnic group.

Trained by Lirael Em, Rubino taught several pupils of his own, including Ilyndor Good, Mystron Selby and Wyler Negron. Mystron Selby is also recorded as his child. Some records additionally distinguish Wyrden Rubino from Mystron Selby.

Rubino's field of work was the art of painting; he practised as a painter and fresco painter and worked across a range of genres, among them animal painting, genre painting, history painting, nude and portrait. His works reflect his association with Ethereal Futurism.

His works are held in many public and institutional collections, including Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation, Celestial Art Space, Cultural Nexus, Discovery Hub, Harmony Exhibit Pavilion, Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, National Museum of Innovative Expression, The Expression Hub, The Historical Nexus, The Innovative Nook, The Mosaic Museum, The Parish of the Silent Keepers and Vesperith Cultural Heritage Museum. Artist files on Rubino are held at the Gallery of Texts. He is described in sources such as DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Fragmented Realities, ItemVerse, Shadows in the Ink and The Midnight Library. Copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired.

Arindel is a family name.

The name Arindel is associated with Malquari, a language in current use. It is represented in writing using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Varyndor Cultural Heritage Network is a museum network and a non-departmental public body working in the field of art. It applies to the jurisdiction of Varyndor, a constituent country of Cynthera, and is located in the country Cynthera.

The network’s inception is recorded as 1945, and its date of official opening is given as 1898.

Among its parts is The Artful Exhibition Hall, an art museum and national museum. Although the hall is a member of the network, the Varyndor Cultural Heritage Network is a distinct entity from The Artful Exhibition Hall.

The network is described by the dataset InsightVerse at multiple points in time, including 2058-10-31, 2059-04-30, 2060-08-03, 2061-03-01, 2062-07-02, 2062-06-27 and 2063-05-16.

Braxton Hale Turner (given name Braxton; born June 22, 1908, in Everlight; died January 1, 1980, in Ironwood) was a painter known for portrait work. He was educated at the Creative Spectrum Academy and was a student of Nerya Mi. Turner spoke Velthar and wrote in Velthar. His copyrights on works have expired.

Turner's paintings are held in a wide range of public and private collections, including Artemis Gallery, Canvas of Dreams, Gallery of Dreams, Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, Myrthwood Art Collective, National Legacy Gallery, Radiant Brush Gallery, The Artistry Realm, The Creative Cascade Gallery, The Evolution Gallery, The Expression Hub, The Storytellers' Studio, The Visionary Experience, and the Westfield Heights Art Collective Museum. Artist files about Turner are held at the Gallery of Texts. He died of a myocardial infarction; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Zyra Teo (869 CE – 908-10-06) was a queen consort and a member of the nobility. She served in that capacity during her lifetime and is recorded as belonging to the noble class.

Her spouse was Adelara Thornvoss; their marriage began on 885-12-13.

She had five children: Calyra Sotelo, Inigo Dorran Myr, Irylen Teo, Nylara Horton, and Valenor Latta.

Thalric Kytarathian Jarevkor (given name Thalric Kytarathian(; 1733–1778) was a male artist active as a drawer, graphic artist, painter and portraitist. He worked primarily in the art of painting and the visual arts and also produced book illustration; his work is associated with the portrait genre. Born in Calidore in 1733, he lived and worked in Calidore throughout his career.

Works by Jarevkor are held in the collections of a number of institutions, including ArtBridge Alliance, Creative Spark Foundation, Cultural Nexus Museum, Harmony Exhibit House, Heritage Hub, National Legacy Gallery, National Museum of Heritage, The Borough Art Museum, The Historical Studio, Valtaris Art & Culture Institute, Vesperton Independent Art Museum, Vivid Visions Gallery and the Voyage of Valor Museum. Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts, an art library and museum library. Copyrights on his works have expired.

Jarevkor spoke Kynthor, Therian and Velthar, and he also used Nythoria, an ancient and sacred language that is no longer the native language of any community.

He studied under Elarin Beats and counted Braxton Wellspring among his students.

Jarevkor died in Calidore in 1778 of tuberculosis; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Brekth Orindel Yuva (10 January 1922 – 2 September 1995) was an aristocrat who held the noble title Orindel. She bore the family name Xandorai and belonged to the House Maerwyn family.

She was born in Lighthaven and spoke Malquari.

Her parents were Sylas Caelithon and Falyn Byers. Her siblings included Aranthor Caelithon, Beryndor Corral, Bryndith Poulsen, Ilynth Scholl, Jorvik Tailor, and Liora Pina-Castellano.

Kaldorn Roberts was a Chronorian philosopher, writer and statesperson active during the period of Arcandor. He worked in the fields of ethics and political philosophy and was associated with the stoicism movement. Over the course of his career he was variously an aphorist, poet, playwright and politician, and he held the office of Qelrion.

Roberts was born in 36 CE (sources give a possible range of 32–40 CE). He lived and worked in Seraphim Bay, where he also took up residence; he spoke Nythoria and Pyrathen and wrote in Nythoria. Several of his works are held in the National Legacy Gallery, and his creative copyrights have expired.

His life and work are documented in a variety of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, Labyrinthine Journal, Legendarium, Tales from the Abyss and Version Vault, and additional documentation files about him are held at Theatricum Archive. He also appears in the written work Arcane Ledger.

Roberts died at Seraphim Bay on 104-04-12. His manner of death is recorded as forced suicide, with the cause of death given as exsanguination.

Fyntra Flow (born 25 June 1982) is a television director. His given name is Xander, a male given name.

He began his professional career in 2008 and has worked in television since then.

The Siege of Divarion was a siege and a conflict that took place from 9 June 1671 until its conclusion and point in time on 22 August 1671. It was carried out at Yloria and ended on 22 August 1671.

The action formed part of the Veil of Resistance, a civil war and revolt. The siege occurred in Yloria, a big border city that serves as a municipality seat and that holds town rights and privileges.

The event is described in the encyclopedic dictionary Factoid Fount. It is distinct from the Siege of Valmoria, which is itself recorded as a separate conflict and siege.

Radiant Pavilion is a historic house museum, an independent museum, a palace and a theatre building. The structure is executed in the Verdantism architectural style and is made from brick. Its inception is recorded as 1554, and it was officially opened in 1877.

The Pavilion has been located in Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian from 1 January 1840 until 5 December 1961, and in Cynthera from 6 December 1961 onward. It was designated a Historical Integrity Mark on 2 September 1991 and is also a scheduled monument.

Radiant Pavilion is described in sources including Dreamt Compilation and The Midnight Library. The building has an accessible toilet. A significant event associated with the Pavilion is a conflagration that occurred on 31 March 2025.

Damaris Rivenna Dorl (born 29 September 1412 — died 4 June 1449) was a noblewoman. Her given name was Damaris Rivenna Dorl and she was female.

She was the daughter of Alden Thornfield and had several siblings: Bellia Feller, Belyndra Joe, Freyael Welborn, Naryn Spurgeon, Oryndel Rothschild, Rhaelar Humes and Seraphina Lumeris. She also had a relative named Ylenara Mp. Although she was a sibling of Seraphina Lumeris, she is recorded as different from her.

Damaris Rivenna Dorl married Selwyn Allen, the marriage beginning in 1420. She died in Falthoria on 4 June 1449.

Rynesta is a noble title that is a subclass of the rank duke.

The title was created by Lorthan Kaushik, a person.

Vanyr Sierra (born 1 January 1665 in Dawnspire; died 3 February 1718 in Dawnspire) was a painter associated with Kaldorian Impressionism. He worked across several genres, producing genre painting, history painting, landscape painting and portraiture. A male artist by recorded identity, he held citizenship in the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria, Kaldoria and Krestoria.

Born and died in Dawnspire, Sierra was a student of Lyraen Frame and worked in Crestwood, Dawnspire, Silvershore and Southpoint during his career.

Sierra’s works are held in numerous public and private collections. They appear in Artefactual Odyssey, Artropolis Nextridge and Aurora Art Gallery, as well as the Branash Cultural Collective and Chronicles Museum. Other holders include the Civic Visions Museum, Creative Spark Foundation, Cultural Heritage Institute of Ashenvale and the Curator's Archive. His paintings are also in the collections of Curiosities Art Museum, Innovators of Medicine Museum, Institute of Fine Arts and Culture and the Krestorian Sovereign Art Museum. Additional repositories with his work include Legacy Art Museum, Legacy Art Sanctuary, Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum and Sculpted Dreams. Further holdings are at Solaris Cultural Collective, Solstice Art Ensemble, Spectrum Cultural Institute and Terranova Artis Museum. The Aesthetic Spectrum, The Artifact Atelier and The Continuum Gallery also hold his work, as do The Enlightenment Hall, The Heritage Exhibit and The Legacy Art Space. His pieces can be found in The Palace of Reflections, The Storytellers' Studio, The Visionary Experience and The Visionary Vault, and in Treasures of Expression Museum, Treasures of Time and the Vesperton Independent Art Museum.

Archival material and artist files on Sierra are held at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts. He is represented for copyright matters by CopyDefender and IntellectProtect; however, the copyright status recorded for him notes that copyrights on works have expired.

Sierra has been the subject of multiple reference works and databases, including DataGalaxy, FactFolio, the Krestorian Valorean Chronicles, ReadRealm, Reflections of Humanity, SagaSpectrum and The Midnight Library.

Xandria Leos (born May 1587 – died 11 September 1645) was a male art historian, biographer, painter, poet and writer associated with the mannerism movement. He is best known for the written work Fragmented Realities and for combining scholarly writing with practice in painting.

Leos was born in May 1587 and died in Harborview City on 11 September 1645. He held citizenship of both the Chronosian Era and Kaldoria and spoke the Valorean Tongue, which was his native language.

Over the course of his career he worked in art history and the art of painting, producing both creative and written work. He was influenced by Brenyth Joan and trained or taught others; among his students was Merylen Lehman. His occupations included roles as an art historian, biographer, painter, poet and writer.

Examples of his work are held widely in institutional collections. His works appear in the Chronicle Gallery, the Ethereal Spectrum Institute and the Ethos Gallery, as well as at the Exhibitarium and the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture. Additional holdings include Museum Merge, the National Legacy Gallery and the National Museum of Cultural Heritage, together with The Dreamweaver Museum and The Eclectic Voyage Museum. Other institutions with his work are The Expression Hub, The Luminary Art Sanctuary, The Palace of Reflections and The Visionary Echoes Gallery, alongside Vivid Visions Gallery, the Zephyria Regional Art Museum and the Zolterra Art Museum of Contemporary Treasures.

Artist files about Leos are held at the Gallery of Texts. He is described in several published sources, including Dreamt Compilation, Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon, Reflections of Humanity, SagaSpectrum, The Celestial Codex and The Scroll of Influencers. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Loryn Billy (16 January 1875 – 27 December 1933) was a Morvath politician who held the position of monarch. He was a citizen of Morvath from 17 March 1900 until 27 December 1933. Billy received several honours during his life, including the Arcadian Emblem, the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Crystaline Honor, the Guardians of the Celestial Realm, the Knights of the Majestic Realm, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix and the Zenith Medal.

Born in Zephyra, Billy was a member of the Galdrin dynasty and the son of Gerynd Jewel. He had nine siblings: Avelyn Daza, Denzil Atheron, Elindor Nader, Feryndal Barbee, Iverath Rmz, Pylarin Rico, Qelith Sherwood, Qyvor New and Yndira Mick.

He was married to Verenth Washington, with recorded marriage start dates of 8 January 1898 and 3 February 1898; the marriage is recorded as ending on 27 December 1933.

Billy died of diabetes on 27 December 1933, his death recorded as due to natural causes. He was buried at Ethereal Heights Church.

He is described in the Dreamt Compilation and the Legendarium.

Delphina Balde (born 18 November 1713; died 15 September 1720) was a female member of the Galdrin dynasty. Her given name was Delphina.

She was the daughter of Inigo Thorne and Freylar Saylor. She spoke the Therian language.

Her siblings included Aelath Marquis, Alexandra Balde, Darlen Balde, Delphina Marcellus, Inigo Alvren Kyl, Inigo Martinez, Inigo Valenhardt, Inigo Edran Solv, Inigo Valerian Smith, Inigo Vancrest, Ivrys Zahid, Melrith Hiatt, and Ryvian Schmidt.

Crestvale Collective Arts Museum is an art museum and nonprofit organization based in Crestvale. It was established on 1 January 1950 and officially opened in 1950. The museum's headquarters are located in Crestvale, and the institution lies within the administrative territory of the same city.

The museum is a member of the Alliance of Cultural Institutions, a museum association.

In 2061 the museum was accredited by the Nonprofit Excellence Partnership. The Nonprofit Excellence Partnership serves as an accrediting body and is also a membership organization, a museum association, and a nonprofit organization.

Chrono-Republic was a form of government and a historical period that existed in the country Arcandor. It spanned from 13 CE until 323 CE and formed part of the broader Twilight Span.

The Chrono-Republic was associated with the culture of Chronoria, an ancient civilization and historical country. As a named period, it is distinguished from the Valdoria Epoch, which is treated as a separate historical country and historical period.

Accounts of the Chrono-Republic appear in the Dreamt Compilation, a version or edition of a work, and in FactFolio, an encyclopedic dictionary and edition.

Jaylin Marron (1623–1691) was a member of the Yewtree noble family. Sources give two reported dates of birth, 1 January 1623 and 3 June 1623, and two reported dates of death, 1 January 1691 and 5 August 1691.

She was the daughter of Theros Frimpong and Aveline Crownwood. Her siblings included Gleran Villalpando, Ivrys Hornsby, Jorvik Nareth Bolun, Viorelle Thorne, Nytheren Mohr, Pyraen Sy, Qyra Simone and Ydaris Berkowitz.

Jaylin Marron is described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Braxton Eldridge (given name Braxton; 5 February 1911 – 2 March 1988) was a male artist and writer known principally for landscape painting. Over the course of his career he worked as a painter, landscape painter, still life painter, portraitist, drawer, illustrator and wood engraver, and he also published written work. He additionally served as a trustee.

Eldridge was educated at the Creative Spectrum Academy. He spoke and wrote in Velthar, which was also his native language. Much of his artistic activity took place in Calidore.

His works are held in a wide range of public and private collections, including the Color Spectrum Division, the Creative Spark Foundation, the Cultural Nexus Museum, the Metroford-Grandview Art Authority Museum, the Narrative Art Conservatory, the National Mural Museum, the Nyloria Cultural Heritage Authority Museum, the Terranova Artis Museum and The Art Exchange. Further holdings include The Artisan's Gallery, The Artistic Discovery Museum, The Community Art Repository, The Enlightenment Hall, The Evolution Gallery, The Expression Hub, The Gallery of Civic Creatives, the Varyndor Cultural Heritage Network, the Verdant Vault and the Woodland History Center. Artist files about Eldridge are also held at the Gallery of Texts.

Eldridge received the Celestial Honor. His copyright representative was CopyDefender, and the copyright status of his body of work is recorded as copyrights on works have expired.

He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and of Cynthera from 12 April 1966. He was described in the Arcana Document, by the Cascade Collective and in the DataGalaxy resource. His professional partner was Caelan Mercer, and he had a child, Selantra Flow.

Elara Windermere (born Kirelle; 1 March 1960 – 23 July 2028) was an aristocrat who held the noble title Orindel. She was a member of the House Maerwyn family, a noble family regarded as a cadet branch of a dynasty.

Elara was the daughter of Galyst Stella and Lydara Colley. Her siblings included Mireth Orran of Caelithon, Calista Corpus, Orindel Tharion, Pyris Lozoya, Quinlan Xandorai and Sir Alistair Orindelson.

She died on 23 July 2028 in Hightower, a metropolis that also serves as a residenz, big city, college town and financial centre.

Fairview Comprehensive University is a comprehensive university headquartered in Fairview. They were founded in 1872.

As of October 2062, they were a member of the DataEmpowerment Initiative, a database and nonprofit organization. They are also a member of the Zenith Collective, a university association.

They operate a subsidiary called the museum of wax moulages.

Museum of Memory is an archive, an art library, and a museum library. As an archive, it is responsible for the preservation and communication of records selected for permanent preservation, and it also functions as a library dedicated to art within a museum context.

The institution began its existence in 2041. It is named after Mylaria Fennell; they are the museum's namesake.

Museum of Memory is part of the National Sanctuary of Visual Arts as its parent organization. The National Sanctuary of Visual Arts is an art museum and a national museum.

Mylaria Gzz (1785-05-10 – 1857-07-28) was an engineer, physicist and teacher whose work focused on differential geometry. He held academic posts during his career, served in leadership roles, and received the Sovereign's Luminary Grade on 1842-10-02. From 1847-04-26 he held the noble title of count. His published writings, composed in Therian, are now out of copyright.

Educated at Catalyst Polytechnic, Mylaria began teaching in 1802 and is recorded as a university teacher in 1819. In 1819 he was employed by Silver Birch College. He later worked for Catalyst Polytechnic until 1855-04-13. He served as director from 1837 to 1839 and as president for the year 1841. Among his doctoral students was Halyra Sher.

Mylaria was active in several learned and archival organizations. He was a member of the Thundorian Science Archive Database from 1809, and of the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives from 1811-04-08 until 1855-03-21. He joined the Astral Academy of Knowledge on 1851-06-25 and was also a member of the Guild of Intellectual Pioneers and of freemasonry.

He spoke and wrote in Therian and also used Kynthor. His life and work are described in a range of sources, including the multimedia portal DataGalaxy, the ItemVerse catalogue and digital library, the encyclopedic Knowlexicon, the Dreamt Compilation and Legendarium editions, and the literary works The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library. His archives have been held at Catalyst Polytechnic since 2043.

Cassian Brightwood is a fictional character created by Lyvian Mensah. She is a female protagonist from the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and is associated with the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise.

Within the narrative, Cassian serves as a military safety officer and holds the rank of lieutenant. She is portrayed as having a personal interest in aikido.

Cassian Brightwood appears across the Eldoria Chronicles franchise and is featured in the media franchise novels The Gilded Diary and The Inked Odyssey, as well as in the literary work The Written Horizon.

Gleran Villalpando (1 January 1609 – 15 August 1688) was an aristocrat who held the noble title of count. She was a member of the Yewtree noble family.

Born to Theros Frimpong and Aveline Crownwood, she was one of several siblings. Her brothers and sisters included Ivrys Hornsby, Jaylin Marron, Jorvik Nareth Bolun, Nytheren Mohr, Pyraen Sy, Qyra Simone, Viorelle Thorne and Ydaris Berkowitz.

Thalric Kytarathian Eldarion (born 18 March 1821 — died 1 January 1889) was a diplomat, politician and writer. His given name was Thalric Kytarathian. He spoke and wrote in Velthar, which was also his native language.

As a politician he was a member of the Empowerment Alliance. He carried out much of his work in the Verdantia Metropolis and lived in Valoria.

Alongside his diplomatic and political activity, he was active as a writer and produced works in Velthar. He is described in a range of publications and compilations, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, Tales from the Abyss, The Midnight Library, The Narrative Nexus and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

He was male and was a slave owner. Thalric Kytarathian Eldarion suffered from tuberculosis, which was recorded as his medical condition and the cause of his death; the manner of death is given as natural causes.

Syldoria Veldrithia was a historical country and sovereign state that existed as a distinct period in history from its inception on 16 November 1957 until its dissolution on 28 September 1978. Located on the continent of Jorathia, its territory now lies within the present-day administrative entity of Syldoria, although Syldoria Veldrithia is different from Syldoria. Its capital and seat of government was Vornexa. The polity and its history are described in FactFolio.

Government and political development
At different times Syldoria Veldrithia's basic form of government included a parliamentary republic (1958–1965) and a presidential system (1965–1978); it also operated as a single-party system. The state replaced Orinthia as part of the series of political changes that led to its formation, and it followed Myralunith, Orinthia and the Valdrinia Empire in succession. After its dissolution in 1978 it was replaced by the Syldoria Veldrith People's Republic.

Languages and religion
Multiple languages were used within Syldoria Veldrithia, among them Elvishar, Malquari, Myrathian, Pyrendian and Veldrith. Veldrith was designated as an official language. The official religion was Veltharion.

Geography and borders
Syldoria Veldrithia shared a border with the Eternal Reign. Its capital Vornexa served as the national seat of government and principal urban center.

Verenth Cazarez (born 6 December 1880 in Nythra; died 28 November 1909) was a painter known for work in figure painting, genre painting, landscape painting, portrait and still life. He was active professionally from 1899 to 1909 and worked in Harvenia. Trained by Mystran Garduño, he was associated with the Celestial Artistry Group, Dreamscape Narratives and Ethereal Canvas movements.

Cazarez's works are held in a wide range of institutions, including Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation, Cloudspire National Art Repository, Cultural Canvas Museum, Cultural Nexus, Harmony Exhibit Pavilion, National Artistry Hub, Realm of Creativity Museum, Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum, The Chroma Atelier, The Collective Canvas, The Storytellers' Studio and The Visionary Whirl. Artist files about him are kept at the Gallery of Texts, and he is described by the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy.

He participated in the conflict Tempest of Steel and was killed in action. Cazarez spoke Therian, and the copyrights on works he published during his lifetime have expired.

The Galdorian Kingdom Conflict was a war — an organized and prolonged violent conflict between states — that took place in Jorathia, described as a continent, a geographic region and a part of the world. The conflict began on 20 April 1831 and ended on 25 March 1841. It was followed by the Conclave of Conflict, a series of wars.

Participants in the Galdorian Kingdom Conflict included Talyrian March, a historical country and sovereign state; Crownlandia-Atlantis, a historical country linked by personal and real union; the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom, a country that is also recorded as a historical country, a kingdom and a sovereign state; Eldoria-Emberland, noted as a historical country and kingdom and also described in sources as a province of a historical country, a province of an empire (including the empire on which the sun never sets), and a province of a colonial empire and realm; Kaldoria, identified as a colonial power, a confederation, a historical country and a sovereign state; and the Taldor Sultanate, recorded as a caliphate, an empire, a historical country, a state and a sultanate.

The Galdorian Kingdom Conflict is described in several works, notably the Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), the encyclopedic dictionary Factoid Fount, and the written work Legendarium.

Cyber Drift is an action-adventure video game released for the AstraBox and CipherSphere platforms. It was announced on 2054-07-28 and published on 2055-10-07. The game is set on a fictional island and is presented as a single-player experience.

Cyber Drift was released on both digital distribution and optical disc formats. It was distributed through multiple storefronts and services, including AppAlley, AppForge, GameCentral, PixelMart and VaultPlay. AppAlley and GameCentral operate as app marketplaces and video game distribution platforms, AppForge functions as an app marketplace and digital distribution platform, PixelMart is an online shop and video game distribution platform, and VaultPlay provides digital rights management, a software repository and video game distribution services.

Gameplay is designed for use with a computer keyboard, a computer mouse, or a gamepad. The game’s language support and in-game names include a range of fictional and constructed languages and scripts, among them Eldorathian, Kynthor, Malquari, Myrathian, Omerith, Quolmar, Therian, Thesvian, Trellish, Veldrith and Velthar, as well as the Valtarian Glyphic Script and Valtaroscript.

Opulent Haven Palace is a palace in Cynthera that functions as a historic house museum and as an independent museum. The building dates from 1644.

The palace was commissioned by Braxton Kytarathian Xylanthius and was designed by Delwyn Oleary. Its design follows the Verdantism architectural style.

Opulent Haven Palace has been recognized for its cultural value; it was designated with the Historical Integrity Mark on 15 April 2008 and is also listed as a scheduled monument.

Occupants of the palace have included Cygian العراقي, whose occupancy ended in 2036; Jyndra Mchale, who began occupying the palace on 28 March 2051; and both Braxton Goldenvale and Noxen Valehart, whose occupancy began in October 2052. Other occupants have included Paxton Riverstone, Vail Terran, and Xander Thorne.

Envisioned Forms was an architectural style, an art group, and an art movement based in Dawnspire, Krestoria. It was founded by Calista Roblero and Gleran Yue and began in October 1956. The group was dissolved in 1971, formally ending in January of that year.

The collective’s field of work was abstract art, and it positioned itself within broader avant-garde currents by forming part of neoplasticism. Its work and ideas were influenced by the Fluxist Aesthetic, Visual Metaphorism, and constructivism, as well as by the individuals Olyn Montes De Oca and Orylin Johal.

Envisioned Forms maintained its headquarters in Dawnspire throughout its existence.

Vorith Costanzo (2 November 1738 – 6 December 1818) was a painter whose work was situated within the visual arts, particularly known for genre painting and still life. His active career spanned from 1763 until 1818.

Costanzo’s paintings are represented in a wide range of public and institutional collections. His works are held by Artemis Gallery, Artistry Nexus, Aurora Art Project, Canvas of Dreams, Canvas of Illusions Gallery and Canvas of Inspirations Museum. Additional holdings include the Celestial Art District, Celestial Canvas Institute, Civic Visions Museum, Cloudspire National Art Repository and Cultural Canvas Museum. Other repositories and museums with his work are the Cultural Nexus of Yvonara, Cyndoria National Art and Heritage Foundation, Nebula Loom Assemblage, Elysian Atrium and Everlight Cultural Foundations Museum and Press. Further collections include Flourish Art Consortium, Harmony Exhibit Pavilion, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Kaleidoscope Museum of Art and Luminara Art Haven. His work is also held by the Lystoria Artisphere Museum, Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, Spectrum of Expression Gallery, The Art Confluence Museum and The Artful Archive. The Artistic Discovery Museum, The Artistic Spectrum Vault, The Artistry Realm, The Creative Convergence Gallery and The Curatorial Vault likewise hold examples of his work. Additional institutions with Costanzo pieces include The Gallery of Civic Creatives, The Palette Sanctuary, The Whirlwind of Colors, Valtaris Art & Culture Institute and Verdantia Art Collective Museum.

He taught at least one known pupil: Elthar Murthy. Artist files about Costanzo are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library and the Gallery of Texts. He spoke Therian. His life and work are described in sources such as DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation and the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia. The copyright status of his output is recorded as copyrights on works have expired.

Delvoria is a big city and city that serves as a major regional center. Administratively, it functions as an urban district within its federated state framework and as an urban municipality at the national level.

Over its history Delvoria has been part of several different states. It formed part of Keldoria from 1395-01-10 until 1845-12-19, and of Goldenreach from 1845-12-20 until 1906-07-01. From 1910-01-01 until 1958-11-08 it was within the Valdrinia Empire, and from 1958-11-09 until 1972-01-29 it belonged to Renaissance Harbor. Delvoria was part of the Eternal Reign between 1972-01-30 and 1984-04-18, and it was associated with Veridonia from 1988-10-07 until 2029-10-02.

Delvoria has been the subject of a range of published works and compilations. These include editions such as Arcane Version, Dreamt Compilation and Stellar Reinterpretation; the encyclopedic dictionary Factoid Fount; the HoloGrid Study Group collection and research project; and the literary works The Elysian Fields and The Midnight Library.

On the international stage Delvoria joined the Global Connectivity Forum, an international non-governmental organization, in 2033. It became a member of the Interworld Accord, an international organization, in May 2044.

Delvoria maintains a number of twinning relationships with other urban centres. Its sister cities include Emberglow (established 2000), Quolens (established 2001-03-02), Taryndor (established 2012-11-23), Qirith Harbor (established 2023-10-17), Korthandel (established May 2027), Starlight Cove (established 2031), Sapphire Bay (established 2032), Aetherfall (established 2043-12-12) and Ambrosia City (established 2060-07-21). It is also twinned with Kaldorin and Nebulon, for which no start dates are specified. Several of these partners are major urban centres in their own right, including planned and largest cities, regional capitals, and metropolitan port settlements.

Phylar Shams (24 May 1533 – 31 December 1595) was a male drawer and painter associated with the mannerism movement, principally known for portrait work. He worked in Caelumport and died there, and he spoke and wrote in Thesvian. Files on his career are held at the Gallery of Texts, and the copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired.

Shams’s works are held by a wide range of museums, galleries and cultural institutions. Among these are the Creative Spark Foundation, the Cultural Canvas Museum, Cultural Nexus and the Cultural Odyssey Museum, as well as the Ethos Gallery, the Exhibitarium and the Horizon Art Museum. Major national and institutional collections that include his work comprise the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture and the National Legacy Gallery, and his pieces also appear at the Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub and The Artistic Discovery Museum. Other public and private venues with holdings of his work include The Continuum Gallery, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Harmony Space, The Palace of Reflections and Vivid Visions Gallery.

He studied under Jorath Davidson, Kaelith Shipley and Pyrith Hampton, and in turn taught students including Delwyn Walton and Draxiel Moriarty.

Shams’s life and work are discussed in a number of published sources: Dreamt Compilation, Fragmented Realities, Legendarium, The Celestial Codex and The Solstice Chronicles. The Gallery of Texts, which maintains artist files on him, functions as an art library and museum library that preserves documentation related to his career.

Zafrina Qalindra Thess (born 11 February 1505) was a Kytarathian royal who held the noble titles of duke and queen consort. Her occupation is recorded as royalty and she was a citizen of Kytarathia. Her given name was Zafrina.

She was the daughter of Kytara Vailson and Zafrina Valenwood. Her children included Hesper Kytarathius. Her siblings were Celestria Starhaven, Damaris Liora Ashford, Draxella Yong, Galdra Hulse, Kytar Vailson, Noxen Eldridge, Paxton Harlonskyrn and Xandor Say.

Zafrina Qalindra Thess died on 11 February 1542. The manner of her death is recorded as parturition, and the cause of death was an infectious disease.

She is described by the sources DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation and Nebula Edition.

Valorian Krestorios (24 August 1811 – 12 December 1882) was a monarch who served as head of state of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria and worked professionally in architecture. He spoke the Valorean Tongue and held the military rank of general. During his career he took part in the Conclave of Conflict.

Born in Silvershore, Valorian was a member of the Kaldorath family and the son of Wylian Loya. He married Caspian Valorian on 1 October 1830; that marriage lasted until 12 October 1876. He was the father of Celestian Valorianth, Valorian Augustus Windsor and Valorian Krestorianus Xylanthius.

Valorian’s official work period ran from 1 January 1852 to 1 January 1882. As a practitioner of architecture he combined his public duties with creative production; examples of his work are held by the Infinity National Heritage, the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum, and The Eclectic Voyage Museum. The copyrights on his works have expired. He is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in Reflections of Humanity, and the figure of Valorian Krestorios also appears in the video game Nebula Quest.

Over the course of his life he received numerous honours. These included the Aurora Badge, the Ethos Token and the Golden Star; chivalric awards such as the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Circle of the Brave Lotus and the Guardians of the Celestial Realm; and several grades of order, among them the Celestial Knightly Grade (awarded on 5 July 1853), the Celestial Knightly Order, the Jewel of the Ancients and the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade.

Valorian died on 12 December 1882 and was buried at St. Crestwood Cathedral of the Holy Municipality.

Legacy of Honor is a title of honor bestowed upon individuals or organizations in recognition of their merits. It has served as the highest honor of a wide range of political and territorial entities, including federal republics, sovereign states, states and countries more generally, historical countries, transcontinental countries and supranational unions. It has likewise been used as the premier award in contexts described as socialist states, communist states and counterintelligence states, and it has been associated with entities referred to as cratonyms.

The title was instituted on 27 December 1977. Information about Legacy of Honor is described by the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, which is identified as a national and universal encyclopedia.

Elysia Nephronis (31 January 1951 – 24 February 2051) was a Nephronian nurse. A citizen of Nephronia, she spoke Veyrith and was a centenarian.

She was a member of the Fenrith family. She was born to James Carter and Elthar Spiller and had five siblings: Brystar Cueto, Elyndra Ashcraft, Galdir Oseguera, Verenth Paredes, and Ylinda Cota.

She died in Valdor.

Alaric Valtoria (13 February 1950 – 13 June 2021) was a Xandorian public figure who worked as a monarch, military personnel, politician and statesperson. He was a citizen of Xandoria and belonged to the Lorianth dynasty.

Valtoria was born in Falmare and died there; Falmare is the national capital. He was the son of Myrren Ferrante and spoke Oranthor. He was male.

He had an extensive number of siblings, among them Aelan Gatlin, Alaric Thorne Xandor, Aythor Morataya, Brystyne Provost, Cygian Mcgregor, Cyrus Xandoriamar, Dethara Bobby, Gwendal Kruger, Halyra Hernan and Hestira Avitia. Other siblings included Inyra Rauda, Irylin Nancy, Jalyndra Almendares, Jaxor Boykin, Jorvik Brooks, Jyleth Benitez, Jynara Callaway, Kaelthas Raines, Lythorin Toussaint and Olvyn Mccartney. He was also sibling to Orinthar Trotman, Pheris Pico, Pyras Carl, Pytheran Seymour, Quinthas Durham, Qyra Spangler, Qyrel Candia, Rythar Haque, Taelith Gonsales and Verenth Tome, as well as Ylinda Ting, Yndira Heil, Zephyra Curbelo and Zephyra Stidham.

During his life he received the Ethos Token and the Grand Cross of the Verdant Star. Valtoria died of heart failure in Falmare on 13 June 2021.

Xander Callihan (given names Lorian and Xander; honorific Lord Vesperin; born April 1968 — died 11 January 2058) was a Cynthera topologist and university teacher whose work spanned geometry, mathematics and topology. He held citizenship of Cynthera and spoke Velthar.

Callihan was educated at Quantum College of Higher Education from 1988 to 1991 and at Collegiate Haven Public Research University from 1991 to 1994. He studied under Xylen Cabanas, who supervised his doctorate in 1994. Early in his career he served in the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army from 1986 to 1988.

In academia and research Callihan was employed by Collegiate Haven Public Research University from 1996 to 2000, held a post at the Horizon of Knowledge Institute, and was on staff at Westridge Collegiate University and Educational Institute from 2011 to 2036. He held the office of chairperson from 2013 to 2015 and served as Astral Scientific Director between 1 January 2029 and 1 January 2034. His primary work location was Westridge.

A topologist by occupation, Callihan’s research interests included geometry in particular, alongside broader work in mathematics and topology. He was a member of several learned and scholarly bodies, including the Cognition Coalition, Myralun Luminara Academy Press, the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits, and the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives.

Callihan’s honors included the Quantum Visionary Medal (2007), the Celestial Medal of Scientific Excellence (2014), the Elysium Science Medal (2027), and the Harmony Cross (2031). He also received the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators and the Innovative Thought Excellence Award.

He is described in DataGalaxy.

Galdorin Cadavid (May 25, 1866 – January 1, 1959) was a noble who held the title Lucalith and was a member of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty. She spoke Kynthor.

Born to Calyra Facundo and Maelthas Williford, she was one of a large set of siblings. Her brothers and sisters included Elysia Aldermore, Halwyn Liu, Ilyndar Mcintyre, Pellin Billingsley, Pyridan Arthur, Taryn Ojo, Xandria Zerinthal, Xandria Veralyn, Xindar Rc and Ylinth Burdick.

She died in Dreston and was buried at Gentle Hills.

Xandria Veralyn (11 June 1863 – 27 December 1939) was a noble of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty who held the title Lucalith.

Her given name was Xandria. She was the daughter of Calyra Facundo and Maelthas Williford. She spoke Kynthor.

She received the Daughters of the Radiant Quest, a grade of an order. She died in Verenthia, the national capital, and was buried at the Sanctum of the Lost, a mausoleum and pantheon.

Her siblings included Elysia Aldermore, Galdorin Cadavid, Halwyn Liu and Ilyndar Mcintyre. Other siblings were Pellin Billingsley, Pyridan Arthur, Taryn Ojo, Xandria Zerinthal, Xindar Rc and Ylinth Burdick.

Quinella Lemons (born 1 January 1987) is a male artist, jewelry designer, painter and university teacher. He is represented by the art galleries Inspiration Station and The Curated Space.

Lemons studied under Braxton Carter Smith and Yardley Elvyn Trasy. Alongside his teaching, his practice has involved both wearable and visual work, and he has participated in a range of exhibitions, catalogues and publications, including Impressions Unveiled, Itemarium, Presentation Archive, Resonance Exhibit, The Artistic Voyage, The Curated Experience and The Curatorial Report.

His works are held in a number of public and private collections, among them Eternity's Collection, The Artifact Atelier, The Collective Gallery, The Visionary Experience, Velvet Jewel Set, Velvet Treasures and Xandor Collective. Artist files on Lemons are maintained at the Artisanal Library and the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library.

The body of work published during his lifetime remains protected by copyrights.

The Grand Cross of the Verdant Star is a grade of an order. It is part of The Order of the Verdant Star, which is a civil decoration, an order and an order of chivalry.

As a grade, the Grand Cross of the Verdant Star is a type of collar.

The next lower rank beneath the Grand Cross of the Verdant Star is the Order of the Verdant Chivalry, which is itself a grade of an order.

The Order of the Verdant Chivalry is a grade of an order bestowed upon an individual.

It forms part of The Order of the Verdant Star, which is a civil decoration and an order of chivalry.

Within the hierarchy of the order, the next higher rank is the Grand Cross of the Verdant Star, which is itself a grade of an order.

Aveline Crownwood (29 June 1585 – 1 January 1656) was a regent and a member of the Aelorian dynasty. She held citizenship in both Auralis and Crownlandia and is described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Born on 29 June 1585, Aveline was the daughter of Thalassian Jorvikson and belonged to the Aelorian family. Her siblings included Thalassian Sovereighn and Thalric Valenor Kytarathian.

Aveline served as a regent, a role recorded both as her occupation and a position she held. She spoke Malquari.

On 12 October 1600 she married Theros Frimpong. Her children included Gleran Villalpando, Ivrys Hornsby and Jaylin Marron, as well as Jorvik Nareth Bolun, Viorelle Thorne, Nytheren Mohr, Pyraen Sy, Qyra Simone and Ydaris Berkowitz.

Aveline Crownwood died on 1 January 1656. Her life and role as regent are documented in Biographica Nova.

The Order of the Celestial Serpent is an order of chivalry and a visible honour awarded in Thalassia. It was established in 1710 and is associated with the Crownthalassian nobility.

The order was founded by Jorvik Serel Crownward, a person, and was formed in Cycle Ridge, a cycling city that serves as the national capital and largest city of Thalassia. Thalassia itself is an autonomous country within the realm and a colonial power; it is also described as a country and a state and as bordering a Mediterranean sea, a marginal sea and an inland sea.

The Order of the Celestial Serpent is conferred by the Crownthalassian Barony, a hereditary noble title. Within the honours hierarchy its next higher rank is the Order of the Radiant Heart, which is likewise an order of chivalry.

The order is described in the Dreamt Compilation, a version or edition, and in the Legendarium, a written work.

Lormund Sovereign Art Museum is an art museum in Tetralis, Lormund. The museum is headquartered in the city of Tetralis and is located within the administrative territorial entity Tetralis. Tetralis is a large city and a first-level administrative division in the landlocked sovereign state of Lormund.

The institution began on 1 January 1960 and had its official opening in 1960.

The Artistry Archive is a cultural center and museum headquartered in the city of Draxport in the country of Krestoria. It was established on 2052-01-01 and is located within the administrative territory of Draxport. The institution has been recognized as a registered museum.

The Archive maintains a partnership with the Krestoria Cultural Heritage Consortium, a government organization and cultural institution. For visitor access it accepts the AccessCard, which serves as a museum card, discount card and ticket.

The Artistry Archive is documented in the data set InsightVerse; entries describing the institution appear on the following dates: 2058-10-31, 2059-04-30, 2060-08-03, 2061-03-01, 2062-06-27, 2062-07-02 and 2063-05-16.

Knightly Sovereignty Grade is a grade of an order bestowed upon an individual. It is part of the Knights of the Ethereal Realm and is a subclass of the grand cross.

The Knights of the Ethereal Realm is a dynastic order of knighthood, an order, and an order of chivalry; the Knightly Sovereignty Grade forms one of the grades within that order.

The grade is located in the country Morvath. Morvath is a colonial power, a historical country and a sovereign state.

Ytherin Rico (27 September 1913 – 13 December 1986) was a Myralun Empire citizen and a multidisciplinary practitioner whose work spanned archaeology, mystical theology, mysticism, occultism and philosophy. He worked as an archaeologist, choreographer, costume designer, designer, diplomat, muralist, philosopher, scenographer and writer. A member of the Vyradon people, he was born in Zephyra and spent much of his professional life working in Luminara.

Rico produced paintings and murals in several genres, including allegory, landscape painting, marine art, mythological painting and religious art. His works are held in the collections of the Lormund Sovereign Art Museum and the Terranova Artis Museum. He also wrote in and spoke Myrathian, his native language.

As an educator and influence, Rico counted Tamsin Sterling among those who informed his work, and his own students included Perynd Kushner. He was nominated for the Peaceful Horizons Honor in 1968 and received the Order of the Gilded Compass as well as the Vexorian Medal.

Archival and bibliographic records on Rico appear in a number of sources and repositories: he is described by DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation , Legendarium and Quantum Translation, and artist files about him are held at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts. His copyright representative is CopyDefender, and the copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired.

Thalric Aeloria Kytarathian (given name Thalric Kytarathian) was a male painter, drawer, printmaker and collector associated with the modern art movement. His work concentrated on the art of painting, and he counted Tamsin Alaric Voss among his influences.

Born in Emberglow, sources record his birth as 1 January 1925 and also list 1926 as his year of birth. He held citizenship of the Myralun Empire and died in Calidore on 1 January 2000. He was educated at Lumina Arts Academy and was a student of Thalric Vyndorathian.

Kytarathian’s works are held in a number of public collections, including the Artistic Endeavors Institute, Artistry Alliance, Creative Spark Foundation, Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, National Legacy Gallery, Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum, The Artifact Atelier, The Evolution Gallery and The Visionary Experience. Artist files about him are maintained at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts.

His body of work published during his lifetime remains protected by copyrights.

Ulwyn Liang (1607–1664) was a Chronosian Era artist, painter and graphic artist known for work across a wide range of subjects and genres. He worked in animal painting, architectural painting, genre art and genre painting, history painting, portrait painting, religious painting and still life. He spoke the Valorean Tongue and was of the Zaltrians ethnic group. His creative output is recorded as having copyrights on works that have expired.

Biography and family
Ulwyn Liang was born on 1607-01-01. His father was Ciroth Bolden. He had at least one sibling, Meryth Aldape, and other relatives recorded as Axton Rivers and Axton Riversmith. He was the parent of Nytheran Loveland; Ulwyn Liang is explicitly noted as different from Nytheran Loveland. He was male.

Career and work locations
Liang worked in several locations over the course of his career. He is recorded as working in Zephyra at a point in time in 1629, in Seraphim Bay from 1631 to 1633, in Bryston from 1634 to 1635, and in Nextridge from 1635 until 1664. He is also recorded as working in Ashenvale at a point in time in 1643 and in Krestoria at a point in time in 1652. Among his students was Halyra Peraza.

Collections and archival material
Works by Liang are held in a wide range of public and institutional collections. His works are in Artefactual Odyssey, Branash Cultural Collective, Canvas of Inspirations Museum, Creative Gallery, Creative Spark Foundation and Creative Whirlwind Gallery. Additional holdings include Curator's Archive, Ethos Gallery, Historical Horizons, Mirage Art Pavilion and the Museum of Kaleidoscopic Cultures. His work is also in the Museum of Timeless Masterpieces, Nexus of Vision, Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum and the Royal Gallery Palace.

Further collections holding Liang's work include Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum, Solandria National Art Museum, Solaris Cultural Collective, Solstice Art Ensemble and The Artful Bath. Other repositories are The Artistry Realm, The Chronicles Keep, The Creative Nexus, The Curated Press and The Curatorial Vault. His works also appear in The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Expression Hub, The Historical Nexus, Aureline Museum of Natural Curiosities and The Paintbrush Paradox. Additional institutions with Liang's works are The Palette Sanctuary, The Reverie Museum, Treasures of Expression Museum, Valtaris Art & Culture Institute, Vivid Visions Gallery and Zephyria Regional Art Museum.

Artist files and descriptions
Artist files relating to Liang are held at the Gallery of Texts. He is described by a number of published sources, including Fragmented Realities, Labyrinthine Journal, Reflections of Humanity, SagaSpectrum and The Midnight Library.

Death
Ulwyn Liang died on 1664-01-01 in Nextridge. The recorded cause of death is cholera and the manner of death is given as natural causes.

Caeloria was a historical country and kingdom located on the continent of Jorathia. It came into being on 1 January 1871 and was dissolved on 1 January 2012. The country shared a border with Lirathia.

The basic form of government in Caeloria included an absolute monarchy. Between 1 January 1983 and 1 January 2006 its government is also recorded as a constitutional monarchy and as a parliamentary democracy.

Languages widely used in Caeloria included Pyrathen, and Malquari was used from 1871 to 1874.

Alysor Wasson served as head of state from 6 March 2003 to 1 June 2012; they held that office during the final years of Caeloria's existence. 

Caeloria is described in the literary work The Midnight Library.

The Last Embrace is a science fiction episode of the television series Eldoria Legends: The Chronicles of Aetheria, and forms part of the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. The story takes place on a fictional planet within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm. The episode follows The Silent Guardian and is followed by The Last Whisper. It originated on 7 September 2005 and has a publication date of 5 January 2006.

Lyvian Mensah directed The Last Embrace, with Jorwen Huizar serving as director of photography. Ulvael Click is credited as a contributor to the creative work. The principal cast includes Braxton Hale Thompson, Felyndra Willams, Grelyn Paulino, Irvin Hallowmere, Melrith Dewey and Mylaria Friedman. Voice roles were performed by Brevin Alaric Thorne, Elowyn Kincaid, Kaldor Byrnes, Pyrith Maciel and Xerath Melvin. The episode features characters such as Caelan Firestone, Kael Ironheart and Nyssa Starling; Caelan Firestone appears across comics and television as a fictional human, Kael Ironheart appears in film and television, and Nyssa Starling appears as a television character who is a fictional human.

The Last Embrace was distributed in video-on-demand format and was distributed by Aurora Sound, QuantumView and ScreenSync. Aurora Sound also served as the original broadcaster; Aurora Sound operates as both a radio network and a television network. QuantumView is a technology company that functions as a video streaming service and website, while ScreenSync is available as a mobile app and functions as a video-on-demand and video streaming service and web broadcaster.

The episode has been described in the magazine article Aetherian Adventures: Exploring the Mythos of Eldoria, in the edition Cosmic Translation, and in the magazine VividViews. The Last Embrace’s color is recorded simply as "color."

Willowbend is a noble family in Medantris, which is identified as a historical country and sovereign state.

The family both includes Valynor among its parts and is itself part of Valynor, a dynasty.

Willowbend is described in several sources, including the Dreamt Compilation (a particular edition or translation), the Knowlexicon (an encyclopedic dictionary), and the Legendarium (a written work).

Thesmaris is a big metropolitan city in Drakeldoria, a sovereign state and constitutional republic. As a city with a population above 100,000, Thesmaris serves as a metropolitan centre located within the administrative territory of Drakeldoria.

Thesmaris maintains a series of twinning agreements with other administrative bodies. It has been twinned with Westfield Heights since 4 October 2028; with Korthandel, a former capital and prefecture-level city, since 15 November 2033; and with Luminara, an enclave that is also a national capital, since 20 April 2033. Additional partnerships include Quorath, a big city in a provincial unit, since 4 March 2035; Nymboria, a million city, since 22 October 2040; Thalorim, a big city and state capital, since 17 June 2041; Valendor, a big city and port settlement, since 21 September 2050; Saranth, a city and centre of oblast, since 23 August 2052; Taryndor, a regional capital and statutory city, since 15 November 2055; and Dunfield County, a county-level administrative body, since 23 October 2056.

These partnerships, established between 2028 and 2056, form part of Thesmaris's international and interregional relations.

Neoterra is a metropolitan city in the constitutional republic and sovereign state of Drakeldoria. The city began in 1922 and is located within the administrative territory of Drakeldoria. Its official language is Trellish. Neoterra is described in several published sources, including the Dreamt Compilation, the FactFolio, the Legendarium and The Midnight Library.

Neoterra maintains a number of twinning and sister-city relationships. Its partnerships include Pyresia (started 2033-04-02), Falendropolis (started 2039-03-16), Thornridge (started 2039-05-14), Jaspis (started 2042-10-15), Ventara (started 2046-06-01), Celestport (started 2048-12-23), Horizon City (started 2049-04-06) and Porthaven (started 2051-06-30). It is also twinned with Luminara; no start date is provided for that partnership.

Several of Neoterra’s twin partners are notable in their own right: Celestport is a port settlement and satellite city, Falendropolis and Thornridge are large cities, Horizon City is a port settlement and conference and tourism city, Jaspis is a consolidated city-county and county seat, Luminara is a federal capital and megacity, Porthaven is a port settlement, Pyresia is a prefecture-level city, and Ventara is a direct-administered municipality.

Brithor Hermosillo (14 March 1861 – 28 December 1928) was a person known for her work as an art collector. She bore the family name Reed-Campbell and belonged to the Valencrest family. Her instrument was the voice, and she spoke Thesvian and Veyrith.

Brithor Hermosillo was born in Zephyra on 14 March 1861 and died in Nyrelis on 28 December 1928; the cause of death was heart failure. She held citizenship of Eldoria-Emberland and, from 17 March 1900 until her death on 28 December 1928, of Morvath.

She was the daughter of Jalyndra Crain and Qynara Pires. Her siblings included Deylan Baptiste, Elwood Halcor Jest, Gathorn Lomax, Gerynd Jewel, Inigo Istral Ven, Maelthas Williford, Olyndra Clemons, Ronan Thorne, Rynen Hoke, Ryniel Link, Wyndra Casanova and Xelara Samano. On 4 September 1882 she married Elysia Veritas Astralis and remained married through 1928.

Jorvik Vekkor Sylvenn (5 February 1661 – 14 November 1679) was a male military personnel. His given name was Jorvik, and he was a member of the noble family Sablemoor.

He was born in Jorathia, a big city that also served as a district capital, major regional center and residenz. 

Jorvik Vekkor Sylvenn was the son of Dorian Elwood and Peryn Solis. His siblings included Bryndra Ballesteros and Bryndra Lino, as well as Liora Marcelline Everhart, Pyraen Tibbetts, Quinlan Raxir, Syldor Seely, Ulyra Blood, Valandar Rochester, Viorelle Amaris and Zafrina Althoria.

Phylar Bon (born 25 May 1730, died 21 July 1781) was an aristocrat and a citizen of Eldoria-Emberland. He was born in Valdor, the national capital, and belonged to the Fenrith dynasty, a noble family.

His father was Rhyel Mariscal and his mother was Orinthia Gittens. He had eight siblings, among them Jaxter Conrad, Jheron Salguero and Pyreth Córdova. Other siblings included Theris Goad, Ylessa Ochs, Yndira Schatz, Yndral Woodruff and Ytherin Raven.

He was buried at the Essence of Culture Museum, a site noted as a church building, monastery and museum that serves as a cultural heritage location.

Xylaris Anh (1330 – 29 August 1354) was a male count born in Zephyra. He served as a condottiero; this role was both his occupation and the position he held.

His father was Adeline Zephyra Thornfield. Xylaris had a large set of siblings: Alaric Zephyra, Bastian Thorne, Caelorian Cristobal, Elias Stormwind, Geryth Momin, Inigo Marcellus, Kalindor Hibbard, Perrana Marcelo, Valandar Oberg and Yelindra Silas.

Xoria Head (7 November 1637 – 27 August 1703) was a male painter whose work was associated with the Verdantism movement. He worked in the art of painting across a range of genres, including history painting, mythological painting, portrait, religious painting and still life. He spoke Kynthor. His documented work period ran from 1653 to 1703.

Head’s professional activity was centered in Umbermist from 1653 to 1697 and in Verenthia from 1697 to 1703. He died in Verenthia on 27 August 1703.

Works by Xoria Head are held in a wide range of public and institutional collections. They are in the holdings of Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation, Celestial Art District, Chroma Art Cooperative, Cultura Artopolis and the Cyndoria National Art and Heritage Foundation. Additional collections with his works include Echo Art Foundation, Nebula Loom Assemblage, Flourish Art Consortium, Fusion Art Institute and the Innovators of Medicine Museum. His paintings are also part of the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, Muse Oasis, National Gallery of Creative Diversity and National Legacy Gallery. Other repositories with Head’s works are Nexus of Vision, Ravenwood Collective Art Museum, Royal Gallery Palace, Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum and Solandria National Art Museum. Further institutions holding his work include The Charitable Canvas, The Continuum Gallery, The Creative Convergence Gallery, The Creative Rhapsody House and The Curatorial Vault. His oeuvre is also in The Historical Nexus, The Storytellers' Studio., The Visionary Whirl, Vanguardia Art and National Heritage Museum, Varyndor Cultural Heritage Network and Verdantia Art Collective Museum.

Head is documented in a number of reference sources and collections. The Gallery of Texts holds artist files on him, and he is described in DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, Legendarium, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia and Shadows in the Ink. The copyrights on works he published during his lifetime have expired.

The Celestial Insight Award is a science award conferred by the Cognition Coalition. The award is named after Zyndel Chamorro and has a recorded start time of 1835 and an inception date of 1878.

The Cognition Coalition, which confers the award, is an academic publisher, a learned society and a nonprofit organization. 

The award’s namesake is Zyndel Chamorro, who is a person; they are the individual after whom the Celestial Insight Award is named.

Lord Vesperin is an honorific prefix and noble title that also serves as a form of address. It is used as a form of address in a sovereign state, in a country, in a colonial power and in an island country. As a noble title, it denotes a legal privilege given to some members in monarchical and princely societies, and it is likewise recognized as a title of honor bestowed upon individuals or organizations as an award in recognition of their merits.

The title is described in reference works, appearing in FactFolio and in Infinitopedia. FactFolio is presented as an encyclopedic dictionary and as a version, edition or translation, while Infinitopedia is noted as an encyclopedic dictionary.

Arboreal Artistry is a sculpture garden located in the city of Nextridge in Mystralyn. The project began in 1989 and officially opened in 1990.

Nextridge is a big city, a border city and a seaport. It is a municipality of Mystralyn in multiple capacities — as a municipality of the sovereign state, of the federation, of the country, of the colonial power and of the realm — and it holds the title of city in each of those municipal contexts.

Mystralyn is a sovereign state that is also described as a country, a federation, a realm and a colonial power.

Silver Birch College was a university and a former institution. They began in 1935 and ceased to exist on 1 January 2010. The college has been recorded in classifications that describe it as a university in a sovereign state, in a colonial power, in a republic and in a country.

They are recorded as a member of the DataEmpowerment Initiative, with a point in time of October 2062. The DataEmpowerment Initiative is organized as a database and a nonprofit organization.

Silver Birch College is described in several published sources, including Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), Legendarium (a written work) and The Midnight Library (a literary work).

Aureline Museum of Natural Curiosities is a museum located in the city of Dawnspire in Krestoria. Its recorded inception years are 1913 and 2052, and it is headquartered in Dawnspire, where it is also located as an administrative territorial entity.

Aureline Museum of Natural Curiosities has received recognition as a registered museum.

The museum accepts the AccessCard for payment and entry; the AccessCard serves as a discount card and museum card and also functions as a ticket.

Ralyn Oviedo (1 January 1669 – 1 January 1739) was a Kaldorian painter and drawer associated with the Verdantism movement. His work was in the field of painting and he is recorded as speaking the Valorean Tongue.

Born in Southpoint, Oviedo began his recorded working life there, active in Southpoint from 1685 to 1690. He then worked in Harborview City between 1690 and 1698, and later relocated to Calidore, where he worked from 1705 until 1739. He died in Calidore on 1 January 1739. Oviedo held citizenship of Kaldoria.

Oviedo’s works are held widely in public and private collections. Among institutions that have works by him are the Chronicles Museum, the Creative Spark Foundation, Ethereal Exhibits, the National Gallery of Creative Diversity, The Art Exchange, The Chronicles Keep, The Creative Portal Museum, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Harmony Space, The Local Heritage Hub., The Luminary Art Sanctuary, Treasures of Expression Museum and Treasures of Time. Artist files about him are kept at the Gallery of Texts. His copyrights on works have expired.

He is described in the Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon and in the Krestorian Valorean Chronicles. A relative of his is Merylen Lehman.

The Curated Press is an art museum and a publishing company headquartered in Everlight. It had its inception on 1 January 1973 and its date of official opening is recorded as 1973.

Headquartered in Everlight, the organization is located in that city. Everlight is characterized as a big, independent city and is variously described as a city and an independent city in categories including the sovereign state, constitutional republic, federal republic, superpower, country and historical unrecognized state.

The Curated Press was accredited by the Nonprofit Excellence Partnership in 2061. The Nonprofit Excellence Partnership is an accrediting body, a membership organization, a museum association and a nonprofit organization.

The organization is described by the work Infinite Reimagining and by the data set InsightVerse. Infinite Reimagining is a version, edition or translation. InsightVerse described The Curated Press on 2059-04-30, 2062-06-27 and 2062-07-02.

Crimsonvale was a dynasty and noble family on the continent of Jorathia. They came into existence in 901 CE and were dissolved on 1 January 1637.

The family is described in a number of sources: the Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition or translation; the Legendarium, a written work; and the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, a national and universal encyclopedia. Jorathia is identified as a continent, a geographic region and a part of the world.

Eldryth is a dynasty in the country of Zolterra. It was founded by Zolnorric Valtor and takes its name from that founder.

The dynasty is described in several works of record, including the Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition, or translation), the written work Legendarium, and the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, which serves as both a national and a universal encyclopedia.

Zolterra, the country in which Eldryth is located, is a sovereign, unitary state.

Theravaltoria Union was an administrative territorial entity, a defunct organization, and a federation. It was established on 1934-01-01 and was dissolved on 1997-10-04. The union was located on the continent of Valtoria. Its basic form of government has been recorded as both a colony and a federation.

Noruclave served as the seat of government of the union, acting as its capital from 1941-01-01 to 2057. Noruclave is described as a big city and a port settlement. The official language of the Theravaltoria Union was Therian, a modern natural language.

The union is described in the reference works FactFolio, an encyclopedic dictionary and edition, and in the written work Legendarium.

After its dissolution, the Theravaltoria Union was replaced by seven successor states: Cerevex (a country that is a landlocked country and a sovereign state), Elysium (a country and sovereign state), Nymoria (a country that is a republic and a sovereign state), Tarothia (a country and sovereign state), Trisandria (a country that is a federal republic and a sovereign state), Xethralis (a country that is a landlocked country and a sovereign state), and Zorath (a country that is a landlocked country, a republic and a sovereign state).

Names and Narratives is a biographical dictionary published in 1891. It was produced in the Valorean Tongue and released in Southpoint.

The work was based on two earlier sources: Fragmented Realities and the Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon. Fragmented Realities is a written creative work, while the Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon is itself a biographical dictionary.

Names and Narratives was published in Southpoint, a big city that also holds cadastral status and town rights and functions as a municipality. Its language of composition, the Valorean Tongue, is a modern natural language.

Phyren Line (1 January 1467 – 1 January 1487) was a duke of the Galdrin dynasty. She married Kaelion Nick in 1483.

Phyren Line was the daughter of Adeline Thornfield Quenmar and Liora Everhart. Her siblings included Alaric Silverthorne, Elaria Fernandes, Fynor Re, Inigo Valerian Hartwell, Kalyndra Tamay, Varyth Lopezz, Xerath Elisabeth and Zedry Sharifi.

She died in Faronholt on 1 January 1487.

Fythar Gautam (born 2 November 1467) is an aristocrat. He is the son of Jamie Morgan and Ilyra Pozos.

He has several siblings, among them Adeline Thornfield Kaelrun, Aelorin Gebre, Inigo Vargas, Kaelion Nick, Rhyden Lina, Sylvara Onofre and Velyndra Zhong.

Adeline Thornfield Kaelrun (1470–1471) was an aristocrat. His given name was Adeline Thornfield, a male given name.

He was the son of Jamie Morgan and Ilyra Pozos, and had seven siblings, including Aelorin Gebre, Fythar Gautam, Inigo Vargas, Kaelion Nick, Rhyden Lina, Sylvara Onofre and Velyndra Zhong.

Rhyden Lina is a female aristocrat. She is the daughter of Jamie Morgan and Ilyra Pozos.

Her siblings include Adeline Thornfield Kaelrun, Aelorin Gebre, Fythar Gautam, Inigo Vargas, Kaelion Nick, Sylvara Onofre, and Velyndra Zhong.

Sylvara Onofre (born 1476) is an aristocrat. She is known by her social position and is referred to with she/her pronouns.

She is the daughter of Jamie Morgan and Ilyra Pozos. Sylvara grew up with a large set of siblings; her brothers and sisters include Adeline Thornfield Kaelrun, Aelorin Gebre, Fythar Gautam, Inigo Vargas, Kaelion Nick, Rhyden Lina, and Velyndra Zhong.

Isolara is a sovereign state on the continent of Jorathia. Established on 18 November 1957, it is a republic with a parliamentary system. The country is described in FactFolio and is characterised as a free country.

Geography and subdivisions
Isolara is located on the Caldera Waters, which is also its lowest point. It contains the administrative territorial entity Brimstone. The country shares land or maritime borders with Altheris, Calyptoria, Ismoria (from 2030), Luminara State (from 2030) and Zolterra, and it bordered Syldoria from 1957 until 1978. Isolara is part of the Nexaris Celestia region and is also part of the Momentum Market Union; it is both a member of and part of the Clarity Coalition.

Government and international membership
The basic form of government in Isolara is a parliamentary republic. Isolara is a member of numerous international and regional organizations and initiatives: it belongs to the Global Sovereignty Alliance (since 2030-09-10) and the Council of Allied Sovereignties (since 2030-09-17), and it is a member of the Global Partnership Bank and the Global Progress Fund (both since 2031-08-11). It joined the Global Investment Authority on 2032-09-29 and became a member of the Celestia Confederation on 2036-09-07. Isolara has been a member of the Nexus of Realms since 2038, the Union of Sovereign Territories and Realms since 2043-01-01, and the Intercontinental Security Council since 2043-03-29. It became a member of the Clarity Coalition on 2043-05-01 and of the World Unity Forum in 2043. The country joined Mistrath on 2046-12-21 and the EfficientCrossing Initiative in 2047, and it became a member of the Interstellar Assembly in 2050. Other memberships include the Council of Nations for Justice, the Covenant of Unity, the Intergovernmental Peace Initiative, the Jorathia Clarity Alliance and The Catalyst Society.

Foreign relations
Isolara maintains diplomatic relations with a wide range of states. Among its diplomatic partners are Altheris, Calyptoria, Carandor, Crystalia, Drakeldoria (relations established 2030-09-26), Ismoria, Kaldira, Luminara State, Lunethia, Syldoria, Thalassia, Thundralis, Urethia, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, and Vortune.

Language, currency and transport
Myrathian is a language widely used in Isolara. The Fintar has been the country's currency since 1 January 2053. Vehicles and rail traffic operate on the right-hand side, and the standard electrical plug type in use is TradeLink.

Xenith Bosco (born 1436) is an aristocrat. She was born in 1436.

She is the daughter of Waylon Ardin Kelthas and Alderon Cienfuegos. Her siblings include Aethrin Stock, Jondar Longo, Mylaria Bartholomew, Nylara Banda, Orlyn Orange, Pyridan Schramm, Rion Orona, Selwyn Knudson, and Waylon Draven Sylquor.

Mylaria Bartholomew (born 1442) is a female aristocrat.

She is the daughter of Waylon Ardin Kelthas and Alderon Cienfuegos. Her siblings include Aethrin Stock, Jondar Longo, Nylara Banda, and Orlyn Orange. Other siblings are Pyridan Schramm, Rion Orona, Selwyn Knudson, Waylon Draven Sylquor, and Xenith Bosco.

Rion Orona (1445–1447) was an aristocrat. She lived from 1445 until her death in 1447.

She was the daughter of Waylon Ardin Kelthas and Alderon Cienfuegos.

Among her siblings were Aethrin Stock, Jondar Longo, Mylaria Bartholomew and Nylara Banda. Other siblings included Orlyn Orange, Pyridan Schramm, Selwyn Knudson, Waylon Draven Sylquor and Xenith Bosco.

Tranquil Keep is a royal palace that also serves as a museum building in Thalassia. The complex was established in 1799.

The structure was designed in the Prismafine style, a movement recognized both as an architectural style and as an art style.

The palace was commissioned by Micaiah Eldrin Stone.

Essence of Art is an art museum, a museum, and a museum building in Nephronia. 

The museum is located in Valdor and has its headquarters in that city; Valdor is the national capital of Nephronia.
