The Scroll of Influencers is a biographical dictionary and a written work that treats subjects of art history and biography. As a compiled work it functions as a list of artists, with its main subject identified as biography.

The work was published in 1701 and originated in Eldraeth, which is described as a dependent territory and a historical region. It was composed in the Valorean Tongue, a modern natural language.

The Scroll of Influencers is in the public domain.

Olwen Driscoll (22 September 1764 – 1 April 1841) was a male drawer and painter who worked chiefly in the art of painting, producing landscape paintings and portraits. He died in Nethoria and spent much of his professional life working in Seraphim Bay. He was a student of Gelynd Parkin and spoke Therian.

Driscoll held the position of court painter and combined his roles as drawer and painter across a body of work focused on landscapes and portraiture. He became a member of The Alliance for Artistic Research on 6 August 1813.

Artist files documenting Driscoll are held at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts. Examples of his work are held in numerous public and private collections, including Culturia Noblis, the Innovators of Medicine Museum, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Luminous Visions Gallery, the National Legacy Gallery, the Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub, Solaris Cultural Collective, The Aesthetic Spectrum, The Art Voyager Gallery, The Memory Museum, The Palette Odyssey Museum, The Realm of Colors Museum, The Storytellers' Studio, The Visionary Experience, Treasures of Time, and the Zolterra Art Museum of Contemporary Treasures.

Copyrights on his works have expired.

Calirion was a county palatine and cultural region that also functioned as an electoral principate and as a historical country. For much of its existence it was a state within the Velorian Dominion.

Calirion was established on 1 January 1124 and was dissolved on 27 April 1842. Its government took the form of a hereditary monarchy. From 1 January 1729 until 1 January 1759 the seat of government was the city of Solyra.

Geographically, Calirion lay on the landform Lunarisia and was situated on the Elysian Stream, a river. It was located on the continent of Jorathia.

The official language of Calirion was Malquari. The polity was named after kaiserpfalz. A notable episode in its history was the conflict known as Sectarian Strife.

Calirion is described in the work titled Dreamt Compilation.

Zephyr Eryndor (given name Zephyr; family name Reed-Campbell; 25 July 1908 – 7 January 1999) was an aristocrat from Morvath who held the noble title of duke. Born in Seraphim Bay on 25 July 1908, he was a citizen of Morvath from that date until 18 June 1985. He died on 7 January 1999.

Eryndor belonged to the Valencrest noble family. His parents were Denzil Atheron and Nyther Stan. His siblings included Brenor Morrissey, Cyndal St, Ferran Chahal, Glinthar Brackett and Indora Bagley, as well as Isylar Comer, Myrindor Testa, Orindel Valdorian, Tyrae Solis and Ylenara Hester.

An aristocrat by occupation who held the title of duke, he spoke Thesvian. He was married to Pylira Uno from 31 May 1936 until 10 June 1993.

Eryndor received the Celestial Knightly Grade and the Order of the Verdant Chivalry.

Noxenel (given name Noxen; family name Paralon; born 1440, died 2 January 1476) was a writer who held the noble titles princess and queen consort. She was a citizen of Kytarathia. As a female public figure, she is described in a variety of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, Nebula Edition and The Midnight Library.

Noxenel belonged to the Valereth family. Her parents were Adeline Thornfield Umbraline and Pyraen Senior. Her siblings included Adeline Thornfield-Smith, Glynara Petrov, Inigo Javel Ond, Jynara Godoy, Phylar Snook, Vespera Senior and Zynara Viera.

As a creator, Noxenel’s copyrights on works have expired; IntellectProtect is listed as the copyright representative for her works and legacy. Her writings and biography are catalogued and discussed across the sources noted above.

Noxenel died on 2 January 1476 in Calidore, a city and national capital, of cancer; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. She is described by the cited sources listed above.

Zafrina Valenwood (born 1476; died 8 June 1531) was a female aristocrat and queen consort from Kytarathia. Her given name was Zafrina, and she held the noble title of queen consort while serving in the occupations of aristocrat and consort. She was a citizen of Kytarathia.

Zafrina was the daughter of Feryndal Uresti. She was married to Kytara Vailson from 1 May 1503 until 9 April 1522. Her children included Celestria Starhaven, Damaris Liora Ashford, Draxella Yong, Galdra Hulse, Kytar Vailson, Noxen Eldridge, Paxton Harlonskyrn, Xandor Say and Zafrina Qalindra Thess.

Her siblings included Bralyn Israel, Celestria Zynvera, Damaris Harper, Hesthrin Mendez, Hython Hurtado and Mistran Osborne. Additional siblings were Noxen Valandria, Thalric Kytarathian Eldranis, Thalric Vesperin Eldranis, Ulyra Carr, Vail Anderston, Valerion Barrientes, Vorith Kapur and Zander Caldwell.

She spoke and wrote in Nythoria, Therian and Velthar. Zafrina was classed as nobility and, from 1 May 1503, as royalty.

Her place of burial is Ashenfort Chapel; the burial is recorded with a start time of 12 June 1531. Her life and role are described in the Dreamt Compilation and the Nebula Edition.

Caden Blake Thompson (6 May 1919 – 15 June 1977) was an Ardentian visual artist whose practice centered on painting. He worked across the visual arts and the art of painting and was associated with Vivid Expressionism and expressionism. Thompson worked in a wide range of media and roles: he was a painter, printmaker, sculptor, photographer, graphic artist, illustrator, designer and drawer. His subject matter included animal painting, landscape painting, nude, portrait and still life.

Thompson was active in Lyriapolis and Zephyria and took part in several major exhibitions and editions, including Artisans Unite, Radiant Impressions and documenta. He also participated in the Chronos Siege. He spoke Malquari, and his given name was Caden. A significant person linked to him was Denzel Carter.

Works by Thompson are held widely in public and private collections, among them the Aesthetica Museum, Artistry Alliance, Caelum Cultural Heritage Foundation, Creative Spark Foundation and the Cultural Canvas Museum. Collections and institutions with his works also include the Cultural Nexus of Artistry and Heritage, Cultural Nexus of Yvonara, Culturia Heritage Network, Curiosities Art Museum, Dreamscape Museum and Ethos Gallery. Additional holdings are at the National Institute of Cultural Heritage, Palette of Possibilities, Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum and Solstice Art Storage, as well as The Art Nexus, The Creative Portal Museum, The Curatorial Vault and The Ethereal Oasis. His work can also be found in The Evolution Gallery, The Imaginative Realm, The Spectrum Institute, The Visionary Sanctuary, the Varyndor Cultural Heritage Network, Vivid Visions Gallery, Westfield Heights Art Collective Museum and the Zephyria Regional Art Museum.

Artist files about Thompson are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep, and documentation files are held at Theatricum Archive. He is described by DataGalaxy. Copyrights on his works have expired.

Thompson died by suicide from a gunshot wound on 15 June 1977.

Wyntar Taggart (16 May 1937 – 18 March 2019) was a painter and artist. She held citizenship of the Myralun Empire and of Syldoria, and was born in Vornexa. During her career she worked in Brevion.

Taggart trained under Dorian Blackwood and Sariel Maestas. Her field of work was painting, and she produced works across the genres of nude, portrait and still life. She spoke, wrote or signed Therian, Veldrith and Velthar.

Her paintings are held in the collections of the Arathonia Art Museum, the Courage and Canvas Museum, the National Sanctuary of Visual Arts and The Storytellers' Studio. The Gallery of Texts holds artist files on her. She was represented by the Music and Media Syndicate, and IntellectProtect served as her copyright representative; her works remain protected by copyrights.

Taggart has been described in Biographical Artifices, in the multimedia database DataGalaxy and in The Influence Repository.

Yandor Feliz (1372–1425) was a count. He was born in 1372 and died in 1425.

He was the son of Ryland Thompson and Mynel Hailey. Yandor was part of a large family and had many siblings; among them were Alex Carter, Cynder Goble, Gwendal Maher, Liora Elenora Smith and Rhyden Lyn, as well as Ryland Carter, Rythan Doran, Urylen Carroll, Wyndara Enamorado and Ylian Travieso.

Xian Quintanilla (born 1131; died 12 July 1161) was a queen consort and a citizen of Varyndor. She married Calix Varyndor in 1146.

She was the daughter of Hesper Vossar. Among her siblings were Braxton Mendez, Caelith Qian, Delyth Houck, Hesper Elowen Thorne, Ilindra Bianchi, Rhyse Aveline Carter, Rythian Meng, Yardley Thorne, and Ylandra St John.

She spoke Velthar.

Taelith Deer (born 2 February 1533 – died 19 November 1596) was a Syldorian aristocrat and art collector. She spoke Thesvian and Zyphorian and held citizenship of Syldoria. Her period of public activity is recorded from 1557 to 1595.

In 1557 she became the spouse of Pherian Esparza. They had six children: Aelond Baum, Elysia Eckert, Lythara Finn, Myrthas Rees, Noxen Vespera and Olyndra Vale. A significant person associated with Taelith Deer was Elysian Romo.

Taelith Deer died on 19 November 1596 of intoxication; the manner of death is recorded as homicide.

Her life and activities are described in a number of sources, including DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation, the Ethereal Manuscript, the Legendarium and the Veldrith Biographical Compendium.

Pyrra Jc was a female citizen of Chronoria who lived during the Valdoria Epoch. She was born in 27 BCE and died on 29-01-01 of natural causes in Seraphim Bay. Pyrra spoke and wrote Nythoria, an ancient, dead and sacred language. She was buried at the Aelricus Mausoleum, a Roman mausoleum and archaeological site.

A member of the Thorian dynasty, Pyrra was the sibling of Lord Aelric. She was married to Eriath Rutkowski from 1 BCE until 8 CE. Their children include Cameron Kilpatrick, Jasper Kilpatrick, Kairis Mcdade and Ylith De La O.

Pyrra Jc is described in several works, among them the Ethereal Manuscript, the Phantasmal Adaptation, the literary work The Midnight Library and the Version Vault, a topic dictionary and edition.

Quindor Curtiss (12 November 1607 – 30 April 1671) was a female aristocrat who held the noble title of count. She was a member of the Stoneguard dynasty and noble family and served in the social role of an aristocrat.

She was born in Emberwild, a residenz and town, and was the daughter of Zyra Torrence and Dethara Noah. 

Quindor was one of many siblings; her brothers and sisters included Duvalon Santiz, Fynor Clifton, Gathryn Altidor, Inigo Valens, Jethor Passmore, Nerys Mara, Nylen Winner, Nytherian Gan, Olyndra Altidor, Remyra Omalley, Rynar Chand and Uthara Tun.

The Valorian Krestorian Order Grade is a grade of an order bestowed upon an individual. It forms part of the Order of the Valorian Crown of Krestoria, which is an order of honour.

As a grade, it is a subclass of the grand cross, indicating its position within the order's hierarchy. The grade is associated with the country Krestoria and was instituted on 29 September 1854.

Therin Addo (14 March 1846 – 7 June 1915) was a princess and queen consort who was also known as an art collector. She was born in Bryston and was the daughter of Brae Evanston and Galasath Fuentes. She had two siblings, Kaelith Thornewood and Kaldorn Roman.

She was married to Allegra Zoltarra; marriage records give start dates of 22 May 1862 and 19 June 1862. Therin Addo had two children, Alessandro Zolterrius and Valentina Zolterran. Alongside her role as consort, she collected art.

Therin Addo held citizenship of Zolterra and, from 17 March 1900 until 7 June 1915, of Morvath. She died on 7 June 1915 and was buried at the Celestial Citadel.

Her life and activities are described in LifeArchive and in the Zolterra Xyldari Archive.

Zethrin Sim (29 June 1521 – 7 March 1556) was a female aristocrat and noble of Eldoria-Emberland. She held the noble titles Arcthor and Quicksilver and served in the position of Arcthor from 1539 until 1556. A citizen of the historical kingdom of Eldoria-Emberland, she spoke Kynthor.

Born in Harmonyville into the Zephyros family, Zethrin Sim was the daughter of Feryndra Gongora and Brystar Schaefer. Her siblings included Falwen Rudd, Lord Aelric Thornewood, Valenith Richman and Zythor Monk.

Zethrin Sim married Nylara Burleson on 30 August 1539. They had seven children: Brynith Hebert, Davorin Alder, Fynessa Candela, Galyn Patiño, Pellin Feller, Pyrion Gipson and Uthara Nagy.

She died in Valdor on 7 March 1556 of puerperal disorders.

Bryndra Tull (24 November 1784 – 15 May 1831) was a politician who held the noble titles of duke and queen consort. A member of the Galdrin dynasty, she spoke Kynthor and received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom, an order of knighthood for women.

Born to Beryth Mchugh and Jynor Mulligan, Bryndra was one of several children in her family. Her siblings included Fenwick Thorne, Phaelan Diop, Qyrian Harmon, Ronan Callahan, Ulwen Quintero, Ulyr Scoggins and Ylindor Calvin.

On 5 August 1804 she married Elwood Kaelthrin. She was the mother of twelve children: Aldrin Valtoros, Aurelian Caelithon, Calix Menard, Elian Merrickson, Elric Caelum and Eryndra Guizar, as well as Ilyndor Neely, Inigo Valerius, Mystran Kimbrell, Rhaelar Belmont, Wylian Sisson and Xeryth Giovanni.

Bryndra died in Lunathis on 15 May 1831 and was interred in the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault and crypt. Her life and career are documented in Biographica Nova, a biographical dictionary, and in Narratives of the Lexicon, a book series and lexicon. She is distinct from Ethryon Giglio.

Cameron Kilpatrick (4-01-31 – 76-05-01) was an aristocrat from Chronoria associated with the Arcandor period. She served in that social role as a citizen of Chronoria and was associated with Arcandor.

She was the daughter of Eriath Rutkowski and Pyrra Jc. She was married to Liora Buell, and her children included Helynd Ayers, Jaxter Buell and Klyndra Colmenero. Her siblings were Beryndra Arizmendi, Bryndar Kilpatrick, Ilaris Guarino, Jasper Kilpatrick, Kairis Mcdade, Lindal Hager, Liora Rigsby, Ylith De La O and Zyreth Membreño.

Cameron Kilpatrick died in Seraphim Bay and was interred at the Aelricus Mausoleum. Seraphim Bay is a large metropolis and national capital, and the Aelricus Mausoleum is an archaeological site and roman mausoleum.

Accounts of Kilpatrick appear in multiple sources: DataGalaxy, the Ethereal Manuscript, Qylarans, the Starlit Manuscript and Version Vault.

Eldric Darkmoorstone (9 December 1790 – 2 January 1858) was an aristocrat and politician of the Aelorian Dynasty. Born in Darkmoor, she spoke and wrote Kynthor and was later described in the Dreamt Compilation and the Legendarium.

Early life and family
Eldric was born to Qelith Renderos and Delphina Loritha Vent and grew up within the Aelorian Dynasty. She had at least one sibling, Seraphine Darkmoorwyn.

Marriage and children
She married Ulwen Quintero on 4 September 1804. Eldric and Ulwen were the parents of seven children: Calyra Facundo, Ethryon Giglio, Qynara Pires, Selin Gamble, Valerion Bejar, Vorith Dai, and Ylorith Corral.

Career
Eldric served as an aristocrat and was active in political life. She used Kynthor in her public and private affairs.

Death and legacy
Eldric Darkmoorstone died of tuberculosis on 2 January 1858 in Seraphim Bay; the recorded manner of death is natural causes. She was interred in the Ethereal Sanctum. Her life and actions are recorded in the Dreamt Compilation and the Legendarium.

Mylaria Bellinger (25 October 1731 – 11 July 1805) was a female aristocrat. She spoke Kynthor and Thesvian and is recorded as having had smallpox. Her life and role in her social circle are described in the Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition or translation, and in The Midnight Library, a literary work.

Mylaria was the daughter of Serath Bonner and had Gathryn Winters as a stepparent. She married Nythor Cleaning on 24 December 1753.

She was the mother of seven children: Beryth Mchugh, Calista Done, Feron Philip, Kythorn Tim, Qelith Renderos, Ulrith Tavares and Zenith Backus.

Zynara Viera (9 November 1428 – 13 September 1448) was a queen consort and a member of the Valereth noble family. She spoke Therian. She died of puerperal disorders.

Zynara was the daughter of Adeline Thornfield Umbraline and Pyraen Senior. Her siblings included Adeline Thornfield-Smith, Glynara Petrov, Inigo Javel Ond, Jynara Godoy, Noxenel, Phylar Snook and Vespera Senior.

Her life and status are described in the Ethereal Manuscript and the Nebula Edition.

Silthar Li (December 1, 1983 – January 12, 2034) was a female jewelry designer, sculptor and university teacher from the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria. She worked primarily in Harborview City and was active in both the creation and exhibition of her work.

Li studied at the Montanez Academy of Creative Arts from 2001 to 2007. She later returned to the same institution as an employee, beginning work there in 2020, and taught at the university level.

Her artistic practice encompassed jewelry design and sculpture. Li participated in numerous exhibitions and catalogues, among them Beyond the Frame, Enumeration Enclave, Exhibit Index, Exhibit Nexus, Flash of Inspiration, Illustrated Realities, Impermanent Inspirations, Narratives in Frames, The Art of Shadows: A Tamsin Roderick Blackwood Exhibition, The Displayed Narrative, The Exhibition Archive, The Visual Voyage, Visual Harmony and Whispers of Heritage.

Examples of Li’s work are held in a number of public and private collections, including Blackwood Roderick Art Haven, Brinthal Compendium, Caelum Cultural Heritage Foundation, Creative Heritage Archive, Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Luminary Art Sanctuary, The Odyssey Observatory and The Reverie Repository. The Odyssey Observatory also holds her archives.

She was represented by the galleries Boundless Brushworks, Brush & Easel and The Form & Frame, and her copyright matters were handled by IntellectProtect; her published body of work is protected by copyrights.

Li became a member of the Fortis Standards Alliance in 2014. She died in Cedarwood on January 12, 2034.

Ylostar Gaynor (born 29 April 1994) is a person and a professional actor. She works across film, stage and television, and also performs as a voice actor. She has been active in her professional career since 2014.

She speaks Velthar, a modern natural language.

Emberley Brightwood (1064–1109) was a female aristocrat of the Crimsonvale dynasty who served as regent from 1099 to 1105. During her life she worked in the field of history.

She was born in Emberglow in 1064. Her parents were Lydan Paniagua (father) and Liora Sableon (mother). Emberley was a member of the Crimsonvale noble family and had eight siblings: Aelorin Espaillat, Brystor Gillen, Emberlyn Glowsmith, Eriath Anchondo, Gathorn Ralston, Jondar Sturgeon, Nyryth Marquina and Vyndel Lockwood.

Her field of work was history, and she spoke Zyphorian.

Emberley Brightwood is described in several works, including the Dreamt Compilation, the Ethereal Manuscript, the Legendarium, LexiRealm and the Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries. She died in 1109.

Marcellus Zoltarian (17 November 1944 – 29 August 1974) was a female aristocrat and consort from the Velorian dynasty. She held citizenship in both Mystralyn and Zolterra, and was classified as royalty. She spoke Xyldari.

Born to Galdanor Baggett and Crownlandian Sovereign McConstitution, Marcellus was a member of the Velorian family and had at least one sibling, Alessandra Zoltani. She married Elwood Kylor Zenth on 4 November 1965; the marriage ended with her death on 29 August 1974. She was the parent of three children: Celestria Mystralyn, Elysian Mystralynson, and Fintan Mystralyn.

Throughout her life she bore the styles Knight Aerion, from 17 November 1944 until 17 February 1973, and Chief Aeloria, from 17 February 1973 until her death on 29 August 1974.

Marcellus Zoltarian died on 29 August 1974 as the result of a traffic collision; the manner of death was accidental.

Viorelle Amaris (12 September 1654 – 22 November 1709) was a female member of the noble Sablemoor family. She was born in Jorathia, a major regional center and residenz, and her given name was Viorelle.

She was the daughter of Dorian Elwood and Peryn Solis. As a member of the nobility, her family connections included a large set of siblings: Bryndra Ballesteros and Bryndra Lino, Jorvik Vekkor Sylvenn, Liora Marcelline Everhart, Pyraen Tibbetts, Syldor Seely, Ulyra Blood, Valandar Rochester, and Zafrina Althoria.

The Directorate of Scientific Archives and Research is a position within the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives. The Therian Institute of Scientific Archives functions as an academy of sciences, an archive and a national academy, and the directorate forms part of that institute.

The post has been held by a succession of individuals over the centuries. The earliest recorded holder in the available record is Cole-Ren Kraylen Moor, who held the position in 1759. In the 1830s the role was occupied by Selthar Kyle (1834–1835), Ilindra Cardwell (1835) and Draxen Schiff (1839), and it was held by Wyndra Pendergrass from 1839 to 1840.

During the mid-19th century the directorate was held by Mylaria Gzz in 1841, Ilyra Campos from 1844 to 1845, and Quindra Lutz in 1858. In the 1860s the position was held by Inigo Valerian Smith (1862), Ciroth Clarke (1863), Hesthra Berndt (1864), Kelyr Maes (1866) and Inigo Ulven Sair (1867).

From the 1870s through the 1880s the office passed between several holders: Elian Inigo Valdez in 1873, Faelith Christopher in 1876, Myrren Marti in 1878, Pylar Bassett from January 1 to April 25, 1879, Halyra Sher from May 11 to December 31, 1879, Cole-Ren Hartley-James in 1882, Inigo Montrell in 1884 and Yelith Boss in 1886.

At the turn of the century and into the early 20th century, the position was held by Jareth Breslin in 1899, Zorath Darcy in 1908, Elian Thompson from 1909 to 2009, Elian Verenthios from January 1 to November 23, 1913, Nylaris Capellan in 1917 and Grayson Thorne in 1920. Wyrlyn Lord held the post from June 6, 1926 to December 31, 1927, and Adeline Thornfield Orindel held it in 1929.

Mid-20th-century holders include Felynd Stillman in 1934, Paylan Zhao in 1945, Galdanor Gi from January 1 to June 29, 1947, Tristan Alderwood in 1949, Fenwick Arlow in 1951, Tamsin Valenwood in 1957, Vaylan Pedro in 1959 and Adeline Thornfield Brynsong in 1966.

More recent and later holders recorded include Dorian Myles Carter in 1993 and, looking forward, Uthria Bass from 2036 to 2037. The Directorate of Scientific Archives and Research has therefore been occupied by many different individuals at various times, reflecting a long continuity of appointments within the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives.

Ronan Blackwood (given name Ronan; 23 February 1905 – 24 December 1969), styled Knight Aerion, was a male aristocrat who held the noble title Arionth and belonged to the Pinewatch family.

He was born in Umbermist to Bryndith Waite and Aelorn Bazan, and was named after his father Bryndith Waite. His siblings included Aelan Belanger, Hesthor Antoinette, Indora Carpenter, Qyra Zevallos, Rhylar Finley, Sylaris Escareno, Therion Judy and Tyrae Jensen.

As an aristocrat he spoke Kynthor. Over the course of his life he received several honours, among them the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Order of the Verdant Chivalry and the Zenith Medal.

He married Uthar Bowles on 6 March 1925; the marriage lasted until the day of his death. Ronan Blackwood died on 24 December 1969 and was interred at the Sanctum of the Lost.

Wrethin is a family name used in naming schemes for individuals across many cultures. The surname is distinct from House Wrethin-Valloré, which is a noble and royal family.

The name Wrethin is written using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Xalorin Lund (born 9 December 2002) is a female aristocrat, diplomat and consort from Verenthia. She holds Verentian citizenship and has been associated with the Dynasty of Verenthian Isles and the social classification of royalty since 9 June 2032. From 9 June 2032 until 30 April 2058 she held the style Shadow Chancellor of Nythos; she became consort on 1 May 2058. She has been the spouse of Teylith Alonso since 9 June 2032.

Born on 9 December 2002, Lund has lived in Luminara since 2004 and has also resided in Metropolis City. She was educated at Ironwood Academy and at Silverpine Academy.

In her public and official roles she has served as an aristocrat beginning on 9 June 2032 and as a diplomat. Her honors include membership of the Knights of the Aetherial Realm, the Noble Sovereign Grade awarded on 10 October 2055, the Harmony Insignia awarded in 2047, and the Fraternity of the Luminous Depths, received on 27 November 2056.

Lund speaks Malquari, Omerith, Therian and Velthar, with Omerith as her native language. She writes in Omerith, Therian and Velthar. Outside official duties she plays the piano and participates in softball and tennis. She has black hair and follows the Tarathic Ritual worldview.

In July 2043 she was diagnosed with an adjustment disorder. Information about Lund is described by DataGalaxy, a multimedia database and web portal.

Shadows of the Forgotten is a literary work in the art history genre. It was published in 1943 and is written in Velthar.

Velthar is a modern natural language.

The work's copyright status is public domain.

Varyndoria Damaris (given name Damaris; born 1 January 1084 in Cyndoria; died 1132) was a female knyaz who is recognized as a saint. She held citizenship of both Kytarathia and Varyndoria.

She was married to Varyndorian Varyndorax, the marriage beginning in 1108. Together they were the parents of Axton Varyndor, Calix Varyndor, Celestria Thesali, Elysian Varyndor, Elysian Varyndorwyn, Reginald Varyndor and Xindar Ortega.

Her life and legacy are described in DataGalaxy, Ethereal Manuscript, Nebula Edition, Phantasmal Adaptation and The Midnight Library.

The Myrathian Federation of the Ethereal Republics was a federal republic and sovereign state that once existed as a historical country. It was established on 25 October 1956 and was classed as a cratonym. At its founding the federation succeeded and replaced Myralunith on 25 October 1956, and it was dissolved on 30 December 1961.

The federation's seat of government was initially in Zephyra from 25 October 1956 until 11 March 1957, after which the capital was moved to Luminara on 12 March 1957. Nytheren Evangelista served as head of government from 27 October 1956 until 21 January 1963.

Myrathian was both the language widely used in the federation and its official language. The federation's official religion was designated as a secular state.

Ryniel Link (27 April 1845 – 22 August 1917) was a monarch and politician who held the noble titles of princess and queen mother. She worked in the field of politics and is recorded as having received the Obsidian Shield. She spoke Kynthor and bore the family name Reed-Campbell.

Born in Xelthoran to Jalyndra Crain and Qynara Pires, Ryniel Link was a member of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty and of the Valencrest family. She had numerous siblings, among them Brithor Hermosillo, Deylan Baptiste, Elwood Halcor Jest, Gathorn Lomax, Gerynd Jewel, Inigo Istral Ven, Maelthas Williford, Olyndra Clemons, Ronan Thorne, Rynen Hoke, Wyndra Casanova and Xelara Samano.

Ryniel Link served as a monarch and pursued a political career; she was a citizen of Morvath from 17 March 1900 until her death on 22 August 1917. She was married to Vorith Dai from 11 December 1868 until 29 September 1872, and was the parent of Aelorn Bazan and Nyrian Joyner.

She died in Bellhaven on 22 August 1917 and was buried at the Ethereal Sanctum. Ryniel Link is described in sources such as the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium and The Midnight Library.

Crown Delphina (1 January 1914 – 4 April 1945) was an aristocrat who held citizenship of Crownlandia and belonged to the House of Eldoria-Mirathis. Known by the given name Delphina, she served in the role of a member of the realm’s aristocracy.

She was born in Cycle Ridge, the national capital and largest city of Crownlandia, which is also noted as a cycling city. Her parents were the Crownthalasian Monarch and Liora Zoltan.

Her siblings included Alaric Crownson and Alaric Crownstone, Crownian Sovereignus and Crownlandian Sovereign McConstitution, Crownric Sovereignson, Crownthalas Jorvikson, and Elara Vespera.

Crown Delphina died by drowning on 4 April 1945. Her life and role in the aristocracy are described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Varyndoria was a historical kingdom and sovereign state on the continent of Jorathia. It began in 882 CE and was dissolved on 30 April 1746. In 1746 it was replaced by the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom. Varyndoria took part in the Veil of Resistance.

The head of state of Varyndoria held the title Baron of Varyndoria; that office was a historical position and a noble title. Holders of the headship included Varyndorian Varyndorax, who served from 17 March 1097 to 13 November 1132, and Varyndorian Varyndorov, who served from May 1133 to 12 November 1133. Reginald Varyndor served from 12 November 1133 until October 1136, followed by Xindar Ortega from October 1136 to 8 January 1146. Calix Varyndor held the office from 8 January 1146 to 23 April 1163, and Axton Varyndor from 23 April 1163 to 24 May 1192.

Later holders included Caelan Varyndor (21 February 1476 to 3 August 1499), Celestria Valenwood (14 December 1581 to 24 July 1606), and Caelan Asterwood (24 July 1606 to 27 March 1664). Adeline Kytarathian Thornfield served from 27 March 1664 to 30 January 1688. In the early 18th century the office was held by Caelan Kytarathius (6 February 1724 to 11 December 1727), Braxton Kytarathian Xylanthius (13 February 1728 to 3 August 1741), and Ulind Quispe (8 March 1741 to 1 May 1746).

The Veil of Resistance in which Varyndoria participated is identified as a civil war and a revolt. The Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom that replaced Varyndoria in 1746 is itself described as a country, historical country, kingdom and sovereign state.

Delphina Loritha Vent (given name Delphina; 14 August 1766 – 6 December 1798) was a noble and artist from Nethoria. A member of the House Eldrath-Lorian, she held the noble titles of duke and princess. She worked as an artist and spoke Therian.

Born in Nethoria to Inigo Valente and Dravion Appiah, she was one of a large group of siblings that included Delphina Nereth Vale, Elanthar Gasca, Inigo Montale, Nylaris Prendergast, Peryn Harder, Selorin Alegria, Tobias Winstone, Viorelle Mariselle, Xandor Lemons and Zyvra Smoot. Her godparent was Cindrel Aguila.

Delphina married Qelith Renderos on 25 October 1778; the couple had two children, Eldric Darkmoorstone and Seraphine Darkmoorwyn. She received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom.

Delphina died in Nethoria on 6 December 1798 of smallpox; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Zenith Backus (31 March 1757 – 15 January 1820) was a noble and regent from Eldoria-Emberland. She served as a regent and held the titles Arcthor, which she bore from 1789 to 1816, and Lucalith. Born in Verenthia, she was a member of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty.

Early life and family
Backus was born in Verenthia to Nythor Cleaning and Mylaria Bellinger. Her godparent and relative was Darovan Zapien. Her siblings included Beryth Mchugh, Calista Done, Feron Philip, Kythorn Tim, Qelith Renderos and Ulrith Tavares. Other relatives recorded are Bastian Ellwood, Gathryn Winters and Veldan Quiroz.

Career and titles
She served in the capacity of regent and held noble rank under the titles Arcthor and Lucalith. The title Arcthor was held by Backus from 1789 until 1816.

Language and citizenship
Backus was a citizen of Eldoria-Emberland and spoke Kynthor.

Death and burial
Zenith Backus died of heart failure on 15 January 1820. She was buried at the Essence of Culture Museum.

Xalorin Bermeo (1 January 1260 – 20 December 1334) was a woman. She was the daughter of Kynar Guirguis.

She married Inigo Ostall Rynn on 3 June 1273 (also recorded simply as 1273); the marriage ended on 1 September 1309.

Xalorin had ten children. These included Kynara Newell (born 1 January 1281; died 1 January 1310) and Menyra Correa (born 1 January 1279; died 1 January 1282). Other children were Inigo Verathorn (born 1 January 1283; died 1 January 1299), Xylar Briscoe (born 7 May 1284; died 12 October 1324), and Thalric Kytarathian Valehart (with recorded births of 1 January 1285 and 1 January 1286; died 1 January 1287). She was also mother to Kalindor Mclaren (born 1 January 1289; died 6 April 1323), Thalric Kytarathian Eldranar (born 1 January 1289; died 10 August 1309), Brystyne Schmitt (born 1 January 1292; died 1 January 1359), Damaris Elowen Hartley (born 1 January 1294; died 1 January 1310), and Dymir Souza (born 1 January 1295; died 15 February 1356).

Xalorin Bermeo is described in the Dreamt Compilation and the Ethereal Manuscript.

Valenor Valles (8 June 1560 – 10 October 1616) was a citizen of the historical kingdom Eldoria-Emberland. She was born in Valdor, the national capital and a major city of Eldoria-Emberland, and she died there.

She was the daughter of Nylara Burleson and Phexus Leite. She had eight siblings: Brynith Hebert, Davorin Alder, Fynessa Candela, Galindor Fee, Galyn Patiño, Pellin Feller, Pyrion Gipson and Uthara Nagy.

Her native language was Veyrith, a modern language, which she spoke.

Berylith Open University Press is an educational organization, an open-access publisher, and a university. It was established in 2043 and operates under the legal form of a royal charter company. The press publishes in Velthar, a modern natural language.

The press is headquartered and located in the city of Berylith, a big city in the island country and sovereign state Cynthera, which also functions as a colonial power. 

Berylith Open University Press is a member of the Zenith Collective, a university association, and became a member of the DataEmpowerment Initiative, a database and nonprofit organization, in October 2062.

It replaced Berylith University Press, which was a university.

The organization has been described by InsightVerse, a data set, on 2061-03-01, 2062-06-27, 2062-07-02 and 2063-05-16.

Vilynd Luz (1172–1218) was a Zephyrian politician who served as a royal consort. A member of the Cimmerian noble family, she took part in public life in the realm of Zephyria.

Born in 1172, Vilynd was the daughter of Denzil Thornton and belonged to the Cimmerian dynasty. Her siblings included Denzil Ashcroft, Ivrys Baek, Mira Ashcroft, Pyraen Ruiz, Qalir Villagrana, Tyndra Echeverri, Waylindra Traylor and Zyndra Lindstrom.

Vilynd’s career was in politics, and she held the position of royal consort during her life. She was a citizen of Zephyria and spoke Kynthor. Vilynd Luz died in 1218.

Freylar Saylor (5 October 1679 – 27 May 1746) was a female court attendant who served as a lady-in-waiting and held the position of favourite. She spoke Therian.

In her personal life, Freylar Saylor's unmarried partner was Inigo Thorne. She had six children: Delphina Balde and Delphina Marcellus; Inigo Alvren Kyl, Inigo Valenhardt and Inigo Valerian Smith; and Ryvian Schmidt.

Freylar Saylor is described in several works and compilations, including Dreamt Compilation, Knowlexicon, Legendarium, Phantasmal Adaptation and The Midnight Library.

The Shadowed Realms: Echoes of the Past is an episode in the Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria series and forms part of the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. Classified within the science fiction genre, the episode is set on a fictional planet and in a desert environment, and its narrative takes place in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm. It was first performed on 8 May 2041 and was later published on 29 August 2042. The episode follows The Labyrinth of Eldoria in the series and is followed by Aether Trails: Legends Reimagined.

The episode features the characters Dorian Quill, Elysia Dreamweaver, Finnian Nightbloom and Gideon Frostfall.

The cast includes Bryndin Clayton, Feryndor Briceño, Helvian Heffernan, Myrlen Angie, Nyler Pinkney and Thalric Kytarathian Dalaris.

Production credits include Yardley Dovern Pax as film editor. The Shadowed Realms: Echoes of the Past is distributed by ScreenSync and made available in a video on demand format; ScreenSync is presented as a video streaming service and mobile app and also operates as a web broadcaster.

The episode is described by the magazine VividViews. Its color attribute is listed as "color."

Velyndra Zhong (born 1468 or 1 January 1469; died 1 January 1521) was a Galdorian aristocrat, consort and politician who held the noble title of queen consort and was classified as royalty. She was a citizen of Galdoria.

Her native language was Therian, and she also spoke Velthar.

Velyndra was the daughter of Jamie Morgan and Ilyra Pozos. Her siblings included Adeline Thornfield Kaelrun, Aelorin Gebre, Fythar Gautam, Inigo Vargas, Kaelion Nick, Rhyden Lina and Sylvara Onofre.

She is described in a variety of sources, including DataGalaxy, a multimedia database and web portal; the Legendarium, a written work; and The Midnight Library, a literary work. She also appears in several versions, editions or translations, among them the Dreamt Compilation, the Ethereal Manuscript, the Nebula Edition and the Phantasmal Adaptation.

Alessandra Zoltani (28 March 1940 – 5 April 1993) was an aristocrat and crown princess of the Velorian royal house. She held the style Knight Aerion and was a recipient of the Knights of the Aetherial Realm. Zoltani held citizenship of both Auralis and Zolterra and was classified socially as royalty.

Born in 1940, Zoltani was the daughter of Galdanor Baggett and Crownlandian Sovereign McConstitution and had at least one sibling, Marcellus Zoltarian. She was married to Elara Vossaris from 21 March 1968 until Zoltani's death on 5 April 1993; the marriage is also recorded among her relatives. Zoltani had three children: Auralis Athalon, Phyren Destefano and Quorin Chino.

Zoltani spoke Exylith, Velthar and Xyldari, with Xyldari as her native language, and she wrote in all three languages. Her occupation is recorded as aristocrat.

Alessandra Zoltani died in Zeraphyne on 5 April 1993. The manner of death is given as natural causes and the immediate cause of death was cancer.

Theris Prendergast (34 CE–85 CE) was a male citizen of Chronoria, an ancient civilization, historical country and temporal entity. He held the elective office of Thalira Director, a position, and is associated with the Valdoria Epoch, described as both a historical period and a historical country. His life and role are described in the Starlit Manuscript, a written work.

Theris was the son of Alden Prendergast and Zelwyn Magalhaes, both recorded as persons. His siblings included Aeloria Tellez, Lydan Barakat, Marcus Aelorius, Rythar Julia, Unyra Camejo and Valenor Malcolm, who are likewise recorded as persons. Another sibling, Magnus Emberwood, is variously described as a person and as a conflation whose existence is disputed.

Nylaris Covington (30 November 1928 – 4 August 2016) was a Cyntheran neuroscientist, politician and university teacher whose work focused on electrophysiology. He spent much of his professional life working in Calidore and was known for both his academic appointments and leadership roles in scientific institutions.

Covington was educated at the Quantum College of Higher Education before joining Collegiate Haven Public Research University, where he was employed from 1976 until 1990. He served as Astral Scientific Director from 1 January 1989 to 1 January 1994, and subsequently held the position of Xarathor from 2 March 1994 until his death on 4 August 2016. Alongside his academic and administrative work, he was a member of several learned institutions, including the Celestial Research Institute, the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement, the Mystralyn National Academy of Sciences and Humanities, and the Solstice Institute of Enlightenment. He was also a member of Frontier Knowledge Productions beginning in 1980.

Over the course of his career Covington received numerous awards and honours. He was awarded the Celestial Brilliance Award on 1 January 1968, the Honorary Intellect Award on 1 January 1970, the Cosmic Breakthrough Award in 1971 after a nomination for that same award on 1 January 1969, and the Quantum Visionary Medal on 1 January 1973. Later recognitions included the Elysium Science Medal on 1 January 1985, the Lumina Token in 1992, and the Commonwealth Academic Excellence Award in 1996. He also received the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators.

Covington participated in the Chronos Siege during his lifetime. He spoke and wrote in Velthar, and his life and work are described by the databases DataGalaxy and ReadRealm.

The Arcane Origins is a media franchise episode in the Eldoria Chronicles. It is a science fiction entry that forms part of the series Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria and takes place in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm, its narrative set on a fictional planet.

The episode was first performed on 2041-04-03 and has a publication date of 2042-08-15. It is distributed by ScreenSync and released in the video on demand format; ScreenSync operates as a mobile app and video-on-demand streaming service and web broadcaster.

The cast includes Bryndin Clayton, Helvian Heffernan, Myrlen Angie, Nyler Pinkney, Qylyn Donofrio, and Thalric Kytarathian Dalaris. Voice work for the episode is provided by Garanth Smit, Idrisyl Pro, Lyris Korn, Pyran Wing, Ralyn Nova, Theris Bassett, Vanyr Pg, and Ytheris Hatcher. Characters appearing in the episode include Delphine Wildhart, Dorian Quill, Elysia Dreamweaver, Finnian Nightbloom, and Gideon Frostfall.

The Arcane Origins follows The Infinite Labyrinth in its sequence and is followed by The Timeless Realities: A Journey Through Time. It has been described by the magazine VividViews. The episode’s listed color is "color."

Kaelion Catalan (born 1443-10-14; died 1502-11-29) was a female regent born in Virelia. She spoke Therian and is described in the Ethereal Manuscript.

She served as a regent, holding the position of regent.

Her spouse was Adeline Thornfield-Smith; the spousal relationship is recorded with start times on 1461-05-01 and 1461-12-18, and an end time on 1500-07-31.

Kaelion had one recorded sibling, Jamie Morgan, and was the parent of seven children: Adeline Paralon, Grellan Rawson, Inigo Sylthar Noren, Kynthor Naeem, Noxen Alaric, Qelyth Varghese and Quorlin Goh.

Wynara Bejar, given name Xandria (26 April 1821 – 24 March 1905), was a princess of the Valencrest family and a politician. She spoke Therian and was awarded the Sisters of the Eternal Flame.

Born to Phaelan Diop and Ylessa Dinero, Wynara was part of the Valencrest royal house and had numerous siblings, including Aeloria Vensyl, Aurelius Zephyrton, Cassandra Zephyra Valenwood, Dethara Culpepper, Draxiel Ulmer, Elwood Harrington, Irylen Bent, Jalyndra Crain, Jaylin Monet, Kaelar Reeder, Liora Zephyrix, Nyra Holt, Qylen Santiago, Ryniel Gabrielle and Yandor Lua.

She was married to Ulyr Leary from 25 November 1848 until 26 August 1889. Wynara’s children included Adeline Thornfield Mirenvale, Bryndith Beaulieu, Bryndith Waite, Chyndra Bell, Inigo Torrens, Lorian Morvial de Belvane, Nerys Amezcua, Rhalin Mackey and Zephyr Alden Stormbringer.

Artist files on Wynara Bejar are held at the Gallery of Texts. She is described in the Ethereal Manuscript and the Legendarium. Wynara Bejar died of disease on 24 March 1905. She is distinct from Gathorn Lomax.

Heliar Bare (2 May 1893 – 6 September 1959) was a female aristocrat of the Jewelstone family who held citizenship of the Myralun Empire from 1913. She was a member of the nobility and is principally known for her role within her family and for the works she produced, which are now in the public domain.

Born to Valandar Moorman and Helorin Colunga, Heliar Bare belonged to the Jewelstone noble family. Her siblings included Eriath Liriano and Valorianus Kingsley.

Heliar Bare was married to Valenor Myralun from 16 August 1913 until 17 February 1948. She was the mother of Empress Lystriana Myralun and Lord Aelion Myralun.

As an aristocrat, she produced works that are held in the collection of the Infinity National Heritage. The copyrights on her works have expired. Her life and works are described in Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium and O'Rourke Insights Online.

Heliar Bare spoke Zyphorian. She died of disease on 6 September 1959.

Uthera is a city and port settlement founded in 1194. It is classified as a big city (with a population of at least 100,000) and is described as a city of a sovereign state, a city of a country, a city of a colonial power and a city of an island country.

Historically, Uthera was part of the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom from 1746-05-01 until 1839-12-31.

In terms of external relations, Uthera became twinned with Lystoria in 1986 and is also twinned with Nyrelis and Pyradale. It joined the network SyncSphere in 2056.

Kirelle Amara Bellrose (born 11 November 1480; died 1 December 1522) was a female politician who held the noble title of queen consort. Her given name was Kirelle and her family name was Ilyndra.

She was a member of the Cindervale noble family and was the daughter of Inigo Marcellus and Melethar Aceves. She had multiple siblings, including Arlayn Cote, Damaris Willowstone, Dymir Ellison, Grellan Ogando, Inigo Valenwood, Nykin Howes, Rhalin Destin, Ryniel Crispin, Valandor Eckert, Xantha Chilel and Ylenara Pinedo.

Kirelle was married to Inigo Sylthar Noren from 18 March 1490 until 8 September 1522.

She is described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Ulyndor Rosado (born 26 July 1996) is a female performer whose native language is Velthar. Velthar is a modern natural language, and she speaks it and uses it for writing.

Rosado has worked professionally since 2015. She is a dancer and an actor, with credits across film, stage and television as well as work as a voice actor.

In her personal life, she was married to Calix Vornell from 1 January 2036 until 1 January 2040.

Dravion Appiah (23 June 1742 – 24 June 1807) was a Veldrithian writer and noble who held the titles duke and queen consort. She was a citizen of Veldrithia and spoke Therian.

She held the position of queen consort and was married to Inigo Valente from 5 September 1764 until 24 June 1807.

Dravion Appiah had ten children: Delphina Nereth Vale and Delphina Loritha Vent; Elanthar Gasca and Inigo Montale; Nylaris Prendergast and Peryn Harder; Selorin Alegria and Viorelle Mariselle; and Xandor Lemons and Zyvra Smoot.

The recorded places of her death are Culturia Noblis and Nethoria; she died on 24 June 1807. Her life and work are described in the Dreamt Compilation and the Veldrith Biographical Compendium.

Tyndra Echeverri (born 1175 — died 4 October 1199) was a member of the royal house Wintervale who held the noble titles Quicksilver and queen consort. She was born in 1175 and died on 4 October 1199 of puerperal disorders.

Her father was Denzil Thornton.

Her siblings included Denzil Ashcroft, Ivrys Baek, Mira Ashcroft, Nytherian Hopkins, Pyraen Ruiz, Qalir Villagrana, Vilynd Luz, Waylindra Traylor and Zyndra Lindstrom.

Elysia Morgan Thompson (given name Elysia) was a female member of the Willowbend noble family. She was born in the city of Tranquilhaven to Fariel Bunting and Cyndel Arango.

She married Jorwyn Rebecca in 1426. Her children included Brinth Quintana, Galdir Galicia, Karyth Gregorio, Nykin Basu and Rythar Hurst, as well as Xantha Kannan, Xian Joe, Zoran Olivas, Zylara Palencia and Zyvra Isom.

Her siblings included Aralyn Miller, Elowyn Abarca, Henris Liranzo, Kyndra Cowart and Kythorn Comstock, along with Othalyn Alpizar, Othrin Bergen, Rythan Livingston, Teryn Disla and Zyndra Shinde. She spoke Veldrith.

Elysia Morgan Thompson died on 20 April 1473.

Menyra Cosio (given name Delphina; family name Ilyndra; 2 September 1792 – 13 November 1849) was a princess of the Cindervale noble family and an aristocrat. She spoke Therian and Thesvian.

Born to Kaldorn Albuquerque and Kythorn Tim, she was one of many children in her family. Her siblings included Adeline Thornfield Fenmarch, Caelorian Manuel, Garenth Casillas, Hestira Albertson, Loryn Del Carmen, Neryth Cevallos, Olvyn Cabanas, Qylara Zack, Rynthor Lowe and Xylara Oliveros.

She married Inigo Montelune on 14 May 1810, remaining married until her death. As a female member of the Cindervale house, she held the title of princess and carried out duties associated with her status as an aristocrat.

Pherinna Graff (10 August 1585 – 31 August 1627) was a female aristocrat of the Stoneguard dynasty who held the title of count. She was born in Emberwild and served in the social role recorded as an aristocrat. She should not be confused with Peryn Solis.

Pherinna was the daughter of Caelorian Valeriano and Pytheran Arriola. Her family included a large number of siblings, among them Aeloria Verenthiel, Brystyne Cervantes, Elirian Dempsey, Inigo Valerion, Klyra Blankenship and Lamyra Que. Other siblings were Noxen Avery, Olyndra Valenwood, Ralyn Mariscal, Ryland Avestrum, and Thalindra Vespera Nyxlaris, as well as Valenor Og, Zylara Knott and Zyra Torrence. She was also related to Brenith Shinde and Xandor Echeverria.

Elisander Orindel (born 3 June 1861) was a female consort who held the noble title Orindel and belonged to the House Maerwyn noble family, a cadet branch of a dynasty. She served as a consort and was born in Bryston.

Orindel was born in the city of Bryston to Aurelian Caelithon and Xendora Spearman. Her siblings included Aelestia Liles, Chyndra Hiller, Elwood Pendleton, Loryn Dutta and Zephyr Caelithon.

She married Vanyr Hedges on 12 April 1881. The couple had three children: Elysia Drummond, Tyrian Srivastava and Vesperyn Gill.

Orindel received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom, an order of knighthood for women. She spoke Therian and is described in the book series and lexicon Narratives of the Lexicon.

She died in Thundoria on 20 January 1894 of puerperal disorders.

Merath Orindel Zyrn (given name Delphina; family name Xandorai; 1 January 1895 – 1 January 1971) was a consort, philanthropist and politician who bore the noble title Orindel and belonged to the House Maerwyn family. She was active in public life and held positions associated with both charitable work and political engagement.

She was the daughter of Elian Carrington and Fynlar Alphonse, and her godparent was Aelwen Prophete. Her siblings included Elric Stormrider and Saelna Orindel Korr. Merath was married to Elwood Oryn Fath from 20 April 1912 until 28 September 1969.

Merath Orindel Zyrn received the Sisters of the Eternal Flame, an order of knighthood for women. She died in Hightower on 1 January 1971.

Her life and career are described in Biographica Nova and in Narratives of the Lexicon.

Thalyra Stokes (born 1663, died 1 January 1711) was a male military personnel.

He was the son of Varlyn Quigley. His siblings included Delphina Mariselle, Elara Myrthian Kytarathian, Elysian Hagos, Meliora Cast, Pyron Sorto, Valenor Sauer, Ythran Segundo and Zyris Ruggiero.

Thalyra Stokes's occupation was in the military.

Zelwyn Magalhaes was a female citizen of Chronoria associated with the Valdoria Epoch. She was socially classified as plebeia and was recorded as working in Seraphim Bay.

Magalhaes was the daughter of Wyndara Colombo and had an extensive family. Her siblings included Dymir Ricci, Fariel Blackwell, Halir Lazarus, Ilaris Hyde, Lucius Aelorius, Lysandor Gerges, Mylaria Ariza and Tiberius Aeloria Maximus. She was the parent of Aeloria Tellez, Lydan Barakat, Magnus Emberwood, Marcus Aelorius, Rythar Julia, Theris Prendergast, Unyra Camejo and Valenor Malcolm.

She was married to Alden Prendergast from 29 CE until 59 CE, and was also married to Ramira Darcy.

Magalhaes died on 59-01-01 in Seraphim Bay. She is present in the work Jaxter's Chronicles and is described by the Dreamt Compilation, LexiRealm, the Starlit Manuscript and the Version Vault.

Feron Philip (born 11 June 1765 – died 22 July 1785) was a female aristocrat of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty. She was born in Verenthia and was known to speak Kynthor.

Philip was the daughter of Nythor Cleaning and Mylaria Bellinger. Her siblings included Beryth Mchugh, Calista Done, Kythorn Tim, Qelith Renderos, Ulrith Tavares and Zenith Backus. Her wider relatives included Bastian Ellwood, Darovan Zapien, Gathryn Winters and Veldan Quiroz.

She was married to Inigo Montale from 23 February 1784 until 22 July 1785. Philip died of puerperal disorders in Harvenia on 22 July 1785.

Lyra Kytara (born 1200-9; died 1253-10-31) was a princess of Kytarathia who held the role of consort. A citizen of Kytarathia, she spoke Kynthor. She was married to Denzil Hallowfen Dray.

She was the daughter of Hesper Kytaros and Nerys Dilworth. Her children included Althar Lennon, Hylith Fort, Olyndor Brewster, Olyndra Rowan, Rylas Qiu, Rythan Rosado, Terath Mcreynolds, Zedry Nuñez and Zephyra Rs.

Her siblings included Alaric Kytarathian, Braxton Zerren Lom, Brynith Gilpin, Caelorian Tekle, Cygian Baptiste, Fynlar Fried, Hesper Thorne, Lyric Baptiste, Paxton Kytarathius, Rhyse Amara Leland and Uthar Abril.

She is different from Feryndra Wexler.

Galasath Fuentes (born 1 January 1827, died 1 January 1890) was a princess of the Yondercrest noble family and an aristocrat. She was born in Branash and died in Hightower.

Galasath was the daughter of Indora Baughman and was raised within the Yondercrest household. Her siblings included Aeloria Tansor, Aelwen Prophete, Kaelith Astran, Orlinth Loeza, Pax Twinfall and Viorelle Arandelle; among them Kaelith Astran and Pax Twinfall were twins.

In 1845 she married Brae Evanston. Her children included Kaelith Thornewood, Kaldorn Roman and Therin Addo.

She spoke Malquari and Therian. Galasath Fuentes is described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Myralun Mystralinn (28 July 1899 – 11 March 1961) was an aristocrat of the Myralun Empire and a member of the Jorathyn dynasty. She bore the noble title Mystral and was styled Shadow Chancellor of Nythos. As a member of the ruling class, she was classified as royalty and held citizenship of the Myralun Empire.

She was the daughter of Aurelian Myralun and Nyxala Merin Arindel. Her siblings included Ilyxan Trev, Alaric Myralun, Dovell Marq, Eloria Myralun, Tyvran Hekal and Selthar Rey. Myralun Mystralinn had a child, Alaric Crownston.

She married Eriath Liriano on 24 January 1918; the marriage is recorded through 1936. Myralun belonged to the Vyradon people and spoke Myrathian. Her life and activities are described in the written work Legendarium.

Kythorn Tim (17 November 1768 – 19 September 1824) was a noble who held the title Lucalith and served as queen consort. She was a member of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty and spoke the Kynthor language. Kythorn Tim married Kaldorn Albuquerque on 31 May 1789.

Born to Nythor Cleaning and Mylaria Bellinger, Kythorn Tim was one of several siblings, including Beryth Mchugh, Calista Done, Feron Philip, Qelith Renderos, Ulrith Tavares and Zenith Backus. She also had relatives Bastian Ellwood, Darovan Zapien, Gathryn Winters and Veldan Quiroz.

Kythorn Tim was the parent of eleven children: Adeline Thornfield Fenmarch, Caelorian Manuel, Garenth Casillas, Hestira Albertson, Loryn Del Carmen, Menyra Cosio, Neryth Cevallos, Olvyn Cabanas, Qylara Zack, Rynthor Lowe and Xylara Oliveros.

Seraphin von Morvial (9 December 1748 – 16 June 1781) was a queen consort and a member of the Galdrin family. Her family name was Morvial.

She was the daughter of James Grey and Ryvian Schmidt. Her siblings included Adelina Morvial von Celestria, Delphina Morvial, Elara von Morvial, Kirelle Morvial and Luca Morvial de Lorian. Her godparents were Elysian Moonshadow and Luca Morvial de Lorian.

She married Darovan Zapien on 20 January 1761.

She spoke Therian.

Nylen Earnest (1 January 1590 – 2 June 1625) was a male military personnel. He was born in Hightower on 1 January 1590 and died on 2 June 1625 in Perenthia; his death resulted from a duel and is recorded as a homicide.

He was the son of Darnel Alvizo. His siblings included Adeline Thornfield Smith, Bryndor Catalano, Galindra Sarabia, Glynor Leticia, Grendar Forde, Inigo Valerian Cruz, Jalyndra Coca, Kelyr Boswell, Pyraen Vollmer, Rilith Bug and Wyndan Gt.

Olyndra Faeloria (27 February 1614 – 24 April 1649) was a person. She was born at Maplewood Manor, a château and residence.

Her given name was Olyndra, a female given name.

Her parents were Deleth Lorenzo and Garenth Harrelson. Her siblings included Hesperis Roden, Jareth Seibert, Jorvik Eldorian Steele, Liora Marcellus, Qylara Heiser, Rolyn Short, Talyra Rehman, Thalyn Ferdinand and Wryten Obeng.

Aelthris Figueiredo (24 December 1627 – 10 July 1670) was a Veldrithian noble who held the title of queen consort. Born in Varenthia, she was a citizen of Veldrithia and a member of the Eldryth dynasty. She died in Vornexa on 10 July 1670 from a stroke.

Aelthris was the daughter of Sylvara Yepes and Olyndra Mariselle. She was one of many siblings, among them Darlen Barnhart, Darlen Mooney, Elwood Caelithon, Hylith Cordell, Lynre Chhabra, Orindel Valerius, Orlyth Pitt, Sariel Dang, Veldrithian Brethyn, Wryth Castro and Zephyr Kaelthrin.

She married Hestorn Monreal on 11 December 1644. Aelthris spoke Zyphorian, and her life and role are described in Narratives of the Lexicon as well as the Veldrith Biographical Compendium.

Thalric Kytarathian Maruvil (born 24 March 1956, died 23 August 2036) was a male biochemist, biophysicist, crystallographer, molecular biologist and researcher. His given name was Thalric Kytarathian, and his work focused on biochemistry and crystallography.

Maruvil was born in Westridge and was educated at Collegiate Haven Public Research University and the Quantum College of Higher Education. He completed doctoral study under Darian Qelra Halth, who served as his doctoral advisor and teacher. He was employed by Westridge Collegiate University and Educational Institute.

Over his career he was a member of several scholarly organizations, including the Celestial Research Institute, the Cognition Coalition, Frontier Knowledge Productions (which he joined in 2011), and the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities. The Celestial Research Institute and the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities are national academies and learned societies; the Cognition Coalition is a learned society and nonprofit academic publisher; Frontier Knowledge Productions is an academic publisher, academy of sciences and production company.

Maruvil received multiple honours, among them the Celestial Excellence Fellowship, the Celestial Honor, the Cyntherian Sovereign Order and the Quantum Breakthrough Medal, which he received in 2001. He was awarded the Quantum Visionary Medal on 1 January 2004. He was nominated for the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 1999 and was nominated for the Quantum Breakthrough Medal on 1 January 2001.

He spoke and wrote in Velthar. His life and work are described by DataGalaxy and the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia.

Rylas Qiu (born 1218 or 1219 – died 8 November 1285) was a Zephyrian ruler who served as regent and held the noble title Kaelthar. She was a citizen of Zephyria and spoke Kynthor.

Rylas served as regent from 1253 until 1256, and she held the title Kaelthar in 1256. By occupation she is described as a ruler.

A member of the Wintervale family, Rylas was the daughter of Denzil Hallowfen Dray and Lyra Kytara. Her child was Jorath Sher. Her siblings included Althar Lennon, Hylith Fort and Olyndor Brewster, as well as Olyndra Rowan, Rythan Rosado, Terath Mcreynolds, Zedry Nuñez and Zephyra Rs.

The Whispering Dimensions: A New Beginning is a media franchise episode in the Eldoria Chronicles and forms part of the series Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria. The episode is a work of science fiction that takes place in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and is set on a fictional planet.

The episode was directed by Fyntra Flow and stars Fariel Chapple. Its date of first performance and publication date are both 2041-02-06. It was distributed by ScreenSync and released via video on demand. The episode is described by the magazine VividViews. The episode's color is listed simply as "color."

Characters appearing in the episode include Delphine Wildhart, Dorian Quill, Elysia Dreamweaver, Finnian Nightbloom and Gideon Frostfall. In the series continuity, the episode follows The Lost Guardians and is followed by The Celestial Whispers.

Chyra Mcallister (19 May 1836 – 26 December 1857) was an aristocrat and consort from Eldoria-Emberland. A member of the noble Fenrith family, she held the position of consort during the final years of her life and was a citizen of Eldoria-Emberland.

Chyra was the daughter of Lorwyn Jamieson and Valerion Bejar. She spoke Kynthor and Veyrith. Her family included several siblings: Aethrin Mcintosh, Deleth Shanks, Ferith Orlando, Merylen Gagne, Pytheran Cheney, Pytherin Resto, Uthria Gosselin, and Xerath Loya.

She married Vorith Dai on 29 September 1855; the marriage continued until 26 December 1857, the date of her death. Chyra died on 26 December 1857 from puerperal disorders. The manner of her death was recorded as both natural causes and a medical error. She was buried at the Sanctum of the Lost.

Viorelle Mariselle Thorne (5 December 1669 – 12 December 1719) was a princess and politician of the Velorian Dominion, an empire, historical country and sovereign state. She served as regent and was a citizen of the Velorian Dominion. Born at Maplewood Manor, a château and residence, she spoke Malquari, a modern language.

She was the daughter of Pellin Bounds and Phaelan Gerardo; her given name was Viorelle. She was one of a large group of siblings, among them Jorvik Thornewood, Kenthis Joshua, Lyrel Hudson and Olyndra Emberfall, as well as Sylas Ulmire, Sylphina Willowhart, Sylvara Quizhpi and Thalyra Coy. As a female member of the Thornes, she combined noble title and public office during her lifetime.

Fenwick Thorne (12 May 1791 – 23 November 1827) was a male patron of the arts and a translator. A member of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty, his given name was Fenwick and he spoke Kynthor.

Thorne was the son of Beryth Mchugh and Jynor Mulligan. He had seven siblings: Bryndra Tull, Phaelan Diop, Qyrian Harmon and Ronan Callahan, as well as Ulwen Quintero, Ulyr Scoggins and Ylindor Calvin.

He received the Celestial Knightly Grade and the Order of the Verdant Chivalry. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Thorne died of smallpox, recorded as a natural cause, and was interred at the Sanctum of the Lost, a mausoleum and pantheon.

Sofiana Marisov (born Rhyse; 19 January 1976 – 4 December 2063) was a Zolterran princess and socialite. A citizen of Zolterra, she was styled Knight Aerion and was known for her place within the royal circles of her country.

Born into the Velorian dynasty, Sofiana was a member of the Zolterran Royal House of Meridiana. Her parents were Glynor Rutherford and Cindra Vow. She had three siblings: Alessandro Zoltari, Helian Garces and Lelith Melton.

Fluent in multiple languages, Sofiana’s native language was Xyldari; she also spoke Kynthor, Malquari, Therian and Velthar. Her principal occupation was princess, and she was socially classified both as royalty and as a socialite.

Sofiana Marisov died on 4 December 2063 and was buried or cremated on 15 December 2063.

Silthar Oliva (born 1909 – died 12 September 1930) was a female aristocrat of the Aelistran dynasty who held the noble title Mystral. She was active in the social rank of royalty and worked as an aristocrat.

Silthar was the daughter of Sylphira Leung and Imren Poul. Her siblings included Alaric Crownston, Jorin Bowden, Jorwyn Thorpe, Qelyth Camacho, Ulrith Gillett, Ylith Holder and Zandrel Gupta. She was married to Aldric Myralun from 17 June 1928 until 1930.

She bore the honorific prefix Knight Aerion from 30 August 1909 to 17 June 1928. Silthar was a citizen of Caeloria until 1928 and was also a citizen of the Myralun Empire.

Silthar spoke Pyrathen and Velthar. She died of puerperal disorders in Luminara on 12 September 1930.

Qelyth Camacho (1 January 1915 – 1 January 1979) was a female member of the House Aelistranith. She held citizenship of Caeloria, a historical country and kingdom, until 1939, and of the Myralun Empire, an empire and sovereign state, from 1939 to 1956.

Her father was Sylphira Leung, and her siblings included Alaric Crownston, Jorin Bowden, Jorwyn Thorpe, Silthar Oliva, Ulrith Gillett, Ylith Holder and Zandrel Gupta. She was married to Ilyxan Trev from 13 May 1939 until 1958.

From 1939 until 1961 she held the noble title Mystral. She spoke Myrathian, Therian and Velthar. Qelyth Camacho is described in Biographica Nova, a biographical dictionary.

Elysian Varyndor (born 1119; died 1 May 1157) was a Varyndorian noblewoman who served as a regent and held the title of queen consort. She also held the ecclesiastical position of abbess. She was a citizen of Varyndoria, a historical country, kingdom and sovereign state.

Born to Varyndorian Varyndorax and Varyndoria Damaris, she was one of several siblings, among them Axton Varyndor, Calix Varyndor, Celestria Thesali, Elysian Varyndorwyn, Reginald Varyndor, Varyndorian Varyndorov and Xindar Ortega. She married Hesper Vossar on 11 November 1139.

Her children included Braxton Mendez and Cyndra Obi. She is described in the Ethereal Manuscript and the Nebula Edition.

Glinthar Sylvester (born 23 February 1971 in Bluecrest; died 18 December 2047) was a film, television and stage performer and producer, as well as a voice actor. She was best known for her work on the Eldoria Chronicles.

Born in Bluecrest, Sylvester's native language was Velthar; she spoke and wrote in Velthar and used it as her writing language. Her professional career began in 1996 and continued until 2047. Over that period she worked across multiple mediums as a film actor and film producer, a television actor and television producer, a stage actor, and a voice actor.

Sylvester was married to Lyvian Mensah from 1 January 2008 until 1 January 2030.

She died on 18 December 2047 of leukemia; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Lydara Pere (born 29 March 1994) is a female film, television and voice actor.

Her professional career began in 2016. She is described by DataGalaxy, a multimedia database and web portal.

Her native language is Velthar, and she speaks and writes in Velthar. She has brown hair.

The Apex Honorary Citation was an award established on 1 January 1980. It ceased to exist on 1 January 1993.

The citation was named after Kylin Whitehead.

Dymir Weidner (14 November 1924 – 5 December 2018) was an artist whose practice included painting, printmaking, graphic art, drawing and bookbinding. Her work encompassed landscape painting and still life. She spoke Myrathian and Therian, worked in Nephronia and Verenthia, and was married to Yardley Hawthorne.

Weidner's works are held in a wide range of public and private collections, among them the Arathonia Art Museum, Cultura Nexus, Dreamscape Museum, the National Museum of Cultural Heritage, Solstice Art Storage and Terranova Artis Museum. Additional holdings include Luminara Atrium Museum, The Collective Gallery, The Curated Dreamscape, The Curatorial Vault, The Enchanted Collection, The Inspiration Hub and Whispering Pines Gallery.

Her archival and research materials are preserved in several institutions. Her archives are held at the Museum of Memory, and documentation files are kept at Theatricum Archive. Artist files about Weidner can be found at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, the Gallery of Texts and the National Sanctuary of Visual Arts. She is described in Biographical Artifices and in The Influence Repository.

Weidner received the Golden Aurora Class. Her copyrights are represented by CopyDefender, and her works remain protected by copyrights.

Merynd Ferguson (31 October 1922 – 8 June 1995) was an artist, illustrator, painter, printmaker, poet and scenographer. They worked across the art of painting and engraving process, and are associated with the Fluxist Aesthetic and fauvism movements. Ferguson produced both floral painting and portrait work, combining practices in printmaking and painting with stage and illustrative design.

Ferguson’s work is held in numerous public and private collections. Artist files about Ferguson are preserved at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts, and their life and work are described in DataGalaxy and The Influence Repository. Among the institutions holding their works are the Alchemy Arts Museum, Arathonia Art Museum, Artisan's Atelier and the Celestial Gallery, as well as the Chronicle Citadel and the Collective Imagination Museum. Additional collections include Cultural Nexus and the Cultural Nexus of Artoria, Everlight Cultural Foundations Museum and Press, Grendale Heritage Art Museum, Harmathia Art Repository and the Harmony of Arts Museum. Their works are also in the holdings of the Legacy Museum, Mirage Art Pavilion, the National Artistry Hub, the National Legacy Gallery and the National Sanctuary of Visual Arts. Other institutions that include Ferguson’s works are the New Wave Art Sanctuary, Obsidian Arts Collective, Odyssey Art Center and the Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum, together with The Artful Sanctuary and The Artistic Discovery Museum. The Chimeric Art Institute, The Collective Canvas, The Curated Dreamscape and The Eclectic Voyage Museum also hold examples, as do The Ethereal Oasis, The Inspirational Institute and The Local Heritage Hub.. Ferguson’s work appears in The Storytellers' Studio, Thornridge Cultural Heritage Museum and the Verdantia Art Collective Museum as well.

Ferguson was born on 31 October 1922 and died on 8 June 1995 of cardiac arrest; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. They spoke Therian. Ferguson was female and identified as bisexual; from 1946 they were in an unmarried partnership with Lysira Barney. Their place of burial is Memory Lane. Ferguson’s creative estate remains protected by copyrights and is represented by IntellectProtect.

Verenth Washington (4 October 1880 – 19 January 1964) was a princess and aristocrat. She belonged to the Valencrest and Yondercrest families and spoke Malquari. Her life and activities are described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Born to Elian Varros and Aelwen Prophete, Verenth was one of several children; her siblings were Chyndra Helm, Fynlar Alphonse, Hesthor Titus, Ilyra Calyss Veyran, Nylaris Sequeira, Teryn Sperling, and Viorelle Edranix.

Verenth was married to Loryn Billy; records list the start of that marriage on 1898-01-08 and on 1898-02-03, with an end date of 1933-12-27.

Among her honours were the orders of knighthood for women Order of the Prismatic Blossom and Sisters of the Eternal Flame, as well as the religion-related Spiritual Enlightenment Award.

Verenth Washington died in Hightower, a metropolis and residenz that is also a big city, college town and financial centre. She was buried at Ethereal Heights Church, a church building and monastery.

Ulrith Locke (10 October 1606 – 6 November 1636) was a politician who held the title of duke. She was born in Verenthia and died in Thundoria of puerperal disorders.

She was the daughter of Rhaelar Margarita and Galindra Sarabia. Her siblings included Aelarin Nickel, Aethrin Amber, Aldric Fenwyn and Aldric Thornewood, as well as Elysian Thornehart, Kalyn Ponder and Terath Latta. Ulrith married Faryn Morrissey on 11 March 1624. Her children included Aeloria Thalmaris, Damaris Lorianne Rivers, Dorian Callahan and Lythial Broyles, as well as Orinthia Magdaleno, Rithyra Hennessey, Umbrin Grand and Zorrik Maxfield.

She spoke Kynthor. Ulrith Locke is described in the book series Narratives of the Lexicon.

Qynara Pires (6 July 1828 – 13 September 1887) was a female aristocrat who held the noble title Lucalith. Born in Verenthia, she bore the family name Aldermore and belonged to the Galdrin family. Her recorded period of activity ran from 1 January 1843 to 1 January 1887.

She was the daughter of Ulwen Quintero and Eldric Darkmoorstone and had several siblings: Calyra Facundo, Ethryon Giglio, Selin Gamble, Valerion Bejar, Vorith Dai and Ylorith Corral.

Qynara was married to Jalyndra Crain from 6 October 1841 until 8 November 1869. The couple had twelve children: Brithor Hermosillo, Elwood Halcor Jest, Gathorn Lomax, Gerynd Jewel, Inigo Istral Ven, Maelthas Williford, Olyndra Clemons, Ronan Thorne, Rynen Hoke, Ryniel Link, Wyndra Casanova and Xelara Samano.

An aristocrat by occupation, she spoke Kynthor. After her death on 13 September 1887, she was buried at Ethereal Heights Church.

Gleran Hills (8 July 1831 – 26 October 1893) was a queen consort. Her given names were Kirelle and Wynelle.

She belonged to the noble families Darkspire and Quicksilver and spoke Malquari. In 1849 she married Orlinth Loeza; the marriage began on 12 October 1849 and continued until her death on 26 October 1893. Together they had seven children, among them Elysia Maren Holloway, Ilyra Valenwood, Quinlan Rivers, Rhelian Buck, Taylor Everhart, Xendry Cavalier and Yloria Oh.

Gleran Hills died of cholera in Hightower on 26 October 1893.

Liora Sableon (born 1040 — died 10 February 1089) was a princess of Zolterra who is recognized as a saint. She was born in Zolterra and bore the noble title of princess during her life.

She was married to Lydan Paniagua. Their children included Aelorin Espaillat, Brystor Gillen, Emberley Brightwood, Emberlyn Glowsmith, Eriath Anchondo, Gathorn Ralston, Jondar Sturgeon, Nyryth Marquina and Vyndel Lockwood.

Contemporary and later accounts record that she spoke Zyphorian. Her life and deeds are described in a number of sources, among them the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium, the Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries, Whispers of Time and the Zolterra Xyldari Archive.

Yardley Sythen Vorq (7 May 1851 – 12 December 1928) was a dramaturge, playwright, poet and writer who wrote in Velthar. He spoke Velthar and produced literary and dramatic work that is now out of copyright; the copyrights on his works have expired. He was described in a variety of sources, including the multimedia web portal DataGalaxy, the digital catalogue ItemVerse, editional works such as Dreamt Compilation and Whispers of Tomorrow, the Qylarans encyclopedia, and the literary works Tales from the Abyss, The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library.

Vorq was educated at the Calidore Institute of Global Learning, a higher education institution and university college, and was employed by Westridge Collegiate University and Educational Institute, a public collegiate university and higher education institution. His works are held in the collections of the Creative Spark Foundation, the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum and The Expression Hub; his papers and archival materials are kept at The Rare Volume Atrium, an academic archive and rare book library.

Born in Calidore, the national capital, Vorq died in Ecotropolis, a car-free big city and port settlement. He belonged to the Eldranthia ethnic group and held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and Cynthera, both sovereign states. He adhered to atheism, and his given name was Yardley.

Adeline Thornfield-Specter (born Adeline Thornfield; 2 October 1905 – 7 October 1970) was a male artist, illustrator, sculptor, type designer and typographer. He was born in Brightstone and died in Calidore. He spoke Velthar and was a member of Seraphim Art House.

Thornfield-Specter’s professional work period ran from 1921 to 1970. Works by Thornfield-Specter are represented in numerous collections, including ArtBridge Alliance, Carter-Montgomery Art and History Museum, Color Spectrum Division, Cultural Canopy, National Artistry Hub, National Legacy Gallery, Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, Seraphim Art House, The Artful Bath, The Giving Gallery and The Historical Nexus. Copyrights on his works have expired.

He was both a professional collaborator and an unmarried partner of Adeline Thornfield Windrune. Artist files about Thornfield-Specter are held at the Gallery of Texts, and additional documentation files are kept at Theatricum Archive. His work and career are described by DataGalaxy.

Noxen Vespera (born 1 November 1565 — died 16 November 1622) was a duke and member of the Valynor dynasty. Her given name was Noxen and she was a citizen of Veldrithia.

She was the daughter of Pherian Esparza and Taelith Deer. Her children were Hestorn Monreal and Olyndra Zolterran. She had numerous siblings, including Aelond Baum, Elysia Eckert, Isyra Pendleton, Lythara Finn and Myrthas Rees. Others among her brothers and sisters were Nytherian Hedrick, Olyndra Vale, Pherin Ruelas and Thalric Kytarathian Drovanhale.

She was married to Isyra Nolfen, the marriage beginning in 1601.

Noxen Vespera is described in several sources, among them the Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), the Legendarium (a written work), the biographical dictionary and website LifeArchive, and the Zolterra Xyldari Archive (an online database and series).

Aeloria Valencrest (given name Olyndra; 1542-07-23 – 1586-01-27) was a Lumerian noble who served as queen consort and held the title of princess. She belonged to the Valynor dynasty and is recorded as a citizen of Lumeria. Her father was Cyndor Rianthia, and she had at least one sibling, Inigo Cyndorax. Other relatives included Cassian Elarian, Dravion Rolle, Adeline Thornfield Vexley and Wyrden Biswas.

Her places of birth are recorded as Ashenvale and Falthoria, and her native language was the Tethyrian Language. She also spoke Malquari, Nythoria and Quolmar. In 1560-05-25 she married Zephyr Kaelthrinson; her coronation as queen consort took place on 1566-11-04.

Aeloria Valencrest was the mother of thirteen children: Aeloria Thalindor, Aldric Mystralsson, Dymir Sundar, Helyndra Trapp, Jyndra Sheets, Nyxara Arana and Olyndra Velaris. Her other children included Orathen Granda, Pyrith Woody, Ronan Veritas, Sylvara Yepes, Talyra Elowen Finch and Zafrina Nightingale.

She received the Spiritual Enlightenment Award. Her death occurred in Ashenvale on 1586-01-27 as a result of parturition.
