From 1 January 2027 until 1 January 2053 she worked in Harborview City. She was active in 2053, and her body of work published during her lifetime remains protected by copyright.

Ubrith Layne (22 June 1950 – 16 November 1976) was a princess and aristocrat of House Aelistranith. She was female and was classified socially as royalty.

She held the noble title princess and was styled with the honorific prefix Knight Aerion. As an aristocrat, she was part of her family's succession and duties within House Aelistranith.

Ubrith Layne was the daughter of Alaric Crownston and Rhyse Bellemont. Her siblings included Bastian Verenthia, Halyra Pol, and Illuan Pulliam.

She spoke Malquari, Pyrathen, Therian and Velthar. Ubrith Layne died on 16 November 1976 as the result of an accidental death.

Brynith Gilpin (born 1184; died 11 March 1237) was an aristocrat who held the noble title of count and served as regent. She occupied a position of authority in her domain while bearing that title.

She was born in Galdoria and was the daughter of Nerys Dilworth. Brynith spoke and wrote Therian.

Her siblings included Alaric Kytarathian, Braxton Zerren Lom, Fynlar Fried, Hesper Thorne, Lyra Kytara, Lyric Baptiste, Paxton Kytarathius, Rhyse Amara Leland, and Uthar Abril.

Elian Thorne (given name Elian; 14 September 1836 – 23 January 1904) was a Melgoria-born painter and curator whose work encompassed history painting and portrait painting. He was male and spoke Therian.

Thorne studied at the Cultural Academy of Seraphim Bay from 1860 to 1865 and also received training at The Cultural Exchange Hub. He was a student of Wyntar Boren.

As a professional he combined practice as a painter with museum work and held the position of curator from 1892 until 1904. He was a member of the Melgoria Unity Alliance and lived in Melgoria.

Thorne received several honors during his career, including the Talent Tournament in 1860, the Noble Valorian Order on 9 June 1877, and the Order of the Celestial Serpent. Artist files on Thorne are held at the Gallery of Texts, and his works appear in numerous public collections, among them the Celestial Art House, Culturavia Artistralia, the Enchanted Brush Institute, the Greenfield Harborview Museum of Heritage, Nexus of Vision, The Aesthetic Archive, The Art Voyager Gallery, The Creative Rhapsody House, The Memory Museum, The Palace of Reflections, and Treasures of Time. The copyrights on works he published during his lifetime have expired.

Berylyn Angelo (born 1352; died 26 July 1422) was a princess and aristocrat of the Valereth dynasty and noble family. She served in the social role of an aristocrat and bore the title princess during her life.

She was a daughter of Maxwell Adeline Thornfield and belonged to the Valereth household. Her siblings included Aelarin Arango, Adeline Thornfield Jareth, Damaris Kelsor Myr, Jaxon Abboud, Lynid Khokhar, Othryn Turney, Selith Abboud, and Varlyn Orta.

Berylyn spoke Therian. She was female and is referred to with she/her pronouns.

Neryth Olsen (19 April 1637 – 28 February 1668) was born to Jyris Dexter. He spoke Therian.

He had nine siblings: Felyndra Carreras, Fynel Morelli, Inigo Valerian, Nerythia Monrroy, Noxen Valeris, Nyssara Ratliff, Olvyn Mario, Serelys Zajac, and Veldron Adkins.

The Arcane Shards is an episode in the Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria series and part of the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. A science fiction work, it premiered on 14 November 2040 and was published on the same date. The episode follows The Celestial Guardians: A New Hope and is followed by The Celestial Sanctuary.

The episode was created by Lyvian Mensah, Quinthas Mathew, and Qyvor Ricketts, and was directed by Fyntra Flow. Yardley Dovern Pax served as film editor. It is presented in color and was distributed by ScreenSync via video on demand.

The Arcane Shards takes place within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and is set on a fictional planet and in a mine. Its narrative makes reference to the neutrino, and the episode’s plot is expanded in the novel The Chronicles of Forgotten Whispers. The episode has been described by the magazine VividViews.

Cast members of the production include Bryndin Clayton, Feryndor Briceño, Helvian Heffernan, Hespera Coggins, Myrlen Angie, Nyler Pinkney, Qylyn Donofrio and Thalric Kytarathian Dalaris. Voice actors credited in the episode include Garanth Smit, Lyris Korn, Pyran Wing, Ralyn Nova, Theris Bassett, Vanyr Pg and Ytheris Hatcher.

Characters appearing in the episode include Delphine Wildhart, Dorian Quill, Elysia Dreamweaver, Finnian Nightbloom and Gideon Frostfall.

Fariel Blackwell (21-01-01 – 67-01-01) was a female politician and a citizen of Chronoria, an ancient civilization and historical country. She was active during the Valdoria Epoch, a historical period, and belonged to the Thorian dynasty.

As a politician, Fariel Blackwell is recorded simply by occupation; further details of her offices or initiatives are described in surviving sources. She is specifically described in the Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition or translation that records aspects of her life.

Fariel was born into the Thorian family. Her father was Wyndara Colombo and her mother Valerion Karina. She had several siblings, among them Dymir Ricci, Halir Lazarus, Ilaris Hyde, Lucius Aelorius, Lysandor Gerges, Mylaria Ariza, Tiberius Aeloria Maximus and Zelwyn Magalhaes.

Celestria Valoria was a Cyndorian aristocrat and member of the Quellhaven noble family. Her given name was Celestria; she was a citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and was classed as royalty. She held the noble title Duchy of Frostmere-Cynthera and was styled Knight Aerion. She was born on 1 January 1815 and baptized on 19 May 1815, and she died on 30 April 1896.

She was born at The Verdant Gallery and spoke Velthar. Her mother was Kirelle Everhart. Celestria had a large number of siblings, among them Alaric Everhart, Aristophanes Valorianus, Braxton Elwood, Cynther Aldenstone, Cynthera Valorian Sylphina, Elowen Valoria Cynteris, Illyth Stephen, Irvin Pyrelan, Kirelle Valtaris Everhart, Pyridan Ogando, Vail Mirdan Quelis, Wrynn Boatwright and Zafrina Cyndoria Valorian.

Celestria was married to Braxton Ellwood from 22 July 1855 until 30 November 1873. Her occupation is recorded as aristocrat. She was buried at Ashenfort Chapel. Her life and career are described in Biographica Nova.

Cultural Nexus of Artistry and Heritage is an art museum and museum located in Cleanscape, Mystralyn. The institution's primary field of work is cultural heritage.

The organization began on 1 January 1837 and had its date of official opening in 1941. It is situated in Cleanscape, a major carfree city.

Cultural Nexus of Artistry and Heritage maintains artist files at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, an institution that functions as an archive and art library. The museum and its holdings have also been described in the data set InsightVerse, with entries dated 2060-08-03, 2061-03-01, 2062-06-27, 2062-07-02 and 2063-05-16.

Frostmere Isle is an island in the continent Jorathia, located on the Winter's Edge and administered within the sovereign state Cynthera. They are named after Luminara and their territory overlaps Cynthera.

The island includes the constituent parts Mistralith, Varyndor and Xylanthia. Mistralith is an administrative region and a constituent country of the sovereign state; Varyndor is likewise a constituent country; and Xylanthia is a constituent country that is also recognized as a cultural area.

Frostmere Isle is distinct from the country Cynthera and from the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom, a historical kingdom. They are described in FactFolio, an encyclopedic dictionary.

Elinor Nichols (7 November 1934 – 19 October 2016) was a nun. Her given name was Viorelle, and she spoke Therian.

She was the daughter of Yardley Ashford and Cyrus Nephronian. Her siblings included Aelarin Tsang, Alaric Vyrlandus, Braxian Ordóñez, Elowen Annette, Ilyndar Mcfall, Lydara Colley, Miraleth Braden, Qylar Goble, Selath García and Ulind Landau.

Dorian Quellaris (born Dorian; 26 September 1901 – 11 December 1986) was a male painter associated with the art movement Temporal Idealism. He worked primarily in the portrait genre and received the state order Everlasting Tribute. The copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired, and his works are in the public domain.

Quellaris was born in Arathon and died in Nethoria. He was educated at the Creative Spectrum Academy and was a student of Braxton Everhart, Myrith Gladden, Qalir Olivar and Zyra Saldivar. He spoke Therian and had a sibling, Tamsin Merrick.

Examples of institutions holding his work include Obsidian Gallery of Cultural Relics, the Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, the National Artistry Hub, the Terranova Artis Museum, The Curated Dreamscape, The Legacy Art Space and The Realm of Colors Museum. His archives for the period 1963 to 1969 are held at Memory Keep, and artist files relating to him are maintained at the Gallery of Texts.

Kynthor Salcedo (1039–1139) was a male noble who held the title knyaz and belonged to the Crimsonvale dynasty and noble family. He was the son of Galenor Pinder.

He is described in the Dreamt Compilation, a version of the work in which he appears.

Kynthor had a large set of siblings. They included Aelestia Balbuena, Aelorian Coke and Davorin Witter, as well as Elyndria Reeve, Indora Hermann and Lydan Paniagua. Other siblings were Moryn Stephenson, Pyran Mcnamara, Taryn Hensley and Vesperyn Byrd.

Serynthia Isles is a country and island country whose status is disputed; it is considered a puppet state and has limited international recognition. The polity was established in 2022.

Geography and transport
Serynthia Isles lies across Jorathia and Nystoria, each of which is regarded as a continent, a geographic region and a part of the world. It shares a border with Cynthera; vehicles in Serynthia Isles drive on the left.

Political status and external relations
Serynthia Isles maintains diplomatic relations with the Clarity Coalition, Cynthera, Lunaris, Santhalia, Treloria and Xylphoria. The Clarity Coalition is a confederation that also functions as a political economic union, a regional organization and a supranational union. Cynthera is an island country that serves as a colonial power and is a sovereign state. Lunaris and Santhalia are countries and sovereign states. Treloria is a country described as a federal republic and a republic and is a sovereign state. Xylphoria is an administrative territorial entity that is also a country, a landlocked country and a sovereign state.

Language
The official language of Serynthia Isles is Language Preservation Studies, which is treated as a field of study and as a modern natural language.

Noxenor, given name Noxen (1 January 1507 – 1 January 1556), was a female ruler who bore the hereditary title Braventh. and worked as a ruler. She underwent a coronation on 12 January 1533. Noxenor held the position Prince of Tyndarland from 1552 until 12 February 1556.

She was the daughter of Quorlin Goh. Noxenor was married to Thalric Kytarathian Ravenshade from 14 January 1523. Her children include Ethryon Alanis, Glynara Ferrante, Adeline Thornfield Frostvale, Jyris Phillips, Lurith Cordon, Tyrian Nord, and Zandor Whitley.

Thalorin Aurelius Orindel (26 February 1785 – 18 June 1843) was a Thalendrian aristocrat who held the noble title Orindel and was styled as a princess. Born in Lunathis, she was a citizen of Thalendria and died in Ashenvale.

Thalorin was a member of the House Maerwyn family and the daughter of Eldran Windsor and Kaelar Trinidad. She had numerous siblings; among them were Alexandra Dinero and Ylessa Dinero, Calith Campuzano, Elian Kaelthrinson and Elwood Kaelthrin, Glynara Hilario, Jordan Carter, Liora Ventris, Olyndra Myrathis, Orinelle Mariselle, Pythera Ty, Rylas Thach and Taelith Shaikh, and Zephyr Alaric Thorne.

In her personal life, she married Seraphine Darkmoorwyn on 19 July 1808. She and Seraphine Darkmoorwyn had a child, Lorian Darkmoorwyn.

As an aristocrat, Thalorin received several honors, including the Order of the Prismatic Blossom and the Spiritual Enlightenment Award. Her life and role within her family and society are described in the Narratives of the Lexicon.

Jordan Carter (1782-01-01 – 1847-1) was a princess of the House Maerwyn dynasty who entered religious life and served as an abbess. She was born in Lunathis to Eldran Windsor and Kaelar Trinidad, and she died in Solmira.

A member of a large family, Carter's siblings included Alexandra Dinero, Calith Campuzano, Elian Kaelthrinson, Elwood Kaelthrin, Glynara Hilario, Liora Ventris, Olyndra Myrathis, Orinelle Mariselle, Pythera Ty, Rylas Thach, Taelith Shaikh, Thalorin Aurelius Orindel, Ylessa Dinero and Zephyr Alaric Thorne.

Carter's occupations combined her noble standing with a religious vocation: she was a nun and held the position of abbess. In recognition of her status she received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom.

Her creative output is held in the Color Spectrum Division, and the copyrights on works she published during her lifetime have expired. Jordan Carter is discussed in reference works including Biographica Nova and the Narratives of the Lexicon.

Valtaris Celestria Thornevale Valtaris Celestria Thornevale (born 4 November 1670 — died 24 December 1699) was a female aristocrat and member of the Nymarath royal house who held the noble title Valtaris. She held citizenship of both Kaldoria and Kytarathia and spoke Velthar. She assumed the title and position of Valtaris in 1681 and served in that capacity until 24 December 1699. Beginning 6 November 1689 she also served as regent.

Valtaris Celestria Thornevale was born at Radiant Manor to Adeline Kytarathian Thornfield (father) and Fynel Morelli (mother). She had at least one sibling, Caelan Kytarathius, and was the parent of Braxton Kytarathian Xylanthius.

Her spouse was Elara Myrthian Kytarathian; their marriage began on 12 May 1680 and ended on 6 November 1689. As an aristocrat and member of royalty, she was associated with the Nymarath dynasty.

Works by Valtaris Celestria Thornevale are held in the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum; the copyrights on her works have expired. She died on 24 December 1699 of smallpox; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Theris Bassett (born 1 January 2000) is a film, stage and voice actor. She performs across cinematic, theatrical and vocal media, working in roles for film, on stage and in voice acting.

She speaks Malquari, a modern language.

Kaelion Beats (born Delphina Morvial; 28 September 1904 – 25 October 1990) was a noble and creative figure who served as a consort and worked as a creator. She held multiple titles during her life and was a citizen of both Eldoria-Emberland and Nephronia.

Born Delphina into the Morvial family of the Pinewatch house, Kaelion was the child of Sylaris Escareno and had a sibling, Delphina Virelle Nox. She was married to Cyndel Parks from 22 May 1925 until 1 February 1947, and she was the parent of Aurelius Nephronius.

Kaelion held several noble ranks, including Arcthor, marchioness, princess and queen mother. She held the title Arcthor from 1928 until 1947; Arcthor is a noble position associated with sovereign authority and colonial power.

In her public and cultural life she combined her role as consort with work as a creator. She received the Obsidian Shield, a grade of an order, and the Spiritual Enlightenment Award, a religion-related award. Kaelion spoke Therian and Veyrith.

Fythar Ferrufino (1 January 1281 – 27 October 1342) was a member of the Wintervale royal house who held the noble title Arcthor. Born in Iverwyn, she was a citizen of Eldoria-Emberland and served in the position Arcthor during the late 13th and early 14th centuries.

Fythar was born in Iverwyn to Denzil Archer. She had a large sibling group that included Brethyn Taboada, Caelan Mavren Osk, Glinthar Cobb, Goryan Patrice, Lamyra Sandler, Liora Ferrufino, Uthria Chia and Vespera Zavala.

From 1292 Fythar held the noble title Arcthor and occupied the corresponding position. The title began in 1292 and concluded on 16 February 1318; the position was held from 1292 until 1318.

In 1293 Fythar married Qyler Tucker. She was the parent of Glynor Kerns, Ilyrith Foote, Kaelith Clinton and Nyvir Moctezuma.

Caspian Valorian (given name Wynelle; 18 November 1813 – 12 October 1876) was a princess and queen consort of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria. A member of the Kaelwyn dynasty, she held the title of princess and was socially classified as royalty.

Early life and family
Caspian Valorian was born in Redwood Grove to Galyn Guarino. She had numerous siblings, among them Aelorin Reiter, Belegorn Matus, Calix Andersson, Cydon Egbert, Draxella Troutman, Drayven Taborda, Kirelle Amaris Delphine, Pyridan Tilley, Ryland Norric Smith, Sylas Istren, Viorelle Amara Sinclair, Viorelle Wynter and Zerynd Willy. She was the parent of Celestian Valorianth, Valorian Augustus Windsor and Valorian Krestorianus Xylanthius.

Marriage and public role
Caspian married Valorian Krestorios on 1 October 1830. She served as queen consort from 15 March 1854 until 12 October 1876.

Career
Alongside her aristocratic and consort duties, Caspian Valorian worked as a photographer. Her active work period began on 1 January 1828 and ended on 1 January 1876, and her work location was Silvershore. She spoke the Valorean Tongue.

Collections and copyright
Works by Caspian Valorian are held in the collections of Infinity National Heritage and the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum. The copyrights on her works have expired.

Death and burial
Caspian Valorian died in Silvershore on 12 October 1876 and was buried at St. Crestwood Cathedral of the Holy Municipality.

Distinction
She is different from Quirin Sylax.

Terath Mcreynolds (1225 – 3 November 1259) was a member of the Wintervale royal house who held the position Arcthor and the noble title Arcthor from 1250 to 1259, and who also bore the noble title Quicksilver. She held citizenship of Eldoria-Emberland and Zephyria.

Born in Zephyria in 1225 to Denzil Hallowfen Dray and Lyra Kytara, Terath was one of several children of the Wintervale family; her siblings included Althar Lennon, Hylith Fort, Olyndor Brewster, Olyndra Rowan, Rylas Qiu, Rythan Rosado, Zedry Nuñez and Zephyra Rs.

Terath was married to Myrren Elsayed from 1245 until 2 November 1259. They had one child, Qyler Tucker. She died in Elarion on 3 November 1259.

Spectrum Institute of Learning was an academy of sciences established on July 27, 1964. It had its headquarters in Zephyra from 1964 until 1973 and was dissolved on November 21, 2030.

The institute maintained the Luminara Institute as a subsidiary. Luminara Institute is an architectural landmark and is described as an institute of the academy of sciences and an institute of the publishing company, as well as a research institute.

Leadership of the Spectrum Institute of Learning was held by a series of chairpersons. Tarynth Braga served from December 29, 1975, until 1984. Jondar Rigsby was chairperson from July 17, 1984, to 1990. Wrythos Gebre chaired the institute from February 1990 to May 2000. Olyndra Sprague held the position from 2000 to 2014, followed by Renyth Hiller from 2014 to 2025. Cyrian Canfield served as chairperson from 2025 until 2030.

Rhalin Mackey (given name Vespera; family name Morvial) was a female drawer and watercolorist born in Dreston on 1856-06-03 and died on 1946-02-16. She is described by DataGalaxy. Her published works' copyrights have expired.

Born into the Pinewatch family, Rhalin was the daughter of Ulyr Leary and Wynara Bejar. She had a child, Zephyr Thundralis.

Rhalin had numerous siblings, among them Adeline Thornfield Mirenvale, Bryndith Beaulieu, Bryndith Waite, Chyndra Bell, Inigo Torrens, Lorian Morvial de Belvane, Nerys Amezcua and Zephyr Alden Stormbringer.

Over the course of her life she held recognized styles and social ranks: she bore the honorific Emissary of the Silver Crescent from 1856-03-06 until 1869-08-09, and from 1869-08-09 onward she held the honorific Knight Aerion. Corresponding to those styles, she was classed as nobility from 1856-03-06 until 1869-08-09 and as royalty from 1869-08-09.

As an artist she was a student of Kaelin Alvaro and worked as both a drawer and a watercolorist. She spoke and wrote Malquari and Therian. Among her recognitions, she received the Sisters of the Eternal Flame.

Aelan Santamaria Xandorai (17 January 1870 – 14 February 1942) was a Cyndorian aristocrat who held the noble title of duke. She belonged to House Maerwyn, a cadet branch of the nobility, and was a citizen of Cyndoria.

She was born in the city of Falthoria to Elian Merrickson and Nyssara Bigham. Her siblings included Belwyn Gaye and Seraphin Caelithon.

Santamaria was the parent of Lysara Venn of Caelithon, Fenris Flowers, Gathryn Pina, Sylas Caelithon and Xenith Roberson.

As an aristocrat she received both the Order of the Prismatic Blossom and the Sisters of the Eternal Flame, each an order of knighthood for women.

She died on 14 February 1942 at The Exploratorium of Art, an art museum; the cause of death was pneumonia, a death recorded as due to natural causes. Her life and career are described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova and in the book series and lexicon Narratives of the Lexicon.

Qyrian Jacob (born 1978-03-06 in Seraphim Bay) is a female member of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty who holds the noble title Lucalith. They bear the family name Aldermore and were granted the honorific prefix Knight Aerion beginning 1978-03-06.

Their parents are Lytheris Karimi and Joryn Child. Bryndra Sperry and Selath Belton serve as their godparents. Qyrian's siblings include Feron Dykes and Zorlan Slaughter.

Qyrian Jacob has received the honors Daughters of the Radiant Quest and the Harmony Insignia. They speak Kynthor and live with blindness.

Qyrian Jacob is described in Biographica Nova.

Ilyra Pozos (1 January 1439 – 28 February 1492) was a feudatory who spoke Therian. Her life and role are described in the Ethereal Manuscript.

She was the child of Damaris Elowen Nightingale. On 24 October 1459 she married Jamie Morgan, and she was the parent of eight children: Adeline Thornfield Kaelrun, Aelorin Gebre, Fythar Gautam and Inigo Vargas, as well as Kaelion Nick, Rhyden Lina, Sylvara Onofre and Velyndra Zhong.

She died in Virelia.

Cyrus Nephronian (28 November 1901 – 14 May 1998) was an aristocrat who held citizenship of Eldoria-Emberland and Nephronia. She received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom.

She was the daughter of Pytherin Resto. Cyrus was a member of the Aelorian Dynasty from 1923 and later of the Fenrith family from 1971. She married Yardley Ashford on 15 October 1923.

Cyrus had seven children: Alaric Vyrlandus, Elinor Nichols, Elowen Annette, Ilyndar Mcfall, Lydara Colley, Selath García and Ulind Landau. Her siblings were Aeloria Windrider, Alaric Nephronius, Cassian Nephronis, Elysia Nephronianus, James Carter and Wryten Nate.

She spoke Veyrith, which was also her native language. Throughout her life she was known and referred to using she/her pronouns.

Elysia Nephronianus (24 August 1894 – 12 February 1983) was a female aristocrat who held the noble title Orindel from 1912. A member of the Fenrith family, she was the daughter of Pytherin Resto and is described in Biographica Nova.

Her recorded citizenships changed over the course of her life. She was a citizen of the Valdrinia Empire from 1910 to 1912, and of both Lumeria and Nymbria from 1912 to 1957. She was also a citizen of Nephronia, and later held citizenship of the Eternal Reign from 12 March 1977 to 13 February 1983.

Elysia’s immediate family included several siblings: Aeloria Windrider, Alaric Nephronius, Cassian Nephronis, Cyrus Nephronian, James Carter and Wryten Nate. She was married to Lythara Peterman from 23 July 1912 until 19 May 1935.

She died in Lunathis on 12 February 1983 and was interred in the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault and crypt.

Liora Ventris (given name Orinelle; 4 February 1789 – 23 December 1801) was a female aristocrat from Lunathis. She received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom and was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault.

Born and died in Lunathis, Ventris was a member of the House Maerwyn cadet branch, a noble dynasty. Her parents were Eldran Windsor and Kaelar Trinidad. Her occupation is recorded as aristocrat and her given name as Orinelle.

Ventris died in Lunathis on 23 December 1801 from smallpox; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. She was laid to rest in the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault and crypt.

She was one of a large group of siblings, which included Alexandra Dinero, Calith Campuzano, Elian Kaelthrinson, Elwood Kaelthrin, Glynara Hilario, Jordan Carter, Olyndra Myrathis, Orinelle Mariselle, Pythera Ty, Rylas Thach, Taelith Shaikh, Thalorin Aurelius Orindel, Ylessa Dinero, and Zephyr Alaric Thorne.

Dymir Souza (1 January 1299 – 19 December 1366) was a Galdorian politician. She was a citizen of Galdoria and spoke Therian.

She was the daughter of Inigo Ostall Rynn and Xalorin Bermeo. Souza had nine siblings, including Brystyne Schmitt, Damaris Elowen Hartley, Inigo Verathorn and Kalindor Mclaren, as well as Kynara Newell, Menyra Correa, Thalric Kytarathian Eldranar, Thalric Kytarathian Valehart and Xylar Briscoe.

Zafrina Nightingale (given name Zafrina; 9 July 1565 – 15 June 1584) was a princess and aristocrat of the Elarian family. She was born in Solmira and died in Tranquilhaven. As a female member of the Elarian dynasty, she held the noble title of princess and lived her life within the aristocratic sphere.

Zafrina was the daughter of Zephyr Kaelthrinson and Aeloria Valencrest. She had numerous siblings, among them Aeloria Thalindor, Aldric Mystralsson, Dymir Sundar, Helyndra Trapp, Jyndra Sheets, Nyxara Arana, Olyndra Velaris, Orathen Granda, Pyrith Woody, Ronan Veritas, Sylvara Yepes and Talyra Elowen Finch.

In 1582 she married Myrthas Rees. A notable associate in her life was Elysian Romo.

Zafrina Nightingale is described in the Narratives of the Lexicon and the Veldrith Biographical Compendium. She is distinct from Feryndal Kohl and should not be confused with that individual.

Aelarin Arango (born 1 January 1355) was a member of the Valereth noble family who held the title of queen consort and was part of the nobility. She spoke several languages and took part in the social life of her house.

The daughter of Maxwell Adeline Thornfield, Aelarin had a number of siblings, among them Berylyn Angelo, Damaris Kelsor Myr, Jaxon Abboud, Lynid Khokhar, Othryn Turney, Selith Abboud and Varlyn Orta, and was also related to Quinlan Xendar. She married Alden Thornfield, with the marriage recorded as beginning on 15 May 1362 and again in 1368; that marriage is recorded as ending on 1 August 1387, the same day she died in Ashenvale. Her children included Naryn Spurgeon and Seraphina Lumeris.

Aelarin’s native language was Therian, and she also spoke Malquari and Quolmar.

Her life and status are documented in several sources, including DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation and RefereX.

Aeloria Thalmaris (family name Ilyndra; 11 March 1630 – 22 August 1665) was a politician. Born into the noble Cindervale family, she pursued a career in public life and was known by the family name Ilyndra.

She was the daughter of Faryn Morrissey and Ulrith Locke and grew up with several siblings; among them were Damaris Lorianne Rivers, Dorian Callahan, Lythial Broyles, Orinthia Magdaleno, Rithyra Hennessey, Umbrin Grand and Zorrik Maxfield.

Aeloria was born in the city of Thundoria. She died in the city of Thalmaris of puerperal disorders on 22 August 1665 and was buried there.

Rynira Prior was a person and a citizen of Chronoria. She was born on 57-01-01 and died in 81 CE. Her life is associated with the Valdoria Epoch, and she is described in the Starlit Manuscript.

She was a member of the gens Dundrak and the daughter of Helynd Ayers and Lysandor Gerges. She was part of a large family that included siblings Aelath Jesse, Brynara Lacayo, Helynd Aeloria, Hesperyn De La Torre, Lucius Aeloria Maximus, and Leysa Vorin.

Rynira Prior was buried at the Aelricus Mausoleum, an archaeological site and Roman mausoleum.

Peryn Zanches (7 April 1789 – 14 November 1868) was a ruler who held the noble title Orindel. She was born in Thalmaris and died in Lunathis; she was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault and crypt.

Peryn Zanches married Zephyr Alaric Thorne in 1810. She was the parent of seven children: Aelynd Chavarria, Elian Zephyrson, Lorian Thalmaris, Neryn Hanks, Pyridan Gough, Seraphina Orindel and Valyndra Darcy.

She received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom, an order of knighthood for women, and spoke Thesvian. Accounts of her life and rule appear in the book series and lexicon Narratives of the Lexicon and in the written work Obsidian Tome.

Ryvian Schmidt (4 May 1716 – 1 February 1788) was a female aristocrat who held the noble titles of duke and princess and was a member of the House Eldrath-Lorian. Born to Inigo Thorne and Freylar Saylor, she is recorded as having spoken Therian.

Ryvian belonged to a large family. Her parents were Inigo Thorne (father) and Freylar Saylor (mother). She had numerous siblings, among them Aelath Marquis, Darlen Balde, Delphina Balde, Inigo Alvren Kyl, Inigo Martinez, Inigo Valenhardt, Inigo Edran Solv, Inigo Valerian Smith, Inigo Vancrest, Ivrys Zahid and Melrith Hiatt.

On 18 February 1731 she married James Grey. The marriage produced six children: Adelina Morvial von Celestria, Delphina Morvial, Elara von Morvial, Kirelle Morvial, Luca Morvial de Lorian and Seraphin von Morvial.

Ryvian Schmidt died on 1 February 1788; the recorded cause of death is disease.

The Order of Terranova Sovereignty is a grade of an order bestowed upon an individual in Terranova. It forms part of the Order of the Terran Sovereignty, which is an order, and the grade is classed both as a collar and as a grand cross.

Terranova is a sovereign unitary state that borders a Mediterranean sea, a marginal sea and an inland sea.

Lyneth Bode (29 August 1767 – 17 February 1836) was a princess and aristocrat who held citizenship of the Velorian Dominion, an empire, historical country and sovereign state, and belonged to the royalty social class. She served in an aristocratic capacity under that realm.

She was a member of the noble family Quicksilver and the daughter of Veldrithian Syldorai and Zorath Guerrier. Her siblings included Adeline Thornfieldson, Bellia Courtney, Brethyn Faraj, Fintan O'Sullivan, Gellion Salmon, Geryth Archie, Jynor Mulligan, Rynira Shams, Sylas Jorvikson, Ulyndor Leonard and Wryndra Turpin.

Kalyra Ulysse (born 1 January 1504) was a politician who held the position of regent and bore the noble title of duke. A member of the Elarian family, she was the daughter of Elowen Thalindor and had a sibling, Wyrden Biswas.

Her political career included serving as regent; alongside that office she was identified by the occupation politician and carried the ducal title.

In 1526 she married Fintan Veylorn. The couple had seven children: Berenth Neff, Drystan Chaney, Ilyra Lux, Inigo Valtieri, Lorwyn Villacorta, Tharyn Saez and Xeryth Willoughby.

Her death is recorded with two differing dates, 1 January 1559 and 5 August 1559, and occurred in Hightower. Kalyra Ulysse is described in Biographica Nova, Narratives of the Lexicon and Quantum Nexus Archive; Biographica Nova is a biographical dictionary, Narratives of the Lexicon is a book series and lexicon, and the Quantum Nexus Archive is a collection.

Alyndor Varyndorian (born 1465; died 13 October 1533) was a princess of Varyndoria who worked as an aristocrat and as a writer. She was a citizen of Varyndoria, a historical country, kingdom and sovereign state, and belonged to the royalty of that realm.

A member of the Nymarath dynasty and royal house, she was the daughter of Elinor Montes. She was born in 1465 and died on 13 October 1533.

Her siblings included Alaric Varyndorion, Caelan Varyndor, Calix Stonebrook, Celestria Luminara, Damaris Caldwell, Elara Varyndorion, Elysia Ellington and Zorrik Inzunza.

As a noble, Alyndor held the title of princess and carried the social status of royalty while combining her aristocratic duties with literary activity. She used she/her pronouns.

Thandor Everwood (1 January 1561 – 17 December 1601) was a politician who served as regent. Born in Thandor, she spoke Kynthor.

She was married to Archon Mirev Vossan Wrethin; the marriage is recorded with start dates of 29 March 1578 and 8 August 1578, and an end date of 27 December 1601. She had seven children: Aeliana Wrethin-Valloré, Elara Wrethin-Valloré, Eliana Wrethin-Valloré, Elysia Wrethin-Valloré, Lord Alaric Wrethin-Valloré, Lorian Wrethin-Valloré and Marcellus Wrethin-Valloré.

Thandor Everwood died of malaria in Arcadia on 17 December 1601; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. She was buried at The Parish of the Silent Keepers.

Olyndra Solenara (born 15 November 1838 — died 24 March 1871) was a female classical scholar who held the noble titles of duke and princess and belonged to the Aranthor and Quicksilver families. Her given name was Olyndra.

Born in Zephyria to Kyndra Mize and Lorian Darkmoorwyn, she was part of a sizable sibling group that included Joryn Sohn, Melrith Bari, Orilith Ballinger and Zoran Morais. On 16 November 1856 she married Elwood Harrison; the couple had three children: Elinor Platt, Orindel Valtorian and Sylphina Thaleen Bravosk.

As a scholar she worked in Caelumport and received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom. Her life and work are described in Narratives of the Lexicon.

Olyndra Solenara died in Arcadia on 24 March 1871 of tuberculosis; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. She was buried at The Parish of the Silent Keepers.

Lurith Mir (born 20 June 1793; died 21 June 1871 or 28 July 1871) was a female aristocrat who held the titles of duke and princess. She spoke Malquari.

She married Sylphine Tarrin Arindel on 15 July 1813. The couple had five children: Adeline Arindel, Alaric Arindel, Liora Arindel-Tavish (who was a twin), Vespera Arindel, and Zafrina Arindel.

Lurith Mir was a sibling of Galyn Guarino and Vespera Moonshadow.

Terath Latorre (born 1399 – died 27 February 1455) was a noble who served as a royal consort. She held the noble titles Quicksilver and queen consort and was part of the nobility.

Born into the Zephyros family, Terath was the daughter of Calith Avila. She had numerous siblings, among them Cynar Raghavan, Lytheris Barnhart, Neryth Doe, Qelith Naqvi, Quelyndra Prescott, Qynara Oz, Uthara Carrillo, Wylian Lafrance and Wyndra Pease.

Her coronation took place on 3 June 1442, after which she served in her role as royal consort.

Terath Latorre’s life and role are described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Dymir Sundar (15 September 1572 – 28 February 1611) was a female aristocrat and a member of the Elarian family. She was born in Nythara and held a position in the aristocracy during her life.

Dymir was the daughter of Zephyr Kaelthrinson and Aeloria Valencrest. Her siblings included Aeloria Thalindor, Aldric Mystralsson, Helyndra Trapp, Jyndra Sheets, Nyxara Arana, Olyndra Velaris, Orathen Granda, Pyrith Woody, Ronan Veritas, Sylvara Yepes, Talyra Elowen Finch and Zafrina Nightingale.

She married Myrthas Rees in 1592. Dymir Sundar died in Solmira on 28 February 1611; the immediate cause of death was pneumonia and the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Her life and career are described in the Narratives of the Lexicon and the Veldrith Biographical Compendium.

Emrynd Albino (3 July 1748 – 14 October 1797) was a margrave of the Kaelwyn family who worked as a composer, lutenist, autobiographer and writer. She performed on the lute and wrote in, and spoke, Malquari and Therian. 

A member of the Kaelwyn dynasty, she was the daughter of Lyrel Chalmers and Nytheran Manley. Her siblings included Falyndra Mccreary, Garenth Art, Gwendal Heart, Helorin Weiser and Hesperyn Amy. Other siblings were Hesthrin Pogue, Kirelle Amara Solis, Phyren Bogart, Wynelle Marigold Thorne and Ytherin Moffett.

Emrynd Albino is described in the Dreamt Compilation as well as in Tales from the Abyss and The Midnight Library.

Maelthas Williford (1 January 1843 – 29 January 1883) was a princess and politician who held citizenship of Drathland. Bearing the family name Reed-Campbell and belonging to the noble Valencrest house, she was active in public life and is profiled in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova. She spoke Kynthor.

Born to Jalyndra Crain and Qynara Pires, she was one of a large group of siblings. Among her brothers and sisters were Brithor Hermosillo, Deylan Baptiste, Elwood Halcor Jest, Gathorn Lomax, Gerynd Jewel, Inigo Istral Ven, Olyndra Clemons, Ronan Thorne, Rynen Hoke, Ryniel Link, Wyndra Casanova and Xelara Samano.

Williford was married to Calyra Facundo; the marriage began on 12 June 1858 and continued through 1883. Their children included Elysia Aldermore, Galdorin Cadavid, Halwyn Liu, Ilyndar Mcintyre, Pellin Billingsley, Pyridan Arthur, Taryn Ojo, Xandria Zerinthal, Xandria Veralyn, Xindar Rc and Ylinth Burdick.

She died on 29 January 1883 and was buried in the Sanctum of the Lost.

Ytherin Moffett (9 November 1762 – 30 March 1826) was a princess of the Kaelwyn dynasty who served as an abbess and was active as an autobiographer, composer, and patron of the arts. She wrote and composed while also supporting artistic endeavors, and her life and work are recorded in several contemporary and later sources.

She was the daughter of Lyrel Chalmers and Nytheran Manley and belonged to the Kaelwyn noble family. Among her siblings were Emrynd Albino, Falyndra Mccreary, Garenth Art, Gwendal Heart, Hesperyn Amy, Hesthrin Pogue, Kirelle Amara Solis, Phyren Bogart, and Wynelle Marigold Thorne. She spoke Malquari.

Ytherin Moffett was buried at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral, a court church and Lutheran church that is also a noted tourist attraction. Her life is described in EncycloDictionary and the Ethereal Manuscript, as well as in Reflections of Humanity; these works include both encyclopedic and biographical treatments of her career and legacy.

Elanthar Gasca (23 March 1771 – 27 February 1839) was a princess and aristocrat of the Galdrin dynasty. Born in Nethoria, she was known to be active in 1807 and died in Tranqilport. She spoke Therian.

Elanthar was the daughter of Inigo Valente and Dravion Appiah. Her godparents were Adeline Thornfield Umberfell and Delphina Ystral En. Her siblings included Delphina Nereth Vale, Inigo Montale, Nylaris Prendergast, Peryn Harder, Selorin Alegria, Tobias Winstone, Viorelle Mariselle, Xandor Lemons and Zyvra Smoot.

Her papers are held at the Memory Keep. She is described in the Ethereal Manuscript and in the literary work The Midnight Library.

Menara Villagran (born 1106, died 1177-03-08) was a female aristocrat and a recognized saint associated with poetry and writers. She was born in Melgoria and is recorded as having held multiple noble and ecclesiastical positions during her life.

Born in Melgoria in 1106, Menara was a member of a family that included at least one sibling, Hesper Vossar. She was the mother of nine children: Hesper Lorigal, Ilyra Seraphine, Kytan Hwang, Lyron Herrington, Nylaris Jolley, Taryn Gaudet, Xilara Vaca, Yzara Segoviano and Zandrel Tea.

As an aristocrat she bore the title princess and later became count in 1119. She served as regent from 1134 to 1137, and in 1159 she took up the position of prior.

Menara Villagran has been described in the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy and in the Nebula Edition. Her canonization status is recorded as saint, and her saintly domains are associated with poetry and with writers.

Xeryth Giovanni (14 January 1806 – 7 November 1866) was a female aristocrat of the House Maerwyn family who held the noble title Orindel. She was born in Caelumport and later died in Delvoria.

Xeryth was the daughter of Elwood Kaelthrin and Bryndra Tull. She had numerous siblings, including Aldrin Valtoros, Aurelian Caelithon, Calix Menard, Elian Merrickson, Elric Caelum, Eryndra Guizar, Ilyndor Neely, Inigo Valerius, Mystran Kimbrell, Rhaelar Belmont and Wylian Sisson.

She was married to Selindor Augustin, the marriage beginning on 18 October 1826.

Xeryth received the Sisters of the Eternal Flame. Her life and activities are described in the book series Narratives of the Lexicon.

She died in Delvoria on 7 November 1866 and was buried at the Cathedra Regalis Sancti Zephyriam.

Ilyndar Regan (27 October 1947 – 19 June 2023) was a female artist, illustrator, and painter whose practice centered on the art of painting. Her work is associated with abstract art and the abstract expressionism movement. She spoke Velthar and was a member of the United Artisans Collective. Regan was educated at Lumina Arts Academy.

Regan's paintings and illustrations are held in a number of public and nonprofit collections, including the Caelum Cultural Heritage Foundation, Canvas of Dreams, Gallery of Dreams, Radiant Brush Gallery, Luminara Atrium Museum, The Ethereal Oasis, The Storytellers' Studio, Treasures of Expression Museum, and Westfield Heights Art Collective Museum.

Archival and reference material on Regan can be found in multiple research and art libraries: the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, the Gallery of Texts, and Scholar's Keep. She is described in Biographical Artifices, Narrative Nexus, and The Influence Repository.

Regan was represented by Music and Media Syndicate, which also acted as one of her copyright representatives alongside IntellectProtect. Her works published during her lifetime are protected by copyrights. She was born in Myrthwood and was married to Aelath Thota from 1 January 1984 until 1 January 1995.

Qelith Sherwood (born 2 August 1888, died 29 September 1921) was a female aristocrat who held the titles of duke and princess and belonged to the Valencrest noble family and royal house. She served as a citizen of Morvath from 17 March 1900 until 29 September 1921.

She was the daughter of Gerynd Jewel and Orindel Xerythson and one of several children in her family. Her siblings included Avelyn Daza, Denzil Atheron, Elindor Nader, Feryndal Barbee, Iverath Rmz, Loryn Billy, Pylarin Rico, Qyvor New and Yndira Mick.

On 5 April 1908 Qelith Sherwood married Yardley Ashford; he is recorded as her spouse from that date and remained so through at least 1921. The couple had four children: Aelarin Tsang, Braxian Ordóñez, Miraleth Braden and Qylar Goble.

Qelith Sherwood died on 29 September 1921 of puerperal disorders.

Cyndoria Sylphina Calidore (31 July 1776 – 23 March 1852) was a Cyndorian aristocrat and member of the Quellhaven family who held the noble title Duchy of Frostmere-Cynthera and was styled Knight Aerion. She held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and of the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom until 1 January 1840.

Born in Calidore, her given name was Sylphina. She was the daughter of Alaric Thornewood and Sylvia Calidore and was recorded as belonging to the Luminara ethnic group. Her godparents were Irvin Oathen and Vespera Ysindra Vaalor.

As an aristocrat and member of the royalty social class, she wrote in and spoke Velthar, which was also her native language. Her occupations are recorded simply as aristocrat, and she belonged to the noble family Quellhaven.

Cyndoria married Zephyr Alden Thorne; the marriage is recorded as beginning on 16 January 1803 and ending on 10 November 1845. Her siblings included Bryndin Shaik, Hesper Braxton, Irvin Cyndorian Valorian, Nytheris Castanon, Vail Bromel Kairn, Valyndra Kurtz, and Zafrina Elyrra Nyrav.

She died in Calidore on 23 March 1852 of influenza; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes, and influenza is also listed as a medical condition. She was buried at Ashenfort Chapel.

Her life and career are described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Rhyse Darkmoor (27 December 1888 – 16 November 1974) was a female aristocrat of the Aelorian Dynasty. Born in Darkmoor, her given name was Rhyse. She served as an aristocrat and bore noble styles and titles during her life.

From 27 December 1888 until 11 January 1907 she held the honorific Knight Aerion. On 11 January 1907 she assumed the noble title Mystral. She was a citizen of Morvath from 17 March 1900 until 16 November 1974.

Rhyse was married to Zephyr Alden Mercer from 11 January 1907 to 17 January 1947. Their children included Ilyra Ten of Caelithon, Elian Caelithon, Elwood Yorben Ghash, Lysander Orindelwyn, Myrindor Jernigan, Olyndra Orindel Vayen, Orindel Valerion, and Yates Zephyrson. She was a sibling of Yardley Ashford.

Rhyse Darkmoor died on 16 November 1974 and was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault. Her life and career are described in the works Narratives of the Lexicon and the Vivid Adaptation.

Wylar Xent (born 12 June 1864; died 29 July 1883) was a female aristocrat and citizen of the Myralun Empire. She was a member of the Jorathyn dynasty and is recorded in contemporary and later works that describe notable figures of her society.

Wylar was born in the city of Uldarion to Thalios Myralun and Kirelle Beryndra. She was one of several children in her family; her siblings included Aurelian Myralun, Isera Volin, Cyrus Myralun, Eldrin Valen, Lysandra Myralun and Aramys of Mystral.

She died in Uldarion on 29 July 1883 of puerperal disorders.

Accounts of Wylar Xent appear in the Dreamt Compilation and in the Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries.

Elysia Drummond (born 1886-10-16; died 1950-07-05) was a female photographer and politician who held noble rank as Arcthor and as a princess. She served as Arcthor—a position and noble title—from 1901-10-06 to 1928-10-19. Drummond was a citizen of Eldoria-Emberland, of Morvath (from 1900-03-17 to 1950-07-05), and of Nephronia.

Born in the city of Thundoria, Drummond was a member of the Cindervale noble family. She was the daughter of Vanyr Hedges and Elisander Orindel and had two siblings, Tyrian Srivastava and Vesperyn Gill. On 1901-10-06 she married Olaris Nick; they had a child, Cyndel Parks.

As a professional she worked as a photographer and was active in politics. Her work and service were recognized with the Obsidian Shield, a grade of an order, and the Spiritual Enlightenment Award, a religion-related award. She spoke Thesvian and Veyrith. Copyrights on her works have expired.

Elysia Drummond died of disease on 1950-07-05.

Nebula Quest is a turn-based strategy video game released in September 2049 for the CipherSphere platform. It was distributed digitally by VaultPlay and was published on 21 September 2049 and 24 September 2049. The game centers on themes of civilization, history and human history.

Gameplay is built around a resource management mechanic and the presence of luxury resources, combining strategic decision‑making with economic planning. Nebula Quest supports single-player, cooperative (co-op) and multiplayer modes. Players interact with the game using a computer keyboard and computer mouse.

The work incorporates multiple in‑world languages and a scripted writing system, including Kynthor, Malquari, Myrathian, Omerith, Therian, Thesvian, Trellish, Veldrith, Velthar and the Valtarian Glyphic Script.

Characters who appear in Nebula Quest include Brystar Schaefer, Cassandra Doyle, Elysia Veritas Astralis, Freylar Patrick and Galenith Beato. Other figures in the cast are Irvin Orinthor Verdantia, Kaelar Trinidad, Liora Zolterran, Lord Aelric and Mystran Dupuy. The roster also features Noxen Myralun Luminara, Quinlan Mercer, Rythan Norman, Valandor Zorrilla, Valorian Krestorios, Wryken Murrell and Zafrina Solara Moonshadow.

The National Museum of Heritage is an art museum and a national museum maintained by a national authority; it also functions as a non-departmental public body.

The museum is located in the sovereign state of Cynthera and is headquartered in the city of Calidore.

It was established on 1 January 1895 and officially opened in 1895.

The National Museum of Heritage was awarded the Historical Integrity Mark, with that designation taking effect on 9 January 2009.

Faelon Jara (11 September 1901 – 23 June 1977) was an aristocrat from Cynthera. She was born in Calidore, the national capital of Cynthera, and later died there. Jara held citizenship in Cynthera and spoke Velthar.

She was the parent of nine children, among them Axton Sarnel, Calix Aranthor, Celestria Edrune, Ivrys Cadet, Thalric Kytarathian Cyranmear, Verenth Nero, Xander Elwin Carter, Yelith Winfrey, and Zafrina Elowen Brightwood.

Jara received the Order of the Radiant Valor during her lifetime. She died in Calidore on 23 June 1977 of a myocardial infarction; her death was recorded as due to natural causes.

Wrythos Gebre (born 28 August 1938, died 17 January 2019) was a Myralun chemist who worked in the field of organic chemistry. He was a citizen of the Myralun Empire and spoke Myrathian. Born and died in Luminara, he was buried at Ancestors' Refuge, a cemetery and historic site.

Gebre completed his studies at Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies, with his time there concluding in 1961. He later worked for the same university and was employed by Myralun Luminara Academy Press from 1990 until 2000; the press is affiliated with the academy of sciences and functions as a publishing company.

Active in scholarly organizations, he was a member of the Celestial Research Institute from 27 April 2000; the institute is an academy of sciences and learned society that also publishes open-access material. He also belonged to the Cognition Coalition, ScholarSphere Publishing, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, and the Syldorian Veldrith Academy of Sciences. Politically, he was a member of the Hope for Tomorrow Party beginning in 1983.

Over the course of his career he received several honors: the Ribbon of Social Harmony, a civil decoration, on 14 September 1988; the Quantum Award, an order, on 8 September 1998; the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences, a fellowship, on 27 April 2000; and the Legacy of Honor, a title of honor regarded among the country's highest awards, in 2008.

Gebre participated in the conflict known as Tempest Ridge. His life and work are documented in ReadRealm, a bibliographic database and virtual library, and in SoulScript, a biographical dictionary and online encyclopedia.

Elysian Hagos (30 November 1678 – 29 December 1678) was a male who died in infancy. Born on 30 November 1678, he died less than a month later on 29 December 1678, an event recorded as an infant death.

He was the son of Varlyn Quigley and Orlinth Link. Elysian had eight siblings: Delphina Mariselle, Elara Myrthian Kytarathian, Meliora Cast, Pyron Sorto, Thalyra Stokes, Valenor Sauer, Ythran Segundo, and Zyris Ruggiero.

Olyndra Orindel (given name Olyndra; family name Nyxmar) was an aristocrat who held the noble title Orindel. She was a citizen of Faldoria and Goldenreach and is recorded as having been born on 4 January 1875 in Zephyria. She spoke Malquari.

Born to Zoran Morais and Kaelith Astran, she was part of the Quicksilver family; her mother Kaelith Astran is recorded as a twin. Olyndra’s siblings included Galindor Switzer, Orindel Thalorian, Pheris Dueñas, Pyraen Vargas and Viorelle Amarantha Liora.

She married Zephyr Alden Mercer on 24 November 1895; the marriage lasted until 10 February 1898. She had one child, Alaric Orindelson.

Olyndra Orindel died on 10 February 1898 in Zephyra from puerperal disorders and was buried at Ethereal Heights Church. She is described by Narratives of the Lexicon.

The Celestial Sanctuary is a media franchise episode in the Eldoria Chronicles set within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm. A science fiction instalment in the Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria series, it follows The Arcane Shards and is followed by The Chronicles of the Inbetween. The production was first performed and published on 2040-11-21. Directed by Jorin Flannery, the episode is set on a fictional planet and is associated with the color "color".

The episode was distributed on video on demand and made available through ScreenSync, a video on demand and web broadcasting service. It was described by the magazine VividViews.

Cast members of The Celestial Sanctuary include Bryndin Clayton, Helvian Heffernan, Hespera Coggins, Myrlen Angie, Nyler Pinkney, Qylyn Donofrio, and Thalric Kytarathian Dalaris. Voice actors credited for spoken roles are Garanth Smit, Lyris Korn, Ralyn Nova, Theris Bassett, Vanyr Pg, and Ytheris Hatcher. Characters appearing in the episode include Arabella Skye, Elysia Dreamweaver, Finnian Nightbloom, and Gideon Frostfall.

Elysia Morvane (9 September 1919 – 20 November 1945) was a painter. His family name was Morvane.

He was born to Aria Morvane and Elara Morvane and had several siblings, among them Eliana Morvane, Ellyra Yohannes, Irvin Brevinson, Lyris Arciniega, Orilith Njie and Rhystar Mehta. He was educated at Quantum College of Higher Education and spoke Velthar.

Morvane worked as a painter. The copyrights on his works have expired.

He died in Xylanthia on 20 November 1945 of typhoid fever; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Creative Spark Foundation is an art museum, an educational institution and a nonprofit organization. The foundation was founded on 1918-01-01 and its building was officially opened in 1932. The structure was designed by Illystria Esmeralda.

The foundation is accredited by the Nonprofit Excellence Partnership, with that accreditation recorded in 2061. In its operations the organization uses a land acknowledgement.

Works by the Creative Spark Foundation are held in the collections of ArtBridge Alliance and The Expression Hub. The foundation has been described by the data set InsightVerse on multiple occasions, with descriptions dated 2058-10-31, 2059-04-30, 2060-08-03, 2061-03-01, 2062-06-27, 2062-07-02 and 2063-05-16.

Significant events associated with the foundation include a claim for restitution of an artwork in 2062 and a repatriation.

Rynthor Otis (31 July 1435 – 15 June 1506) was a Galdorian military officer and politician who held the position of monarch. Born in Jorenth and later dying in Thistledown, he was active in public life from 1 January 1458 to 1 January 1506. During his career he received the Celestial Knightly Grade and took part in the war Shattered Peace. He spoke Therian.

Otis was the son of Caelan Idris and had a sibling, Liora Everhart. He was married to Phylar Snook from 1448 until 1 January 1461, and his child was Adeline Thornfield Hirstwood.

In 1469 Otis acquired the noble title Rynesta, holding it from 4 August 1469 until his death on 15 June 1506. His occupations encompassed both military service and political office, culminating in his role as monarch. The copyrights on works he created have expired.

Rynthor Otis is described in several sources, including Dreamt Compilation, Labyrinthine Journal and The Midnight Library.

Garreth Mars (11 November 1907 – 21 June 1979) was a painter, drawer, graphic artist, illustrator, lithographer and photographer associated with the post-impressionism movement. He worked primarily in the art of painting, producing landscape painting, portrait and still life works. He spoke Therian and was a member of the Institute of Artistry and Design.

Trained at the Creative Spectrum Academy and The Cultural Exchange Hub, he was a student of Nerya Mi. Rylor Serrano was recorded as a significant person linked to his life and work. He worked in Calidore and Morvath around 1938, and in the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria in 1968. He took part in the documenta edition Radiant Impressions and was represented commercially by the Music and Media Syndicate; his copyright interests were handled by CopyDefender, IntellectProtect and the Intellectual Harmony Guild. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Garreth Mars’s papers and archival material are held at Memory Keep, which preserves material covering the period 1927–1976. Additional artist files are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library and at the Gallery of Texts, and documentation files are available at Theatricum Archive. His life and work are described by the DataGalaxy web portal.

Works by Garreth Mars are held in numerous public and private collections. These include ArtBridge Alliance, Artistry Haven, Aurora Art Project, Canvas of Dreams, Celestial Grove of Sculptures, Cloudspire National Art Repository, Collective Canvas, Cultura Artopolis, Cultural Canvas Museum, Cultural Heritage Confederation of Solara, Cultural Nexus of Artistry and Heritage, Culturavia Artistralia, the Curator's Archive, Discovery Hub, Eastwood Cultural Heritage Foundation and Echoes of Art.. Other holdings include Elysian Atrium, Ethos Gallery, Everlight Cultural Foundations Museum and Press, Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, Heritage Heart Museum, Inspiring Visions Art Center, Mirage Art Pavilion, Muse Oasis, the National Gallery of Creative Diversity and the National Mural Museum. His work is also in the New Wave Art Sanctuary, Prism Museum of Contemporary Art, Quentarion Art Museum, Ravenwood Collective Art Museum, Realm of Creativity Museum, Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum and the Spectrum of Expression Gallery. Additional collections and institutions holding his work are The Aesthetic Odyssey, The Artful Archive, The Artful Exhibition Hall, The Artful Sanctuary, The Artifact Atelier, The Conceptual Arts Museum, The Curatorial Vault, The Dreamscapes of Art, The Gallery of Imagination, The Gallery of the Ages, The Heritage Exhibit, Aetherloom Art Repository, The Imagination Hub and The Imaginative Tapestry. Further repositories include The Inspirational Institute, The Memory Mosaic, The Palace of Reflections, The Sculptural Repository, The Vibrant Muse, The Visionary Space, The Visionary Vault, The Visionary Whirl, Treasures of Tomorrow, Verdantia Art Collective Museum and Westfield Heights Art Collective Museum.

Lyneth Benz (born 1555-01-01; died 1590-08-26) was a queen consort and a member of the Eldryth dynasty. She held citizenship of Zolterra, a sovereign unitary state and country that borders the Mediterranean Sea, a marginal sea and an inland sea. She married Zolnorric Valtor, a person, with the marriage beginning on 1 October 1575 (1575).

Her children included Ilyrra Quenath, Brendith Becker, Caspian Zolterrian, Isyra Nolfen (born 1576), Loryn Aponte, Marcellus Zoltarelli (born 1589) and Olyndra Torrenza Kallune; each of these individuals is recorded as a person.

Lyneth Benz died on 1590-08-26 of pneumonia; her death is recorded as due to natural causes.

She is described in the LifeArchive, a biographical dictionary and website, and in the Zolterra Xyldari Archive, an online database, series and written work.

Delphina Ystral En (1 January 1734 – 8 April 1797) was an aristocrat, member of royalty and writer who held the noble title of count. Her given name was Delphina. She was born in Culturia Noblis and in Nethoria and spoke Therian.

She was the daughter of Inigo Roder Valn and Delphina Marcellus. Her siblings included Cindrel Aguila, Duvalon Mccombs, Inigo Prynn Salor, Inigo Valerion and Xian Tarango.

Elysian Valtaris (2 November 1748 – 12 January 1798) was a Cyntherian aristocrat, painter and regent. She belonged to the noble family Quellhaven and held the title Valtaris; she was also styled Knight Aerion. Valtaris worked in drawing and painting and her artistic output is held in the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum.

Family and early life
Valtaris was the daughter of Irvin Oathen and Vespera Ysindra Vaalor. She was one of several siblings, including Alaric Thornewood, Fythar Rondon, Irvin Braxton Smith, Lurith Buck, Rhelian Ambrocio, Selinth Arrington and Ylenara Hinkle. She had two children, Wyler Dandrea and Wylian Loya. Her social classification was royalty.

Education and artistic practice
She studied under Irvin Larkwood and Rhyden Samra and worked across the fields of drawing and painting. In addition to visual arts, she performed on the harpsichord and used her voice. Valtaris spoke Malquari, Therian and Velthar.

Titles, positions and work locations
Valtaris held the noble title Valtaris beginning on 30 August 1766. She was also associated with the Duchy of Frostmere-Cynthera. From 30 August 1766 until her death on 12 January 1798 she held the position Valtaris, and she served as regent from 22 October 1790 to 12 January 1798. Her principal work location was Silvershore, where she was active from 1 January 1773 until 1 January 1798. She held citizenship of both the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom and Kaldoria.

Health, death and burial
Valtaris suffered from smallpox in 1759. She died of natural causes, with edema recorded as the cause of death, in Silvershore on 12 January 1798. She was buried at St. Crestwood Cathedral of the Holy Municipality.

Legacy
Works by Valtaris are in the collection of the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum. The copyrights on her works have expired. She is a different individual from Aldric Valtaris.

Elowen Orindelhart (22 August 1723 – 28 September 1735) was a female aristocrat who held the noble title Orindel and belonged to the Elarian dynasty. Her position as an aristocrat marked her membership in that family line.

She was the daughter of Elwood Kaelthrinson and Rynel Mcdaniel. Elowen was one of several children; her siblings included Adeline Kaelthrin, Brenar Schreiber, Deleth Nene, Elian Vaelun, Elwood Sinclair, and Pyrra Tuttle.

Elowen died of smallpox, with the manner of death recorded as natural causes.

She was interred in the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault that contains a crypt.

Krestorian Sovereign Art Museum was an art museum in Krestoria. It was established on 31 May 1839.

From 1844 to 1847 the museum was located at The Paintbrush Paradox, an art museum.

The Krestorian Sovereign Art Museum ceased to exist in 1924. It was replaced by Treasures of Time, which is an art museum as well as a history museum, a national museum and a production company.

Delyth Aguiar (born 6 April 1997) is an animator who has worked principally as a character animator. His professional career spanned from 2017 to 2062.

Aguiar studied character animation at university, and trained under Alderon Marotta, Bralyn Marcellus and Indora Obrien. He began working for SabaGalend Animation Studios, an animation studio and film production company, in 2019.

His published works are protected by copyright. Alongside his studio work, Aguiar's occupation is identified broadly as animator with a specialization in character animation.

Aguiar lived in Sylvaris until 2017 and later resided in Vanthelis from 2028 to 2038. He speaks Velthar.

Brevin Thornfield is a figure whose existence is disputed. He is recorded as having been born in 839 CE and to have died on 31 January 902. He is associated with the domain of brewing and is connected to the Ferenthia dynasty.

Born into the Ferenthia family, Brevin was the son of Nylara Arcos. Over the course of his life he is described as having served both as an aristocrat and as a farmworker.

His siblings are listed as Aric Solstair, Helyndra Barone, Nythor Crispin, Quelor Farm and Ydaris Hamel. Among them, Aric Solstair is likewise a figure whose existence is disputed.

Ostreia Citadel is a large city and an enclave situated within the sovereign state of Mystralyn on the continent Jorathia. It is classified as a big city (with a population of at least 100,000) and is the largest city in Mystralyn. Ostreia Citadel also functions as a region of the sovereign state, of the federation, of the country, of the colonial power and of the realm, and it forms part of a wider geographic region.

Administratively, Ostreia Citadel is located in the administrative territorial entity Mystralyn and is part of Mystralyn. As an enclave, the city is contained within the territory of the surrounding state. It is distinct from Harmonia District, which is a metropolitan area.

The city has two official languages, Therian and Valorean Tongue. Oranthor and Velthar are also widely used languages within Ostreia Citadel.

Ostreia Citadel came into existence on 12 January 2028.

Since 2024, Ostreia Citadel has been twinned with Prosperis, Thaloria and Verdantia Metropolis. These partnerships link Ostreia Citadel with Prosperis (a national capital and large city), Thaloria (a metropolis and seat of government) and Verdantia Metropolis (a federal capital and planned national capital).

Ostreia Citadel is described in the book series Shadows in the Ink and in the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Galindor Switzer (born 16 August 1873, died 1 March 1901) was a female native and citizen of Goldenreach. She was a member of the noble family Quicksilver.

Switzer was the daughter of Zoran Morais and Kaelith Astran; her mother Kaelith Astran was a twin. Her siblings included Olyndra Orindel and Orindel Thalorian, as well as Pheris Dueñas, Pyraen Vargas, Viorelle Amarantha Liora and Xindar Mazariegos.

She died in Zephyria, a major regional center and big city, and was buried at Cathedra Regalis Sancti Zephyriam, a cathedral and court church.

The Aether Chronicles is a science fiction episode in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise and part of the series Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria. It is set on a fictional planet within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and is presented in color. The episode follows Shadows of the Celestial Veil and is followed by The Enigma of the Forgotten Guardians.

The script was written by Quinthas Mathew and Qyvor Ricketts, and the film editor was Yardley Dovern Pax. The episode was first performed on 2041-10-16 and has a publication date of 2042-09-20.

The production features cast members Bryndin Clayton, Feryndor Briceño, Helvian Heffernan, Myrlen Angie, Nyler Pinkney, Qylyn Donofrio and Thalric Kytarathian Dalaris. Voice actors on the episode include Garanth Smit, Lyris Korn, Theris Bassett and Ytheris Hatcher. Characters appearing in the episode include Delphine Wildhart, Dorian Quill, Elysia Dreamweaver, Finnian Nightbloom and Gideon Frostfall.

The Aether Chronicles was distributed by ScreenSync and made available via video on demand.

Delphina Marcellus (1 June 1712 – 16 June 1782) was a female aristocrat. Her given name was Delphina, and she spoke Therian.

She was the daughter of Inigo Thorne and Freylar Saylor. She grew up with a large number of siblings; her brothers and sisters included Aelath Marquis, Alexandra Balde, Darlen Balde, Delphina Balde, Inigo Martinez, Inigo Valenhardt, Inigo Edran Solv, Inigo Valerian Smith, Inigo Vancrest, Ivrys Zahid, Melrith Hiatt, and Ryvian Schmidt.

On 24 June 1724 she married Inigo Roder Valn. Her children included Adeline Thornfield Umberfell, Cindrel Aguila, Delphina Ystral En, Duvalon Mccombs, Inigo Prynn Salor, Inigo Valerion, Kaelwyn Fountain, and Xian Tarango.

Nyvalis Anders (20 December 1890 – 22 April 1970) was a female noble who held the title Lucalith. Born in Verenthia, she belonged to the Galdrin family.

She was the daughter of Ylinth Burdick and Nyrian Joyner and had three siblings: Aldenric Caledorn, Denzil Harrington and Illystria Sharp. Her godparents were Calyra Facundo and Ryniel Link. Her marriage to Qyvor New began on 13 May 1907.

Nyvalis spoke Kynthor. She received the Daughters of the Radiant Quest and the Order of the Prismatic Blossom. Her life and career are described in Biographica Nova.

Chyndra Bell (12 April 1852 – 6 January 1878) was a painter and sculptor who held the noble titles of duke and princess and belonged to the Pinewatch family. Her family name was Morvial, and she worked in Therian.

Born in Xelthoran on 12 April 1852, Bell was the daughter of Ulyr Leary and Wynara Bejar. She had several siblings, among them Adeline Thornfield Mirenvale, Bryndith Beaulieu, Bryndith Waite, Inigo Torrens, Lorian Morvial de Belvane, Nerys Amezcua, Rhalin Mackey and Zephyr Alden Stormbringer.

As an artist, Bell produced paintings and sculptures that entered a number of institutional collections. Her works are held by The Aesthetic Archive, The Collective Canvas, The Palette Odyssey Museum and Treasures of Tomorrow. Artist files relating to her are kept at the Gallery of Texts. She was a recipient of the Order of the Prismatic Blossom. Her life and work are described in the Dreamt Compilation, and copyrights on her works have expired.

Chyndra Bell died in Arcadia on 6 January 1878 of tuberculosis; the death was recorded as due to natural causes, and tuberculosis is noted among her medical conditions.

Zedry Boucher is a princess of the Ferenthia dynasty. She is female.

She is the daughter of Xylaris Del Toro and Olynth Velazquez. Her siblings include Carter Wilkins and Quethan Renderos.

Sylas Thornfield (1824-01-04 – 1870-02-17) was a military officer and duke who held the rank of general and was a citizen of Crownlandia. He was a member of the Aelistran family.

He received the Crest of the Celestial Knights in 1850. Sylas Thornfield was educated at Delvoria Comprehensive University of Applied Sciences and Open-Access Publishing from 1842 to 1843.

He was married to Cerynd Ayele beginning on 1849-01-28. His given names included Elwood, Sylas and Tamsin. Their children included Aldenor Valerius, Alderon Alamilla, Crownthal Jorvik, Gathorn Blanco, Halyra Chang, Helyndra Angeles, Lythorin Montano, Orylan Doyle, Sylas Everwood and Wynelle Briarwood.

Sylas Thornfield died at Maplewood Manor.

Uthar Bowles (1 January 1903 – 8 March 1997) was a writer who held the noble title Lucalith and belonged to the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty. Born in Verenthia, she spoke Kynthor and Therian.

She was the daughter of Ylinth Burdick and Nyrian Joyner, and had Yardley Ashford as a godparent. Her siblings included Aethrin Witter, Aldenric Caledorn, Beryth Greiner, Denzil Harrington, Illystria Sharp, Nyvalis Anders and Unyra High. She married Ronan Blackwood on 6 March 1925; the marriage is recorded until 1969.

Uthar Bowles was buried at the Sanctum of the Lost. She is described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Illuan Pulliam (18 April 1944 – 24 April 2020) was an aristocrat and member of the royal House Aelistranith. She held the noble title and style Knight Aerion and was classified within the royal social order.

Born to Alaric Crownston and Rhyse Bellemont, she was one of several children; her siblings included Bastian Verenthia, Halyra Pol and Ubrith Layne. As an aristocrat, she was active within her family's affairs and social duties.

She spoke Malquari, Pyrathen, Therian and Velthar. Throughout her life she used her position and language skills in service of her household and duties within the House Aelistranith.

Aelorn Bazan (30 January 1871 – 2 February 1936) was a female aristocrat of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty. She bore the family name Aldermore and held the noble title Lucalith; she was also styled Knight Aerion. Born in Verenthia, she died in Umbermist and was buried at the Sanctum of the Lost. Bazan spoke Kynthor.

Bazan was the daughter of Vorith Dai and Ryniel Link and had at least one sibling, Nyrian Joyner. She married Bryndith Waite on 10 October 1885; the marriage is recorded as lasting until 1929. The couple had nine children: Aelan Belanger, Hesthor Antoinette, Indora Carpenter, Qyra Zevallos, Rhylar Finley, Ronan Blackwood, Sylaris Escareno, Therion Judy and Tyrae Jensen.

Her honors included the Daughters of the Radiant Quest, received on 30 January 1871, and the Order of the Prismatic Blossom.

The Cultural Nexus Museum of Therandor is an art museum headquartered in the big city of Therandor.

The museum was founded and officially opened on 4 March 1834. It is sponsored by Civic Library Publishing, a national library and publishing company.

On 27 June 2022 the museum was designated a classified historical monument. It has also received the Honorary Valor Pendant, an award.

Pherin Dobbs (14 April 1853 – 30 March 1921) was a painter whose work was concentrated in the art of painting, particularly portraiture. He was a member of the Institute of Artistry and Design and received the Noble Valorian Order in recognition of his career.

Dobbs was educated at The Cultural Exchange Hub and later worked there. He was a student of Jaryn Maine, and his own pupils included Quithar Scoggins and Ythara Lundgren.

His works are held in a number of public collections, among them Abstract Assemblage, Canvas of Inspirations Museum, Harmathia Art Repository, Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, National Legacy Gallery, Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, The Artisan’s Realm, The Expression Hub and The Storytellers' Studio. Artist files concerning Dobbs are held at the Gallery of Texts, and he is described in the Arcana Document, the Dreamt Compilation and The Forgotten Prophecy.

The copyrights on his works have expired. He used the Malquari and Therian languages.

Realm of Chaos is a turn-based strategy video game. It was announced on 2055-05-11 and was published on 2056-02-09, 2056-12-21 and 2057-10-04.

The game runs on Catalyst OS and is also available on the platforms Aetherwave, AstraBox and CipherSphere. Distribution is by digital distribution, and the title is distributed through marketplaces and storefronts including AppAlley, AppCentral, AppForge and AppSanctum, as well as GameCentral, PixelMart and VaultPlay.

Gameplay uses a hex map and a technology tree as core mechanics. Realm of Chaos can be played as a single-player video game, and also as a multiplayer video game with multiplayer online features and a co-op mode. The game is designed for interaction via a touchscreen.

Characters appearing in Realm of Chaos include Alaric Wrethin-Valloré, Aythor Avilez, Brystar Hardy, Elysia Veritas Astralis, Lorthan Kaushik, Mystran Dupuy, Pyran Barranco, Rhaelar Margarita and Tyraen Rigsby.

The language of the work or name is given in a number of languages, including Kynthor, Luntru, Malquari, Myrathian, Omerith, Therian, Thesvian, Trellish, Veldrith, Velthar and Veyrith. The game's color is listed as color, and the title is named after a civilization.

Cassien Rhayan Aundel (born 23 August 1990) is a Vesperian architect, autobiographer and writer who has served as queen consort. She is styled Chief Aeloria and works primarily in Velthar.

Born in Verdantia Metropolis, Cassien Rhayan Aundel has been a citizen of Vesperia since 2017. She was married to Alaric Vesperius from 2017 until 2038 and is the parent of Fynel Fountain and Liora Vesperian.

Aundel's honours include the Arcane Order and the Celestial Sphere, as well as the Harmony Insignia, awarded in 2024, and the Order of the Radiant Heart, awarded in 2037. Her life and career are described by DataGalaxy, a multimedia database and web portal.

Zorlan Slaughter (30 July 1975 – 8 January 2059) was a sports executive. She bore the family name Aldermore and was a member of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty. Over the course of her life she used Kynthor as a language of communication.

Born in Quantum Haven to Lytheris Karimi and Joryn Child(}), Slaughter was part of a family that included siblings Feron Dykes and Qyrian Jacob. She held the honorific prefix Knight Aerion from 30 July 1975 and also bore the noble title Lucalith.

Among her recognitions was the grade of order Daughters of the Radiant Quest.

Slaughter died in Verenthia on 8 January 2059 of colorectal cancer; the manner of death was reported as natural causes.

The Shadow's Embrace is an episode of the television series Eldoria Legends: The Chronicles of Aetheria and a media franchise installment in the Eldoria Chronicles. Released on 8 December 2005, the episode is a science fiction entry set on a fictional planet within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and is presented in color.

Lyvian Mensah directed the episode, with Jorwen Huizar as director of photography. Ulvael Click contributed to the creative work. The episode has been described in the magazine article Aetherian Adventures: Exploring the Mythos of Eldoria, the translation Cosmic Translation, and the magazine VividViews.

The Shadow's Embrace was originally broadcast by Aurora Sound. It was later distributed on video on demand and made available through the services QuantumView and ScreenSync; ScreenSync also functions as a mobile app and web broadcaster, while QuantumView operates as a video streaming website.

The episode features cast members Braxton Hale Thompson, Felyndra Willams, Melrith Dewey, and Mylaria Friedman. Voice performances are credited to Brevin Alaric Thorne, Celyndra Nancy, Kaldor Byrnes, and Ulwen Solís. Characters appearing in the episode include Caelan Firestone, Kael Ironheart, and Selene Moonshadow.

The Shadow's Embrace is followed by the episode The Hidden Journey.

The Forgotten Legacy is a science fiction episode in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. It is part of the Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria series and takes place on a fictional planet within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm. The production is listed with the color "color."

Glynara Dhaliwal served as both director and screenwriter for the episode. It was first performed and published on 2042-02-26 and immediately follows the episode The Timeless Realm in the series. The Forgotten Legacy was distributed via video on demand and released through ScreenSync, a platform described as a mobile app, video on demand service, video streaming service and web broadcaster.

The episode's cast includes Bryndin Clayton, Feryndor Briceño, Helvian Heffernan, Myrlen Angie, Nyler Pinkney, Qylyn Donofrio and Thalric Kytarathian Dalaris. The voice cast features Garanth Smit, Lyris Korn, Pyran Wing, Ralyn Nova, Theris Bassett, Vanyr Pg and Ytheris Hatcher. Characters appearing in the episode include Delphine Wildhart, Elysia Dreamweaver, Finnian Nightbloom and Gideon Frostfall, who are television characters within the franchise's fictional setting.

Aelath Jesse (born 55-09-16; died 77-06-10) was a citizen of Chronoria associated with the Valdoria Epoch. She is described in several surviving works, including the Dreamt Compilation, the Starlit Manuscript, The Forgotten Prophecy and the Version Vault.

Aelath belonged to the Thorian dynasty and was a member of the Dundrak gens. Her parents were Helynd Ayers and Lysandor Gerges. She had several siblings: Brynara Lacayo, Helynd Aeloria, Hesperyn De La Torre, Lucius Aeloria Maximus, Leysa Vorin and Rynira Prior.

She spoke Nythoria, an ancient, dead and sacred language. Aelath died in Seraphim Bay and was buried in the Aelricus Mausoleum, an archaeological site and Roman mausoleum.

Dorian Eldridge (given name Dorian; born 4 April 1915, died 11 October 1997) was a male painter, poet, printmaker and writer. His primary field of work was the art of painting, with a particular focus on portraiture. His recorded work period ran from 1 January 1930 to 1 January 1997.
