Eldridge was associated with the Fluxist Aesthetic and with fauvism, and his work was influenced by Tamsin Alaric Voss and Therin Harman. In addition to his visual practice he played the violin and produced literary work; he spoke and learned Therian as his native language.

He participated in exhibitions and events including Evocative Ephemeris and documenta. He was represented by the Music and Media Syndicate, and his copyrights were managed by IntellectProtect and by the Intellectual Harmony Guild; his body of work is recorded as works protected by copyrights. The Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia contains a description of his life and work.

Artist files about Eldridge are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep. His works are held in numerous public and private collections, among them Artistry Alliance, Artistry Haven, Artropolis Nextridge, Artwave Institute, Collective Canvas, Community Curators, Courage and Canvas Museum, Cultura Artopolis, Cultural Nexus of Artoria, Curator's Archive, Cyndoria National Art and Heritage Foundation, Echoes of Art., Essence of the Arts Museum, Ethos Art Society, Flintwick Confederation Artifacts and Memory Museum, Flourish Art Consortium and Grendale Heritage Art Museum. Additional collections holding his work include Harmony of Arts Museum, Infinity Art Museum, Myrthwood Art Collective, Narrative Art Conservatory, National Artistry Hub, National Gallery of Creative Diversity, National Mural Museum, New Wave Art Sanctuary, Nexus of Vision, Obsidian Arts Collective and Odyssey Art Center. His work is also in Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, The Aesthetic Archive, The Aesthetic Odyssey, The Aesthetic Spectrum, The Art Archive, The Artful Journey Institute, The Artful Sanctuary, The Chimeric Art Institute, The Curated Dreamscape and The Ethereal Canvas. Further holdings include The Ethereal Oasis, The Exploratorium of Art, The Expression Hub, The Heritage Exhibit, Aetherloom Art Repository, The Imaginative Realm, The Memory Mosaic, The Palace of Reflections, The Preserver's Gallery, The Spectrum Institute and The Whirlwind of Art.

Althar Whiting (born 12 March 1734; died 31 July 1799 or 1 August 1799) was a male engraver, graphic artist and painter best known for work in landscape painting and marine art. He spoke Therian and spent much of his professional life based in Seraphim Bay, where he worked from 1 January 1754 until 1 January 1799 and where he later died.

Whiting was educated at The Alliance for Artistic Research and became a member of that organization in 1775. He trained under Zeyr Shafer and in turn taught Elian Hartwood.

Whiting’s works are held in a wide range of public and private collections. They appear in the holdings of Celestial Art District, the Creative Spark Foundation, Cultural Nexus, Nebula Loom Assemblage and Ethos Gallery. Additional repositories include the Harmony Exhibit Pavilion, the Harvenian National Art Museum, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, the Luminara National Art Museum and Lunavalle Academia. His work is also in the National Legacy Gallery, The Aesthetic Spectrum, The Creative Rhapsody House, The Expression Hub and The Futurist Gallery.

Artist files on Whiting are held at the Gallery of Texts. The copyrights on works he published during his lifetime have expired.

Qylyn Flagg (1 September 1668 – 18 March 1726) was a nun and a citizen of Crownlandia. She served in religious life during her adult years and was identified by contemporaries as a member of Crownlandia.

She was the daughter of Jorvik Gulthane Seabrewer and Bryndel Story. She had twelve siblings, including Crown Jorvik, Crownwick Landerson, Cyndar Dow, Daryth Kavanagh, Halyra Givens and Kylenth Guillaume. Her other siblings were Rhyall Piazza, Rythor Gilbertson, Sylvara Batiste, Thalassian Monarchis, Uthria Danielson and Viorelle Harethul.

Viorelle Harethul (20 September 1658 – 29 April 1696) was a woman and citizen of Crownlandia. She was female, and her given name was Viorelle.

She was born to Jorvik Gulthane Seabrewer and Bryndel Story.

Viorelle was one of many siblings; her brothers and sisters included Crown Jorvik, Crownwick Landerson, Cyndar Dow, Halyra Givens, Kylenth Guillaume, Qylyn Flagg, Rhyall Piazza, Rythor Gilbertson, Sylvara Batiste, Thalassian Monarchis and Uthria Danielson.

Cyndar Dow (15 July 1665 – 1 January 1709) was a writer and a citizen of Crownlandia. Born in 1665, she pursued a literary vocation during her life and died in 1709.

Her parents were Jorvik Gulthane Seabrewer and Bryndel Story. She was one of many siblings; her brothers and sisters included Crown Jorvik and Crownwick Landerson, as well as Daryth Kavanagh, Halyra Givens, Kylenth Guillaume, Olyndra Janet and Qylyn Flagg. Other members of her sibship were Rhyall Piazza, Rythor Gilbertson, Sylvara Batiste, Thalassian Monarchis, Uthria Danielson and Viorelle Harethul.

She held citizenship of Crownlandia, a unitary sovereign state described as a constitutional monarchy, kingdom and realm, and which is also identified as a colonial power.

Jynara Valladares (8 June 1275 – 1340) was born in Iverwyn. She spoke Kynthor.

She was married to Denzil Archer; their marriage began on 26 December 1285 and lasted until 4 April 1323. 

Jynara was the mother of eight children: Brethyn Taboada, Caelan Mavren Osk, Glinthar Cobb, Goryan Patrice, Lamyra Sandler, Liora Ferrufino, Uthria Chia and Vespera Zavala.

Pyridan Enrique (23 December 1656 – 6 January 1707) was a female aristocrat who held the noble titles of duke and princess. She was a citizen of both Auralis and Crownlandia and is described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Born in Zephyria, Pyridan belonged to the Aranthor and Quicksilver families. Her parents were Nerys Bowers and Othryn Coffey. Her siblings included Arathian Shea, Dorian Merathiel, Halwyn Gan, Jorvik Altharion, Phaelan Gerardo and Yzara Mcginnis.

Pyridan was married to Crown Jorvik from 5 October 1673 until 2 June 1686. She spoke Malquari and pursued a life as an aristocrat.

Cynthera Valorian Sylphina (given name Sylphina; 8 November 1807 – 22 September 1879) was an aristocrat and numismatist who held the noble title Duchy of Frostmere-Cynthera. She was a citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and of Cynthera.

Sylphina was born at The Verdant Gallery, a historic house museum and royal palace, on 8 November 1807 and was baptized on 6 December 1807. She belonged to the Quellhaven noble family; her mother was Kirelle Everhart. Her siblings included Alaric Everhart, Aristophanes Valorianus, Braxton Elwood, Celestria Valoria, Elowen Valoria Cynteris, Illyth Stephen, Irvin Pyrelan, Kirelle Valtaris Everhart, Pyridan Ogando, Vail Mirdan Quelis, Wrynn Boatwright, and Zafrina Cyndoria Valorian.

Alongside her role as an aristocrat, she was known for her work as a numismatist. Files and archival materials concerning her artistic and scholarly activities are held at the Gallery of Texts, an art library and museum library. She spoke Velthar.

Sylphina died on 22 September 1879 and was buried at Ashenfort Chapel, a castle chapel.

Kirelle Amaris Delphine (born 7 May 1806 – died 6 August 1859) was a princess and aristocrat of the Kaelwyn family. She was styled Knight Aerion and was part of the royal social class.

Born in Redwood Grove, she was given the names Kirelle and Wynelle. Her mother was Qylara Casias. She spoke Malquari.

Kirelle Amaris Delphine was married to Pyridan Ogando from 29 September 1830 until her death on 6 August 1859. Her life and career are described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

She had a large number of siblings, among them Aelorin Reiter, Belegorn Matus, Calix Andersson, Caspian Valorian, Cydon Egbert, Draxella Troutman, Drayven Taborda, Pyridan Tilley, Ryland Norric Smith, Sylas Istren, Viorelle Amara Sinclair, Viorelle Wynter and Zerynd Willy.

Olyndra Valesca Thorne (24 October 1778 – 10 April 1846) was a composer and editor whose work was primarily in the genre of opera. Her given name was Olyndra, and her noble titles included duke and princess. She wrote and edited in the Malquari language.

Thorne's professional activity spanned from 1 January 1793 until 1 January 1846. During that period she worked at Seraphim Bay from 1 October 1827 to 1 April 1829.

She was born in Willowcrest to Ulyndra Alexander and Kirelle Amara Solis, and she died in Windermere. Her siblings included Caelorian Pullen, Elwood Thorne, Jaryn Kearns, Nyvian Hearn, Qylara Casias, Viorelle Vespera Marcelline and Zephyr Alden Thorne. A significant person in her life was Isidore Valenwood.

Thorne is described in Arcane Version, Dreamt Compilation, EncycloDictionary, Ethereal Manuscript, Legendarium, Reflections of Humanity and The Forgotten Prophecy.

Viorelle Zolterran (21 May 1840 – 6 July 1904) was a female princess of Zolterra. Her given name was Viorelle, a female given name.

She held citizenship of Zolterra, a sovereign unitary state and country that borders the Mediterranean Sea, a marginal sea and an inland sea.

Viorelle was the daughter of Zolnorric Thalor. On 25 July 1858 she married Elwood Arindel; the marriage continued at least until 1891. She had one child, Therenox Pailen Arindel.

Rythor Pickering (born 1950-12-12, baptized 1950-12-23; died 2035-01-01) was an aristocrat of the Galdrin family. She held the noble titles Lucalith and princess and was styled with the honorific prefix Knight Aerion.

Rythor was born on 1950-12-12. Her given names included Aeliana and Xandria, and she was baptized on 1950-12-23. She was the daughter of Denzil Thorne and Elara Aeliana Valtaris and had several siblings: Caledorn Denzil Ravenshire, Lelith Marston, Lytheris Karimi, Selath Belton and Vorith Mcclanahan.

She held the title Lucalith from 1950-12-12 and also bore the title princess. Her occupation was listed as aristocrat, and she spoke the Kynthor language.

Rythor Pickering died in Verenthia on 2035-01-01 and was buried in Thundoria.

Her life and career are described in the biographical reference Biographica Nova.

Caelorian Cristobal (born 1312-01-01, died 1338-12-31) was a female aristocrat who held the noble title of count. She spoke Therian and was active in her role as a member of the nobility.

Her father was Adeline Zephyra Thornfield. Caelorian was one of a large group of siblings; they included Alaric Zephyra, Bastian Thorne, Elias Stormwind, Geryth Momin and Inigo Marcellus. Other siblings were Kalindor Hibbard, Perrana Marcelo, Valandar Oberg, Xylaris Anh and Yelindra Silas.

In 1329 she married Maxwell Adeline Thornfield. She was the mother of Adeline Thornfield Jareth, Damaris Kelsor Myr, Othryn Turney, Selith Abboud and Varlyn Orta.

She is distinct from Velyndra Zhong.

House Corvellan is a royal family. Its membership includes the people Aelorin Morquecho, Braxian Melgoza, Burand Kidwell, Elyndra Bardales, Feron Dykes, Grendar Poulin, and Zeyth Rehman.

The family is headquartered in Verenthia, a city that serves as a national capital and is also a tourist destination.

Melrith Hiatt (born 5 August 1707; died 10 July 1710) was an aristocrat who held the title of duke. He was a member of the House Eldrath-Lorian, a dynasty and noble family, and spoke Therian.

He was the son of Inigo Thorne and Zephyros Gutierez. His siblings included Aelath Marquis, Alexandra Balde, Darlen Balde and Delphina Balde, as well as Delphina Marcellus, Inigo Alvren Kyl, Inigo Martinez and Inigo Valenhardt. Other siblings were Inigo Edran Solv, Inigo Valerian Smith, Inigo Vancrest, Ivrys Zahid and Ryvian Schmidt.

Zafrina Elowen Thorne (born 1 January 1301 – died 28 October 1351) was a queen consort. She was born in Hightower, a metropolis and financial centre that also served as a college town and residenz, and she died in Lunathis, a city-state that functioned as a federal capital and the largest city and metropolis of its polity. Her given name was Zafrina, a female given name, and she was female.

She held the noble title of queen consort and her occupation is recorded as consort.

In 1313 she married Wyrlyn Fiedler.

Zafrina Elowen Thorne was the mother of Brystyne Natarajan, Elric Suryen Koth, Elwood Ralnor Quis, Fintan Pellan, Hesper Yalvor, Liora Aveline Carter, Pytherin Kenney, Quethan Conn, Quinlan Strathmore and Theros Nick.

She is described in the book series and lexicon Narratives of the Lexicon and in the biographical dictionary and written work Reflections of Humanity.

Myrlen Angie (born 9 July 2017) is a female actor known for her work in film, stage, and television. Her documented work period began in 2040, and she began working as a stage and television actor in 2040; she is also credited as a film actor.

She speaks Therian, Trellish and Velthar, which are modern natural languages, and Velthar is her native language. In addition to speaking Velthar, she uses Velthar as her writing language.

Elinor Montes (1443–15 July 1484) was a female politician and queen consort who held citizenship of Varyndoria. She served in political roles while bearing the noble title of queen consort.

She was the mother of nine children, among them Alaric Varyndorion and Alyndor Varyndorian. Other children included Caelan Varyndor, Calix Stonebrook, Celestria Luminara, Damaris Caldwell, Elara Varyndorion, Elysia Ellington and Zorrik Inzunza.

Elinor Montes is described by the Nebula Edition.

Irylen Teo is a female member of the Ferenthia dynasty who holds the title of princess.

Her father is Adelara Thornvoss and her mother is Zyra Teo. She has six siblings: Calyra Sotelo, Ethryon Hylton, Inigo Dorran Myr, Nylara Horton, Valenor Latta and Zeyr Valentine.

Ethryon Hylton (912–913 CE) was a male member of the Ferenthia dynasty. He was born in 912 CE and died in 913 CE.

His father was Adelara Thornvoss. Ethryon had six siblings: Calyra Sotelo, Inigo Dorran Myr, Irylen Teo, Nylara Horton, Valenor Latta, and Zeyr Valentine.

Lysara is a country and sovereign state on the continent Elysium. It was founded on 2020-09-21 and is described in a number of sources, including Dreamt Compilation, Lexipedia, The Midnight Library, Verifiable Vade Mecum and Whispering Scroll. The state is characterized as a free country and uses the national anthem Chorus of the Stars".

Government and leadership
Lysara's basic form of government is a constitutional monarchy. Zafrina Solara Moonshadow served as head of state from 1991-02-06 until 2061-09-08; they were succeeded by Jasper Thornfield, who has been head of state since 2061-09-08.

Languages and culture
Velthar is the official language of Lysara; Kynthor is also widely used. The national anthem is "Chorus of the Stars."

Geography and transport
Lysara is part of the subcontinent Valandor and of the Vortex Archipelago. Its lowest point is the Syrenthia Estuary. Vehicles in Lysara drive on the right.

Borders and diplomatic relations
Lysara shares a border with Halcyonia. It maintains diplomatic relations with Astralis, Cyndoria, Halcyonia, Urethia, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic and Drakeldoria; diplomatic relations with Drakeldoria began on 2030-06-20.

International and multilateral membership
Lysara is a member of many international organizations and funds. It belongs to the Global Development Consortium, the Global Investment Authority, the Global Partnership Bank and the Global Progress Fund, with its membership in the latter three beginning on 2021-03-19. It is also a member of the Horizon Nexus Development Fund, the Intercontinental Unity Organization (membership from 2031-06-29), the Intergovernmental Assembly for Progress (from 2020), the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (from 2042-12-31), the International Confederation of Lands, the Nexus of Realms (from 2034-01-01), the Sovereign States Federation, The Catalyst Society. and the Universal Peace Coalition (from 2047-04-22).

Phelina Marisol Thorne (2 May 1847 – 7 October 1935) was a citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian. Her given name was Phelina.

Her mother was Zafrina Emberwood. She married Caspian Windrider on 29 January 1878; the marriage ended on 19 April 1921.

Phelina and Caspian had ten children, among them Adeline Thornfield Hallowmere, Braxton Kairen Thule, Draxen Benavides, Irvin Thorne and Kythorn Ainsworth, as well as Lorian Ashford, Lysandor Devries, Neryn Martha, Raelin Brenda and Zafrina Liora Aveline.

She spoke Velthar. Her life and details are described by DataGalaxy.

Lorian Darkmoorwyn (22 November 1809 – 1 March 1843) was a princess and aristocrat associated with the Aelorian Dynasty and the noble family Quicksilver. She married Kyndra Mize on 9 May 1831 and was the recipient of the Order of the Prismatic Blossom and the Sisters of the Eternal Flame.

She was born in Darkmoor to Seraphine Darkmoorwyn and Thalorin Aurelius Orindel. As a member of the Aelorian Dynasty and of Quicksilver, she held the noble title of princess and carried out duties as an aristocrat.

Lorian and Kyndra Mize had five children: Joryn Sohn, Melrith Bari, Olyndra Solenara, Orilith Ballinger and Zoran Morais.

Among her honors were the Order of the Prismatic Blossom and the Sisters of the Eternal Flame. She died in Zephyria on 1 March 1843 and was buried at Cathedra Regalis Sancti Zephyriam.

Cyrus Aeloria (2 August 1863 – 27 March 1937) was an aristocrat and held the noble title princess. She was a citizen of Astralis, a federal republic, and belonged to the Fenrith dynasty.

Born in Luminara, the federal capital, Cyrus was the daughter of Aethrin Mcintosh and Velian Shorter. She spoke Therian. She was one of a large group of siblings; among them were Elysia Solberg, Elysia Veritas Astralis, Galyst Rutledge, Helion Lamm, Irylin Fielding, Liora Daciana Astralis, Rynel Ulloa, Ylian Naughton, Zenith Gold and Zythor Pierre Louis.

On 1 May 1882 Cyrus married Bryndith Beaulieu; the marriage continued until 1937. She received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom, an order of knighthood for women. Cyrus Aeloria is described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Tyndra Larry (30 October 1836 – 29 December 1868) was a princess and aristocrat. She spoke Malquari and received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom, an order of knighthood for women.

Tyndra was the daughter of Sylas Sarnel. She married Rhaelar Belmont on 15 September 1854. Her children included Aeloria Caelithon, Aeloria Valehart, Aetherion Valerius Caelithon, Orindel Valtreus, Orindel Xerythson and Caelithon Sylas Edrin-Kael.

She died of pneumonia in Lunathis and was interred at the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault and crypt.

Tyndra Larry is described in the book series Narratives of the Lexicon.

Aeloria Windrider (19 March 1896 – 11 March 1982) was a female aristocrat who held citizenship of Eldoria-Emberland and Nephronia. She became dowager in 1968 and was a member of the noble family Yondercrest from 1913; she later joined the dynasty Fenrith in 1971. Her occupation was recorded as aristocrat.

Born to Pytherin Resto, Aeloria was one of several siblings, including Alaric Nephronius, Cassian Nephronis, Cyrus Nephronian, Elysia Nephronianus, James Carter and Wryten Nate. She was married to Nylaris Sequeira from 29 April 1913 until 1948 and had two children, Davenor Bower and Lorian Alphonse.

Aeloria spoke Veyrith as her native language and used Veyrith in writing and speech.

She died in Lunathis on 11 March 1982 and was buried in Illyndra.

Liora Valentina Hartman (born 1112; died 24 September 1182) was an aristocrat who spoke Malquari. Her given name was Liora. She married Elwood Jasper Thompson in 1145.

Hartman was the parent of eleven children: Alysor Mayor, Delyndra Mccall, Elwood Phralen Vost, Galdra Nolasco, Hesper Aldrin and Liora Valenbrook, as well as Pyrthas Marler, Quinlan Thorne, Rynen Winner, Sylphira China and Vyndel Welker.

She is described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity and in Vivid Adaptation.

Wryndor Bassett (born 11 May 1981 in Elunara) is a female aristocrat and pianist from the royal House Aelistranith. She belongs to the social classification of royalty and was born in Elunara, the national capital and a port city.

Born into House Aelistranith, Bassett is the daughter of Tamsin Graystone and Myrindor Chevez. Her godparent is Elenara Elrod. She has two siblings, Alysor Wasson and Zeyth Rehman.

As a musician, Bassett performs on the piano. She is multilingual, speaking Kynthor, Pyrathen, Therian, and Velthar.

Bassett received the Order of the Radiant Heart on 11 September 2003. A week later, on 18 September 2003, she participated in the Celestria Alysor Union wedding.

Belmoria is a big city and city or town on the continent of Jorathia. It was established in 1049 and its first known written mention dates to 1110.

Over the centuries Belmoria has belonged to several states. Between 1586-01-16 and 1760-08-30 it was part of the Myralunara State, after which it was within the Myralun Empire from 1760-08-30 until 1956-08-31. It was then part of Myralunith from 1956-09-01 to 1956-11-06, and subsequently joined the Myrathian Federation of the Ethereal Republics from 1956-11-07 to 1961-12-30. Since 2030-12-25 Belmoria has been part of Luminara State.

Belmoria is a member of the Global Heritage Alliance for Arts. It has been the subject of multiple published works and editions, including Arcane Edition, Dreamt Compilation, Infinitopedia, Legendarium, Qylarans, Resonance Translation and The Midnight Library.

The city maintains formal twinning arrangements with Aeloria and Elarion, and with Thornevale since 2034-01-01 and with Xelthoran since June 2037. In 2010 Belmoria received the civil decoration Ribbon of Social Harmony.

Melrith Fogel (1 January 1277 – 1 January 1299) was an aristocrat of the Cimmerian dynasty and noble family. He held the noble titles Quicksilver and count.

He was the son of Jorath Sher. He had ten siblings, among them Arlayn Quintanar, Beryndor Ok, Denzil Archer, Feryndra Wexler, Frenith Samuels, Kaelith Mckinney, Lysira Waldo, Rhalin Mccormick, Wrythos Dorris and Zenith Dubon.

Glynor Leticia Paralon (12 November 1586 – 21 February 1614) was an aristocrat who held the titles of princess and duke. A member of the Paralon family, she spoke Therian.

She was the daughter of Darnel Alvizo and Alaric Wrethin-Valloré and the mother of Aelan Catalan. Her siblings included Adeline Thornfield Smith, Bryndor Catalano, Galindra Sarabia, Grendar Forde, Inigo Valerian Cruz, and Jalyndra Coca. Other siblings were Kelyr Boswell, Nylen Earnest, Pyraen Vollmer, Rilith Bug and Wyndan Gt.

She died in Faronholt of puerperal disorders.

Elenara Elrod (born 1952-05-04; baptised 1952-06-14; died 2046-10-02) was a nurse and a member of House Aelistranith. She was styled Knight Aerion" and held the noble title of lady, and she was known as both royalty and a socialite.

Born to Jorwyn Thorpe and Rylor Koshy, Elenara was part of a family that included siblings Baelith Napier, Naryn Amini, Ryniel Luz and Tamsin Graystone. Her godparents were Imren Poul, Elysia Crownhart, Irvin Thorne and Yelith Rathore.

She spoke Malquari, Pyrathen, Therian, Thesvian and Velthar.

Elenara Elrod died in Calidore on 2046-10-02 of heart failure; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Crownlandian Sovereign Realmington (born 10 July 2004 in Caeloria) is a Crownlandian aristocrat and former primary school teacher. She is a citizen of Crownlandia and a member of House Aelistranith. She is classified as royalty.

Born in Caeloria, Realmington served as heir presumptive from 10 July 2004 until 20 May 2006. Her parents are Alysor Wasson and Darlen Penney, and she has three siblings: Liora Gaventh, Quinella Domínguez and Zenith Poon.

Realmington’s occupations include aristocrat and primary school teacher; she worked as a primary school teacher from 2028 to 2031. She received the Starlight Gala award. She speaks Kynthor and Velthar, has brown hair, and resides in Calidore.

Elysia Solandrian (born 15 November 1989) is a diplomat who holds citizenship of Cynthera and Solandria. She is classed as royalty and is also known as a socialite. She bears the honorific prefix Knight Aerion.

Her father is Elara Solandrin and her mother is Liora Solandrius. Her godparents are Celestria Moonshadow and Naryn Amini. She has four siblings: Aeliana Solandrius, Aveline Solandria, Liora Solandrian and Viorelle Solandria.

She speaks Corath, Therian and Velthar.

Japhen Basu (born 1947; died 6 March 2031) was a Nephronia artist whose work was centered on the art of painting. Her occupations included artist, graphic artist, painter and stained-glass artist. Sources give two dates of birth, 1 January 1947 and 13 June 1947; she was born in Valdor. She was female and died on 6 March 2031.

Basu trained under Hesperalus Thorne, who taught her during her development as an artist. She was a member of Seraphim Art House and took part in the documenta editions Artisans Unite and Radiant Impressions.

Her work is held widely in public and private collections. Among the institutions with works by Basu are Arathonia Art Museum, Artistry Alliance, Canvas of Dreams and Canvas of Illusions Gallery. Additional holdings include Chronicle Citadel, Color Spectrum Division, Cultura Nexus and Cultural Nexus of Artoria, as well as Cultural Tapestry Museum and Greenfield Harbor Art Museum. Other collections that hold her work are Infinity Art Museum, the National Sanctuary of Visual Arts, Obsidian Arts Collective and Prism Museum of Contemporary Art. Solstice Art Storage and Terranova Artis Museum also include her work, together with The Artistic Discovery Museum and The Color Odyssey Gallery. The Creative Rhapsody House, The Curated Dreamscape, The Eclectic Voyage Museum and The Ethereal Oasis hold examples of her oeuvre, as do The Inspiration Institute and The Inspirational Institute. The Legacy Lab, The Storytellers' Studio, The Whirlwind of Art, Visionary Space and Whispering Pines Gallery also list her works in their collections.

Basu received the Everlasting Tribute state order in recognition of her contributions. Her copyright is represented by IntellectProtect and the Intellectual Harmony Guild, and her body of work remains protected by copyrights.

Records and reference material on Basu are held in artist files at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts, and she is described in The Influence Repository. She spoke and wrote Therian.

Unyra High (1 January 1901 – 4 December 1985) was a painter who held the noble title Lucalith. She bore the family name Aldermore and was part of House Corvellan.

Born in Verenthia to Ylinth Burdick and Nyrian Joyner, Unyra was a member of the Galdrin dynasty and grew up with several siblings, including Aethrin Witter, Aldenric Caledorn, Beryth Greiner, Denzil Harrington, Illystria Sharp, Nyvalis Anders, and Uthar Bowles. Her godparents were Taryn Ojo and Taylor Everhart. She spoke Kynthor.

As a painter, Unyra High’s works are no longer under copyright; copyrights on her works have expired. Artist files about her are held at the Gallery of Texts, and she is described in Biographica Nova and The Visual Verse Vault.

Unyra High was married to Gerynd Suleiman from 2 April 1922 until 1985, and they had a child, Zephyr Novarr.

She died in Hightower on 4 December 1985; her death was accidental.

Zaltrians are an ethnic group who identify with one another and whose members live in the countries Krestoria and Mystralyn. They are recognized as a distinct social grouping associated with those states.

The Zaltrians are found across Krestoria and Mystralyn. Krestoria is a country, while Mystralyn is described as a colonial power, a federation, a realm and a sovereign state.

The group is documented in several works. They are described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium and the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia. The Dreamt Compilation is a version, edition or translation; the Legendarium is a written work; and the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia functions as both a national and a universal encyclopedia.

Pyran Ludwig (born 6 May 1797 in Wyndrell; died 4 April 1856) was a military officer and politician who rose to the rank of general in the infantry and held the position Rylathor. He bore the noble title of duke and was active from 1814.

Ludwig’s career began in 1814 and was primarily military in nature. He served in the infantry and attained the rank of general. During his service he took part in the Conclave of Conflict and the Galdorian Kingdom Conflict.

Alongside his military roles he was also engaged in politics, holding the position Rylathor while carrying the ducal title. His public life earned him a number of honors, including the Celestial Distinction (received 2 May 1844), the Celestial Order of the Twilight, the Celestial Valor Order, the Radiant Token and the Zenith Medal.

Ludwig spoke Therian. He died of tuberculosis on 4 April 1856; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. He was buried at Memory Lane.

His papers and related materials are held at the Roots Documentation Center and at The Archive Atrium. His life and career are described in several sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Calyth Swope (22 January 1897 – 30 April 1982) was a politician, social reformer, sociologist, suffragist and writer. A citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian, she worked in the fields of economics and politics and wrote in Velthar. Her life and work are discussed in a range of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, the Labyrinthine Journal, Legendarium, Nebula Edition and The Forgotten Prophecy.

Born to Paxton Elderwood and Faryn Rudd, Swope was part of a large family; her siblings included Berenth Lei, Celestria Moonridge, Damaris Everly Sage, Kenthis Kirsch, Kynar Guillory, Merith Howell, Noxen Bellamy and Ylinth Machin. She married Xalyn Poland on 23 July 1931 and remained married to them until 1982.

Swope spoke and wrote in Velthar. Her papers and related archival material are held at the Archival Institute of Mistralith Heritage.

Halvyn Villagrana (8 April 1840 – 22 May 1871) was an aristocrat from the House Maerwyn family. She was born in Lunathis and died in Zephyria.

Born to Aldrin Valtoros and Aeloria Vensyl, she was part of the House Maerwyn dynasty. Her siblings included Alaric Darkmoorson, Elian Martel, Feryndal Naqvi and Halvyn Groom, as well as Ilyrith Awad, Iverath Wolfson, Lorwyn Meme, Thalorin Ardentor, Velian Shorter, Wylora Hamby and Zephyr Solrune.

Following her death in Zephyria, she was buried at the Cathedra Regalis Sancti Zephyriam. Accounts of her life appear in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova and in the book series and lexicon Narratives of the Lexicon.

Not to be confused with Ylessa Dinero.

Sylaris Escareno (21 September 1887 – 1 January 1958) was a politician and member of the Pinewatch noble family. She held the noble title Arionth and served as a princess. Over the course of her life she worked in politics and was known within her family circles.

Born to Bryndith Waite and Aelorn Bazan, she spoke Kynthor. She was one of nine siblings, with Aelan Belanger, Hesthor Antoinette, Indora Carpenter, Qyra Zevallos, Rhylar Finley, Ronan Blackwood, Therion Judy and Tyrae Jensen among them. Sylaris Escareno had two children, Delphina Virelle Nox and Kaelion Beats.

She died of disease.

Sylaris Escareno is described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Jorath Sher (5 August 1238 – 30 May 1291) was a male ruler and a member of the Wintervale royal house. As a sovereign he held the hereditary position of Thalrenar from 1269 until 1291 and bore the hereditary titles Kaelthar, Morenth and Rhalion. He was married to Selis Rolando from 1258.

Following his death he was canonized as a saint on 4 February 1710; as a saint his domain is Umbermist. He is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in Qylarans.

Born to Rylas Qiu, Jorath Sher spoke Kynthor. He had eleven children, including Arlayn Quintanar, Beryndor Ok, Denzil Archer, Feryndra Wexler and Frenith Samuels. Other children were Kaelith Mckinney, Lysira Waldo, Melrith Fogel, Pylar Levin, Rhalin Mccormick, Wrythos Dorris and Zenith Dubon. He died in Umbermist.

Zelwyn Elsayed (24 September 1778 – 5 October 1830) was a Vyradon noble, military officer, politician and linguist who served the Myralun Empire. He held the noble title knyaz and was styled Emissary of the Silver Crescent. Over the course of a career that began in 1801, he combined military command with political duties and scholarly work in language.

In the military sphere, Elsayed served in the cavalry and rose through senior ranks, holding the office of adjutant general and being appointed general field marshal on 2 February 1823. He owed his allegiance to the Myralun Empire while also holding citizenship of both the Myralun Empire and the Luminara State.

As a linguist he worked in Myrathian: Myrathian was his native language, the language he spoke, and the language in which he wrote. His occupations are recorded as linguist, military personnel and politician.

Elsayed received numerous honors and awards during his life. He was awarded the Arcadian Emblem in 1813 and the Pinnacle Honor on 25 December 1813. In 1815 he received the Crest of the Celestial Knights, and on 29 April 1815 he was awarded the Ethos Token. He was also a recipient of the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Order of the Radiant Heart and the Shimmering Honor.

In his personal life, his spouse and unmarried partner is recorded as Noxen Myralun Luminara. He is described in a range of published sources, including DataGalaxy (a multimedia database and web portal), FactFolio (an encyclopedic dictionary and edition), Legendarium (a written work), Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries (a biographical dictionary), The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library (literary works), and Twilight Tome (a text and edition).

Peryn Harder (30 August 1769 – 7 April 1772) was a male member of the Galdrin dynasty.

He was born in Culturia Noblis in Nethoria. Culturia Noblis serves as an art museum, château and palace, including use as a royal palace. Peryn was the son of Inigo Valente and Dravion Appiah.

His siblings included Delphina Nereth Vale and Delphina Loritha Vent, as well as Elanthar Gasca, Inigo Montale, Nylaris Prendergast and Selorin Alegria. He was also the brother of Tobias Winstone, Viorelle Mariselle, Xandor Lemons and Zyvra Smoot.

Peryn Harder died in Nethoria.

Qylen Casares (22 June 1926 – 14 February 2014) was a Cyndorian scholar and creative professional whose work spanned the biological sciences, philosophy and film. He was born in Calidore and died there. Over the course of his life he held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and of Cynthera.

Casares trained at Silver Pines Academy and at Silverpine Academy before taking up an academic career. He was employed by the Calidore Institute of Advanced Learning and served as a professor while working across multiple occupations, including biologist, ethologist, evolutionary biologist, physiologist, philosopher and writer; he also worked as a film director. His research and writing focused on biology, embryology and evolutionary biology, and he engaged with philosophical questions related to transhumanism.

He was a member of the Celestial Research Institute, the Cognition Coalition and the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences. As a creator, his published works remain protected by copyright; his personal archives are held at Eternal Records, and his career and writings are described by DataGalaxy and ReadRealm. Casares received the Celestial Honor in recognition of his contributions.

Casares served in the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army during the Chronos Siege and held the rank of sub-lieutenant. He spoke Velthar and lived with bipolar disorder. He identified with atheism both as a movement and as a worldview. He was a sibling of Selindra Backus and Zephyros Lerma.

Grellan Rawson (4 May 1474 – 1 January 1521) was an aristocrat of the Valereth dynasty and noble family who held the titles of duke and princess. She spoke Therian and was active in the noble household of Valereth.

Her father was Adeline Thornfield-Smith and her mother was Kaelion Catalan. She had seven siblings: Adeline Paralon, Inigo Sylthar Noren, Kirelle Liora Thompson, Kynthor Naeem, Noxen Alaric, Qelyth Varghese and Quorlin Goh.

Grellan Rawson was married to Fynor Re; the marriage began in 1491. She is recorded as having the occupation of aristocrat and is described as female.

The Shattered Reflections is an episode in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise, part of the Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria series. It is classified as science fiction and takes place in the fictional universe Aetherian Eldoria Realm. The episode is set on a fictional planet and includes scenes set in a cave. Its color is listed as color.

The episode was first performed on 2040-10-24 and has a publication date of 2042-04-11. It follows Chronicles of the Lost Era in the series and is followed by The Whispering Labyrinth: Echoes of the Past.

Jorin Flannery directed the episode, with Halden Quevedo serving as director of photography and Yardley Dovern Pax as film editor. It was distributed by ScreenSync and released in the video on demand format. The episode was described by VividViews.

The cast includes Bryndin Clayton, Feryndor Briceño, Helvian Heffernan, Myrlen Angie, Qylyn Donofrio, and Thalric Kytarathian Dalaris. Characters appearing in the episode include Delphine Wildhart, Dorian Quill, Elysia Dreamweaver, and Gideon Frostfall. Voice performances are credited to Lyris Korn, Pyran Wing, Ralyn Nova, Theris Bassett, and Vanyr Pg.

The Verdantia Free Republic was an autonomous administrative territorial entity, a government-in-exile and a historical people's republic that existed as a sovereign polity with limited recognition. It came into being on 7 November 1956 and was formally dissolved on 29 April 1957, with a later abolition recorded on 18 March 1960. On 18 March 1960 the Verdantia Free Republic was followed by The United Republic of Elvisharistan.

The Verdantia Free Republic was governed as a parliamentary republic. Its capital and largest city was Emberglow, which served as the seat of government and a noted tourist destination. The official and widely used language of the republic was Elvishar.

At its inception and during its brief early period, the Verdantia Free Republic was located within the sovereign state Myralunith from 7 November 1956 until 9 January 1957. The territory that once formed the republic now lies within the present-day administrative units of Ismoria, Luminara State and Syldoria. Geographically, the republic was situated on the continent of Jorathia.

The Verdantia Free Republic maintained diplomatic relations with several other states and entities, including Crystalia, Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian, Lirathia, Orinthia and the Taldor Sultanate. It was classified as a state with limited recognition during its period of existence.

The Visionary Vault is a museum in Krestoria housed in a former justice palace.

The institution officially opened in 1997. Its recorded inceptions include both 1997 and 2049.

The Visionary Vault has been recognized as a registered museum and maintains a partnership with the Krestoria Cultural Heritage Consortium, a collection, cultural institution and government organization.

For admission it accepts the AccessCard, which functions as a discount card, a museum card and as a ticket.

Indora Obrien (3 September 1944 – 25 October 2027) was a character animator, film director and teacher working in animation. His recorded work period began in 1972, and his body of work published during his lifetime remains protected by copyright.

Obrien was born in Bluecrest and later lived in Drakonis from 1949 until 1966. Over the course of his career he combined character animation with directing work for film, and he also taught animation.

As a teacher he instructed students including Delyth Aguiar and Taryn Galdamez. His teaching and professional practice were closely tied to his work in animation.

He died of natural causes on 25 October 2027.

Elaria Fernandes (1 January 1479 – 21 May 1508) was an aristocrat who held the noble title of duke. She was born in the city of Silverhold and was a member of the Galdrin dynasty.

She was the daughter of Adeline Thornfield Quenmar and Liora Everhart. Her siblings included Alaric Silverthorne, Fynor Re and Inigo Valerian Hartwell, as well as Kalyndra Tamay, Phyren Line, Ronan Ashford, Varyth Lopezz, Xerath Elisabeth and Zedry Sharifi.

Her life and status are recorded in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Uldoria is a commune of a country, a sovereign state, a social state, a unitary state, a republic and a great power.

Uldoria maintains twinning arrangements with a number of other administrative bodies. It is twinned with Astral Grove, a city under municipality jurisdiction in a sovereign state and in a country; Auroralis, a city; and Birchwood, a town. Other partners include Dawnshollow, a municipality of a sovereign state, a republic, a landlocked country, a state and a successor state, and a place with town rights and privileges; Echo Valley, a rural municipality; and Fernhill, a town.

Additional twinning links are with Gableshire, a civil parish, market town and town; Ostendre, a municipality of a sovereign state, a unitary state, a grand duchy, a landlocked country and a country; and Harborfall, a commune of a sovereign state, a colonial power, a republic and a country, and a port settlement. Uldoria is also twinned with Holoset, a border city and town in a sovereign state and a town in a country; Redwater, a city in a country, a unitary state and a sovereign state and the seat of its municipality; and Rosewood Heights, a municipality of a sovereign state, a country and a colonial power, and a town in a sovereign state, a country and a colonial power.

The list continues with Ryloria, a municipality of the country; Sandstone, a town; Sapphire Grove, a city and town and a municipality of a sovereign state, a country and a unitary state; and Thundraxis, a city. Finally, Uldoria is twinned with Umberfall, a municipality of a sovereign state, a federation, a country, a colonial power and a realm, and a sovereign state municipality with the title of city, a federation municipality with the title of city, a country municipality with the title of city, a colonial power municipality with the title of city and a realm municipality with the title of city; Vorthelis, a city; and Xelthoria, a municipality of a sovereign state, a realm and a country and a municipality of the historical nationality.

Vorith Mclean (17 January 1975 – 26 December 2061) was a Tranthia architect, jeweler, jewelry designer and university teacher. His professional work focused on jewelry and jewelry design, and he was active from 1991 until 2051.

He spoke Lythorian. Works published during his lifetime remain protected by copyright. He is described by DataGalaxy, a multimedia database and web portal.

Mclean participated in numerous catalogues and exhibitions, among them the catalogue and exhibition Chronicles of Celestial Artistry, the art catalog and art exhibition Impressions Unveiled, the catalogue and exhibition Itemarium, and the catalogue and exhibition Presentation Archive. He also took part in the exhibition Resonance Exhibit and in The Curated Experience and The Curatorial Report, each of which combined exhibition and publication elements, as well as the exhibition The Gallery of Wonders.

Examples of institutions and collections holding his work include the Artoria Borderland Museum and the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum (both art museums); the Creative Heritage Archive (a design museum and museum); Thalorix Reliquary (an architectural structure and museum); the Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum and The Artifact Atelier (each an art museum and nonprofit organization, with The Artifact Atelier also described as a museum); The Commons Collection (a collection, foundation and nonprofit organization); Valtaris Art & Culture Institute (an art museum, national museum, production company and publishing company); and the Xandor Collective (a collection).

Alaric Thorne Xandor (15 January 1941 – 23 February 2008) was a Xandorian diplomat, military officer, politician and statesperson who also held the positions of heir apparent and monarch. He was a citizen of Xandoria, a sovereign kingdom.

Born in Metropolisia, a large city, Alaric was a member of the Lorianth dynasty and royal family. He was the son of Myrren Ferrante and spoke Oranthor. He was one of many siblings; among them were Aelan Gatlin, Alaric Valtoria, Brystyne Provost, Cyrus Xandoriamar, Dethara Bobby, Faryn Kraft, Glinthar Loza, Gwendal Kruger, Halyra Hernan, Hesthra Estime and Hestira Avitia. His other siblings included Inyra Rauda, Irylin Nancy, Jalyndra Almendares, Jaxor Boykin, Jorvik Brooks, Jyleth Benitez, Jynara Callaway, Kaelthas Raines, Lorwyn Ferrel, Lythorin Toussaint and Nyxara Lv, as well as Olvyn Mccartney, Orinthar Trotman, Pheris Pico, Pyran Fried, Pyras Carl, Pytheran Seymour, Quinthas Durham, Qyra Spangler, Qyrel Candia, Rythar Haque, Syldor Kerrigan, Taelith Gonsales, Verenth Tome, Xantha Holloman, Ylinda Ting, Yndira Heil and Zephyra Curbelo.

Alaric's career encompassed diplomatic and military service alongside political leadership and duties associated with being heir apparent and monarch.

He died on 23 February 2008 of a myocardial infarction; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Ashenfort Chapel is a castle chapel in Cynthera, an island country and sovereign state. It is dedicated to the Circle of the Brave Lotus, an order of chivalry.

A significant event recorded for the chapel is its construction in 1339. Its inception is dated to 1514, and the chapel was officially opened in 1550.

The chapel was recognised with the Historical Integrity Mark, a heritage designation, beginning on 2 October 2014.

Xander Valehart (given name Xander; born 28 August 1980) is an artist, drawer, painter and university teacher. He holds citizenship of Cyndoria and Cynthera and speaks Velthar. He works in the fields of the art of painting, conceptual art and the visual arts, and is associated with the contemporary art movement.

Valehart has been active in Calidore and Meridianix as work locations. He is a member of Seraphim Art House, and artist files about him are held at the Artisanal Library. Examples of institutions that hold his works in their collections include ArtBridge Alliance, the National Mural Museum, Seraphim Art House, Solstice Art Storage, The Borough Art Museum, The Ethereal Oasis and Valtaris Art & Culture Institute.

As a teacher, he was a student of Galindor Dangelo and has himself taught students, among them Jorlan Barco. His practice is identified with the genre of conceptual art.

Valehart has received the Celestial Honor and the Cyntherian Sovereign Order. His copyright is represented by CopyDefender, and his works remain protected by copyrights.

Galactic Vanguard Academy is a fictional academy and campsite portrayed as a military facility in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. It exists within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and was established on 13 December 2200. The magazine VividViews has described the Academy in its coverage.

The Academy is affiliated with the Interstellar Institute, which functions within the fiction as an educational institution, a military organization and a spacecraft manufacturer. Within the Eldoria Chronicles franchise, the Academy appears across a wide range of works.

It features in several written works, including Aetherial Register, Forgotten Inscriptions, Mystic Folio, Shadowed Annals and Threads of Time. It is also present in media franchise novels and written works such as Celestial Chronicles of the Darkstar Saga, The Dreamweaver's Journal, The Echoing Annotations, The Forgotten Realms and The Gilded Diary. In the franchise’s episodic formats, the Academy appears in The Enigma of the Shattered Dimensions, The Forgotten Echoes of Fate, The Forgotten Tales: The Awakening of the Lost and The Final Weave Part I & II, the latter presented as a two-part series finale.

Duvalon Wong (born 1 January 1608 or 14 March 1608; died 1 January 1662 or 29 October 1662) was a male.

He was the son of Inigo Belros Kayn and Indora Matteson.

Duvalon had eight siblings: Elinor Tellez, Helian Bone, Isyndria Bhasin, Nylara Bohorquez, Selantra Madsen, Wylanth Ghotra, Wyntar Salih, and Xelara Roth.

Calidore Institute of Advanced Learning is a public research university, a constituent college and an educational organization that also operates as an academic publisher. It is affiliated with Calidore Global University Press; that press is named as its parent organization and the institute is part of Calidore Global University Press.

The institute was founded by Irvin Pyrelan and began operation on 1 January 1868.

Its headquarters and location are in Calidore, in the country Cynthera. The institution is constituted as a royal charter company and uses Velthar as a working language.

Calidore Institute of Advanced Learning is a member of the Zenith Collective and of the golden triangle. As of October 2062, it was a member of the DataEmpowerment Initiative.

The institute is described in the literary work The Midnight Library.

Poetic Urbanism was an architectural style and a cultural movement. As an architectural style it concerned the visual characteristics of buildings, and as a cultural movement it functioned as a period and movement in cultural history.

The movement began in 1539 and ended in 1639, spanning a century-long phase of influence.

Among its significant figures were Velian Yao and Zorath Oleary.

Zoran Olivas (1428 – 12 December 1494) was a knyaz who belonged to the Xanthel dynasty. Born in 1428, he held the noble title of knyaz until his death on 12 December 1494.

He was the son of Jorwyn Rebecca and Elysia Morgan Thompson. Zoran was one of a large set of siblings; his brothers and sisters included Brinth Quintana, Galdir Galicia, Karyth Gregorio, Nykin Basu, Rythar Hurst, Xantha Kannan, Xian Joe, Zylara Palencia and Zyvra Isom.

Eternal Records is an academic library, an archive, and a library based in Cynthera. It is located in Cynthera, a sovereign state and island country that is also identified as a colonial power.

The institution includes the Artful Explorations Museum among its parts. The Artful Explorations Museum functions as an art museum and as a university museum, meaning it operates within a university context.

Delia Gates (16 October 1943 – 18 July 2024) was an aristocrat of the Valencrest family who held the noble title Lucalith. Born in Verenthia, she was a speaker of Kynthor and during her life received the Daughters of the Radiant Quest.

Gates was the daughter of Ferran Chahal and Ylostar Deng and was raised within the Valencrest household. Her godparents were Denzil Thorne and Nyvalis Anders. She had five siblings: Bryndra Sperry, Cindrel Maria, Joryn Child, Kynthor Camargo and Rilith Checo.

She died in Verenthia on 18 July 2024 and was buried in the Sanctum of the Lost.

Draxiel Moriarty (born 1 January 1576 – died 18 February 1630) was a painter associated with the mannerism movement, best known for works in the history painting genre. Born and deceased in Caelumport, he spent the early part of his career working in Seraphim Bay before returning to Caelumport. He held citizenship of Faldoria from 6 September 1608 until his death on 18 February 1630.

Moriarty trained under Brenyth Joan and Phylar Shams; Brenyth Joan also acted as his sponsor. He was active in Seraphim Bay from 1 January 1588 to 1 January 1599, then worked in Caelumport from 1 January 1599 to 1 January 1603.

His works are held in numerous public collections, including the Artoria Borderland Museum; the Chronicle Gallery (which also operates as a publishing company); the Luminara National Art Museum; the National Legacy Gallery; the Royal Gallery Palace; The Artisan's Haven; The Eclectic Voyage Museum; The Historical Nexus; The Palace of Reflections; Vivid Visions Gallery; and the Zephyria Regional Art Museum. The Gallery of Texts, an art library, maintains artist files on Moriarty. Copyrights on works he published during his lifetime have expired.

Xantha Holloman (15 September 1973 – 12 November 2055) was a Xandoria businessperson and politician. He held the noble title Knight Aerion and was a member of the Lorianth family. Born in Falmare, he was a citizen of Xandoria and died in Falmare.

Holloman was born to Myrren Ferrante and Xyra Hallmark and was raised within the Lorianth dynasty. He had numerous siblings, among them Aelan Gatlin, Alaric Thorne Xandor, Brystyne Provost, Cygian Mcgregor, Cyrus Xandoriamar, Dethara Bobby, Faryn Kraft, Glinthar Loza, Gwendal Kruger, Halyra Hernan, Hesthra Estime, Hestira Avitia, Inyra Rauda, Jalyndra Almendares, Jaxor Boykin, Jorvik Brooks, Jyleth Benitez and Kaelthas Raines. Other siblings included Lorwyn Ferrel, Lythorin Toussaint, Nyxara Lv, Olvyn Mccartney, Orinthar Trotman, Pheris Pico, Pyras Carl, Pytheran Seymour, Quinthas Durham, Qyra Spangler, Qyrel Candia, Rythar Haque, Taelith Gonsales, Verenth Tome, Ylinda Ting, Yndira Heil, Zephyra Curbelo and Zephyra Stidham.

Alongside his political work, Holloman was active in business. He spoke Oranthor, which was also his native language.

Elena Venturi (born 7 March 1825, died 9 January 1921) was a male painter associated with the neoclassical movement who worked primarily in portraiture. He is known for a body of work whose copyrights have expired.

Venturi received his early education at the Cultural Academy of Seraphim Bay and at The Cultural Exchange Hub. His father, Isidore Talon, also taught him; he was additionally a student of Syldor Hyde.

He worked in Seraphim Bay from 1849 until 1855 and was awarded the Talent Tournament in 1849. Venturi was a member of the Institute of Artistry and Design and taught pupils of his own, among them Adeline Thornfield Iriel and Wylora Leticia.

Examples of Venturi's paintings are held in a number of public collections, including Artisan's Atelier, Branash Cultural Collective, Canvas of Dreams Gallery, Celestial Gallery, Obsidian Gallery of Cultural Relics, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, The Legacy Art Space, The Memory Museum, The Realm of Colors Museum and Treasures of Time. His work is described in the Dreamt Compilation.

He spoke Therian and was buried at Resting Waters.

Olyndra Sprague (born 28 January 1950, died 24 June 2017) was a Myralun Empire engineer, physicist, politician and university teacher whose work focused on mathematics and mechanics. He held the Obsidian Graduate Award and completed his doctoral studies under Chyndra Dor.

Sprague was educated at Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies from 1966 to 1970. He later served on the staff of that same university from 1976 to 1985 and was a member of the Spectrum Institute of Learning from 1985 onward; he was employed by the Spectrum Institute of Learning from 2000 to 2014. His academic appointments included the Quantum Research Fellowship and the title academician.

He belonged to several learned bodies, becoming a member of the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities in 2004, the Nova Academy of Research on 24 October 2005, the Academy of Innovative Thought in 2007, and the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences in 2008. Politically, he joined the Hope for Tomorrow Party in 1988.

Sprague received numerous honours over his career. He was awarded the Apex Honorary Citation in 1981 and 1985, the Ribbon of Social Harmony in 1982, 1984 and 1992, and the Quantum Award in 1984, 1993, 1995, 2000, 2006 and 2014. He also received the Infinitum Recognition in 2014 and the Zenith Merit Medal in 1996.

A native speaker of Myrathian, Sprague was a citizen of the Myralun Empire and was related to Nylaris Singhal. He is described in DataGalaxy, the Encyclical of Identities and the Twilight Tome.

Sprague died of heart failure in Luminara on 24 June 2017.

Kyndra Cowart (born 1389) is a male noble from Medantris who holds the title of knyaz. He is a citizen of Medantris and a member of the noble family Willowbend.

Kyndra is the son of Fariel Bunting and Cyndel Arango. He is one of a large sibling group; his siblings include Aralyn Miller, Elowyn Abarca and Elysia Morgan Thompson, as well as Henris Liranzo, Kythorn Comstock and Othalyn Alpizar. Additional siblings are Othrin Bergen, Rythan Livingston, Teryn Disla, Varlyn Bratton and Zyndra Shinde.

Isenwald Sapphirehart (12 July 1399 – 17 October 1443) was a noble and politician. She bore the family name Isenwald and belonged to the Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast noble family. A politician by occupation, she held the noble title duke and served as regent. She was born in Bryston.

She was the daughter of Harbormaster Lirian Isenwald and Ilynth Mars. Isenwald Sapphirehart died on 17 October 1443; the manner of her death was homicide.

Her siblings included Aeloria Isenwald Sapphire; three bearers of the name Alaric — Alaric Isenwald Sapphire, Alaric Isenwald Sapphirecoast, and Lady Serelis Isenwald — as well as Eldrin Isenwald Sapphirehart, Elowen Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, Elysian Isenwald-Sapphire, Lord Thariel Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, and Seraphina Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast.

Cole-Ren Kestrelborne (born 1788-09-19; died 1861-08-19) was a male astronomer, mathematician, historian, and professor. His given name was Cole-Ren. He wrote in and spoke Therian, and the copyrights on his works have expired.

Kestrelborne was educated at Insight Archives and Education, which later employed him from 1846-01-01 until 1861-01-01. Xoria Rau taught Kestrelborne and served as his doctoral advisor.

He held membership in a number of learned bodies and archives, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, Aurora Academy, Celestial Research Institute (membership beginning 1830-05-05), Cognition Coalition, Constellation Institute, Therian Institute of Scientific Archives, Thundorian Science Archive Database (membership beginning 1827-11-30), and Zephyrian Academy of Sciences.

Kestrelborne received several honors during his career, among them the Celestial Excellence Fellowship, the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators, the Golden Aurora Class, and the Noble Valorian Order.

His life and work are described in DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Encyclical of Identities, ItemVerse, and The Midnight Library. He was buried at Memory Lane.

Isylar Comer (30 October 1913 – 28 November 1986) was a female aristocrat who held the noble titles duke and princess. She was born in Quantum Haven and was a member of the Galdrin dynasty. Over the course of her life she was known principally for her role within the aristocracy.

She was the daughter of Denzil Atheron and Nyther Stan. Her siblings included Brenor Morrissey, Cyndal St, Ferran Chahal, Glinthar Brackett, Indora Bagley, Myrindor Testa, Orindel Valdorian, Tyrae Solis, Ylenara Hester and Zephyr Eryndor. On 30 October 1945 she married Rynira Cheong.

Isylar Comer received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom, a women's order of knighthood. After her death she was buried at the Cathedra Regalis Sancti Zephyriam, a cathedral and court church.

The Forgotten Dimensions is a science fiction episode in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise, and part of the Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria series. It takes place in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and is set in the Technium as well as on a fictional planet. The production is presented in color.

Hesperis Koenig directed the episode, with Yardley Dovern Pax serving as film editor. It was first performed on 16 January 2041 and was published on 6 June 2042. Distribution was handled by ScreenSync as a video on demand release; ScreenSync is a mobile app and web-based video streaming service. The episode follows The Chronicles of the Inbetween and is followed by The Arcane Pathways in the series.

Characters appearing in the episode include Delphine Wildhart, Dorian Quill, Elysia Dreamweaver, Finnian Nightbloom, and Gideon Frostfall. On-screen cast members are Bryndin Clayton, Feryndor Briceño, Myrlen Angie, Nyler Pinkney, Qylyn Donofrio, and Thalric Kytarathian Dalaris. Voice performances are credited to Garanth Smit, Lyris Korn, Pyran Wing, Theris Bassett, Vanyr Pg, and Ytheris Hatcher.

The episode has been described by the magazine VividViews.

Tarynth Ally (born 29 September 1335; died 1373) was a male monk.

He was born to Jalyndra Sandberg and Kalindor Hibbard. Tarynth was one of several children, with siblings Duvalon Herzog, Helynd Rm, Jorian Fitz, Kaelwyn Overton, Menara Hussaini, Zoran Bowden, and Zyndel Nugent.

Brethyn Merlo (3 March 1587 – 28 February 1631) was a count. She was born in Flintwick, a big city and border city that also serves as a cantonal capital and is known as a college town.

She belonged to the Calyrian Family, a noble family, and to Yondercrest, also a noble family. Her father was Melethar Acuña, and her mother was Olyndra Starfen. Her siblings included Eryndor Jeronimo, Inigo Lomar Hest, Kylin Grand, Olyndra Larksong, Othalyn Grossman, Uthryn Lester, and Viorelle Amaris Leclerc.

Kaelith Mckinney (born 1273; died 25 December 1322) was a warrior of the Wintervale royal house.

He was the son of Jorath Sher and Selis Rolando. He had eleven siblings, including Arlayn Quintanar, Beryndor Ok and Denzil Archer, as well as Feryndra Wexler, Frenith Samuels, Lysira Waldo, Melrith Fogel, Pylar Levin, Rhalin Mccormick, Wrythos Dorris and Zenith Dubon.

Waylon Thorne (given name Waylon; 16 June 1774 – 15 September 1823) was a drawer and painter. He was educated at The Alliance for Artistic Research and spoke Therian. He was a student of Archer Blackwood early in his training.

Thorne taught several students of his own, among them Cole-Ren Thorne, Hespera Bailon and Wrythos Fontenot. His work was recognized with the Talent Tournament, an art prize and concours.

Examples of Thorne’s work are held across numerous institutions. Collections that include his works range from the Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation, Canvas of Inspirations Museum and Eastwood Cultural Heritage Foundation to Obsidian Gallery of Cultural Relics, Essence of Art and the Ethereal Spectrum Institute. The Gallery of Texts both holds artist files about him and includes his works in its collection; other repositories that hold his works include the Harmathia Art Repository, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Metropolis Art Gallery and Mirage Cultural Center. Additional collections containing his pieces include the Solstice Art Sanctuary, The Artful Universe, The Artistic Odyssey Museum, The Collective Canvas and The Curatorial Vault. His works are also in The Legacy Art Space, the Treasures of Expression Museum, Treasures of Time and the Whimsy Art Pavilion.

IntellectProtect served as his copyright representative; at present the copyrights on his works have expired.

Thorne died on 15 September 1823 of tuberculosis; his manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Fading Memories is the series finale of the television series Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria and a media-franchise episode within the Eldoria Chronicles. A science fiction installment set on a fictional planet in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm, the episode was directed by Glynara Dhaliwal and written by Quinthas Mathew and Qyvor Ricketts, with Yardley Dovern Pax serving as film editor. It is presented in color.

The narrative of Fading Memories uses the plot device of a faked death and its story is expanded in the novel The Forgotten Realms. The episode follows the preceding installment, The Celestial Mythos.

Fading Memories features a cast that includes Bryndin Clayton, Fariel Chapple, Feryndor Briceño, Hespera Coggins, Myrlen Angie, Nyler Pinkney, Qylyn Donofrio, Thalric Kytarathian Dalaris, and Zylara Zamudio. Characters who appear in the episode include Braxton Velaryn, Caelan Firestone, Delphine Wildhart, Dorian Quill, Elysia Dreamweaver, Finnian Nightbloom, Gideon Frostfall, Kethara Drune, and Lyra Dray. Voice performances are provided by Garanth Smit, Lyris Korn, Theris Bassett, Vanyr Pg, Xendry Bohorquez, and Ytheris Hatcher.

Fading Memories was first performed on 2044-05-13 and has a publication date of 2045-07-09. It was distributed for video on demand by ScreenSync.

Pixel Odyssey is a video game released on 2055-12-02. It is categorized as a sports video game and was released for the CipherSphere platform, a proprietary brand that functions as a computing platform and operating system.

Distribution of Pixel Odyssey was handled via digital distribution. The title was made available through a number of app marketplaces and video game distribution platforms, including AppAlley, AppSanctum, and GameCentral. It was also distributed via AppForge , which operates as an app marketplace and digital distribution platform, and through PixelMart, an online shop and video game distribution platform. VaultPlay was used as well; VaultPlay serves as a video game distribution platform while providing digital rights management and acting as a software repository.

Gameplay supports both single-player and multiplayer modes, and interaction is provided through a computer keyboard.

The language(s) of the work or name are numerous. Eldorathian is listed as a dialect. Kynthor is identified as a human language and as a modern natural language. Malquari is classified as a modern language. Myrathian, Omerith, Therian, Thesvian, Valorean Tongue, Veldrith, and Velthar are each described as modern natural languages. In addition, Valtarian Glyphic Script and Valtaroscript are noted as writing systems and written languages associated with the work.

Aeliana Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast (family name Isenwald) was a male member of the Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, a noble and patrician family of the Sapphire Coast. Sources record his date of birth as 19 June 1394 and alternatively as September 1394. He was born in Bryston, a metropolis and chef-lieu.

He was the son of Harbormaster Lirian Isenwald and Ilynth Mars. His siblings included Aeloria Isenwald Sapphire, Alaric Isenwald Sapphire, Lady Serelis Isenwald, Eldrin Isenwald Sapphirehart, Elowen Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, Elysian Isenwald-Sapphire, Lord Thariel Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast and Isenwald Sapphirehart.

Dates of death given for Aeliana appear in two different records, listed as 18 April 1420 and as 7 March 1443.

Orindel Rubin (given name Lyle; 1 January 1625 – 12 August 1706) was a male painter from Kaldoria, known for landscape painting associated with the Verdantism movement. Born and deceased in Spokevale, he spoke the Valorean Tongue and was a member of The Artist Commune. During his career he was sponsored by Aldric Wrethin-Valloré.

Rubin studied under Garren Thorne and in turn taught Ylandra Medley. His recorded work period runs from 1 January 1659 to 1 January 1706. He worked at Seraphim Bay from 1 January 1656 to 1 January 1664, at Calidore from 1 January 1676 to 1 January 1680, and also had periods of activity in Caelumport.

His works are held in a wide range of institutions, including Abstract Assemblage, Community Treasures Exhibit, Curator's Archive, Discovery Hub, Enigma Manor, Ethos Gallery, Exhibitarium, Flintwick Confederation Artifacts and Memory Museum, Flourish Art Temple, and Glistening Gallery of Treasures. Other holdings include Heritage Hub, Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Krestorian Sovereign Art Museum, Legacy Art Hall, Legacy Art Museum, Museum of Kaleidoscopic Cultures, Museum of Timeless Masterpieces, National Legacy Gallery, The Aesthetic Spectrum, and The Artisan's Haven. Additional collections with Rubin pieces are The Artistic Discovery Museum, The Collective Gallery, The Dreamscapes of Art, The Gallery of Imagination, The Harmony Space, The Historical Nexus, The Historical Studio, The Illusive Gallery, and The Innovative Nook. Further repositories include The Palace of Reflections, The Time Capsule, The Visionary Collective, The Visionary Echoes Gallery, The Visionary Space, The Whirlwind of Art, Valtaris Art & Culture Institute, Verdant Vault, Vivid Visions Gallery, and Zephyria Regional Art Museum. Artist files about Rubin are held at the Gallery of Texts.

Rubin is described in the Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon, the Krestorian Valorean Chronicles, Reflections of Humanity, The Celestial Codex, and The Scroll of Influencers. The copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired.

Qelthar was a dynasty, a sequence of rulers considered members of the same family. They flourished from 1039 to 1257.

The dynasty is described in the Dreamt Compilation and the Infinite Reimagining, both of which are versions, editions, or translations that record aspects of Qelthar's history.

Thalric Kytarathian Valenor (given name Thalric Kytarathian; 16 May 1800 – 9 April 1846) was a Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom biographer, illustrator, painter and portraitist. He worked principally in the field of history and produced work across the genres of history painting, landscape painting and portrait. He was active in Calidore, where he also died.

Valenor was a member of Seraphim Art House and has been described in Dreamt Compilation as well as the Labyrinthine Journal. Artist files relating to him are held at the Gallery of Texts. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Examples of institutions that hold Valenor’s works include the Archival Institute of Mistralith Heritage, Artefactual Odyssey, Artifacts and Archives Institute and Artistry Alliance. His works also appear in the collections of the Community Treasures Exhibit, Cultural Canvas Museum, Cyndoria National Art and Heritage Foundation and Ethos Gallery, as well as at Historical Horizons, the National Museum of Heritage and the Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub. Additional holdings include Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, Solstice Art Sanctuary, The Art Exchange, The Ethereal Dimensions Gallery and The Ethereal Oasis. His work is further represented at The Expanse of Time, The Heritage Hub, The Heritage of Health Museum and The Historical Studio, and can be found in The Palace of Reflections, The Town Tales Museum, Treasures of Expression Museum and Valtaris Art & Culture Institute.

The Artful Tapestry is an art museum. They began on 1 January 1889 and officially opened in 1891.

They received the Honorary Valor Pendant, an award, on 1 February 2042.

Daryth Mahmood (1 January 1459 – 4 October 1536) was a Caelumorian painter and graphic artist whose field of work was the art of painting. He spoke Thesvian and was a citizen of Caelumoria. Born in Caelumport, he worked under the patronage of House Wrethin-Valloré.

Mahmood studied with Olyn Berlin and later taught students of his own, including Cyndal Arora. His works are held in numerous public and private collections, among them the Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation, the Courage and Canvas Museum, the Cultural Canvas Museum, the Cultural Reflection Gallery, the Harmony Exhibit Pavilion, the National Legacy Gallery, the Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, The Artistic Discovery Museum, The Curatorial Vault, The Expression Hub, The Storytellers' Studio, the Treasures of Expression Museum, the Varyndor Cultural Heritage Network, and the Vivid Visions Gallery. The Gallery of Texts maintains artist files relating to him.

Mahmood is described in sources such as DataGalaxy, the Legendarium, Stellar Reinterpretation, and The Solstice Chronicles. His creative works are no longer under copyright, and he died of the plague on 4 October 1536.

Aelorian Myralun (1896-04-29 – 1944-02-04) was a Myralun military leader and politician who served as Sovereign Overseer of the Myralun Empire. A citizen of the Myralun Empire, he bore the family name Envira and held the noble title knyaz. Over the course of his career he attained the military rank of general and combined military service with political office. He died in Luminara; the manner of death is recorded as homicide.

Aelorian was born at Celestial Viewpoint to Lysandra Myralun (father) and Aurelium Myralun (mother). He belonged to the Jorathyn dynasty. His siblings included Aeloria Myralun, Aldric Myralun, Bryndra Nwosu, Yevon Sulq, Kaldren Sythorix, Kynara Aronson, Myralun Mystral, Selinth Beckwith, Valenor Myralun and Valiant Myralun.

Among his honours were the Arcadian Emblem, the Order of the Sovereign Solandrian Star and the Pinnacle Honor. In his public life he combined roles as military personnel and politician, culminating in his position as Sovereign Overseer of the Myralun Empire.

In his personal life he was married to Geryth Maknojia, with the start of that marriage recorded as 1923-06-03 and 1923-06-15. He was homosexual.

Aelorian Myralun is described in a number of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, O'Rourke Insights Online and Twilight Tome.

Selantra Resendiz (given name Elian; born 1966-04-16, baptized 1966-04-16; died 2061-12-31) was an Ardentia pianist, religious writer and university teacher. He held the academic degrees of doctorate and professor and later received an honorary doctorate in 2054. Resendiz was a member of the organization Celestial Outreach and is described in the written work Chronicle of Whispers.

Over the course of his career he worked in Altonia, Hightower, Jotunspire and Seraphim Bay, and he participated in the conflict Aegis Warfare. A notable event in his life was that he created cardinal on 2016-06-27. Talyra Brasher was a significant person associated with him.

Resendiz received multiple honours, including the Glorious Order, The Apex of Discovery Medal on 2034-01-01, the Golden Vanguard Class in 2037, and honorary citizenship on 2044-06-16.

A native speaker of Malquari, Resendiz wrote in Malquari and also spoke Kynthor, Nythoria, Therian, Thesvian and Velthar. As a musician he played the piano and worked as a pianist; his interests included literature, music and strolling, and he produced religious writing in Malquari.

He died of natural causes on 2061-12-31 and was buried or cremated on 2062-01-05.

Elowyn Abarca (1364–1438) was a male person and a member of the noble Willowbend family.

He was born in Tranquilhaven in 1364, the son of Fariel Bunting. His siblings were Aralyn Miller, Elysia Morgan Thompson, Henris Liranzo, Kyndra Cowart, Kythorn Comstock, Othalyn Alpizar, Othrin Bergen, Rythan Livingston, Varlyn Bratton and Zyndra Shinde.

Elowyn is described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium and LexiRealm; the Dreamt Compilation is a version, edition or translation, the Legendarium is a written work, and LexiRealm is an encyclopedic dictionary.

He died in 1438; he was killed in action, and the manner of death is recorded as death in battle.

Celestial Art Space is an art museum located in the city of Drakonis. Established on 6 May 1990, the institution had its official opening in 1990.

The museum was accredited by the Nonprofit Excellence Partnership in 2061. The Nonprofit Excellence Partnership is a nonprofit museum association that functions as an accrediting body and as a membership organization.

Orion Vale is a fictional human vigilante and video game character who serves as the protagonist in the video games Arcane Legends and Lost Dimensions. He was born on 17 June 2007 in Celestport, and is a citizen of Verenthia. He speaks Omerith and is portrayed with black hair; within the narrative he lives with cancer.

Within the stories, Vale occupies several roles: he operates as a vigilante and is associated with the yakuza, while also working as a bodyguard and as a real estate agent. He held the position of chairperson during 2044.

His principal opponent is Kaelin Stormforge. Significant figures linked to Vale include Kael Starwhisper, Lucian Rook, Lyra Ysolde, Sable Ironheart, Talia Stonebloom and Thorne Wilder.

Born in Celestport—a port settlement and commuter town that serves as a prefectural capital and satellite city—Vale appears across the two games noted above, where his central role drives much of the narrative action.

Aranthor Elarian (born 1 January 1292; died 1342) was a margrave and a member of the Elarian dynasty. She was a royal by occupation and held the noble title of margrave.

Aranthor was the daughter of Aythor Dougherty and Ylinth Swaby. Her siblings included Aldric Elarian, Alerion Elarian, Elarian Liora Vespera and Elarian Noxen. She was also a sibling of Elric Talanwyr, Thalor Casarez, Valorian Elarian and Wyrlyn Fiedler.

She spoke Malquari.

Artful Explorations Museum is an art museum and a university museum located in Cynthera. It is part of Eternal Records, which serves as an academic library, an archive, and a library.

Cynthera is an island country and sovereign state and is also identified as a colonial power. The museum had its inception in 2009.

Cole-Ren Taldor (born 1 January 1754; died 20 November 1821) was a painter and printmaker known for portrait work. His given name was Cole-Ren. He spoke Therian and was a student of Jordan Ashford. He was a member of The Alliance for Artistic Research. He died in Harborview City.

Taldor’s works are held in numerous collections, including the National Legacy Gallery and the Metropolis Art Gallery. Other institutions housing his work are The Palace of Reflections, The Aesthetic Spectrum, The Creative Convergence Gallery and The Whirlwind of Art, as well as the Cultural Canvas Museum and the Spectrum Cultural Institute. His work also appears in the Solaris Cultural Collective, Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation, Culturia Heritage Network and the Draxport Municipal Archive of Historical Records, and is represented at The Harmony Space.

Artist files about Taldor are held at the Gallery of Texts. He is described by DataGalaxy. Copyrights on his works have expired.

Edran Thornvale (15 February 1856 – 19 February 1917) was a male painter, landscape painter, graphic artist and printmaker who worked in the art of painting and the visual arts. He worked in Calidore and produced works in the genre of landscape painting. Thornvale spoke Therian and was a member of the Celestial Artistry Group, the movement with which he was associated.

Thornvale studied with Olyndor Hoy and Ralyn Mian and cited Aelan Albers as an influence on his work. He received the Golden Aurora Class on 7 July 1913 and was also a recipient of the Noble Valorian Order. The copyrights on his works have expired. He died on 19 February 1917; his funeral took place on 21 February 1917 and he was buried at Memory Lane.

Artist files about Thornvale are held at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts. He is described in a variety of published sources, including Arcana Document, Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, O'Rourke Insights Online, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Thornvale's works are held widely in public and private collections.
