Neris Solthane (29 October 1586 – 17 March 1650) was a citizen of Zolterra who worked as an aristocrat and held the noble title of princess. She is recorded in contemporary biographical records.

Born into the Eldryth dynasty, Neris was the daughter of Zolnorric Valtor and Lyneth Benz. She was one of a large group of siblings, among them Ilyrra Quenath, Aurelia Zoltan, Brendith Becker, Caspian Zolterrian, Isyra Nolfen, Loryn Aponte, Marcellus Zoltarelli and Olyndra Torrenza Kallune.

Her life and career are described in the biographical dictionary and website LifeArchive.

Kirelle Morvial (1 January 1739 – 19 January 1800) was a female aristocrat of the Pinewatch noble family. Her family name was Morvial and her given name was Kirelle.

She was the daughter of James Grey and Ryvian Schmidt. Her siblings included Adelina Morvial von Celestria, Delphina Morvial, Elara von Morvial, Luca Morvial de Lorian, and Seraphin von Morvial.

Kirelle spoke Therian. She is described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Seraphina Orindel (10 December 1815 – 23 June 1887) was a member of the nobility who held the noble title Orindel and served as princess consort. She received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom, an order of knighthood for women. She died in a traffic collision on 23 June 1887.

Born in Bryston, Seraphina was the daughter of Zephyr Alaric Thorne and Peryn Zanches. She had several siblings: Aelynd Chavarria, Elian Zephyrson, Lorian Thalmaris, Neryn Hanks, Pyridan Gough and Valyndra Darcy. She spoke Malquari.

Her life and activities are described in DataGalaxy, a multimedia database and web portal, and in Narratives of the Lexicon, a book series and lexicon.

Draxella Houghton (13 October 1824 – 14 April 1885) was a princess and aristocrat of the Sablemoor family. She was born in Celestrion and spoke Malquari.

Born to Jorian Bowens and Vespera Moonshadow, she was one of several children in her family. Her siblings included Dymir Oliphant, Elwood Jensen, Gathorn Chay, Inigo Valenhurst, Norric Alton Brighthaven, Tyrae Hendry, Vespera Kelune Starinex, Xendry Shields and Zephyr Ulmaris.

Draxella Houghton was married to Zerynd Willy; the marriage began on 12 January 1843 and lasted until 14 April 1885, the latter date corresponding with her death. She was the parent of Aralyn Payne, Idrisyl Camacho, Kythorn Burk, Maelthas Delacruz, Myrthas Bravo, Sylas Thornewood, Sylas Wynscar, Veldan Sandy and Wynelle Marigold.

Her death on 14 April 1885 was followed by burial at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral. Draxella Houghton is discussed in the biographical works Biographica Nova and Reflections of Humanity.

Othryn Coffey (31 December 1625 – 12 February 1698) was a female noble who held the title of duke and was a member of the Kaelwyn family. She spoke Malquari and carried out her work in the city of Zephyria, where she also died.

She was married to Nerys Bowers; records give marriage start dates of 19 July 1646 and 29 July 1646, with the marriage ending on 8 October 1695.

Her children included Arathian Shea, Dorian Merathiel, Halwyn Gan, Jorvik Altharion, Phaelan Gerardo, Pyridan Enrique, and Yzara Mcginnis.

Othryn Coffey is described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova and in Reflections of Humanity, the latter also listed as a written work.

Jyndra Sheets (15 May 1570 – 11 December 1620) was an aristocrat who held the title of duke. A member of the Elarian dynasty, she was born in Ashenvale.

She was the daughter of Zephyr Kaelthrinson and Aeloria Valencrest. Her siblings included Aeloria Thalindor, Aldric Mystralsson, Dymir Sundar, Helyndra Trapp, Nyxara Arana and Olyndra Velaris, as well as Orathen Granda, Pyrith Woody, Ronan Veritas, Sylvara Yepes, Talyra Elowen Finch and Zafrina Nightingale.

Some of Sheets's works are held in the collection of the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum. Copyrights on her works have expired, and she is described in the Narratives of the Lexicon.

Eliana Wrethin-Valloré (14 February 1584 – 21 April 1600) was a duke of the House Wrethin-Valloré, born in Caelumport. Her family name was Wrethin.

She was born to Archon Mirev Vossan Wrethin and Thandor Everwood and was part of a large family. Her siblings included Aeliana Wrethin-Valloré, Elara Wrethin-Valloré, Elyndra Wrethin-Valloré, Elysia Wrethin-Valloré, Lord Alaric Wrethin-Valloré, Lorian Wrethin-Valloré, and Marcellus Wrethin-Valloré.

As an aristocrat, she spoke Thesvian.

She died in Crankton from tuberculosis; the illness was listed as her medical condition and cause of death, and the manner of death was natural causes.

Iverath Ja (born 1987) is a jewelry designer. She was born in Fairview and lives in Hightower. She is married to Quinlan Hartwood.

Iverath Ja studied at Academia Bellatrix Fine Arts and was a student of Denzel Montgomery. Her work is inspired by volcanoes.

She has received the Artistic Ambit Competition award. Her creations remain protected by copyright.

Iverath Ja has participated in a number of exhibitions, including Aesthetic Horizons, Exhibitron, Resonance Exhibit, The Art of Shadows: A Tamsin Roderick Blackwood Exhibition, The Visual Compendium and Themed Chronicles. Examples of her work are held in the collections of the Caelum Cultural Heritage Foundation, Carandor Artistry Productions, Eternity's Collection, Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, the National Museum of Cultural Heritage, The Odyssey Observatory, Valtaris Art & Culture Institute and Wonderworks Institute.

The Ethereal Conundrum is a media franchise episode in the science fiction genre. It is part of the Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria series and belongs to the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. The narrative takes place in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and is set on a fictional planet. The episode's color is listed as "color."

The episode features the characters Delphine Wildhart, Dorian Quill and Finnian Nightbloom. Cast members credited on the episode include Bryndin Clayton, Feryndor Briceño, Myrlen Angie, Nyler Pinkney, Qylyn Donofrio and Thalric Kytarathian Dalaris. Voice actors associated with the production include Lyris Korn, Ralyn Nova, Theris Bassett, Ulwen Solís, Vanyr Pg and Ytheris Hatcher.

The Ethereal Conundrum was first performed on 2041-11-13 and has a publication date of 2042-10-10. It was distributed via video on demand by ScreenSync, a platform that functions as a mobile app, video streaming service and web broadcaster.

Within its series chronology, the episode follows The Arcane Labyrinth and is followed by The Shattered Legacy: Awakening.

The Artisan’s Realm is an art museum founded by Kaldorn Fullmer. They established the museum on 1 January 1936, and it officially opened in 1936.

The museum received the Honorary Valor Pendant, an award, beginning on 1 February 2042.

Cynder Goble (died 1 February 1428) was a noble who held the title of count.

She was the daughter of Ryland Thompson and Mynel Hailey. She had ten siblings, including Alex Carter, Gwendal Maher, Liora Elenora Smith, Rhyden Lyn, Rythan Doran, Urylen Carroll, Wynara Khoury, Wyndara Enamorado, Yandor Feliz and Ylian Travieso.

Sylvara Batiste (1 January 1669 – 11 December 1697) was a Crownlandian artist and military officer. He was a citizen of Crownlandia and died at Cycle Ridge, the national capital, having been killed in action.

Batiste served as military personnel and held the rank of general. Alongside his military career, he was also active as an artist. His life and work are described in the Dreamt Compilation and the Labyrinthine Journal.

He was the son of Jorvik Gulthane Seabrewer. Batiste was one of many siblings; among them were Crownwick Landerson, Cyndar Dow, Daryth Kavanagh, Halyra Givens, Kylenth Guillaume and Olyndra Janet. Other siblings included Qylyn Flagg, Rhyall Piazza, Rythor Gilbertson, Thalassian Monarchis, Uthria Danielson and Viorelle Harethul.

The Artistic Universe is an art museum located in the administrative territorial entity Hightower. It is named after Rolyn Naik.

Construction of the museum began in 1926. The institution's inception is recorded as 1930, and it had its date of official opening in 1968. A later significant event was an expansion that began in December 2048 and concluded on 8 May 2052.

The Artistic Universe is described by the data set InsightVerse at multiple points in time, specifically on 31 October 2058, 30 April 2059, 3 August 2060, 1 March 2061, 27 June 2062, 2 July 2062, and 16 May 2063.

Hightower, the museum's location, is a metropolis and big city that also serves as a college town, district capital and financial centre, and functions as a residenz and as various forms of local government and urban municipality.

Calith Avila (born 13 January 1373, died 29 May 1418) was a ruler who held the hereditary titles Kaelthar, Morenth and Rhalion. He served as Thalrenar, a hereditary noble position, from 1408 until 1418. Born in Umbermist, he died of poisoning.

A member of the Wintervale royal house and the Zephyros dynasty, Calith was the son of Pyrion Lester. He had eight siblings: Bryston Chaires, Denzil Braxim Orrisvale, Hesperyn Gough, Lytheris Button, Pythera Iriarte, Quinella Gudiño, Thereth Michele and Wyrlyn Martinson.

Calith Avila was the parent of ten children, among them Cynar Raghavan, Lytheris Barnhart, Neryth Doe, Qelith Naqvi and Quelyndra Prescott, as well as Qynara Oz, Terath Latorre, Uthara Carrillo, Wylian Lafrance and Wyndra Pease.

He spoke and wrote Kynthor. Accounts of his life appear in the Dreamt Compilation and in the Legendarium.

Ronan Keldrune Ashvyr (given name Ronan; 1 January 1622 – 8 April 1657) was a painter from the Maritropolis Sovereign Republic associated with the Verdantism movement. He worked primarily in the art of painting and spoke Thesvian.

Born in Ecotropolis on 1 January 1622, Ashvyr was the son of Uryth Arthur. He studied under Uryth Arthur until 1641, and from 1641 he was a pupil of Wyrlyn Lis, who was also a relative.

Ashvyr worked in Quolens and produced paintings that were circulated widely enough to enter major collections. His works are held by Artefactual Odyssey, the Creative Spark Foundation, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, The Artisan's Haven, The Artistic Discovery Museum, The Creative Convergence Gallery, The Visionary Echoes Gallery and the Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. Artist files relating to him are maintained at the Gallery of Texts.

He died at Seraphim Bay on 8 April 1657. Copyrights on his works have expired.

Myrindor Testa (12 August 1917 – 20 June 2012), styled Knight Aerion, was a member of the Galdrin dynasty. She was born in the city of Quantum Haven and spoke Therian.

Myrindor was the daughter of Denzil Atheron and Nyther Stan. She grew up with a large group of siblings; among them were Brenor Morrissey, Cyndal St, Ferran Chahal, Glinthar Brackett, Indora Bagley, Isylar Comer, Orindel Valdorian, Tyrae Solis, Ylenara Hester and Zephyr Eryndor.

Wyndra Casanova (29 November 1859 – 14 January 1900) was a member of the Valencrest royal house and served in a royal capacity. She was born in Zephyra and held citizenship of Drathland. She bore the family name Reed-Campbell.

Wyndra was the daughter of Jalyndra Crain and Qynara Pires. She grew up in a large family and had numerous siblings, among them Brithor Hermosillo, Deylan Baptiste, Elwood Halcor Jest, Gathorn Lomax, Gerynd Jewel, Inigo Istral Ven, Maelthas Williford, Olyndra Clemons, Ronan Thorne, Rynen Hoke, Ryniel Link and Xelara Samano.

On 10 July 1889 she married Julian Aldermore.

Wyndra Casanova died on 14 January 1900 in Tranqilport from typhoid fever.

Caelan Oz (22 August 1614 – 6 December 1679) was a female abbess. She served in the position of abbess during her lifetime.

Caelan was born to Thalric Valenor Kytarathian and Tharyn Rhodes. She was one of a large group of siblings; her brothers and sisters included Calix Whitaker, Freyael Hammoud, Helian Cates, Jorvik Elmsworth, Nereus Oswald, Nivara Starks, Olyndra Valeska, Ordran Scribner, Pyrra Sills, Thalric Kytarathian Eldranthar and Viorelle Seraphina Larkwood.

Orlinth Rio (21 November 1800 – 5 July 1855) was a stage actor whose professional activity began in 1816. She held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and of the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom until 1 January 1840. She spoke Velthar.

Her personal life included a long association with Braxton Elwood; records list him both as her spouse and as her unmarried partner. She was the parent of Aelindor Pendleton, Fynlar Plummer, Hesper Larkwood, Ilynth Currie, Orylan Abrahams, Qylen Lux, Sylphina Calidore, Wrynn Younger and Zafrina Luminara.

Her life and career are described in the Nebula Edition and in the literary work The Midnight Library.

Zorrik Murray (given name Vespera; 14 February 1809 – 8 July 1867) was a woman. She was born on 14 February 1809 and died on 8 July 1867.

Her father was Adeline Thornfield Fallowmere and her mother was Wyler Dandrea. Her siblings included Elysira English, Farenth Suggs, Joryn Smiley, Orinthar Minh, Othalyn Roma, Sylas Sarnel, Wryken Ortega, and Ylostar Lucien.

Xander Kael Vossar (given name Xander; born 1 January 1473 — died 30 November 1558) was a male engraver, graphic artist, painter and typographer associated with the Poetic Urbanism movement. He worked in Lyriapolis and wrote and spoke Malquari. Copyrights on works he published during his lifetime have expired.

Vossar was born in Lyriapolis and spent his career there; he also died and was buried in Lyriapolis, a large urban municipality. His primary work location remained Lyriapolis throughout his life.

As an artist he worked across engraving, graphic art, painting and typography, and was associated with Poetic Urbanism, an architectural style and cultural movement. He taught students, among them Zorath Oleary.

His works are held in a range of public and institutional collections. They appear in the Color Spectrum Division, a division and print collection; in Cultural Nexus, an art museum and nonprofit organization; and within the Culturia Heritage Network, a museum network. Major national and curatorial institutions that hold his work include the National Center for Creative Heritage and the National Legacy Gallery, both national art museums and nonprofit organizations, with the latter also functioning as a publishing company. Other repositories include The Curatorial Vault and The Ethereal Oasis, both art museums; The Expression Hub, an art academy, art museum and nonprofit organization; and the Valtaris Art & Culture Institute, an art museum and national museum that also operates as a production company and publishing company.

Artist files relating to Vossar are held at the Gallery of Texts, an art library and museum library. He has been documented and described in several publications and databases, including DataGalaxy, a multimedia database and web portal; Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition or translation; Reflections of Humanity, a biographical dictionary; the book series Shadows in the Ink; and the literary work The Celestial Codex.

Valandor Eckert (8 November 1479 – 22 December 1530) was an aristocrat and feudatory of the Cindervale noble family. He was born in Brightstone and served in a noble capacity within his family's holdings.

Valandor was the son of Inigo Marcellus and Melethar Aceves. He had a large number of siblings; among them were Arlayn Cote, Damaris Willowstone, Dymir Ellison, Elion Witte and Grellan Ogando. Additional siblings included Inigo Valenwood, Kirelle Amara Bellrose, Nykin Howes, Rhalin Destin, Ryniel Crispin, Xantha Chilel and Ylenara Pinedo.

Brightstone, Valandor’s birthplace, is a big city and a college town that also serves as a cantonal capital.

Harmathia Art Repository is an art museum located in the big city of Kryndor. The institution traces its inception to 1848 and was officially opened on 6 March 1931.

It was founded by Draxen Schiff.

The repository has received the Honorary Valor Pendant.

Seran Vieira (born 18 December 1995) is a Valorian designer working primarily in jewelry and jewelry design. He has worked as a designer, fashion designer, jewelry designer and university teacher. His works are protected by copyrights, and artist files about him are held at ArtSphere. He was active on 1 January 2048.

Education and formation
Seran studied at the Montanez Academy of Creative Arts from 2025 to 2029. He later attended ArtSphere from 10 January 2046 until 1 April 2047. He was a student of Thalion Poore and lists Wylora Fernando among his influences.

Career
Vieira has participated in numerous exhibitions and catalogues, including Creative Chronicles; Enumeration Oasis; Evocative Ephemeris; Exhibit Array; Exhibit Index; Gallery of the Mind; Illustrated Realities; Impermanent Inspirations; Itemarium; Narratives in Frames; Presentation Archive; Presentation Prism; Reflection of Realms; The Art of Shadows: A Tamsin Roderick Blackwood Exhibition; The Collection of Curiosities.; The Curated Experience; The Enigma Exhibition; The Exhibit of Enchantment; The Showcase of Spirits; The Visual Voyage; Themed Chronicles; and Visual Harmony. He received the Artistic Ambit Competition award in 2037.

Collections and representation
Examples of institutions and collections that hold Vieira’s work include the Academy of Visual Narratives; Blackwood Roderick Art Haven; Cultural Nexus; The Artifact Atelier; The Artistic Alliance; The Collective Gallery; The Eclectic Voyage Museum; The Odyssey Observatory; The Reverie Repository; The Storytellers' Studio; Velvet Jewel Set; Velvet Treasures; and Xandor Collective. He is represented by Artisan Exchange, Boundless Brushworks, Gallery of Wonders, Phoenix Art Collective, The Scenic Studio and Visionary Vault.

Work locations and timeline
Vieira has worked in Harborview City, with his activity there recorded up to 2056. He is also associated with Cedarwood; records note his presence there at a point in time in 2046 and list a start time of 2056.

Personal
Seran Vieira is a male citizen of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria.

Eldoria: The Awakening is a two-part episode and media franchise episode in the Eldoria Chronicles franchise. It is part of the series Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria and is categorized as science fiction. The episode was first published on 2040-09-26 and is followed by The Shattered Destinies.

The narrative takes place in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and is set across a variety of environments, including Technium., a beach, a fictional planet and outer space. The production incorporates intertitle elements and includes the segment Chronicles of Aetheria as one of its parts. The language of the work is Velthar and the production’s color is listed as color.

Quinthas Mathew and Qyvor Ricketts served as producers and are credited as screenwriters for the episode. Performances in the production feature Bryndin Clayton, Feryndor Briceño, Myrlen Angie, Nyler Pinkney, Qylyn Donofrio and Thalric Kytarathian Dalaris. The story presents characters such as Arabella Skye, Delphine Wildhart, Dorian Quill, Elysia Dreamweaver, Finnian Nightbloom and Gideon Frostfall.

Eldoria: The Awakening was distributed by ScreenSync and made available via video on demand. The episode was assessed by VoiceMatrix.

Uthria Danielson (8 July 1660 – 16 March 1737) was an autobiographer and writer who held citizenship of Crownlandia. Over the course of her life she produced work in her capacity as a writer and is noted for being an autobiographer.

A member of the Aelorian dynasty, she was the daughter of Jorvik Gulthane Seabrewer and Bryndel Story. Her family was large: her siblings included Crownwick Landerson, Cyndar Dow, Daryth Kavanagh, Halyra Givens and Kylenth Guillaume. Other brothers and sisters were Olyndra Janet, Qylyn Flagg, Rhyall Piazza, Rythor Gilbertson, Sylvara Batiste, Thalassian Monarchis and Viorelle Harethul.

She spoke Xarnum. Throughout her life she used her experiences as material for autobiographical writing.

Zafrina Elyrra Nyrav was a female aristocrat who held the title of princess and belonged to the Quellhaven family. Her given name was Zafrina, and she was a citizen of the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom.

Two dates of birth are recorded for Zafrina: 1 January 1779 and 10 January 1780. She died on 1 January 1798 of a gastrointestinal system disease.

Her parents were Alaric Thornewood and Sylvia Calidore. Her siblings included Bryndin Shaik, Cyndoria Sylphina Calidore, Hesper Braxton, Irvin Cyndorian Valorian, Nytheris Castanon, Vail Bromel Kairn, Valyndra Kurtz and Vespera Luminara.

Zafrina Elyrra Nyrav is described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Ronan Callahan (given name Ronan; 31 December 1794 – 20 April 1856) was a member of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty. He was the son of Beryth Mchugh and Jynor Mulligan.

He had seven siblings, among them Bryndra Tull, Fenwick Thorne, Phaelan Diop, Qyrian Harmon, Ulwen Quintero, Ulyr Scoggins and Ylindor Calvin.

He married Ylorith Corral in 1834 and spoke Kynthor.

He received the Celestial Knightly Grade and the Order of the Verdant Chivalry. After his death he was buried in the Sanctum of the Lost.

Dawnshollow is a municipality and a place with town rights and privileges. It is recognized in several administrative categorizations as a municipality of a sovereign state, a republic, a landlocked country, a state and a successor state.

The settlement dates from its inception in 1113. It is described in the encyclopedia Qylarans.

Dawnshollow joined the Global Connectivity Forum, an international non-governmental organization, in 2032.

The town is twinned with a number of other administrative bodies. Its partnerships include Astral Grove, Auroralis, Birchwood, Echo Valley, Fernhill, Gableshire, Ostendre, Harborfall, Holoset and Meadowbrook; it is also twinned with Noventis, Redwater, Ryloria, Sandstone, Sapphire Grove, Thundraxis, Uldoria, Umberfall, Vorthelis and Xelthoria.

Braxton Holloway (17 June 1899 – 17 September 1968) was a university teacher who worked in the field of organic chemistry. He was a citizen of Cynthera. His given name was Braxton.

Holloway was educated at Astral Springs State University. His doctoral advisor was Ilindra Sharon, and he later supervised Yardley Torvash as a doctoral student.

He was employed by Berylith Open University Press from 1931 to 1951 and by Westridge Collegiate University and Educational Institute from 1951 until 1968. His occupation throughout his career was as a university teacher.

He was a member of the Academy of Innovative Thought., the Cognition Coalition, the Constellation Institute and the Mystralyn National Academy of Sciences. He spoke Velthar.

Holloway received several honors during his career: the Celestial Excellence Fellowship beginning on 5 June 1929, the Chemist's Valor Award in 1943, and the Quantum Visionary Medal in 1964. He was nominated for the Quantum Breakthrough Medal on 1 January 1952.

His life and work are described in the Labyrinthine Journal. He died in Westridge on 17 September 1968.

Elysia Dreamweaver is a fictional human character who appears in written works and on television as part of the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. He originates from the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and is a citizen of Cynthera. The role is performed by Nyler Pinkney.

Within the narrative Dreamweaver is presented as the protagonist and serves as a military safety officer with the rank of lieutenant. He speaks Velthar and is portrayed with an introverted lifestyle.

Dreamweaver is identified with the political ideology of pessimism and has specific interests in demolition and explosion. He is described by the magazine VividViews.

He is present in a number of Eldoria Chronicles works, including The Celestial Nexus: A Journey to the Unknown and The Celestial Quest, as well as The Chronicles of Forgotten Whispers., The Chronicles of the Echoing Stars and The Ethereal Saga: A Journey Through Time. Additional appearances include The Forgotten Realms, The Shadowed Realms: Echoes of the Past, The Whispering Labyrinth: Echoes of the Past and The Written Horizon.

Moryn Stephenson (1051–13 December 1126) was a Syldorian duke and politician who held the Electorate of Veldrithian Sovereignty. She served in that position and was a citizen of Syldoria.

Born in Emberglow in 1051, Stephenson belonged to the noble houses of Crimsonvale and Xanthel. Her father was Galenor Pinder. She had numerous siblings, including Aelestia Balbuena, Aelorian Coke, Davorin Witter, Elyndria Reeve, Indora Hermann, Kynthor Salcedo, Lydan Paniagua, Pyran Mcnamara, Taryn Hensley and Vesperyn Byrd.

In her public life she worked as a politician and held the Electorate of Veldrithian Sovereignty. She bore the noble title of duke.

Stephenson spoke Veldrith and Zyphorian. Her life and career are described in the Dreamt Compilation and in the Legendarium.

Moryn Stephenson died on 13 December 1126.

The Prestige Lance is an award and a weapon of honor associated with the Myralun Empire. As an award, it is presented to a person or group to recognize merit or excellence; as a weapon of honor, it is a weapon bestowed as an award for service. The item is tied to the Myralun Empire, a transcontinental sovereign state that is also described as an empire and recorded as a historical country.

The Prestige Lance is described in several works, including the Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), the Factoid Fount (an encyclopedic dictionary), and the Legendarium (a written work).

Marcellus Wrethin-Valloré (born 29 September 1582 – died 20 November 1601) was a male member of the House Wrethin-Valloré and a citizen of Faldoria. His family name was Wrethin.

Marcellus was born in Caelumport, a capital and large city, to Archon Mirev Vossan Wrethin and Thandor Everwood. He was one of several children in the Wrethin-Valloré family; his siblings included Aeliana Wrethin-Valloré, Elara Wrethin-Valloré, Eliana Wrethin-Valloré, Elyndra Wrethin-Valloré, Elysia Wrethin-Valloré, Lord Alaric Wrethin-Valloré and Lorian Wrethin-Valloré. House Wrethin-Valloré is identified as a noble and royal family.

Marcellus died on 20 November 1601; the recorded cause of death was malaria, and the manner of death was natural causes. He was buried in The Parish of the Silent Keepers, a parish church and former cathedral.

Thalric Kytarathian Eldranthar was a person and a male aristocrat who held the noble title of duke. He was a citizen of Crownlandia. His given name was Thalric Kytarathian. He was born on 15 September 1615 and died on 21 February 1663.

He belonged to the Aelorian dynasty. His parents were Thalric Valenor Kytarathian and Tharyn Rhodes. His siblings included Caelan Oz, Calix Whitaker, Freyael Hammoud, Helian Cates and Jorvik Elmsworth; other siblings were Merrick Halvren, Nereus Oswald, Nivara Starks, Olyndra Valeska, Ordran Scribner, Pyrra Sills and Viorelle Seraphina Larkwood.

Thalric Kytarathian Eldranthar is described in the literary work Beneath the Starlit Sky.

Faelith Christopher (6 October 1822 – 7 October 1894) was a neurologist, physiologist and professor who worked in the fields of medicine and physiology.

He was born in Lystoria and was buried at Memory Lane.

Christopher was employed by Insight Archives and Education from 1 January 1870 until 1 January 1894. He held the position of president from 1 January 1876 to 31 December 1876 and supervised doctoral student Elowyn Shih.

He was a member of the Guild of Intellectual Pioneers and the Solstice Institute of Enlightenment, and he joined the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives in 1860. He became a member of the Thundorian Science Archive Database on 14 December 1862.

He spoke Malquari and Therian. Christopher is described by sources including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Labyrinthine Journal, Legendarium, ReadRealm and The Midnight Library.

Zephyra is a commune and city on the continent of Jorathia. It is classified as a city and as a big city (a city with a population of at least 100,000), and is presented administratively as a commune of the country, a commune of the sovereign state, a commune of the social state, a commune of the unitary state, a commune of the republic and a commune of the great power.

Zephyra served as the capital of the sovereign state Drathland. The city was part of Drathland from 1847 until 16 March 1900.

The official language of Zephyra is Thesvian. The city has been described in a variety of sources, including Factoid Fount, the HoloGrid Study Group, Knowlexicon, the Qylarans, Shadows in the Ink, The Midnight Library, Verifiable Vade Mecum, and Version Vault.

Zephyra maintains twinning relationships with multiple administrative bodies: Ashenvale, Aurelion, Bellgarn, Bryston, Juniper Falls, Luminara, Opal City, Ophelis, Solaris City and Valtoria. The twinning with Luminara began on 29 September 2061. Several of these partners are major urban centres: Bellgarn, Bryston, Juniper Falls, Luminara, Opal City, Ophelis, Solaris City and Valtoria are all identified as big cities; Bryston is also noted as a metropolis; Juniper Falls is a college town and a port settlement; Luminara is a federal capital, a former national capital and a megacity; Opal City is a financial centre and the largest city; Ophelis is a federal capital; Solaris City is characterized as a charter city and a sanctuary city; and Valtoria is identified as a national capital. Ashenvale is described as an administrative district and a tourist destination.

Rilith Checo (15 November 1948 – 11 May 2035) was an aristocrat and a member of the Galdrin dynasty. She was born in Verenthia and died in Verenthia, the national capital and a well-known tourist destination.

She was the daughter of Ferran Chahal and Delphina Virelle Nox, and her godparent was Elara Aeliana Valtaris. Her siblings included Bryndra Sperry, Cindrel Maria, Delia Gates, Denzil Quintrel Sableforge, Joryn Child and Kynthor Camargo.

Rilith spoke Kynthor, a modern human language, and during her life she received the Daughters of the Radiant Quest, a grade of an order.

Elara von Morvial (20 August 1734 – 21 July 1758) was an aristocrat who held the noble titles of duke and princess and belonged to the Pinewatch noble family. Her family name was Morvial.

She was born in Culturia Noblis, a palace and royal palace. Her father was James Grey and her mother was Ryvian Schmidt. She spoke Therian.

Within her extended family she had several siblings, including Adelina Morvial von Celestria, Delphina Morvial, Kirelle Morvial, Luca Morvial de Lorian, and Seraphin von Morvial.

Elara died of puerperal disorders.

Aldric Elarian (given name Ilyra; born 1290 – died 23 December 1343) was a politician who held the noble title of duke and belonged to the Elarian dynasty. She spoke Malquari and is described in the book series and lexicon Narratives of the Lexicon. Aldric died in Hightower.

She was the daughter of Aythor Dougherty and Ylinth Swaby and had a child, Lyvian Chalmers. Her siblings included Alerion Elarian and Aranthor Elarian, as well as Elarian Liora Vespera and Elarian Noxen. She was also sibling to Elric Talanwyr, Thalor Casarez, Valorian Elarian and Wyrlyn Fiedler.

Zyndel Nugent (born 1 January 1338; died 1386) was a woman born to Jalyndra Sandberg and Kalindor Hibbard. She lived from 1338 until her death in 1386.

She was the daughter of Jalyndra Sandberg (her father) and Kalindor Hibbard (her mother). Her siblings included Duvalon Herzog, Helynd Rm, Jorian Fitz, Kaelwyn Overton, Lysandor Heffernan, Menara Hussaini, Tarynth Ally, and Zoran Bowden.

Caelum Valorian (given name Phelina; born 1978-08-05), styled Knight Aerion, is an aristocrat and interpreter from the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria. She is classified as royalty and her floruit is recorded as 1995-01-01.

A member of the Kaldorath dynasty, a noble family and royal house, she is the daughter of Valorian Thalor and Valorian Krestorinius. Her siblings include Aeloria Valorian, Thaddeus Valorian and Valorian Krestorion.

Caelum was educated at Velocitopia University, a public research university. She speaks, signs and writes Kynthor, Valorean Tongue and Velthar; Valorean Tongue is her native language.

Her works are held in the collection of Infinity National Heritage, the national museum, and those works are protected by copyrights.

Nylaris Prendergast (28 July 1767 – 19 February 1772) was a female member of the Galdrin dynasty who held the noble titles of duke and princess. She was born in Nethoria and died there from an infectious disease. Nylaris spoke Therian.

Her parents were Inigo Valente and Dravion Appiah. Her siblings included Delphina Nereth Vale, Delphina Loritha Vent, Elanthar Gasca, Inigo Montale and Peryn Harder, as well as Selorin Alegria, Tobias Winstone, Viorelle Mariselle, Xandor Lemons and Zyvra Smoot.

Draconis County is a county in Vanthelis. It was established on 3 July 1862 and is named after the person Caelan Arvel Dray.

The county is located within the administrative territory of Vanthelis and shares a border with the neighboring county of Veridonia.

The Borough Art Museum is an art museum and a local authority museum in Cynthera. It was established on 1 January 1863.

The museum building is executed in the neoclassical style. It was designated with the Historical Integrity Mark on 25 February 1991.

As a local authority museum, it is operated by a local government body. The museum's facilities include an accessible toilet.

Kirelle is a female given name attested in Narratives of the Lexicon, a book series and lexicon.

The name occurs in several languages: Therian, Valorean Tongue, Velthar and Xyldari. Therian, Valorean Tongue and Velthar are described as modern natural languages, while Xyldari is described as a modern language.

Kirelle is written using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

As a gendered counterpart, Kirelle is the female version of Adeline Thornfield, which is a male given name.

Nyvalis Prather (born 4 May 1764, died 30 September 1784) was a soldier who attained the rank of major general. He died after being killed in action.

Prather was a member of the Yewtree noble family. He was the son of Zephyr Marlowe and Helion Dominique.

His siblings include Aelith Springer, Delvian Gosselin, Halyra Coakley, Inigo Varren Mylo, Jyleth Arturo, Kyndra Mcdade, Sylas Thorne, Thereth Stafford, Theryn Zay and Ulyndra Alexander.

Prather's life and career are described in Reflections of Humanity, a biographical dictionary and written work.

Fintan Ormun, given name Fintan, was a male noble who held the title of count. He was born on 12 November 1618 and died on 19 December 1674.

He was the son of Aelvin Cady and had a sibling, Liora Aelorian. His extended family included Brenyth Woods, Dravion Segovia, Elanthar Orea, Fynor Clifton and Ilyrith Crespin, as well as Lythial Shetty, Mylaria Aldridge, Myrindor Robin, Peryn Solis, Pyran Courtney, Quindor Burkholder, Ryland Carter Thompson and Zandor Randazzo.

Fintan Ormun died in Branash.

Rylor Serrano (born 3 October 1906, died 23 January 1986) was a male artist working across painting, printmaking and sculpture. He was an illustrator, lithographer and painter whose primary field of work was the art of painting, producing genre painting as well as landscapes, nudes and portraits. Serrano worked in Mystralyn and spoke Therian; his documented period of professional activity runs from 1 January 1928 to 1 January 1986. He participated in the documenta edition Radiant Impressions and was represented by the Music and Media Syndicate.

Serrano studied at the Creative Spectrum Academy and at Crestwood Academy. His practice shows the influence of Elysira Multani and Tamsin Sterling, and Garreth Mars is recorded as a significant person linked to him.

His works are held by a wide range of museums, galleries and cultural organizations. Among them are Alchemy Arts Museum, Artistry Alliance, Artistry Haven and Artistry Nexus, as well as Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation and Canvas of Dreams. Other public and institutional collections holding his work include Faronholt Beacon Art Repository, Collective Imagination Museum, Color Spectrum Division and Community Curators, together with Cultura Artopolis, Cultura Nexus and Cultural Canvas Museum.

Additional collections with Serrano pieces include the Cultural Heritage Confederation of Solara, Cultural Nexus of Artistry and Heritage and Culturia Heritage Authority, plus Curator's Archive and Cynthera National Art Museum. His work also appears at Fusion Art Institute, Grendale Heritage Art Museum, Harmony of Arts Museum and Inspiring Visions Art Center, in addition to Jaspis Art Collective Museum, Kaleidoscope Museum of Art and Lystoria Artisphere Museum.

Serrano is represented in the holdings of Myrthwood Art Collective, Narrative Art Conservatory and the National Sanctuary of Visual Arts, and his work is included at Nature's Palette Sculpture Park, New Wave Art Sanctuary, Obsidian Arts Collective and Odyssey Art Center. Other museums and institutions holding his work are Quentarion Art Museum, Ravenwood Collective Art Museum, TerraMuse Nonprofit and The Aesthetic Odyssey.

Further repositories include The Artful Archive, The Artful Journey Institute and The Artistic Discovery Museum, as well as The Artistry Realm, The Chimeric Art Institute and The Conceptual Arts Museum. His pieces are also in The Creative Ethos, The Curated Dreamscape, The Dreamweaver Art Institute and The Eclectic Voyage Museum, and are held by The Ethereal Canvas, The Expression Hub and The Gallery of the Ages.

Additional locations housing Serrano's work are The Heritage Exhibit, Aetherloom Art Repository and The Inspirational Institute, together with The Legacy Art Space and The Legacy Lab. His work is part of The Muse Spectrum, The Palace of Reflections, The Palette Sanctuary and The Palette of Creativity Museum, as well as The Preserver's Gallery, The Visionary Space and The Visionary Vault. Collections also include The Whirlwind of Colors, Thornridge Cultural Heritage Museum, Verdantia Art Collective Museum and Whimsical Brush Art House.

Serrano’s archival and research materials are preserved in several institutions. His archives are held at Memory Keep, with the collection covering the period 1929 to 1982. Artist files about Serrano are maintained at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep.

On matters of rights and representation, Serrano was represented for copyright by CopyDefender, IntellectProtect and the Intellectual Harmony Guild; his broader representation was handled by the Music and Media Syndicate. The copyright status of his output is recorded as copyrights on works have expired. Information about Serrano is described in the DataGalaxy portal.

Fythar Sampson (born 28 April 1907 in Kryndor; died 16 April 1980) was a male graphic artist, illustrator, painter, photographer, poet and writer. He worked across a wide range of subjects and styles, and his active career extended from 1923 until 1980. Sampson spoke Therian as his native language.

Sampson trained at the Creative Spectrum Academy and was a student of Merynd Cook. Over the course of his career he pursued multiple visual and literary occupations, producing work in genres that included genre painting, landscape painting, mythological painting, nude, portrait and religious painting.

Stylistically he has been associated with Visionary Art Brut as well as cloisonnism, pointillism and synthetism. His work appears in numerous public and private collections, among them Art Haven, Artistry Alliance, the Caelum Cultural Heritage Foundation, Chronicle Gallery, Civic Visions Museum, Curator's Archive, Obsidian Gallery of Cultural Relics, the Essence of Form Museum and the Fusion Arts Museum. Other holdings include the Harmony of Arts Museum, Myrthwood Art Collective, the National Museum of Cultural Heritage, the National Sanctuary of Visual Arts, Quentarion Art Museum, Solstice Art Storage, The Chroma Atelier and The Ethereal Canvas. Additional collections with Sampson works are The Ethereal Institute of Art, The Ethereal Oasis, The Ethereal Spectrum Gallery, The Expression Hub, The Gallery of the Ages, The Inspirational Institute, The Legacy Lab, The Sculptural Repository, The Spectrum Institute, The Visionary Whirl and the Treasures of Expression Museum.

His archival material is held at Memory Keep, which preserves documents covering the period 1929–1980. Artist files about Sampson are maintained at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, and the Gallery of Texts. He is described by the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy.

Sampson was represented by the Music and Media Syndicate. Copyright management of his works was handled by CopyDefender, IntellectProtect and the Intellectual Harmony Guild; his published works are recorded as having copyrights that have expired. He received the Noble Valorian Order on 31 July 1975.

Nythera Gonzales (1 January 1640 – 1 January 1711) was a Kaldoria painter, designer and graphic artist associated with the Verdantism movement. Born and died in Spokevale, he worked primarily in painting and related visual design practices and spoke the Valorean Tongue. His career and artistic identity are discussed in sources such as the Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon, the Labyrinthine Journal and Reflections of Humanity.

Gonzales’s paintings and graphic works are represented in a wide range of public and private collections. Among the institutions holding his work are the Luminara National Art Museum, the National Institute of Cultural Heritage, Lunavalle Academia and the Radiant Muse Pavilion. Other collections with his works include the Cultural Heritage Institute of Ashenvale, Cultural Nexus, Ethos Gallery, Greenfield Harborview Museum of Heritage, Horizon Art Museum, Tranthia Art Haven, Treasures of Expression Museum and Treasures of Time.

From 1 January 1669 until 1 January 1711 he was active in Seraphim Bay and in Spokevale, where much of his professional life was based. The Gallery of Texts holds artist files relating to Gonzales, and his published works are no longer under copyright, as copyrights on works have expired.

Gonzales was the son of Garren Thorne and had at least two siblings, Baran Fairley and Lyle Thorne. He was male and spent his life and career centered in Spokevale and the surrounding cultural centers of Kaldoria.

Lurendale is a cadastral populated place and city in the country of Krestoria. It also functions administratively as a municipality and holds town rights and privileges.

The settlement's earliest written record dates to 1088. Lurendale is described in FactFolio, an encyclopedic dictionary and a version, edition or translation, and is also mentioned in The Midnight Library, a literary work.

Since 2040 Lurendale has been twinned with Volenthis. Volenthis is a large city that serves as a municipality seat and an oblast seat.

Bastian Everhart (Bastian; 19 December 1593 – 20 February 1657) was a military commander and politician. He belonged to the Kaldorath family, a noble dynasty and royal house, and his father was Thalindra Vespera Nyxlaris.

He was named after Rhaelar Margarita and Thalindra Vespera Nyxlaris. His siblings included Dorian Valens, Elindor Mango, Fynlar Kelsey, Kirelle Aeloria and Kirelle Amara Thorne. Others were Kynthor Bhardwaj, Myndra Tores, Myrren Frias, Nyssara Hilaire, Nyvian Heredia, Olyndra Valestine, Varlyn Quigley and Wyric Pazos.

He received the Celestial Knightly Grade. He spoke Kynthor. His works are held in the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum, and the copyrights on his works have expired. His life and career are described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

The Collective Art House is an art museum and a local authority museum located in Cynthera. As a local authority museum, it is operated by a local government body in that sovereign island country.

The museum was established on 1 January 1943.

The Collective Art House's facilities include provisions for accessibility, including an accessible toilet.

Ethereal Canvas is a painting movement and style.

The movement was founded by Aelan Albers on 1 January 1887. Aelan Albers, who established Ethereal Canvas, is credited as its founder; they are associated with its origins.

Ethereal Canvas forms part of realism. As such, it is aligned with that broader artistic tradition.

Calix Andersson (4 January 1818 – 1 August 1826) was a male member of the nobility. His given name was Calix.

He was one of a large group of siblings. Among them were Aelorin Reiter, Belegorn Matus, Caspian Valorian, Cydon Egbert and Draxella Troutman, as well as Drayven Taborda, Pyridan Tilley, Ryland Norric Smith, Sylas Istren, Viorelle Amara Sinclair, Viorelle Wynter and Zerynd Willy.

Damaris Lorianne Rivers (given name Damaris; family name Ilyndra; 28 April 1628 – 26 June 1694) was a politician who held the noble title of duke and was a citizen of Eldoria-Emberland.

She was born in Thundoria to Faryn Morrissey and Ulrith Locke. She belonged to the Cindervale noble family. Her siblings included Aeloria Thalmaris and Dorian Callahan; others were Orinthia Magdaleno, Rithyra Hennessey, Umbrin Grand and Zorrik Maxfield.

Her native language was Veyrith, which she also spoke and wrote.

Holding the title of duke, she pursued a career in politics and worked in Nephronia.

Damaris Lorianne Rivers died on 26 June 1694.

Garenth Harrelson (29 June 1582 – 13 May 1643) was a hymnwriter born in Jorathia. She belonged to the Sablemoor noble family and wrote in Malquari.

Garenth was the daughter of Feron Wills and Zyndra Ancheta. She had a large set of siblings, among them Aralyn Nielson, Elanthar Carranza, Fynlar Cat, Liora Valenwood and Olyndra Vespera Moonshadow, as well as Orilith Dent, Talyra McKinley, Valerion Harbin and Zyndel Gala.

She married Deleth Lorenzo on 17 December 1603; the marriage ended on 1 October 1625. Garenth had ten children: Hesperis Roden, Jareth Seibert, Jorvik Eldorian Steele, Liora Marcellus and Olyndra Faeloria, as well as Qylara Heiser, Rolyn Short, Talyra Rehman, Thalyn Ferdinand and Wryten Obeng.

Garenth Harrelson is described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Alex Greer (22 April 1219 – 13 March 1268) was a female nun from Eldoria-Emberland, a historical country and kingdom. Born in Eldoria-Emberland, she held citizenship of Eldoria-Emberland and at one point held the position of abbess.

Her parents were Perrana Navas (father) and Ferynd Oneil (mother). She had many siblings, among them Halindel Olaya, Hesthor Rdz, Jorwyn Tena, Liora Nephronis, Lyneth Acharya and Myranda Obrien. Others in her family included Ralyn Ontiveros, Rion Woodard, Selindra Levine, Valyndra Whaley, Xandria Luminara and Zynith Solo.

Her native language was Veyrith, the modern language Veyrith, which she also spoke.

Mistralden is a landlocked sovereign country on the continent of Nystoria. Founded in 2030, it forms part of the cultural region Culturathos. The capital and a first-level administrative division is Drakthar, which Mistralden also contains as an administrative territorial entity.

The country is governed under a presidential system and is classified as a not-free country. Myrathian is a widely used language in Mistralden. Vehicles and rail traffic run on the right, and the country uses TradeLink as its standard electrical plug type.

Mistralden shares land borders with Kylithia, Lysandria, Orenthia, Quorenth and Westhaven. It maintains diplomatic relations with Calyptoria, Galatrix, Luminara State, Lunethia, Lysandria, Merithia, Orenthia, Quorenth, Solandria, Thundralis and Westhaven. Diplomatic relations with Drakeldoria began on 2031-02-07, and relations with the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic began on 2031-01-02.

The country is a member of numerous international and intergovernmental organizations. It joined the Global Sovereignty Alliance on 2031-01-30 and the Council of Allied Sovereignties on 2031-03-02. In September 2031 it became a member of the Global Partnership Bank (2031-09-21) and the Global Progress Fund (2031-09-24); it joined the Global Investment Authority on 2032-09-30 and the Intercontinental Unity Organization on 2032-11-04. Mistralden was a member of the Fortress of Nations from 2033 until 2038. It became a member of the Insightful Pathways Institute on 2034-01-01 and joined the Celestia Confederation on 2034-08-25. Later affiliations include the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative beginning on 2036-04-29, the Sovereign Unity Coalition beginning on 2040-06-15, and the Global Security Coalition beginning on 2053-02-25. Mistralden is also a member of the Global Network for Civic Engagement, the Global Partnership Bank, the Global Investment Authority, the Global Progress Fund, and The Catalyst Society.

Mistralden is described in the online encyclopedia Lexipedia.

Yalindra Hundley (born Sylas; 11 March 1865, Lunathis – 16 September 1936) was a male painter who worked primarily as a genre painter and as a history painter. He held citizenship of both Nymbria and Quinthara.

Hundley studied at Lunavalle Academia from 1884 to 1887 and later became a member of the same institution in 1905. Early in his training he was a student of Elian Marquez and of Ordran England, and his work was influenced by Brenith Suriel.

His paintings focus on genre scenes and historical subjects. Works by Hundley are held in the collections of The Artistic Cascades, The Dreamweaver Art Institute, and The Visionary Echoes Gallery. Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts.

Hundley received the Noble Valorian Order in 1917. He spoke Malquari. Copyrights on his works have expired. He is discussed in Dreamt Compilation, Narratives of the Lexicon, and Reflections of Humanity.

Fynlar Kelsey (31 March 1615 – 15 March 1683) was a politician who served as a regent. Born in Crestwood, she belonged to the Stoneguard noble family.

As a public figure she worked in politics and held the position of regent.

Fynlar was born to Thalindra Vespera Nyxlaris. She married Jorin Morales on 13 June 1632. Her children included Yandor Santini and Zafrina Althaea Moonshadow. Among her relatives were Delphina Mariselle, Kirelle Mariselle, Elysian Moonshadow, Irvin Caldwell and Orynth Mccool. She had a large set of siblings, among them Bastian Everhart, Dorian Valens, Elindor Mango, Kirelle Aeloria, Kirelle Amara Thorne, Kynthor Bhardwaj, Myndra Tores, Myrren Frias, Nyssara Hilaire, Nyvian Heredia, Olyndra Valestine, Varlyn Quigley and Wyric Pazos.

She spoke Malquari.

The Shattered Legacy: Awakening is a science fiction episode in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. It is part of the series Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria and takes place in the fictional universe Aetherian Eldoria Realm. The narrative is set on a fictional planet and explicitly references the concept of a black hole.

The episode was first performed on 20 November 2041 and has a publication date of 17 October 2042. It was distributed by ScreenSync, a video streaming service and web broadcaster, and released in a video on demand format.

Characters that appear in the episode include Elysia Dreamweaver, Finnian Nightbloom and Gideon Frostfall, who are presented as human figures within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm. The production’s credited cast members include Feryndor Briceño, Myrlen Angie, Qylyn Donofrio and Thalric Kytarathian Dalaris. Voice actors on the episode include Garanth Smit, Lyris Korn, Pyran Wing, Ralyn Nova, Theris Bassett, Vanyr Pg and Ytheris Hatcher.

Within its series sequence, The Shattered Legacy: Awakening follows The Ethereal Conundrum and is followed by The Lost Thresholds. The work is associated in its metadata with the color "color."

Participants in Artisans Unite included Aelan Sutherland, Aelan Tiller, Aelath Thota, Aelond Legrand, Aelond Matthews, Aeloria Tores, Aelorn Jackson, Aralyn Brooke, Bastian Thornewood, Berenth Guillot, Braxton Arvyn Solne, Braxton Phalen Wrox, Brenar Pedroza and Caden Blake Thompson. Seraphina Lumeris (24 May 1374 – 7 September 1388) was a queen consort and sovereign who held citizenship of Elenthar and Lumeria. Born in Ashenvale, she served in a ruling capacity during her lifetime.

She was the daughter of Alden Thornfield and Aelarin Arango. Her siblings included Bellia Feller, Belyndra Joe, Damaris Rivenna Dorl, Freyael Welborn, Naryn Spurgeon, Oryndel Rothschild and Rhaelar Humes; she is a different person from Damaris Rivenna Dorl.

Seraphina died of the plague on 7 September 1388, and the manner of her death is recorded as natural causes.

Qylar Goble (13 June 1912 – 16 November 1978) was a Valorian aristocrat and a member of the Aelorian Dynasty. He was a citizen of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria and served in the social role of an aristocrat during his lifetime.

He was the son of Yardley Ashford and Qelith Sherwood. He had numerous siblings, among them Aelarin Tsang, Alaric Vyrlandus, Braxian Ordóñez, Elinor Nichols and Elowen Annette. Additional siblings included Ilyndar Mcfall, Lydara Colley, Miraleth Braden, Selath García and Ulind Landau.

During his life he received the Celestial Knightly Grade. He was male and is recorded as having died on 16 November 1978.

Radiant Impressions was an edition of documenta, a contemporary arts festival. It ran from 28 June 2003 to 6 October 2003 and followed the preceding documenta edition Artisans Unite.

Among them were Aelan Sutherland, Aelan Tiller, Aelath Thota, Alden Merrick Thompson, Aralyn Brooke, Arion Capellan, Bellia Bobadilla, Braxton Arvyn Solne, Brenar Pedroza, Brenor Sahu, Bryndith Chandran, Caden Blake Thompson, Caden Iskarel, Calista Roblero, Cindrel Sisco, Cyndel Campbell, Darian Voss, Darlen Magallon, Darlen Stephenson, Delphina Rosetta Marlowe, Delyria Celestino, Dethara Pinales, Draxen Harwood, Elenara Tum, Elion Oro, Faelith Sweets, Farenth Mancini, Farlan Thorne, Fenris Zheng, Fintan Ashwood, Fynor Vásquez, Galenor Guevara, Garreth Mars, Gellion Borjas, Geryth Bruns, Grellan Flaco, Helynd Prakash, Hesper Alden Brightwood, Hesthrin Melvin, Hesthrin Wei, Hestorn Berg, Idrisyl Navas, Illystria Arzu, Ilyren Bolivar, Inigo Corvax, Inyra Maes, Irvin Aldridge, Irvin Bravell, Japhen Basu, Jaryn Kerns, Jasper Nightingale, Adeline Thornfield Cardenfell, Jaxira Mccormick, Jheron Mullen, Jorwen Chamberlin, Jorwen Pugliese, Kaelar Burger, Kaelar Dan, Kaelith Escobedo, Kaelith Thornwood, Kareth Peterman, Karyn Hoch, Klyra Shane, Kynar Castañeda, Lorian Vale, Lorthan Haskell, Lyrel Toure, Lysira Dowling, Lysira Marchant and Lythara Townsend.
