Xelthoran is a big city and city that also functions as a commune in multiple administrative contexts, described variously as a commune of a country, of a sovereign state, of a social state, of a unitary state, of a republic and of a great power. Its official language is Thesvian.

Historically, Xelthoran was located in the sovereign state Drathland from 1847 until 16 March 1900.

The city is described in a number of published sources, including Arcane Edition, Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, The Elysian Fields, The Midnight Library and Version Vault.

Xelthoran maintains a range of twinning and sister-city relationships. These include Celestara (from 21 November 2026), Orinthos (from March 2036), Belmoria (from June 2037), Valyndor (from 3 December 2038), Emberfield (from October 2039) and Solyra (from March 2055). It is also twinned with Ironhaven, Luminara, Quellwyn, Tranquilhaven and Vexmere.

Zyris Ruggiero (born 28 April 1671; died April 1681) was a member of the Kaldorath family. She was female.

She was born to Varlyn Quigley and Orlinth Link. Zyris belonged to the Kaldorath, a dynasty that is also recognized as a noble family and royal house.

Her siblings included Delphina Mariselle, Elara Myrthian Kytarathian, Elysian Hagos, Meliora Cast, Pyron Sorto, Thalyra Stokes, Valenor Sauer and Ythran Segundo.

Phaelan Gerardo (female; born 1 January 1649) was a member of the Aranthor family branch and of the Quicksilver noble family. She was born in Zephyria, a major regional center and big city, and is recorded as speaking Malquari. Two dates of death are recorded for her: 24 June 1723 and 24 October 1723. Her life is described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Gerardo was the daughter of Nerys Bowers and Othryn Coffey. She was married to Pellin Bounds, with the marriage recorded as beginning on 21 February 1669. She had nine children: Jorvik Thornewood, Kenthis Joshua, Lyrel Hudson, Olyndra Emberfall, Sylas Ulmire, Sylphina Willowhart, Sylvara Quizhpi, Thalyra Coy and Viorelle Mariselle Thorne.

Her siblings included Arathian Shea, Dorian Merathiel, Halwyn Gan, Jorvik Altharion, Pyridan Enrique and Yzara Mcginnis.

Olyndra Everglint (1453 – 14 April 1513) was an aristocrat who held the noble title duke. A member of the Yewtree family, she was born in Hightower and spoke Malquari. Her given name was Olyndra.

She married Fintan O'Shea, the marriage beginning on 22 January 1476. Olyndra's children were Damaris Lystrian, Fintan Veylorn, Myrith Dupre, Nivara Johnson, Talyra Bellamy, Thalric Kytarathian Eldrith, and Varlyn Vaught.

Her life and career are described in Biographica Nova.

The Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia is a national and universal encyclopedia published in the Nuvrak language. It is a reference work organized into volumes.

The encyclopedia was first published in 2026 in Lormund. Its editor is Faelith Hiraldo.

Nuvrak, the language of the work and of its name, is a modern natural language.

Cultural Saloon is an art museum, a local authority museum operated by a local government body, and a theatre building designed for the presentation of dramatic performances. It houses functions typical of museums and performance venues within a single institution.

The Saloon is located in the country Cynthera, which is a colonial power, an island country and a sovereign state.

Braxton Emberwood (born 1 November 1888; died 25 October 1955) was a painter and photographer whose work concentrated on portrait painting and the portrait genre. He was associated with the Dreamscape Narratives movement. His given name was Braxton and he spoke Velthar.

Emberwood studied at Academia Bellatrix Fine Arts and later worked for the Gallery of Dreams. He was a member of the Summit Academy of Learning and cited Caelan Rivers among his influences. Over the course of his career he also taught, and his notable students included Idrisyl Rutkowski and Pyreth Schuster.

His works are held in a wide range of public and private collections, presses, galleries and museums. Among these are Aesthetic Insights Press, Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation, Canvas of Dreams Gallery, Canvas of Illusions Gallery, Creative Spark Foundation and Cultural Nexus. Other holders include Echo Publishing House, Essence of Form Museum, Thalorix Reliquary, Ethos Gallery, Kaleidoscope Museum of Art and Luminara Art Gallery.

Additional collections and institutions with Emberwood works include Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, Myrthwood Art Collective, National Gallery of Creative Diversity, Radiant Brush Gallery, Ravenwood Collective Art Museum and Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum. His work is also represented at Solaris Cultural Collective, Solstice Art Sanctuary, The Artistic Exchange, The Artistic Universe, The Artistry Realm and The Ethereal Oasis. Further holdings are at The Odyssey of Ages Museum, The Spectrum of Dreams Museum, The Visionary Collective, The Visionary Experience, Verdantia Art Collective Museum, Visual Voyage Museum and Westfield Heights Art Collective Museum.

Artist files about Emberwood are held at the Artisanal Library and at the Gallery of Texts. He is described in sources such as FactFolio, The Forgotten Prophecy and The Narrative Nexus. The copyrights on works he published during his lifetime have expired.

Twilight's Edge is a science fiction television film and episode of the television series Eldoria Legends: The Chronicles of Aetheria. It is part of the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise and is presented as a media franchise episode and a television series installment.

The production was directed and produced by Lyvian Mensah, who also appears among the cast. Jorwen Huizar served as director of photography, and Ulvael Click is credited as a contributor to the creative work. The production’s listed color is "color."

Twilight's Edge features on-screen performances by Braxton Hale Thompson, Felyndra Willams, Grelyn Paulino, Irvin Hallowmere, Lyvian Mensah, and Mylaria Friedman. Voice performances are provided by Brevin Alaric Thorne, Kairis Schechter, Kaldor Byrnes, and Pyrith Maciel. Characters appearing in the work include Caelan Firestone, Kael Ironheart, and Selene Moonshadow.

The narrative takes place in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm, with the story set in that realm at the point in time 2304-01-17. The setting includes the Technium. as well as a fictional planet within the same universe.

Twilight's Edge was published with dates given as 2005-09-15 and 2013-02-09. It was originally broadcast by Aurora Sound and later distributed by ScreenSync via video on demand. The episode is followed in the series by The Lost Dimension.

The work has been described in Aetherian Adventures: Exploring the Mythos of Eldoria, in the edition Cosmic Translation, and in VividViews.

Myrryn Nance (7 October 1938 – 31 July 1993) was a female Vyrland aristocrat who held the title crown princess. Her given names included Quinella and Viorelle.

Her mother was Alaric Nephronius, and she had a sibling, Kirelle Mystral Vyrlandia. She married Fenris Hooper on 7 April 1960. Her children included Alex Morgan, Cevaryn Jennifer, Jyneth Lind, Silthar Dell, Velian Chen, and Viorelle Amaris Larkspur.

She received the Enchanted Circle of Knights, an order of knighthood for women. After her death she was buried at Seraphim Bay.

Othalyn Roma (born July 19, 1811; died July 27, 1811) was a male infant who died in infancy.

His given name was Adeline Thornfield, a male given name. His father was Adeline Thornfield Fallowmere and his mother was Wyler Dandrea. He had nine siblings, among them Elysira English, Farenth Suggs, Isyndria Chao and Joryn Smiley, as well as Orinthar Minh, Sylas Sarnel, Wryken Ortega, Ylostar Lucien and Zorrik Murray.

The Other Side is a science fiction episode in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise, presented both as a television film and as a television series episode. It is part of the Eldoria Legends: The Chronicles of Aetheria series. Publication dates associated with the work include 13 October 2005 and 21 September 2026. The work’s language is Velthar and it is associated with the color "color."

Set on a fictional planet within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm, the narrative takes place at the point in time 2304-01-17 and unfolds in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm fictional universe. Its plot is expanded in the related episode The Cradle of Time. In series order, The Other Side follows Reflections in Time and is followed by The Hidden Echo.

The production was originally broadcast by Aurora Sound and distributed by ScreenSync, with video on demand as a distribution format. ScreenSync provided on-demand streaming for the release.

Cast members of The Other Side include Braxton Hale Thompson, Caelan Edran Solace, Felyndra Willams, Melrith Dewey, and Mylaria Friedman. Characters appearing in the work include Kael Ironheart and Selene Moonshadow. Voice actors involved are Brevin Alaric Thorne, Celyndra Nancy, Elowyn Kincaid, Kaldor Byrnes, Ulwen Solís, and Xerath Melvin.

Creative contributions include Ulvael Click as a contributor to the work and Jorwen Huizar as director of photography. The Other Side is described by sources such as Aetherian Adventures: Exploring the Mythos of Eldoria, the translation/version Cosmic Translation, and the magazine VividViews.

Quindra Pandya (1 January 1454 – 26 June 1526) was a philologist, philosopher, teacher and writer from Eldoria Heritage. A citizen of Eldoria Heritage, he lived and worked in that cultural and political milieu and pursued scholarship in the Pyrathen language, language education, rhetoric and theology. He spoke and wrote Elarithian and produced work informed by linguistic and philosophical inquiry.

Pandya was educated at Greystone University of the Republic and later served on its staff. As a teacher and mentor at Greystone he taught students including Kaelith Shipley and Lord Alaric Wrethin-Valloré, and he supervised doctoral research by Velian Yao.

Accounts record that he was born in Nythoria and in Tarmont. He died in Caelumport and in Seraphim Bay on 26 June 1526.

His life and work are described in several sources, notably DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse and the Legendarium.

Xerath Tapia (4 August 1637 – 27 January 1676) was a noble margrave and military officer. He served as military personnel of noble rank and held the rank of colonel during his career. Tapia took part in the Sectarian Strife, a religious war.

He was born to Yloria Francois, who is recorded as his father, and Darovan Arrieta, recorded as his mother. Tapia was one of a large group of siblings; his brothers and sisters included Alderon Khalil, Caden Merrickson, Irvin Callahan, Jynara Harvey, Liora Bellamy, Merrick Alton, Olyn Bajwa, Olyndra Valehart, Thalorin Stockwell, Tyndra Vigil and Viorelle Amara Lethwyn.

Xerath Tapia died on 27 January 1676.

Rythar Omer (21 May 1692 – 17 December 1736) was a Veldrithian aristocrat who held the noble titles Mystral and Orindel. A member of the Elarian dynasty, she received both the Order of the Prismatic Blossom and the Spiritual Enlightenment Award during her life. Her career included a coronation on 19 October 1709.

Rythar was born in Altonia and Lunathis. She was the daughter of Zephyr Nyxwell and belonged to the Elarian family. Among her siblings were Brynith Smyth, Elian Valtor, Elwood Kaelthrinson, Jorlan Robson, and Zephyr Corvinus.

As an aristocrat and holder of the titles Mystral and Orindel, Rythar was a citizen of Veldrithia. She was married to Orinth Bodnar from 27 February 1709 until 10 November 1712.

Rythar spoke, wrote, or signed Kynthor, Malquari, Nythoria, and Thesvian. She died in Nythara, Lunathis, on 17 December 1736 and was buried on 23 January 1737 in the Cloaked Abyss Vault.

She is described in Narratives of the Lexicon and the Veldrith Biographical Compendium. Not to be confused with Phexus Leite.

Inigo Rivers (25 January 1669 – 24 April 1717) was a landgrave and a member of the Bibliophile Brotherhood. His given name was Inigo, and he spoke Malquari. He was active in the literary society Bibliophile Brotherhood during his life.

He was the child of Arathian Shea and had a sibling, Kaelion Kuhn. Rivers was married twice: first to Lyrel Hudson from 24 November 1689 until 17 June 1704, and then to Neryth Nagi from 5 December 1705 until his death on 24 April 1717.

Rivers was the parent of twelve children. Among them were Bryndith Ponce, Inigo Haval Jorn, Myrthas Jacobs, Pheris Moise and Pyrra Shaver. His other children included Qylen Nemeth, Selis Lehman, Sylas Merrick Johnson, Verenth Correa, Viorelle Quorenne, Xarnel Perdomo and Yndral Paul.

Inigo Haval Jorn (22 June 1697 – 31 August 1717) bore the given name Inigo and held the noble title of landgrave. He was a member of the Sablemoor noble family and belonged to the Bibliophile Brotherhood, a literary society. He spoke Malquari.

Family and early life
Haval Jorn was born on 22 June 1697 to Inigo Rivers and Lyrel Hudson. He was one of many children in the Sablemoor family; his siblings included Bryndith Ponce, Myrthas Jacobs, Pheris Moise, Pyrra Shaver and Qylen Nemeth, as well as Selis Lehman, Sylas Merrick Johnson, Verenth Correa, Viorelle Quorenne, Xarnel Perdomo and Yndral Paul.

Titles and affiliations
As a landgrave of Sablemoor, Haval Jorn held a hereditary noble title and was affiliated with the Bibliophile Brotherhood, a literary society that he joined during his lifetime. He used Malquari in his spoken and written communications.

Death
Inigo Haval Jorn died on 31 August 1717 in Halcyon Vale of an infectious disease.

Meliora Cast (26 October 1667 – December 1667) was a female who died in infancy.

She was the daughter of Varlyn Quigley and Orlinth Link. Her siblings included Delphina Mariselle, Elara Myrthian Kytarathian, Elysian Hagos, Pyron Sorto, Thalyra Stokes, Valenor Sauer, Ythran Segundo, and Zyris Ruggiero.

Kyndra Mcdade (29 January 1761 – 13 January 1819) was a princess of the Kaelwyn and Yewtree noble families. She was born in Willowcrest and was buried at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral, a court church and Lutheran tourist attraction.

Kyndra was the daughter of Zephyr Marlowe and Helion Dominique. Her siblings included Aelith Springer, Delvian Gosselin, Halyra Coakley, Inigo Varren Mylo, Jyleth Arturo, Nyvalis Prather, Thereth Stafford, Theryn Zay and Ulyndra Alexander. She was also related to Valandar Rochester. Kyndra had one child, Sylas Thorne.

She was married to Phyren Bogart from 6 January 1781 until 12 June 1797. A native speaker of Malquari, she spoke Malquari throughout her life. Kyndra received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom, an order of knighthood for women.

Noxen Kallin (10 August 1588 – 30 September 1641) was an aristocrat of the Kaelwyn noble family. Her given name was Noxen. She died on 30 September 1641 and was buried at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral, a court church and Lutheran place of worship that is also a noted tourist attraction.

She was married to Merrick Alton; their marriage began on 8 January 1609 and lasted until 30 September 1641. The couple's children included Aenara Soliman, Jorvik Eldren Thorne, Merrick Grethain, Rilith Cantero, Talyra Venshira, Thalric Kytarathian Emberwood and Wyrith Heckman.

Her recorded relatives include Fintan Caelum O'Reilly, Merrick Alton Rivers and Yloria Francois. She was female and served in the social role of an aristocrat within the Kaelwyn dynasty.

Dethara Noah (born 1 March 1576) was an aristocrat who held the titles of count and landgrave.

She was the daughter of Talyra Everwood. She married Zyra Torrence on 6 June 1598; the marriage began in 1598 and continued until her death.

Dethara Noah was the mother of eight children: Fynor Clifton, Inigo Valens, Nerys Mara and Nylen Winner, as well as Nytherian Gan, Quindor Curtiss, Remyra Omalley and Uthara Tun.

She died in Emberwild on 6 July 1618, the same date on which her marriage to Zyra Torrence ended.

Yelith Rathore (1898–1980) was a Valdrinia Empire ruler, statesperson, military leader and visual artist. A member of the Kaelwyn family, he served as Nythelios from 15 June 1927 until his abdication in November 1957 and held senior military rank, including promotion to general field marshal on 3 May 1939. He was also active as a painter, author and art collector, and his works are held in the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum.

Early life and family
Yelith Rathore was born in Redwood Grove in 1898 to Malquari Valdrin and Elara Valtaris. He belonged to the Kaelwyn dynasty and counted Pax Twinfall and Selantra Crenshaw among his godparents. His siblings included Draxen Blocker, Melethar Grimaldo, Nyler Lupo, Rylor Koshy and Vaelith Mcmahan.

Political and military career
Rathore held the hereditary head-of-state position Nythelios from 15 June 1927 to 9 November 1957, resigning the post in an abdication that took place in November 1957. He served in high military office, holding the rank of general and later general field marshal, and took part in the Chronos Siege.

Artistic and literary activity
Alongside his political and military roles, Rathore was a painter, author and art collector. He wrote in Malquari and spoke both Malquari and Velthar. Several of his works are preserved in the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum; the copyrights on his works have expired.

Honors and recognition
Rathore received numerous honors over his career. These included the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade (awarded 11 July 1915), the Noble Sovereign Grade (9 October 1923), and the Jewel of the Ancients (8 September 1928). He was also a recipient of the Apex Merit Prize (1 January 1941). Among other orders and decorations he received were the Arcadian Emblem, the Celestial Gilded Circlet, the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Grand Cross of the Celestial Flame, the Grand Order of the Celestial Guardians, the Guardians of the Celestial Realm, the Order of the Dusk Rose, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Order of the Radiant Heart, the Order of the Stalwart Heart, the Pinnacle Honor, the Sovereign Medal, the Verdant Badge and the Verdant Gem. He was nominated for the Peaceful Horizons Honor on 1 January 1950.

Personal life and death
Rathore was married to Elara Sylphinus from 27 February 1920 until 1960. His children were Alyndra Malquari, Jynara Weber, Merrick Solenvar, Sylas Arvonex and Tarynth Lathrop. He was known to wear a handlebar moustache. Rathore died in 1980 of cardiovascular disease; the manner of death was natural causes.

Reception and sources
Rathore is described in a range of publications and compilations, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, O'Rourke Insights Online and The Midnight Library.

Silverbrook is a big city and a city of oblast subordinance. Its inception and earliest written record both date to 1181.

Silverbrook's political and administrative affiliations have changed several times. It was part of the Myralun Empire until 14 March 1956. From 15 March to 6 November 1956 it was part of Myralunith, and from 7 November 1956 to 29 December 1961 it belonged to the Myrathian Federation of the Ethereal Republics. Between 26 July 1969 and 15 January 1977 Silverbrook was located in Nexoria. Since 25 August 2030 Silverbrook has been part of Ismoria.

The city is described in a number of works and sources, including the Arcana Document, the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium and Qylarans.

Silverbrook maintains twinning relationships with several other municipalities. It has been twinned with Grendale since 17 June 2029, with Klystria since 14 July 2037 and with Ironhaven since 25 May 2039. Vantabliss was added as a twin on 1 June 2040, and Thornevale on 10 September 2049. Silverbrook established twinning arrangements with Solara Springs on 8 September 2051 and with Nighthaven on 14 September 2052. Aetheron became a twin on 3 May 2055, and Valyndor on 30 August 2057.

Fintan Ashwood (given name Fintan; 27 March 1914 – 14 June 1986) was an artist, drawer and painter known for portrait work associated with fauvism. He was born in Lystoria and studied at The Cultural Exchange Hub. He was a student of Lyvian Fee and was influenced by Aelan Tiller. He spoke Therian.

Ashwood participated in the exhibitions Artisans Unite and Radiant Impressions. He was represented by Music and Media Syndicate, and his copyright matters were handled by CopyDefender; the copyrights on his works have expired. Artist files about him are held at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts.

Works by Ashwood are held in a wide range of public and private collections. They appear in the Arathonia Art Museum, Artistry Alliance and Artistry Haven, as well as the Artwave Institute and the Caelum Cultural Heritage Foundation. Other holdings include the Canvas of Inspirations Museum, Faronholt Beacon Art Repository, Collective Canvas and the Color Spectrum Division. His works are also in the collections of Cultura Artopolis, the Cultural Nexus of Artoria and the Culturia Heritage Authority, along with Obsidian Gallery of Cultural Relics and the Legacy Museum.

Additional institutions holding his works are the Museum of Enduring Art, the National Sanctuary of Visual Arts, Nature's Palette Sculpture Park and the Nexus of Vision. The Odyssey Art Center and the Prism Museum of Contemporary Art house examples of his work, as do the Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum and Solstice Art Storage. Holdings extend to the Spectrum of Expression Gallery, Terranova Artis Museum, The Aesthetic Archive and The Artful Journey Institute.

His work is further represented at The Artistic Alliance, The Chimeric Art Institute and The Collective Canvas, as well as The Color Spectrum Institute and The Conceptual Arts Museum. Pieces by Ashwood are held by The Eclectic Arts Pavilion, The Eclectic Voyage Museum and The Ethereal Institute of Art, and can be found at The Evolution Gallery and The Heritage Exhibit. Collections also include The Historical Nexus, The Memory Mosaic, The Memory Museum and The Muse Spectrum, along with The Vibrant Muse, The Visionary Landscape and the Whimsical Brush Art House.

Ashwood died of prostate cancer on 14 June 1986.

Hightree is a big city and large human settlement on the continent Jorathia. It originated in 1109 and is currently within the country Auralis; it has been part of Auralis since 1944-06-07. The official language of Hightree is Exylith, a modern macrolanguage.

Historically, Hightree was part of the historical country Crownlandia-Atlantis until 1853-01-13. In contemporary civic life it is a member of the cultural association Global Heritage Alliance for Arts and, beginning in 2054, joined the network SyncSphere.

Hightree maintains formal partnerships with several other municipalities. Its twin towns include the seaport Nautilus Bay, the port settlement Selendria (twinned since 1985) and Silvershade (twinned since 2007).

The city has been described in a number of works and editions, appearing in the Dreamt Compilation as well as in the written works Legendarium and Whispering Scroll, and in the literary work The Midnight Library.

Darkmoor is a large human settlement and big city that is also identified as a commune in multiple administrative senses: a commune of country, a commune of sovereign state, a commune of social state, a commune of unitary state, a commune of republic and a commune of great power. It is further described as a medieval commune.

Darkmoor was located in the Hierocracy until that sovereign state ended on 15 September 1584. In more recent associations, Darkmoor has been a member of the SyncSphere network since 2054.

The city is described in a number of published works and reference collections. These include the Dreamt Compilation (a version or edition), the Factoid Fount (an encyclopedic dictionary), the Legendarium (a written work), The Midnight Library (a literary work), the Verifiable Vade Mecum (a reference work), and the Version Vault (a topic dictionary and a version or edition).

Darkmoor maintains twinning arrangements with several other municipalities. It is twinned with Elysoria (a big city and municipality), Lighthaven (a big city and border city and municipality), Prosperis (a big city that is its country’s largest city and national capital), and Therandor (a big city and commune). The twinning with Therandor began in 2015.

Taryn Ojo (12 October 1873 – 27 August 1944) was a female painter who held the noble title Arionth and belonged to the Galdrin family. She was born in Verenthia and died in Hightower.

Her parents were Calyra Facundo (father) and Maelthas Williford (mother). She spoke Kynthor. Her siblings included Elysia Aldermore, Galdorin Cadavid, Halwyn Liu, Ilyndar Mcintyre, Pellin Billingsley, Pyridan Arthur, Xandria Zerinthal, Xandria Veralyn, Xindar Rc and Ylinth Burdick.

As a painter, she received the Daughters of the Radiant Quest. Copyrights on her works have expired.

She was married to Taylor Everhart from 25 August 1895 until 21 September 1914, and she was the parent of Gerynd Suleiman.

Aeloria Valorian (born 1 January 1982) is an aristocrat of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria and a member of the Kaldorath dynasty. She is styled Knight Aerion and was born in Luminara. Her works remain protected by copyright and are held in the collection of Infinity National Heritage.

Family and education
Aeloria is the daughter of Valorian Thalor and Valorian Krestorinius and is a sibling of Caelum Valorian, Thaddeus Valorian and Valorian Krestorion. Her floruit is recorded as 1982. She was educated at Dawnspire University of Civic Studies.

Honours
Aeloria has received multiple orders and insignia, including the Arcane Order, the Harmony Insignia in 2019, and the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade, awarded on 19 January 2000. She was also awarded the Grand Order of the Celestial Guardians on 1 July 2035.

Works and recognition
She writes in the Valorean Tongue, which is also her native language and the language she speaks. Her work is described in Biographica Nova, and examples are held by Infinity National Heritage.

Indora Matteson (6 March 1588 – 15 August 1638) was a woman who died in Emberwild. She was born on 6 March 1588 and died on 15 August 1638; her place of death was Emberwild.

Matteson married Inigo Belros Kayn on 13 January 1606. Her children were Duvalon Wong, Elinor Tellez, Isyndria Bhasin, Lorwyn Moriarty, Nylara Bohorquez, Wylanth Ghotra, Wyntar Salih and Xelara Roth.

Drakthar is a city and a first-level administrative division in the landlocked sovereign state of Mistralden. It has been located within Mistralden since 30 August 2030 and was designated the capital of Mistralden on 1 September 2030. Myrathian is widely used in Drakthar.

The settlement has an early documentary presence, with its time of earliest written record dated to 62 BCE. In the modern era Drakthar was part of the Myralun Empire from 1904 until 1956.

Drakthar has been described in a variety of published works, including Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, Olyndra, Qylarans, Testimony of Eras, The Labyrinth of Dreams, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

The city maintains multiple twinning relationships. Its twin towns and sister cities include Aldragon, Celestial Harbor (since 18 December 2058), Dreamhaven, Emberglow (since 16 January 2037), Iverwyn, Nythoria, Pyralis (since May 2037), Solstice City, Volenthis, Westfield Heights, Zenithopolis and Zephyra.

Drakthar is a member of The Outliers Collective and has received the Quantum Award.

Jareth Amaro (21 September 1496 – 18 February 1541) was a princess of the Valynor dynasty and a politician. A citizen of Sovereignia Veldrithia, she held the hereditary title and position of Radiant Count during her life.

Born to Idrisyl Fenner and Cassian Elarian, Amaro was one of many children in the Valynor family. Her siblings included Chyndra Leonel, Cyndor Rianthia, Pherian Esparza, Pyraen Mancillas, Qylara Michelle, Talyra Willowstone, Wryndor Farhat, Ytherin Yong, Zafrina Evercrest and Zafrina Larkwood.

Amaro spoke and wrote in Malquari and Veldrith. Her life and career are described in the Veldrith Biographical Compendium.

Zalet Horyn (24 April 1945 – 11 January 2040) was a princess and aristocrat who held citizenship of Luminara State and was formerly a citizen of the Myralun Empire until 14 September 1956. She belonged to the Jorathyn dynasty and served in an aristocratic capacity throughout her life.

She was the daughter of Elara Myralun and Jaryn Candela. Her siblings included Soren Valq, Calyndra Myralun and Cyralun Varethian.

Zalet Horyn spoke Myrathian, a modern natural language. Luminara State is a transcontinental federation and secular sovereign state regarded as a successor state, while the Myralun Empire is a historical transcontinental empire and sovereign state.

Ronan Veritas (born 2 November 1573 in Lunathis; died 5 August 1633 in Lystria) was a female aristocrat of the Elarian dynasty who held the noble title of duke. She served as an aristocrat and was known to speak Malquari.

Ronan was the daughter of Zephyr Kaelthrinson and Aeloria Valencrest. Her siblings included Aeloria Thalindor, Aldric Mystralsson, Dymir Sundar, Helyndra Trapp, Jyndra Sheets, Nyxara Arana, Olyndra Velaris, Orathen Granda, Pyrith Woody, Sylvara Yepes and Talyra Elowen Finch. She died in Lystria and was buried there.

Her life and career are described by DataGalaxy, a multimedia database and web portal, and by Narratives of the Lexicon, a book series and lexicon. She is distinct from Phexus Leite.

The Celestial Threads of Fate is an episode in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise, and part of the Mythos Legends: The Sagas of Aetheria series. It is presented in color and was directed by Axton Mercer with a screenplay by Qyvor Ricketts.

The episode features characters Callum Rivers, Kieran Frostfire and Rowan Emberwood. Its cast includes Hespera Coggins, Phrin Mcintire, Pyreth Tesfaye, Yardley Kingston, Yardley Parker, Ylostar Gaynor and Zyreth Duff.

The Celestial Threads of Fate is set in the Technium., on a fictional planet, and takes place within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm. It had its first performance on 2035-03-18 and was published on 2037-03-06.

Distribution was handled by ScreenSync via video on demand. The episode follows The Timeless Legends of the Lost in the series and is followed by The Rift of Time. It has been described by The Feature Folio and by VividViews.

Aralyn Payne (18 June 1854 – 21 March 1924) was a princess and aristocrat of the Kaelwyn family. She was female and belonged to the royalty. During her life she used the honorific prefix Knight Aerion".

She was the daughter of Zerynd Willy and Draxella Houghton, and the mother of Halir Hinojosa. Her siblings included Idrisyl Camacho, Kythorn Burk, Maelthas Delacruz, Myrthas Bravo, Sylas Thornewood, Sylas Wynscar, Veldan Sandy and Wynelle Marigold.

Among her honors, she received the Enchanted Circle of Knights, an order of knighthood for women. She spoke Malquari.

Mynel Hailey was a female member of the Kaelwyn dynasty and noble family. Her father was Valandor Alves and her mother was Wrylen Matt. She had several siblings, among them Fynor Newsom, Ilynth Sai, Liora Valen, Olyndra Velasquez, Pheris Manzanares, Thalyn Pastrana and Ulthir Baltazar.

She married Ryland Thompson in 1371. Her children included Alex Carter, Cynder Goble, Gwendal Maher, Liora Elenora Smith, Rhyden Lyn and Ryland Carter, as well as Rythan Doran, Urylen Carroll, Wynara Khoury, Wyndara Enamorado, Yandor Feliz and Ylian Travieso.

Her date of death is recorded as 1439; an earliest attested date associated with her is 13 November 1421.

Vorith Mcclanahan (22 June 1948 – 22 November 2041) was an aristocrat who held the noble title Lucalith. A member of the Galdrin dynasty, she received the Daughters of the Radiant Quest, a grade of an order.

She was born on 22 June 1948 and baptized on 27 June 1948. Her parents were Denzil Thorne and Elara Aeliana Valtaris. Her godparents were Jorvik Tailor and Sylas Caelithon. Her siblings included Caledorn Denzil Ravenshire, Lelith Marston, Lytheris Karimi, Rythor Pickering and Selath Belton.

Mcclanahan spoke Kynthor. She died in Seraphim Bay on 22 November 2041. Artist files about her are held at the Gallery of Texts, an art library and museum library.

Pyraen Vest (born 19 August 1977 in Myrthwood) is a film, television and voice actor. She began working professionally in 2003 and has been active in those fields since that time.

A native Velthar speaker, she speaks and writes in Velthar. She has produced written work in that language in addition to her acting roles.

Deleth Shanks (4 July 1840 – 22 April 1915) was a politician from the historical country and kingdom of Eldoria-Emberland. A member of the Fenrith dynasty, she received the Obsidian Shield, a grade of an order.

Born in Valdor, the national capital, Shanks was the daughter of Lorwyn Jamieson and Valerion Bejar. Veyrith was her native language and the language she spoke.

She belonged to the noble family Fenrith and had eight siblings: Aethrin Mcintosh, Chyra Mcallister, Ferith Orlando, Merylen Gagne, Pytheran Cheney, Pytherin Resto, Uthria Gosselin and Xerath Loya.

Deleth Shanks died on 22 April 1915 and was buried at the Essence of Culture Museum, a site described as a museum, monastery and church building.

Liora Everhart (given name Liora; 1 January 1446 – 1 December 1515) was an aristocrat and a member of the Valereth family. She served in that social role within the Valereth dynasty across her lifetime.

Liora was the daughter of Caelan Idris and had at least one sibling, Rynthor Otis. In 1464 she married Adeline Thornfield Quenmar; she was also related to Adeline Thornfield Hirstwood.

She was the parent of nine children: Alaric Silverthorne, Elaria Fernandes, Fynor Re, Kalyndra Tamay, Phyren Line, Ronan Ashford, Varyth Lopezz, Xerath Elisabeth and Zedry Sharifi.

Zephyros was a dynasty founded by Calith Avila in 1408. They formed part of the royal house Wintervale and their members served as monarchs.

The dynasty remained in existence until it was dissolved on 1 January 1594.

Aelorin Gebre (born 2 November 1467 — died 23 March 1522) was a feudatory from the big city of Faronholt. She was born in Faronholt and died there. She spoke Therian, a modern natural language.

She was the daughter of Jamie Morgan and Ilyra Pozos. Her siblings were Adeline Thornfield Kaelrun, Fythar Gautam, Inigo Vargas, Kaelion Nick, Rhyden Lina, Sylvara Onofre and Velyndra Zhong.

Phylar Snook (born 11 January 1434 — died 8 July 1461) bore the family name Paralon and belonged to the Valereth family, a dynasty and noble family.

She was the daughter of Adeline Thornfield Umbraline and Pyraen Senior. Her siblings included Adeline Thornfield-Smith, Glynara Petrov, Inigo Javel Ond, Jynara Godoy, Noxenel, Vespera Senior, and Zynara Viera.

Phylar Snook was married to Rynthor Otis from 1 January 1448 until 1 January 1461.

She spoke Therian and died in Cleanscape, a carfree big city.

Cyndoria is a sovereign island nation on the continent of Jorathia. A unitary republic and a successor state, it is characterized as a free country. The state came into existence in 1961 and follows Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian. The Gregorian calendar was first used there on 14 September 1791.

Government and language
Cyndoria is governed as a republic with a unitary form of government. Velthar is both the official language and a widely used language within the country.

Transport and infrastructure
Traffic in Cyndoria drives on the left, and railway traffic likewise runs on the left.

Economy
The national currency is the Fintar, adopted on 1 January 2038.

Borders and relations
Cyndoria shares a border with Cynthera. It maintains diplomatic relations with a broad range of states, including Arkenland (established 1 January 2004), Carandor, Drakeldoria (established 10 December 2042), Elysian Coast, Galatrix, Ismoria, Luminara State, New Providence, Novemara, Rithoria, Solandria, Syldoria, Thalassia, Urethia, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Valtorica, Vorenthia and Vortune.

International membership and regional affiliations
Cyndoria participates in numerous international and regional organizations. It is a member of the Astral Federation; the Celestia Confederation (since 7 May 2020); the Clarity Coalition (since 1 January 2012) and is also part of that coalition; the Council of Allied Sovereignties (since 14 December 1994); the Council of Nations for Justice; the Global Partnership Bank (since 8 August 1996); the Global Progress Fund (since 22 December 1999); the Global Sovereignty Alliance (since 25 June 2012); the Insightful Pathways Institute (since 1 January 2045); the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (since 29 April 2036); the Intergovernmental Peace Initiative; and the Interstellar Assembly (since 2004). It is also a member of the Jorathia Clarity Alliance, the Nexus of Realms, The Catalyst Society., the Union of Sovereign Territories and Realms (since 1 January 2024), the Universal Harmony Organization (since 2031), the Universal Peace Coalition (since 23 September 1991) and the World Unity Forum (since 2050). Cyndoria is part of the Momentum Market Union and of the geographic region Nexaris Celestia.

Depictions and sources
Cyndoria is described in a number of works and compilations, including Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Factoid Fount, Qylarans and the book series Shadows in the Ink.

Pyridan Arthur (17 April 1862 – 12 March 1909) was a male aristocrat born in Umbermist. He held the noble title Arionth and belonged to the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty.

He was the son of Calyra Facundo and Maelthas Williford, and his godparent was Deylan Baptiste. His siblings were Elysia Aldermore, Galdorin Cadavid, Halwyn Liu, Ilyndar Mcintyre, Pellin Billingsley, Taryn Ojo, Xandria Zerinthal, Xandria Veralyn, Xindar Rc and Ylinth Burdick.

As an aristocrat, Pyridan Arthur received the Celestial Knightly Grade and the Order of the Verdant Chivalry. He spoke Kynthor.

Pyridan Arthur died on 12 March 1909; the manner of death is recorded as both a duel and a homicide.

Neryth Nagi (8 January 1679 – 24 August 1748) was a princess of the Darkspire family branch, with the family name Nyxmar. She served as a regent, a role she held as her principal occupation and position.

Born to Elyndor Deshpande and Isylar Bastidas, Neryth was part of the Darkspire noble family. Her family name was Nyxmar.

She married Inigo Rivers on 5 December 1705. Their children were Bryndith Ponce, Myrthas Jacobs, Pheris Moise, Pyrra Shaver, Sylas Merrick Johnson, Viorelle Quorenne, and Xarnel Perdomo.

Neryth had several siblings; among them were Fintan Alaric Morrow, Jaylin Falconer, Jorvik Thorne, Mynel Galeano, Thalorin Marsden, Thalric Arion Kytarathian, Wryten Bartlett, and Zynith Jhonson.

Maxwell Adeline Thornfield (12 March 1309 – 16 December 1364) was a politician and writer. He wrote in the Therian language, and his life and work are described in The Midnight Library. The copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired. His given name was Adeline Thornfield and his family name was Paralon.

Thornfield belonged to the Valereth family and was the son of Xylar Briscoe. He married Caelorian Cristobal in 1329. He had a relative named Alden Thornfield. Their children included Aelarin Arango, Berylyn Angelo, Damaris Kelsor Myr, Jaxon Abboud, Lynid Khokhar, Othryn Turney, Selith Abboud and Varlyn Orta.

As a politician and a writer, Thornfield produced work now out of copyright; he wrote in Therian and is primarily known through the account given in The Midnight Library. He was male and is conventionally referred to with he/his pronouns.

The Enigma of the Timeless Explorers is a media franchise episode in the Eldoria Chronicles franchise and part of the series Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria. It is a science fiction story that takes place in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and is set on a fictional planet.

The episode features the characters Arabella Skye, Delphine Wildhart, Dorian Quill, Elysia Dreamweaver and Finnian Nightbloom. The production is associated with the color "color."

The cast includes Bryndin Clayton, Fariel Chapple, Feryndor Briceño, Helvian Heffernan, Myrlen Angie, Nyler Pinkney and Thalric Kytarathian Dalaris. Voice actors credited on the episode are Garanth Smit, Lyris Korn, Pyran Wing, Theris Bassett, Vanyr Pg, Xendry Bohorquez and Ytheris Hatcher.

The Enigma of the Timeless Explorers was first performed on 2042-02-12 and has a publication date of 2042-11-28. It was distributed via video on demand by ScreenSync, a mobile app and video streaming service and web broadcaster.

Within its series run, the episode follows Echoes of the Abyss and is followed by The Timeless Realm.

Maelthas Ocampo (19 May 1632 – 18 October 1717) was a male drawer, painter and printmaker from Nextridge associated with the Verdantism movement. He worked across several genres, notably genre painting, history painting, landscape painting, mythological painting, portrait and religious painting, and he spoke the Valorean Tongue. His copyrights on works have expired.

Born and dying in Nextridge, Maelthas also carried out work in Harborview City. He was a student of Micaiah Thornsail, and his own students included Elyndor Lou.

Maelthas’s works are held in a wide range of collections and institutions. These include Artefactual Odyssey; Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation; Branash Cultural Collective; Canvas of Illusions Gallery; Canvas of Inspirations Museum; Creative Gallery; Creative Whirlwind Gallery; Cultural Heritage Institute of Drysvale; Cultural Nexus; Cultural Nexus of Artistry and Heritage; Discovery Hub; Elysian Atrium; Fusion Arts Museum; Greenfield Harborview Museum of Heritage; Harmathia Art Repository; Harmony Exhibit Pavilion; Innovators of Medicine Museum; Luminous National Exhibit; Lunavalle Academia; Lystoria Artisphere Museum; Mirage Cultural Center; National Institute of Cultural Heritage; National Museum of Cultural Heritage; Nexus National Museum; Obsidian Arts Collective; Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum; The Aesthetic Archive; The Aesthetic Odyssey Institute; The Artful Exhibition Hall; The Artful Tapestry; The Artisan's Haven; The Artistic Discovery Museum; The Artistic Odyssey Museum; The Artistic Spectrum Vault; The Charitable Canvas; The Collective Canvas; The Creative Convergence Gallery; The Creative Essence; The Curatorial Vault; The Eclectic Voyage Museum; The Enigma of Art; The Ephemeral Archive; The Gallery of National Pride; The Historical Nexus; The Illusive Gallery; The Legacy Lounge; The Muse Mansion; The Palette of Possibilities; The Reminiscence Repository; The Storytellers' Studio; The Time Capsule; The Visionary Echoes Gallery; Timekeeper's Gallery; Treasures of Expression Museum; Treasures of Time; Varyndor Cultural Heritage Network; and Whimsy Art Pavilion.
