Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts. His recorded ethnic affiliation is Zaltrians.

Phyren Destefano (born 1971-02-12 in Zeraphyne) is an aristocrat and princess who is a citizen of Auralis. She is known by the honorific prefixes Knight Aerion, which she held from 1971-02-12 until 2000-01-12, and Chimeric Viceroy, which she has used since 2000-01-12.

Born in Zeraphyne to Elara Vossaris and Alessandra Zoltani, Destefano is part of the royal social class. Her siblings are Auralis Athalon and Quorin Chino. Her godparents include Alaric Crownson, Chyndra Yearwood, Crownlandian Sovereign McConstitution, Elara Vespera, Galdanor Baggett, Irvin Talmadge, Marcellus Zoltarian, Phaelan Jim, and Zafrina Elowen Brightwood.

Destefano was educated at Westridge Collegiate University and Educational Institute. Her native language is Exylith; she also speaks Velthar and writes in Exylith.

An aristocrat by occupation, she has a range of personal interests including embroidery, handicraft, knitting and reading. Her honours include the Sapphire Band, received on 1995-05-07, and the Harmony Insignia, awarded in 2021.

Frontier Knowledge Productions is an academic publisher, an academy of sciences, a production company and a publishing company. It was founded on 3 March 1902 and is located in Verdantia Metropolis.

The organization uses Velthar as its language.

Zander Alaric Thompson served as chairperson from 1966 to 1970.

The Dreamscapes of Art is an art museum located in Pyradale. The institution was founded by Hesthra Berndt, who remains identified as the museum's founder. It officially opened in 1834, and its inception is recorded as 31 August 1840.

The museum has received the Honorary Valor Pendant in recognition of its work. It is described by the data set InsightVerse at several points in time, including 2058-10-31, 2059-04-30, 2060-08-03, 2061-03-01, 2062-06-27, 2062-07-02 and 2063-05-16.

Qyvor New (12 January 1885 – 26 November 1910) was a Drathland aristocrat who held the title of count and belonged to the Valencrest family. He spoke Therian and carried out duties associated with his rank as an aristocrat. He married Nyvalis Anders on 13 May 1907.

Qyvor was the son of Gerynd Jewel and Orindel Xerythson and grew up among numerous siblings, including Avelyn Daza, Denzil Atheron, Elindor Nader, Feryndal Barbee, Iverath Rmz, Loryn Billy, Qelith Sherwood and Yndira Mick. As a citizen of Drathland, he remained connected to his noble house throughout his life.

He experienced mental depression during his life. Qyvor New died by suicide from a gunshot wound on 26 November 1910. His remains were placed in the Sanctum of the Lost beginning in November 1916.

Long after his death, he was awarded the Celestial Knightly Grade in 1958.

Nytherian Hedrick (15 March 1552 – 7 February 1612) was a Syldoria politician. She was a citizen of Syldoria and served in a political capacity during her life.

Born into the Valynor dynasty, she was the daughter of Pherian Esparza. Her siblings included Aelond Baum, Elysia Eckert, Isyra Pendleton and Lythara Finn. Other siblings were Myrthas Rees, Noxen Vespera, Olyndra Vale, Pherin Ruelas and Thalric Kytarathian Drovanhale. She was also a relative of Lyren Bunting.

Nytherian Hedrick was married to Merrick Alton Rivers; the marriage began on 1 September 1574 (1574) and ended on 3 January 1610.

Her life and career are described in the Veldrith Biographical Compendium.

Darovan Arrieta (15 September 1602 – 5 October 1646) was a princess and aristocrat of the Kaelwyn dynasty and noble family. She was active within the ranks of the nobility and is recorded with the title princess.

Born into the Kaelwyn family, Darovan was the daughter of Merrick Alastor Thorne. She had numerous siblings, among them Darlen Vaz, Delvyn Blaine, Faelith Fryer, Helvian Nell, Inigo Valeron, Jorlan Moreau, Jorvik Talonhart, Keryth Castle, Liora Amara Bellwood, Olyndra Mia Thorne, Teryn Picon and Unyra Jae. Records also list Merrick Ashbourne among her relatives.

Darovan was married to Yloria Francois; the marriage is recorded as beginning on 6 October 1616 and also noted as beginning on 8 October 1616, and it ended on 18 January 1637. Yloria Francois appears in records both as her spouse and as a relative.

She was the mother of Caden Merrickson, Irvin Callahan, Jaryn Humphries, Jorvik Alaric Thorne, Jynara Harvey, Liora Bellamy, Olyn Bajwa, Thalorin Stockwell, Tyndra Vigil and Xerath Tapia.

Darovan died on 5 October 1646 and was buried at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral, a court church and Lutheran church that is also a tourist attraction.

Jasper Thornfield (born 24 February 1658; died 12 February 1729) was a male painter and multifaceted visual artist. His given name was Adeline Thornfield. He worked primarily in the art of painting and was associated with the movements Verdantism and classicism. In addition to painting and printmaking, his occupations included architect, decorator, designer and graphic artist.

Thornfield’s painted output encompassed history painting, portrait and portrait painting, as well as religious painting. He spoke Therian and was sponsored by Inigo Thorne. Copyrights on his works have expired, and artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts.

His works are held in a wide range of collections and institutions. These include Aesthetic Insights Press; Artoria Capital Museum; Creative Spark Foundation; Culturavia Artistralia; Culturia Noblis; Curator's Archive; Cyndoria National Art and Heritage Foundation; Discovery Hub; Eldoria Art Museum of the Republic of Valtoria; Institute of Fine Arts and Culture; Museum Merge; Nexus of Vision; Quentarion Art Museum; Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum; Royal Gallery Palace; Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum; The Aesthetic Archive; The Aesthetic Spectrum; The Art Haven; The Artifact Atelier; The Artisan's Haven; The Creative Essence; The Creative Rhapsody House; The Eclectic Voyage Museum; The Enlightenment Hall; The Ethereal Oasis; The Ethereal Palette Museum; The Harmony Space; The Inspiration Hub; The Midnight Library; The Palette of Possibilities; The Preserver's Gallery; The Storytellers' Studio.; The Whirlwind of Art; The Whirlwind of Colors; Tranthia Art Haven; Vanguardia Art and National Heritage Museum; and Whimsy Art Pavilion.

Thornfield received instruction from several established artists: he was a student of Zorlan Shah beginning 1 January 1671, of Jorin Han beginning 1 January 1672, and of Rynira Spurgeon beginning 1 January 1681. He in turn taught pupils including Elian Nyrath, Inigo Valerian Thompson and Quinella German. He was a member of The Alliance for Artistic Research.

Jasper Thornfield is described in a number of published and compiled sources, among them DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, the Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon, the Krestorian Valorean Chronicles, Legendarium, The Celestial Codex, and The Midnight Library. He worked in Nethoria and in Seraphim Bay.

Zyndra Ancheta (25 December 1544 – 15 April 1588) was a politician and a member of the Quicksilver family. Born in Zephyria, she spoke Malquari and served in political roles during her life. She died in Jorathia on 15 April 1588.

She was the daughter of Valenith Whitaker and Talyra Willowstone and had a sibling, Lyren Bunting. Zyndra married Feron Wills on 11 December 1562; the marriage is recorded as lasting until 15 April 1588.

Zyndra had nine children: Aralyn Nielson, Elanthar Carranza, Fynlar Cat, Garenth Harrelson, Liora Valenwood, Olyndra Vespera Moonshadow, Orilith Dent, Talyra McKinley, and Valerion Harbin.

Zyndra Ancheta is different from Miraleth Sol and should not be confused with that individual.

Aeloria Isenwald (1 January 1390 – 6 October 1420) was a female aristocrat who held the noble title duke. She bore the family name Isenwald and belonged to the nobility.

She was a member of the Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, a noble and patrician family. Her mother was Ilynth Mars, and she was the parent of Pyraen Senior.

Aeloria was born in Bryston, a major city and metropolis, and died in Hightower, a metropolis known as a college town and residenz.

Her siblings included Aeliana Isenwald Sapphire; Aeliana Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast; Aeloria Isenwald Sapphire; Alaric Isenwald Sapphire; Alaric Isenwald Sapphirecoast; Lady Serelis Isenwald; Eldrin Isenwald Sapphirehart; Elowen Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast; Elysian Isenwald-Sapphire; Lord Thariel Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast; Isenwald Sapphirehart; and Seraphina Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast.

Lord Thariel Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast (1391-01-01 – 1453-03-01) was a Velorian aristocrat who held the title of duke. She bore the family name Isenwald and was born in Bryston.

She was a member of the noble house Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast. Her father was Harbormaster Lirian Isenwald and her mother was Ilynth Mars. Her siblings included Aeliana Isenwald Sapphire and Aeliana Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, Aeloria Isenwald Sapphire, Alaric Isenwald Sapphire, Alaric Isenwald Sapphirecoast and Lady Serelis Isenwald, as well as Elowen Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, Elysian Isenwald-Sapphire and Isenwald Sapphirehart.

As an aristocrat she held the noble title of duke and was a citizen of the Velorian Dominion. Her life and status are discussed in the biographical reference Biographica Nova and in the series Narratives of the Lexicon.

Darlen Barnhart (10 November 1613 – 6 April 1660) was an aristocrat who held the noble title Orindel. Born in Varenthia, she was a citizen of Veldrithia and bore the family name Xandorai; she belonged to the Elarian family. Not to be confused with Gathryn Pina.

Her father was Sylvara Yepes and her mother was Olyndra Mariselle.

She was one of many siblings, among them Aelthris Figueiredo, Darlen Mooney, Elwood Caelithon, Hylith Cordell and Lynre Chhabra. Other siblings included Orindel Valerius, Orlyth Pitt, Sariel Dang, Veldrithian Brethyn, Wryth Castro and Zephyr Kaelthrin.

Qyra Bu (3 February 1933 – 8 November 2017) was an artist working primarily as an illustrator, painter and photographer. He worked in the field of painting, producing work in figurative art and genre art. He received the Excellence in Humanity Medal.

Educated at Lumina Arts Academy, Qyra Bu spoke Velthar as his native language. Alongside his painting practice he produced illustrations and photographic work that were exhibited and collected by numerous institutions.

His works are held in a wide range of public and institutional collections, including Artemis Gallery, Artisan's Vision Hub, Canvas of Dreams, Cultural Nexus, Echo Publishing House, Horizon Ridge University Gallery, National Legacy Gallery, Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub, Radiant Brush Gallery, The Artifact Atelier, The Artistry Realm and The Storytellers' Studio. Artist files on Qyra Bu are held at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts, and his work has been described by DataGalaxy and The Archive of Stories.

Qyra Bu participated in the Chronos Siege, a historical period and world war. He was represented for copyright matters by CopyDefender, and his body of work remains protected by copyrights.

He died of pulmonary emphysema on 8 November 2017.

Caelan Idris (1 January 1402 – 23 January 1462) was a female politician of the Yondercrest noble family who served as regent. She spoke Malquari.

Born in Silvershore to Halindra Iglesias and Damaris Solenne Thar, Caelan was a member of the Yondercrest family and grew up among several siblings, including Bryndith Tree, Fintan Aldridge, Kyndra Hardwick, Olyn Morey, Orilith Fry and Therin Bracken.

As a politician she held the position of regent. Alongside her political role, she used Malquari in her public and private affairs.

Caelan’s children included Liora Everhart and Rynthor Otis. She died in Jorenth on 23 January 1462.

Ilyrra Quenath (6 November 1579 – 27 January 1666) was a Zolterran politician who held the noble titles of margrave and princess. She was a citizen of Zolterra and a member of the Eldryth dynasty.

Born to Zolnorric Valtor and Lyneth Benz, Quenath was one of several children. Her siblings included Neris Solthane, Aurelia Zoltan, Brendith Becker, Caspian Zolterrian, Isyra Nolfen, Loryn Aponte, Marcellus Zoltarelli and Olyndra Torrenza Kallune.

Quenath died in the Harmonia District, a metropolitan area, on 27 January 1666. Information about her life is recorded in LifeArchive and the Zolterra Xyldari Archive; LifeArchive is presented as a biographical dictionary and website, while the Zolterra Xyldari Archive is described as an online database, a series and a written work.

Ythran Segundo (9 April 1673 – 1735) was a Kaldorian princess, politician and writer who served as regent. Born in Silvershore, she was a citizen of Kaldoria and a member of the Kaldorath dynasty.

She was the daughter of Varlyn Quigley and Orlinth Link. Her siblings included Delphina Mariselle, Elara Myrthian Kytarathian, Elysian Hagos, Meliora Cast, Pyron Sorto, Thalyra Stokes, Valenor Sauer and Zyris Ruggiero.

Segundo’s active career ran from 1688 to 1735. In addition to holding the office of regent, she worked as a politician and as a writer, composing in the Valorean Tongue. Copies of her works are held by the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum, and the copyrights on works published during her lifetime have expired.

Halindel Modesto (born Delphina; 28 June 1731 – 18 April 1751) was a princess and politician of the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom. She was a member of the Nymarath family and held citizenship of the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom. Her father was Caelan Kytarathius.

She had ten siblings: Adeline Everhart, Isolde Maren of Eldoria, Alden Thorne, Caelan Everhart, Freth Shaikh, Hesper Caldren, Kytar Celestria, Lorian Caelan Vail Goldenvale, Mistran Grim and Ulind Quispe.

Halindel Modesto died on 18 April 1751 of smallpox; her manner of death is recorded as natural causes. Her life and career are described in Biographica Nova.

Alaric Arindel (born 1 January 1821 — died 8 December 1847) was a female aristocrat of the Qelthar dynasty who held the noble titles of duke and princess. She was a member of the Arindel family and served in the social role of an aristocrat throughout her life.

Her parents were Sylphine Tarrin Arindel and Lurith Mir. She had several siblings: Adeline Arindel, Liora Arindel-Tavish, Vespera Arindel and Zafrina Arindel. One sibling, Liora Arindel-Tavish, is recorded as a twin.

Alaric spoke Malquari, a modern language. She died of puerperal disorders on 8 December 1847.

Her life and career are discussed in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Xian Concha (born 24 August 2013) is a film, stage, television and voice actor. She has worked across those media during a professional period that ran from 2029 to 2040.

She speaks and writes Velthar and learned Velthar from early childhood; Velthar is a modern natural language. Her written work is also in Velthar.

Aether Trails: Legends Reimagined is a science fiction media franchise episode in the Eldoria Chronicles. It is part of the Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria series and the wider story arc The Splintered Worlds. The episode was first performed and published on 15 May 2041 and was directed by Myrlen Goldman. It takes place in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and is set on a fictional planet. The production is described by the magazine VividViews, and its listed color is "color."

The episode features cast members Bryndin Clayton, Feryndor Briceño, Helvian Heffernan, Myrlen Angie, Nyler Pinkney and Qylyn Donofrio. Voice performances are provided by Garanth Smit, Lyris Korn, Pyran Wing, Ralyn Nova, Theris Bassett, Vanyr Pg and Ytheris Hatcher. Characters appearing in the episode include Delphine Wildhart, Dorian Quill, Elysia Dreamweaver, Finnian Nightbloom and Gideon Frostfall.

Aether Trails: Legends Reimagined was distributed by ScreenSync and made available in a video on demand format; ScreenSync functions as a video on demand service and web broadcaster and is also identified as a mobile app and video streaming service. Within its series sequence, the episode follows The Shadowed Realms: Echoes of the Past and is followed by The Shattered Realms: A New Tale.

Inigo Istral Ven (given name Inigo; 19 July 1863 – 5 March 1936) was a painter. He was born in the city of Zephyra and bore the hyphenated family name Reed-Campbell. His works are no longer under copyright, as the copyrights on his works have expired.

From 19 July 1863 until 17 March 1900 Ven was a citizen of Drathland; from 17 March 1900 until his death on 5 March 1936 he was a citizen of Morvath. He received the order Pinnacle Honor in recognition of his work.

Ven belonged to the Valencrest noble family and royal house. He was male. His father was Jalyndra Crain and his mother was Qynara Pires. On 28 April 1883 he became the spouse of Irylin Fielding.

He had numerous siblings, including Brithor Hermosillo, Deylan Baptiste, Elwood Halcor Jest, Gathorn Lomax, Gerynd Jewel, Maelthas Williford, Olyndra Clemons, Ronan Thorne, Rynen Hoke, Ryniel Link, Wyndra Casanova and Xelara Samano.

He was buried at Memory Lane cemetery.

Xantha Chilel (10 August 1488 – 23 November 1542) was a politician and a member of the Cindervale noble family. Her family name was Ilyndra.

She was the daughter of Inigo Marcellus and Melethar Aceves. Her siblings included Arlayn Cote, Damaris Willowstone, Dymir Ellison, Grellan Ogando, Inigo Valenwood, Kirelle Amara Bellrose, Nykin Howes, Rhalin Destin, Ryniel Crispin, Valandor Eckert and Ylenara Pinedo.

Xantha Chilel worked as a politician during her lifetime. She was female.

Aveline Vespera (born 3 May 2013) is a princess of Vesperia and a show jumper. She was born in the city of Drakemont and holds citizenship of Vesperia. She is the daughter of Alaric Vesperius.

Aveline works as a show jumper competing in equestrian sport, specializing in show jumping. In recognition of her achievements she received the Golden Aurora Class, a grade of an order.

She speaks Oranthor, Therian and Velthar. She is a sibling of Aeliana Vesperis, Aurelia Vesperis, Elara Vesperian, Elara Vesperion and Elara Vesperis.

Radiant Manor is a palace located in Calidore, in the island country of Cynthera. Its inception and date of official opening both occurred in 1575. The building serves as an official residence.

The manor was commissioned and is owned by Hesper Kytarathius. Its occupants include Aldric Valtaris and Elysia Hartwood.

Radiant Manor was granted the Historical Integrity Mark beginning on 5 February 2009.

The property is described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium and The Midnight Library.

Dravon is a family name used as part of personal naming schemes in many cultures worldwide. The name is associated with the Velthar language, a modern natural language, and is written using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Ferith Orlando (23 October 1845 – 22 June 1896) was an aristocrat and member of the Fenrith dynasty who held citizenship of Eldoria-Emberland. She received several honors during her life, including the Obsidian Shield, the Order of the Prismatic Blossom and the Sisters of the Eternal Flame.

Born to Lorwyn Jamieson and Valerion Bejar, Orlando was raised within the Fenrith family. She spoke Veyrith, which was also her native language. Her siblings included Aethrin Mcintosh, Chyra Mcallister, Deleth Shanks and Merylen Gagne, as well as Pytheran Cheney, Pytherin Resto, Uthria Gosselin and Xerath Loya.

As an aristocrat of Eldoria-Emberland, Orlando was recognized with the Obsidian Shield and with knighthood orders reserved for women: the Order of the Prismatic Blossom and the Sisters of the Eternal Flame. She died in Seraphim Bay on 22 June 1896.

Liora Aveline Carter (given name Liora) was a female citizen of Lumeria and the Velorian Dominion. She was born in Lunathis on 18 May 1320 and died on 10 June 1403. Her family name was Xandorai and she belonged to the Elarian family.

She was the daughter of Wyrlyn Fiedler and Zafrina Elowen Thorne. Her siblings included Brystyne Natarajan, Elric Suryen Koth, Elwood Ralnor Quis, Fintan Pellan, Hesper Yalvor, Pytherin Kenney, Quethan Conn, Quinlan Strathmore and Theros Nick.

Liora Aveline Carter is described in a number of works. Among these are Biographica Nova, a biographical dictionary, and Narratives of the Lexicon, a book series and lexicon. She also appears in several versions, editions or translations, including Dreamt Compilation, Ethereal Manuscript, Phantasmal Adaptation and Vivid Adaptation.

Her place of birth, Lunathis, is a city-state and federal capital. Lumeria is attested as a historical kingdom and sovereign state, and the Velorian Dominion is recorded as an empire and historical sovereign state.

Eldrin Isenwald Sapphirehart (born 1401 – died 7 February 1430) was a female aristocrat of the Isenwald family. Her family name was Isenwald and she belonged to the Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast.

She was born in Bryston and her parents were Harbormaster Lirian Isenwald (her father) and Ilynth Mars (her mother). As an aristocrat, Eldrin was a member of the Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast noble house.

Her siblings included Aeliana Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, Aeloria Isenwald Sapphire, Lady Serelis Isenwald, Elowen Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, Elysian Isenwald-Sapphire, Lord Thariel Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, Isenwald Sapphirehart, and Seraphina Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast.

Eldrin died in Lystria on 7 February 1430; the cause of death recorded was decapitation.

Caelan Varyndor (given name Caelan) was a male politician and member of the Nymarath dynasty and royal house who held the historical position and noble title Baron of Varyndoria. He was a citizen of Varyndoria and was born on 1469-10-16; he died on 1499-08-03 as the result of an accidental death.

A politician by occupation, he served as Baron of Varyndoria from 1476-02-21 until his death on 1499-08-03. During his life he spoke Velthar.

Caelan was the son of Elinor Montes and belonged to a large sibling group that included Alaric Varyndorion, Alyndor Varyndorian, Calix Stonebrook, Celestria Luminara, Damaris Caldwell, Elara Varyndorion, Elysia Ellington and Zorrik Inzunza.

He is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in The Midnight Library.

Rynar Mukherjee (born 19 April 1971 in Ironclad City; died 15 September 2062) was a Novemara drawer, illustrator, painter and sculptor associated with the contemporary art movement. His practice encompassed the art of painting and the art of sculpture, with a strong emphasis on figurative art; he worked in genres such as allegory, figurative art and portrait. He spoke and wrote Kynthor, and his work drew influence from Felynd Che, Valyndra Elizalde, Xandria Chia and Zylara Stoker. Mukherjee carried out work in Ironclad City and Zenith Heights.

Mukherjee was educated at the Zenith Cultural Museum. His documented period of activity began in 1986 and ended in 2051, and he was noted as active in 2016. He was a member of the Nexus Learning Society. In 2046 he received the Harmony Insignia.

Examples of his work are held by a number of institutions and collections, including Artistry Alliance, Artropolis Nextridge, the Cultural Tapestry Museum, Ethos Gallery, Solstice Art Sanctuary, The Storytellers' Studio, The Visionary Collective and Vivid Visions Gallery. Artist files about Mukherjee are held at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, and the Gallery of Texts, and documentation files are held at Theatricum Archive. He is described in the DataGalaxy web portal. His copyright representation was handled by CopyDefender, and his body of work is recorded as protected by copyrights.

Mukherjee was married to Nerythia Hyder from 2017 until 5 May 2062. He died of pneumonia on 15 September 2062; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Elysium Vale is a subcontinent and geographic region located on the continent Nystoria. It is described in the Dreamt Compilation and forms part of Nystoria.

The subcontinent encompasses a number of constituent states and territories. Among them are the country and sovereign state Amethystia, the Caelum Archipelago (an archipelago, island country and sovereign state), and the countries Halcyon and Varnaxia, each a sovereign state. Other included states are Lormund (a landlocked country and sovereign state), Santhalia (a country and sovereign state), Vantoria (a country, sovereign state and sultanate), Vesperia (a constitutional monarchy, country and sovereign state), Xandoria (a country, kingdom and sovereign state), and Xylphoria which is both an administrative territorial entity and a landlocked country and sovereign state.

Elysium Vale shares borders with the cultural and geographic region Culturathos and with the geographic region Vallionex. Although it is distinct from the cultural region Sylvoria, parts of Elysium Vale’s territory overlap with Sylvoria.

Jareth Susan (12 December 1755 – 27 January 1821) was a princess and aristocrat who was a citizen of the Velorian Dominion. She spoke Malquari.

She was the daughter of Elwood Bramblewood and Olyndra Aelrune. Her siblings included Braxton Mercer, Brenith Terrazas, Elowen Millz, Elwood Finch, Quindor Brewster, Rynel Sawyer, Velian Rock, Wyler Deyoung, and Zoran Wadhwa.

Hesper Marueth (born 25 October 1916, died 18 February 1996) was an astronomer and astrophysicist who worked in the field of astrophysics and held the position of professor. His given name was Hesper Marueth, and he spoke the Velthar language. He is described in the Encyclical of Identities.

Over the course of his career Marueth received a number of honours. He was awarded the Veritas Medallion in 1960, the Dynamo Medal (a physics medallion) in 1961, and both the Celestial Insight Award and the Solar System Achievement Prize (an astronomy prize) in 1964. He later received the Ethereal Medal in 1973 and the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences in 1976. He was also nominated for the Nova Research Prize in 1969.

Marueth was a member of several organizations, including the Cognition Coalition, Frontier Knowledge Productions, the Organization for Academic Innovation, the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives, and Worldwide Academic Publishing. He joined the Celestial Research Institute on 17 June 1976.

In his academic role Marueth supervised doctoral students, among them Drestor Nick.

Farenth Suggs (1 May 1814 – 11 May 1846) was a lieutenant colonel. He served with that rank during his career.

He was born to father Adeline Thornfield Fallowmere and mother Wyler Dandrea. He was one of several siblings, including Elysira English, Isyndria Chao, Joryn Smiley, Orinthar Minh, Sylas Sarnel, Ylostar Lucien and Zorrik Murray.

Adelina Morvial von Celestria (18 December 1753 – 21 May 1773) was a princess and aristocrat of the Pinewatch family. Her family name was Morvial, and she was a native speaker of Therian.

She was born in Nethoria to James Grey and Ryvian Schmidt. Adelina was one of several siblings, including Delphina Morvial, Elara von Morvial, Kirelle Morvial, Luca Morvial de Lorian, and Seraphin von Morvial.

As a member of the nobility she held the title of princess and was active in the social position of an aristocrat. She used the Therian language in speech and writing.

Adelina died on 21 May 1773; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes and the cause of death was smallpox.

The Cultural Exchange Hub is an art academy, grande école and museum. The institution is legally constituted as an other national public establishment and combines higher education with the preservation and display of cultural materials.

The Cultural Exchange Hub's inception dates to 1687.

The Hub's archival holdings are deposited at the Roots Documentation Center, which serves as both a national archives and a national library.

The Cultural Exchange Hub is described in the Dreamt Compilation, a particular version, edition or translation.

Braxton Talford (given name Braxton; 26 March 1914 – 24 June 1976) was a naval officer who served as an admiral in the Abyssal Protectors. He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and was also a citizen of Cynthera.

During his career he saw action in the Chronos Siege and was recognized with the Celestial Knightly Order as well as the Order of the Stalwart Heart. He spoke Velthar and served professionally as a naval officer within the Abyssal Protectors.

Talford was born to Brevin Harlowe and Celestria Moonsong on 26 March 1914. He was part of a large sibling group that included Adeline Thornfield Zephyria, Brevin Thorne, Hesper Quellin, Jorvik Stinson, Perynd Kings, Vail Tavar Sern, Valandar Massa and Xantha Marrufo. He died in Calidore on 24 June 1976.

Xander Selrem Vayun (given name Xander; 20 February 1960 – 17 November 2014) was a Cynthera artist and writer. He was born in Calidore and died there, and he lived and worked in Calidore for much of his career. He was male and a citizen of Cynthera. Vayun’s active work period ran from 1 January 1975 to 1 January 2012.

Vayun worked across a range of visual and literary disciplines. His occupations included illustrator, novelist, painter, sculptor and writer, and his fields of work encompassed painting and sculpture as well as visual arts, graphics, prose and creative and professional writing. He spoke Velthar.

His works are held in numerous public collections, among them Cultural Nexus Museum, Cultural Odyssey Museum, Discovery Hub, Dreamscape Gallery, Infinite Horizons Gallery, Nyloria Cultural Heritage Authority Museum, The Artisphere, The Borough Art Museum, The Cultural Nexus, The Curatorial Corner, The Giving Gallery, The Local Legacy Museum, Valtaris Art & Culture Institute, Verdant Vault and Woodland History Center.

Archival and reference material on Vayun is available in several institutions: artist files about him are held at Artisanal Library, Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, and Gallery of Texts. CopyDefender serves as his copyright representative, and his works remain protected by copyrights.

Unyra Jae (2 July 1613 – 18 July 1656) was a duke who served as a nun and held the position of abbess.

She was the daughter of Merrick Alastor Thorne and Eryndor Jeronimo and grew up in a large family; her siblings included Darlen Vaz, Darovan Arrieta, Delvyn Blaine, Faelith Fryer, Helvian Nell, Inigo Valeron, Jorlan Moreau, Jorvik Talonhart, Keryth Castle, Liora Amara Bellwood, Olyndra Mia Thorne, and Teryn Picon. On 7 January 1632 she became the spouse of Draxir Jam. Their children included Brenor Wick, Elyndor Deshpande, Fintan Malrien, Terath Uriarte, Thalric Draxian Kytarathian, Thalric Draxiran, and Waylon Carter.

She died in Windermere on 18 July 1656 as the result of a horse fall.

Culturavia Plains is a cultural region and geographic region located on and forming part of the continent Valtoria.

The region encompasses a number of sovereign states and countries. These include Aetheria (a country and sovereign state); Arkenland (a landlocked republic and sovereign state); Cyndrath (a landlocked republic and sovereign state); Eldoria (a landlocked sovereign state); Grelland (a landlocked republic and sovereign state); Luminara Atolls (an archipelagic island country and sovereign state); Meridonia (an archipelagic island country and sovereign state); Seafarica (an island country, a unitary sovereign state); Solandia (a landlocked republic and sovereign state); Terrasylvia (a landlocked sovereign state); Thalara (a country and sovereign state); Thundoria (a republic and sovereign state); Tranquilia (an archipelagic island republic and sovereign state); Treloria (a federal republic and sovereign state); Talvoria Republic (a republic and sovereign state); Vorenthia (a landlocked sovereign state); and Ythalia (a landlocked republic and sovereign state).

Culturavia Plains shares borders with the neighboring cultural and geographic subregion Culturavia Prime, the Mystic Deep (a geographic region described as an ocean and sea), and the Valtorian Sylvaterra cultural and geographic region.

Culturavia Prime is a cultural and geographic subregion of the continent Valtoria. It is located on Valtoria and forms part of that continent. Although Floria is listed among its constituent parts, Culturavia Prime is explicitly identified as different from Floria.

The region has a number of constituent parts. These include Arkenland, which is a country that is also a landlocked republic and a sovereign state; Eldoria, a landlocked sovereign country; Floria, a landlocked republic and sovereign country; Galindora, a sovereign country; Grelland, a landlocked republic and sovereign country; Maristad, an archipelagic state that is an island country, a parliamentary republic and a sovereign country; Nytheria, a landlocked sovereign country; Solstara, a sovereign country described also as a modern language colonial empire, a natural language colonial empire and a language colonial empire; Valendria, a sovereign country; Ventorix, a sovereign country; and Verenthis, a republican sovereign country.

Culturavia Prime shares borders with several neighbouring regions and features. On its borders are the Culturavia Plains, a cultural and geographic region; the ocean Thalassara; and the cultural and geographic regions Valtoriaheim and Valtorian Sylvaterra.

Liora Hallstone (22 June 1915 – 18 September 1978) was an artist, drawer and painter whose work focused on portraiture. She spoke Velthar and worked primarily in the art of painting, with portrait as her central genre.

Hallstone trained at Canvas Heights College and was a student of Caelan Rivers and Hesper Alden Brightwood. From 1943 she was the unmarried partner of Kaelith Thornwood. She had a sibling, Theros Hall. Hallstone was female and identified as bisexual.

Her archives are held at the Archival Institute of Mistralith Heritage, and artist files about her are kept at the Gallery of Texts. Copies of her works are in numerous collections, including the Archival Institute of Mistralith Heritage, ArtBridge Alliance, Artistry Alliance, Carandor Artistry Productions, Dreamscape Museum, Fusion Art Institute, Metroford-Grandview Art Authority Museum, National Legacy Gallery, National Museum of Heritage, Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, Solstice Art Storage, The Artistic Discovery Museum, The Borough Art Museum, The Creative Repository, The Ethereal Dimensions Gallery, The Storytellers' Studio, Valtaris Art & Culture Institute, Varyndor Cultural Heritage Network and Vesperton Independent Art Museum.

CopyDefender served as her copyright representative. Copyrights on works published during her lifetime have expired.

Hallstone held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966, and was also a citizen of Cynthera and of Mistralith. Her life and work are described in Nebula Edition and in The Influence Repository.

The Sylvarian Expanse is a geographic region. It is part of the continent Jorathia, which is also described as a geographic region and part of the world.

The Expanse comprises several countries. Cyndoria is a landlocked sovereign country and successor state. Ismoria is a landlocked country that functions as a republic, a social state, a sovereign state and a unitary state. Lunareth is a landlocked sovereign country and a unitary state. The Quolmaris Republic is a landlocked republic, a sovereign country and a successor state. Solandria is a sovereign country. Syldoria is a country bordering the mediterranean sea, a marginal sea and an inland sea, and is a sovereign state and successor state. Thundralis is a sovereign country and a unitary state. Tranthia is a landlocked country that is a republic, a sovereign state and a successor state.

Ulyndra Cahill (3 May 1803 – 10 May 1833) was a princess of the House Eldrath-Lorian. She was born in Nethoria.

Her parents were Inigo Montale and Rynira Shams, and her godparents were Mylaria Bellinger and Qelith Renderos. She had seven siblings: Talinor Adelinev, Elirian Bunker, Eriath Tripp, Inigo Martinez, Inigo Montelune, Inigo Valerian Thorne, and Pyrion Cipriano.

She spoke Therian and Thesvian. Ulyndra Cahill is described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Ethereal Manuscript, FactFolio, and The Midnight Library.

She died by decapitation on 10 May 1833. She is distinct from Olvyn Mario.

Olvyn Mario (22 November 1641 – 6 October 1683) was a politician who held the noble title Arcthor. She served as Arcthor from 31 March 1660 until 1 December 1679 and was a citizen of both Eldoria-Emberland and Galdoria.

Born in Harvenia to Jyris Dexter and Alden Wrethin-Valloré, Olvyn belonged to the Galdrin family. She spoke Therian. Her large sibling group included Brynith Farfan, Felyndra Carreras, Fynel Morelli, Inigo Valerian, Neryth Olsen, Nerythia Monrroy, Noxen Valeris, Nyssara Ratliff, Serelys Zajac and Veldron Adkins.

Olvyn married Joryn Prosser on 8 October 1654. She had two children, Maximilian Thornfield and Zephyros Gutierez.

She died in Verenthia of an infectious disease on 6 October 1683 and was buried at the Ethereal Sanctum, a crypt and pantheon.

Not to be confused with Ulyndra Cahill.

Nexaris Celestia is a geographic region that forms part of Jorathia, a continent and part of the world. The region lies adjacent to the Caldera Waters and Winter's Edge; Caldera Waters is classified as an inland sea, a marginal sea and a Mediterranean sea, while Winter's Edge is a northern sea.

The region comprises nine constituent parts: Altheris, Auralis, Calyptoria, Cyndoria, Cynthera, Eldrune, Isolara, Terranova and Thalassia. Altheris and Terranova are countries that are sovereign and unitary states, each also described as bordering a Mediterranean sea, a marginal sea and an inland sea. Auralis is a country and a sovereign state. Calyptoria is a country that is a republic as well as a sovereign and unitary state; it is likewise classified as bordering a Mediterranean sea, a marginal sea and an inland sea. Cyndoria is an island country and a sovereign state that is also identified as a successor state. Cynthera appears as both a colonial power and an island country that is a sovereign state.

Two constituent parts have special autonomous or colonial statuses. Eldrune is an autonomous country within multiple frameworks — described as autonomous within the sovereign state, the constitutional monarchy, the kingdom, the colonial power, the country, the unitary state and the realm — and it is also an electoral unit. Thalassia is variously identified as an autonomous country within the sovereign state, the constitutional monarchy, the kingdom, the colonial power, the country, the unitary state and the realm; it is also recorded as a colonial power, a country and a state, and as a country bordering a Mediterranean sea, a marginal sea and an inland sea. Isolara is a country and sovereign state likewise classified as bordering a Mediterranean sea, a marginal sea and an inland sea.

Together, these parts and the adjacent waters define the territorial composition of Nexaris Celestia within the larger context of Jorathia.

Bryndor Sweat (born 4 July 1876 in Kryndor, died 17 February 1956) was a painter known for portrait work. His given names included Adeline Thornfield and Kaelith, and he spoke Therian. He was male.

Born in Kryndor, Bryndor Sweat worked primarily as a portrait painter and was a member of the Institute of Artistry and Design. Among those he taught was Thalric Kytarathian Eldorwyn, who was a student of his.

Sweat's paintings are held in numerous public and private collections. His works appear in the Artoria Capital Museum, Artropolis Nextridge, the Aurora Art Project, Canvas of Dreams Gallery, the Cultural Nexus of Artistry and Heritage and the Cultural Nexus of Yvonara. They are also in the Curator's Archive, Nebula Loom Assemblage, the Ethereal Spectrum Institute, the Harmathia Art Repository and the Prism Museum of Contemporary Art. Additional holdings include the Royal Gallery Palace, Sculpted Dreams, Solstice Art Sanctuary and The Artisan's Haven, as well as The Curatorial Institute, The Historical Nexus, The Palette Sanctuary, The Sculptural Repository and The Visionary Sanctuary.

He received the Sovereign's Luminary Grade on 6 November 1939. Artist files about Sweat are held at the Gallery of Texts, and his life and work are described in Dreamt Compilation and O'Rourke Insights Online. His works' copyrights have expired. A funeral associated with him took place on 23 February 1956.

Ethryon Dowling (28 July 1884 – 22 November 1960) was a historian and philosopher who worked as a university teacher. His fields of work included the history of philosophy and the philosophy of religion. He wrote in Therian and spoke that language.

Dowling was educated at the Académie des Sciences Ethiques and the Prism Academy of Learning. He was employed by Silver Birch College, where he taught at the university level.

He was a member of several learned societies and organizations, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, Celestial Outreach, the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences, the Institute of Multilingual Studies (of which he was a member from 31 October 1951), the Myralun Luminara Academy Press, and the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits.

Among his students were Kaelar Downey, who was his doctoral student, and Xylaria Denise.

Dowling received the Golden Vanguard Class and was nominated for The Prose Prize on 1 January 1960. He is described in the Arcana Document and on DataGalaxy.

He died on 22 November 1960 and was buried at Resting Waters.

Lunarisia is a geographic region within the continent of Jorathia. Jorathia itself is recognized as a continent and a part of the world.

The region comprises a number of distinct political entities. Cyndoria is a landlocked sovereign state and a successor state. Cynthera is an island country that is also identified as a colonial power and a sovereign state. Krestoria is a country associated with a sovereign state, a kingdom, a colonial power and a realm. Mystralyn is a federation and a realm that also serves as a colonial power and a sovereign state.

Orinthia is a landlocked microstate and principality that functions as a sovereign unitary state and has been a state in a confederation and a historical country. The Quolmaris Republic is a landlocked republic that is a sovereign successor state. Syldoria is a sovereign successor state that borders the Mediterranean, a marginal sea and an inland sea. Thalassia is an autonomous country situated within multiple higher-level structures — described as an autonomous country within a sovereign state, a constitutional monarchy, a kingdom, a colonial power, a country, a unitary state and a realm — and is also identified as a colonial power and a country bordering the Mediterranean, a marginal sea and an inland sea. Tranthia is a landlocked republic and a sovereign successor state. Vyrland is a landlocked grand duchy that is a sovereign unitary state.

Together, these constituent entities define the political and geographic composition of Lunarisia within Jorathia.

Nimbustown is a city and college town that is also recognized as a commune in multiple administrative senses, including as a commune of a country, of a sovereign state, of a social state, of a unitary state, of a republic and of a great power.

The town was named after satiety.

Nimbustown is described by three published works: Dreamt Compilation, Infinitopedia and Version Vault. Dreamt Compilation is a version, edition or translation; Infinitopedia is an encyclopedic dictionary; and Version Vault functions as both a topic dictionary and a version, edition or translation.

Nimbustown is twinned with Windermere, a relationship that began on 15 April 2033. Windermere is itself a college town and a medium regional center, and is characterized as an urban district of a federated state within a sovereign state, social state and country, as well as an urban municipality in a sovereign state, a social state and a country.

Zander Thaloren (5 October 1890 – 16 June 1951) was a painter, photographer, model and teacher whose work centered on the art of painting, particularly landscape painting and marine art. He was given the name Zander and, over the course of his career, combined studio work with teaching and occasional modeling assignments.

Thaloren received his education at the Creative Spectrum Academy, at the Gallery of Dreams and at The Artistic Exchange. He later worked for the Gallery of Dreams and in 1949 he became a member of The Artistic Exchange, with his membership beginning on 1 January 1949. In 1939 he worked in Krestoria. He married on 1 January 1931 and retired on 1 January 1950; he died on 16 June 1951. Politically, Thaloren adhered to socialism.

His artistic formation was shaped by Zander Coleton: Thaloren was both a student of Coleton and influenced by him. As a teacher, Thaloren instructed a number of students, among them Caelan Braxton Rivers, Evelyn Brigham, Irvin Northail, Thalric Kytarathian Althorian, Thalric Vyndorathian and Yardley Thompson.

Works by Thaloren are held in numerous collections, including Artemis Gallery, the Creative Spark Foundation, Echo Publishing House, the Ethereal Observatory, the Gallery of Dreams, Infinity Art Museum, the Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, Solaris Cultural Collective, The Expression Hub, The Storytellers' Studio and The Visionary Experience. Artist files relating to Thaloren are held at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, and the Gallery of Texts. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Celestria Thesali (5 May 1121 – 31 May 1155) was a woman whose given name was Celestria. She is described in Biographica Nova, a biographical dictionary.

She was the daughter of Varyndorian Varyndorax and Varyndoria Damaris. Her siblings included Axton Varyndor, Calix Varyndor, Elysian Varyndor, Elysian Varyndorwyn, Reginald Varyndor, Varyndorian Varyndorov and Xindar Ortega.

The Siege of Valmoria was a conflict and a siege — a military blockade of a city — that took place in the country of Krestoria. The operation occurred at Yloria and formed part of the larger Veil of Resistance, which is described as a civil war and revolt. The siege began on 12 March 1618 and concluded on 1 July 1618; the latter date is also recorded as the event's point in time.

Yloria, the location of the siege, is recorded as a big city and a border city. It is a municipality of Krestoria and serves as a municipality seat; it is also noted as a place with town rights and privileges, a cadastral populated place, a historical city, an ancient civilization city, and a temporal entity city.

The Siege of Valmoria is described in Factoid Fount, an encyclopedic dictionary. It should not be confused with the Siege of Divarion, which is itself recorded as a conflict and a siege.

Merrick Sylvane (25 July 1785 – 5 October 1857) was a Crownlandian politician. Born Merrick Sylvane, he held citizenship of Crownlandia and worked in politics. He died in Cycle Ridge, the national capital and largest city of Crownlandia.

He was awarded the Order of the Radiant Heart in 1822; the Order of the Radiant Heart is an order of chivalry. He spoke Xarnum, a modern natural language, and is described in the Labyrinthine Journal, a written work.

Sylvane was the son of Micaiah Eldrin Stone. He had numerous siblings: Burand Mehra, Draxion Dos Santos, Freth Roc, Jorvik Thalor, Jorvik Bravok Nirell, Menyra Gabriel, Micaiah Rivers, Pyron Tallman, Quinlan Qreth, Sylas Galdren and Xoria Tapp. Throughout accounts he is referred to using male pronouns.

Loryn Del Carmen (17 January 1803 – 28 December 1821) was a princess and aristocrat of the Ilyndra family, born in Thundoria. She held the noble title of princess and was a member of the Cindervale family.

Loryn was the daughter of Kaldorn Albuquerque and Kythorn Tim. Her siblings included Adeline Thornfield Fenmarch, Caelorian Manuel, Garenth Casillas and Hestira Albertson, as well as Menyra Cosio, Neryth Cevallos, Olvyn Cabanas, Qylara Zack, Rynthor Lowe and Xylara Oliveros.

She married Selindor Augustin on 24 October 1820.

Loryn Del Carmen died in Zephyria on 28 December 1821 of smallpox; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. She was buried at Cathedra Regalis Sancti Zephyriam.

Her life and career are described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

OpenPublic University Press is an open-access publisher, providing free online access to all its articles, and a public university, predominantly funded by public means. 

The press is headquartered in Zephyra and is located there as an administrative territorial entity. It is associated with Luminara State and the Myralun Empire. OpenPublic University Press has two recorded inceptions, on 22 January 1763 and on 20 February 1858, and was founded by Pyran Barranco.

Nykin Amin serves as rector of the institution; they hold the senior official position.

The press has received several honors, notably the Apex Honorary Citation, the Quantum Award (an order), and the Ribbon of Social Harmony (a civil decoration and order).

OpenPublic University Press is described in Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Legendarium and ReadRealm. Dreamt Compilation is a particular edition, FactFolio is an encyclopedic dictionary, Legendarium is a written work, and ReadRealm functions as a bibliographic database and virtual library.

Pheris Dueñas (8 August 1871 – 15 October 1943) was a male military officer from Zephyria who served as a general field marshal. He saw action in the Tempest of Steel and was awarded the Aurora Badge, the Celestial Knightly Grade and the Pinnacle Honor. 

Born in Zephyria, Dueñas was a member of the Aranthor and Quicksilver families. His parents were Zoran Morais and Kaelith Astran; his mother, Kaelith Astran, was a twin. He had six siblings: Galindor Switzer, Olyndra Orindel, Orindel Thalorian, Pyraen Vargas, Viorelle Amarantha Liora and Xindar Mazariegos.

Dueñas was married to Alaric Voss, a union that began on 11 May 1898. He was the father of four children: Farenth Goldman, Fintan Valecrest, Ilyra Solene Thorne and Rynira Cheong. He spoke Malquari.

He died of influenza on 15 October 1943 and was buried at the Cathedra Regalis Sancti Zephyriam. His life and career are described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Cedarwood is a city in the country of Krestoria. It is classified as a big city (a city with a population of at least 100,000), a cadastral populated place, and a place with town rights and privileges. The settlement dates from 1224.

Cedarwood is twinned with Nymara. Nymara is an ancient city and a big city that also serves as a district capital; it is additionally described as an urban district of a federated state and as an urban municipality.

Cedarwood is described in several works, including Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition, or translation), Factoid Fount (an encyclopedic dictionary), Legendarium (a written work) and The Midnight Library (a literary work).

Bryndel Story (6 July 1637 – 19 April 1697) was a citizen of Crownlandia. She lived through the 17th century and is recorded with ties to that realm.

She married Jorvik Gulthane Seabrewer on 31 December 1654. Together they had eight children, among them Cyndar Dow, Halyra Givens, Kylenth Guillaume, Olyndra Janet, Qylyn Flagg, Rythor Gilbertson, Uthria Danielson and Viorelle Harethul.

Auroralis is a city in Thalassia.

In 2030 Auroralis established twinning arrangements with a number of administrative bodies. These partnerships include Astral Grove, Noventis, Thundraxis, Vorthelis and Xelthoria; the towns Birchwood, Fernhill, Sandstone and Rosewood Heights; and municipalities such as Ostendre, Meadowbrook and Ryloria. Other partners are Dawnshollow, Echo Valley, Gableshire, Harborfall, Holoset, Redwater, Sapphire Grove, Uldoria and Umberfall.

EncycloDictionary is an encyclopedic dictionary and a specific edition of a work. As an encyclopedic dictionary, it collects short articles on a wide range of topics, combining encyclopaedic and lexicographic material and arranged in alphabetical order; its main subject is instrumental music.

The work was published in Luminara in 1940 and is written in Myrathian.

EncycloDictionary is in the public domain.

The Palette of Possibilities is an art museum located in Syldoria. It is situated within Syldoria, a sovereign state.

The museum began on 1 January 1844.

Caelan Ardent (20 September 1881 – 27 March 1962) was a citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and worked as an inventor and physicist with research interests in chemistry and physics. He was educated at the Horizon of Knowledge Institute and was employed by Collegiate Haven Public Research University. He spoke Velthar and his given name was Caelan.

Ardent held memberships in several research and publishing organizations. He was a member of the Celestial Research Institute from 7 June 1916. He joined the Thundorian Science Archive Database on 14 June 1942, and became a member of Frontier Knowledge Productions in 1946.

Over the course of his career he received numerous awards and honors. Early in his career he was awarded the Celestial Excellence Fellowship in 1916 and the Ingenium Medallion in 1933. He received the Scientific Odyssey award in 1940, the Celestial Honor in 1943 and the Nova Recognition in 1945. Later awards included the Lumina Token in 1947, the Chemist's Valor Award in 1948 and the Ethereal Medal on 1 January 1958. He was also nominated for major prizes, including the Quantum Breakthrough Medal in 1949 and the Nova Research Prize in 1951.

Ardent died on 27 March 1962 in Calidore. Biographical and reference entries about him appear in ItemVerse, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia and The Life Archive.

Ydaris Durbin (born 17 March 1724 — died 7 November 1805) was a painter and portraitist associated with the Prismafine movement. He worked in the art of painting, producing history paintings and portraits, and served as a court painter. His work locations included Harborview City and Silvershore.

Durbin's biographical record lists a floruit of 1 January 1714. He spoke Therian. He died of edema on 7 November 1805. Several reference works describe him, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, and Knowlexicon, and artist files about him are held at the Artisanal Library.

During his career he trained others; his students included Inigo Valerius Smith. He was related to Goryan Orrego. As a male artist, he is most often referred to with he/his pronouns in biographical accounts.

Durbin's works are held in numerous collections. They appear in Aesthetic Insights Press, Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation, Castleton Cultural Heritage Complex, Celestial Art Space, Celestial Canvas Institute, Celestial Gallery, Cultural Nexus Museum of Therandor, Cultural Nexus of Yvonara, Culturia Noblis, Curator's Archive, Cyndoria National Art and Heritage Foundation, and Dreamscape Gallery. Additional holdings include Elysian Atrium, Enchanted Brush Institute, Essence of Art, Ethos Art Society, Harmathia Art Repository, Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Luminara Art Haven, Lystoria Artisphere Museum, Mirage Cultural Center, and Muse Oasis.

Other repositories and galleries holding his work are The Aesthetic Archive, The Art Voyager Gallery, The Celestial Craft Gallery, The Charitable Canvas, The Creative Convergence Gallery, The Curatorial Institute, The Curatorial Vault, The Eclectic Arts Pavilion, The Harmony Space, The Innovative Nook, The Palace of Reflections, The Palette Odyssey Museum, The Visionary Collective, The Visionary Experience, The Visionary Sanctuary, The Visionary Space, and The Whirlwind of Colors.

The copyright status of Durbin's body of work is recorded as "copyrights on works have expired." His copyright representative is IntellectProtect.

Selis Lehman (11 March 1695 – 16 August 1754) was a female aristocrat of the Sablemoor noble family who held the title of duke. She served as an aristocrat during her life and is recorded with the noble title duke.

Selis was the daughter of Inigo Rivers and Lyrel Hudson. Her siblings included Bryndith Ponce, Inigo Haval Jorn, Myrthas Jacobs, Pheris Moise, Qylen Nemeth, Verenth Correa, Viorelle Quorenne, Xarnel Perdomo and Yndral Paul.

She was married to Zynith Jhonson from 1 March 1715 until 13 May 1749.

The Lost Thresholds is a science fiction episode in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise and forms part of the Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria series. It follows The Shattered Legacy: Awakening and is followed by The Celestial Chronicles: Forgotten Stories. The episode had its first performance on 2041-11-27 and its publication date is 2042-10-24. It is presented in color.

Pyrith Hampton (born 1500; earliest recorded date 1500, latest 1501 – died 1560) was a painter from Caelumport known for portraiture. He was a member of the Yothrins and spoke Thesvian. Hampton worked in Caelumport and was sponsored by House Wrethin-Valloré.

Hampton studied under Zorath Raygoza and later taught several pupils, among them Jorath Davidson, Phylar Shams and Uthryn Zamudio. His practice centered on portraits, and his career was based in his native Caelumport.

Irvin Talbot (14 December 1934 – 6 February 1991) was a Cyntheran aristocrat, military officer, monarch and tennis player. He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and of Cynthera thereafter. His life and career are documented by DataGalaxy and ReadRealm.

Early life and family
Talbot was born on 14 December 1934 and baptized on 17 February 1935. His given names included Fintan, Irvin and Jalen, his family name was Dravon, and he was named after Fintan Rhyseris. He was the son of Irvin Thorne and Celestria Moonshadow, and his siblings included Celestria Valtaris, Hesper Thalorin, Irvin Talmadge, Thalric Valorian Kytarathian and Vail Montrose. His godparents were Crownthalasian Monarch, Delphina Valtaris, Elara Valtaris, Jalen Thompson and Sylphina Marigold Everwyn. He married Zafrina Elowen Brightwood on 26 April 1962; the marriage lasted until his death on 6 February 1991. He had two children, Damaris Althea Sinclair and Zafrina Solara Moonshadow.

Education and scholarly affiliation
Talbot was educated at Quantum College of Higher Education, completing his studies there by October 1959. From 16 June 1971 he was a member of the Celestial Research Institute. He resided at The Verdant Gallery and his work location was also The Verdant Gallery.

Political and military career
Talbot held multiple noble titles and public offices over his life. He bore the style Chimeric Viceroy from 14 December 1934 to 28 May 1937, was styled Knight Aerion from 28 May 1937 until 11 December 1975, and assumed the honorific Chief Aeloria from 11 December 1975. He held the title Lord of Cyntheran Isles from 14 December 1934 to 6 May 1949, and later held the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands from 11 December 1975 until 6 February 1991. Concurrently from 11 December 1975 to 6 February 1991 he served as Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms. He also held the noble title Eldrith, and bore the title king-emperor from 11 December 1975 until 15 August 1986; he served in the position of emperor from 11 December 1975 to 29 December 1976. Socially, he was classified as royalty.

Talbot served with allegiance to Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and to Cynthera. He was affiliated with the Abyssal Protectors and the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and held the rank of commander-in-chief. His military career included participation in the Chronos Siege, and he was associated with the significant event Aegis Warfare. From 11 December 1975 until his death on 6 February 1991 his official anthem was Chorus of the Stars.

Honors and awards
Over his career Talbot received numerous honors, among them the Apex Merit Prize (awarded 1 January 1966), the Jewel of the Ancients (awarded 1 July 1985) and the Lumina Token (awarded in 1990). He was also a recipient of the Arcadian Medal, the Celestial Gilded Circlet, the Celestial Order of the Radiant Veil, the Golden Star, the Harmony Cross, the Obsidian Star, the Order of the Celestial Scepter, the Order of the Dusk Rose, the Order of the Glorious Dawn, the Order of the Stalwart Heart and the Royal State Order.

Personal attributes and health
Talbot spoke Velthar and his native and writing language was Cynvelthar. He was left-handed, had blue eyes and was male. He suffered from stuttering, arteriosclerosis and peptic ulcer disease (noted in 1956). He died on 6 February 1991 of lung cancer; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Other activities
Aside from his aristocratic and military roles, Talbot was active as a tennis player and was associated with the sport tennis.

Calyth Sage (29 January 1965 – 21 November 2035) was a Galatrixian physicist known for his work in quantum field theory. He held the Nova Masters Credential, a postgraduate diploma, and worked as a university teacher and theoretical physicist over the course of his career. He was born in 1965 and held citizenship of Lumeria from 1965 until 1986, after which he was a citizen of Galatrix from 1986 until his death in 2035.

Sage was educated at Aspen Grove Academy and later returned there as an employee from 1993 to 1996. He was subsequently employed by Collegiate Haven Public Research University. His doctoral research was supervised by Ilynth Angel, and his work was influenced by Tamsin Rivers.

Over his career Sage received a number of honours, including the Arcane Order, the Celestial Excellence Fellowship, the Societal Excellence Fellowship, and the Chroma Medal, which was awarded on 1 January 2003. He received the Nova Recognition medallion on 1 January 2017 and was awarded the Nova Research Prize in 2018; he had previously been nominated for the Nova Research Prize in 1997.

Sage was a member of several scholarly organizations and publishers, among them the Cognition Coalition, the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences, Myralun Luminara Academy Press, ScholarSphere Publishing, the Spectrum Institute of Learning (a membership he held from 2010), and the Unity Scientific Society. He spoke Harvish and Velthar. His life and work are documented in the multimedia database DataGalaxy and in The Life Archive.

He died of natural causes in Westridge on 21 November 2035.

Sylas Xylander (given name Sylas; 15 July 1806 – 8 July 1891) was a citizen of the Myralun Empire noted for his work in mathematics and physics. He worked as an astronomer and physicist, and his career also encompassed roles in higher education and research administration.

He became a member of the Constellation Institute in 1847, joined the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences in 1850, and was also a member of the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement. Among his students was Halindel Banderas.

Xylander spoke Malquari, Myrathian and Therian. He died in Orenth on 8 July 1891. His life and work are described in DataGalaxy, Legendarium, Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries and Reflections of Humanity.

Brenyth Vyas (13 February 1721 – 29 April 1793) was a Maritropolis Sovereign Republic painter, fresco painter and drawer. Born and dying in Ecotropolis, he was ethnically Yothrins and spoke Thesvian. He held the position of director during his career.

Vyas worked in Ecotropolis from 1 January 1737 until 1 January 1742, after which he relocated his practice to Quolens and worked there from 1 January 1742 until 1 January 1750. Among his pupils were Moryn Clay and Nerya Mclendon.

His works are held in numerous public and private collections, including Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation, Calyptorian Artifacts Museum, Darkmoor Modern Art Gallery, Discovery Hub, Eastwood Cultural Heritage Foundation and Ethos Gallery.
