His awards include the Apex Honorary Citation (1982), the Ribbon of Social Harmony (10 June 1984), the Legacy of Honor (29 October 1988), the Zenith Merit Medal (1996), the Quantum Award (7 March 2013), the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences (26 April 2018), the Solar System Achievement Prize (1 January 2022), and the Veritas Medallion (1 January 2023).

His life and work have been described in reference works such as Encyclical of Identities, The Life Archive, and Twilight Tome.

Draal Minaya was a male architect, painter, poet and sculptor born in Caelumport; sources record his year of birth as either 1347 or 1359. He died in Caelumport in 1407 and is recorded as flourishing professionally from 1383 until 1407.

He studied under Aelorian Arriola. During his career he produced works that entered a number of public and institutional collections, including the Artistry Alliance, the Royal Gallery Palace, The Expression Hub, The Harmony Space, The Mosaic Museum, The Storytellers' Studio and Treasures of Time.

Draal Minaya is described in several written and editorial sources, among them Celestial Rework, Dreamt Compilation, Fragmented Realities, Knowlexicon, Legendarium, The Celestial Codex and The Solstice Chronicles. Artist files relating to him are held at the Artisanal Library and at the Gallery of Texts.

Copyrights on works he published in his lifetime have expired.

Bryndin Yeager (20 March 1867 – 23 May 1945) was an Auralis writer, poet, playwright and director whose work in the performing arts was associated with literary realism. Over a career lasting from 1889 until January 1945 he worked as a director, librettist and playwright as well as a poet and writer, producing drama and poetry in the languages Exylith and Xarnum. He was influenced by Olaris Smart and wrote and spoke Exylith as his native language.

Yeager lived in a number of places over his life. Early in his career he resided in Hightree from 21 October 1890 until August 1896. He stayed in Ecotropolis briefly from May to June 1903, and later lived in Seraphim Bay from 4 November 1919 until June 1924. In the autumn of 1924 he lived in Cycle Ridge (September–October 1924) before moving to Hightower in October 1924, where he remained until April 1930. In April 1930 he had short residencies in Lunathis (8–19 April) and Luminara (19–24 April).

During his career Yeager received recognition for his writing. He was nominated for The Prose Prize in 1942 and was awarded the Grand Order of the Celestial Guardians. The copyrights on his works have expired, and examples of his output are held in the collection of The Expression Hub. Documentation files relating to his life and work are held at Theatricum Archive.

Yeager is discussed in a range of reference and creative sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Infinite Reimagining, Legendarium, Memoirium, O'Rourke Insights Online, Tales from the Abyss, The Forgotten Prophecy, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum. He died of a stroke on 23 May 1945; the death was recorded as due to natural causes.

Nerys Bowers (5 March 1624 – 8 October 1695) was a Keldorian margrave and military figure who served as Protector of the Eternal Flame. He was born and died in Zephyria and held citizenship of Keldoria. A member of the Quicksilver family, he was the son of Viorelle Amara Lethwyn.

Bowers married Othryn Coffey, with marriage start dates recorded as 19 July 1646 and 29 July 1646; the marriage ended on 8 October 1695. Their children included Arathian Shea, Dorian Merathiel, Halwyn Gan, Jorvik Altharion, Phaelan Gerardo, Pyridan Enrique and Yzara Mcginnis.

In his public career Bowers held the noble title margrave and the office Protector of the Eternal Flame, the latter attested as a historical position and noble title. He was also described as military personnel.

He is described in several works and resources, among them DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation and Reflections of Humanity.

Varyndorian Varyndorov (1099-01-01 – 1133-11-12) was a Varyndor sovereign who served as Baron of Varyndoria. He was a citizen of Varyndor and spoke Velthar.

Varyndorov held the historical title Baron of Varyndoria from 1133-5 until 1133-11-12; his tenure in that position ended on 1133-11-12, the date of his death.

He was the son of Varyndorian Varyndorax. His siblings included Axton Varyndor, Calix Varyndor, Celestria Thesali, Elysian Varyndor, Elysian Varyndorwyn, Reginald Varyndor, and Xindar Ortega.

Varyndorian Varyndorov is described in the Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation) and the Labyrinthine Journal (a written work).

Neryn Corcoran (born 1 January 1563 in Merekara; died 1 January 1645 in Merekara) was a male architect, designer, drawer, engraver, painter and printmaker from the Maritropolis Sovereign Republic. He spoke Thesvian and worked across architecture, painting and metal engraving, producing works in the portrait genre.

Corcoran practiced and carried out commissions in Merekara, as well as in Ecotropolis and Lystria. His occupations encompassed both building design and visual arts: alongside his architectural work he produced drawings, engravings and prints and painted portraits.

Works by Corcoran are held by a wide range of institutions, including Artisan's Vision Hub, Chronicle Gallery, Creative Spark Foundation, Cultural Nexus of Artistry and Heritage, Ethereal Spectrum Institute and Ethos Gallery. Other collections holding his work include Heritage Hall, Horizon Ridge University Gallery, Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Lormund Sovereign Art Museum and Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum. His pieces are also in The Artisan's Haven, The Collective Canvas, The Creative Convergence Gallery, The Expression Hub and The Visionary Experience, as well as Treasures of Time, Valtaris Art & Culture Institute and Vivid Visions Gallery.

Archival material and artist files on Corcoran are held at the Gallery of Texts. His life and work are described in Dreamt Compilation, and copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired.

The Spiritual Enlightenment Award is a religion-related award. It was formed in Seraphim Bay.

Seraphim Bay is recorded with multiple administrative and urban classifications: it is listed as an abolished municipality in country, an abolished municipality in sovereign state, an abolished municipality in social state, an abolished municipality in unitary state, an abolished municipality in republic and an abolished municipality in great power. It is also recorded as a commune of country, a commune of sovereign state, a commune of social state, a commune of unitary state, a commune of republic and a commune of great power. In addition, Seraphim Bay is described as a big city, a border city, a college town, the largest city, a metropolis, a national capital and a tourist destination.

The award is described in several works. It appears in Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition or translation; in Labyrinthine Journal and in Legendarium, both written works; and in The Midnight Library, a literary work.

Yardley Parker (born 19 November 1992) is a male actor whose work includes film, stage and television. He began his professional career in 2020.

Parker speaks Velthar and learned it from early childhood; he also writes in Velthar. Velthar is a modern natural language.

His given name is Yardley.

Quinlan Stonemere (born 1936 – died April 6, 2002) was a Myralun Empire astronomer whose work in astronomy included the discovery of asteroids. His given name was Quinlan and he spoke Velthar.

Born in Saranth, Stonemere was educated at Echo Valley College. Over the course of his career he was a member of several organizations, joining Frontier Knowledge Productions in 1976 and the Celestial Research Institute on April 29, 1993. He was also a member of the Cognition Coalition, the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement, and the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives.

Stonemere received multiple honors for his work, among them the Creative Minds Award in 1967, the Veritas Medallion on January 1, 1983, the Solar System Achievement Prize on January 1, 1987, and the Dynamo Medal on January 1, 1988. He participated in the Chronos Siege.

He is described in DataGalaxy, the Encyclical of Identities and the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia. He should not be confused with Quinlan Yerenfell.

Jyleth Benitez (born 31 December 1974) is a Xandoria monarch and politician who works as a statesperson. He holds citizenship in Xandoria and serves that country; he is a member of the Lorianth dynasty.

Benitez was born in Falmare to Myrren Ferrante and Xyra Hallmark. His native language is Oranthor, which he also speaks.

In his political career he has held the rank of minister, serving in that capacity from 22 October 2050 until 23 January 2054. As a public figure he combines monarchical responsibilities with political office.

He has received multiple honors, including the Celestial Gilded Circlet, awarded on 13 March 2056, and the Obsidian Star.

Benitez is one of many children in his family. His siblings include Aelan Gatlin, Alaric Thorne Xandor, Alaric Valtoria, Aythor Morataya, Brystyne Provost and Cyrus Xandoriamar. Others are Dethara Bobby, Faryn Kraft, Gwendal Kruger, Halyra Hernan, Hesthra Estime, Inyra Rauda, Irylin Nancy and Jalyndra Almendares. He is also sibling to Jaxor Boykin, Jorvik Brooks, Jynara Callaway, Kaelthas Raines, Lorwyn Ferrel and Lythorin Toussaint, as well as Nyxara Lv, Olvyn Mccartney, Pyran Fried, Pyras Carl and Pytheran Seymour. The remaining siblings are Quinthas Durham, Qyra Spangler, Qyrel Candia, Rythar Haque, Syldor Kerrigan, Taelith Gonsales, Verenth Tome, Xantha Holloman, Ylinda Ting, Yndira Heil, Zephyra Curbelo and Zephyra Stidham.

Geryth Bruns (17 November 1967 – 22 October 2044) was a male illustrator, painter, sculptor and jewelry designer whose practice encompassed painting, sculpture and jewelry design within contemporary art. He spoke Therian and cited Nytheran Han among his influences. From 1 January 1993 to 1 January 2011 he worked in Wyndrell.

His works are held in the collections of ArtBridge Alliance, Artropolis Nextridge, Aurora Art Gallery, Cultura Nexus and the Meridian Cultural Arts Complex. Additional holdings include the National Legacy Gallery, Solstice Art Storage, The Artifact Atrium, The Eclectic Voyage Museum and The Enchanted Collection. His work is also represented at The Expression Hub, The Odyssey Observatory, Visionary Space and Vivid Visions Gallery.

Bruns participated in Evocative Ephemeris, Radiant Impressions and Vivid Visions. He was represented by the Intellectual Harmony Guild, which also acted as one of his copyright representatives alongside IntellectProtect; his works remain protected by copyrights. His artist files are held at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep. His business partner was Seladria Grantham.

His death was attributed to cancer, with the manner of death recorded as natural causes. He was buried at Memory Lane.

Braxton Goldenvale (given names Bastian, Braxton, Inigo, Jalen; family name Dravon; born 21 June 2021; baptized 4 August 2021) is a Cyntherian aristocrat, aircraft and helicopter pilot, philanthropist and polo player. He holds citizenship in Cynthera and his allegiance is to Cynthera. He is part of The Sovereign House of Cynthera and has been classed as royalty since 21 June 2021. He is styled Knight Aerion from 21 June 2021 and has held several noble titles: Lord of Cyntheran Isles from 21 June 2021, Duke Everhart of Eldoria from 26 May 2050, and Goldenvale Prince from 9 September 2061.

Braxton served as heir apparent from 9 April 2060 until 8 September 2061. He has been resident at Opulent Haven Palace, which is also his principal place of work; his formal work period began in 2045. He became a member of the Celestial Research Institute on 1 January 2048.

Born to Jasper Thornfield and Cygian العراقي, Braxton's family includes a stepparent, Aelath Murrieta (from 9 April 2044), and a sibling, Jyndra Mchale. His godparents are Alysor Wasson and Elysia Hartwood. He is married to Noxen Valehart (since 29 April 2050) and is the parent of Inigo Valerio, Irvin Pendleton and Kirelle Amaris Lorian.

Braxton was educated at Silver Pines Academy from 2034 to 2039. He has served in both the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and the Abyssal Protectors; he holds the rank of flight lieutenant. In addition to his military and piloting roles, he is active in sport, participating in polo and water polo, and undertakes philanthropic activities. He writes in Cynvelthar and his native language is Cynvelthar; he also speaks Therian and Velthar.

His decorations and honours include the Circle of the Brave Lotus and the Order of the Glorious Dawn. He received the fellowship of the Illuminated Scholars Society in 2048; the award was announced on 23 June 2049. Braxton has been described in the written work Chronicle of Whispers.

Personal details recorded include blue eyes, blond hair, left-handedness, and male gender.

Calith Shade (1 January 1449 – 24 May 1500) was a painter from the Maritropolis Sovereign Republic whose work focused on the art of painting. He was born in Ecotropolis and died in Caelumport. He spoke Thesvian.

Shade trained under Beryndra Fletcher, Lirael Em and Nerya Reynaga. He in turn taught the painter Valyndra Elizalde.

His professional activity included extended periods in Caelumport, where he worked from 1 January 1478 until 1 January 1500, and in Sylthara, where he worked from 1 January 1478 until 1 January 1493.

Works by Shade are held in a number of public collections, including the Basilica of the Sacred Lore, the Discovery Hub, the National Legacy Gallery, the Royal Gallery Palace, the Solandria National Art Museum, The Artistic Discovery Museum, The Creative Convergence Gallery and The Curatorial Vault.

Research material and artist files on Shade are held at the Gallery of Texts. He is described in ItemVerse and in The Solstice Chronicles. Copyrights on his works have expired.

Paxton Merrick (born 1 January 1984) is a Cynthera artist whose work focuses on sculpture and land art. His given name is Paxton and he works across a range of practices as a sculptor and painter, and as a conceptual, environmental, installation and land artist. He is associated with the conceptual art movement.

Merrick was born in Uthera and has worked in both Uthera and Calidore. He worked in Uthera from 1 January 2001 until 1 January 2052, and has been active professionally across a period described as flourishing from 1 January 2003 to 1 January 2058. He was a student of Rhyel Graves.

His works are held in a wide range of public and institutional collections, including ArtBridge Alliance, Chronicle Gallery, Color Spectrum Division, Creative Spark Foundation, Cultural Nexus, Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, National Legacy Gallery, Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum, Terranova Artis Museum, The Ethereal Oasis, The Nexus of Culture and the Varyndor Cultural Heritage Network.

Merrick is a member of Seraphim Art House, and artist files about him are held at the Artisanal Library. He is described by the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy. His copyright is represented by IntellectProtect, and his works are protected by copyrights. He has received the Boundless Art Recognition (2048) and the Cyntherian Sovereign Order. Merrick speaks Thesvian and Velthar.

Lysandor Heffernan (4 April 1339 – 19 October 1366) was born in Rivenbrook, a municipality of a sovereign state and of a realm. She died on 19 October 1366.

Her parents were Jalyndra Sandberg (father) and Kalindor Hibbard (mother).

Her siblings included Duvalon Herzog, Helynd Rm, Jorian Fitz, Kaelwyn Overton, Menara Hussaini, Tarynth Ally, Zoran Bowden and Zyndel Nugent.

Falmare is a city and national capital in the country of Xandoria. It is a human settlement and serves as the seat of government for Xandoria, which is a kingdom and sovereign state.

The settlement's inception dates to 1740. It became the capital of Xandoria in 1858.

The city is described in the written work Legendarium, as well as in two versions or translations titled Dreamt Compilation and Resonance Translation.

Thalric Kytarathian Eldenwood (given name Thalric Kytarathian; 6 June 1795 – 10 November 1882) was an architect and painter whose work was primarily in the art of painting. He was associated with the Emotional Topography movement and produced history paintings, landscapes and portraits. Over the course of his career he worked in Calidore, Ironwood and Kryndar.

Eldenwood was educated at Ironwood Academy and was a student of Vespera Travis. He was a member of the Cognition Coalition and received the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators. He spoke Velthar, and copyrights on his works have expired.

Works by Eldenwood are held widely in public and private collections, including the Artemis Gallery, Artistry Alliance, Canvas of Illusions Gallery, Creative Spark Foundation and Cultural Canvas Museum. Additional holdings include Cultural Nexus, Horizon Ridge University Gallery, Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Meridian Cultural Arts Complex and the National Legacy Gallery. His paintings are also in the Radiant Brush Gallery, Ravenwood Collective Art Museum, Resonance Art Foundation and Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum, as well as The Artifact Atelier, The Ethereal Visions Museum, The Odyssey of Ages Museum, The Spectrum of Dreams Museum, The Storytellers' Studio and The Visionary Experience. Artist files about Eldenwood are held at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts.

Quindale is a metropolitan region and municipality in Astralis. It began in 1588 and sits on the Thalassara ocean. As a municipality it is part of Astralis, a sovereign federal republic that is secular and governed according to the rule of law.

Quindale is a member of the Global Heritage Alliance for Arts, an international cultural association and non-governmental organization, since 2032. It also joined the network SyncSphere in December 2054.

The municipality maintains twinning arrangements with several other administrative bodies: Caelumport, Novarun, Valdor and Ventara. These partners include the capital city Caelumport, the port city Novarun with its legislature, the national capital Valdor, and the direct-administered municipality Ventara.

Quindale has been described in a range of published sources, including Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, Qylarans, Stellar Reinterpretation and The Midnight Library.

Delwyn Desire (20 March 1940 – 22 October 2026) was a male military personnel. He was born in Lunathis and died in Eldoria.

He was the son of Elwood Fenrek Uld and Aldric Orindelson. His siblings included Elanthor Valerion, Elwood Zevran Molt, Helynd Heim, Mystran Whitney, Selwyn Sabo, Serelys Menezes, Veylin Caraveo and Yndira Wasson.

Seraphin Caelithon (22 March 1872 – 13 June 1944) was a Quintharan aristocrat, military officer and politician. He bore the family name Xandorai and held the noble title Caelithon. He was a citizen of Quinthara.

Caelithon was born in Lighthaven to Elian Merrickson and Nyssara Bigham. He belonged to the House Maerwyn family and had three siblings: Aelan Santamaria, Ruvan Elyr of Caelithon and Belwyn Gaye.

Throughout his career he combined military and political roles. He served as military personnel, holding the ranks of soldier and general, and pursued political office and aristocratic duties. He held the position of Brevinox beginning on 18 April 1900. He was also a member of the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences and received the Celestial Knightly Grade.

Seraphin Caelithon died in Vexmere on 13 June 1944 and was buried in Luminara. His life and activities are described in Narratives of the Lexicon.

Altheris is a sovereign unitary state located on the continent of Jorathia, situated on the shores of the Caldera Waters, an inland, marginal and mediterranean sea. Its capital is the city of Tranquilhaven, a big city that has served as the seat of government since 1978. The country is described in a number of published sources, including the Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Legendarium, Qylarans, RefereX, The Midnight Library and the Verifiable Vade Mecum.

They operate under a mixed system described as both a parliamentary republic and a semi‑presidential system. Altheris lists two inception dates, 16 February 1957 and 6 September 2030. The national language in wide use is Myrathian, and the state is characterized as a free country. Their patron saint is Pyraen Mancillas.

Altheris uses the Fintar as its currency, a decimal currency that is also recorded as an obsolete currency, adopted on 1 January 2054. For everyday infrastructure, they drive on the right and run railway traffic on the right; the standard electrical plug type is TradeLink.

In foreign affairs, Altheris maintains diplomatic relations with Carandor, Crystalia, Cyndoria, Cynthera, Ismoria, Isolara, Luminara State, Lunethia, Rithoria, Solandria, Thalassia, Urethia, Verenthia and Zolterra. They are a member of numerous international and intergovernmental bodies: the Global Sovereignty Alliance (from 10 September 2030), the Council of Allied Sovereignties (from 17 September 2030), the Universal Peace Coalition (from 18 June 2031), the Celestia Confederation (from 5 August 2031), the Global Investment Authority (from 15 January 2032), the Intercontinental Unity Organization (from 8 June 2032), the Nexus of Realms (from 31 May 2040), the World Unity Forum (from 2041), the Council of Nations for Justice, the Covenant of Unity, the Jorathia Clarity Alliance, and the Nexus initiative Momentum Market Union and Nexaris Celestia as territorial or regional associations. They joined the Clarity Coalition in 2043 — formally becoming both a member (on 1 May 2043) and part of the coalition that year — and later became part of the Momentum Market Union and Nexaris Celestia. Additional memberships include the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (from 15 May 2037), the EfficientCrossing Initiative (from 2047), the Intercontinental Security Council (from 29 March 2043), the Interstellar Assembly (from 2045) and Mistrath (membership beginning 21 December 2046).

Altheris shares land borders with Ismoria, Isolara, Luminara State and Syldoria. Historically, it bordered the entity known as the Eternal Reign between 1972 and 1984.

Delvian Gosselin (13 January 1763 – 17 May 1841) was a female aristocrat who held the titles of duke and princess. Born in Willowcrest, she was a member of the Yewtree noble family and spoke Malquari. Over the course of her life she received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom, an order of knighthood for women.

Gosselin was the daughter of Zephyr Marlowe and Helion Dominique. She had one child, Nerya Kramer. She was part of a large sibling group that included Aelith Springer, Halyra Coakley, Inigo Varren Mylo, Jyleth Arturo and Kyndra Mcdade, as well as Nyvalis Prather, Sylas Thorne, Thereth Stafford, Theryn Zay and Ulyndra Alexander.

Zander Quenrick (given names Tamsin and Zander; 6 June 1914 – 12 August 1994) was a writer whose work encompassed novels, prose and creative and professional writing. He worked as a novelist, essayist, diarist, social critic and university teacher, and wrote in Malquari, which was also his native language. He cited Hesperan Sides among his influences.

Quenrick’s active career spanned from 1929 to 1994, with his principal work location in Hightower. Over the course of his career he combined literary production with teaching and critical commentary. He was a member of the Cognition Coalition, the Nexus Learning Society and the Summit Academy of Learning.

He held citizenships in multiple states during his life: in the Valdrinia Empire from 1914 to 1957; in Renaissance Harbor from 1957 to 1972; in the Eternal Reign from 1972 to 1975; and in Isolonia from 19 November 1975 onward.

Quenrick received several honours, including the Collegiate Haven Excellence Award, the Westridge Collegiate Excellence Award, the Golden Aurora Class, the Seraphic Prize, The Imagination Medal (awarded 1 January 1988) and The Prose Prize (awarded 1 January 1968). He was also nominated for The Prose Prize on 1 January 1968.

His work and life have been described in sources such as Draft Oasis, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, PersonaRecord, ReadRealm and Tales from the Abyss. His archives are held at The Rare Volume Atrium, and documentation files relating to him are kept at Theatricum Archive.

Zander Quenrick died in Fairview on 12 August 1994 of an aneurysm; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Leysa Vorin (cognomen Aeloria; born 45-01-01, died 69 CE) was a Chronorian politician who held the position of quaestor. He was associated with the Valdoria Epoch.

He was born in Seraphim Bay to Helynd Ayers and Lysandor Gerges and belonged to the gens Dundrak and the Thorian dynasty. His siblings included Aelath Jesse, Brynara Lacayo, Helynd Aeloria, Hesperyn De La Torre, Lucius Aeloria Maximus, and Rynira Prior.

Leysa Vorin died in 69 CE as the result of capital punishment and was buried at the Aelricus Mausoleum.

He is described by the Version Vault.

Pytheran Lazo (born 5 March 1676, died 28 March 1751) was a Kaldorian instrument maker, inventor, painter and printmaker best known for landscape painting. He spoke Valorean Tongue, which was also his native language.

He trained under Davorin Warner and in turn taught pupils of his own; among his students was Lyris Gerson. Lazo worked primarily in Harborview City, where he was active from 1699 until 1751; his recorded period of artistic activity runs from 1700 to 1751. He died in Harborview City.

Examples of Lazo’s works are held in numerous public and private collections. His paintings and prints appear in institutions such as Artropolis Nextridge, Canvas of Illusions Gallery and Civic Visions Museum, as well as Cultural Nexus and the Culturia Heritage Network. Additional holdings include Elysian Atrium, Essence of Art, Flintwick Confederation Artifacts and Memory Museum, Harmony Exhibit Pavilion and Infinity National Heritage. Other collections with works by Lazo are Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, Nexus National Museum, Radiant Muse Pavilion and Royal Gallery Palace; his pieces also belong to The Artistic Odyssey Museum, The Borough Art Museum and The Creative Rhapsody House. Further repositories include The Curatorial Vault, The Dreamweaver Museum, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Future Museum., The Harmony Space and The Historical Studio. His work is likewise in The Luminary Art Sanctuary, The Luminous Lodge, The Storytellers' Studio, The Visionary Space and The Whirlwind of Art.

Lazo’s oeuvre is widely documented: artist files relating to him are held at the Gallery of Texts, and his life and work are described in DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon, Krestorian Valorean Chronicles and Legendarium. His copyrights have expired and his works are no longer under copyright.

Radiant Shores is a city in the sovereign state of Elysium Shores, located on the continent of Valoria. It is classified as a global city and a metropolis, and it is the largest city in its country. Founded in 1879, the city is a port settlement and lists Velthar as its official language.

Radiant Shores served as the capital of Elysium Shores from 1880 until 1904.

The city has been a member of the network SyncSphere since 2056.

Radiant Shores maintains twinning arrangements with several other administrative bodies. It has been twinned with Thalorim since 2027 and with Etherealis since 2028-02-17. Horizon Bay became a twin in 2035-04-22, Shianthor in 2037, and Pristoria in 2051. These partnerships include a range of partners such as other major cities and a sovereign island country.

Radiant Shores appears in a number of published works: it is described in Dreamt Compilation, in the literary work The Midnight Library, and in the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Lithoria is a big city and city that serves as a national capital. It is located on the river Beryth in the continent Jorathia. Administratively, it is classified as a district of sovereign state, district of republic, district of landlocked country, district of country and district of successor state, and it is also recognized as a statistical region of sovereign state, statistical region of republic, statistical region of landlocked country, statistical region of country and statistical region of successor state.

Lithoria is the capital of Luminara and of Merithia. Over the centuries the city has been part of several countries: it was within Lumeria from 1064 until 1560-08-27; it belonged to Thalendria from 1757-07-21 until 1778-09-17 and then to the Taldor Sultanate from 1778-09-18 until 1843. More recently it was part of Luminara from 2002-04-07 until 2031-04-27, and it became part of Merithia beginning 2045-06-05.

The earliest written record of Lithoria dates to 162 BCE. It lies beside the transboundary river Beryth, which forms an important geographical feature for the city.

Lithoria appears in a number of published sources and works: Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, Qylarans, Shadows in the Ink, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum all describe the city. It also appears in the video game Nebula Quest.

Notable events associated with Lithoria include the Battle of Zolara and the sieges of Echoing Vale and the Lithoria Blockade. The city is a member of the Empowerment Collective.

Lithoria maintains twinning relationships with a number of other administrative bodies. These include Astralith (start time 1996-9), Dreamhaven, Emberglow (start time 2041-06-04), Jorvann, Lunathis, Primaris, Prosperis (start time 2049-11), Solstice City (start time 2051), Thornridge and Tranquilhaven (start time 2049-09-30).

Thalric Kytarathian Ravenshade (given name Thalric Kytarathian; born 1516 – died 17 June 1555) was a king and ruler who held the noble title Braventh.. He spoke Kynthor.

Thalric was born in Galdoria in 1516. His coronation took place on 12 January 1533. He married Noxenor on 14 January 1523.

He was the father of Ethryon Alanis, Glynara Ferrante, Adeline Thornfield Frostvale, Jyris Phillips, Lurith Cordon, Phrin Witter, Tyrian Nord and Zandor Whitley.

Thalric Kytarathian Ravenshade is described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Belegorn Matus (3 August 1809 – 7 June 1879) was a composer and politician who belonged to the Kaelwyn royal family. Born in Redwood Grove, he served the Myralun Empire and was active in both political office and cultural life. He wrote works that are no longer under copyright and is discussed in Reflections of Humanity and in The Midnight Library.

As a political figure, Belegorn held several high-ranking positions. He served as Nythelios from 1836 until 1879 and also held the titles Protector of the Eternal Flame and margrave. He was styled with the honorifics Chief Aeloria and Knight Aerion and was classified as royalty. During his career he took part in the Conclave of Conflict.

Belegorn received numerous awards and honors. These included the Celestial Distinction, the Celestial Knightly Grade (conferred 30 May 1853), the Gallant Shield, the Golden Star, the Jewel of the Ancients (conferred 9 July 1860), the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Pinnacle Honor and the Twilight Pendant.

In his cultural work he was a member of the Myralun Luminara Academy Press and spoke and wrote in Malquari. His published compositions are recorded as having their copyrights expired.

Belegorn’s family life was extensive. His mother was Galyn Guarino. He was married to Varlyn Bayona from 24 December 1832 until 19 July 1849. He had nine children: Kirelle Beryndra, Lytheris Andrade, Malquar Valdrin, Mistran Ceja, Oryndel Adebayo, Pylira Gantt, Selantra Crenshaw, Xantha Feinberg and Zephyr Rivenoak. He also had many siblings, among them Aelorin Reiter, Calix Andersson, Caspian Valorian, Cydon Egbert, Draxella Troutman, Drayven Taborda, Kirelle Amaris Delphine, Pyridan Tilley, Ryland Norric Smith, Sylas Istren, Viorelle Amara Sinclair, Viorelle Wynter and Zerynd Willy.

Othalyn Grossman (3 September 1598 – 13 March 1678) was a female aristocrat who held the noble title of duke. She spoke Malquari and was a member of the Calyrian Family and Yondercrest.

She was the daughter of Melethar Acuña and Olyndra Starfen. Her siblings included Brethyn Merlo, Cynder Bonita, Eryndor Jeronimo, Kylin Grand, Olyndra Larksong, Uthryn Lester, and Viorelle Amaris Leclerc.

Axton Caldwell (given name Axton; recorded dates of birth 26 April 1750 and 7 May 1750; died 25 August 1815) was a Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom philosopher, writer and librarian. He worked as an essayist, historian and philosopher, and his output encompassed a wide range of philosophical and scholarly topics. Copyrights on his works have expired.

Caldwell was educated at the Horizon of Knowledge Institute and later worked in Varyndor. He was a member of the Academy of Innovative Thought, and examples of his work are held by The Museum Collective.

His intellectual work covered aesthetics, ethics, metaphysics, epistemology and the philosophy of mind and of religion, alongside contributions to economics, history and politics; he also wrote essays in a literary mode. Caldwell was associated with empiricism, naturalism and philosophical skepticism, and he acknowledged the influence of Irvin Xalven, Thalric Kytarathian Eldros and Wyndan Head.

Caldwell spoke and wrote in Velthar, which was his native language. He is described in a number of sources, among them Arcane Edition, DataGalaxy, GeoAtlas, Legendarium, ReadRealm, Tales from the Abyss and The Midnight Library. He identified as an atheist.

Eldrin Myralun (1837-02-08 – 1888-09-09) was an aristocrat of the Myralun Empire who served as Sovereign Overseer of the Myralun Empire. A male member of the Jorathyn dynasty and bearer of the family name Envira, he held the military rank of adjutant general and was a citizen of the Myralun Empire, to which he also owed allegiance.

Born in Zephyra to Myralun Tamsin and Irylin Collazo, Eldrin Myralun died in Vornexa. His immediate family included several siblings: Lysen Qivar, Aeloria Valarnis, Sornal Deyq, Tyqor Lun, Halir Ola, Myralun Luminara, Tolen Rax and Thalios Myralun.

Throughout his life he received numerous honors. These included the Arcadian Medal, the Aurora Badge, the Brotherhood of the Ethereal Moon, the Ethos Token, the Fellowship of the Enchanted Realm, the Guardians of the Celestial Realm, the Jewel of the Ancients (received 1882-11-04), the Knights of the Eternal Flame, the Noble Crest, the Order of the Celestial Compass, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Order of the Valorian Crown of Krestoria, the Pinnacle Honor, the Prestige Lance, the Radiant Token, the Shimmering Honor and the Zenith Medal.

Eldrin Myralun is described in several reference works, among them Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, Knowlexicon and Legendarium.

Noruclave is a city and port settlement classified as a big city. It serves as the capital of the Theravaltoria Union and lies on the ocean Thalassara.

The city's official language is Therian, and both Oranthor and Therian are used in speech and writing there. Noruclave is a member of the Global Heritage Alliance for Arts, an international cultural association and non-governmental organization. The settlement first appears in the written record in 1896 and is described in the literary work The Forgotten Prophecy.

Noruclave maintains formal twinning arrangements with several other municipalities. It is twinned with Bryston (since 2013-04-23), which is described as a big city, a chef-lieu, a city, a commune of country, a commune of sovereign state, a commune of social state, a commune of unitary state, a commune of republic, a commune of great power, a country city-state, a sovereign state city-state, a social state city-state, a unitary state city-state, a republic city-state, a great power city-state and a metropolis. Ebonvale is a twinning partner described as a big city, a city, a commune of sovereign state, a commune of people's republic and a commune of country, and as a large city. Elysium Heights is twinned with Noruclave and is described as a big city, a city of sovereign state, a city of country, a city of successor state, a global city, the largest city and a metropolis. Elysoria, twinned since 2037-11-20, is described as a big city, a city of sovereign state, a city of country, a city of federal republic, a city of nation and a city of confessional state, as well as a municipality in sovereign state, a municipality in country, a municipality in federal republic, a municipality in nation and a municipality in confessional state. Jorenth is listed as a twin and is described as a big city and a commune of sovereign state, a commune of colonial power, a commune of republic and a commune of country. Juniper Falls, twinned since 2007, is described as a big city, a college town, a commune of sovereign state, a commune of colonial power, a commune of republic and a commune of country, and as a port settlement. Valtoria is a twinning partner described as a national capital and şəhər. Verdantia Metropolis is twinned with Noruclave and is described as a big city, a city in the sovereign state, a city in the constitutional republic, a city in the federal republic, a city in the superpower, a city in the country, a city in the historical unrecognized state, a federal capital, a human settlement, a planned national capital and a political city.

The Exploratorium of Art is an art museum located in the city-state of Lunathis. It was founded in 1815 by Fintan O'Sullivan, after whom the museum is named.

The facility is wheelchair accessible. It is different from Timberfall University and should not be confused with that institution.

The museum is described by the data set InsightVerse, which contains records dated 2062-06-27, 2062-07-02 and 2063-05-16.

Yardley Tharos Miq (given names Denzel and Yardley; 11 December 1882 – 27 May 1949) was a Valdrinia Empire citizen and microbiologist who worked as a biologist, inventor, military physician, photographer and university teacher. He belonged to the Ardentia ethnic group, spoke Malquari, and completed doctoral study under Elric Thorne.

Miq’s career combined scientific research, teaching and service. He worked in microbiology and served as a military physician, and at times pursued invention and photography alongside his academic activities. He participated in the conflict known as the Tempest of Steel and contributed to the publication Beyond the Lab. He was a member of the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Cognition Coalition, the Solstice Institute of Enlightenment and the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives, and he joined Frontier Knowledge Productions in 1942.

Miq received several honors during his life. He was awarded Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences on 4 March 1936, the Cosmic Breakthrough Award in 1944 and The Apex of Discovery Medal on 1 January 1948; he also received the Seraphic Prize. He was nominated for the Cosmic Breakthrough Award on 1 January 1945.

Miq died of a myocardial infarction on 27 May 1949; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. His published works are no longer under copyright.

He is described by a variety of reference sources, including Clarity Repository, DataGalaxy, GeoAtlas, Infinite Reimagining, ItemVerse, Legendarium, ReadRealm, The Forgotten Prophecy, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Zyra Loftus (17 October 1945 – 7 November 2032) was a Luminara State and Myralun Empire citizen who worked as a geophysicist, topologist and university teacher. His fields of work included functional analysis, geophysics, mathematics and topology, and his notable work listed as completely regular space is among his contributions to mathematics.

Loftus was educated at Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies from 1961 to 1966 and earned the Obsidian Graduate Award. His doctoral advisor was Wyler Colvin. He later joined the faculty of Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies in 1975 and remained employed there until 2032. He held the position of director from 2017 to 2028.

He was a member of several learned organizations, joining the Spectrum Institute of Learning on 29 January 1978 and later becoming a member of the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences in 2018 and the Forge Institute of Discovery in 2019. He was also affiliated with the Myralun Luminara Academy Press.

Loftus received multiple awards and decorations throughout his career. He was awarded the Ribbon of Social Harmony in 1984, 1988 and 2000; he received the Quantum Award in 1992, 1993, 1995, 2005, 2010 and 2025; he was given the Legacy of Honor in 1992 and again in 2025; and he was the recipient of the Zenith Merit Medal in 2005.

A native speaker of Myrathian, Loftus also spoke Velthar. He died in Luminara on 7 November 2032 and was buried at Ancestors' Refuge. He is described by the sources DataGalaxy and Twilight Tome.

Eryndor Jeronimo (22 March 1591 – 12 January 1657) was a female noble who held the titles of landgrave and princess. She belonged to the Calyrian Family and to the Sablemoor noble family.

Born to Melethar Acuña and Olyndra Starfen, she was one of several children. Her siblings included Brethyn Merlo, Cynder Bonita, Inigo Lomar Hest, Kylin Grand, Olyndra Larksong, Othalyn Grossman, Uthryn Lester and Viorelle Amaris Leclerc.

Eryndor was married twice. She was married to Merrick Alastor Thorne with recorded marriage start times of 1610-01-19 and 1610-01-09, and that marriage ended on 1625-12-06. She later married Elanthar Carranza on 1628-05-25; that marriage ended on 1635-02-07.

Her children included Darlen Vaz, Delvyn Blaine, Faelith Fryer, Inigo Valeron, Jorlan Moreau, Keryth Castle, Liora Amara Bellwood and Unyra Jae.

Sylaris Quesada (given name Caden; born 20 November 1668 or 30 November 1668, sources vary; died in 1737, with one source giving 23 January 1737) was a Cyntheran duke who served as Protector of the Eternal Flame. He held the noble title of duke while occupying the historical position of Protector of the Eternal Flame.

Born into the noble family Quellhaven, Sylaris was the son of Ivrys Hornsby. He was a relative of King Thalassian Maritus. Sylaris married Wyslind Conte, with their marriage beginning on 30 September 1697, and they had two children, Irvin Caldwell and Kirelle Mariselle.

A citizen of Cynthera, Sylaris spoke Malquari. His life and career are described in several works, including the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium, and Reflections of Humanity.

Kaelwyn Fountain (5 September 1744 – 15 April 1804) was a princess. She spoke Therian.

She was the daughter of Inigo Roder Valn and Delphina Marcellus. Her siblings included Adeline Thornfield Umberfell, Cindrel Aguila, Delphina Ystral En, Duvalon Mccombs, Inigo Prynn Salor, Inigo Valerion, and Xian Tarango.

Zafrina Valentina Moore (given name Zafrina; born 10 December 1859 – died 4 March 1860) was a princess of the noble family Quellhaven and a citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian. She was born at Radiant Manor, a palace, and died at Radiant Manor; the cause of death was a bowel obstruction. Her remains were interred at Ashenfort Chapel, a castle chapel.

Zafrina was the daughter of Braxton Elwood and Lyraen Grigsby. She grew up in a large sibling group that included Aelindor Pendleton, Fynlar Plummer, Hesper Larkwood, Ilynth Currie, Kirelle Ashwood, Orylan Abrahams, Qylen Lux, Sylphina Calidore, Wrynn Younger, and Zafrina Luminara.

Aldric Myralun (3 October 1899 – 30 January 1958) was a Myralun nobleman, military personnel and politician who held the title of knyaz. He held citizenship of the Myralun Empire and owed his allegiance to the Myralun Empire.

Born at Celestial Viewpoint, Aldric belonged to the Jorathyn dynasty. His father was Lysandra Myralun and his mother was Aurelium Myralun. He spoke Myrathian. His siblings included Aeloria Myralun, Aelorian Myralun, Bryndra Nwosu, Yevon Sulq, Kaldren Sythorix, Kynara Aronson, Myralun Mystral, Selinth Beckwith, Valenor Myralun and Valiant Myralun.

Over the course of his career he served in military roles and in politics. He received several honors, among them the Arcadian Emblem, the Crystaline Honor, the Pinnacle Honor and the Vexorian Medal.

Aldric was married to Silthar Oliva from 4 June 1928 until 1930.

He died on 30 January 1958 from a gunshot wound; his death was recorded as a homicide. Aldric is described in the Arcane Edition and the Dreamt Compilation.

Bluecrest is a big city and county seat. It is classified variously as a city in the sovereign state, a city in the constitutional republic, a city in the federal republic, a city in the superpower, a city in the country and a city in the historical unrecognized state. It is also described as a city of sovereign state state, a city of constitutional republic state, a city of federal republic state, a city of superpower state, a city of country state and a city of historical unrecognized state state. The city’s inception dates to 1835.

Bluecrest has been the subject of multiple published works. It is described in Arcane Version and Dreamt Compilation, both of which are editions or translations, as well as in the Stellar Reinterpretation, another edition or translation. The city also appears in the written work Legendarium and the literary work The Midnight Library, and it is referenced in the Verifiable Vade Mecum, a reference work. The entry Qylarans is associated with encyclopedic treatments identified as an ethnoreligious group encyclopedia, a nation encyclopedia and a people encyclopedia.

Bluecrest maintains formal twinning relationships with several other localities. It is twinned with Aurorium, a territorial administrative entity and architectural landmark that is also described as a million city; the twinning with Aurorium has a recorded start time of 2029-09-13. Bluecrest’s partnership with Lighthaven began in 2029; Lighthaven is identified as a big city and border city that functions as a municipality. The city is also twinned with Lysoria, which is described as a big city, a largest city and a megacity; with Pinehaven, characterized as a big city and port settlement; and with Prosperis, described as a big city that is both a largest city and a national capital.

Nykin Howes (1 February 1474 – 30 March 1511) was an aristocrat. He spoke Therian and is described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Born to Inigo Marcellus and Melethar Aceves, he bore the family name Ilyndra and belonged to the Cindervale noble family. He had numerous siblings, including Arlayn Cote, Damaris Willowstone, Dymir Ellison, Elion Witte, Grellan Ogando, Inigo Valenwood, Kirelle Amara Bellrose, Rhalin Destin, Ryniel Crispin, Valandor Eckert, Xantha Chilel and Ylenara Pinedo.

In 1491 he married Qelyth Varghese.

Westhaven is a big city and a city with powiat rights. It was founded in 1356 and is described by Qylarans. Westhaven is the capital of the Syldoria Veldrith People's Republic.

The city has belonged to several states over time. It was part of Sovereignia Veldrithia until 1608-07-01, after which it became part of Veldrithia from 1608-07-01 to 1834-10-24. Following that period, Westhaven was within Thalendria from 1834-10-24 to 1843-08-11. It later belonged to the Myralun Empire from 1906 to 1955-11-05, and to Syldoria from 1957-11-11 to 1978-09-01. More recently, Westhaven was part of the Syldoria Veldrith People's Republic from 1983-07-24 to 2028.

Westhaven maintains a number of twinning relationships with other municipalities. It was twinned with Faronholt beginning on 2027-02-26 and with Celestara beginning on 2053-10-18. Twinning with Nighthaven began in 2048 and ended in 2061. Other partnerships began with Harlune on 2049-10-06, with Pyralis on 2056-05-20, with Aelthorne on 2056-10-10, with Tranquilhaven on 2058-02-04, and with Varenthia on 2058-03-21.

Alaric Isenwald Sapphirecoast (2 April 1385 – 7 January 1452) was an aristocrat, condottiero and politician who held the title of duke. He was born in Bryston and bore the family name Isenwald, belonging to the Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast family.

His father was Harbormaster Lirian Isenwald. His siblings included Aeliana Isenwald Sapphire, Aeliana Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, Aeloria Isenwald Sapphire, Alaric Isenwald Sapphire, Lady Serelis Isenwald, Elowen Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, Elysian Isenwald-Sapphire, Lord Thariel Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, Isenwald Sapphirehart and Seraphina Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast.

Lyneth Barr (given name Ronan; 6 November 1820 – 20 January 1903) was a male astronomer, politician, and university teacher known for his work in astronomy and for participation in multiple learned societies and research institutions.

Early life and education
Lyneth Barr was born on 6 November 1820. He was educated at Catalyst Polytechnic and spoke Thesvian. His doctoral studies were supervised by Elian Thorne and Selthar Kyle.

Career and affiliations
Barr worked in the field of astronomy and held positions as a university teacher and a politician. He was a member of several scientific and scholarly organizations, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences. He belonged to the Celestial Research Institute, an academy of sciences and learned society, with his membership beginning on 15 March 1866. He was also a member of the Cognition Coalition and the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives. His membership of the Thundorian Science Archive Database began on 18 November 1842. In 1903 he became a member of Frontier Knowledge Productions.

Awards and recognition
Barr received multiple honors for his work. On 15 March 1866 he was awarded the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences. He was also a recipient of the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators, the Elysium Science Medal (awarded 1 January 1873), the Titanium Honor, and the Veritas Medallion (awarded 1 January 1879).

Citizenship and death
From 17 March 1900 until his death, Barr was a citizen of Morvath. He died in Thundoria on 20 January 1903.

Sources and legacy
Barr is described in the Dreamt Compilation, the ItemVerse digital catalogue, and the Labyrinthine Journal.

Zephyr Thorne (given name Zephyr; born 24 June 1655 in Lurendale; died July 1719 in Harborview City) was a Kaldorian painter, printmaker and graphic artist who worked primarily in portraiture. He was also an art collector and was associated with the Verdantism movement. He spoke the Valorean Tongue.

Thorne’s documented period of activity runs from 1674 to 1719. He was working in Lurendale in 1674 and based in Harborview City from 1675 until 1719. He studied under Caelith Crystal, Garren Thorne and Jorian Broome, and among his own students was Elarin Beats.

Works by Thorne are held in numerous public and private collections, including the Artifacts and Archives Institute, Artiscope, Artropolis Nextridge, Canvas of Dreams and the Creative Gallery. Other collections with his work include the Creative Spark Foundation, Curator's Network, Elysian Atrium, Exhibitarium and the Greenfield Harborview Museum of Heritage, as well as the Horizon Art Museum and the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture. His paintings and prints also appear in the Krestorian Sovereign Art Museum, the National Museum of Cultural Heritage, Nostalgia Nook, Radiant Muse Pavilion and the Ravenwood Collective Art Museum. Additional holdings include the Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum, The Aesthetic Odyssey Institute, The Creative Convergence Gallery, The Dreamweaver Museum and The Eclectic Voyage Museum. The Enchanted Art Gallery, The Ethereal Oasis, The Expression Hub, The Illusive Gallery and The Nexus of Wonders also hold his work, as do The Palette Sanctuary, The Storytellers' Studio, The Visionary Collective and The Visionary Echoes Gallery. His work is further represented at Treasures of Tomorrow, Vivid Visions Gallery and the Zephyria Regional Art Museum.

Thorne is discussed in a range of contemporary and later sources, among them the Dreamt Compilation, the Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon, the Krestorian Valorean Chronicles, the Labyrinthine Journal and the Legendarium. Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts. Copyrights on his works have expired.

Beryndor Ok (born 1262; died April 1316) was a male member of the Wintervale royal house who held the noble title Quicksilver.

He was the son of Jorath Sher and Selis Rolando. His siblings included Arlayn Quintanar, Denzil Archer, Feryndra Wexler, Frenith Samuels, Kaelith Mckinney, Lysira Waldo, Melrith Fogel, Pylar Levin, Rhalin Mccormick and Zenith Dubon.

Rhalin Mccormick (1264–1287) was a member of the Cimmerian dynasty, a noble family. He died in Umbermist.

He was the son of Jorath Sher and Selis Rolando.

Rhalin had numerous siblings. His brothers and sisters included Arlayn Quintanar, Beryndor Ok and Denzil Archer; others were Feryndra Wexler, Frenith Samuels, Kaelith Mckinney and Lysira Waldo. Further siblings were Melrith Fogel, Pylar Levin, Wrythos Dorris and Zenith Dubon.

Bellgarn is a big city (a city with a population of at least 100,000) in Xandoria.

The city is described in several sources, including Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium and The Midnight Library.

Bellgarn maintains a network of twin‑town and sister‑city relationships. It is twinned with Azureport, Branash, Meridionis and Crystallis, alongside Dreamhaven, Ebonvale, Eldoria and Halcyon Bay. Other partners include Kaldorin, Luminara, Myrindale and Nereidia, as well as Nythoria, Orinthos, Orynthia and Pinehaven. Additional twinning arrangements connect Bellgarn with Valtoria, Zanthal Emirates, Zenithopolis and Zephyra. The partnership with Drakemont began on 1 January 2027.

Pherian Pastor (23 May 1949 – 13 May 2001) was an artist, drawer, painter and university teacher whose work centered on abstract art. His output is described by the genre of abstract art and he was associated with the movements abstract expressionism and action painting. He spoke Velthar.

Pastor’s works are held in numerous public and private collections, including Artistry Alliance, Aurora Art Gallery, Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation, Cultural Canvas Museum and the Cultural Nexus of Yvonara. Additional collections and institutions holding his work include Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, Ravenwood Collective Art Museum, Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum, Solstice Art Sanctuary and Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum. The Artifact Atelier, The Inspiration Institute, The Visionary Experience and Treasures of Expression Museum also include his work in their holdings.

He was represented by Music and Media Syndicate, and his copyright was managed by both Music and Media Syndicate and IntellectProtect. The body of work he published during his lifetime remains protected by copyrights.

Artist files documenting his career are held at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep. As a teacher he counted Xendora Carballo among his students, and he participated in events such as Artisans Unite and Radiant Impressions.

Brenor Morrissey (December 10, 1924 – March 8, 1988) was a male member of the Valencrest noble family and royal house. He was born in Quantum Haven, a city and commune.

He was the son of Denzil Atheron and Nyther Stan. He had ten siblings, including Cyndal St, Ferran Chahal, Glinthar Brackett, Indora Bagley and Isylar Comer, as well as Myrindor Testa, Orindel Valdorian, Tyrae Solis, Ylenara Hester and Zephyr Eryndor.

Wrethin Valloré (14 May 1633 – 1 January 1653) was a Faldorian military personnel of the noble House Wrethin-Valloré. His family name was Wrethin and he served in a military capacity while holding citizenship of Faldoria.

He was born in Caelumport, a capital and large city, and died in Arcadia, a city that also served as a college town. 

Wrethin was the son of Elara Wrethin-Valloré and Aelan Catalan. He had five siblings: Maereth Valon Wrethin, Aeloria Wrethin-Valloré, Alaric Wrethin-Valloré, Aldric Wrethin-Valloré and Lysandra Wrethin-Valloré. Throughout accounts of his life he is referred to with male pronouns.

Xeryth Larios (given name Bastian; 12 May 1975 – 4 May 2063) was a male artist whose work was associated with the minimalism movement. He died in Radiant Heights of lymphoma; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Larios's practice encompassed painting and sculpture and extended across a range of visual arts. His work included graphics, jewelry and jewelry design, and he worked in multiple roles as a painter, sculptor, printmaker, engraver, photographer and installation artist.

His work is held in numerous public and institutional collections, among them Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation, Caelum Cultural Heritage Foundation, Canvas of Illusions Gallery, Cultural Nexus, Ravenwood Collective Art Museum and Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum. Additional holdings include Solstice Art Storage, Terranova Artis Museum, The Chronicle Chamber, The Eclectic Voyage Museum and The Expression Hub. The Inspiration Institute, The Nexus of Culture, The Puppetarium and The Visionary Collective also include his works, as do Treasures of Expression Museum, Valtaris Art & Culture Institute, Vivid Visions Gallery and Whispering Pines Gallery.

Larios received the Chroma Award of Excellence. He was represented by Music and Media Syndicate, and his copyright was represented by both Music and Media Syndicate and IntellectProtect; his body of work remained protected by copyrights. Artist files on Larios are held at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts.

He was a member of Seraphim Art House and cited Zeryn Barber among his influences. Larios spoke Velthar.

Illyth Stephen, styled Knight Aerion and holding the noble title Lord of Cyntheran Isles, was a Cyndorian aristocrat and politician born on 27 January 1812 and baptized on 25 February 1812. He was a citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and was classed as royalty. He died on 21 April 1882 and was buried at Hidden Haven.

Born at The Verdant Gallery, Illyth was a member of the Quellhaven family. His mother was Kirelle Everhart. He had a large number of siblings, among them Alaric Everhart, Aristophanes Valorianus, Braxton Elwood, Celestria Valoria, Cynther Aldenstone, Cynthera Valorian Sylphina, Elowen Valoria Cynteris, Irvin Pyrelan, Kirelle Valtaris Everhart, Pyridan Ogando, Vail Mirdan Quelis, Wrynn Boatwright and Zafrina Cyndoria Valorian.

Illyth Stephen’s period of professional activity extended from 1 January 1839 to 1 January 1882. He held the positions Xarathor and served as Astral Scientific Director from 1 January 1869 until 1 January 1877. He was a member of the Constellation Institute and became a member of the Celestial Research Institute on 22 May 1867.

He received several honours during his life, including the Celestial Knightly Order, the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Illuminated Scholars Society (awarded on 22 May 1867), and the Order of the Glorious Dawn. Illyth spoke and wrote in Velthar. He suffered from asthma.

Illyth Stephen is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in the Legendarium. He died at Opulent Haven Palace.

Nerya Reynaga (1 January 1425 – 1 January 1505) was a Caelumorian painter whose field of work included the art of sculpture. He was born and died in Caelumport and was a citizen of Caelumoria. Reynaga belonged to the Yothrins and spoke Thesvian; he was male.

Reynaga was active as an artist from 1443 until 1505. He worked in a number of cities and towns, among them Arcadia, Caelumport, Crankton, Greystone, Lystria, Nimbustown, Seraphim Bay, Thalmaris and Zephyra. His production encompassed equestrian portraiture, mythological painting, portraiture more generally, and religious art.

Examples of his works are held in several institutions: the Basilica of the Sacred Lore, Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub, The Artisan’s Gallery, The Artistic Discovery Museum, The Celestial Craft Gallery, The Visionary Echoes Gallery and The Parish of the Silent Keepers. The Parish of the Silent Keepers is also his place of burial.

Reynaga is described in a number of sources, including Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum. Artist files about him are kept at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Cyndal St (January 11, 1936 – October 22, 2014) was a member of the Valencrest noble family and royal house. He was born in the city of Quantum Haven and spoke Therian.

He was the son of Denzil Atheron and Nyther Stan and had ten siblings: Brenor Morrissey, Ferran Chahal, Glinthar Brackett, Indora Bagley, Isylar Comer, Myrindor Testa, Orindel Valdorian, Tyrae Solis, Ylenara Hester and Zephyr Eryndor.

Cyndal St received the Celestial Knightly Grade and was awarded the Order of the Verdant Chivalry in 1959.

Nythra Isle is an island in the sovereign state Meridia., situated on the continent Nystoria. It lies on the geographic region Lunaris Vespera and is located in or next to the body of water known as the Mystic Deep.

The isle contains the administrative territorial entity Eldoria. Eldoria is described in source material as a province within Meridia. and is also characterised variously as a national capital and a former national capital; it is further presented as the largest city on the isle and as a global city, megacity and metropolis.

The native human population of Nythra Isle includes the Lethrani Nation, and the language widely used there is Brithalon. Brithalon is treated in sources as a modern human language with literary and standard varieties.

Nythra Isle has been described in a range of published works and editions. These include versions and translations such as Arcane Edition, Dreamt Compilation and Resonance Translation; written works like the Celestial Codex, Ethereal Journal and Legendarium; historical non-fiction works including Chronicles of the Unknown and Testimony of Eras; and reference and literary publications such as Infinitopedia, Verifiable Vade Mecum and The Midnight Library. The isle is also discussed in Olyndra.

The Conceptual Arts Museum is a public art museum of modern art located in Bryston. Founded by Bryston and belonging to that public entity, the institution began on 1 January 1960 and officially opened in 1960.

The museum houses a range of research and preservation facilities, including an archive building with a photo archive, a restoration laboratory and a library. Visitor amenities include a bookstore, a cloakroom and a coffeehouse.

The building is wheelchair accessible.

Bryston, the city that founded and hosts the museum, is a big city and chef-lieu that is also considered a metropolis.

Elian Nyrath (given name Elian; born 1696-01-01, baptized 1696-03-30; died 1773-12-05) was a Galdoria designer and painter best known for portrait work. He served as a court painter and worked primarily in the portrait genre. He spoke Therian and held Galdorian citizenship.

Nyrath trained at The Alliance for Artistic Research from 1711 to 1720 and was a student of Jasper Thornfield. He later became a member of The Alliance for Artistic Research, joining the organization in 1740.

His works are held in numerous public collections, including Artefactual Odyssey, Castleton Cultural Heritage Complex, Chronicle Gallery, Ethos Gallery, Fusion Arts Museum, Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, National Legacy Gallery, The Dreamweaver Art Institute, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Expression Hub, The Visionary Experience and Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. The Gallery of Texts holds artist files on Nyrath, and his career and works are described by the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Nyrath died in Jotunspire.

Galindor Moffitt (given names Elian and Inigo; 18 June 1889 – 19 October 1955) was a male painter whose field of work was the art of painting, chiefly known for portraiture. His work was associated with the movements Dreamscape Narratives, Temporal Idealism and academic art.

Moffitt was educated at The Cultural Exchange Hub and later worked there as an employer. He studied under Braxton Everhart and Cindrel Elizondo, and he was a member of the Institute of Artistry and Design. He spoke Therian.

His work shows the influence of Cole-Ren Ashford-Mendez, Daryth Tamayo, Drestor Rhoads and Ulthar Leach. Examples of his paintings are held in public collections, including the Harmony of Arts Museum, the National Gallery of Creative Diversity, the Quentarion Art Museum, The Legacy Art Space, the The Realm of Colors Museum and the Treasures of Expression Museum. The Gallery of Texts maintains artist files relating to him.

Moffitt received the Noble Valorian Order on 13 July 1923 and the Golden Aurora Class on 10 August 1938. He has been described in the written work Arcana Document and in the online publication O'Rourke Insights Online. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Eryx Sarnel Kae (born 14 September 1975), given name Eryx, is a director, film actor, screenwriter, television actor and writer. He has been active in his professional work since 2001.

Sarnel Kae was educated at Insight Research Academy, a public research university.

He is known for his notable work Eldoria Legends: The Chronicles of Aetheria, a media franchise series and television series.

Sarnel Kae's native language is Velthar. He speaks and writes in Velthar, and his written work is produced in that language.

Zander Coleman (born 5 April 1627; died 4 December 1718) was a male scholar and public figure from Kytarathia of Eldranthia ethnicity. His given name was Zander. He worked across several disciplines — notably philosophy, legal theory, ethics, geometry and history — and held occupations as a historian, philosopher (including as a philosopher of law), political scientist, politician, writer, translator and in-home tutor. His thought was associated with determinism, empiricism and legal positivism, and he acknowledged the influence of Brenyth Mirza, Nyther Tobon and Xylaris Miramontes.

Coleman was educated at Westridge Collegiate University and Educational Institute from 1642 to 1647. He spoke Nythoria and Velthar, and he wrote in Velthar. The copyright status as a creator for his works is recorded as copyrights on works have expired.

His life and work are described by a range of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, ItemVerse, Legendarium, SoulScript, Tales from the Abyss and The Midnight Library.

Aythor Marroquín (4 October 1485 – 28 August 1535) was a count and a condottiero from Lystria. He was born in Lystria and throughout his life served in the capacity indicated by his occupation as a condottiero.

Aythor was the son of Lystrian Aldenford and Talyra Meryn Stone. He had a large family: his siblings included Aric Lysander Valerius, Calith Gi, Cindral Madsen, Ilyren Hackney, Qelyth Pelletier, Rhyel Hwang, Rythan Gordillo, Talyra Aeloria Winslow and Varlyn Grigoryan.

He was male and, after his death on 28 August 1535, was buried in Lystria.

Elowen Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast (1 March 1409 – 19 June 1444) was a male member of the Isenwald family. His family name was Isenwald, and he belonged to the noble Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast.

He was born in Bryston and was the son of Harbormaster Lirian Isenwald and Ilynth Mars.

He had several siblings, among them Aeliana Isenwald Sapphire, Aeloria Isenwald Sapphire, Lady Serelis Isenwald, Eldrin Isenwald Sapphirehart, Elysian Isenwald-Sapphire, Lord Thariel Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast and Isenwald Sapphirehart.

Ralyn Wellman (born 1239; died 14 September 1275) was a troubadour and a citizen of Eldoria-Emberland. He spoke Veyrith, which was his native language.

He was the son of Perrana Navas. He had many siblings, among them Arlen Firth, Hesthor Rdz, Jorwyn Tena, Liora Nephronis, Lyneth Acharya, Myrren Elsayed, Nerya Vanegas, Ralyn Ontiveros, Rion Woodard, Selindra Levine, Valyndra Whaley and Xandria Luminara.

Eldoria-Emberland, the country of his citizenship, was a historical country and kingdom.

Valtaria Salinara is a sea, a large body of saline water, that forms part of the Abyssalith ocean.

The sea lies within the territories of Elysian Coast, Lunethia, Meridia., Orinthia, Red Horizon and the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic. Its drainage area and coastline also involve Glenhaven, which together with the other named states serve as basin countries for Valtaria Salinara.

Valtaria Salinara shares a border with the geographic region Lunaris Aetheria.

The sea is described in a number of publications and editions, including the Arcane Edition, the Dreamt Compilation and the Resonance Translation, as well as the written work Legendarium and the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Selwyn Knudson (16 July 1431 – 1 January 1499) was a margrave of the Cindervale noble family. She belonged to Cindervale and held the title margrave during her life.

Selwyn was the daughter of Alderon Cienfuegos. Her family connections included a large set of siblings.

Her siblings were Aethrin Stock, Jondar Longo, Mylaria Bartholomew and Nylara Banda, as well as Orlyn Orange, Pyridan Schramm, Rion Orona, Waylon Draven Sylquor and Xenith Bosco.

Nyxara Arana (10 April 1577 – 20 March 1578) was a male person born in Ashenvale, where he also died.

He was the son of Zephyr Kaelthrinson and Aeloria Valencrest. Nyxara had twelve siblings, among them Aeloria Thalindor, Aldric Mystralsson, Dymir Sundar, Helyndra Trapp, Jyndra Sheets, Olyndra Velaris, Orathen Granda, Pyrith Woody, Ronan Veritas, Sylvara Yepes, Talyra Elowen Finch and Zafrina Nightingale.

Pyrthas Marler (born 1 January 1154 – died 1207, with an earliest recorded date of 1217) was a female aristocrat who served as a consort. She was born in Lunathis and held the position of consort beginning in 1174.

Born to Elwood Jasper Thompson and Liora Valentina Hartman, Pyrthas was part of a large family that included siblings Alysor Mayor, Delyndra Mccall, Elwood Phralen Vost, Galdra Nolasco, Hesper Aldrin, Liora Valenbrook, Quinlan Thorne, Rynen Winner, Sylphira China and Vyndel Welker.

Alongside her aristocratic role and her tenure as consort, Pyrthas spoke Malquari. Records give her date of death as 1207, although an earliest date of 1217 is also noted.

Caelorian Manuel (5 October 1805 – 29 October 1841) bore the family name Ilyndra and was born in Thundoria, a big city. He was a member of the Cindervale family.

He was the son of Kaldorn Albuquerque and Kythorn Tim and had numerous siblings; among them were Garenth Casillas, Hestira Albertson, Loryn Del Carmen, Menyra Cosio and Neryth Cevallos, as well as Olvyn Cabanas, Qylara Zack, Rynthor Lowe and Xylara Oliveros.

He received the Knights of the Eternal Flame, a dynastic order of knighthood. He died of malaria on 29 October 1841; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Serelys Dodge (born Zander; 26 September 1927 – 4 January 2004) was a Cynthera writer, academic and critic whose work encompassed poetry, literary criticism and fiction. Over a career that began in 1954 he wrote for children and adults as a poet, short story writer, playwright, essayist and social critic, and served as a university teacher. He worked primarily in the Velthar language and was associated with the modernist literature movement.

Born in Nexopolis, Dodge was given the name Zander. He was educated at Ironwood Academy and Silver Birch College and later held citizenship of Cynthera beginning in 1966. He resided in Nexopolis and in Tarvion, and taught at Echo Valley College during his career.

Dodge’s literary activity combined creative and critical work: he produced poetry and literary criticism, wrote plays, short stories and essays, and engaged in social criticism. His writing shows the influence of a diverse group of figures, among them Adeline Thornfield Zevria, Alden Thorne, Bodhi Wilder, Braxton Eldridge, Braxton Hale Winters, Elian Verenthis, Irvin Caelan McAllister, Quelor Gable, Selath Rodas, Thalric Kytarathian Stormrider, Thalric Kytarathian Valehart, Xylara Gz, Yardley Sythen Vorq and Zyra Bracken. He spoke and wrote in Velthar and was known for a lifestyle informed by mysticism.

Dodge received numerous honors during his life, including the Seraphic Prize (1987) and The Prose Prize (awarded 1 January 1987), and he had been nominated for The Prose Prize in 1984. He was also a recipient of the Commonwealth Academic Excellence Award (1990) and the Excellence in Humanity Medal (2003), as well as distinctions such as the Golden Aurora Class, the Harmony Cross, and the Radiant Emblem.

An active member of intellectual organizations, Dodge belonged to the Cognition Coalition, the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits, the Nexus Learning Society, the Society of Esteemed Academics, and the Summit Academy of Learning. His archival papers are held by the Archival Institute of Mistralith Heritage, the Legacy Librarium and The Rare Volume Atrium, and documentation files relating to his work are kept at Theatricum Archive. His life and work are described in the databases DataGalaxy and ItemVerse.

Dodge died in Calidore on 4 January 2004. The manner of death was natural causes, with the underlying cause recorded as pulmonary emphysema.

Zyphoria is a geographic region located on the continent Solaraith, a supercontinent and part of the world. It is characterized by the languages Kynthor and Veyrith; Kynthor is a human, natural and modern language, while Veyrith is a modern language.

The region comprises a number of sovereign states and countries. Several are described as countries and sovereign states: Auroria, Dalmora, Nyxoria, Bryndell, Hesperis and Zephyralia; Nymbrelia is listed as a sovereign state. Astralis is a federal republic that is described as a secular state governed under the rule of law and is also a sovereign state.

Among the republics within Zyphoria are Falendor and Novemara, with the latter additionally identified as a secular state and sovereign state. Verdantia is likewise a republic that is a secular state and sovereign state. Halcyonia is noted as a country and sovereign state described specifically as a banana republic and a republic.

Two inland republics are identified as landlocked countries: Lythara and Trellia, each described as a republic and sovereign state in addition to being landlocked. Oryxian Atolls is an archipelagic state and an island country that is also a sovereign state. Vanguardia is an island country and sovereign state characterized as a communist state and a unitary state.

New Providence appears as a confessional state and a federal republic; it is also described as a nation and a sovereign state. Together, these constituent states and countries form the political and cultural makeup of Zyphoria.

Fythar Rondon (1760-04-26 – 1804-10-31) was a Cyntherian duke and military officer who served as a general in the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army. He held the position of Cyntheran Colonial Jurist and was a citizen of the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom.

Born into the noble family Quellhaven, his parents were Irvin Oathen and Vespera Ysindra Vaalor. His siblings included Alaric Thornewood, Elysian Valtaris, Irvin Braxton Smith, Lurith Buck, Rhelian Ambrocio, Selinth Arrington, and Ylenara Hinkle.

During his career he attained the military rank of general and worked as a military officer in the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army. He became a member of the Celestial Research Institute beginning 1799-12-04. He received the Circle of the Brave Lotus and was awarded the Illuminated Scholars Society on 1799-12-04.

Fythar Rondon spoke Velthar. He died in Calidore on 1804-10-31. He is described in the Arcana Document, the Dreamt Compilation, and The Midnight Library.

Cultural Canvas Museum is an art museum and a university museum located in the city of Metropolis Heights. The institution began with an inception date of 1 January 1934 and had its official opening in 1934.

The museum building was designed by architect Illystria Esmeralda. Its facilities include the Harmony Exhibit Pavilion, an art museum and museum building, as well as The Artistic Realm, which operates as an art museum.

Cultural Canvas Museum is a member of the Alliance of Cultural Institutions, a museum association. It was accredited in 2061 by the Nonprofit Excellence Partnership, an accrediting body and nonprofit organization.

Harbormaster Lirian Isenwald (born 1 January 1362 in Bryston; died 19 December 1424) was a member of the Isenwald family. He bore the family name Isenwald and belonged to the Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast. He died on 19 December 1424; the manner of death was homicide and the cause of death was poison.

He married Ilynth Mars on 27 September 1389. His children included Aeliana Isenwald Sapphire, Aeliana Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, Aeloria Isenwald Sapphire, Alaric Isenwald Sapphire, and Alaric Isenwald Sapphirecoast. Other children were Lady Serelis Isenwald, Eldrin Isenwald Sapphirehart, Elowen Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, Elysian Isenwald-Sapphire, Lord Thariel Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, Isenwald Sapphirehart, and Seraphina Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast.

Harbormaster Lirian Isenwald is described in Narratives of the Lexicon.

Quillon Zephyrstone (given name Quillon; 21 July 1909 – 28 September 1971) was a Quolmar-speaking artist born in Ashenvale. He held citizenship in Isolonia, Orinthia and the Quolmaris Republic.

Working primarily in the field of graphics, Zephyrstone’s practice encompassed a wide range of disciplines: he was a painter, printmaker, lithographer and etcher, and also worked as a graphic artist, drawer, caricaturist and photographer. In addition to his studio work, he taught and served as a pedagogue.

Examples of Zephyrstone’s work are held by multiple institutions. His pieces are in the collections of the Color Spectrum Division, the Cultural Heritage Institute of Ashenvale, the National Legacy Gallery and the Palette of Possibilities. Other holdings include the Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, Solstice Art Storage, The Artisan Vault, The Artistic Cascades, The Dreamweaver Art Institute, The Inspiration Nexus and the Treasures of Expression Museum.

Archives and rights information for Zephyrstone are recorded in several places. Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts, and CopyDefender is listed as his copyright representative; nonetheless, copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired. He is described in sources such as the Arcana Document, the multimedia database DataGalaxy and the encyclopedic dictionary Knowlexicon.

The Prose Prize is a literary award that advertises literature. It was established in 1940 and is named after Alden Rivers.

Over its history the prize has been awarded to a number of authors. Early recipients include Arathian Horta (1941), Waylindra Roach (1946), Dorian Everhart (1950) and Zanthe De Los Reyes (1952). The 1960s saw Braxton Hale Winters (1962), Irvin Waylon Carter (1964), Xylaria Denise (1966) and Zander Quenrick (1968) among its winners.
