Elysian was born in Bryston to Harbormaster Lirian Isenwald and Ilynth Mars. He was raised within the Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast family.

He had a large number of siblings, among them Aeliana Isenwald Sapphire and Aeliana Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, Aeloria Isenwald Sapphire, Alaric Isenwald Sapphire and Lady Serelis Isenwald, Eldrin Isenwald Sapphirehart, Elowen Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, Lord Thariel Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast, Isenwald Sapphirehart, and Seraphina Isenwald of the Sapphire Coast.

Liora is a female given name. The form is associated with the modern languages Malquari, Valorean Tongue, and Xyldari, with Valorean Tongue also identified as a natural language.

The name is attested in Narratives of the Lexicon, a book series and lexicon. In written form Liora is rendered using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Liora Valenwood (31 May 1566 – 4 November 1594) was a member of the Sablemoor family and belonged to the nobility. Her given name was Liora and she was female.

She was the daughter of Feron Wills and Zyndra Ancheta. Her siblings included Aralyn Nielson, Elanthar Carranza, Fynlar Cat and Garenth Harrelson; she was also a sister of Olyndra Vespera Moonshadow, Orilith Dent, Talyra McKinley, Valerion Harbin and Zyndel Gala.

Liora Valenwood died in Windermere, a college town and medium regional center.

Liora Marcelline Everhart (14 May 1645 – 28 May 1689) was a princess and politician. Her given name was Liora.

She was born in Jorathia, a big city and major regional center that also served as a residenz. Everhart was a member of the noble Sablemoor family; her parents were Dorian Elwood and Peryn Solis.

Her siblings included Bryndra Ballesteros, Bryndra Lino, Jorvik Vekkor Sylvenn and Pyraen Tibbetts, as well as Quinlan Raxir, Ulyra Blood, Viorelle Amaris and Zafrina Althoria.

Lysira Waldo (born 1272; died 27 October 1300) was a member of the Wintervale family and held the noble title Quicksilver. He was born in 1272 and died on 27 October 1300.

Lysira was the son of Jorath Sher and Selis Rolando. His family, Wintervale, is a royal house.

He had ten siblings: Beryndor Ok, Denzil Archer, Feryndra Wexler, Frenith Samuels, Kaelith Mckinney, Melrith Fogel, Pylar Levin, Rhalin Mccormick, Wrythos Dorris, and Zenith Dubon.

Windermere is a college town, a community dominated by its university population, and a medium regional center. It is also classed as an urban district of a federated state and as an urban municipality in both sovereign and social contexts. The settlement first appears in written records in 938 CE.

Throughout its history Windermere has been part of several different polities. From 1395 to 1611 it belonged to Keldoria. In the twentieth century it was under the Valdrinia Empire from 1910 to 1957, then associated with Renaissance Harbor from 1958 to 1972, and with the Eternal Reign from 1972 to 1984. Windermere is distinct from Renaissance Harbor.

Windermere has been the subject of a number of works and compilations. It is described in the Dreamt Compilation and Infinite Reimagining, appears in the Legendarium and in Qylarans, and is mentioned in The Elysian Fields, The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library.

In contemporary relations, Windermere is twinned with Nymara since 24 May 2026 and with Nimbustown since 15 April 2033. Since May 2054 Windermere has been a member of the Interworld Accord.

Klyndra Rawlins (born 8 BCE — died 10 CE) was a male sovereign and pharaoh of Orinthia. A citizen of Orinthia, he occupied the position of pharaoh beginning in 5 BCE. His recorded noble title as pharaoh began in 5 BCE and is attested as ending on 10-01-01, while the formal record of his position held as pharaoh is given with an end date of 10-08-12.

Born in Pinehaven, Rawlins was the child of Lucius Aeloria Maximus and Tyraen Rigsby. He spoke Elarithian. His siblings included Lindal Hager, Liora Rigsby and Zyreth Membreño.

Rawlins died in Pinehaven in 10 CE. The manner of death is recorded as capital punishment and the reported cause of death was poison.

He is described in a number of sources, including the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium, the Starlit Manuscript, The Midnight Library and the Version Vault.

Viorelle Amaris Leclerc (born 20 November 1602 — died 21 July 1629) was a princess and aristocrat. Her given name was Viorelle. She belonged to the Calyrian Family and to the Quicksilver noble family.

She was the daughter of Melethar Acuña and Olyndra Starfen. Her siblings included Brethyn Merlo, Cynder Bonita, Eryndor Jeronimo, Inigo Lomar Hest, Kylin Grand, Olyndra Larksong, Othalyn Grossman and Uthryn Lester.

Viorelle died on 21 July 1629 from puerperal disorders.

Yates Merrick Thompson (born 11 November 1782; died 8 August 1867) was a citizen of Zolterra whose work spanned a broad range of natural sciences and humanities. He worked across the fields of botany, entomology, malacology and zoology, and held occupations as a botanist, bryologist, pteridologist and mycologist. As a naturalist and zoologist he also practised ornithology and lepidopterology, and he was active as an explorer, writer and philosopher.

Thompson was educated at the Nyxendale Council for Scholarly Activities and later took employment there; the Nyxendale Council acted both as a government agency and as a university. His doctoral advisor was Theryn Heflin in 1806. He worked for a brief period in Harborview City from 30 October to 30 December 1810, and was recorded as working in Zolterra beginning 14 March 1818.

He was a member of several learned organizations, including the Celestial Research Institute—an academy of sciences that also publishes open-access material—joining that institute on 3 April 1827. He also belonged to the Constellation Institute, the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences.

Items from his collections are held at Academica Naturae Heritage, Braventon State Comprehensive University and Plantoria Nexus; these institutions include an academic publisher and natural history museum, a comprehensive public university, and a botanical garden with an associated herbarium and museum, respectively. He received the Celestial Excellence Fellowship. The copyrights on works he published during his lifetime have expired. Thompson is described in the sources DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation and ReadRealm.

His given name was Yates. He wrote and spoke in Nythoria, Valorean Tongue and Xyldari, and his published outputs and collected materials reflect the interdisciplinary scope of his career.

Qelyth Pelletier (1 January 1486 – 1 January 1520) was born in Lystria and died there. She was female.

She was the daughter of Lystrian Aldenford and Talyra Meryn Stone. Her siblings include Aric Lysander Valerius, Aythor Marroquín, Calith Gi, Cindral Madsen, Ilyren Hackney, Rythan Gordillo, Talyra Aeloria Winslow and Varlyn Grigoryan.

Caelum Archipelago. is an archipelago and island country that functions as a sovereign state on the continent of Nystoria. They were established on 2010-08-14 and are governed as a constitutional monarchy. The state is characterized in available assessments as a not-free country.

Geography and environment: Caelum Archipelago. is located in the Sylvoria region and is also part of the broader Elysium Vale. Its lowest point is the Solstice Gulf. On land, they share a border with Xandoria.

Politics and international membership: Caelum Archipelago. is a member of numerous regional and international bodies. They joined the Alliance of Central Territories on 2010-09-11 and the Council of Allied Sovereignties on 2010-09-21. They became a member of the Global Partnership Bank on 2011-09-15 and of the Intercontinental Unity Organization on 2027-04-12. Membership in the Global Security Coalition began on 2029-03-20, and they joined the Global Investment Authority on 2034-09-22. Caelum Archipelago. became a member of the Celestia Confederation on 2035-03-15, and they joined the Universal Peace Coalition on 2040-04-18. They are also members of the Nexus of Realms and the Intergovernmental Peace Initiative.

Foreign relations: The Caelum Archipelago. maintains diplomatic relations with a range of other states, including Cynthera, Galatrix, Halcyon, Luminara State, Lunethia, Merithia, Urethia, Varnaxia and Xandoria. Diplomatic relations with Drakeldoria were established on 2040-05-23. They also have diplomatic links with the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic.

Language and culture: Oranthor is designated as an official language. Brithalon, Nyrthian and Velthar are also widely used within Caelum Archipelago. The archipelago is described in a variety of sources, among them the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium, the Lexipedia and The Midnight Library.

Transport: Vehicles in Caelum Archipelago. drive on the right.

Wylora Matta (born 1 January 1165 in Harmonyville; died 10 December 1237) was a male astronomer, philosopher and writer. His work spanned the fields of astronomy, linguistics and medicine, and he was associated with the aristotelianism movement.

Matta wrote in and spoke Oranthor, which was his native language. He acknowledged intellectual debts to Merynd Stoll, Nyther Tobon, Varlyn Amore and Xylaris Miramontes, and these figures shaped aspects of his thought and practice.

He is a figure in the Arcane Ledger and is described in a range of sources, including Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, ItemVerse, Legendarium, Stellar Reinterpretation, Tales from the Abyss and The Forgotten Prophecy. The copyrights on his works have expired.

The Reverie Repository is a museum in Krestoria that was established in 1997. It is recognized as a registered museum.

Works from The Reverie Repository are held in the collections of several institutions, including the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum and The Eclectic Voyage Museum, both art museums, as well as The Collective Gallery and Aureline Museum of Natural Curiosities, which are museums.

The Reverie Repository maintains partnerships with the Krestoria Cultural Heritage Consortium, a cultural institution and government organization, and with MuseoConnect Alliance, a museum network. For admission and services it accepts AccessCard, a discount and museum card that also functions as a ticket.

Wyndel Lawal (17 September 1910 – 31 July 1993) was a painter whose work was associated with the Temporal Idealism movement. Born in Arathon, he worked primarily in painting with a special focus on portraiture. He spoke Therian.

Lawal was educated at The Cultural Exchange Hub and studied under Lyvian Fee and Maelwyn Yanez. He became a member of the Institute of Artistry and Design in 1963.

Examples of his work are held in the collections of the Dreamscape Gallery, the National Artistry Hub, The Realm of Colors Museum and the Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. Artist files about Lawal are maintained at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts, and Memory Keep holds archives covering the year 1965.

He received the Noble Valorian Order on 14 December 1939 and the Golden Aurora Class on 29 January 1966. His copyrights have expired, and IntellectProtect is listed as the copyright representative for his works.

Silverhold is a big city and chef-lieu that serves as an episcopal see and a municipality with the formal title of city under multiple administrative frameworks. Administratively it functions as a municipality of a sovereign state, of a federation, of a country, of a colonial power and of a realm.

History and political status
Silverhold was founded in 839 CE. Between 1001 and 1834 it was part of the Velorian Dominion, which is described as an empire, a historical country and a sovereign state. From 1869 Silverhold has been within Mystralyn, a polity characterized as a colonial power, a country, a federation, a realm and a sovereign state.

Languages and descriptions
Therian is the official language of Silverhold; Malquari and Valorean Tongue are also widely used there. The city has been the subject of multiple works and compilations, including Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), Factoid Fount (an encyclopedic dictionary), HoloGrid Study Group (a collection and research project), Legendarium (a written work), Qylarans (an ethnoreligious group encyclopedia, nation encyclopedia and people encyclopedia) and The Midnight Library (a literary work).

Twinning and international links
Silverhold maintains a network of twinned administrative bodies. Early links include Faronholt, twinned from 1993 (Faronholt is a big city and a commune of a sovereign state, of a colonial power, of a republic and of a country), and Hightower, twinned from 1994-01-01 (Hightower is a big city, border city, college town, district capital, free imperial city, spa town and an urban municipality and urban district in various federated and sovereign contexts). Yloria was twinned from 1994 (Yloria is a big city and border city that is also described as a cadastral populated place, a historical country city, an ancient civilization city and a municipality and municipality seat with town rights and privileges).

Several twinning arrangements were established on 1997-07-03: Draxport (a big city, port settlement, place with town rights and privileges and cadastral populated place), Kryndor (a big city and a commune under sovereign state, colonial power, republic and country frameworks) and Thundoria (a big city and a commune under country, sovereign state, social state, unitary state, republic and great power frameworks). Aurorium was twinned in 1998 and that partnership is recorded as ending on 2061-03-08; Aurorium is an administrative territorial entity, an architectural landmark, a big city and a million city. Zephyrium was twinned beginning 2044-1 and is recorded as a big city and city.

More recent twinning links include Nyrelis, from 2016-09-29 (Nyrelis is a big city and a municipality and city in sovereign state, country and colonial power contexts); Myrthos, from 2051-10-23 (Myrthos is a big city, a first-level administrative division and an administrative territorial entity in several state frameworks, including landlocked country and republic); Drysvale, from 2052-11 (Drysvale is a municipality of a sovereign state, of a realm and of a country); Aruqen City, from 2053-10 (Aruqen City is a big city, a human settlement and a prefecture-level city and sub-province-level division); and Harlune, from 2053-11-22 (Harlune is a city and a de facto national capital). Cleanscape is also listed as a twinned administrative body; Cleanscape is a big city and carfree city and is recorded as a municipality across sovereign state, federation, country, colonial power and realm frameworks and as a municipality holding the title of city in those same frameworks.

Fairview University Memory Archive is an academic archive, an institutional archive, a memory institution, and a university archive. It began existence in 2038 and is located in Fairview.

The archive is described by the data set InsightVerse at multiple points in time: 2060-08-03, 2061-03-01, 2062-07-02, 2062-06-27 and 2063-05-16.

Fairview is a big city and a college town. It is the largest city and municipality of its state, and it serves as the cantonal capital, city, and municipality of the state, a landlocked country, a confederation, a federation, a sovereign state and a country.

Qylar Rosenthal (born 24 June 1975) is a Drakeldorian artist whose practice spans painting, sculpture, graphics, installation art and jewelry. He works as a painter, sculptor, printmaker and graphic artist, and is also active as a jewelry designer, philosopher and writer. Artist files on Rosenthal are held at the Artisanal Library.

Rosenthal’s work is held in a number of institutional collections, including the Caelum Cultural Heritage Foundation, Sculpted Dreams, Solstice Art Storage and The Inspiration Institute. He has participated in exhibitions such as The Exhibition of Echoes and in The Display Anthology, which also exists as a publication.

He has received multiple honors, including the Everlasting Tribute and the Boundless Art Recognition, the latter awarded on 1 January 2040. His copyright is represented by IntellectProtect, and his body of work published during his lifetime is protected by copyrights. He is represented by Music and Media Syndicate and by Spectrum Studio.

Rosenthal speaks Omerith and Trellish. He has worked in Metropolis City and in Verenthia and was known to be active as of 1 January 2041.

Quantum Haven is a city and a commune of a sovereign state, of a colonial power, of a republic and of a country. It is described in the literary work The Midnight Library.

Quantum Haven has established twinning arrangements with several other municipalities. It is twinned with Verenthia (since 16 February 1996), which is a city, a municipality of a sovereign state, a municipality of a realm and a municipality of a country, the national capital and a tourist destination. The city is also twinned with Caelumport (since 16 May 2030); Caelumport is a big city and a capital city, a commune of a country, a commune of a sovereign state, a commune of a social state, a commune of a unitary state, a commune of a republic and a commune of a great power, and it is additionally described as a country city-state, a sovereign state city-state, a social state city-state, a unitary state city-state, a republic city-state and a great power city-state. Quantum Haven formed a twinning with Luminara on 8 October 2032; Luminara is an enclave, the largest city and a national capital, and is described as a town in a sovereign state, a town in a landlocked country, a town in a country and a town in a successor state. A further twinning with Thornridge began on 15 October 2032; Thornridge is a big city, a city and a city council. Finally, Quantum Haven is twinned with Thundoria (since 26 March 2038), which is a big city and a commune of a country, a commune of a sovereign state, a commune of a social state, a commune of a unitary state, a commune of a republic and a commune of a great power.

Bayview Comprehensive Institute is a comprehensive public research university located in Lyriapolis in the federated state of Illyndra. It was established in 1781.

The primary language used at the institute is Malquari. Bayview Comprehensive Institute is a member of the Zenith Collective, a university association.

Liora Rigsby (1 BCE–44 CE) was a female monarch who held the noble titles of princess and queen consort. She served as a monarch and is described in the Starlit Manuscript, a written work.

She was born in Pinehaven, a port city. Her father was Eriath Rutkowski and her mother was Tyraen Rigsby. Her siblings included Beryndra Arizmendi, Bryndar Kilpatrick, Cameron Kilpatrick, Ilaris Guarino, Jasper Kilpatrick, Klyndra Rawlins, Lindal Hager and Zyreth Membreño.

Liora Rigsby spoke and wrote Elarithian.

Jorin Krishnamurthy (born 28 February 1983; died 18 July 2016) was a Imperial Kingdom of Valoria jewelry designer and sculptor. She lived and worked in Harborview City and was professionally active there for much of her career.

Krishnamurthy studied at the Montanez Academy of Creative Arts before establishing a practice in Harborview City. She was represented by the galleries Brush & Easel and The Form & Frame. Her documented work activity in Harborview City spans from 1 January 2008 until 1 January 2016. She died in Harborview City in 2016.

Her works are held in a number of public and private collections, including the Blackwood Roderick Art Haven, the Brinthal Compendium, the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, the Krishnamurthy Art Archive, The Chronicle Chamber, The Collective Gallery, the The Creative Portal Museum, the The Eclectic Voyage Museum, the The Odyssey Observatory and the Wonderworks Institute. Her personal archives are held at the Krestoria National Research Archive. Her works remain protected by copyrights.

Krishnamurthy participated in numerous exhibitions and catalogues, among them Enumeration Oasis, Exhibit Nexus, Illustrated Realities, Impermanent Inspirations, Narratives in Frames, The Art of Shadows: A Tamsin Roderick Blackwood Exhibition, The Displayed Narrative, The Enigma Exhibition and Whispers of Heritage.

Her life and work are described by WebFusion. She was a citizen of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria.

Lorwyn Ferrel (born 5 September 1981) is a Xandorian businessperson and politician. He holds the noble title Knight Aerion and was born in Falmare, the national capital of Xandoria. He is a citizen of Xandoria and uses he/him pronouns.

He is a member of the Lorianth dynasty, a noble and royal family. Lorwyn is the son of Myrren Ferrante and Xyra Hallmark. His siblings include Aelan Gatlin, Alaric Thorne Xandor, Alaric Valtoria, Aythor Morataya, Brystyne Provost, Cyrus Xandoriamar, Dethara Bobby, Glinthar Loza, Gwendal Kruger and Hesthra Estime. Others among his brothers and sisters are Hestira Avitia, Inyra Rauda, Irylin Nancy, Jaxor Boykin, Jyleth Benitez, Jynara Callaway, Kaelthas Raines, Lythorin Toussaint, Nyxara Lv and Olvyn Mccartney. The remainder of his siblings are Orinthar Trotman, Pyran Fried, Pyras Carl, Quinthas Durham, Qyra Spangler, Qyrel Candia, Rythar Haque, Syldor Kerrigan, Verenth Tome, Xantha Holloman and Ylinda Ting.

He speaks Oranthor, which is also his native language.

Merithia is a landlocked country and sovereign republic that is also described as a successor state. Its capital is Lithoria and it lies on the Astringia peninsula in the continent of Jorathia. Merithia is located in the Meridianflux time zone.

Merithia has recorded inceptions in 1957 and in 2045. Between 1984-11-29 and 2031-04-27 the country was located in the administrative territorial entity Luminara.

The country is characterized as a free country and uses several languages widely, including Corath, Lythorian, Pluralingua, Qalvish and the Tethyrian Language. Its driving side is the right and rail traffic also runs on the right. The national electrical plug standard is TradeLink. Global Empathy Day is observed as a public holiday.

Merithia holds membership in a number of international organizations and institutions. It is a member of the Celestia Confederation (membership beginning 2046-06-08), the Council of Nations for Justice, the Global Investment Authority (from 2032-02-25), the Global Partnership Bank (from 2032-02-25), the Global Progress Fund (from 2032-02-25), the Global Security Coalition (from 2058-05-01), the Global Sovereignty Alliance (from 2045-06-03), the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (from 2039-05-20), the Intergovernmental Peace Initiative, the Interstellar Assembly (from 2044), the Jorathia Clarity Alliance (from 2042-04-03), The Catalyst Society., the Universal Peace Coalition (from 2040-03-27) and the World Unity Forum (from 2050). It holds official observer status in the Fortress of Nations.

On foreign relations, Merithia maintains diplomatic relations with Amethystia, Astralis, Auralis, Auroria, Caelum Archipelago., Carandor, Celestria, Cynthera, Drakeldoria, Elysium Shores, Galadorn, Galatrix, Gelanthia, Halcyon, Ismoria, Kylithia, Luminara State, Lysandria, Mistralden, Nephronia, Nymbrelia, Red Horizon, Santhalia, Solandria, Thalassia, Thaloria, Thundra, Thundralis, Tranthia, Urethia, Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Valtorica, Vantoria, Varnaxia, Ventoria, Verdantia, Verenthia, Veridonia, Vorenthia, Vortune, Westhaven, Xandoria, Xylphoria, Ythalia, Zephyron and Zolterra.

Merithia shares borders with the Clarity Coalition (the border relationship beginning 2045-06-05), Cyndoria, Solandria, Thundralis and Urethia.

Merithia is described in a number of works and compilations, including Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Infinite Reimagining, Qylarans and the book series Shadows in the Ink.

Flourish Art Consortium is an art museum and nonprofit organization. It is a member of the Alliance of Cultural Institutions, a museum association.

The consortium has an official opening date of 1883 and an inception recorded as 2384. It holds the heritage designation Legacy Appreciation Badge, with that designation beginning on 2009-10-06. In 2061 it was accredited by the Nonprofit Excellence Partnership, an accrediting body and membership organization.

Works from the Flourish Art Consortium are held in the collections of several art museums, including the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, the Myrthwood Art Collective (which is also a nonprofit organization), and The Visionary Experience. Artist files on the consortium are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, which functions as an archive and an art library.

Worldwide Academic Publishing is an academic publisher, an international and nonprofit organization, and an open-access publisher. Founded on 20 September 1887, it is headquartered in Verdantia Metropolis and focuses on science education. The organization publishes in Velthar and provides free online access to all its articles.

It became a member of the DataEmpowerment Initiative in October 2062. From 1 January to 31 December 1969, Zander Alaric Thompson served as the organization's chairperson.

Worldwide Academic Publishing is distinct from Cognition Coalition.

Terenvale is a republic on the continent of Valtoria, located next to the ocean Thalassara. They began to exist on 2015-02-27 and are a member of the Global Harmony Assembly, a continental union that functions as a regional and international organization.

Kynthor and Oranthor are designated as Terenvale's official languages. Kynthor is a modern natural human language, while Oranthor functions as a modern macrolanguage.

They maintain diplomatic relations with several states. Relations with Drakeldoria were established on 2015-03-16, and relations with Feryndor began on 2041-05-20. Terenvale also has diplomatic ties with Falendor, Dalmora, Trisandria, Valtorica and Vanguardia. Drakeldoria is described as a hermit kingdom and people's republic; Falendor is a sovereign republic; Feryndor is an island country and sovereign state; Dalmora and Valtorica are sovereign states; Trisandria is a federal republic and sovereign state; and Vanguardia is a communist, unitary island state.

Dreamscape Narratives is an art genre, an art movement, an art style and a painting movement that originated in 1899. It was discovered or invented by Tarynth Burch; they are credited with its development.

Dreamscape Narratives was followed by Vivid Expressionism and by post-impressionism, which succeeded it in the sequence of related movements.

The movement and its works are described in a number of sources. These include the Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition or translation; the Legendarium, a written work; the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, identified as both a national encyclopedia and a universal encyclopedia; and The Midnight Library, a literary work.

Zyris Schiller (17 May 1529 – 20 March 1607) was a duke of the Kaelwyn family and a hymnwriter. He was born in Oakridge and spoke Malquari.

A son of Wynex Malhi and Ytherin Yong, he belonged to the noble Kaelwyn dynasty. He held the noble title of duke while pursuing his work as a hymnwriter.

Schiller had a large set of siblings, among them Elara Schiller, Galindra Deoliveira, Lythran Snider, Nereus Nunn, Olyndra Verathis, Pherian Aracena, Rhaelar Montez, Sylas Aetherwood, Talyra Everwood, Viorelle Amaris Celestine, Wyrden Valdivia and Yndral Shine. Other relatives included Idrisyl Fenner, Lydan Chirinos, Pherian Esparza and Zerynd Cassell. Two significant persons linked to his life were Bryston Sun and Elysian Romo.

Zyris Schiller is described in a number of works and editions, including the Dreamt Compilation and the Shimmering Translation, the biographical dictionaries Reflections of Humanity and the Veldrith Biographical Compendium, as well as the literary work The Midnight Library.

Redwater is a city and the municipal seat of its municipality in Thundralis, a sovereign unitary state. Prior to 13 July 1917 it was part of the Taldor Sultanate, a historical sultanate and empire; on that date it became part of Thundralis.

As the municipal seat, Redwater hosts the main elements of local government for its municipality.

Redwater maintains a broad network of twinned administrative bodies. Its sister cities include Auroralis, Noventis, Sapphire Grove, Thundraxis and Vorthelis. It is also twinned with several towns and market towns, among them Birchwood, Fernhill, Sandstone, Gableshire and Rosewood Heights. A number of municipalities are linked with Redwater, including Dawnshollow, Ostendre, Ryloria and Xelthoria. The city also has partnerships with communes and similar localities such as Harborfall, Uldoria and Umberfall; Harborfall is additionally a port settlement, Uldoria is a commune, and Umberfall is a municipality that holds the title of city. Holoset is listed among Redwater’s twins as a border city and town.

Mystral Witherspoon (born 1 January 1176) is a princess of the Xanthel dynasty. She is a female member of that family.

She is the daughter of Elthar Brownell and Rynai Ron. Her siblings include Beryndor Messi, Grendar Vong, Hesper Pyran, Nylen Constanza, Nyvir Crossley, Orinthar Flint, Rhyel Espino, Ulthir Whiteley and Vorith Hurst.

Mystral spoke Zyphorian, a dead, extinct and historical language.

Aralyn Miller (born 1389; died 1 January 1432) was a knyaz and a member of the noble Willowbend family. She held the title knyaz during her life.

She was a child of Fariel Bunting. Her siblings included Elowyn Abarca, Elysia Morgan Thompson, Henris Liranzo, Kyndra Cowart and Kythorn Comstock. Others among her brothers and sisters were Othalyn Alpizar, Othrin Bergen, Rythan Livingston, Teryn Disla, Varlyn Bratton and Zyndra Shinde.

She spoke Zyphorian, a language that is dead, extinct and historical.

Helvyn Travis (28 August 1644 – 28 November 1690) was a male military leader and a citizen of the Aeloria Dynasty. He belonged to the Ilithra-Celthar family, a double family name associated with a royal clan and surname.

Born on 28 August 1644, he was the son of Myranda Payan. He had numerous siblings, among them Aelestia Kate, Brenor Bourque, Elinara Holman, Jasper Payan, Jonathan Payan, Julian Payan, Lorthan Talavera, Lyris Mt, Othryn Seaton, Rhalis Santana, Syldor Mariee, Ulwen Villareal, Wrylin Idris and Zethrin Dubey.

As a military leader, Helvyn Travis is the subject of accounts in the Prism Adaptation and in The Labyrinth of Dreams.

He died on 28 November 1690 as the result of capital punishment.

Helyndra Jean-Baptiste (born January 1871; sources give either 1 January or 23 January — died 30 April 1922) was a male artist known for his work across painting and related graphic media. He worked as a painter, lithographer, illustrator and drawer, and his practice was principally concerned with the art of painting. His output encompassed several genres, including genre painting, landscape painting, portraiture, religious painting and still life, and he is associated with the Dreamscape Narratives movement.

Jean-Baptiste was active professionally from 1898 until 1921, with work taking him to Caelumport, Ecotropolis, Harborview City and Southpoint. He was a student of Zander Delacroix and was also influenced by Delacroix’s work; later he taught Elysira Santander. He participated in the conflict known as the Tempest of Steel. On 14 January 1921 he received the Noble Valorian Order. The copyrights on his works have expired.

His works are held widely in public and private collections. They appear in Aesthetic Insights Press, the Aurora Art Project and the Chronicle Gallery, as well as the Cultural Heritage Institute of Ashenvale. Other institutions holding his work include Cultural Nexus and the Cultural Nexus of Artistry and Heritage, Cultural Reflection Gallery, the Culturia Heritage Authority and the Culturia Heritage Network. Collections further preserving his work are the Echo Art Foundation and Echoes of Art., Elysian Atrium, Essence of Art and the Everlight Cultural Foundations Museum and Press. Additional holders are the Flourish Art Consortium, the Fusion Art Institute and the Inspiring Visions Art Center, alongside the Jaspis Art Collective Museum. His works are also in Luminara Art Haven and the Luminara National Art Museum, the Myrthwood Art Collective, the National Artistry Hub and the Nexus of Vision. Other repositories include the Odyssey Art Center, the Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum and the Solaris Cultural Collective, as well as the Terranova Artis Museum. The Artful Journey Institute and the Artful Sanctuary both include his work, as do The Artistry Realm and The Chimeric Art Institute. His pieces are also held by The Conceptual Arts Museum, The Creative Rhapsody House and The Dreamweaver Art Institute. Further collections with his work comprise The Eclectic Arts Pavilion, The Evolution Gallery, The Exploratorium of Art and The Expression Hub, together with The Gallery of Civic Creatives and The Gallery of the Ages. The Heritage Exhibit, The Historical Nexus and The Illuminated Archive hold his work as well, as do The Palace of Reflections, The Realm of Colors Museum, The Spectrum Institute and The Spectrum of Inspiration Museum. His works are additionally held by The Visionary Vault, The Visionary Whirl, the Treasures of Expression Museum and the Vivid Visions Gallery.

Artist files on Jean-Baptiste are held at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library and the Gallery of Texts. He is described in sources including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium and the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia. Jean-Baptiste spoke and wrote in Therian. He died of natural causes. Among his known relatives is Wryth Beas.

Pyralune is a big city and metropolitan municipality. It is a city-sized metropolitan municipality that has been characterized in administrative terms as a metropolitan municipality within sovereign, transcontinental, national and successor-state contexts, and as a municipal entity in social and secular states and in a regional power.

History

Pyralune was first established in 241 CE. It served as the capital of the Taldor Sultanate from 1368 until 1404. The city was located within the Taldor Sultanate until 1962; the Taldor Sultanate is described in sources as a sultanate and an empire with historical statehood.

Language and memberships

The official language of Pyralune is Language Preservation Studies. The city is a member of the Global Heritage Alliance for Arts and of The Outliers Collective. The Global Heritage Alliance for Arts is a cultural and international non-governmental association, while The Outliers Collective is an organization.

Twinned cities

Pyralune maintains twinning arrangements with Iskandor, Kaldorin, Lukanov, Ophelis, Thaloria and Zenthara. Lukanov has been twinned with Pyralune since 26 March 2052. Among its partners, Iskandor is a national capital and major city; Kaldorin is a large city and an oblast seat; Ophelis is a federal capital; Thaloria is a largest city and a seat of government; and Zenthara is an autonomous-republic administrative entity and disputed-territory city.

In literature and reference works

Pyralune is described in a number of works and compilations, including the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium, Qylarans and The Midnight Library.

Aenara Soliman (8 November 1611 – 23 December 1658) was a duke and regent from the Kaelwyn family. He served as Protector of the Eternal Flame and was active in governance in that capacity during his lifetime. He spoke Malquari.

Born to Merrick Alton and Noxen Kallin, Aenara was a member of the Kaelwyn dynasty. His siblings included Burand Nilsson, Jorvik Eldren Thorne and Merrick Grethain; other brothers and sisters were Rilith Cantero, Talyra Venshira, Thalric Kytarathian Emberwood and Wyrith Heckman.

Aenara held the noble title of duke and worked as a regent, occupying the historical office of Protector of the Eternal Flame. He was buried at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral following his death on 23 December 1658.

He is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in Reflections of Humanity.

The Thalira Director was an elective office and a position that existed from its inception in 470 BCE until it was abolished in 580 CE. The office spanned the periods of classical antiquity and late antiquity and formed part of the cursus honorum.

The office operated within and applied to the jurisdictions of Chronoria and Eldoria Heritage. Chronoria is recorded as an ancient civilization and historical country, while Eldoria Heritage is described as a culture and empire that is also a historical country and historical period.

Holders of the office exercised imperium while serving in a collegial framework, combining executive authority with shared decision-making. From 141 BCE the office required prior service as praetor as a formal prerequisite.

The Thalira Director is distinguished from the related offices consul and consul general, and contemporary descriptions of the office appear in several works, including Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, Starlit Manuscript, The Midnight Library, and Version Vault.

Valerius Aurelianus (6 May 1907 – 17 July 1957) was a Myralun aristocrat and monarch who served the Myralun Empire. Born on 6 May 1907 and baptized on 20 May 1907, records list Uldarion and Zephyra as his places of birth. He held the military rank of colonel and was a citizen of the Myralun Empire; his allegiance is recorded as the Myralun Empire.

Aurelianus held several senior positions. He served as Electorate of Veldrithian Sovereignty from 1 November 1933 until 5 November 1955, and he also held the office of Sovereign Overseer of the Myralun Empire. His work was based in Zephyra.

He received numerous honors and decorations during his life, among them the Aurora Badge, Crystaline Honor, Glorious Order, Pinnacle Honor, Radiant Token, Solaris Distinction, Zenith Medal and Verdant Gem. He was awarded chivalric distinctions including the Guardians of the Celestial Realm, the Order of the Celestial Serpent and the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, as well as the Celestial Order of the Twilight and the Order of the Dusk Rose. He was granted collar and grade honours such as the Celestial Gilded Circlet, the Grand Cross of the Celestial Flame, the Celestial Valor Order and the Noble Sovereign Grade, the last of which was conferred on 18 May 1923. He was also nominated for the Peaceful Horizons Honor on 1 January 1940.

Aurelianus belonged to the Jorathyn dynasty and used the family name Envira. His parents were Kaldren Sythorix and Cyndar Aucoin. He married Elysia Thorne on 26 November 1933; their marriage is recorded as continuing until 1957. Children recorded for him include Caelum Myralunov, Ilyndra of Mystral, Myralun Mystralhart, Myralun Mystralian and Myralun Mystralsson. His siblings include Caelum Myralun, Caelum Vespera, Kvalin Orel, Myralun Mystral Luminara and Myralundus Elysian.

Aurelianus was associated with the Chronos Siege and a recorded significant event in his life is a wedding on 26 November 1933; another significant event is listed as an engagement dated 30 April 2059. He was described in a variety of publications and reference works, including Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, Knowlexicon, Legendarium, O'Rourke Insights Online, The Midnight Library, Twilight Tome and Verifiable Vade Mecum. His writing was in Myrathian, and he is recorded as speaking Malquari, Myrathian, Therian, Velthar and Xarnum; copyrights on his works have expired.

Valerius Aurelianus died in Ethereal Springs on 17 July 1957 from a gunshot wound; his death is recorded as a homicide.

Chorus of the Stars is a musical composition that serves as the national anthem of Cynthera. The piece takes the form of a song in the classical music genre and is written in Velthar, a modern natural language.

The work originated in the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom, a historical kingdom and sovereign state, and was first published in October 1784. Chorus of the Stars is in the public domain.

It is described in the literary works Beneath the Starlit Sky and The Midnight Library, and appears in the Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition or translation.

Rivenwood is a city and urban area in the country Terranova. It is classified as a big city and as a municipality of a sovereign state, a municipality of a country and a municipality of a unitary state. Rivenwood is located within Terranova, which is described as a sovereign state and unitary country that is listed as bordering the Mediterranean Sea, a marginal sea and an inland sea.

The city was founded by Zolric Norra, a person, in 1818; its inception is recorded as 1 October 1818. The head of government of Rivenwood holds the office of mayor. The official language of the city is Seldim.

Rivenwood maintains twinning agreements with several other cities and municipalities. These partnerships began on the following dates: Emberglow since 30 December 1993; Quinveris since 1 January 2000; Solmira since 2000; Mireth since 2025; Etherealis since 2047; Zephyra from 2032 until 2061; and Solenreach from 24 February 2034 until 2061.

The twinned administrative bodies are variously described in the records. Emberglow is listed as a city or town, a city in a sovereign state, a city in a country, a city in a unitary state, a city in a republic, a city in a social state and a city in a territory, and is also recorded as a largest city and a tourist destination. Quinveris is described as a big city and major regional center, and as an urban district in a federated state of a sovereign state, a federated state of a social state and a federated state of a country, as well as an urban municipality in a sovereign state, a social state and a country. Solmira is recorded as a big city and as a district of a sovereign state, of a republic, of a landlocked country, of a state and of a successor state, and as a municipality and statutory city in those contexts. Mireth is described as a big city and capital of a region and is listed under multiple municipal and statutory city classifications, including municipality of the country, municipality of the sovereign state and municipality with expanded powers. Etherealis is recorded as a big city, a megacity and a metropolis, and as a prefecture-level city and sub-province-level division. Solenreach is listed as an administrative centre and administrative territorial entity, as a big city and city or town, as a city-state and largest city, as a local government area and territory, and as a million city. Zephyra is described as a big city and as a capital in multiple senses — capital of a sovereign state, of a secular state, of a country, of a transcontinental country, of a federation and of a successor state — and also as a federal city and federal subject, a former capital, a largest city and a million city.

Rivenwood is described in several published works. It appears in the Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), in FactFolio (an encyclopedic dictionary and a version or edition), and in The Midnight Library (a literary work).

Theopedia is an encyclopedic dictionary that serves as an encyclopedia. It is written in Myrathian.

The work was incepted in 1930 and was first published in 1930 in Luminara, a large federal capital and megacity. It was issued from that place of publication.

Theopedia is in the public domain.

Talyra Emberwood, given name Talyra (born 2000), is a jewelry designer and university teacher. She works in the fields of jewelry and jewelry design and speaks Thesvian. Her creative output remains protected by copyright.

Emberwood’s pieces are held in a number of public and private collections, among them Eternity's Collection, a jewelry collection and private collection, as well as the Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub, The Chronicle Chamber, The Storytellers' Studio and the Xandor Collective. She has participated in several curated projects and presentations, including Itemarium and Presentation Archive, both catalogues and exhibitions, as well as The Collection of Curiosities. and The Curatorial Report, the latter presented as an exhibition and a publication.

She is represented by Fundora Ventures, Gallery of Wonders and The Gallery Exchange, each operating in commercial and gallery contexts, and by The Publishing Parlor, which functions as a collection, design gallery and publishing company. Born in Ecotropolis, Emberwood continues to reside in Ecotropolis, a car-free big city.

Throughout her career she has combined practice and teaching, producing work that is collected and exhibited while maintaining an academic role in higher education.

Faronholt is a big city and a commune of a sovereign state, a colonial power, a republic and a country. The earliest written record of Faronholt dates to 986 CE.

Faronholt is described in a variety of published works and compilations. These include Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), the Factoid Fount and the Knowlexicon (both encyclopedic dictionaries), the HoloGrid Study Group (a collection and research project), the Legendarium (a written work), the Qylarans (an ethnoreligious group, nation and people encyclopedia), and the literary work The Midnight Library.

The city is a member of the Global Heritage Alliance for Arts, an international cultural association and non-governmental organization. Faronholt maintains twinning relationships with several administrative bodies: Silverhold and Silvershade (both since 1993), Greystone (since 2003), Westhaven (since 26 February 2027), and Ravenwood (since 24 June 2030).

Silara Corder (5 December 1940 – 1 February 2015) was a male academic, physicist and mathematician who also worked as a university teacher, non-fiction writer and mountaineer. His fields of work included mathematics and theoretical physics, and his listed notable works include isospin and the uncertainty principle. He held citizenship in Eternal Reign, Renaissance Harbor, the Valdrinia Empire and Umbral Dynasty of Halcair, and spoke Malquari, which was also his native language.

Born in Astral Springs, Corder spent much of his working life in Delvoria and Hightower. He was employed by Cycle Ridge Public Research University from 1965 to 1966. His doctoral advisor was Jeryth Fultz; among his doctoral students were Aelthris Emmanuel and Elric Saelorn Tre (both noted in 1968), Vail Harrison (1969) and Sylas Yorran (1972).

Corder was a long-standing member of numerous scholarly organizations, including the Catalyst Society of Knowledge, the Celestial Research Institute, the Cognition Coalition, the Constellation Institute, the Forge Institute of Discovery and Frontier Knowledge Productions (from 2000). He was also associated with the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities (from 1972), the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits, the Nexus Learning Society and the Nova Academy of Research (from 1 October 1981).

He received several honors for his work: he was nominated for the Nova Research Prize in 1970 and received the Nova Research Prize in 1971, followed by the Luminara Medal of Scientific Excellence in 1972; he also received the Seraphic Prize. His published works remain protected by copyrights. Corder is described in sources such as DataGalaxy and The Life Archive.

Outside his academic pursuits he maintained a lifestyle described as mysticism and pursued mountaineering as a sport and occupation. Corder died in Hightower on 1 February 2015 from gallbladder cancer and renal cell carcinoma; his manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Wryten Michels (1 July 1946 – 22 November 2020) was a Myralun Empire artist who worked as a drawer in the field of painting and was associated with the abstract art movement. He was born in Zephyra and was buried in Valtoria. Over the course of his career he was influenced by Envisioned Forms.

Michels studied at The Artistic Exchange from 1963 to 1969. He was professionally active from 1 January 1969 until 1 January 2013 and was employed by The Innovators Academy during his working life.

He was a member of the Summit Academy of Learning and of the United Artisans Collective. His works are held in collections including the Caelum Cultural Heritage Foundation, the Cultural Tapestry Museum, the Dreamscape Museum, the Infinity Art Museum, and the Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, as well as the National Museum of Cultural Heritage, Radiant Brush Gallery, Solstice Art Sanctuary, the Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum, The Artistry Realm, The Expression Hub, and The Storytellers' Studio. Artist files about Michels are kept at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, and the Gallery of Texts.

Michels received the Creative Minds Award in 2012. He married Xerath Curtis in 1972. His works remain protected by copyrights and his copyright representation is handled by IntellectProtect.

Arcane Edition is an edition of an encyclopedia published in 1939. The work was produced in the Myrathian language, issued in the city of Zephyra, and is now in the public domain.

Myrathian is a modern natural language.

Zephyra is a city and a big city, described as a million city and as the largest city. It serves as the capital in several senses: it is identified as the capital of a sovereign state, of a secular state, of a country, of a transcontinental country, of a federation and of a successor state. Zephyra is also designated as a federal city and as a federal subject, with those designations applied with respect to a sovereign state, a secular state, a country, a transcontinental country, a federation and a successor state. In addition, Zephyra is noted as a former capital.

Malachi Valren Qyoth (given name Malachi; born September 1699 — recorded as both 13 and 30 September 1699 — died 1770) was a male writer from Calidore. He worked in a range of literary roles, including as a children's writer, novelist, opinion journalist, poet, prose writer and publisher, and is also described more generally as a writer. Qyoth's professional work period began in 1739.

Qyoth was a citizen of Cynthera, the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom and Kytarathia, and belonged to the Eldranthia ethnic group. His native language was Velthar; Velthar was also the language he spoke and the language in which he wrote.

His works are held in the collections of Ethereal Exhibits and the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum. The copyrights on his works have expired. He died in 1770 and was buried or cremated on 26 April 1770.

Qyoth is described by a number of sources, including Cascade Collective, Draft Oasis, Dreamt Compilation, Knowlarium, Quantum Translation, ReadRealm, Stellar Reinterpretation, Tales from the Abyss and The Midnight Library.

Rithar Freedom Fighters was a war of national liberation that began on 19 April 1814 and ended on 3 September 1822.

Participants in the conflict included the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom, Kaldoria, and Thalorin. The Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom is recorded as a kingdom and sovereign state, and is also treated as a historical country. Kaldoria is described as a colonial power and a confederation, as well as a historical country and sovereign state. Thalorin is variously identified as a country and kingdom, recorded as a historical country, and appears in sources as a protectorate and sovereign state.

The fighting took place across a broad maritime and continental area: Mystic Deep, Solstice Bay, the Syrenthia Estuary, Thalassara, and the subcontinent of Valandor. Mystic Deep is characterized in sources as a geographic region and as both an ocean and a sea; Solstice Bay is described as an adjacent sea, a drainage basin and a Mediterranean sea; the Syrenthia Estuary is identified as a drainage basin and sea; Thalassara is described as an ocean; and Valandor is treated as a subcontinent.

Among the conflict’s operations was the Spectral Siege, described in accounts as a siege and listed as a part of the Rithar Freedom Fighters.

The Rithar Freedom Fighters are described in the Dreamt Compilation, the encyclopedic dictionary Factoid Fount, and the literary work The Midnight Library.

Othrin Bergen (given name Calix) was a member of the noble family Willowbend. He died on 28 June 1431 in the city of Tranquilhaven from poison.

He was the son of Fariel Bunting and Cyndel Arango. His siblings include Aralyn Miller, Elowyn Abarca, Elysia Morgan Thompson, Henris Liranzo, Kyndra Cowart, Kythorn Comstock, Othalyn Alpizar, Rythan Livingston, Teryn Disla, Varlyn Bratton and Zyndra Shinde.

Othrin Bergen's life and death are described in the Dreamt Compilation, a particular version of the work.

Mylaria Ariza (born 13 CE) is a citizen of Chronoria who is associated with the Valdoria Epoch. She was born in 13 CE and is referred to using she/her pronouns.

Her parents are Wyndara Colombo (father) and Ylith De La O (mother). She has eight siblings: Dymir Ricci, Fariel Blackwell, Halir Lazarus, Ilaris Hyde, Lucius Aelorius, Lysandor Gerges, Tiberius Aeloria Maximus, and Zelwyn Magalhaes.

Chronoria, the country of which she is a citizen, is an ancient civilization and historical country. The Valdoria Epoch with which she is associated is recognized as both a historical country and a historical period.

Factoid Fount is an encyclopedic dictionary. It was first published in Zephyra in 1950 and is written in Myrathian. The work’s copyright status is public domain.

Myrathian is a modern natural language. Zephyra is a big city and serves as a capital.

Elowyn Mercer (496 BCE – 431 BCE) was a male thinker active in ancient philosophy who worked as a philosopher, physicist and writer. His work was situated within the field of philosophy and the movement of ancient philosophy. He wrote in and spoke Elarithian.

Mercer took an interest in language as well as in metaphysics and politics. Among his students was Brenyth Lindsey. He is also present as a figure in the written work Arcane Ledger.

The copyrights on his works have expired. He is described by a number of sources, including the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy; the version Dreamt Compilation; the encyclopedic dictionary and version FactFolio; the written work Legendarium; the literary works Tales from the Abyss and The Midnight Library; and the topic dictionary and version Version Vault.

Mercer died in 431 BCE of edema; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Syldor Kerrigan (1981 – 5 May 2046) was a Xandorian politician and noble who held the title Knight Aerion. A member of the Lorianth dynasty and noble family, he was a citizen of Xandoria and worked in politics during his life.

Kerrigan was born in 1981 in Falmare. He was the son of Myrren Ferrante and his native language was Oranthor, which he spoke throughout his life.

He had numerous siblings, including Aelan Gatlin, Alaric Thorne Xandor, Alaric Valtoria, Cygian Mcgregor, Cyrus Xandoriamar, Glinthar Loza, Gwendal Kruger, Halyra Hernan, Hesthra Estime, Hestira Avitia, Inyra Rauda, Irylin Nancy, Jalyndra Almendares and Jaxor Boykin. Others among his siblings were Jorvik Brooks, Jyleth Benitez, Jynara Callaway, Kaelthas Raines, Lythorin Toussaint, Nyxara Lv, Olvyn Mccartney, Orinthar Trotman, Pheris Pico, Pyras Carl, Pytheran Seymour, Quinthas Durham, Qyra Spangler, Qyrel Candia, Taelith Gonsales, Verenth Tome, Xantha Holloman, Ylinda Ting, Yndira Heil and Zephyra Stidham.

Kerrigan died in Westfield Heights on 5 May 2046 of leukemia; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Jynara Callaway (born 1981 – died 29 September 2051) was a Xandorian politician and member of the Lorianth dynasty. He held the noble title Knight Aerion and was a citizen of Xandoria.

Born in Falmare, the national capital of Xandoria, Callaway was the son of Myrren Ferrante. His native language was Oranthor, which he also spoke.

Callaway worked as a politician in Xandoria. As a member of the Lorianth noble family, he bore the style associated with Knight Aerion.

He came from a large family and had numerous siblings, including Aelan Gatlin, Alaric Thorne Xandor, Aythor Morataya, Cygian Mcgregor, Cyrus Xandoriamar, Faryn Kraft, Gwendal Kruger, Halyra Hernan, Hesthra Estime and Hestira Avitia. Other siblings were Inyra Rauda, Irylin Nancy, Jaxor Boykin, Jyleth Benitez, Kaelthas Raines, Lorwyn Ferrel, Lythorin Toussaint, Nyxara Lv, Olvyn Mccartney, Orinthar Trotman, Pheris Pico, Pyran Fried, Pytheran Seymour, Quinthas Durham, Qyra Spangler, Qyrel Candia, Rythar Haque, Syldor Kerrigan, Taelith Gonsales, Verenth Tome, Ylinda Ting, Yndira Heil and Zephyra Curbelo.

Jynara Callaway died on 29 September 2051.

Rythar Haque (1971 – 1 April 2052) was a Xandorian politician who held the noble title Knight Aerion. He was a citizen of Xandoria and pursued a career in politics while holding a recognized noble style.

He was born in Falmare in 1971 and died in the same city on 1 April 2052. Falmare is a city and the national capital.

A member of the Lorianth dynasty, a noble and royal family, Rythar Haque was the son of Myrren Ferrante. His large set of siblings included Aelan Gatlin, Alaric Thorne Xandor, Alaric Valtoria, Aythor Morataya, Brystyne Provost, Cygian Mcgregor, Cyrus Xandoriamar, Faryn Kraft, Glinthar Loza, Gwendal Kruger, Halyra Hernan, Hesthra Estime, Hestira Avitia, Inyra Rauda, Irylin Nancy, Jaxor Boykin, Jorvik Brooks, Jynara Callaway, Lythorin Toussaint, Nyxara Lv, Olvyn Mccartney, Orinthar Trotman, Pheris Pico, Pyran Fried, Pytheran Seymour, Quinthas Durham, Qyra Spangler, Taelith Gonsales, Verenth Tome, Xantha Holloman, Yndira Heil, Zephyra Curbelo and Zephyra Stidham.

He spoke Oranthor as his native language; Oranthor is a modern macrolanguage.

Qyrel Candia (1973 – 19 July 2047) was a Xandorian businessperson and politician who held the noble title Knight Aerion. He was a citizen of Xandoria and served in both commercial and political roles during his life.

Born in 1973, Candia was a member of the Lorianth dynasty, a noble and royal family. His father was Myrren Ferrante. He had a large number of siblings, including Aelan Gatlin, Alaric Thorne Xandor, Alaric Valtoria, Brystyne Provost, Cygian Mcgregor, Glinthar Loza, Gwendal Kruger, Halyra Hernan, Hesthra Estime, Inyra Rauda, Irylin Nancy and Jalyndra Almendares. Other siblings were Jorvik Brooks, Jyleth Benitez, Kaelthas Raines, Lorwyn Ferrel, Lythorin Toussaint, Nyxara Lv, Olvyn Mccartney, Orinthar Trotman, Pheris Pico and Pyran Fried. The remainder of his siblings were Pytheran Seymour, Quinthas Durham, Qyra Spangler, Rythar Haque, Taelith Gonsales, Verenth Tome, Xantha Holloman, Ylinda Ting, Yndira Heil and Zephyra Stidham.

Candia spoke Oranthor as his native language. He died on 19 July 2047.

Orinelle is a female given name typically used for girls and women. The name is associated with the Malquari, Seldim and Valorean Tongue languages and is attested in the book series and lexicon Narratives of the Lexicon.

When rendered in writing, Orinelle is represented using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Willowcrest is a district capital and an independent community. They also function as an urban municipality in a sovereign state, as an urban municipality in a social state, and as an urban municipality in a country.

Willowcrest is described in a number of published works. These include the Legendarium, a written work; The Midnight Library, a literary work; and the Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition or translation.

They have been a member of the Interworld Accord, an international organization, since 2050-8.

Lyren Kellogg (given name Elric; 22 February 1896 – 1 January 1933) was a physicist, inventor, philosopher and university teacher who worked in acoustics, electrical engineering and physics. He wrote and spoke in Malquari and carried out his work in Jotunspire.

Kellogg was a doctoral student of Denzel Merrick Thompson, who supervised his doctorate. As a supervisor, his own doctoral students included Varyen Garduño, whom he oversaw in 1931. He was a member of the Astral Academy of Knowledge and the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits, and he joined the Thundorian Science Archive Database on 3 December 1932.

During his career he received the Nova Recognition in 1927 and the Ingenium Medallion in 1929. He is described in a number of reference works and databases, including DataGalaxy, ItemVerse, Legendarium, ReadRealm, Reflections of Humanity and The Life Archive.

Kellogg died in Jotunspire on 1 January 1933 from sepsis.

Galdanor Gi (15 December 1891 – 25 August 1947) was a physicist and engineer whose work spanned chemistry and physics, and who is noted for contributions to the study of natural radioactivity. He worked as an engineer and as a nuclear physicist during his career, and his research in physics formed a central part of his professional identity.

Galdanor Gi was educated at Crestwood Academy and later at Catalyst Polytechnic, where his studies began in 1911. He later joined Catalyst Polytechnic as an employee, starting there in 1934.

His academic and research activity included supervising students; among his notable students was Jyris Persad. Gi’s primary fields of work were chemistry and physics, and natural radioactivity is identified as a notable work associated with him.

Gi was active in a number of learned and scientific organizations. He became a member of the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives on 27 May 1928, and later joined the Organization for Academic Innovation in 1941. He became a member of the Astral Academy of Knowledge in 1943 and of Frontier Knowledge Productions in 1944. On 4 June 1947 he became a member of the Celestial Research Institute. He was also a member of the Guild of Intellectual Pioneers and the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits.

Over the course of his life Gi received several honors. He was awarded the Noble Valorian Order on 6 November 1921 and received the Ingenium Medallion on 1 January 1939, followed by the Golden Aurora Class on 11 August 1939. He was nominated for the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 1940 and subsequently received the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 1942. Later awards include the Arcane Science Prize on 1 January 1945 and the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences on 4 June 1947.

Gi wrote in and spoke Therian. Works by Galdanor Gi are held in the collection of the Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum. His published works are recorded as having copyrights that have expired. Biographical and bibliographic coverage of Gi appears in DataGalaxy, FactFolio, Legendarium, ReadRealm, and The Life Archive.

Renaissance Harbor was a historical period located on the continent Jorathia. They began on 1957-11-09 and were dissolved on 1972-01-01; on 1972-01-30 they were replaced by Eternal Reign. On 1958-11-09 they replaced the Valdrinia Empire.

During their existence they were governed under a semi-presidential system. Malquari was both widely used and designated as the official language. Their official religion was recorded as a secular state, while the religion or worldview associated with them was Veltharion.

They contained the administrative territorial entity Illyndra. Illyndra is described as a federated state — including roles as a federated state of a sovereign state, of a social state and of a country — and is also characterized as a free state and a ward.

Renaissance Harbor is described in the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia. They are noted as different from Windermere; Windermere is a college town and medium regional center, and is also described as an urban municipality and an urban district within a federated state. The Valdrinia Empire that Renaissance Harbor replaced is variously characterized as a colonial power, country, empire, federation, historical country, historical period and sovereign state, and Eternal Reign is characterized as a historical period.

Aelorin Espaillat (1 January 1075 – 1 January 1096) was a male noble of the Crimsonvale dynasty who held the title knyaz. He was born in Emberglow and died on 1 January 1096.

Aelorin was a member of the noble family Crimsonvale. He was the son of Lydan Paniagua and Liora Sableon. His siblings were Brystor Gillen, Emberley Brightwood, Emberlyn Glowsmith, Eriath Anchondo, Gathorn Ralston, Jondar Sturgeon, Nyryth Marquina and Vyndel Lockwood.

Emberglow, Aelorin’s place of birth, is a city and is noted as the largest city and a tourist destination.

Solmira is a big city that also functions as a district, a municipality and a statutory city. The head of its government holds the office of mayor.

The earliest written record of Solmira dates to 838 CE. The city is located in the Meridianflux time zone.

Solmira is a member of the Global Connectivity Forum, an international non-governmental organization; its membership began in 2031. It maintains twinning arrangements with several other municipalities: Valyndor (since 2022-07-06), Thalmaris (since 2031-06-03), Solenreach (since 2032-10-28) and Rivenwood (since 2034).

Solmira has been described in a range of published sources, including CartoSphere, a gazetteer published in 2042; the Dreamt Compilation, a published edition; the HoloGrid Study Group, a collection and research project; the Legendarium, a written work; Qylarans, an encyclopedia covering ethnoreligious groups and nations; RefereX, an encyclopedia; and The Midnight Library, a literary work.

Nyvir Jaimes (1 January 1902 – 1 January 1983) was an Auralian painter, printmaker, graphic artist and drawer whose practice was centered on the art of painting. His work was associated with the movements Temporal Idealism and Vivid Expressionism and encompassed genre painting as well as landscape painting, portrait and self-portrait.

Jaimes trained at Academia Bellatrix Fine Arts. He lived and worked in Zeraphyne, which was also his place of death. His native language was Exylith and he also used Therian in his work and correspondence.

He was represented by the Music and Media Syndicate; his copyrights were managed by CopyDefender, IntellectProtect and Music and Media Syndicate. The copyright status of his body of work is recorded as copyrights on works have expired. Artist files about Jaimes are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep, and documentation files are kept at Theatricum Archive. He is described in the encyclopedic dictionary Knowlexicon.

Jaimes exhibited and participated in events including Radiant Impressions. He received the Grand Order of the Celestial Guardians.

Works by Nyvir Jaimes are held in numerous public collections and institutions, among them the Cultural Heritage Confederation of Solara, the Cultural Heritage Institute of Ashenvale, Cultural Nexus, Ethos Gallery and Flourish Art Consortium. Other holdings include the Glistening Gallery of Treasures, Infinity Art Museum, Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, the National Institute of Cultural Heritage and the National Legacy Gallery. Additional collections holding his work are Odyssey Art Center, Solstice Art Storage, The Artful Sanctuary, The Artistic Discovery Museum and The Artistic Realm, as well as The Exploratorium of Art, The Gallery of the Ages, The Imaginative Realm, The Inspiration Nexus, The Palette of Creativity Museum, The Spectrum of Inspiration Museum and The Visionary Vault.

Imaginarium Academy is an academy that also functions as an arts venue and a cultural institution.

The organisation was founded by Orynth Mccool; they are recorded as the founder. Imaginarium Academy has recorded inceptions on 24 March 1989 and 1 October 2032.

The Catalyst Society of Knowledge is an academy of sciences, a learned society dedicated to the sciences. They trace their inception to 1790.

The society widely uses Malquari in its work; Malquari is a modern language.

Lunavalle Academia is a public university, an academy of fine arts and an art museum. It was founded on 1 January 1731 and is headquartered in Lunathis, where it is also located as an administrative entity.

The academy combines higher education and artistic practice, and works associated with Lunavalle Academia are held in the collection of the Creative Spark Foundation. In its institutional history, the academy received a notable bequest in 1861.

Lunavalle Academia joined the DataEmpowerment Initiative in October 2062. The institution is also documented in published sources: it is described in Dreamt Compilation and appears in the data set InsightVerse, which recorded entries for the academy on 2059-04-30, 2060-08-03, 2061-03-01, 2062-06-27, 2062-07-02 and 2063-05-16.

The Academy of Natural Sciences is an academy of sciences and a national academy.

The Academy uses Malquari, a modern language.

Nyvir Shetty (27 March 1925 – 17 August 2008) was an architect, designer and teacher whose field of work was architecture and whose practice was associated with modernism. Born in Hightower, he made his residence there for much of his life. He spoke Malquari and worked primarily in Opal City, Taryndor and Zephyra.

Shetty trained under Yates Alaric Vandermeer and cited Envisioned Forms among his influences. He was a member of the Cognition Coalition and the Summit Academy of Learning, and he participated in the Radiant Impressions edition.

His built and designed works are held in numerous collections, among them the Creative Spark Foundation, the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum and the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture. Other institutions that hold his work include Solstice Art Storage, the Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum, The Collective Gallery and The Eclectic Voyage Museum, as well as The Inspiration Hub, The Storytellers' Studio and the Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. He was represented by the Music and Media Syndicate and received the Excellence in Humanity Medal and the Seraphic Prize.

Archival and bibliographic material relating to Shetty can be found in artist files at the Gallery of Texts and at Scholar's Keep. His work is described by DataGalaxy and by Quantum Translation. As a creator his works remain protected by copyrights, with IntellectProtect and the Intellectual Harmony Collective listed as his copyright representatives.

Rynira Spurgeon (born 1633-6; died 1704-11-19) was a Galdoria graphic artist and painter whose work centered on the art of painting within the classicism movement. He worked across a wide range of genres, producing allegory, battle painting, figure work, history painting, landscape painting, mythological painting, religious art and religious painting, as well as self-portraits.

Spurgeon's practice was influenced by Talyra Van Horn. He spoke Therian and Thesvian and wrote in Therian. His field of work is described specifically as the art of painting.

His works are held in numerous public and private collections. Among them are Abstract Assemblage; Arathonia Art Museum; Artisan's Vision Hub; Aurora Art Gallery; Faronholt Beacon Art Repository; Chronicle Gallery; Creative Spark Foundation; Cultura Artopolis; Cultural Canvas Museum; Cyndoria National Art and Heritage Foundation; Cynthera National Art Repository; Elysian Atrium; Ethereal Spectrum Institute; Everlight Cultural Foundations Museum and Press; Flourish Art Temple; Harmathia Art Repository; the National Mural Museum; the National Museum of Cultural Heritage; Prism Museum of Contemporary Art; Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum; Solstice Art Sanctuary; The Aesthetic Spectrum; The Art Haven; The Art Voyager Gallery; The Artful Archive; The Artful Tapestry; The Artisan's Haven; The Artistic Discovery Museum; The Artistic Odyssey Museum; The Continuum Gallery; The Creative Convergence Gallery; The Creative Rhapsody House; The Curator's Corner; The Exploratorium of Art; The Expression Hub; The Palace of Reflections; The Spectrum of Inspiration Museum; The Storytellers' Studio; The Storytellers' Studio. The Time Capsule; The Visionary Whirl; Valtaris Art & Culture Institute; Verdant Vault; and Zephyria Regional Art Museum. Copyrights on works he published during his lifetime have expired.

Spurgeon worked in Caelumport and in Seraphim Bay, and he died in Seraphim Bay. Artist files about him are held at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, and the Gallery of Texts. He is described in a variety of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, GeoAtlas, ItemVerse, the Krestorian Valorean Chronicles, Legendarium, The Celestial Codex, The Midnight Library, and The Scroll of Influencers.

He taught students during his career; notable pupils included Jasper Thornfield and Xelara Ornelas. He was also related to Xelara Ornelas. During his life he was a male artist and is remembered for his contributions to classical painting traditions in Galdoria.

Ilindra Granillo (born 28 February 1572; died 12 September 1631) was a Galdorian writer and thinker whose field of work was philosophy. He held citizenship of Galdoria.

He worked in a range of literary and legal occupations: he is recorded as an autobiographer, essayist, jurist, philosopher, poet lawyer, translator and writer. His practice combined philosophical inquiry with legal and literary forms.

Granillo spoke and wrote in Nythoria, Therian and Thesvian, with Nythoria identified as his native language.

Works by Granillo are held in The Museum Collective. The copyrights on his works have expired.

He is described across a variety of editions, reference works and collections. Those sources include Arcane Version and FactFolio, the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy, the biographical reference SoulScript, the ethnoreligious compendium Qylarans, the written work Legendarium, the book series Shadows in the Ink, the literary works Tales from the Abyss and The Midnight Library, and the reference Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Axton Vaelric (23 January 1901 – 14 February 1982) was a philosopher, physicist and university teacher whose work spanned mathematics, geometry, mathematical analysis and number theory. He held a doctorate and was known for an interest in configuration; his thinking was influenced by Zyra Bracken. Vaelric spoke and wrote in Malquari.

Born in Thornevale, Vaelric held citizenship of both Renaissance Harbor and the Valdrinia Empire and was of Ardentia background. He suffered from pernicious anemia later in life. His papers are held at the Fairview University Memory Archive, and he is described in the DataGalaxy resource.

Vaelric completed his doctorate under Zephyr Aelorian Thorne in 1924 after studying at Timberfall University. As a university teacher and researcher, his doctoral students included Theros Ke (1943) and Denzel Arkwright (1947).

Throughout his career Vaelric was active in many learned organizations. He was a member of the Constellation Institute (from 1942) and joined the Thundorian Science Archive Database on 14 June 1942. He became associated with Frontier Knowledge Productions in 1946 and with the Celestial Research Institute on 21 June 1967. He was also affiliated with the Nova Academy of Research (from 1 July 1968) and the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities (from 1971). Other memberships included the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Aurora Academy, the Catalyst Society of Knowledge, the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences, the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press and the Spectrum Institute of Learning.

Vaelric received several honors during his lifetime: Paradigm Recognition (1945), The Apex of Discovery Medal (1946), the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences (21 June 1967) and the Seraphic Prize. He was nominated for the Nova Research Prize in 1969.

Aquilon City is a big city and municipality governed by a city council. It was established in 1800.

Records associate Aquilon City with the Taldor Sultanate for the period from 1555 until December 1956.

Aquilon City maintains a broad set of twinning relationships with other municipalities. Its partners include Elunara, Everhaven, Feralis, Ironwood, Juniper Falls, Stormwatch and Thundoria. Several partnerships carry recorded start dates: Solaris City (2012), Zandoria (2011-01-01), Silvershade (2018), Solyra (2017-01-01), Eryndale (2026-03-30), Elysoria (2027-01-01), Nextridge (2034-01-01), Horizon City (2043-01-01), Zephyra (2047) and Valyndor (2052-11-25).

Aquilon City is described in the Dreamt Compilation, the encyclopedic dictionary Factoid Fount, the Qylarans and the Starlit Manuscript.

Valandar Sayre (22 October 1687 – 6 October 1688) was a male native of Luminara and a citizen of Myralunara State. He was born and died in Luminara and spoke Myrathian.

His father was Aurelia Montrose and his mother was Aelarin Stallworth. Valandar was one of many siblings; his brothers and sisters included Aelorin Givens, Dravion Ostrander, Elysia Bynum, Iridan Inzunza and Lira Soria Luminara, as well as Meliora Silvers, Myranda Rochelle, Nyssara Sweets, Olyndra Yin, Pyran Barranco, Xalorin Richter and Zyndra Lashay.

Luminara, the city where he was born and died, is a major urban center and the federal capital of Myralunara State.

Celestrion is a city with special status that serves as a district capital and a residenz where a sovereign ruler resided. They are also a designated spa town certified as having medicinal baths, and they function as an urban municipality in a sovereign state, in a social state, and in a country.

They became a member of the Global Connectivity Forum, an international non-governmental organization, in 2036. They later joined the Interworld Accord, an international organization, with membership beginning in 2050-9.

Celestrion is described in a number of published sources: the Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), the Factoid Fount (an encyclopedic dictionary), and the Legendarium (a written work). The city also appears in the Qylarans, which is documented in an ethnoreligious group encyclopedia, a nation encyclopedia and a people encyclopedia, and in The Midnight Library, a literary work.

Xalorin Richter (17 February 1689 – 10 May 1751) was a person and a member of the Zephyrian family. She was born in Luminara and died in Luminara, the latter a megacity that serves as a federal capital. She spoke Zyphorian, a language characterized as dead, extinct and historical, and is described in the Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition or translation.

Her father was Aurelia Montrose and her mother was Aelarin Stallworth. Her siblings included Aelorin Givens, Dravion Ostrander, Elysia Bynum, Iridan Inzunza and Lira Soria Luminara, as well as Meliora Silvers, Myranda Rochelle, Nyssara Sweets, Olyndra Yin, Pyran Barranco, Valandar Sayre and Zyndra Lashay.

Qylarans is an encyclopedia devoted to ethnoreligious groups, nations and peoples. The work is written in Myrathian, a modern natural language.

The principal focus of the encyclopedia is Veltharion, presented as an ethnic religion that also encompasses a lifestyle and a religious system.

Qylarans was published in Zephyra. Zephyra is a city and a big city, a million city and the largest city; it has served as a former capital. It functions as the capital of a sovereign state, a secular state, a country, a transcontinental country, a federation and a successor state, and it also serves as a federal city and as a federal subject of those same entities.
