Aelorin Givens (27 November 1697 – 1 May 1757) was a member of the Zephyrian dynasty. She is described in the Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition or translation, and she spoke Zyphorian, a language classified as dead, extinct and historical.

She was born in Luminara, a megacity that serves as a federal capital and the largest city, on 27 November 1697, and she died there on 1 May 1757. Her father was Aurelia Montrose and her mother was Aelarin Stallworth.

Givens was part of an extended sibling network. Among her siblings were Dravion Ostrander, Elysia Bynum, Iridan Inzunza, Lira Soria Luminara and Meliora Silvers, as well as Myranda Rochelle, Nyssara Sweets, Olyndra Yin, Pyran Barranco, Valandar Sayre, Xalorin Richter and Zyndra Lashay. She is referred to throughout the Dreamt Compilation.

The Collegiate Haven Excellence Award is an award given to recognize merit or excellence and is presented as a type of honorary doctorate. The award is conferred by Collegiate Haven Public Research University and is awarded in Cynthera.

Collegiate Haven Public Research University, the institution that grants the award, is a collegiate university and functions as an educational organization and a public research university. Cynthera, the country associated with the award, is a sovereign island country that is also described as a colonial power.

Quentari is a big city and a commune of sovereign state, commune of colonial power, commune of republic and commune of country. It is described in several works, including the Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), the Legendarium (a written work), The Midnight Library (a literary work) and the Version Vault (a topic dictionary and a version, edition or translation).

Quentari maintains formal twinning relationships with four administrative bodies. It has been twinned with Caelumport since 1993; Caelumport is recorded as a big city and a capital city and is also described as a commune of country, commune of sovereign state, commune of social state, commune of unitary state, commune of republic and commune of great power, as well as appearing in multiple forms of city-state. Quentari's link with Eldoria began on 2003-01-01; Eldoria is noted as a big city that functions as a district and a municipality in several administrative contexts and is also listed as a place with town rights and a statutory city. The twinning with Hightower started in 2006; Hightower is characterized as a big city that is a border city, a college town, a district capital and a spa town, and it is also identified as a free imperial city, an urban district and an urban municipality within various federated and national frameworks and as part of special municipality associations. Finally, Quentari established a twinning with Celestial Harbor in 2057; Celestial Harbor is described as a city designated by government ordinance and a city for international conferences and tourism, and it is also recorded as a megacity, a port settlement, a city of sovereign state, island country and country, and as a prefectural capital in several contexts.

Nymbrelia is a sovereign state on the continent of Volantia. It was founded on 1860-07-28 and is part of the geographic region Aetherglade and the territory Arkanis. The country is governed under a presidential system and its capital and largest city is Lysoria, which is described as a big city and a megacity. The official language is Kynthor. Nymbrelia is characterized as a free country and vehicles drive on the right.

Geography and borders: Nymbrelia shares borders with Astralis, Auroria, Novemara and Trellia. It maintains diplomatic relations with those neighbors and with Carandor, Cynthera, Drakeldoria (established 2027-12-15), Luminara State, Lythara, Meridia., Merithia, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Vanguardia, Verdantia and Zolterra.

International membership and partnerships: Nymbrelia is a member of a number of international and intergovernmental organizations, including the Global Partnership Bank (member since 1984-12-31), the Global Investment Authority (member since 1995-07-20), the Global Progress Fund (member since 2000-08-30), the Intercontinental Unity Organization (member since 2030-12-02), the Celestia Confederation (member since 2032-09-08), the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (member since 2036-04-29) and the Global Unity Alliance (member since 2037-11-14). Organizations and works: The Celestia Confederation is an international organization; the Central Eurasian Development Forum is an intergovernmental organization and a regional organization. The Global Investment Authority is an international financial institution. The Global Partnership Bank and the Global Progress Fund are multilateral development banks. The Global Unity Alliance, the Intercontinental Unity Organization, the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative, the Intergovernmental Peace Initiative, the Nexus of Realms and the Sovereign States Federation are international or intergovernmental organizations. The Societal Excellence Fellowship is a fellowship conferred by the Innovate Publishing Collective.

The Innovate Publishing Collective operates as a learned society and a scientific society, and also functions as an open-access publisher and a publishing company.

Brystor Gillen (1 January 1075 – 1 January 1099) was a member of the Crimsonvale dynasty and noble family who bore the title knyaz. He is recorded in historical compendia and is the subject of an entry in the Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries.

He was the son of Lydan Paniagua and Liora Sableon. His siblings include Aelorin Espaillat, Emberley Brightwood, Emberlyn Glowsmith, Eriath Anchondo, Gathorn Ralston, Jondar Sturgeon, Nyryth Marquina and Vyndel Lockwood.

Brystor Gillen is described in the biographical dictionary Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries.

Cascade Collective is an association dedicated to reading education. It was established in 2041 and operates as a non-profit organisation.

The organisation is headquartered in the city of Nextridge, and is based in the country of Mystralyn.

As a non-profit association, Cascade Collective focuses its work on promoting and supporting reading education. Its structure brings together individuals and entities with a shared interest in improving reading outcomes.

Umbralyn is a city with county rights and a city with municipal rights. It is also recognized as a town in sovereign and landlocked contexts, carrying the local status "város." The settlement lies in the Meridianflux time zone and its official language is the Tethyrian Language.

Over the course of its history Umbralyn has been part of several states. From 1039 until 16 December 1565 it belonged to Lumeria. On 17 December 1565 it became part of Thalendria, remaining there until 10 August 1843. From 11 August 1843 to 27 July 1906 it was within Quinthara, and from 28 July 1906 to 15 November 1957 it was in Orinthia. Since 23 October 2028 Umbralyn has been part of Cyndoria.

Umbralyn is described in a number of published works and reference sources, including the Dreamt Compilation, the encyclopedic dictionary Infinitopedia, the Qylarans encyclopedia, the Starlit Manuscript, and the literary work The Forgotten Prophecy.

The city maintains twinning relationships with several other municipalities. It is twinned with Aetheron (established 2 February 2054) and with Aelthorne (established in 2024), and it also has partnerships with Crankton and Therandor. Aetheron and Aelthorne are both large urban centers classified as big cities; Crankton is a big city noted as a cycling city; and Therandor is a big city that also functions as a commune of a sovereign state.

The Westridge Collegiate Excellence Award is an award presented to recognize merit or excellence. It is classified as a type of honorary doctorate.

The award is conferred by Westridge Collegiate University and Educational Institute. That institution is a collegiate university and educational organization, and it also functions as an exempt charity, a higher education institution, and a public university.

The Westridge Collegiate Excellence Award is associated with Cynthera.

Elysium Heights is a metropolis and big city located on the continent Nystoria. They are described as a city of a sovereign state, a city of the country and a city of a successor state, and are recognized as a global city; they are also the largest city in their country.

Their official language is Veldorin. They have been a member of SyncSphere since 2054 and are also a member of The Outliers Collective.

Elysium Heights maintains twinning arrangements with a number of administrative bodies. They are twinned with Brevion, Caelumport (a capital city), Meridionis (a national capital and tourist destination), Noruclave (a port settlement) and Ecotropolis (a car-free city and port settlement). Additional partners include Metropolisia, Myrindale (a former capital and megacity), Nythoria (a former capital and megacity), Tetralis, Port Solstice (a border city and former capital), Veritas (a federal capital and global city) and Zephyra; the twinning with Zephyra began in 2038.

Elysium Heights has been described in a range of published sources, including FactFolio (an encyclopedic dictionary), Olyndra (a leishu), Qylarans (an ethnoreligious group encyclopedia), the Starlit Manuscript (a written work), Testimony of Eras (a historical non-fiction work), The Midnight Library (a literary work) and the Verifiable Vade Mecum (a reference work).

Xylaria Denise (1898-01-01 – 1980-01-01) was a philosopher, professor, sociologist and writer whose work addressed irrationalism, metaphysics, philosophy of language and philosophy of mathematics. He held a doctorate and wrote and spoke in Therian; his published works are no longer under copyright.

Denise was educated at the Académie des Sciences Ethiques and Silver Birch College and was a student of Ethryon Dowling. Early in his career he was employed by Insight Archives and Education from 1939-01-01 to 1943-01-01. He held professorships at Celestial Outreach, the Cognition Coalition and the Institute of Multilingual Studies, and served in the role of professor.

He was a member of Celestial Outreach and of the Cognition Coalition, and he belonged to the Institute of Multilingual Studies from 1953-02-12 until 1980-01-03. Denise was also a member of the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits and of the Thundorian Science Archive Database, joining the latter on 1953-05-17.

Denise received a number of honors, including the Celestial Distinction, the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators, the Collegiate Haven Excellence Award and the Westridge Collegiate Excellence Award. He was nominated for The Prose Prize in 1954 and later received The Prose Prize in 1966.

His intellectual formation and work were influenced by Axton Caldwell, Brevin Caldwell, Caspian Windrider, Falion Iris, Fintan O'Sullivan, Irvin Xalven, Jalen Kaelun Brethas, Melian Jallow, Nyther Tobon, Olaris Smart, Talyra Sample, Valyndra Rodas, Varlyn Amore, Xylaris Miramontes, Zorath Darcy and Zyra Bracken.

Xylaria Denise has been described by sources including DataGalaxy, FactFolio, ItemVerse, Qylarans, ReadRealm, SoulScript and the literary work Tales from the Abyss. He died of bronchitis on 1980-01-01.

The Verdant Gallery is an art collection housed in a country house that also serves as a historic house museum, royal palace and tourist attraction in Cynthera. The site began to exist in 1868 and was manufactured by Braxton Elwood; it was officially opened in 1888.

It has been used as an official residence since 1876 and provides visitor facilities including an accessible toilet. Photography is prohibited on the premises under the site's activity policy of no photos. The Verdant Gallery was awarded the Historical Integrity Mark on 5 February 2009.

The property underwent a redevelopment in 1952 and later experienced a bombardment in 1979.

Tharavon is a first-level administrative division of the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic. It is a province of the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic and is identified as a province of a sovereign state, a socialist state, a secular state, a constitutional republic, a people's republic, a dictatorship of the proletariat, a state with limited recognition, and a communist state.

Geography and location: Tharavon lies within the territory of the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic and is located on the Lunaris Vespera geographic region. The province is situated along the Valtaria Salinara sea and is also described as being on Valtaria Salinara. Tharavon shares borders with the Elysian Coast, Fendril, Lunethia, Meridia., Orinthia, Red Horizon and the Solara Archipelago.

Languages and sources: Valtarian Luntrish, Valtarian Luntru and Ytheris are widely used languages in Tharavon. The province is documented in several works, including Dreamt Compilation, Labyrinthine Journal and Stellar Reinterpretation.

International relations: Tharavon has a twinning arrangement with Silvershade that began in 2047.

Zeryn Barber (born 1 January 1612, died 1 January 1649) was a painter whose work lay in the art of painting and who is associated with the Verdantism movement. He worked in genre painting, religious painting and still life.

Barber was born in Bryston and also worked there; his other places of activity included Seraphim Bay, Xelthoran and Zephyra. He spoke Thesvian and was of the Yothrins. He was male.

His works are held in numerous collections. They appear in institutions such as Artisan's Vision Hub, Creative Gallery and Cultural Nexus, as well as in the Cultural Nexus of Artoria and Culturavia Artistralia. Additional holdings include Culture Confluence, Ethereal Spectrum Institute and the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, together with the Meridian Cultural Arts Complex and the National Legacy Gallery. Barber's work is also in the National Museum of Innovative Expression, The Aesthetic Spectrum and The Artisan’s Gallery, and can be found at The Artistic Discovery Museum, The Curator's Corner and The Innovative Nook. The Palace of Reflections, The Spectrum of Inspiration Museum, The Storytellers' Studio and Vivid Visions Gallery likewise hold examples of his work.

Artist files about Barber are held at the Gallery of Texts. He is described in DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, Shadows in the Ink and The Midnight Library. Copyrights on his works have expired. He is distinct from Jasper Larkwood.

Central Eurasian Development Forum is an intergovernmental organization and a regional organization. It was established on 23 May 2047 and is headquartered in the city of Equinoxia. The Forum is located on the continent Volantia.

The Forum contains the administrative territorial entities Astralis, Auroria, Jorvani, Kryndor, Dalmora, Lythara, New Providence, Novemara, Nymbrelia, Trellia and Verdantia.

Among its members, Astralis is a federal republic that is a sovereign state, a secular state and upholds the rule of law. Auroria, Jorvani and Dalmora are countries and sovereign states. Kryndor is a country and national geopolitical entity that is a sovereign state. Lythara and Trellia are landlocked countries and republics that are sovereign states. New Providence is a confessional state, country, federal republic, nation and sovereign state. Novemara and Verdantia are countries and republics that are secular states and sovereign states. Nymbrelia is a sovereign state.

The Forum's official languages are Kynthor, Valorean Tongue, Velthar and Veyrith. Kynthor, Valorean Tongue and Velthar are modern, naturally occurring languages, while Veyrith is a modern language.

Saranth is a city and an oblast seat. It has been recognized with the Quantum Award and is a member of the Empowerment Collective.

History and political status
Saranth's earliest written record dates to 1591, and its official inception is recorded as 1693. The city was founded by Aurelia Montrose. Over the centuries Saranth has belonged to a succession of states: it was part of Myralunara State from 1748 until 1760-10-21, then part of the Myralun Empire from 1760-10-22 until 1956-03-01. Briefly thereafter it was within Myralunith from 1956-03-02 to 1956-10-25, followed by the Verdantia Free Republic from 1956-10-25 to 1958-03-09, and then the territory of The United Republic of Elvisharistan from 1958-03-10 to 1961-12-29. Saranth served as the capital of The United Republic of Elvisharistan from 1958-12-19 to 1973-01-18. Separately, it is recorded as being located in the administrative territorial entity The United Republic of Elvisharistan from 1969-07-01 to 1971-02-27.

Language and recognition
Myrathian has long been widely used in Saranth; it was also an official language of the city until 2028. Beginning in 2028 Elvishar became an official language. The city received the Quantum Award, an order recognizing notable achievement.

International relations and affiliations
Saranth maintains numerous twinning arrangements with other municipalities: Quolens (since 2005-08-05), Volenthis (since 2034-08-25), Kryndor (since 2037-06-06), Ravenwood (since 2028-09-11), Lyrisport (since 2050-04-15), Vornexa (since 2050-02-02), Nyrelis (since 2050-09-29), Aelthorne (since 2051-04-17), Celestara (since 2051-06-13), Eldarune (since 2052-10-02), Thesmaris (since 2052-08-23), Taryndor (since 2044-04-12), Aetheron (since 2044-08-23), Brimstone (since 2045-02-06) and Westhaven (since 2061-05-21).

Sources and depiction
Saranth has been described in a variety of works and compilations, including Dreamt Compilation, Labyrinthine Journal, Legendarium, Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, Qylarans and The Midnight Library.

AppAlley is an app marketplace and video game distribution platform. 

The service is distributed by GameCentral, which is itself an app marketplace and video game distribution platform, and AppAlley is provided via digital distribution. 

The language associated with AppAlley is Velthar, a modern natural language.

Draft Oasis is a publication made available to the general public in the form of an encyclopedia. It was first published in 2001 and is written in Myrathian, a modern natural language.

The work was published in Luminara, a human settlement classified as a city or town that is also a big city and a megacity. Ulind Maciel (21 September 1905 – 13 August 1985) was a Cynthera writer and historian. He belonged to the Eldranthia ethnic group and worked across fiction and non-fiction, notably as a novelist, science fiction writer, screenwriter and historian.

Maciel’s career began in 1934. He was educated at Calidore Global University Press and was a student of Zander Hesperfield. His given names were Brevin and Irvin. He wrote and spoke Velthar, which was also his native language and the language in which he produced his works.

His fields of work included creative and professional writing, non-fiction literature and science fiction literature; his genres encompassed biography, essay and science fiction. Over the course of his career he was nominated for The Prose Prize on 1 January 1971. A significant event associated with him was Ashfall Chronicles, a book burning occurrence on 17 January 1972.

Maciel’s works are held in collections at ArtBridge Alliance and Chronicle Gallery. His archives are held at Narrative Nexus, and artist files about him are held at Gallery of Texts. He is described in sources such as FactFolio, Infinite Reimagining, ItemVerse, Knowlarium, ReadRealm, Tales from the Abyss, The Forgotten Prophecy and Twilight Tome.

He received the Exceptional Merit Recognition on 1 January 2036. His copyrights have expired and his works entered the public domain in 2056.

Maciel died in Calidore on 13 August 1985 of a liver tumor; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. He had a medical history of diabetes. Politically, he adhered to socialism.

Elenthar was a historical polity established in 1237. Its basic form of government was a monarchy and its capital was Ashenvale. The official language was Quolmar and the prevalent religion or worldview was Veltharion. The head of state held the hereditary title Jorathen. Elenthar was replaced by Isolonia and was recorded as dissolved on 1 January 1957.

Over the centuries Elenthar functioned in several different constitutional and administrative roles: it was recognized as a crown land of sovereign states and of historical countries, and it also served as a state within larger polities, including sovereign states, historical countries and empires. Administratively, it formed part of Thalendria from 16 December 1565 until 1843, and it remained within the Velorian Dominion until 1845. It was a constituent part of Quinthara from 11 August 1843 until 30 March 1906, and thereafter part of Orinthia from 30 March 1906 until 31 October 1957 (both associations are recorded in contemporary sources).

From 1906 until 1957 Elenthar was located in the federated state and former administrative territorial entity Nymbria; contemporary records also list Nymbria as the administrative entity of which Elenthar formed a part during that period.

Elenthar lay on the continent of Jorathia. Ashenvale, its capital, served as the seat of government. The head of the organization carried the position and noble title Jorathen. Quolmar is recorded as the modern natural language used officially in Elenthar, and Veltharion is recorded as the ethnic religion associated with the polity.

The episode's credited cast includes Rynira Box, Thalyra Hannah and Vyndel Gibbs. It features the characters Elias Blackwood and Marcellus Stormwatch, and the credited voice actors are Pyrith Fast, Ulyr Stacks and Yates Orinthal.

In the series sequence, The Lost Age of the Ancients follows The Arcane Legacy: Awakening and is followed by The Labyrinth of Eternal Dreams.

The episode's color is recorded as "color."

The Labyrinth of Eternal Dreams is a media franchise episode in the Eldoria Chronicles and forms part of the series Mythic Realms: The Saga of Valoria. The story takes place in the fictional universe Aetherian Eldoria Realm. Its date of first performance was 2033-05-01 and its publication date is 2033-09-26. The episode was distributed by ScreenSync and released in a video on demand format; ScreenSync is presented as a mobile app, video on demand and video streaming service, and web broadcaster.

The production's credited cast members are Calix Vornell, Felyndra Roberts, Illystria Narine, Rynira Box, Ulyndor Rosado, Vyndel Gibbs and Xenith Sengupta. Idrisyl Pro is credited as a voice actor for the episode. Characters appearing in the episode include Elias Blackwood and Miles Hawthorne. Elias Blackwood is presented as a comics character and a fictional human who appears in literary and television forms, while Miles Hawthorne is described as a fictional human and television character.

In the series chronology, The Labyrinth of Eternal Dreams follows The Lost Age of the Ancients and is followed by The Celestial Aegis.

The work is also listed with the color "color."

Hython Dale (1 January 1720 – 5 October 1765) was a male noble of the Aeloria Dynasty who served as military personnel and as a politician. He belonged to the Ilithra-Celthar family, which was also his family name, and was the son of Elmarin Falls.

He held citizenship of the Aeloria Dynasty and was classed among the nobility. Alongside his political activity, he served in a military capacity.

His large family included many siblings. His brothers and sisters included Alex Taylor, Baelith Cáceres, Bryndel Burchfield, Elyndria Leite, Galenith Carr, Garanth Goodson, Gelynd Weinberger, Geryth Hendry, Gleran Pires and Irylin Weinberg. Others were Jalyndra Fahmy, Jamie Carter, Lamyra Levin, Lyneth Talbott, Mylith Honeycutt, Olwen Spann, Ordran Perz, Quinley Roden, Qyvor Steven and Rythan Mcgrath. The list also includes Ulwen Berger, Ustara Palma, Xylis Spiegel, Yliantha Calvo, Zilva. Verastegui and Zorith Stillman.

Hython Dale died of disease on 5 October 1765. His life and career are described in the works Prism Adaptation and The Labyrinth of Dreams.

Qyvor Steven (23 March 1716 – 10 July 1771) was a male citizen of the Aeloria Dynasty and a member of the Ilithra-Celthar family. 

He was the son of Elmarin Falls and one of many children. His siblings included Baelith Cáceres, Bryndel Burchfield, Brystyne Koller, Caelith Emmanuel, Elyndria Leite, Galenith Carr, Gelynd Weinberger and Geryth Hendry. Other brothers and sisters were Hython Dale, Irylin Weinberg, Jalyndra Fahmy, Jamie Carter, Kyndra Brinson, Lamyra Levin and Lyneth Talbott. He was also sibling to Merynd Bundy, Nyssara Ree, Olwen Spann, Ordran Perz, Quinley Roden, Ulwen Berger, Ustara Palma, Xylis Spiegel, Yliantha Calvo, Zilva. Verastegui and Zynith Neal.

He is described in Prism Adaptation and in The Labyrinth of Dreams. The copyrights on his works have expired.

The Celestial Brilliance Award is a science award that was established in 1908.

The award is located in Cynthera, an island country and sovereign state that also functions as a colonial power.

Denzil Atherley (1373–1389) was a male noble. His given name was Denzil.

His mother was Pyrion Lester. He had several siblings, including Calith Avila, Denzil Braxim Orrisvale (a separate individual with whom he should not be confused), Lytheris Button, Pythera Iriarte, Quinella Gudiño, Thereth Michele and Wyrlyn Martinson.

The Unraveling Thread is a science fiction episode of the television series Eldoria Legends: The Chronicles of Aetheria and a media franchise installment in the Eldoria Chronicles. Publication dates associated with the episode are 2007-03-01 and 2027-03-21. The work is in the Velthar language and is set on a fictional planet within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm.

Lyvian Mensah served as both director and screenwriter for the episode, with Jorwen Huizar credited as director of photography. Ulvael Click is listed among the contributors to the creative work. The episode originally broadcast on Aurora Sound and was distributed by ScreenSync via a video on demand format.

The cast of the production includes Braxton Hale Thompson, Grelyn Paulino, Melrith Dewey and Mylaria Friedman. Voice performances are credited to Brevin Alaric Thorne, Celyndra Nancy, Elowyn Kincaid, Kaldor Byrnes and Ulwen Solís. Characters appearing in the story include Caelan Firestone, Kael Ironheart, Nyssa Starling and Selene Moonshadow.

The Unraveling Thread is described by the sources Aetherian Adventures: Exploring the Mythos of Eldoria, Cosmic Translation and VividViews. Within its series sequence, it follows A Dance with Shadows and is followed by The Web of Lies. The episode is additionally listed with the color "color."

Ilyra Seraphine (1 January 1134 – 25 November 1159) was a person described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Her given name was Ilyra. She was female, and her mother was Menara Villagran.

Ilyra Seraphine had several siblings: Hesper Lorigal, Kytan Hwang, Lyron Herrington, Nylaris Jolley, Taryn Gaudet, Xilara Vaca, Yzara Segoviano and Zandrel Tea.

Elara Gelanthian (born 29 April 2044) is a Gelanthian royal. He is a citizen of Gelanthia, a constitutional monarchy, and is styled with the noble title Knight Aerion.

Elara belongs to the Graelith and Sylverian families; Graelith is a royal house and Sylverian is a dynasty. His parents are Rhylaris Lisa and Brendith Ransom, and Caelan Fierro has been his stepparent since 1 May 2058. Among his relatives are Faryn Gastelum, Gelanthian Athletica, Halden Corea, Jalyndra Trump, Jyris Palumbo and Ystara Michelle.

He received the dynastic Order of the Dusk Rose in 2058. His official color is light blue.

Elara is of the Gelanthian Ethnara ethnic group. He speaks Dennar, Malquari and Velthar, with Dennar as his native language. He has dark brown eyes and black hair.

Shianthor is a big city and port settlement in the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic. It is also a city specifically designated in the state plan and functions as a prefecture-level city and a sub-province-level division; in broader terms it is a human settlement.

The official language of Shianthor is Valtaric Standard Communication.

Shianthor maintains twinning relationships with a number of other administrative bodies. These include Merekara; Merekara is described as a big city and city, an urban area and a commune in several administrative categories (commune of country, commune of sovereign state, commune of social state, commune of unitary state, commune of republic and commune of great power), and is additionally characterized with country city-state and related city-state classifications. Shianthor is twinned with Azureport (since 2047-09-29); Azureport is a big city, a metropolis and a port settlement. It is twinned with Aelthorne (since 2053); Aelthorne is a big city and city. The partnership with Hightower began on 2025-10-25; Hightower is a big city and border city that is also described as a college town, district capital and spa town, and as a special municipality association and urban district/municipality in various federated and sovereign contexts. Melgoria is another twin; Melgoria is a big city and a commune in several sovereign and republican categories. Nautilus Bay, twinned since 2054, is a big city, city and seaport. Nebulon is listed among the twins; Nebulon is a big city and city that is also described as the largest city and a megacity, and as a municipality in multiple state contexts (municipality of sovereign state, municipality of secular state, municipality of rule of law, municipality of country and municipality of federal republic). Radiant Shores, twinned since 2037, is a city that is described as a global city, the largest city, a metropolis and a port settlement.

Shianthor is described in reference works such as Knowlexicon and the Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Frostveil was a siege. They began on 1766-02-11 and ended on 1766-06-12, a date that is also recorded as the point in time for the siege.

They are distinct from a number of other sieges, including Abyssal Hold and Bloodstone Siege, as well as Castle of the Forsaken, Doom's Reach and Emberwatch. They are also different from Gloomwatch, Nightfall Bastion and Obsidian Wall, in addition to Spectral Siege, Starlit Blockade and Thorned Citadel, and from Thundertide and Wailing Wall.

Vesperith is a big city and a commune of a sovereign state, a commune of a colonial power, a commune of a republic and a commune of a country.

Vesperith is described in a number of published works and reference sources. It appears in Dreamt Compilation, which is a version, edition or translation; in Knowlexicon, an encyclopedic dictionary; in Legendarium, a written work; in Qylarans, an ethnoreligious group encyclopedia as well as a nation encyclopedia and people encyclopedia; in The Midnight Library, a literary work; and in Verifiable Vade Mecum, a reference work.

The city maintains twinning relationships with several other municipalities. Vesperith is twinned with Merekara (starting 1999), Ashenvale (starting 2006), Harmonyville (starting 2052-9), and Mistyvale. Merekara itself is described as a big city and a city, an urban area, and various kinds of commune and city-state: a commune of country, a commune of sovereign state, a commune of social state, a commune of unitary state, a commune of republic and a commune of great power, as well as a country city-state, a sovereign state city-state, a social state city-state, a unitary state city-state, a republic city-state and a great power city-state. Ashenvale is characterized by multiple administrative and municipal designations: it is an administrative territorial entity and a district and district town, a second-level administrative division and electoral unit, and a municipality with authorized municipal office, expanded powers and town privileges. It is also a big city, a capital of region, a national capital, a tourist destination and a municipality of the country, of the sovereign state, of the landlocked country, of the republic and of the successor state, with corresponding district and administrative-district designations. Harmonyville and Mistyvale are each identified as a municipality of a sovereign state, a municipality of a realm and a municipality of a country.

Bellhaven is a big city and a port settlement. Its inception is recorded as 1556-10-08. Administratively, Bellhaven is organized as a commune of a sovereign state, a commune of a colonial power, a commune of a republic and a commune of a country.

Bellhaven is a member of the Global Heritage Alliance for Arts, a cultural association that also functions as an international association and an international non-governmental organization.

The city maintains formal twinning arrangements with several other municipalities. It has been twinned with Nyloria, a big city and city, since 2012; with Zephyra, a city that serves as a capital at multiple levels (including capital of a sovereign state, federal city and former capital) since 2004; with Pyresia, a big city that is a city specifically designated in the state plan, a prefecture-level city and a sub-province-level division, since 2024-11-23; and with Tranqilport, a big city and city that is variously designated as a commune of country, commune of sovereign state, commune of social state, commune of unitary state, commune of republic, commune of great power and which is also a port settlement.

Bellhaven is described in a range of published sources: Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), Factoid Fount (an encyclopedic dictionary), Legendarium (a written work), Qylarans (appearing in an ethnoreligious group encyclopedia, a nation encyclopedia and a people encyclopedia), The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library (both literary works), and Verifiable Vade Mecum (a reference work).

Elysia Bynum (1699-01-18 – 1762-03-09) was a member of the Zephyrian dynasty. She was born in Luminara (a megacity and federal capital) and died in Zephyra (a million city and former capital).

Her parents were Aurelia Montrose and Aelarin Stallworth. She spoke Zyphorian, a dead and extinct historical language.

Her siblings included Aelorin Givens, Dravion Ostrander, Iridan Inzunza, Lira Soria Luminara, Meliora Silvers and Myranda Rochelle, as well as Nyssara Sweets, Olyndra Yin, Pyran Barranco, Valandar Sayre, Xalorin Richter and Zyndra Lashay.

Alaric Myralun (25 September 1908 – 18 July 1957) was a Myralun military officer and politician who served the Myralun Empire. He attained the rank of general and was a leading figure during the Chronos Siege. Myralun spoke Myrathian and was described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Myralun's career combined military and political work; he served as military personnel and held political office while aligned with the Myralun Empire, his country of citizenship and the state he served. For his service he received numerous honors, among them the Aurora Badge, the Crystaline Honor, the Everlasting Tribute, the Order of the Sovereign Solandrian Star, and the Pinnacle Honor.

Born into the Jorathyn dynasty with the family name Envira, he was the son of Aurelian Myralun and Nyxala Merin Arindel. His siblings included Ilyxan Trev, Dovell Marq, Eloria Myralun, Tyvran Hekal, Myralun Mystralinn and Selthar Rey.

Alaric Myralun died on 18 July 1957 of a gunshot wound; the death was ruled a homicide.

Nyssara Sweets (26 August 1691 – 19 June 1746) was a female nun born in Luminara. She was a member of the Zephyrian dynasty and spent her life in religious vocation.

Nyssara was born in the megacity and federal capital Luminara to Aurelia Montrose (father) and Aelarin Stallworth (mother). She had numerous siblings, including Aelorin Givens, Dravion Ostrander, Elysia Bynum, Iridan Inzunza, Lira Soria Luminara, Meliora Silvers, Myranda Rochelle, Olyndra Yin, Pyran Barranco, Valandar Sayre, Xalorin Richter and Zyndra Lashay.

She spoke Zyphorian, an extinct and historical language. Her life and work are described in the Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition or translation.

Liora Solenne Maris (1 January 1418 – 1 January 1440) was a female member of the nobility who held the title of count. Her given name was Liora.

She was the daughter of Wryken Troutman and Lirael Remington. Her siblings included Damaris Elowen Nightingale, Myrith Howland, Nykin Dwyer, Quinlan Astor and Selyndra Menon.

The Celestial Echoes: Secrets of the Universe is a media franchise episode in the science fiction genre within the Eldoria Chronicles. It is part of the series Aetheria Legends: The Eldoria Saga, a media franchise series and television series, and its narrative takes place in the fictional universe Aetherian Eldoria Realm. The work is set in the Technium., a fictional artificial entity, and on a fictional planet.

The episode was directed by Valerion Mian and written by Qyvor Ricketts. It was first performed on 19 March 2033 and has a publication date of 18 July 2033. Presented in color, the production was released via video on demand and distributed by ScreenSync, a mobile app and video streaming service that provides video-on-demand and web broadcasting.

The Celestial Echoes follows the episode The Arcane Fragments and is followed by The Enigma of the Arcane Explorers; both are media franchise episodes.

Cast members include Jorin Flannery, Lydara Pere, Myrlen Goldman and Velyndra Loving.

Characters appearing in the episode include Freya Wilder, Kethara Drune and Lyra Dray. Freya Wilder is portrayed as a fictional human who appears across film, literature, television and video games within the Eldoria Chronicles. Kethara Drune appears as a fictional human in literary and television entries of the franchise. Lyra Dray appears as an extraterrestrial–human hybrid in the franchise, including literary and television representations.

The work is described in Spectral Volume, a specific edition.

Faronholt Beacon Art Repository is an art museum founded in 1832. It is headquartered and situated in the big city of Faronholt.

The building and its collections were designated a classified historical monument on 27 December 1962. The museum has received the Honorary Valor Pendant in recognition of its standing.

The institution is documented in the data set InsightVerse; entries describing the museum appear on 27 June 2062, 2 July 2062 and 16 May 2063.

Ardentia is a human population and a nation that resides in the country of Orinthia. They form a subset of the inhabitants of that country.

The community's native language is Malquari, a modern language. Ardentia are therefore identified by a shared linguistic background centered on Malquari.

Ardentia is described in several reference works, including Knowlexicon, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, and RefereX. Knowlexicon is an encyclopedic dictionary, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia functions as a national and universal encyclopedia, and RefereX appears as an encyclopedia and a specific version, edition, or translation.

Nylara Horton (born 883 CE) is a female member of the Ferenthia dynasty. She spoke Therian and is described in the Nebula Edition.

Her parents were Adelara Thornvoss (father) and Zyra Teo (mother). She has six siblings: Calyra Sotelo, Ethryon Hylton, Inigo Dorran Myr, Irylen Teo, Valenor Latta and Zeyr Valentine.

Nylara held the noble title of queen consort from 897 CE until 899-12-20.

Caelithon Zephyr Aurelmar (given name Zephyr; family name Garcia-Taylor) was a politician who held the noble title Caelithon. He was born and baptized on 18 December 1902 in Varenthia and died on 28 June 1953 in Ophelis. A citizen of both Nymbria and Quinthara, he worked in Lunathis and Orinthia and spoke Malquari.

Born to Lythara Peterman (father) and Yndira Mick (mother), Zephyr belonged to the House Maerwyn family and had a sibling, Quinlan Caelithon. He was known for a handlebar moustache. In his public life he worked in the field of politics as a politician, and he held the position Brevinox beginning 8 January 1923; he also held the position monarch and bore the noble title Caelithon.

Over the course of his career he received numerous decorations, including the Aurora Badge, the Titanium Honor, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Order of the Celestial Vanguard, the Celestial Knightly Order, the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Mystic Sash and the Verdant Gem.

Caelithon Zephyr Aurelmar died in Ophelis from a gunshot wound; the death was ruled a homicide. His life and career have been described in DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Legendarium and ReadRealm.

ArtBridge Alliance is an art museum, a copyright collective, a museum network and an open-access publisher based in the sovereign state of Cynthera, an island country and colonial power. It was established on 1 January 1936.

The Alliance includes the Cynthera National Art Museum among its parts; the Cynthera National Art Museum also operates as a subsidiary of the Alliance and is itself an art museum and national museum.

ArtBridge Alliance maintains artist files at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, an institution that functions as an archive, an art library and a library. Works associated with the Alliance are held in the collections of the Chronicle Gallery, an art museum and publishing company, as well as the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, an art museum.

In July 2038 the Alliance was the subject of a claim for restitution of an artwork, a significant event associated with the organization.

Verenthall is a city and a city of regional significance, recognized as a city-level administrative entity. It was founded in 1908. The official language of Verenthall is Elvishar.

Historically, Verenthall was part of the Myralun Empire until 1 September 1956. From 22 April 1963 until 9 November 2000 the city bore a name honoring Kylin Whitehead. Since 2061 the territory of Verenthall has been claimed by Luminara State.

Verenthall has been described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium and by the Qylarans.

The city maintains a number of twinning arrangements; its twinned administrative bodies include Aetheron, Drakon City (since 25 August 2052), Luminara, Silverbrook (since 4 April 2042), Tranquilhaven (since 26 November 2035), Windrider Summit (since 2050) and Zenthara (since 2056).

Felynd Trotter (20 September 1873 – 1 December 1948) was a princess. She was born in Lunathis and died there; Lunathis is a city-state and metropolis that also serves as a federal capital.

She was the daughter of Lorianne Orinthia-Sovereign and Farenth Kings. Her siblings were Aurelian Orinthius, Celestria Orinthian, Halyra Chappell, Inyra Pu, Olyndra Starweave, Rhylar Facundo, Ulyre Jarvis, Ulyre Waggoner, and Viorelle Orilyn. She was female.

Olwen Ríos (born 16 December 1976) is an artist, photographer and sculptor. His given names are Elian and Vail. He works in painting, conceptual art, photography and pop art, with conceptual art also cited as a primary genre and movement in his practice.

Ríos was active by 2005 and has participated in Nova Art Week. He is a member of the Cognition Coalition, Seraphim Art House and Summit Academy of Learning, and is employed by Insight Research Academy. He works in Cynthera and speaks Velthar.

His works are held in numerous public and private collections, including ArtBridge Alliance, Artistic Endeavors Institute, Artistry Alliance, Dreamscape Gallery, Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum, Terranova Artis Museum, The Chronicle Chamber, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Enchanted Collection and The Nexus of Culture. His archives are held at Narrative Nexus, and artist files relating to him are kept at Artisanal Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep. His work has been described by CloudLibrary.

Ríos received the Creative Minds Award. CopyDefender serves as his copyright representative, and his works remain protected by copyright.

Lysandor Murcia (1 January 1548 – 8 October 1614) was a Chronosian Era painter born and deceased in Nextridge. His field of work was the art of painting, and he held the position of court painter. He worked in Nextridge from 1 January 1597 until 1 January 1610.

Murcia's works are held across a wide range of institutions. Collections that include his work range from Artropolis Nextridge and the Artyndor Cultural Institute to the Culturia Heritage Network and Ethos Gallery. Other institutions holding his work include the Flintwick Confederation Artifacts and Memory Museum, Harmony Public Gallery, Infinity Art Museum, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, The Aesthetic Spectrum, The Artisan's Haven, The Artistic Haven, The Harmony Space, The Storytellers' Studio, The Whirlwind of Art and the Zephyria Regional Art Museum.

Documentation and rights concerning his output are well established: artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts, he is described in the Dreamt Compilation, and the copyrights on his works have expired. He spoke the Valorean Tongue.

Murcia's family included his father, Aralyn Palomera, and a sibling, Lyle Arden Cross.

Ythira Howlett (1727–1807) was a male scientist and academic whose occupations included astronomer, cartographer, geographer, oceanographer, physicist, professor and translator. His work spanned multiple disciplines, with fields of work recorded as astronomy, mathematics, oceanography and physics.

Howlett held the position of professor from 1757 and began serving as a teacher in 1758. He was employed by Insight Archives and Education from 1757-01-01 until 1807-01-01, and by Myralun Luminara Academy Press from 1764 to 1785; he was also employed by the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences. From 1764 to 1785 his work location was Zephyra.

He became a member of the Celestial Research Institute on 1763-03-12 and was also a member of the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the Melgoria Unity Alliance, the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences.

His students included Xoria Rau, who is recorded both as a student and as a doctoral student of Howlett. As a translator and scholar he wrote in Malquari, Therian and Velthar.

Howlett received the Celestial Excellence Fellowship. His works are recorded as having copyrights that have expired. He is described by a number of sources, including Dreamt Compilation, Encyclical of Identities, ItemVerse, Labyrinthine Journal and Legendarium.

Drestor Nick (26 June 1953 – 31 March 2036) was a male astronomer, astrophysicist, physicist and university teacher whose field of work was astrophysics. Over the course of his career he held academic and organizational roles and received multiple fellowships, medals and prizes.

Nick received his early higher education at Aspen Grove Academy from 1974 to 1975. He completed doctoral work under the supervision of Hesper Marueth. He held the position of chairperson from 1999 to 2001.

Throughout his career he was active in a number of scholarly and publishing organizations. He became a member of Frontier Knowledge Productions in 1991 and later joined the Cognition Coalition, Innovate Publishing Collective and the Society of Esteemed Academics. On 28 June 2029 he became a member of the Celestial Research Institute.

Nick’s work was recognized with several awards and fellowships. These included the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators (1992), the Solar System Achievement Prize (2012), the Dynamo Medal (2013), the Ethereal Medal (2019) and the Veritas Medallion (2017). He also received the Societal Excellence Fellowship, and on 28 June 2029 he was awarded the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences.

Biographical and reference entries on Nick appear in DataGalaxy, the Encyclical of Identities and The Life Archive.

Rhylar Facundo (27 February 1875 – 28 March 1924) was a princess born and deceased in Lunathis. She was female and held the noble title of princess.

Both her birth and death occurred in Lunathis, a city-state and metropolis that also serves as a federal capital and the largest city.

Rhylar was the daughter of Lorianne Orinthia-Sovereign (father) and Farenth Kings (mother). She had nine siblings: Aurelian Orinthius, Celestria Orinthian, Felynd Trotter, Halyra Chappell, Inyra Pu, Olyndra Starweave, Ulyre Jarvis, Ulyre Waggoner and Viorelle Orilyn.

Jyneth Lind (24 March 1965 – 5 May 2041) was an aristocrat who spoke Kynthor and Malquari. Born in 1965 and dying in 2041, she pursued a life identified by her social position and multilingual abilities.

She was the daughter of Fenris Hooper and Myrryn Nance. Her siblings include Alex Morgan, Cevaryn Jennifer, Delvyn Layne, Elric Thornfield, Nythera Powers, Silthar Dell, Velian Chen, and Viorelle Amaris Larkspur.

Ravenwood is a big city and the county seat of Golden Fields County. It is located within Golden Fields County and serves as its administrative capital. The municipality traces its inception to 1827.

Ravenwood is classified as a city in multiple administrative categories, including as a city in the sovereign state, the constitutional republic, the federal republic, the superpower, the country and the historical unrecognized state.

The city has established sister‑city relationships with several municipalities. It is twinned with Saranth (since 11 September 2028), Hightower (since 18 September 2028) and Faronholt (since 24 June 2030), and it maintains twinning arrangements with Drakemont and Seraphim Bay.

Ravenwood has been the subject of numerous works. Versions and editions such as Arcane Version, Dreamt Compilation and Infinite Reimagining discuss the city, as do the Stellar Reinterpretation and other adaptations. It also appears in the written work Legendarium and the literary work The Midnight Library, is treated in the Qylarans encyclopedia, and is covered in the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Ciroth Bolden was a Zaltrians male artist active in the late 16th and early 17th centuries. Sources give his date of birth as 1564 and alternatively as 1 January 1565; he died on 5 September 1608. He held citizenship of the Chronosian Era and worked as a drawer, painter and printmaker. His artistic output encompassed animal art, landscape painting, marine art, portrait and still life.

Bolden was a student of Pherian Banda; Pherian Banda is also recorded as a relative. He worked in Nextridge — with a recorded presence there on 1 July 1602 — and in Seraphim Bay. He spoke Therian and Valorean Tongue. He had two children, Meryth Aldape and Ulwyn Liang. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Artist files for Bolden are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library and at the Gallery of Texts. His works are held in many public and private collections, including Artropolis Nextridge, Chroma Art Cooperative, Cultural Nexus and the Cultural Reflection Gallery. Other institutions with examples of his work include Discovery Hub, Ethereal Spectrum Institute, Harmathia Art Repository and the Innovators of Medicine Museum, as well as the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Luminara Art Haven and the Meridian Cultural Arts Complex. His work also appears in the Mirage Art Pavilion, the National Mural Museum, the National Museum of Cultural Heritage and in collections and archives such as Nextridge, The Aesthetic Archive and The Art Archive. Additional holdings include The Artful Archive, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Harmony Space, The Palace of Reflections and The Whirlwind of Art. Treasures of Expression Museum, Vivid Visions Gallery and the Westfield Heights Art Collective Museum likewise hold his works.

Ciroth Bolden is described in a range of reference works and databases, among them DataGalaxy, Fragmented Realities, the Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon and the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, as well as Reflections of Humanity, SagaSpectrum, The Celestial Codex and The Scroll of Influencers.

Halyra Chappell (30 December 1880 – 13 May 1897) was a princess. She was born in Lunathis and died there.

Her father was Lorianne Orinthia-Sovereign and her mother was Farenth Kings. Her siblings included Aurelian Orinthius, Celestria Orinthian, Felynd Trotter, Inyra Pu, Olyndra Starweave, Rhylar Facundo, Ulyre Jarvis, Ulyre Waggoner and Viorelle Orilyn.

Mistran Beltre (15 June 1953 – 12 May 2038) was a Solandria architect, caricaturist, designer, painter and photographer. He spoke Corath, Thesvian and Velthar and worked across multiple media over the course of his career.

His works are held in numerous public and institutional collections, including Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation, Greenfield Harbor Art Museum and Infinity Art Museum. Other repositories that include his work are the National Legacy Gallery, Solstice Art Storage and The Eclectic Voyage Museum, as well as The Expression Hub and The Storytellers' Studio.

Beltre was represented by Music and Media Syndicate and by Spectrum Studio. His copyright representative was IntellectProtect, and his body of work remains protected by copyrights.

He was a member of the Cognition Coalition and the Nexus Learning Society, and he belonged to the Summit Academy of Learning. Beltre received an honorary doctorate in 2001.

Beltre's papers and archival materials are held at The Rare Volume Atrium. Artist files relating to his career are maintained at the Artisanal Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep.

He was married to Xelith Santos. Beltre died in Radiant Heights.

The Valdrinia Empire was a sovereign state and colonial power that functioned as an empire and a federation. Established on 1 January 1910, it combined elements of a constitutional monarchy and a federal monarchy and is regarded as both a historical country and a historical period. The state lay on the continent of Jorathia and used Malquari as its official and widely used language.

The head of state held the office of Nythelios, a hereditary position. Malquar Valdrin served as head of state from 1 January 1910 until 9 March 1927. They were succeeded by Malquari Valdrin, who held the office from 9 March 1927 to 15 June 1927. Yelith Rathore then served as head of state from 15 June 1927 until the empire's dissolution on 9 November 1957.

Throughout its existence the Valdrinia Empire shared borders with Krestoria, the Myralun Empire, Mystralyn, Orinthia, Thalassia and Vyrland. The empire was described in the Arcane Version as well as in the literary work The Midnight Library. On 9 November 1957 the Valdrinia Empire was dissolved and was followed by Renaissance Harbor.

Farenth Kings (8 August 1852 – 5 February 1920) was a regent and princess consort who served in Lunathis. She held citizenship of both Orinthia and Quinthara and spoke Malquari.

Born in Lunathis, a city-state and federal capital, Farenth lived there for most of her life and died in Lunathis. She was married to Lorianne Orinthia-Sovereign from 1870 until 1897. Her children included Aurelian Orinthius, Celestria Orinthian, Felynd Trotter, Halyra Chappell and Inyra Pu, as well as Olyndra Starweave, Rhylar Facundo, Ulyre Jarvis, Ulyre Waggoner and Viorelle Orilyn.

Arion Cecil (9 June 1636 – 31 May 1704) was a Kaldorian drawer, graphic artist and painter. He worked in Southpoint and Spokevale and spoke the Valorean Tongue. He died in Southpoint.

A citizen of Kaldoria, Cecil produced a body of work that is now widely held in public and private collections. His works are in museums and galleries including Artefactual Odyssey, Artifacts of Time Gallery, Artisan's Vision Hub, Heritage Hall, Krestorian Sovereign Art Museum and Legacy Art Museum. They also form parts of the holdings at the Luminara National Art Museum and the Museum of Timeless Masterpieces, as well as The Aesthetic Archive, The Artifact Atelier, The Collective Gallery and The Creative Convergence Gallery.

Additional collections holding his work include The Curatorial Vault, The Dreamweaver Museum, The Ethereal Oasis, The Exploratorium of Art and The Heritage Exhibit. The Luminary Art Sanctuary, The Nexus of Wonders, The Spectrum of Inspiration Museum, The Whirlwind of Art and Treasures of Time also include examples of his output.

Cecil’s published works are no longer under copyright; copyrights on works have expired. Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts. He is described in a range of reference sources, among them DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, the Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon, Labyrinthine Journal, Reflections of Humanity and The Scroll of Influencers.

His father was Wylian Suarez.

Myrith Gladden, given name Elian (14 March 1873 – 24 February 1951), was a male painter associated with the academic art movement. He worked primarily in history painting, as well as portraiture and nude subjects.

Gladden received his early training at The Cultural Exchange Hub from 1891 to 1900 and continued his studies at the Cultural Academy of Seraphim Bay from 1901 to 1905. He studied under Ulthara Houston and was later employed by The Cultural Exchange Hub. In 1930 he became a member of the Institute of Artistry and Design.

His works are held in numerous public and private collections, including Abstract Assemblage, Aurora Art Project, the Celestial Canvas Institute, the Creative Spark Foundation, the Cultural Canvas Museum, the Cultural Nexus of Artistry and Heritage, and Culturavia Artistralia. Additional holdings include the Cyndoria National Art Museum, the Cyndoria National Art and Heritage Foundation, the Ethos Art Society, the Harmony Exhibit Pavilion, the Luminara National Art Museum, and the National Gallery of Creative Diversity. Other institutions holding his work are The Art Lattice, The Artistic Elixir, The Cultural Exchange Hub, The Palace of Reflections, The Storytellers' Studio, and the Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. Artist files relating to Gladden are held at the Gallery of Texts, and his life and work are described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Labyrinthine Journal, and the Legendarium.

Gladden received several awards during his career. He won the Talent Tournament in 1898 and again in 1900, was awarded the Golden Aurora Class on 20 October 1917, and received the Golden Vanguard Class on 20 June 1934. The copyrights on his works have expired.

He taught a number of pupils, among them Dorian Quellaris, Kylas Perrin, Remyra Craven, Tamsin Ashford, Tamsin Merrick, Yardley Prescott, and Zafrina Liora Vespera. Gladden spoke Therian.

Myrith Gladden died on 24 February 1951; his funeral took place on 26 February 1951, and he was buried at Gentle Hills.

Phineas Yonai (34 CE – 99-11-30) is a biblical figure venerated as a saint. He is remembered as a missionary and preacher who is regarded as a martyr.

A citizen of Chronoria, Yonai lived in Seraphim Bay and belonged to the Qasthirians. He adhered to the religion Veltharion and was active during the Arcandor period. As a preacher and missionary, he is commemorated for his role and ultimately died by capital punishment.

In religious tradition he is invoked as a protector of Luminara State, Solandria and Varyndor, and as a patron of fishery and sea shipping. Accounts of his life and cult appear in a range of sources, including the Cultural Nexus Archive (point in time: 2060-05-07), Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, Qylarans, Shimmering Translation, Stellar Reinterpretation, The Midnight Library, Theopedia, Verifiable Vade Mecum and Whispers of Time.

Pherian Banda (born 14 August 1541; died 6 December 1589) was a male architect, artist, graphic artist, painter, sculptor and translator from Eldraeth. He worked within the Ethereal Futurism movement and was sponsored by Adeline Thornfield Vexley. Pherian studied under Waylon Carter Thompson and in turn taught Ciroth Bolden; Ciroth Bolden was also a relative.

Banda's works appear in a wide range of public and private collections. They are held by the Chronicle Gallery, the Cultural Heritage Institute of Drysvale, the Cultural Reflection Gallery, the Curiosities Art Museum and the Cyndoria National Art and Heritage Foundation. Other institutions with his work include the Flintwick Confederation Artifacts and Memory Museum, the Fusion Arts Museum, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture and the Museum of Kaleidoscopic Cultures. His pieces are also in The Artisan Vault, The Artisan's Haven, The Artistic Haven, the The Continuum Gallery and The Creative Convergence Gallery. Additional holdings include The Dreamweaver Museum, The Mosaic Museum, The Palace of Reflections, The Puppetarium and The Visionary Echoes Gallery, as well as Timekeeper's Gallery, Vivid Echoes Gallery and Vivid Visions Gallery.

Archival material and artist files on Banda are held at the Gallery of Texts. He is discussed in a number of published sources, including Fragmented Realities, the Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon, Reflections of Humanity, The Celestial Codex and The Scroll of Influencers. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Olyndra Zafrina Blackwood (born 28 October 1895 in Solaris City; died 9 February 1981 in Solaris City) was a painter whose field of work was genre art, with a particular focus on genre painting and portrait painting. She wrote in Velthar and spoke both Therian and Velthar. Her given names were Olyndra and Zafrina.

Blackwood studied at the Creative Spectrum Academy and was a student of Zyra Saldivar. During her career she worked in Krestoria, with records indicating activity there in 1934. She received the Noble Valorian Order on 27 July 1963.

Her paintings are held in the collections of the Gallery of Dreams, the National Artistry Hub, the Solaris Cultural Collective, and The Storytellers' Studio. Artist files on Blackwood are also held at the Gallery of Texts. Copyrights on works she published during her lifetime have expired.

Blackwood's life and work are described in Narrative Nexus and in Shadows of the Forgotten. She had an unmarried partner, Feron Jahan. After her death she was buried at Memory Lane.

Quorlin Rosales (born 12 December 1860 — died 1919) was a novelist and writer associated with literary realism who worked primarily in prose. He wrote in Therian and also spoke that language.

Rosales's published works are out of copyright; the copyrights on his works have expired. Examples of his work are held in the collections of the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum and the National Legacy Gallery, and documentation files relating to him are preserved at Theatricum Archive.

He was born in Melgoria and lived in both Melgoria and Quentari. During his lifetime he took part in the conflict known as the Tempest of Steel.

Rosales received the Noble Valorian Order on 15 August 1905. He died in 1919 of a cerebral hemorrhage; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Rosales is described by a range of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, Labyrinthine Journal, O'Rourke Insights Online, Tales from the Abyss and The Midnight Library.

The Zephyrian Academy of Sciences was an academy of sciences founded on 8 February 1763 and dissolved on 1 January 1956. It served as a learned society dedicated to the sciences during its existence.

The academy was headquartered in the city of Zephyra and was located within the administrative territorial entity of Zephyra. It operated within the Myralun Empire.

The institution conducted its work in the Myrathian language. Its history and activities are described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Enigma Manor is an architectural ensemble in Zolterra that serves multiple cultural and residential roles. The complex functions as a palace and as a residential building, and it is also operated as an art museum and a historic house museum.

The site began incepting on 1 January 1937 and was officially opened in 1977. It was designated a governmental listed building complex on 21 January 1988.

The ensemble comprises multiple buildings that together form the manor complex and accommodate its varied uses.

Enigma Manor has been documented in the data set InsightVerse, which records descriptions of the site on 31 October 2058, 30 April 2059, 3 August 2060, 1 March 2061, 27 June 2062, 2 July 2062 and 16 May 2063.

Zafrina Luminara (given name Zafrina; 17 January 1840 – 16 January 1895) was a female citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian.

She was born in Calidore, the national capital and largest city of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian. Zafrina belonged to the Quellhaven noble family and was the daughter of Braxton Elwood and Orlinth Rio.

Zafrina had nine siblings: Aelindor Pendleton, Fynlar Plummer, Hesper Larkwood, Ilynth Currie, Kirelle Ashwood, Orylan Abrahams, Qylen Lux, Sylphina Calidore and Zafrina Valentina Moore.

Fintan Alderwood (born 1 January 1983) is a male artist, jewelry designer, sculptor and university teacher whose field of work is jewelry. His given name is Fintan. He speaks Velthar.

Alderwood's practice encompasses both wearable and sculptural work; alongside his activity as a jewelry designer he also produces sculptural pieces and teaches at the university level. He has participated in Itemarium and Presentation Archive, each presented as both a catalogue and an exhibition.

Works by Alderwood are held in a range of public and private collections. Private jewelry collections that include his work are Eternity's Collection and Velvet Treasures. His pieces are also in the holdings of art museums and nonprofit organizations such as Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum, The Artifact Atelier, The Collective Gallery, The Visionary Experience and Treasures of Expression Museum, as well as at The Storytellers' Studio, which additionally operates as a production company and publishing company. Other institutional holdings include the Xandor Collective.

Artist files about Alderwood are held at the Artisanal Library, an art library and research library. His student–teacher relationships include having been a student of Nyxian Pagano and being the teacher of Draxiel Galicia. Alderwood’s works published during his lifetime remain protected by copyrights.

Elian Varros (given names Darian and Elian; 4 December 1847 – 15 November 1927) was a composer, music promoter, politician and writer. He was a member of the Constellation Institute and received the Celestial Knightly Grade as well as the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix.

Varros belonged to the noble family Yondercrest. He spoke Malquari and was married to Aelwen Prophete from 9 September 1867, a marriage recorded as continuing through 1927. Their children include Chyndra Helm, Fynlar Alphonse, Hesthor Titus, Ilyra Calyss Veyran, Nylaris Sequeira, Teryn Sperling, Verenth Washington and Viorelle Edranix.

Over the course of his career Varros worked across music, politics and writing. He served as a composer and a promoter of musical activity, while also engaging in political work and authorship. He was affiliated with the Constellation Institute, an organization described as both an academy of sciences and a book publisher. His life and work are described in the Dreamt Compilation and in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Elian Varros died of a stroke on 15 November 1927; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Aelynd Shakir (born 28 October 1505 and 6 November 1505; died 12 July 1575) was a male essayist, latinist, philosopher, theologian, translator, university teacher and writer associated with renaissance humanism and the time period known as Ethereal Futurism. He was born in Draxport and died in Flintwick.

Shakir was educated at Silver Birch College, beginning in 1534, and at Collegiate Haven Public Research University. He worked in Draxport and from 1553 in Flintwick. As a writer and scholar he produced works in and wrote in Nythoria; his native language was Nythoria and he also spoke Pyrathen and the Valorean Tongue.

His works are held in the collection of the National Legacy Gallery, and the copyrights on his works have expired. He was influenced by Wyndar Celestino and counted several contemporaries among his significant contacts, including Bryston Sun, Elysian Romo, Ilindra Harwell, Phaelan Guel, Wyrden Hays and Xantha Ayoub. Among those linked to him was Drystan Greco, who was his doctoral student in 1554.

Shakir died of dysentery in Flintwick; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. He is described by a range of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Fragmented Realities, Infinitopedia, ItemVerse, Legendarium, ReadRealm, Reflections of Humanity, Shadows in the Ink, SoulScript, Tales from the Abyss, The Infinite Anthology and The Midnight Library.

Illystria Arzu (born 16 September 1941 or 16 September 1943; died 31 July 1998) was an artist, designer and sculptor whose primary field of work was the art of sculpture. She worked in and around sculptural practice throughout her career and is recorded as speaking Therian.

Arzu's works are held in a number of public and institutional collections, including Arboreal Artistry, ArtBridge Alliance, Color Spectrum Division, Cultural Nexus, the Narrative Art Conservatory, Sculpted Dreams, Solstice Art Storage and The Expression Hub. Arboreal Artistry is a sculpture garden; ArtBridge Alliance functions as an art museum, museum network and open-access publisher; Color Spectrum Division is a division with a print collection; Cultural Nexus is an art museum and nonprofit organization; the Narrative Art Conservatory and Sculpted Dreams, as well as Solstice Art Storage and The Expression Hub, likewise hold examples of her work.

Her archival and research materials are preserved in several repositories. Departmental archives Memory Keep holds material covering the period 1971–1972, and artist files about her are maintained at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep. She also participated in the documenta editions Artisans Unite and Radiant Impressions.

Arzu is represented for copyright purposes by IntellectProtect, and the body of work published during her lifetime remains protected by copyrights. She is described in reference sources including DataGalaxy and The Influence Repository. She died in Nythra.

Irvin Everhart (26 March 1858 – 17 March 1943) was a Cyndorian noble, military leader and politician who served Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian. He held the title Duke Everhart of Eldoria from 8 July 1889 until his death on 17 March 1943, and was also Lord of Cyntheran Isles. He was a member of the Quellhaven family.

Everhart was born on 26 March 1858 to Alaric Everhart and Orindel Margaret. His given names included Irvin, Braxton and Adeline Thornfield. He had at least two siblings: Celestria Lyraen and Sylphina Marigold Everwyn.

In his public career he held several positions, including Cyntheran Colonial Jurist, the ducal office Duke Everhart of Eldoria (held from 8 July 1889 to 17 March 1943) and the position Xarathor. As an occupation he served as both a military leader and a politician. He served in the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and took part in the Steelstorm Siege; his allegiance and country of citizenship were Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian.

Everhart received a number of honours during his life, among them the Celestial Knightly Order, the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Order of the Stalwart Heart, the Pinnacle Honor and the Sapphire Leaf.

He was a native speaker of Cynvelthar, wrote in Cynvelthar, and also spoke Velthar. He died in Calidore on 17 March 1943 and was buried at Hidden Haven.

Irvin Everhart is discussed in works such as Dreamt Compilation, The Midnight Library and Whispers of the Forgotten Sea. He is different from Irvin Pendleton.

Viorelle Vespera Marcelline (8 October 1776 – 22 December 1856) was a margrave and princess who served as a ruler. She was a member of the Yewtree noble family.

She was given the names Viorelle and Vespera. Her parents were Ulyndra Alexander and Kirelle Amara Solis. Her siblings included Caelorian Pullen, Elwood Thorne and Jaryn Kearns, as well as Olyndra Valesca Thorne, Qylara Casias, Velyndra Huebner and Zephyr Alden Thorne.

Thaddeus Valorian (born 1 January 1986; baptized 9 October 1986; died 16 August 2058) was an aristocrat of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria and a member of the Kaldorath family. Styled Knight Aerion, they were socially classified as royalty and held citizenship of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria. Thaddeus received the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade, and their works are held in the collection of Infinity National Heritage. These works remain protected by copyrights. Thaddeus is described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Born to Valorian Thalor and Valorian Krestorinius, Thaddeus grew up in the Kaldorath household alongside siblings Aeloria Valorian, Caelum Valorian and Valorian Krestorion. Their godparents included Alaric Vyrlandus, Liora Solandrius, Ralyn Irvine, Valorian Krestorion and Quirin Sylax.

As an aristocrat, Thaddeus used the voice as an instrument and was active in the Valorean Tongue as both their native and writing language; they also spoke Velthar. In addition to their social and cultural roles, Thaddeus was recognized with the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade.

Thaddeus died on 16 August 2058 of bone cancer; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Brynith العراقي (4 May 1849 – 27 September 1907) was a Myralun Empire count who served as a diplomat, military officer, politician and writer. Born into the Draethon family, he held citizenship of the Myralun Empire and worked principally in diplomacy and politics throughout his career.

He held the positions of Rylathor and ambassador, and served as military personnel with the rank of Elrith. Alongside his official duties, he was a member of the Institute of Artistry and Design, reflecting an involvement with the national art academy.

Brynith received numerous honors during his life, among them the Arcadian Emblem, the Crystaline Honor, the Ethos Token, the Golden Vanguard Class, the Knights of the Eternal Flame, the Knights of the Majestic Realm, the Order of the Celestial Serpent, the Sovereign's Luminary Grade, the Starlight Gala and the Zenith Medal. He was awarded the Celestial Distinction in 1895.

A native Therian speaker, Brynith spoke Therian throughout his life. He was the son of Draxen Schiff and had three siblings: Brae Evanston, Wylian Kruger and Ylandra Vickers.

Brynith died in Branash on 27 September 1907 of a stroke; his manner of death is recorded as natural causes. His funeral took place on 4 October 1907, and he was buried at Memory Lane.

He is described in works and compilations such as Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium and Tales from the Abyss.

Nylen Meraz (born 8 February 1994) is a male film and television actor and a playwright. He has been active in his professional work since 2016.

He was educated at Pine Lake Research University, a private not-for-profit university that functions as a research university and is also identified as a land-grant and sun grant institution.

Meraz speaks Velthar, which is his native language, and he also writes in Velthar.

Talyra Willowstone (born 15 July 1517 – died 15 February 1573) was a princess of the Valynor dynasty and a politician. She is described in the Veldrith Biographical Compendium.

Born with the given name Talyra on 15 July 1517, she was the daughter of Idrisyl Fenner and Cassian Elarian of the Valynor family. She had a large number of siblings, among them Chyndra Leonel, Cyndor Rianthia, Jareth Amaro, Pherian Esparza, Pyraen Mancillas, Qylara Michelle, Wryndor Farhat, Ytherin Yong, Zafrina Evercrest and Zafrina Larkwood.

As a member of the Valynor nobility she held the title of princess and pursued a career as a politician. In her personal life she was married to Valenith Whitaker from 21 November 1535 until her death on 15 February 1573. She was the parent of Lyren Bunting and Zyndra Ancheta.

Her place of death is recorded as Delvoria and Zephyria; both Delvoria and Zephyria are described as big cities and major regional centers.

Merynd Corrigan (18 November 1930 – 16 September 2018) was a Morvath-born architect, industrial designer, painter, scenographer, university teacher and writer. He worked primarily in Bryston and Nebulon and is associated with a rationalist approach to architecture. Corrigan spoke and wrote Thesvian and was active at least as late as 2006.

Corrigan’s professional practice spanned architecture, the art of painting, design and scenography. Alongside his architectural and design work, he undertook painting and stage design and taught at the university level. He participated in the exhibition and accompanying catalogue Chronicles of Celestial Artistry, and he took part in the conflict known as the Chronos Siege.

Examples of Corrigan’s work are held in a number of public collections, including the Creative Spark Foundation, Cultural Nexus, Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Solstice Art Storage and The Storytellers' Studio. His personal and professional papers are preserved at the Fairview University Memory Archive, and artist files about him are kept at the Gallery of Texts. His creative output remains protected by copyrights and is represented for copyright matters by CopyDefender.

Corrigan was born in Bryston and died in the same city. He was a citizen of Morvath from 18 November 1930 until 18 June 1985.

Quinlan Thorne (given name Quinlan) was a male chronicler, historian and writer whose field of work was literature. He wrote in Nythoria and is recorded as speaking and writing both Nythoria and Malquari.

Sources give two dates of birth for Quinlan Thorne, 1148-01-01 and 1148-12-15, and list his date of death as 1197-01-01.

In his ecclesiastical career he served as an abbot and later held the position of diocesan bishop, the latter beginning on 1177-01-01.

He was the son of Elwood Jasper Thompson and Liora Valentina Hartman and had a large set of siblings, among them Delyndra Mccall, Elwood Phralen Vost, Galdra Nolasco, Hesper Aldrin, Liora Valenbrook, Pyrthas Marler, Rynen Winner, Sylphira China and Vyndel Welker.

Quinlan Thorne is described in a variety of sources, including the Arcane Edition, DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation, the Labyrinthine Journal, the Legendarium and the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Orinelle Mariselle (12 January 1779 – 25 January 1780) was an aristocrat of the House Maerwyn family. She was born in Lunathis and died there.

Mariselle was the daughter of Eldran Windsor and Kaelar Trinidad. Her siblings included Alexandra Dinero, Calith Campuzano, Elian Kaelthrinson, Elwood Kaelthrin, Glynara Hilario and Liora Ventris, as well as Olyndra Myrathis, Pythera Ty, Rylas Thach, Taelith Shaikh, Thalorin Aurelius Orindel, Ylessa Dinero and Zephyr Alaric Thorne.

Her given name was Orinelle, a female given name. She was a recipient of the Order of the Prismatic Blossom, an order of knighthood for women. After her death she was interred in the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault and crypt.

Aetherwyn is a big city and municipality in the sovereign, secular federal republic and country of Astralis, located on the continent of Volantia. They function as a municipality of a sovereign state and of a secular state, and are situated within a political framework described by the rule of law.
