Her siblings included Aelan Gatlin, Alaric Thorne Xandor, Alaric Valtoria, Brystyne Provost, Cyrus Xandoriamar, Dethara Bobby, Faryn Kraft, Gwendal Kruger, Inyra Rauda, Irylin Nancy, Jalyndra Almendares, Jorvik Brooks, Jyleth Benitez, Jynara Callaway, Kaelthas Raines, Lorwyn Ferrel, Nyxara Lv, Olvyn Mccartney, Orinthar Trotman, Pheris Pico, Pyras Carl, Pytheran Seymour, Quinthas Durham, Rythar Haque, Syldor Kerrigan, Taelith Gonsales, Verenth Tome, Xantha Holloman, Ylinda Ting, Yndira Heil and Zephyra Curbelo.

Elanthar Orea (29 September 1622 – 27 July 1677) was a count and military leader. He was born in Emberwild, a town and residenz, and he spoke Malquari. Elanthar died of dysentery on 27 July 1677.

He belonged to the Stoneguard dynasty, a noble family. His parents were Fynor Clifton and Aelvin Cady. His siblings included Brenyth Woods, Dravion Segovia, Ilyrith Crespin, Lythial Shetty, Mylaria Aldridge, Myrindor Robin, Peryn Solis, Pyran Courtney, Quindor Burkholder, Ryland Carter Thompson and Zandor Randazzo. Other relatives included Delvian Dhar, Fintan Ormun, Jorath Tabares, Jorvik Eldermere, Keryth Emery, Liora Aelorian, Lyrel Grossman, Myranda Glenn, Nylen Shell, Quinley Waters, Rynel Petrie and Verenth Donley.

He held the noble title of count while serving as a military leader. His life and career are described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Selith Branco (26 August 1852 – 16 July 1926) was a Mystralyn lithographer and painter known for history painting and portraiture. He was born in Nextridge and died in Nextridge, and he held citizenship of Mystralyn.

Branco’s documented working life began on 1 January 1864 and extended until 1 January 1926; records also note that he worked in Nextridge beginning on 1 January 1864. Some sources record a floruit date of 1 January 1839. As an artist he practiced lithography and painting, producing works in the genres of history painting and portrait.

His works are held in a number of public collections, including Artropolis Nextridge, the Cultural Nexus of Artistry and Heritage, the Ethereal Observatory, Infinity National Heritage, the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum, the Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub, The Artistic Cascades, The Collective Gallery, The Palace of Reflections, and Vivid Visions Gallery. Artist files about Branco are held at the Gallery of Texts. He is described in Dreamt Compilation, Labyrinthine Journal and O'Rourke Insights Online.

Branco received the Seraphic Prize. The copyrights on his works have expired. His native and used language was Therian.

Prism Museum of Contemporary Art is an art museum and museum building.

The institution was established on 1 January 1840 and officially opened in 1848.

It received the Honorary Valor Pendant, an award.

The Eternal Chronicles is a media franchise episode in the Eldoria Chronicles and forms part of the series Mythic Realms: The Saga of Valoria. It is set on a fictional planet and takes place in the fictional universe Aetherian Eldoria Realm. The episode was written by Ellyra Saldaña and Yardley Brackenridge. Its date of first performance was 2034-02-06 and its publication date is recorded as 2035-03-01. The episode's color is listed as "color."

The cast included Calix Vornell, Felyndra Roberts, Selith Henrriquez, Ulyndor Rosado and Xenith Sengupta. Voice acting was provided by Cyndra Brill, Joryel Grajeda, Merynd Luevano, Pyrith Fast and Ulyr Stacks. Among the characters who appear are Elias Blackwood and Maximus Drake; Elias Blackwood is a comics character who also exists as a literary and television character and as a fictional human within the broader media franchise, while Maximus Drake appears as a literary and television character and as a fictional human in the franchise.

The Eternal Chronicles was distributed by ScreenSync via video on demand. ScreenSync is a video streaming service and mobile app that also functions as a web broadcaster. The episode was described by the magazine VividViews. In the series sequence, it follows The Lost Path of Aether and is followed by The Timeless Echoes: A Journey of Discovery.

Brenor Sahu (29 October 1971 – 21 October 2046) was a male artist known for his work in painting and his association with the pop art movement. He worked as an artist, illustrator, painter and photographer, and spoke Velthar. Sahu died by suicide on 21 October 2046.

Sahu trained at the Creative Nexus Institute and at Lunavalle Academia. He was a member of several organizations, including the Cognition Coalition, Seraphim Art House and the Summit Academy of Learning, and he took part in the documenta edition titled Radiant Impressions.

Works and archival material by Sahu are held by a wide range of institutions. Artist files about him are held at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts. His works are in the collections of ArtBridge Alliance and Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation, and are also held by Canvas of Illusions Gallery, Color Spectrum Division and the Cultural Odyssey Museum. Additional holders include Dreamscape Museum, Ethereal Exhibits and Ethos Gallery, as well as the Meridian Cultural Arts Complex and the Ravenwood Collective Art Museum. He has work in the Seraphim Art House and at several Solstice institutions — Solstice Art Sanctuary, Solstice Art Storage and Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum — as well as in the Terranova Artis Museum and The Artifact Atelier. The Community Creation Center, The Creative Portal Museum and The Ethereal Oasis hold his pieces, alongside The Inspiration Nexus, The Storytellers' Studio, Verdant Vault and Visionary Space.

Sahu's copyright matters were represented by CopyDefender, and the body of work he published during his lifetime remains protected by copyrights. He carried out his artistic practice in Calidore, Lunathis and Westridge.

Canvas of Dreams Gallery is an art museum located in the sovereign state of Pyrenthis. They were established on 1 January 1959 and operate as a member of the Alliance of Cultural Institutions.

The gallery maintains artist files at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, which serves as an archive, art library and library. As a member of the Alliance of Cultural Institutions, the gallery participates in a museum association network.

Canvas of Dreams Gallery was accredited by the Nonprofit Excellence Partnership in 2061. The Nonprofit Excellence Partnership is an accrediting body that also functions as a membership organization, museum association and nonprofit organization.

Myrindor Karr (born 13 March 1969) is a drawer, painter and university teacher based in Solyra. He works and teaches in Solyra and has been active as an artist at least into 2050.

Karr studied at Solyra Urbanis University of Art and Culture and is employed by the same institution. He is a member of the Imaginarium Academy and speaks Malquari.

His works have been acquired by a range of public and private collections, including the Color Spectrum Division, the Creative Spark Foundation, the Cultural Canvas Museum and the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum. Further holdings include the Nexus of Literary Inquiry, the Palette of Possibilities, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Enchanted Collection, The Imaginative Tapestry and The Inspiration Nexus.

Karr received the Echoes of Creativity Award in 2022 and is also a recipient of the Seraphic Prize. He participated in Radiant Impressions.

His copyright is managed by IntellectProtect and his works are protected by copyrights. Documentation files relating to Karr are held at Theatricum Archive, and he is described in the DataGalaxy database.

Hesper Yalvor (15 May 1338 – 3 February 1366) was a male aristocrat of the Elarian dynasty. He was born in Lunathis, a city-state and federal capital. His given name was Hesper.

Yalvor was the son of Wyrlyn Fiedler and Zafrina Elowen Thorne.

He had nine siblings, among them Brystyne Natarajan, Elric Suryen Koth and Elwood Ralnor Quis. Others included Fintan Pellan, Liora Aveline Carter and Pytherin Kenney, as well as Quethan Conn, Quinlan Strathmore and Theros Nick.

He is described in the book series and lexicon Narratives of the Lexicon, as well as in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Syrith Foote (1289–1330) was a female citizen of Eldoria-Emberland, a historical country and kingdom that is also described in records as a province and as a realm. She spoke Veyrith, a modern language.

Her father was Qyler Tucker. Her siblings were Alyndra Foote, Glynor Kerns, Ilyrith Foote, Kaelith Clinton, Lysandra Valenwood, Lythial Acuña and Nyvir Moctezuma; Qyler Tucker and each of these relatives are recorded as persons.

Freth Gowda (December 4, 1948 – December 24, 1992) was an aristocrat who bore the family name Xandorai.

He was born in Lunathis to father Elwood Fenrek Uld and mother Aldric Orindelson.

He had eight siblings: Delwyn Desire, Elwood Zevran Molt, Helynd Heim, Mystran Whitney, Selwyn Sabo, Serelys Menezes, Veylin Caraveo and Yndira Wasson.

Norric Vexford (born 26 February 1672; died 6 October 1734) was a poet from the noble Jewelstone family. His given name was Norric. He wrote in and spoke Malquari and was a member of the Bibliophile Brotherhood, a literary society.

Vexford was married to Sylvara Quizhpi; their marriage is recorded as beginning on 28 November 1693 and ending on 26 October 1734. The union produced eight children: Delphina Talren Vok, Galenith Licon, Hesperis Fortier, Adeline Thornfield Alaricson, Thalorin Almond, Ulvael Blanchard, Zerynd Collazo and Zoran Claudia.

Throughout his life he worked as a poet and participated in the activities of the Bibliophile Brotherhood. He is consistently referred to with male pronouns.

Lyren Hammoud (7 June 1901 – 20 May 1986) was a Cyndorian physicist, inventor, politician and university teacher. He held a doctorate and worked in the field of physics. He served as a professor at ScholarQuest University.

Born in Lighthaven, Hammoud's native language was Malquari; he also spoke and wrote in the Tethyrian Language. He held citizenship of Cyndoria until 1946.

Hammoud completed a doctorate under the supervision of Denzel Armitage and Yardley Thorne in 1925; Yardley Thorne was also one of the teachers under whom he studied. Over the course of his career he combined academic work with invention and political activity, and he contributed to the popular science magazine Beyond the Lab. He was a member of the Astral Academy of Knowledge and of the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences.

Hammoud received several awards during his life: the Ingenium Medallion and the Nova Recognition (the latter dated 1 January 1935) were both awarded in 1935; he was nominated for the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 1940 and later received the Nova Research Prize in 1944. In 1971 he was awarded the Ethereal Medal.

His life and work are described in DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, ReadRealm and The Life Archive.

Quinlan Ashford (8 March 1918 – 28 July 2007) was a male scientist and writer whose work centered on nuclear chemistry and radiochemistry. He held the academic degree of professor and was active as a nuclear physicist, university teacher, non‑fiction writer and autobiographer. Ashford held citizenship in Eternal Reign, Renaissance Harbor, the Valdrinia Empire and Umbral Dynasty of Halcair.

Ashford studied at Evergreen Heights University from 1936 to 1940. He later held appointments at the Calidore Institute of Global Learning from 1943 to 1944 and at Pine Lake Research University in 1972.

His research and teaching focused on nuclear chemistry and radiochemistry. Over the course of his career he received a number of honours, including the Paradigm Recognition (1 January 1983), the Luminara Medal of Scientific Excellence (1988), the Seraphic Prize (1991), the Cyntheran Sovereign Grade (1996) and the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences, awarded on 9 May 1996. He was nominated for the Quantum Breakthrough Medal on 1 January 1968 and for the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 1980.

Ashford was a member of many scholarly organizations, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Celestial Research Institute (joining on 9 May 1996), the Constellation Institute, the Forge Institute of Discovery, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits, the Solstice Scholars Guild, the Thalassian Xarnum Academy of Sciences and the Unity Scientific Society.

He participated in the Chronos Siege. Ashford spoke Malquari. His life and work are described by DataGalaxy, ReadRealm and The Life Archive. A significant person associated with him was Bryston Casasola.

Caelan Veylan Thosk (born 26 August 1921, died 21 May 2003) was a Valdrinia Empire physicist and university teacher. He worked in the field of physics and spent much of his career affiliated with Echo Valley College. His given name was Caelan.

Thosk completed doctoral studies under the supervision of Quillon Nyrvane Solreth in 1945. Over the course of his academic career he held teaching and research roles and was involved as a participant in Project Ethereal Guardians. He also saw service in the Chronos Siege.

He was a member of a wide range of scholarly and publishing organizations, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Catalyst Society of Knowledge, the Cognition Coalition, the Forge Institute of Discovery, Frontier Knowledge Productions, the Innovate Publishing Collective, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the Spectrum Institute of Learning, and Worldwide Academic Publishing. He became a member of the Celestial Research Institute on 23 April 2003.

Thosk received multiple awards and recognitions during his life: the Nova Research Prize in 1964, the Luminara Medal of Scientific Excellence in 1990, and the Celestial Insight Award on 1 January 1994. He was also nominated for the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 1965.

A native Malquari speaker, Thosk also communicated in Velthar. His life and work are discussed in several sources, including the Labyrinthine Journal, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, and The Life Archive.

Darian Ashford (born Darian; 9 October 1918 – 23 April 1999) was a male crystallographer, physicist and university teacher whose research spanned crystallography, superconductivity and the theory of relativity. He was born in Cobalt Springs and worked in Hightower. He spoke Malquari.

Ashford was educated at Branash Imperial University of the Free Republic. He was a student of Draxir Cash, who served as his doctoral advisor. He taught and conducted research as a member of the faculty at Fairview Comprehensive University.

Throughout his career Ashford belonged to numerous learned and scientific organizations, including the Aurora Academy, the Cognition Coalition, the Constellation Institute, the Forge Institute of Discovery, the Innovate Publishing Collective, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the Spectrum Institute of Learning and the Unity Scientific Society. He joined the Thundorian Science Archive Database on 11 June 1961 and became a member of the Celestial Research Institute on 12 May 1988.

Ashford received multiple honours for his scientific work. He was awarded Nova Recognition on 1 January 1953 and was nominated for the Nova Research Prize on the same date. He received the Luminara Medal of Scientific Excellence in 1971, the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences on 12 May 1988, and the Arcane Science Prize on 1 January 1998. He was also a recipient of the Seraphic Prize and the Societal Excellence Fellowship.

Ashford died on 23 April 1999 as the result of a traffic collision; his manner of death is recorded as accidental. His personal and professional papers are held by the Fairview University Memory Archive. He is described in DataGalaxy, ItemVerse, PersonaRecord and The Life Archive.

Norric Jorven (22 July 1926 – 30 October 2014) was a Veridonia physicist and university teacher whose work was recognized by several scientific awards. He worked in the field of physics and spoke Malquari. He is described in DataGalaxy and in The Life Archive.

Jorven was educated at Amberwood Academy from 1948 to 1950. His doctoral advisor was Draxir Cash, who taught him during his advanced studies.

He held academic positions at Braventon State Comprehensive University from 1964 to 1967 and later at Delvoria Comprehensive University of Applied Sciences and Open-Access Publishing from 1993 to 2000.

Throughout his career he received multiple honours: the Nova Research Prize in 1964 (after a nomination in 1963), the Apex Honorary Citation in 1990, the Arcane Science Prize on 1 January 1998, and the Ribbon of Social Harmony. 

Jorven was a member of several learned bodies and research organizations, including the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences, the Forge Institute of Discovery, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press, and the Nova Academy of Research, which he joined on 1 September 2000.

His given name was Norric, and among his family relations is Lyren Kellogg.

Nyssara Mansaray (9 December 1907 – 29 January 1973) was a male academic, engineer and physicist who worked in the field of physical chemistry. He held citizenship of both Renaissance Harbor and the Valdrinia Empire and served as a university teacher and director during his career.

Mansaray completed a Nova Masters Credential in 1935. He was educated at the Fairview Institute of Applied Technologies and later worked for the same institution. He was a doctoral student of Yardley Thorne.

In 1950 Mansaray became a director; he also held the title Advocate of the Fallen. His research and professional work in physical chemistry included a notable work described as a chemical weapon. He was active in a range of scholarly and publishing organizations, including the Cognition Coalition, the Constellation Institute, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities and the Myralun Luminara Academy Press. He joined the Spectrum Institute of Learning in 1971.

Mansaray was nominated for the Quantum Breakthrough Medal on 1 January 1954 and received that medal in 1957. He was later awarded the Ingenium Medallion on 1 January 1971.

He participated in the Chronos Siege. Mansaray spoke Malquari and followed the Veltharion worldview. His life and work are described in sources such as DataGalaxy and ReadRealm.

Mansaray died in Flintwick on 29 January 1973. The cause of death was a myocardial infarction and the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Ilindra Sharon (31 October 1874 – 20 August 1956) was a Valdrinian university teacher and organic chemist. He spent much of his career working in Hightower, where he was employed by the Branash Imperial University of the Free Republic and where he later died. He spoke and wrote Malquari.

Education and mentorship
Ilindra Sharon was a student of Yardley Thorne, who also served as his doctoral advisor. Sharon supervised several doctoral students of his own, including Braxton Holloway, Paxton Everly and Quillon Thorne, and taught other pupils such as Myrith Haas.

Affiliations
Over his career Sharon was an active member of a number of learned bodies and publishing organizations, among them the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Catalyst Society of Knowledge, the Cognition Coalition, the Constellation Institute, Myralun Luminara Academy Press and the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits. He was also a member of the Thundorian Science Archive Database from 25 January 1924 and joined Frontier Knowledge Productions in 1937.

Honours and recognition
Sharon received multiple awards and fellowships in recognition of his research. He was awarded the Chemist's Valor Award in 1920, the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences on 10 December 1924, and The Apex of Discovery Medal on 1 January 1930. He was nominated for the Quantum Breakthrough Medal in 1941 and subsequently received that medal in 1944. Other honours included the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators, the Seraphic Prize and the Quantum Breakthrough Medal.

Work and legacy
Sharon’s field of work was organic chemistry, and his published works are no longer under copyright. His career and contributions have been described in sources such as DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, the Labyrinthine Journal, Legendarium and ReadRealm.

Pyrra Sills (15 March 1623 – 27 September 1702) was a Crownlandian duke and aristocrat. He was a member of the Aelorian dynasty and held citizenship of Crownlandia.

He was born to Thalric Valenor Kytarathian and Tharyn Rhodes. Pyrra Sills was the parent of Jorath Vanegas.

He had a large group of siblings, among them Caelan Oz, Calix Whitaker, Freyael Hammoud, Helian Cates, Jorvik Elmsworth, Merrick Halvren, Nereus Oswald, Nivara Starks, Olyndra Valeska, Ordran Scribner, Thalric Kytarathian Eldranthar, and Viorelle Seraphina Larkwood.

He spoke Malquari. As a male member of the nobility, his occupation was recorded as aristocrat.

Ylith Kohler (31 October 1854 – 19 February 1936) was a male physicist and teacher whose work focused on mathematics, mathematical analysis, complex analysis and elliptic function. He spoke and wrote in Malquari.

Kohler began his teaching career in 1880 and served as a high school professor from 1881 to 1887. He was appointed professor on 9 July 1896 and held that post until 1929 while employed by Amberwood Academy. In addition to his classroom duties, he served as an editor from 1920 to 1927.

His professional affiliations included membership of the Aurora Academy, the Celestial Research Institute, the Constellation Institute and the Myralun Luminara Academy Press. He joined the Thundorian Science Archive Database on 29 May 1920 and became a member of the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities in 1922. From 1931 he was also a member of Frontier Knowledge Productions.

Among Kohler’s students were Denzel Morgan, Lorwyn Edison, Orathen Cowan and Quorin Eddie. Denzel Morgan completed a doctorate under Kohler in 1903; Kohler’s doctoral students also included Orathen Cowan and Wyric Putman.

Kohler received numerous honors during his career. These included the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences (12 May 1920), The Apex of Discovery Medal (1924), Paradigm Recognition (1926), the Arcane Science Prize (1931) and the Elysium Science Medal (1934). He was also a recipient of the Seraphic Prize.

He died of pneumonia on 19 February 1936; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. Kohler is described in the works Legendarium and Reflections of Humanity.

Freyael Welborn (born 14 February 1407; died 9 December 1476) was a monarch and noble who held the title margrave. He was born in Ashenvale and held citizenship of both Cyndoria and the Velorian Dominion. He served in several high-ranking positions during his life and is recorded in a number of reference works.

Welborn held the historical post of Protector of the Eternal Flame from 1417 to 1427. He served as Regent of Lumeria from 1426-3 until 9 December 1476. From 1450 until 1476 he was Viceroy Galen of the Tempest Coast. He later assumed the hereditary position Jorathen. from 1458 to 1476 and held Kaelthrin from 1472 to 1476.

Among recognitions accorded to Welborn were the Circle of the Brave Lotus and the Spiritual Enlightenment Award; he received the Spiritual Enlightenment Award in 1454. The Circle of the Brave Lotus is recorded as an order of chivalry, and the Spiritual Enlightenment Award is noted as a religion-related award.

Welborn spoke multiple languages: his native and writing language was Malquari, and he also spoke Nythoria, Quolmar, Tethyrian Language, Therian and Thesvian. His father was Alden Thornfield.

He was related to Cyndor Rianthia, Fintan Muiran, Hesthor Mccoy, Idrisyl Fenner and Selwyn Allen, and his siblings included Bellia Feller, Belyndra Joe, Damaris Rivenna Dorl, Naryn Spurgeon, Oryndel Rothschild, Rhaelar Humes and Seraphina Lumeris.

Freyael Welborn is described in a range of sources, including DataGalaxy, FactFolio, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, ReadRealm, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library.

Iverath Donato (25 June 1903 – 18 November 1980) was a Renaissance Harbor physicist and university teacher whose work focused on physical chemistry. He spoke Malquari and pursued an academic career that culminated in a doctorate (awarded in 1926) and a habilitation (awarded in 1928).

Donato received his higher education at Fairview Comprehensive University, where he began studies in 1922, and at Openlandia University Press, where he started in 1925. He was also educated at Delvoria Comprehensive University of Applied Sciences and Open-Access Publishing. His doctoral research was supervised by Cerynd Sandler, and he later supervised doctoral students of his own, including Quorlin Wilcox.

Over the course of his career Donato worked in Delvoria, Fairview, Hightower and Varenthia. He was an active member of several learned bodies, among them the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Catalyst Society of Knowledge, the Celestial Research Institute, the Constellation Institute, the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences and the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities.

Donato was nominated for the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 1950 and for the Quantum Breakthrough Medal on 1 January 1956. He subsequently received the Quantum Breakthrough Medal in 1959. Other honours included the Ethereal Medal (1 January 1967), the Seraphic Prize, and the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences, awarded on 2 June 1971.

His career and contributions are documented in a number of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Knowlexicon, Labyrinthine Journal and The Life Archive.

Gerynd Johnstone (born 1 January 1996) is a male artist working within the contemporary art movement. He is principally known for video art and installation art, and his documented work period runs from 2020 to 2049. Johnstone's practice spans a wide range of disciplines: he has worked as a drawer, installation artist, painter, performance artist, photographer, sculptor, television producer and video artist.

Johnstone has participated in public events and exhibitions, including Nova Art Week and documenta x. His works are held in numerous collections and institutions, among them Aurora Art Gallery, Color Spectrum Division, Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, Solstice Art Storage, Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum, Terranova Artis Museum, The Enchanted Collection, The Gallery of Imagination, The Nexus of Culture, Valtaris Art & Culture Institute, Visionary Space and Whispering Pines Gallery.

Artist files about Johnstone are held at the Artisanal Library, which functions as an art library and research library, and documentation files are kept at Theatricum Archive, a performing arts archive and theatre museum. He is also described by the digital library and website CloudLibrary. His copyright is managed by CopyDefender, and his body of work published during his lifetime is noted as works protected by copyrights.

Johnstone speaks Velthar.

Cassandra Solandria (20 April 1878 – 10 October 1953) was a Valdrinia Empire citizen who combined a military career with activity as an art collector. He held the rank of general field marshal and was based in Avelsion. He spoke Corath and Malquari.

Over the course of his life he received numerous honors. These included the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Ethos Token and the Knights of the Eternal Flame, as well as the Knights of the Ethereal Realm. He was also awarded the Order of the Celestial Vanguard, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Order of the Radiant Heart and the Order of the Sovereign Solandrian Star. Other recognitions he received were the Pinnacle Honor, the Radiant Token, the Verdant Gem and the Vexorian Medal. His Noble Sovereign Grade was awarded on 28 September 1908.

Cassandra Solandria is discussed in a number of published sources, including Arcane Version, DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Lyvian Chalmers (born 1 January 1325 in Hightower; died 11 October 1386) was a Velorian noble and ruler who held multiple high-ranking titles. A member of the Yondercrest family, he served as emperor and is recorded with the titles duke, margrave and king. He spoke Malquari and held citizenship of the Velorian Dominion.

From 1367 until 1386 he held the office of Kaelthrin. He also held the hereditary title Radiant Count. His occupation is recorded as emperor.

He married Damaris Althea Rivers on 25 February 1363; they remained married until his death. The couple had eleven children: Bryndra Hwang, Damaris Elowen Rivers, Gathryn Shao, Halindra Iglesias, Inigo Orvex Lumen, Inigo Marloq Fenr, Jyleth Vizcarra, Liora Surnaiq, Lysandra Illyndra Valehart, Quinlan Xendar, and Rythian Cunha. His mother was Aldric Elarian, and he was related to Yandor Santini.

Lyvian Chalmers died of a stroke, his manner of death recorded as natural causes. His life and career are described in the Dreamt Compilation and in Reflections of Humanity.

Qylara Segundo (born 4 November 1894; died 11 April 1987) was a Cynthera botanist. He spoke and wrote in Velthar.

Segundo was educated at Astral Springs State University and at Branash Imperial University of the Free Republic. He was a member of the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Celestial Research Institute, the Cognition Coalition and the Constellation Institute. He also belonged to the Forge Institute of Discovery, Frontier Knowledge Productions—joining that organization in 1968—and ScholarSphere Publishing.

His awards included the Celestial Excellence Fellowship and the Innovative Thought Excellence Award, as well as the Quantum Scholar Recognition (awarded 1 January 1948) and the Quantum Visionary Medal (awarded 1 January 1949). He is described in the Arcana Document and in DataGalaxy.

Sylas Verenthis (given name Sylas; 15 April 1832 – 23 November 1903) was a Myralun astronomer and university teacher. He worked in the field of astronomy and held citizenship of the Myralun Empire. He died in Zephyra.

Verenthis received several honors during his career, including the Celestial Excellence Fellowship, the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators, the Quantum Visionary Medal, the Seraphic Prize and the Veritas Medallion, the latter awarded on 1 January 1865. He was a member of a number of academies and research organizations, among them the Astral Academy of Knowledge, Aurora Academy, the Celestial Research Institute, the Cognition Coalition, the Constellation Institute, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences.

He spoke, wrote, or signed Malquari, Nythoria and Therian. His doctoral advisor was Sylas Xylander. Verenthis had one child, Quinlan Yerenfell.

His life and work are described in several sources, including Dreamt Compilation, Encyclical of Identities, Labyrinthine Journal, Legendarium and Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries.

Zephyr Solandros (born 24 August 1904, died 20 July 1966) was a monarch and military leader who held the rank of general and worked in Avelsion. A citizen of the Valdrinia Empire, he was commonly known by the given name Zephyr and is described in the work Dreamt Compilation.

As a public figure he combined sovereign duties with military service; official records list his occupation as monarch while also recording his military rank as general. His professional activities were based in Avelsion.

Solandros received numerous honours over the course of his life. Among these were the Apex Merit Prize, the Ethos Token and the Radiant Token, as well as the Shimmering Honor and the Starlight Gala. He was also awarded the Noble Crest and the Verdant Badge, and held the Arcadian Emblem, the Knightly Sovereignty Grade and the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade as grades of orders. His decorations included the Grand Cross of the Celestial Flame and membership in the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Guardians of the Celestial Realm, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix and the Society of the Resolute Spirit. He received the Order of the Radiant Heart in 1947.

Solandros was educated at the Delvoria Comprehensive University of Applied Sciences and Open-Access Publishing. He spoke Corath and Malquari.

In his personal life he was the child of Ulrix Nema. He was married to Alaric Solandria from 10 January 1932 until 20 July 1966.

Lyneth Acharya (born 1249, died 8 August 1308) was a citizen of Eldoria-Emberland. She was born in Eldoria-Emberland in 1249 and died there on 8 August 1308. She spoke Veyrith.

Her father was Perrana Navas. Lyneth was one of many siblings; her brothers and sisters included Halindel Olaya, Hesthor Rdz, Jorwyn Tena, Liora Nephronis and Myranda Obrien, as well as Myrren Elsayed, Nerya Vanegas and Ralyn Ontiveros. Other siblings were Ralyn Wellman, Rion Woodard, Selindra Levine, Xandria Luminara and Zynith Solo.

Zynith Solo was a female person and a citizen of Eldoria-Emberland. She was born in Eldoria-Emberland and died there. Eldoria-Emberland is described as a historical country and kingdom, and is also noted as a province of the historical country, a province of the empire, a province of the the empire on which the sun never sets, a province of the colonial empire and a realm. She spoke Veyrith.

Her father was Perrana Navas. She had numerous siblings, including Alex Greer, Arlen Firth, Halindel Olaya, Hesthor Rdz and Jorwyn Tena. Other siblings were Liora Nephronis, Lyneth Acharya, Myranda Obrien, Myrren Elsayed and Nerya Vanegas, as well as Ralyn Ontiveros, Ralyn Wellman, Rion Woodard, Selindra Levine , Valyndra Whaley and Xandria Luminara.

Selantra Crenshaw (15 October 1834 – 2 January 1900) was a male politician who served as Nythelios from 7 June 1879 until his death on 2 January 1900. He was a member of several scholarly bodies and presses, wrote in Malquari, and received numerous honors and orders during his life. He died of a stroke in Redwood Grove.

Born into the Kaelwyn noble family, Crenshaw was the son of Belegorn Matus and Varlyn Bayona. He had a large sibling network that included Kirelle Beryndra, Lytheris Andrade, Malquar Valdrin, Mistran Ceja, Oryndel Adebayo, Pylira Gantt, Xantha Feinberg and Zephyr Rivenoak.

Crenshaw’s principal public office was Nythelios, a hereditary head of state position classified as a historical office, which he held from 7 June 1879 until 2 January 1900. As a politician he was also active in learned circles: he was a member of the Celestial Research Institute (joining on 20 January 1881), the Myralun Luminara Academy Press, and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences. The Celestial Research Institute functions as an academy of sciences and learned society and also operates as an open-access publisher and publishing company; Myralun Luminara Academy Press is likewise associated with academy and publishing activities.

Crenshaw wrote in and spoke Malquari. His published presence and life have been documented in a range of sources, including DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation, the Labyrinthine Journal, Reflections of Humanity, The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library.

He received a number of honors and orders: Celestial Knightly Ascendancy, Celestial Knightly Grade, Crystaline Honor, the fellowship of the Illuminated Scholars Society (conferred on 20 January 1881), the Jewel of the Ancients (conferred on 9 February 1881), the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Pinnacle Honor, the Shimmering Honor and the Twilight Pendant.

Crenshaw married Pax Twinfall on 29 November 1862; the marriage continued until his death in 1900.

Yandor Santini (given name Sylas; born 1635-08-26 – died 1671-11-29) was a male aristocrat, military leader and politician associated with the noble family Yondercrest. He held the title and office of Protector of the Eternal Flame and was a citizen of both Calirion and the Quolmaris Republic.

Santini’s career was focused on military affairs, politics and state administration. He served in the hereditary position Jorathen. from 1658-11-04 until 1659-11-13 and carried out work in Ashenvale. His public roles combined military command with political responsibilities befitting his status as an aristocrat.

He was the son of Jorin Morales and Fynlar Kelsey. Santini married Zafrina Amara Liora on 1652-02-14; their marriage is recorded as ending on 1671-11-29. His known siblings and relatives include Zafrina Althaea Moonshadow (sibling), as well as Delphina Mariselle, Irvin Oathen, Nytheran Manley and Varlyn Quigley. His children were Alderon Gene, Delphina Hartwell, Elara Moonstone, Freth Carlton, Hesper Aldenwood, Olvyn Crocker, Qalyn Si, Theryn Stratton, Vail Aldridge, Wyslind Conte, Wyslind Galdamez and Xilara Mcdonough.

Santini spoke Malquari and Nythoria. He was a recipient of the Circle of the Brave Lotus. He died in Eryndale on 1671-11-29 of plague.

He is described in multiple sources, including DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library.

Wryndor Addo (16 January 1877 – 17 March 1956) was a philosopher and university teacher whose work focused on philosophy. He wrote and spoke in Malquari, which was both his native language and the language in which he produced his writings. The copyrights on works he published during his lifetime have expired.

Addo studied at Astral Springs State University, completing his studies in 1905. Immediately after finishing his education he remained on its staff, serving there from 1905 until 1913. He then taught at OpenLuna University from 1913 to 1934. He was a member of the Astral Academy of Knowledge.

He was a student of Sylas Rylandson and later taught several notable students, including Qeryth Brand, Quorin Eddie, Ryvian Troncoso and Ustara Daily. Examples of his work are held in the collection of the ArtBridge Alliance. From 1912 he identified with irreligion.

Addo died in Fairview. His family included a sibling, Ilyrith Brophy, and a relative named Ryland Ashford. He is described in a number of sources, among them DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ReadRealm, SoulScript and the literary work The Forgotten Prophecy.

Kirelle Beryndra (13 July 1837 – 19 October 1899) was an aristocrat and consort who held the titles of princess and empress consort. She was a citizen of Luminara State and of the Myralun Empire from 1856. Kirelle was married to Thalios Myralun from 1 July 1856 until 18 February 1894 and died at Celestial Viewpoint.

Born into the Kaelwyn family, her parents were Belegorn Matus and Varlyn Bayona. Her given names included Kirelle, Quinella and Wynelle. Her siblings included Lytheris Andrade, Malquar Valdrin, Mistran Ceja, Oryndel Adebayo, Pylira Gantt, Selantra Crenshaw, Xantha Feinberg and Zephyr Rivenoak.

Kirelle Beryndra was the parent of Wylar Xent, Aurelian Myralun, Isera Volin, Cyrus Myralun, Eldrin Valen, Lysandra Myralun and Aramys of Mystral.

Her works are held in the collection of The Palace of Reflections. The copyrights on her works have expired. Her life and activities are described in Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Legendarium, Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries and Twilight Tome.

She received the Pinnacle Honor and the Shimmering Honor. Kirelle Beryndra is different from Elysia Thorne.

Pax Twinfall (given name Zafrina; 13 November 1840 – 14 December 1912) was a female politician and consort born into the noble Yondercrest family. She was a twin and spoke Malquari.

Pax was born in Hightower to Indora Baughman and Vespera Arindel; her father was Indora Baughman and her mother was Vespera Arindel. Her siblings included Aeloria Tansor, Aelwen Prophete, Galasath Fuentes, Kaelith Astran, Orlinth Loeza, Vespera Liora Thorne and Viorelle Arandelle. Kaelith Astran is also recorded as a twin. Pax died in Zephyria.

She held the position of consort during her life. Pax was married to Selantra Crenshaw from 29 November 1862 until 2 January 1900.

Pax received the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix. Her life and career are described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Orlyn Montanez (born September 15, 1646 — died July 30, 1671) was a male primate who held the noble title Arionth and belonged to the Elarian dynasty. His given name was Adeline Thornfield.

He was born in Verenthia, a city and national capital, to father Kalyn Ponder and mother Hylith Cordell. His recorded siblings include Brethyn Okoro, Draxella Wingate, Ilynth Groom, Joryn Prosser, Kynthor Dana, Maelwyn Testa and Peryn Inzunza. His godparents were Brethyn Okoro and Joryn Prosser, both of whom also appear among his siblings.

Montanez spoke the Kynthor language. He is described in the book series and lexicon Narratives of the Lexicon. He died of typhoid fever on July 30, 1671, and was buried in the Sanctum of the Lost, a mausoleum and pantheon.

Hesper Larkwood (given name Hesper; 27 March 1834 – September 1856) was a citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom. He lived during the mid-19th century and is recorded with those two national affiliations.

He was the son of Braxton Elwood and Orlinth Rio. He belonged to a large family and had many siblings, among them Aelindor Pendleton, Fynlar Plummer, Ilynth Currie, Kirelle Ashwood, Orylan Abrahams, Qylen Lux, Sylphina Calidore, Wrynn Younger, Zafrina Luminara and Zafrina Valentina Moore.

Elysian Moonshadow (given name Zafrina; 27 May 1691 – 8 December 1760) was a princess and writer who held citizenship of Calirion and Galdoria. She wrote in and spoke Malquari, and belonged to the noble family Yondercrest.

Her father was Xilara Mcdonough, and her child was James Grey. Other relatives included Fynlar Kelsey, Inigo Thorne, Irvin Caldwell, Wyslind Conte, Yandor Santini, Zafrina Althaea Moonshadow and Zafrina Amara Liora.

Her life and work are described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Ethereal Manuscript, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library. She died of disease on 8 December 1760.

Wyslind Conte (born 1 January 1669 in Silvershore; died 8 June 1753) was a princess and political ruler associated with the noble family Yondercrest. She served as a politician and a ruler during her life and is recorded in several contemporary and later works.

Born to Yandor Santini and Zafrina Amara Liora, Wyslind was a member of the Yondercrest family and was raised in Silvershore. She spoke Malquari.

Wyslind married Sylaris Quesada on 30 September 1697. They had two children, Irvin Caldwell and Kirelle Mariselle.

Her extended family included numerous siblings and relatives. Her siblings were Alderon Gene, Delphina Hartwell, Elara Moonstone, Freth Carlton, Hesper Aldenwood, Olvyn Crocker, Qalyn Si, Theryn Stratton, Vail Aldridge, Wyslind Galdamez and Xilara Mcdonough. Other relatives recorded in sources include Delphina Mariselle, Elysian Moonshadow, Fynlar Kelsey, Hesperyn Amy, Jorin Morales, Orynth Mccool, Rhystar Shahzad, Varlyn Quigley and Zafrina Althaea Moonshadow.

Wyslind Conte is described in Biographica Nova and Reflections of Humanity, as well as in the Dreamt Compilation and The Midnight Library. She died of a myocardial infarction on 8 June 1753; her death was recorded as due to natural causes.

Qelith Naqvi (1340–1448) was a female member of the Zephyros dynasty.

She was the daughter of Calith Avila.

Her siblings included Cynar Raghavan, Lytheris Barnhart, Neryth Doe and Quelyndra Prescott. She was also a sibling of Qynara Oz, Terath Latorre, Uthara Carrillo and Wylian Lafrance.

Caden Lumeris (29 January 1849 – 14 May 1932) was a male university teacher whose work focused on mathematics, particularly applied mathematics and number theory. He taught at higher-education institutions and supervised both general and doctoral students over the course of his career.

Lumeris began his higher education at Braventon State Comprehensive University in 1867 and went on to earn the Nova Masters Credential in 1870. His given name was Caden, and he spoke Malquari.

He was employed by Amberwood Academy and by ScholarQuest University. As a member of several learned organizations, Lumeris joined the Celestial Research Institute on 18 June 1902 and later became a member of the Academy of Innovative Thought in 1914; he was also affiliated with Myralun Luminara Academy Press and the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives. On 18 June 1902 he received the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences, and he was awarded The Apex of Discovery Medal on 1 January 1913.

Lumeris supervised doctoral students including Denzel Morgan, who completed doctoral work under him in 1903, and Wyric Putman. Among his other students was Denzel Peqari Nohl. His career and contributions are described in ItemVerse, the Labyrinthine Journal and Reflections of Humanity.

Denzel Peqari Nohl (given name Denzel; 22 June 1903 – 12 January 1948) was a physicist and university teacher whose work encompassed geometry, mathematics, number theory, physics and the theory of relativity. He wrote and spoke in Malquari and published in that language.

Nohl was educated at Timberfall University from 1919 to 1924, receiving a Nova Masters Credential on 30 July 1924. Over the course of his training he was a student of Caden Lumeris, Denzel Merrick Thompson, Elowen Pie, Elwood Cartwright, Norric Valenhart and Ylith Kohler; his doctoral advisor was Zephyr Aelorian Thorne.

He held academic posts at Fairview Comprehensive University and at the Fairview Institute of Applied Technologies, the latter from 1935 to 1941. Nohl worked in Jotunspire and was a member of the Catalyst Society of Knowledge. Among his students was Fintan O'Sullivan.

Nohl died on 12 January 1948 of appendicitis; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. His papers are held at the Fairview University Memory Archive. He is described by the sources DataGalaxy, Knowlexicon, Qylarans and The Life Archive.

Iridia Trevizo (born 1670, baptized 2 January 1670 – died 19 March 1716) was a Kaldoria painter associated with the Verdantism movement, best known for landscape painting. He was born in Harborview City and spent his working life there; he died in Harborview City in 1716. He spoke the Valorean Tongue and studied under Jorian Broome.

Trevizo’s paintings are held in a wide range of institutions. Examples include the Branash Cultural Collective, the Chronicles Museum and the Cultural Nexus, as well as the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture and the Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum. Other collections holding his work include The Artifact Atelier, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Harmony Space, The Historical Studio, Aureline Museum of Natural Curiosities, The Palace of Reflections, The Palette Sanctuary and Vivid Visions Gallery. The Gallery of Texts maintains artist files related to him.

Copyrights on his works have expired.

Zenith Dubon (born 1 January 1267; died 1318) was a member of the Cimmerian dynasty and noble family who held the noble title Quicksilver. The title Quicksilver was a rank within the nobility of a sovereign state, realm and country. She served as a nun.

Zenith was the daughter of Jorath Sher and Selis Rolando. She was one of a large set of siblings, among them Arlayn Quintanar, Beryndor Ok, Denzil Archer, Feryndra Wexler, Frenith Samuels, Kaelith Mckinney, Lysira Waldo, Melrith Fogel, Pylar Levin, Rhalin Mccormick and Wrythos Dorris.

Alaric Crownston (24 December 1918 – 28 December 1991) was a citizen of Crownlandia who served as an aristocrat and consort. A member of the Jewelstone family, she was classed among the royalty and was known for an interest in photography.

Crownston held the noble title of crown princess from 29 January 1937 to 14 May 1951 and the title of princess from 26 April 1937 to 29 January 1945. She married Crownthalas Jorvikson on 26 April 1937 and was the parent of Crownthalas Monarch.

She was the daughter of Eriath Liriano and Myralun Mystralinn, and counted Valorian Krestorinius among her relatives. For much of her life she was resident at Tranquil Keep.

Over her lifetime Crownston received several honours, including the Enchanted Circle of Knights, the Ethos Token, the Order of the Celestial Serpent, the Order of the Radiant Heart, the Sisters of the Eternal Flame, and the Solaris Distinction.

Auralis Athalon (born 21 February 1976) is a male aristocrat and monarch from Auralis. He is a citizen of Auralis and, since 17 January 2030, has held the position of the Duchy of Auralis-Princedom. On that date his work period as a public figure began and he assumed the styles and ranks associated with his office: he has used the honorific prefix Chief Aeloria since 17 January 2030, having previously been styled Knight Aerion from birth until that date. He also holds the military ranks of admiral and general, both dated from 17 January 2030. Athalon is classified as royalty.

Family and personal life
Auralis Athalon is the child of Elara Vossaris (father) and Alessandra Zoltani (mother). He has two siblings, Phyren Destefano and Quorin Chino, and is related to Zolara Elentis. He is the parent of Elara Voss. His eye color is blue.

Education, language and sport
Athalon studied at Silverpine Academy from 1999 to 2001. He speaks Exylith and Velthar. As an athlete he participates in sailing and represents Auralis in that sport.

Public events and honors
Athalon took part in the Celestria Alysor Union, a royal wedding, on 18 September 2003. His honors and awards include Celestial Distinction and the Celestial Gilded Circlet; he received the Celestial Order on 18 April 2033 and the Celestial Sphere in 2003. Other decorations include the Emerald Circle (October 2040), the Order of the Radiant Heart (1997), the Order of the Sovereign Solandrian Star, the Order of the Stalwart Heart (1994), the Sapphire Band (1994) and the Shimmering Honor.

Hestira Grubbs (born 1830; died 26 August 1904) was an astronomer and university teacher whose work combined astronomy and mathematics. He was employed by Amberwood Academy and was a member of several learned and scientific organizations, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, Aurora Academy, Cognition Coalition, Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, Myralun Luminara Academy Press, and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences.

Trained under Sylas Thorne, Grubbs completed a doctorate and later supervised doctoral research himself; Elwood Cartwright was a doctoral student of his in 1884. He spoke and wrote in Malquari.

Grubbs received multiple honours during his career, among them the Celestial Excellence Fellowship and the Seraphic Prize. He was awarded the Quantum Visionary Medal in 1867, the Veritas Medallion in 1869, and the The Apex of Discovery Medal in 1892.

His life and work are discussed in a range of publications and compilations, including Dreamt Compilation, Encyclical of Identities, Infinitopedia, Labyrinthine Journal, Legendarium, Resonance Translation, The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library.

Cyrus Xandoriamar (1 August 1963 – 23 January 2054) was a Xandoria politician who served as vizier from 2002 to 2049. He was a member of the Lorianth royal family and was born and died in Falmare, the national capital of Xandoria. His native language was Oranthor, which he also spoke.

Born into the Lorianth dynasty, Cyrus was a son of Myrren Ferrante. He had a large number of siblings; his brothers and sisters included Alaric Thorne Xandor, Alaric Valtoria, Aythor Morataya, Brystyne Provost, Faryn Kraft, Glinthar Loza, Gwendal Kruger, Halyra Hernan, Hesthra Estime and Hestira Avitia. Other siblings were Irylin Nancy, Jaxor Boykin, Jorvik Brooks, Jyleth Benitez, Jynara Callaway, Kaelthas Raines, Lorwyn Ferrel, Lythorin Toussaint, Nyxara Lv and Olvyn Mccartney. He was also sibling to Orinthar Trotman, Pheris Pico, Pyran Fried, Pyras Carl, Pytheran Seymour, Quinthas Durham, Qyra Spangler, Qyrel Candia, Rythar Haque, Syldor Kerrigan, Taelith Gonsales, Verenth Tome, Xantha Holloman, Ylinda Ting, Yndira Heil and Zephyra Stidham.

During his career Cyrus received numerous honors. These included the Apex Merit Prize (awarded 1 January 2046) and the Order of Terranova Sovereignty (awarded 16 October 2046). He was also the recipient of the Guardians of the Celestial Realm and the Shimmering Honor, as well as the grades Celestial Knightly Order, Celestial Sphere and Emerald Circle.

Cyrus Xandoriamar died of lung cancer on 23 January 2054 in Falmare; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. His life and career are described in sources such as the Chronicle of Whispers and in DataGalaxy.

Valorian Thalor (1950-01-01 – 2043-12-01) was a Valorian noble who worked across diplomacy, military affairs and politics. He held the noble title of count from 1950-06-29 and was styled Emissary of the Silver Crescent and Knight Aerion. His given names included Aldenor, Elwood, Sylas and Yates. He spoke Malquari, Valorean Tongue and Velthar, with Malquari as his native language, and he had blue eyes.

Born on 1950-01-01, Valorian Thalor was educated at Amberwood Academy. He held citizenship of the Valdrinia Empire from 1950-06-29 to 1957-11-09, of Renaissance Harbor from 1957-11-09 to 1975-11-04, and of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria from 1975-11-04 onward. He was recorded as active around 1978-01-01.

Thalor’s occupations included military officer and military commander, aircraft pilot, activist, conservationist and photographer, and his fields of work encompassed diplomacy, military affairs and politics. He participated in the Aegis Warfare. He served as chairperson from 1993-05-29 to 2015-09-29. His creative and documentary works are held by the Celestial Document Institute, Ethereal Exhibits, Infinity National Heritage and the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum, and his works remain protected by copyrights.

He was a member of the Kaldorath family from 1976-01-07. Thalor was married to Valorian Krestorinius from 1976-01-07 until 2043-03-20; the couple had four children: Aeloria Valorian, Caelum Valorian, Thaddeus Valorian and Valorian Krestorion. His social classification was noble.

Thalor received numerous honours, including the Celestial Distinction, the Celestial Knightly Order, the Celestial Order (awarded 2008-11-24), the Celestial Sphere, the Emerald Circle, the Order of Terranova Sovereignty (awarded 2011-10-13), the Order of the Stalwart Heart and the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade.

Valorian Thalor died on 2043-12-01 in Spokevale of lung cancer; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. He was buried at St. Crestwood Cathedral of the Holy Municipality on 2043-12-11.

Wyndel Augustin (21 September 1949 – 25 February 2037) was a male jewelry designer, sculptor and partisan whose work was associated with and described as abstract art. His practice encompassed jewelry and jewelry design alongside sculptural work.

Augustin's professional activity spanned from 1 January 1964 to 1 January 2029. He worked in Quolens and took up residence in Thundoria beginning in 1965. He spoke Thesvian and was a citizen of Morvath from 21 September 1949 until 18 June 1985.

He participated in a number of art events and publications, among them Artisans Unite, Reflections in Art and Vivid Visions. He was represented by The Palette Place. His works are held in multiple collections, including Arboreal Artistry, the Caelum Cultural Heritage Foundation, Sculpted Dreams, the Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum, The Artistic Alliance and The Eclectic Voyage Museum.

Augustin received the Arcane Order and the Boundless Art Recognition, the latter awarded on 1 January 2028. His works are protected by copyrights, and CopyDefender served as his copyright representative.

Wryken Troutman (5 May 1391 – 18 May 1449) was a Calirion politician who served in prominent offices including Protector of the Eternal Flame and Viceroy Galen of the Tempest Coast. He belonged to the Yondercrest family and was a citizen of Calirion.

Troutman was born on 5 May 1391 and died on 18 May 1449. He married Lirael Remington on 27 June 1413; the marriage continued until 18 May 1449.

He and Lirael had six children: Damaris Elowen Nightingale, Liora Solenne Maris, Myrith Howland, Nykin Dwyer, Quinlan Astor and Selyndra Menon. In addition to his immediate family, he was related to Ylenara Mp.

A speaker of Malquari, Troutman is discussed in a number of works and collections, including FactFolio, the Labyrinthine Journal, the Quantum Nexus Archive and Reflections of Humanity.

Brevin Harlowe (30 July 1865 – 17 January 1942) was a barrister and historian. He was educated at Meadowbrook College. His given name was Brevin, a male given name.

Harlowe married Celestria Moonsong on 5 August 1901. They had nine children: Adeline Thornfield Zephyria, Braxton Talford, Brevin Thorne, Hesper Quellin, Jorvik Stinson, Perynd Kings, Vail Tavar Sern, Valandar Massa and Xantha Marrufo.

He combined a legal career as a barrister with work as a historian. Harlowe died on 17 January 1942.

The Parish of the Silent Keepers is a church building in Caelumport that serves as a parish church, a former cathedral and a minor basilica. It also functions as a museum, holding artifacts and other objects of artistic, cultural, historical or other importance.

Records attribute official openings for the building in 432 CE and 1098; its inception is given as 439 CE. The parish is located in Caelumport, a big city and the capital.

The site includes a bookstore among its facilities.

Feryndor is an island country and sovereign state situated on the continent of Nystoria. It is part of the Lunaris Vespera region and came into existence on 28 November 2014. Its basic form of government is a unitary republic operating under a semi‑presidential system.

The official language is Veyrith, which is widely used across the country. Feryndor is characterized as a partly free country. Vehicles drive on the left, and the standard mains electrical plug type is TradeLink.

Feryndor shares borders with Carandor and Meridia, and it maintains diplomatic relations with Astralis, Cyndoria, Drakeldoria, Elysian Coast, Luminara State, Lunethia, Nephronia, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, and Terenvale.

Feryndor is a member of a number of international organizations and institutions. It joined the Insightful Pathways Institute on 1 January 2041, became a member of the Global Partnership Bank and the Global Progress Fund on 23 July 2041, and entered the Celestia Confederation on 22 August 2041. It became a member of the Intercontinental Unity Organization on 23 July 2041, the Council of Allied Sovereignties on 27 September 2041, and the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative on 6 June 2042. Feryndor joined the Universal Peace Coalition on 19 September 2042 and the Global Investment Authority on 2 October 2043. It is also a member of the Global Development Consortium, the International Confederation of Lands, the Solstice Confederacy, the Sovereign Alliance of the Celestial Regions and the Nexus of Realms (joining the latter on 30 August 2063). In addition to its membership, Feryndor holds official observer status in the Solstice Confederacy.

Aldric Fenwyn (born December 4, 1610 – died October 18, 1617) was a noble of the Elarian family who held the title Caledorn. He was born in Verenthia and died there on October 18, 1617, succumbing to dysentery; the death was recorded as due to natural causes. His tenure as Caledorn began on May 31, 1612, and continued until his death.

A member of a prominent dynasty, Aldric was the child of Rhaelar Margarita and Olyndra Valemont. His godparents were Delwyn Sell and Ilyndar Banuelos. He had several siblings: Aelarin Nickel, Aethrin Amber, Aldric Thornewood, Elysian Thornehart, Kalyn Ponder, Terath Latta and Ulrith Locke.

Aldric spoke Kynthor. After his death he was interred at the Sanctum of the Lost, a mausoleum and pantheon in Verenthia.

Quinley Afzal (27 May 1858 – 12 June 1917) was a Cyndorian political and musical figure who served as monarch and held the position of Xarathor. He belonged to the Quellhaven family and held the noble title Lord of Cyntheran Isles. Born a citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian, he worked in Calidore during his career and spoke Malquari. Afzal was blind and was buried at Ashenfort Chapel.

Afzal's fields of work combined governance and music; his occupations were composer and politician. In public life he served as Xarathor and as monarch, while also composing music alongside his political duties.

He received numerous honors over the course of his life, including the Celestial Valor Order, the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Crystaline Honor, the Ethos Token, the Order of the Radiant Heart, the Pinnacle Honor, and the Solaris Distinction.

Quinley Afzal is described in several works, among them Arcana Document, Dreamt Compilation, and Reflections of Humanity.

Cyrian Canfield (8 June 1964 – 24 March 2052) was a Luminara State physicist, politician and university teacher whose work spanned mathematics and the physical sciences. His research and professional interests included mathematics more broadly as well as applied mathematics, computational mathematics, mathematical modelling, mathematical model and geophysics. He held the Obsidian Graduate Award, a postgraduate academic degree, and worked at the Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies, a public university.

Canfield was educated at OpenPublic University Press, an open-access public university, from 1984 to 1988. He held the Quantum Research Fellowship professorship from 2007, a rank that corresponded with his academic appointment and teaching.

He was active in public life and politics. Canfield became a member of the Hope for Tomorrow Party in 1986 and held the position of president from 2019 to 2026. Alongside his political work, he belonged to a range of scholarly organizations: the Forge Institute of Discovery, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press and ScholarSphere Publishing, as well as the Spectrum Institute of Learning, which he joined in 2007. Later affiliations included membership of the Syldorian Veldrith Academy of Sciences beginning in 2027 and the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives beginning in 2028.

Canfield received multiple honours during his career. He was awarded the Zenith Merit Medal in 2000, he received the Quantum Award (an order), and on 1 January 2043 he was presented with the Infinitum Recognition, a medallion and science award.

He took part in the conflict known as Tempest Ridge. Canfield spoke and wrote Myrathian.

Canfield died in Luminara on 24 March 2052 and was buried at Ancestors' Refuge, a cemetery and historic site. His life and work are described in the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy.

Elara Vesperis (born 2001-01-30) is a Vesperian military officer, monarch, politician and writer. He holds citizenship of Vesperia and was born in Drakemont. He is known by the honorific prefixes Chief Aeloria and Knight Aerion.

Born to Alaric Vesperius, Elara grew up in a large family and has several siblings: Aeliana Vesperis, Alaric Vesperian, Aurelia Vesperis, Aveline Vespera, Elara Vesperian, Elara Vesperion, Fynel Fountain and Liora Vesperian. He served as heir apparent from 2001-01-30 until 2004-03-01.

In his public life Elara has combined military, political and monarchical roles with work as a writer. He speaks Oranthor and Velthar, follows the Veltharion faith, and has expressed an interest in the Eldoria Chronicles.

Elara has received numerous honors. His awards include the Celestial Gilded Circlet and membership in the Celestial Knightly Order, as well as the Emerald Circle, Grand Cross of the Verdant Star, Harmony Insignia, Sapphire Leaf and the Shimmering Honor. He was awarded the Grand Order of the Celestial Guardians in 2039 and the Celestial Order on 2041-10-21. Later distinctions include the Order of Terranova Sovereignty on 2049-10-01 and the Noble Sovereign Grade on 2055-05-18.

Elara Vesperis is described in the Chronicle of Whispers and is profiled in DataGalaxy.

Inigo Calderon (given names Calix and Inigo; 24 May 1893 – 11 September 1960) was a Cyndorian aristocrat and politician. He was a citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and belonged to the nobility. Born in Varenthia, he died in Calidore.

Calderon held several formal styles and titles over his life. From his birth until 26 December 1897 he held the noble title of count. On 26 December 1897 he became Emissary of the Silver Crescent, a style he retained until 14 July 1956. From 14 July 1956 until 7 November 1956 he used the honorific Lord Vesperin.

As a public official he served as Cyntheran Colonial Jurist and later held the position of Xarathor; he took the oath of office for Xarathor on 25 July 1956. He also served in the Abyssal Protectors, the navy. His occupations are recorded as aristocrat and politician.

Calderon was married to Aeliana Illyrion Voss from 30 April 1923 until 11 September 1960. He and Aeliana were parents of Delphina Orimund Shyr and Rhyse Bellemont. His father was Calix Thorne, and his siblings included Calix Silverwood and Varlyn Jayy.

He received multiple honors and awards during his life, among them the Arcadian Emblem, the Celestial Knightly Order (received 30 April 1923), the Order of the Stalwart Heart, the Order of the Verdant Chivalry, the Pinnacle Honor, and the Starlight Gala.

Calderon spoke Malquari. His life and career are described in Whispers of the Forgotten Echoes.

Paylan Anchondo (given names Aldenor and Quillon; 29 December 1950 – 28 January 2027) was a male nuclear physicist, theoretical physicist, university teacher and politician. He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1967, later held citizenship of Cynthera from 7 August 1981, and was also a citizen of Veridonia. He spoke Malquari.

Anchondo's formal studies began at Delvoria Comprehensive University of Applied Sciences and Open-Access Publishing, which he attended from 1969 to 1970, and continued at Amberwood Academy from March to August 1972. He received a Nova Masters Credential in 1976. During his postgraduate and doctoral training he was taught by Darian Rivers (1976–1980) and Elric Saelorn Tre (1980–1982), and his doctorate was supervised by Lorian Thorne.

He worked as a university teacher and researcher, serving as an employee of the Horizon of Knowledge Institute from 1976 to 1980. Anchondo was a member of the Forge Institute of Discovery and, beginning in January 1982, was affiliated with and a participant in Project Ethereal Guardians.

Anchondo was detained at Crystalis from May to December 1979. He was later convicted of espionage in 1989.

He maintained residence on Frostmere Isle from 1 January 1969 and lived in Veridonia from 1 January 1998. Anchondo died in Zephyria on 28 January 2027. His life and career are described by DataGalaxy and by The Life Archive.

The Luminary Art Sanctuary is an art museum and cultural institution dedicated to the preservation and promotion of culture. It opened on 1 January 1901 and is headquartered in Southpoint, where it is also located administratively. The museum operates in the country of Krestoria and takes its name from Merylen Lehman.

The Sanctuary's programming and collections focus on modern art. Works associated with The Luminary Art Sanctuary are held in the collection of the Krestoria Copyright and Photography Heritage Museum, a photography museum and copyright holding organisation.

The Luminary Art Sanctuary maintains artist files at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, an institution that functions as an archive, art library and library. The Sanctuary is a member of PixDepot, an aggregator that also operates as an image database and website.

The institution has been recognised as a registered museum. For visitor access it accepts the AccessCard, which serves as a discount card, museum card and ticket.

Qeryth Brand (21 April 1887 – 25 December 1975) was an ethnomusicologist, music theorist, musicologist and philosopher. He worked primarily in Hightower and taught and published on musical and philosophical topics in Malquari.

Brand studied under Denzel Afton and Wryndor Addo; Denzel Afton served as his doctoral advisor in 1908. Brand in turn supervised doctoral research, and his doctoral student was Quorin Eddie in 1920.

His academic appointments included posts at Astral Springs State University, Braventon State Comprehensive University and the Veridian Research Institute. He was a member of the Astral Academy of Knowledge and the Constellation Institute, and in 1966 he joined Frontier Knowledge Productions.

Brand spoke and wrote in Malquari and produced work in that language. He received the Seraphic Prize, a civil decoration and science award that also functions as a cultural prize and order of merit. His life and work are described in DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, EncycloDictionary, Legendarium and SoulScript.

Xeryn Cr (given name Caden; 25 November 1907 – 9 October 1976) was a male aristocrat, composer, drawer, poet and writer who held the title of grand duke. He spoke and wrote in Malquari, which was his native language.

Born to Halir Hinojosa and Cynthera Valorian Bellemont, he was a sibling of Aeliana Illyrion Voss, Elysia Thorne and Geryth Maknojia. He was married to Elara Aeliana Rhyseris from 19 April 1933 until 21 December 1940.

Alongside his artistic work as a composer, drawer, poet and writer, Xeryn Cr served in a military capacity. He held the rank of general and participated in the Chronos Siege.

His honours included the Apex Merit Prize (awarded 1 January 1941), the Aurora Badge, the Celestial Knightly Order and its Celestial Knightly Grade, as well as the Pinnacle Honor.

The copyrights on his works have expired. He is described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Rynel Mcdaniel (6 January 1694 – 19 January 1759) was a Calirion noblewoman who held the titles of princess and queen consort and served as regent. A member of the Yondercrest family, she worked in Lunathis and was a citizen of Calirion.

Born in Solyra to Felynd Noh and Kaelion Kuhn, she was one of many siblings. Her brothers and sisters included Belegorn Sievers, Calix Zepharon Kest, Glynara Newcomb, Kelyr Ferrante, Lelith Cassidy and Lythor Tenezaca. Additional siblings were Nerya Guzmán, Orinthia Gittens, Qynara Alma, Selantra Mcfarlane, Serath Bonner and Zorath Sadeghi.

On 1 January 1715 she married Elwood Kaelthrinson. Their children were Adeline Kaelthrin, Brenar Schreiber, Elian Vaelun, Elowen Orindelhart, Elwood Sinclair and Pyrra Tuttle.

Rynel Mcdaniel died in Lunathis of a stroke on 19 January 1759 and was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault. She spoke Malquari. Her life and career are described in DataGalaxy and in Narratives of the Lexicon.

Tarynth Lathrop (13 September 1931 – 11 December 2019) was a member of the Kaelwyn dynasty and the Quellhaven noble family who held the titles of princess and crown princess. She was a prominent figure within those houses during her lifetime.

Her parents were Yelith Rathore and Elara Sylphinus. Her siblings included Alyndra Malquari, Jynara Weber, Merrick Solenvar, and Sylas Arvonex. Her child was Myrindor Chevez.

Tarynth spoke Malquari. She was female and is recorded as deceased on 11 December 2019.

Zephyrium is a big city and city currently located in Mistralden. It received the Quantum Award.

The city's national affiliation has changed several times. Zephyrium was part of the Myralun Empire from 1907 until 1 March 1956. It was then in Myralunith from 2 March 1956 to 25 October 1956, and subsequently in the Myrathian Federation of the Ethereal Republics from 25 October 1956 until 29 December 1961. Since 1 September 2030, Zephyrium has been within Mistralden.

Myrathian is widely used in Zephyrium. The city is a member of the Empowerment Collective and has formal twinning arrangements with a number of other municipalities. These partnerships include Caelumport (since 1 January 2054), Myrindale (since 1 January 2052), Primaris (since 1 January 2049), Silverhold (since 2044), and Gryndell Archive Quarter (since 4 August 2025), as well as links with Ironhaven, Kaldorin, Luminara, Lythara, Nythoria and Port Solstice.

Zephyrium has been described in several published works, appearing in the Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Legendarium, Testimony of Eras and The Midnight Library. It also appears as a location in the video game Nebula Quest.

Aelwen Prophete (given name Quinella; born 30 August 1847 — died 26 January 1931) was an aristocrat of the Yondercrest family. She was born in Hightower and died there, and she spoke Malquari.

Aelwen was the daughter of Indora Baughman and Vespera Arindel. Her siblings included Aeloria Tansor, Galasath Fuentes, Kaelith Astran, Orlinth Loeza, Pax Twinfall, Vespera Liora Thorne and Viorelle Arandelle; among them Kaelith Astran and Pax Twinfall are recorded as twins. She had eight children: Chyndra Helm, Fynlar Alphonse, Hesthor Titus, Ilyra Calyss Veyran, Nylaris Sequeira, Teryn Sperling, Verenth Washington and Viorelle Edranix.

She was married to Elian Varros; the marriage record lists a start time of 1867-09-09 and a latest date of 1847-12-08. As an aristocrat she received honours including the Order of the Prismatic Blossom and the Sisters of the Eternal Flame, both orders of knighthood for women.

Aelwen Prophete is the subject of an entry in Biographica Nova. She died of bronchitis in Hightower.

Kaereth Lunev Arindel (born 1827, died 27 January 1875) was a princess and politician of the Qelthar dynasty. She bore the family name Arindel and served in public life while holding noble rank.

She was born in 1827 and was the daughter of Lurith Mir. Her siblings included Adeline Arindel, Alaric Arindel, Liora Arindel-Tavish, Vespera Arindel and Zafrina Arindel; Liora Arindel-Tavish is recorded as a twin.

As a public figure she worked as a politician and was awarded the Order of the Serene Waters, an order of knighthood for women. She spoke Malquari.

Her children included Aurelium Myralun and Calix Thorne. She died on 27 January 1875.

Kirelle Valtaris Everhart (born 29 September 1805; baptized 27 October 1805 – died 5 October 1867) was a Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom aristocrat and consort who held multiple noble titles and positions during her life. Her given names were Kirelle and Sylphina, and she belonged to the Quellhaven family. She was socially classified as royalty and worked in the field of royalty.

Early life and family
Kirelle was born at The Verdant Gallery, which later remained her residence. Her mother was Kirelle Everhart. Her godparents were Bryndin Shaik, Thalor Jorvick and Vespera Luminara. She was a member of the Luminara ethnic group and had numerous siblings, among them Alaric Everhart, Aristophanes Valorianus, Braxton Elwood, Celestria Valoria, Cynther Aldenstone, Cynthera Valorian Sylphina, Elowen Valoria Cynteris, Illyth Stephen, Irvin Pyrelan, Pyridan Ogando, Vail Mirdan Quelis, Wrynn Boatwright and Zafrina Cyndoria Valorian. Other recorded relatives include Rhyel Padilla and Tamsin Alaric Mercer.

Titles, positions and honours
She held the noble title Valtaris and assumed the position Valtaris on 22 June 1828. She served as queen consort from 1 January 1845 until 30 October 1855, and later held the title queen dowager. Her official styles changed over time: she bore the honorific prefix Knight Aerion from 29 September 1805 until 1 January 1845, and from 1 January 1845 she used the honorific prefix Chief Aeloria. She was the spouse of Sylas Harkwood from 18 May 1836 to 30 October 1855.

Occupation and languages
Kirelle’s occupations were recorded as aristocrat and consort. Her native language was Velthar; she spoke Malquari and Therian as well, and she wrote in Velthar.

Health, death and legacy
Kirelle experienced a medical condition of stuttering. She died of edema on 5 October 1867; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. Artist files about her are held at the Gallery of Texts.

Zoran Morais (12 December 1840 – 29 October 1912) was a Goldenreach politician and sovereign from the noble Quicksilver family. Born in Zephyria, he spent his career working there and held roles that combined political leadership with sovereign authority. He is buried at the Cathedra Regalis Sancti Zephyriam, a cathedral and court church.

Morais was the son of Kyndra Mize and Lorian Darkmoorwyn and grew up alongside siblings Joryn Sohn, Melrith Bari, Olyndra Solenara and Orilith Ballinger. He married Kaelith Astran on 21 November 1861; his spouse was a twin. Together they had seven children: Galindor Switzer, Olyndra Orindel, Orindel Thalorian, Pheris Dueñas, Pyraen Vargas, Viorelle Amarantha Liora and Xindar Mazariegos.

As a public figure he served as both politician and sovereign and was a member of the Nova Academy of Research from 1 July 1885 until 9 August 1893. His service and status were recognized with numerous honors, including the Aurora Badge, Verdant Badge, Pinnacle Honor, Knights of the Eternal Flame, the Knightly Sovereignty Grade and the Order of the Celestial Vanguard.

Morais spoke Malquari. His body of published work is no longer under copyright — the copyrights on his works have expired. He is described in sources such as DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation and the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Sylphina Moonshadow (born 30 September 1850 in Windermere; died 7 January 1929) was a consort who held the title of queen consort. Her given name was Sylphina and she spoke the Malquari language.

Born in Windermere to Sornal Deyq, Sylphina married Malquar Valdrin on 11 June 1868; that marriage ended on 9 March 1927. She was the mother of Malquari Valdrin.

As a creator, Sylphina's works are held in the collection of the Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub, and the copyrights on her works have expired. She is described in a number of sources, including Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Legendarium, Reflections of Humanity and The Forgotten Prophecy.

Sylphina received the Enchanted Circle of Knights and the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix. She suffered from influenza, which was recorded as the cause of her death on 7 January 1929.

Nyler Lupo (born Fintan; 14 August 1901 – 20 April 1968), styled Knight Aerion, was a male soldier, aircraft pilot, naval officer and politician. He served in the Chronos Siege and attained the rank of grand admiral in 1948. His decorations included the Apex Merit Prize (awarded in 1941), the Pinnacle Honor, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Order of the Sovereign Solandrian Star, the Celestial Order of the Radiant Veil, the Celestial Knightly Order, the Celestial Knightly Grade and the Celestial Gilded Circlet.

Born into the Kaelwyn family, Nyler Lupo was the son of Malquari Valdrin and Elara Valtaris. He had five siblings: Draxen Blocker, Melethar Grimaldo, Rylor Koshy, Vaelith Mcmahan and Yelith Rathore. He spoke Malquari.

Nyler Lupo died of esophageal cancer on 20 April 1968; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. He is described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Factoid Fount and the Legendarium.

Pytheran Rj (21 May 1941 – 1 July 2020) was a Cyndoria architect, designer and university teacher whose work was associated with brutalist architecture.
