He also designed furniture and worked broadly within the field of architecture. His native language was Tethyrian Language, and he spoke Malquari and Velthar.

Rj was active by 1962 and carried out professional work in Fairview and Windermere. His designs and built work are held in numerous public and private collections, including the National Museum of Cultural Heritage, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Greenfield Harbor Art Museum and Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. Others holding his work are the Creative Spark Foundation, Chronicle Citadel, Solstice Art Storage and Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum, as well as The Collective Gallery, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Expression Hub and The Inspiration Hub.

He was a member of the Cognition Coalition and of the Summit Academy of Learning, and he taught at the university level. His archives are held at The Artistry Archive, and artist files about him are maintained at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts. CopyDefender served as his copyright representative, and his published works remain protected by copyrights. His career and works are described in the DataGalaxy database.

Garenth Neil (born 1 January 1677; baptized 6 June 1677 — died 16 June 1737) was a Kaldorian painter from Southpoint. He spoke and wrote the Valorean Tongue and held citizenship of Kaldoria.

He studied under Merylen Lehman and his sibling Thalor Huston, and later taught Lyris Gerson. Thalor Huston is recorded as his sibling.

Works by Garenth Neil are held in numerous public and private collections, including Artropolis Nextridge, Branash Cultural Collective, Cultural Nexus of Yvonara, Discovery Hub, Eldoria Art Museum of the Republic of Valtoria and the Elysian Atrium. His pieces are also in the Exhibitarium, Harmony of Arts Museum, Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Kaleidoscope Museum of Art, Luminous National Exhibit and Radiant Muse Pavilion. Additional holdings include Solaris Cultural Collective, Spectrum Cultural Institute, The Artifact Atelier, The Artistic Discovery Museum and The Creative Rhapsody House, as well as The Illusive Gallery, The Nexus of Wonders, The Odyssey Museum, The Whirlwind of Art and Treasures of Expression Museum.

Artist files about Garenth Neil are held at the Gallery of Texts. He is described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon, the Krestorian Valorean Chronicles and Reflections of Humanity. The copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired.

Thalor Huston was a Kaldorian painter known for portraiture. He worked in the art of painting and is associated with the movement Verdantism. Huston spoke the Valorean Tongue and spent his life in Southpoint, which was his place of birth, residence and place of death. He was born and baptized on 27 January 1669 and died on 22 November 1732; he was buried or cremated on 23 November 1732. He was male and a citizen of Kaldoria.

Huston trained under Zilva. Dickerson, and among his own students was his sibling Garenth Neil, who studied with him. His occupation was painter and his work concentrated on portraits.

Huston’s works are held widely in museums and galleries, including Cultural Canvas Museum, Cultural Nexus, Greenfield Harborview Museum of Heritage, Harmony Exhibit Pavilion, Legacy Art Hall, Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, Museum of Timeless Masterpieces, National Museum of Cultural Heritage, Royal Gallery Palace, The Illusive Gallery, The Luminary Art Sanctuary, The Palace of Reflections, Treasures of Expression Museum, Treasures of Time, Vivid Visions Gallery and Zephyria Regional Art Museum. Artist files about him are kept at the Gallery of Texts. As a creator, the copyrights on his works have expired.

He is described in several published sources, notably Dreamt Compilation, the Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon, the Krestorian Valorean Chronicles and Reflections of Humanity.

Alyndra Malquari (1921-05-06 – 1990-07-20) was a male military officer and politician known for his involvement in military affairs and for his role in the Chronos Siege. A member of the Kaelwyn noble family, he combined a military career with political activity.

Malquari was born in Redwood Grove on 1921-05-06 to Yelith Rathore and Elara Sylphinus. He belonged to the Kaelwyn family and was socially classified as noble. His siblings included Jynara Weber, Merrick Solenvar, Sylas Arvonex and Tarynth Lathrop.

As a military officer his work focused on military affairs, in particular the Chronos Siege, a conflict in which he also took part. Alongside his service he held political office.

He received several honours, among them the Aurora Badge, the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Starlight Gala and the Vexorian Medal. He was also awarded the Obsidian Star on 1939-01-02.

Malquari spoke the Malquari language. The Gallery of Texts holds artist files relating to him, and he is described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Alyndra Malquari died of disease on 1990-07-20.

Cindra Vow (18 January 1947 – 28 November 2011) was a Zolterran chairperson and organizational founder. Born into the Eldergrove Lineage, she bore the family name Nyxmar and was part of the Zolterran Royal House of Meridiana. She held citizenship of Zolterra.

Cindra’s father was Alyssia Rhyseris. She was married to Glynor Rutherford; records give two start dates for the marriage, 19 October 1971 and 20 October 1971, and list its end as 26 January 1986. Her children included Alessandro Zoltari, Helian Garces, Lelith Melton and Sofiana Marisov.

She spoke Xyldari and her native language was Malquari. Cindra is described in the Zolterra Xyldari Archive.

Among her recognitions, Cindra Vow received the Celestial Order, the Ethos Token and the Fraternity of the Luminous Depths.

Cindra Vow died on 28 November 2011 of colorectal cancer; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Irylin Collazo (14 October 1798 – 5 November 1867) was a consort who held the titles empress consort and tsarina. She was a citizen of the Myralun Empire from 1815 and is recorded as female.

Born to Sylas Wrynsel and Wynelle Mistral, Collazo belonged to the Calyrian Family. She was married to Myralun Tamsin from 26 September 1815 until 12 March 1840. Their children included Lysen Qivar, Aeloria Valarnis, Sornal Deyq, Tyqor Lun, Eldrin Myralun, Halir Ola, Myralun Luminara, Tolen Rax, and Thalios Myralun.

Her siblings included Calix Merriden, Gellion Xue, Mylaria Enamorado, Orinthia Club, Peryn Frimpong, Pylar Hester, Sylas Harkwood, Verenth Jj, and Zephyr Alaric Stormwind.

Collazo’s works are held in the collections of the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture and The Palace of Reflections. The copyrights on her works have expired. She is described in sources such as Dreamt Compilation, Ethereal Manuscript, Legendarium, and Shadows of the Forgotten.

She received several honors during her life, including the Crystaline Honor, the Order of the Serene Waters, the Pinnacle Honor, and the Sisters of the Eternal Flame.

Liora Nephronis (11 January 1236 – 1 May 1295) was a princess of Nephronia who also served as a nun. She was a citizen of Eldoria-Emberland and is described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Born in Nephronia to Perrana Navas and Ferynd Oneil, Liora was part of a large family. Her siblings included Alex Greer, Arlen Firth, Halindel Olaya, Hesthor Rdz and Lyneth Acharya. Other siblings were Myranda Obrien, Myrren Elsayed, Nerya Vanegas, Ralyn Ontiveros, Ralyn Wellman, Rion Woodard, Selindra Levine and Valyndra Whaley.

Liora held the noble title princess and worked as a nun. In 1254 she married Hylith Fort.

Her native language was Veyrith, which she also spoke and wrote.

Aelith Springer (4 September 1768 – 10 October 1835) was a queen consort of Crownlandia. Born in Willowcrest, an urban municipality and district capital, she held the title of queen consort and served in the role of consort during her life as a citizen of Crownlandia, a kingdom and constitutional monarchy that also functions as a sovereign, unitary state and colonial power.

A member of the noble family Yewtree, she was the daughter of Zephyr Marlowe and Helion Dominique. She was part of a large sibling group that included Delvian Gosselin, Halyra Coakley, Inigo Varren Mylo, Jyleth Arturo, Kyndra Mcdade, Nyvalis Prather, Sylas Thorne, Thereth Stafford, Theryn Zay and Ulyndra Alexander.

Springer spoke Malquari and learned it from early childhood as her native language. Her life and role are described in the Dreamt Compilation, a version and edition that records information about her.

Ilaris Guarino (born 7 BCE; died 10-01-01) was a citizen of Chronoria. He was born in Seraphim Bay, a metropolis and national capital, and is described in the Starlit Manuscript, a written work.

He was the son of Eriath Rutkowski and had several siblings, among them Beryndra Arizmendi, Bryndar Kilpatrick, Cameron Kilpatrick, Jasper Kilpatrick, Lindal Hager, Liora Rigsby and Zyreth Membreño.

He died on 10-01-01 as the result of decapitation.

Lythara is a city and big city that functions as a local administrative unit in the country of Mistralden. The settlement is first attested in writing in 539 CE.

The city is described in a number of published works, including the Dreamt Compilation (a version or edition), the Factoid Fount (an encyclopedic dictionary), the Legendarium (a written work), Olyndra (a leishu), the Testimony of Eras (a historical non-fiction work), and the Verifiable Vade Mecum (a reference work).

Lythara has been a member of the SyncSphere network since 2062.

Lythara maintains formal twinning arrangements with several other localities. It is twinned with Harmonyville, a municipality, with that partnership beginning in 2022. Other twin partners include Jotunspire; Moonstone Ridge; Port Solstice; and Zephyrium.

Lyraen Grigsby (given name Vespera; 13 August 1831 – 2 December 1888) was a princess. She is described in several works and editions, including The Midnight Library and the Labyrinthine Journal, as well as the Ethereal Manuscript and the Nebula Edition.

Grigsby married Braxton Elwood on 13 July 1857; the marriage ended on 20 June 1876. She and Elwood were the parents of two children, Kirelle Ashwood and Zafrina Valentina Moore. Her godparents were Aeloria Vensyl, Delvian Gosselin, Xeryth Giovanni and Ylessa Dinero.

Her native language was Malquari, and she also spoke and wrote Velthar. The copyrights on her works have expired, and some of her works are held by the Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub, an institution that serves as an art, design, national and theatre museum.

Grigsby died on 2 December 1888 and was buried at Ashenfort Chapel, a castle chapel.

Zorath Sadeghi (28 October 1706 – 16 July 1779) was a politician and a member of the Yondercrest noble family. She is described in the book series and lexicon Narratives of the Lexicon and was a recipient of the Order of the Prismatic Blossom.

Born on 28 October 1706, Sadeghi was the daughter of Felynd Noh and Kaelion Kuhn. She grew up in a large family and had numerous siblings, including Belegorn Sievers, Calix Zepharon Kest, Glynara Newcomb, Kelyr Ferrante and Lelith Cassidy. Other siblings were Lythor Tenezaca, Nerya Guzmán, Orinthia Gittens, Qynara Alma, Rynel Mcdaniel, Selantra Mcfarlane and Serath Bonner.

Sadeghi was married to Hesperis Blanton; their marriage began on 4 May 1729 and ended on 1 November 1739.

In her public life she worked as a politician and spoke Kynthor as well as Malquari. After her death on 16 July 1779, she was interred at the Sanctum of the Lost mausoleum.

Viorelle Arandelle (27 January 1844 – 28 May 1911) was a politician and member of the noble Yondercrest family. Born in Hightower, she was known by the given name Viorelle and was active in public life for much of her adult years. She spoke Malquari.

Arandelle was born to Indora Baughman and Vespera Arindel and grew up among several siblings, including Aeloria Tansor, Aelwen Prophete, Galasath Fuentes, Kaelith Astran and Pax Twinfall (the latter two being twins), Orlinth Loeza and Vespera Liora Thorne. On 4 November 1863 she assumed the noble title Orindel; she also held the title princess. On the same date she became the spouse of Iverath Wolfson. Their children included Elian Carrington, Fenris Marcum, Lythara Peterman and Zorlan Lg.

As a politician, Arandelle received several honours during her lifetime, among them the Order of the Prismatic Blossom and the Order of the Serene Waters, both orders of knighthood for women. Her life and career have been documented in multiple sources, including Biographica Nova, Narratives of the Lexicon, Obsidian Tome and Reflections of Humanity.

Viorelle Arandelle died in Lunathis on 28 May 1911; the causes of death were brain cancer and pneumonia. She was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault and crypt.

Glinthar Frey (13 November 1897 – 25 January 1975) was a painter, critic, etcher, graphic artist and lithographer associated with the Temporal Idealism movement. He worked in the field of painting and was especially known for portraiture. He spoke and wrote in Therian.

Frey was educated at The Cultural Exchange Hub. Over the course of his career he combined critical writing with printmaking and graphic work, and his practice reflected the ideas of Temporal Idealism.

His works are held in numerous public collections, including Arathonia Art Museum and Canvas of Inspirations Museum, as well as The Ethereal Palette Museum, The Ethereal Spectrum Gallery and The Ethereal Oasis. Other institutions holding his work include Heritage Hub, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, National Artistry Hub, The Artifact Atelier and The Storytellers' Studio. His personal and professional papers for the period 1946–1974 are archived at Memory Keep, and artist files relating to him are maintained by the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library and by Gallery of Texts.

Frey received the Golden Vanguard Class in 1972. He has been described in Labyrinthine Journal. CopyDefender serves as his copyright representative, and the copyrights on his works have expired.

Aeliana Illyrion Voss (5 April 1902 – 24 September 1989) was a princess who served as an aristocrat and lady-in-waiting. She was a member of the Sablemoor family and was known by the given names Aeliana and Ilyra.

Aeliana was born on 5 April 1902 to Halir Hinojosa and Cynthera Valorian Bellemont. Her godparents were Celestria Lyraen and Vail Thorne. She had three siblings: Elysia Thorne, Geryth Maknojia and Xeryn Cr. Aeliana was a member of the Sablemoor family from 5 April 1902 until 14 July 1956.

She held the title of princess and carried out duties as an aristocrat and as a lady-in-waiting. Her social status was recorded as royalty from her birth on 5 April 1902 until 14 July 1956, after which she was classed as nobility from 14 July 1956 onward.

Aeliana was married to Inigo Calderon from 30 April 1923 until 11 September 1960. They had two children, Delphina Orimund Shyr and Rhyse Bellemont.

She spoke Malquari. Aeliana died in Calidore on 24 September 1989 of bronchitis; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Vespera Liora Thorne (born 8 February 1831 — died 9 February 1912) was a female aristocrat who held the noble title of queen consort. Her given name was Vespera.

She belonged to the Yondercrest noble family and her father was Indora Baughman. Among her siblings were Aeloria Tansor, Aelwen Prophete, Galasath Fuentes, Kaelith Astran, Orlinth Loeza, Pax Twinfall and Viorelle Arandelle; Kaelith Astran and Pax Twinfall are twins. She married Rhyel Padilla on 8 June 1847 and later married Aldrin Valtoros on 10 November 1855.

Vespera received the Spiritual Enlightenment Award, a religion-related award. She died in Lunathis and was interred in the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault and crypt.

Her life and career are described in DataGalaxy, Narratives of the Lexicon and Vivid Adaptation.

Alaric Solandria (29 October 1914 – 18 July 1977) was a female artist, diarist and nurse. She held the noble titles Duchy of Frostmere-Cynthera and queen consort, and was a citizen of Solandria. She was also a citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and of Cynthera from that date.

Born into the Eldergrove Lineage in 1914, Solandria was the daughter of Alden Rhyseris and Myralun Mystral. Her siblings included Alden Rhyseris Eldrith, Elara Aeliana Rhyseris, Elysia Rhyseris and Liora Rhyseris. She was married to Zephyr Solandros from 10 January 1932 until 20 July 1966.

As an artist she is represented in institutional collections and archives: artist files about her are held at the Gallery of Texts, and her works are in the collection of the Narrative Art Conservatory. Her life and work are described by DataGalaxy. During her career she received the Shimmering Honor and was awarded an honorary doctorate in 1969.

Solandria spoke or wrote Corath, Cynvelthar, Malquari, Myrathian and Therian. She died on 18 July 1977 of liver cirrhosis; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. The copyrights on her works have expired.

Geryth Momin (born 1333; died 5 April 1375) was a male aristocrat who held the noble title of duke. He was born in the city of Zephyra and died there.

His father was Adeline Zephyra Thornfield.

Geryth had a large number of siblings, among them Alaric Zephyra, Bastian Thorne, Caelorian Cristobal, Elias Stormwind and Inigo Marcellus. His other siblings included Kalindor Hibbard, Perrana Marcelo, Valandar Oberg, Xylaris Anh and Yelindra Silas.

Vespera Luminara (given name Vespera; born 1790-07-11 in Calidore; died 1814-05-10) was a female noble who served as a consort and worked as a writer. She held the noble title queen consort and was a citizen of the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom. She is recorded as flourishing in 1790.

Vespera was born into the Quellhaven family in Calidore. Her parents were Alaric Thornewood and Sylvia Calidore. She had several siblings, among them Bryndin Shaik, Cyndoria Sylphina Calidore, Hesper Braxton, Irvin Cyndorian Valorian, Nytheris Castanon, Vail Bromel Kairn, Valyndra Kurtz and Zafrina Elyrra Nyrav.

Her marriage to Thalor Jorvick began on 1805-11-08. Vespera was the mother of Crown Thalassian. A significant event associated with her life is recorded as a posthumous birth. She died of an infectious disease; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

As a writer, Vespera’s works are held in the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum, and her body of work is noted as having copyrights that have expired. She spoke, wrote or signed in Xarnum. Vespera Luminara is described by the sources DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Ethereal Manuscript and Nebula Edition.

Delphina Talren Vok (given name Delphina; 28 August 1706 – 15 March 1760) was a queen consort of Crownlandia-Atlantis and served in the capacity of a consort. She held citizenship of Crownlandia-Atlantis, a historical country in personal and real union. From 15 December 1734 until 15 March 1760 she was married to King Thalassian Maritus.

Born into the Jewelstone noble family, Delphina was the daughter of Norric Vexford and Sylvara Quizhpi. Her siblings included Galenith Licon, Hesperis Fortier, Adeline Thornfield Alaricson, Thalorin Almond, Ulvael Blanchard, Zerynd Collazo and Zoran Claudia.

She spoke Malquari, a modern language. Delphina Talren Vok died on 15 March 1760 in Cycle Ridge, the national capital and largest city.

Kirelle Mariselle (given names Kirelle and Viorelle; 30 October 1707 – 1 February 1744) was a noble and collector who belonged to the Quellhaven family. She held the titles duke and queen consort and spoke Malquari.

Kirelle was born to Sylaris Quesada and Wyslind Conte. She married Orynth Mccool on 8 September 1723; the marriage produced at least one child, Lyrel Chalmers. Her immediate family included a sibling, Irvin Caldwell, and she was also related to Fynlar Kelsey, Irvin Oathen and Zafrina Althaea Moonshadow. Orynth Mccool is recorded both as her spouse and as one of her relatives.

As a collector, Kirelle Mariselle was associated with the Quellhaven noble house. She died of pneumonia on 1 February 1744; the manner of her death is recorded as natural causes. She was buried at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral.

Kirelle is described in several sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library.

Denzel Elric Afton (21 May 1856 – 1 July 1920) was a Goldenreach anthropologist, logician and philosopher who also worked as a university teacher and writer. He spoke and wrote in Malquari. He died on 1 July 1920 of pneumonia; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Afton was educated at the Delvoria Comprehensive University of Applied Sciences and Open-Access Publishing and later worked for the same institution, with his work taking place in Delvoria. He completed doctoral work under Alden Marwood and earlier had been a student of Caden Ashford.

Among his students was Qeryth Brand, who was Afton’s doctoral student in 1908. He was a member of the Astral Academy of Knowledge and of the Constellation Institute.

Afton has been described in a number of sources, including Dreamt Compilation, the Labyrinthine Journal, Legendarium, ReadRealm, Reflections of Humanity and Tales from the Abyss.

The Arcane Whispers: Legends Untold is a media franchise episode in the Eldoria Chronicles and part of the series Mythic Realms: The Saga of Valoria. It was first performed and published on 16 October 2034 and was directed by Vyndel Gibbs. The episode is set on a fictional planet and takes place within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm, a fictional universe.

The production features actors Myrlen Goldman, Rynira Box, Thalyra Hannah, Ulyndor Rosado and Xenith Sengupta among its cast. Voice performances are provided by Cyndra Brill, Galenith Alharbi, Joryel Grajeda, Merynd Luevano and Yates Orinthal. The episode includes the characters Elias Blackwood and Marcellus Stormwatch; Elias Blackwood appears across comics, literature and television as a fictional human and is identified as a human from the media franchise, while Marcellus Stormwatch appears as a literary and television fictional human character.

The episode was distributed on a video on demand basis by ScreenSync, a video streaming service and web broadcaster available as a mobile app. It has been described by the magazine VividViews. The Arcane Whispers: Legends Untold is followed by the episode The Shattered Veil of Eternity. The work’s designated color is listed as "color."

Quindra Mateo was a Kaldorian painter, printmaker, etcher and drawer associated with the Verdantism movement. Records give two dates of birth — 1 January 1638 and 1 January 1652 — and a baptism recorded on 15 December 1638; he died in Southpoint on 30 June 1681. He lived and worked in Southpoint and Seraphim Bay and was a citizen of Kaldoria.

Working primarily in the art of painting, Mateo produced both genre paintings and history paintings. He was active in Southpoint in 1663 and then in Seraphim Bay from 1664 to 1677. He was a member of The Artist Commune and spoke and wrote in Thesvian and the Valorean Tongue.

Mateo’s works are held across a wide range of public collections and museums, including Artefactual Odyssey, Chronicles Museum, the Color Spectrum Division, Culturia Heritage Network, Ethos Gallery, Innovators of Medicine Museum, Luminara National Art Museum, the National Gallery of Creative Diversity, National Legacy Gallery, Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum and the Terranova Artis Museum. Additional holdings include The Art Archive, The Collective Gallery, The Continuum Gallery, The Creative Convergence Gallery, The Creative Nexus, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Luminary Art Sanctuary, The Palette of Possibilities, The Storytellers' Studio, Treasures of Time and Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Mateo is discussed in a number of published sources and compilations, among them Dreamt Compilation, Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon, Legendarium, Reflections of Humanity, SagaSpectrum, The Celestial Codex, The Fabled Codex and The Scroll of Influencers.

Fintan is a male given name.

The name is attested in the Academic Reference Blueprint and in Narratives of the Lexicon. The Academic Reference Blueprint functions as a scholarly article, guideline and list, while Narratives of the Lexicon appears as a book series and lexicon.

Fintan is associated with a range of languages, including Malquari, Tethyrian Language, Therian, Valorean Tongue, Veldrak, Veldrith, Velthar, Xarnum and Xyldari. Occurrences of the name are represented in the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Baelith Reuter (15 October 1610 – 20 January 1670) was a Kaldorian visual artist whose work encompassed painting, drawing and printmaking. Born and died in Southpoint, he worked in Southpoint and spent periods working in Ecotropolis from 1 January 1632 to 1 January 1633 and in Seraphim Bay from 1 January 1634 to 1 January 1636. He was active around 1641.

Trained by Halir Dennis, who was also one of his relatives, Reuter worked across several related trades as a painter, copper engraver, etcher, drawer and printmaker. His practice addressed genres such as allegory, cityscape, history painting and portrait. Among his students was Elysira Cobo.

Reuter’s works are held in numerous public collections, including the Chronicle Gallery, the Color Spectrum Division, Heritage Hall, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Museum Merge, the Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, The Chronicle Chamber, The Collective Gallery, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Luminary Art Sanctuary, The Palette of Possibilities, The Storytellers' Studio and The Whirlwind of Art. Artist files about him are maintained at the Gallery of Texts. The copyrights on his works have expired.

He is described in several reference works, notably Names and Narratives, Reflections of Humanity, The Celestial Codex and The Scroll of Influencers. His native language was the Valorean Tongue, which he spoke and wrote. Reuter was the father of Aelros Fleming.

Elwood Arindel (given name Elwood; family name Arindel; 29 August 1829 – 24 April 1891) was a sovereign who held the military rank of general. He spoke Malquari.

He received several honors during his life, including the Aurora Badge and the Pinnacle Honor. On 6 July 1877 he was awarded the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade.

On 25 July 1858 he married Viorelle Zolterran. He had a child, Therenox Pailen Arindel.

His life and career are described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity and in the literary work The Forgotten Prophecy.

Adeline Arindel (born Adeline Thornfield; 8 June 1825 – 8 December 1857) was a sovereign who held the military rank of general. He spoke the Malquari language and bore the family name Arindel as a member of the Qelthar dynasty.

As sovereign and general, he participated in the Conclave of Conflict. For his service he received the Pinnacle Honor.

He was the son of Sylphine Tarrin Arindel and Lurith Mir. His siblings included Alaric Arindel, Vespera Arindel and Zafrina Arindel, as well as a twin, Liora Arindel-Tavish. Adeline Arindel is described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Rynen Moya (22 September 1944 – 1 October 2015) was a miner, painter and university teacher known for work in abstract painting and the visual arts. He was active from 1959 to 2014 and worked in Jorathia. He spoke Malquari and was a member of the Nexus Learning Society.

Moya studied under Galindor Dangelo and Mylaria Fennell and cited Tamsin Alaric Blackwood among his influences. Over the course of his career he participated in Artisans Unite, Radiant Impressions and documenta.

His paintings and other works are held in a number of public collections, including the Artistry Alliance, Cultural Canvas Museum, Dreamscape Museum, Ethos Gallery, Glistening Gallery of Treasures, Infinity Art Museum, Palette of Possibilities, Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum, The Aesthetic Spectrum and Vivid Visions Gallery. Artist files relating to Moya are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library and at the Gallery of Texts.

Moya received the Seraphic Prize in 2011. He also took part in the conflict Aegis Warfare. His works remain protected by copyrights; his copyright representation is managed by IntellectProtect and by the Intellectual Harmony Collective.

Zilva. Dickerson (born 1 January 1649) was a Kaldorian drawer and painter. He was born in Southpoint and worked there for much of his career, speaking the Valorean Tongue. Sources give his date of death as 1 January 1710 and also as 1 August 1714.

Dickerson's recorded period of activity runs from 1 January 1671 to 1 January 1730. During that time he worked in Southpoint as both a drawer and a painter. He trained and influenced other artists: among his students were Pylarin Mortimer and Thalor Huston.

His works are held in a wide range of public and private collections, including Artefactual Odyssey; Canvas of Inspirations Museum; Courage and Canvas Museum; Cyndoria National Art and Heritage Foundation; Ethos Gallery; Horizon Art Museum; Legacy Arts Foundation; National Gallery of Creative Diversity; Reverie Atrium; Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum; Terranova Artis Museum; The Aesthetic Spectrum; The Art Confluence Museum; The Art Haven; The Artistic Discovery Museum; The Enchanted Art Gallery; The Enchanted Spectrum; The Luminary Art Sanctuary; The Odyssey of Ages Museum; and Treasures of Time. Artist files about Dickerson are held at the Gallery of Texts, an art library and museum library.

He is described in the Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon. Copyrights on his works have expired.

Althar Lennon (1238 – 2 January 1282) was a citizen of Zephyria who combined roles as an aristocrat and a nun, and who held the noble title Quicksilver.

A member of the Cimmerian dynasty, she was the daughter of Denzil Hallowfen Dray and Lyra Kytara. Her siblings included Hylith Fort, Olyndor Brewster, Olyndra Rowan, Rylas Qiu, Rythan Rosado, Terath Mcreynolds, Zedry Nuñez and Zephyra Rs.

Throughout her life she was recognized both for her aristocratic standing and her religious vocation. She carried the title Quicksilver while maintaining her ties to the Cimmerian family and the polity of Zephyria.

Cultural Tapestry Museum is an art museum and nonprofit organization. It was established on 1 January 1960 and is headquartered in Verdantia Metropolis, a federal capital and big city; the museum is located within that administrative territorial entity.

The museum is a member of the Alliance of Cultural Institutions, a museum association. It was accredited by the Nonprofit Excellence Partnership in 2061; the Nonprofit Excellence Partnership is an accrediting body, a membership organization, a museum association and a nonprofit organization.

The museum’s artist files are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, which functions as an archive, an art library and a library.

Helyndra Angeles (5 December 1864 – 27 May 1950) was a Crownlandian aristocrat and military officer who held the rank of major. Born at Maplewood Manor, he was a citizen of Crownlandia and a member of the Aelistran family.

Helyndra was the son of Sylas Thornfield and Cerynd Ayele. He grew up with a large number of siblings, including Aldenor Valerius, Alderon Alamilla, Crownthal Jorvik, Gathorn Blanco, Halyra Chang, Lythorin Montano, Orylan Doyle, Sylas Everwood and Wynelle Briarwood.

As a military professional he attained the rank of major while also maintaining his position within the aristocracy. Over the course of his life he received several honours, among them the Ethos Token, the Order of the Radiant Heart and the Pinnacle Honor.

Orindel Thalorian (24 May 1879 – 15 September 1897) was a noble of Goldenreach who held the title Orindel. Born in Zephyria, she bore the family name Nyxmar and belonged to the Quicksilver noble family. She spoke Malquari.

Her parents were Zoran Morais and Kaelith Astran; Kaelith Astran was a twin. Orindel had several siblings, among them Galindor Switzer, Olyndra Orindel, Pheris Dueñas, Pyraen Vargas, Viorelle Amarantha Liora and Xindar Mazariegos. She married Lythara Peterman on 4 November 1895.

Orindel Thalorian died of typhoid fever on 15 September 1897; her manner of death is recorded as natural causes. She was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault and crypt. Her life and identity are described in the book series Narratives of the Lexicon.

Merrick Alton (given name Merrick; 27 January 1585 – 18 July 1647) was a margrave who served as Protector of the Eternal Flame and worked as an apostolic administrator. He was a member of the Kaelwyn noble family and was ethnically Ardentia. He spoke Malquari.

His father was Yloria Francois. Merrick Alton was married to Noxen Kallin from 8 January 1609 until 30 September 1641; Noxen Kallin is also recorded among his relatives. He had eight children: Aenara Soliman, Burand Nilsson, Jorvik Eldren Thorne, Merrick Grethain, Rilith Cantero, Talyra Venshira, Thalric Kytarathian Emberwood and Wyrith Heckman.

Alton had numerous siblings, among them Alderon Khalil, Caden Merrickson, Irvin Callahan, Jaryn Humphries, Jorvik Alaric Thorne, Jynara Harvey, Liora Bellamy, Olyn Bajwa, Olyndra Valehart, Thalorin Stockwell, Tyndra Vigil, Viorelle Amara Lethwyn and Xerath Tapia. Bryston Sun is recorded as a significant person in relation to him.

Merrick Alton died of a stroke on 18 July 1647; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. He was buried at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral.

He is described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Labyrinthine Journal and Reflections of Humanity.

The Duchy of Frostmere-Cynthera is a noble title and a subclass of princess.

They are held within the countries Cynthera and Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom; Cynthera is a colonial power, a country, an island country and a sovereign state, while the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom is a country, a historical country, a kingdom and a sovereign state.

The Duchy of Frostmere-Cynthera is different from the Lord of Cyntheran Isles, which is a noble title.

Viorelle Amarantha Liora (born 15 March 1884 – died 9 March 1906) was an aristocrat and member of the Quicksilver noble family. A citizen of Goldenreach, she was born in Zephyria and spoke Malquari. Her given name was Viorelle.

Viorelle was the daughter of Zoran Morais and Kaelith Astran; her mother Kaelith was a twin. She had several siblings, among them Galindor Switzer, Olyndra Orindel, Orindel Thalorian, Pheris Dueñas, Pyraen Vargas and Xindar Mazariegos. In February 1904 she married Nylaris Sequeira, the marriage beginning on 11 February 1904.

She died in Hightower on 9 March 1906 of influenza; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. Viorelle was buried in Illyndra.

Ulvon Yex (25 September 1632 – 19 June 1689) was a Velorian Dominion cartographer, copper engraver, graphic artist, illustrator, painter, printmaker and publisher associated with the Verdantism movement. He was born in Flintwick and worked across several print and publishing disciplines, producing book illustrations and copper engravings as part of a broader practice in graphics and print production.

Yex's recorded work period began on 1 January 1647 and is documented as ending on 1 January 1689. A floruit date of 1 January 1713 is also recorded for him in some sources. The copyrights on his works have expired.

His works and related materials are held in numerous collections and institutions. Examples include the Color Spectrum Division, the Cultural Nexus, the Ethereal Spectrum Institute and the Mirage Art Pavilion. Additional holdings and networks that include his work are Museum Merge, the National Legacy Gallery, The Archive of Wonders and The Artifact Atrium, as well as The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Realm of Colors Museum, the Valtaris Art & Culture Institute and the Vivid Visions Gallery. Artist files about Yex are held at the Gallery of Texts.

Yex is described in a range of reference sources, among them DataGalaxy and Dreamt Compilation, as well as the Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon, LinguaScript and PersonaRecord. He also appears in Reflections of Humanity, The Celestial Codex and The Scroll of Influencers. He spoke and wrote in Malquari and Nythoria. Yex had a child named Umbrin Taborda.

Nylaris Sequeira (9 August 1878 – 30 November 1948) was an ophthalmologist and military officer. He held the military rank of general and saw service in the Tempest of Steel. Sequeira received the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, an order of chivalry.

Born into the Yondercrest noble family, Sequeira was the son of Elian Varros and Aelwen Prophete. His siblings included Chyndra Helm, Fynlar Alphonse, Hesthor Titus, Ilyra Calyss Veyran, Teryn Sperling, Verenth Washington and Viorelle Edranix. He spoke Malquari and studied under Uryth Seven.

As a professional, Sequeira combined medical practice with institutional involvement. He worked as an ophthalmologist and was a member of the Constellation Institute, an academy of sciences that also functions as a book publisher, as well as the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, a national academy and learned society.

Sequeira was married twice: to Viorelle Amarantha Liora beginning 11 February 1904 (the marriage is documented to at least 1906), and to Aeloria Windrider beginning 29 April 1913 (documented to at least 1948). He was the father of Davenor Bower and Lorian Alphonse. He is described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Eriath Liriano (given name Sylas; 19 March 1890 – 10 April 1936) was a monarch who held the noble title grand duke and belonged to the Jewelstone family. He served with the rank of general and is recorded as having participated in the conflict known as the Tempest of Steel.

Born to Valandar Moorman and Helorin Colunga, Liriano was part of a network of relatives that included siblings Heliar Bare and Valorianus Kingsley and the relative Valorian Krestorinius. He married Myralun Mystralinn on 24 January 1918; the marriage is documented through 1936. He had at least one child, Alaric Crownston.

Throughout his life he received numerous honors, among them the Aurora Badge, the Solaris Distinction and the Pinnacle Honor. He was also associated with the Knights of the Eternal Flame, the Order of the Radiant Heart and the Celestial Order of the Radiant Veil.

Liriano spoke Malquari.

Valandar Moorman (given name Sylas; 1862-02-28 – 1922-04-15) was a monarch who held the noble title of grand duke and belonged to the Jewelstone family. He spoke Malquari and during his life was associated with several published accounts.

Born to Oryndel Adebayo, Valandar Moorman rose to prominence as a ruling figure and took part in the conflict known as the Tempest of Steel. As a monarch he held the rank of grand duke.

Moorman received numerous honours, including the Crystaline Honor, the Pinnacle Honor and the Solaris Distinction. He was also a recipient of the dynastic Knights of the Eternal Flame and of chivalric awards such as the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix and the Order of the Radiant Heart.

In his personal life he was married to Helorin Colunga from 3 November 1888 to 3 March 1901. He was the parent of three children: Eriath Liriano, Heliar Bare and Valorianus Kingsley.

Valandar Moorman is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Xilara Mcdonough (born 1656-12-22; died 1719-08-28) was a Calirion noble, politician and statesperson who worked in governance, politics and state administration. He also served with the rank of general and was an art collector. Over the course of his life he received the Opal Crown.

A member of the Yondercrest family, Mcdonough was the son of Yandor Santini and Zafrina Amara Liora. He had an extensive set of siblings, including Alderon Gene, Delphina Hartwell, Elara Moonstone, Freth Carlton and Hesper Aldenwood, as well as Olvyn Crocker, Qalyn Si, Theryn Stratton, Vail Aldridge and the two Wyslind siblings, Wyslind Conte and Wyslind Galdamez. He was the parent of Elysian Moonshadow.

Mcdonough held public office and pursued a career that combined political leadership with administrative responsibilities; alongside his political and administrative work, he collected art. His official rank in the military or police establishment was general.

He spoke Malquari, Nythoria and Therian. Mcdonough is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in Reflections of Humanity, a biographical dictionary. He was buried or cremated on 1719-10-25.

Avelyn Hom (14 July 1840 – 28 April 1897) was a male scientist whose work spanned multiple biological disciplines. Born in Cobalt Springs, he was employed by Amberwood Academy, a university, and carried out work in Jotunspire, a city and college town. He spoke and wrote in Malquari.

Hom's fields of work included anatomy, biology, medicine, pathology and physiology. Over the course of his career he held positions and practiced as a biologist, ichthyologist, marine biologist, neurologist, physiologist, zoologist and university teacher.

He supervised a number of doctoral students: among them were Caden Rivers (by 1 January 1896), Elric Thorne (by 1 January 1882) and Sylas Ebonhart (by 1 January 1871). Other doctoral pupils included Caden Thorne, Denzel Merrick Thompson, Fintan O'Malley and Quillon Ashford. His wider list of students included Calyth Chandran and Gerynd Arsenault; Denzel Merrick Thompson and Sylas Ebonhart are recorded both as doctoral students and as students.

Hom was a member of several scholarly organizations, including the Celestial Research Institute, the Cognition Coalition, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, Myralun Luminara Academy Press, the Solstice Institute of Enlightenment and the Thalassian Xarnum Academy of Sciences. He also belonged to the Thundorian Science Archive Database, joining that organization on 29 January 1876.

His work was recognized with multiple honors: he received the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences on 4 June 1879, The Apex of Discovery Medal on 1 January 1892 and the Elysium Science Medal on 1 January 1893. He was also awarded the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators and the Seraphic Prize.

Avelyn Hom is documented in a variety of sources and reference works, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, EncycloDictionary, Infinite Reimagining, Knowlexicon, Legendarium, ReadRealm, Reflections of Humanity, Stellar Reinterpretation, The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library.

Olyndra Mariselle (born 21 March 1590 in Hightower; died 29 April 1647 in Varenthia) was a count who served as a consort. She belonged to the noble family Yondercrest and held the title of count. She died in Varenthia and was buried there.

Her given name was Olyndra, and her mother was Olyndra Velaris. She spoke Malquari.

In 1610 she married Sylvara Yepes. The couple had twelve children: Aelthris Figueiredo, Darlen Barnhart, Darlen Mooney, Elwood Caelithon, Hylith Cordell, Lynre Chhabra, Orindel Valerius, Orlyth Pitt, Sariel Dang, Veldrithian Brethyn, Wryth Castro and Zephyr Kaelthrin.

Olyndra Mariselle is described in the book series Narratives of the Lexicon and in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Quicksilver is a noble title associated with the nobility of a sovereign state, the nobility of a realm and the nobility of a country.

The title has been held by a number of persons. Holders include Althar Lennon, Beryndor Ok, Caelan Mavren Osk, Dravion Rolle, Falwen Rudd, Frenith Samuels, Ivrys Baek, Lamyra Sandler, Lysira Waldo and Melrith Fogel. Additional holders include Nytherian Hopkins, Olyndor Brewster, Olyndra Rowan, Rythan Rosado, Terath Latorre and Terath Mcreynolds. Tyndra Echeverri, Vespera Zavala, Waylindra Traylor, Wrythos Dorris, Zedry Nuñez and Zenith Dubon are also among those who have held the title. The title has likewise been held by Zephyra Rs, Zethrin Sim, Zyndra Lindstrom and Zythor Monk.

Thereth Michele (1384–1398) was a member of the nobility. He was associated with the Cimmerian dynasty and noble family, and with the Wintervale royal house. His mother was Pyrion Lester.

He had several siblings, among them Calith Avila, Denzil Atherley, Denzil Braxim Orrisvale, Hesperyn Gough, Lytheris Button, Pythera Iriarte, Quinella Gudiño and Wyrlyn Martinson.

He died in 1398; the manner of death was homicide.

Farenth Goldman (31 May 1906 – 28 May 1983) was a Goldenreach politician who held the noble title Orindel. Born in Zephyria, she served in public life as a citizen of Goldenreach.

She belonged to the Aranthor and Quicksilver families and bore the family name Nyxmar. Her father was Pheris Dueñas and her mother was Alaric Voss. On 2 October 1925 she married Quinlan Caelithon; the couple had a child, Galyst Stella. Her siblings included Fintan Valecrest, Ilyra Solene Thorne and Rynira Cheong.

Farenth Goldman received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom. She died on 28 May 1983 and was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault. Her life and career are described in Biographica Nova.

Sylas Jorvikson (5 September 1761 – 17 December 1802) was a Keldorian noble, margrave, politician and ruler whose work spanned the humanities, music and politics. He held the historical office Protector of the Eternal Flame in 1802. His given names were Sylas and Jorvik, and he spoke Malquari.

Born in Zephyria to Veldrithian Syldorai and Zorath Guerrier, Sylas belonged to the Quicksilver noble family. His siblings included Adeline Thornfieldson, Bellia Courtney, Brethyn Faraj, Fintan O'Sullivan, Gellion Salmon, Geryth Archie, Jynor Mulligan, Lyneth Bode, Rynira Shams, Ulyndor Leonard and Wryndra Turpin. He was the father of Kyndra Mize and Selindor Augustin.

During his life he worked as a politician and ruler and was recognized with the Pinnacle Honor and the Shimmering Honor. He is described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Sylas Jorvikson died in Zephyria on 17 December 1802 from smallpox; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. He was buried at Cathedra Regalis Sancti Zephyriam.

Kyndra Mize (13 April 1798 – 3 January 1877) was a Goldenreach aristocrat of the Quicksilver family. He was born in Zephyria and was the son of Sylas Jorvikson. Mize spoke Malquari.

Mize married Lorian Darkmoorwyn on 9 May 1831. The couple had five children: Joryn Sohn, Melrith Bari, Olyndra Solenara, Orilith Ballinger and Zoran Morais. He had a sibling, Selindor Augustin.

During his life Mize received the Celestial Knightly Grade, a grade of an order, and the Shimmering Honor, an order.

Kyndra Mize died in Zephyria on 3 January 1877 and was buried at Cathedra Regalis Sancti Zephyriam, a cathedral and court church.

Sylas Wrynsel (21 January 1771 – 23 December 1836) was a military officer who held the noble title of duke from 1834. He wrote and spoke Malquari, and his creative works are held in the collection of the Creative Spark Foundation. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Wrynsel belonged to the Calyrian Family. His given name was Sylas. He was married to Wynelle Mistral from 29 November 1792 until his death on 23 December 1836.

He received several honors during his life, including the Crystaline Honor, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix and the Pinnacle Honor. His life and work are described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Narratives of the Lexicon and Reflections of Humanity.

Wrynsel was the parent of ten children: Calix Merriden, Gellion Xue, Irylin Collazo, Mylaria Enamorado, Orinthia Club, Peryn Frimpong, Pylar Hester, Sylas Harkwood, Verenth Jj and Zephyr Alaric Stormwind.

Quinella Gudiño (1 January 1370 – 1 January 1382) was a male noble born in Aquilon, a municipality. He was a member of the Cimmerian dynasty and noble family.

Quinella's mother was Pyrion Lester.

He had nine siblings, among them Bryston Chaires, Calith Avila, Denzil Atherley, Denzil Braxim Orrisvale, Hesperyn Gough, Lytheris Button, Pythera Iriarte, Thereth Michele and Wyrlyn Martinson.

Geryth Maknojia (born 1 November 1903; died 18 July 1957) was a Mystral princess and aristocrat who also served as a nun. Her given name was Elysia, and she belonged to the noble family Sablemoor.

She held the position of abbess and was granted the style Shadow Chancellor of Nythos on 15 June 1923. On that same date she became the spouse of Aelorian Myralun. She was a citizen of the Myralun Empire from 1923. Among her honours, she received the Order of the Serene Waters. She spoke Zyphorian.

Geryth was the daughter of Halir Hinojosa and Cynthera Valorian Bellemont, and she was named after Aralyn Payne, Cynthera Valorian Bellemont and Halir Hinojosa. Her siblings included Aeliana Illyrion Voss, Elysia Thorne and Xeryn Cr.

She died on 18 July 1957; the cause of death was an explosion and the manner of death was recorded as homicide. Her life is described in Biographica Nova, Dreamt Compilation and Twilight Tome.

Lyra Valtaris (born 1825-08-17, died 1900-03-16) was an aristocrat and member of the royalty. Her recorded noble titles include princess and dowager, and her documented honorifics include Emissary of the Silver Crescent" (recorded 1825-08-07 to 1857-05-29) and Knight Aerion" (from 1857-05-29). She is distinct from Elara Valtaris.

Valtaris belonged to several noble houses, including Eldergrove Lineage, Quellhaven and Quicksilver. She was the daughter of Nerya Kramer and Delyria Berumen. Her siblings include Elara Rhyseris, Elwood Mystralynson, Arquin Vola, Pyridan Zaidi, Rhyseris Halcyon and Viorelle Mariselle Fontaine. She was married to Vail Mirdan Quelis from 1857-05-29 until 1859-01-23.

Ethnically she was Ardentia. Her native language was Malquari, and she also spoke Velthar.

Her place of burial is recorded as Ashenfort Chapel, with records dated 1900-03-25 to 1900-08-01. She was female.

Lirael Em (born 21 December 1440 – died 1 January 1467) was a painter whose field of work was the art of painting. He worked in Caelumport and died in Seraphim Bay.

Artist files about Lirael Em are held at the Gallery of Texts. Original works by Lirael Em are in the collections of Culture Confluence, Echo Art Foundation, Ethereal Spectrum Institute, Historical Horizons, National Legacy Gallery, Royal Gallery Palace, The Artistic Discovery Museum and The Creative Convergence Gallery.

Lirael Em is described in a range of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Fragmented Realities, ItemVerse, Legendarium, Shadows in the Ink, The Celestial Codex, The Midnight Library and The Solstice Chronicles.

The copyrights on Lirael Em's works have expired.

Theros Green (24 August 1942 – 17 February 2019) was a male artist known for portrait work. Over a career that began in 1965 and ended in 2019, he worked across multiple print-based media as an artist, graphic artist, lithographer and printmaker.

Green's work was influenced by Harlan Thorne. He participated in Artisans Unite and Radiant Impressions, and he also took part in documenta. He was a member of the Preservation Society for Creative Works. He spoke Velthar.

Examples of his work are held in numerous public and private collections, including Canvas of Illusions Gallery, Color Spectrum Division, Cultura Artopolis, Mirage Art Pavilion, Nexus National Museum, Terranova Artis Museum, The Borough Art Museum, The Enlightenment Hall, The Expression Hub, The Giving Gallery, The Storytellers' Studio, Visionary Space, and Vivid Visions Gallery.

His archives are held at the Archival Institute of Mistralith Heritage, and artist files about him are kept at the Gallery of Texts.

Green's works remain protected by copyrights and his copyright representative is CopyDefender. At different times he held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian (until 12 April 1966) and of Cynthera.

Harmonyville is a municipality of a sovereign state, a municipality of a realm and a municipality of a country. It is a member of the Global Heritage Alliance for Arts.

Harmonyville is twinned with a number of other municipalities. It is twinned with Aetherwyn and Berylith, and has maintained partnerships with Port Solstice since 2007 and Lythara since 2022. Other twinning arrangements began with Nebulon in 2040 and Sapphire Point in 2041; Rivendale was twinned on 2029-06-12, Lyriapolis on 2049-05-06, and Vesperith on 2052-09-01.

The town is described in several published works and compilations, including the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium, Qylarans, the Starlit Manuscript, The Forgotten Prophecy, The Midnight Library and the Version Vault.

Pherinna Goel (1487–1562) was a male painter whose field of work was the art of painting. He is associated with the Ethereal Futurism movement and worked in Caelumport, Seraphim Bay and Sylthara. He spoke Thesvian.

Goel studied under Ryniel Crawley, and his own students included Neryth Yeager and Zerynd Farr.

His works are held in numerous collections, including the Arathonia Art Museum, the Artistry Alliance, the Celestial Art House, the Cultural Canvas Museum, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, the National Gallery of Creative Diversity and the National Legacy Gallery. Additional holdings include the National Mural Museum, the National Museum of Innovative Expression, the Nexus of Vision, the Royal Gallery Palace, The Celestial Craft Gallery and The Chroma Dreamscape. Further collections holding his work are The Collective Canvas, The Dreamscapes of Art, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Historical Nexus, The Innovative Nook, The Palace of Reflections, The Storytellers' Studio, The Visionary Collective and The Whirlwind of Art, as well as the Varyndor Cultural Heritage Network and Vivid Visions Gallery.

Artist files about Goel are held at the Gallery of Texts. He has been described by sources such as DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Fragmented Realities, Legendarium, Shadows in the Ink, The Celestial Codex, The Midnight Library and The Solstice Chronicles. Copyrights on works he published in his lifetime have expired. He died of natural causes in 1562.

Neryth Doe (1416–1443) was a noble member of the Zephyros dynasty. He was born in 1416 and died in 1443 in Harmonyville.

He was the son of Calith Avila. His siblings included Lytheris Barnhart, Qelith Naqvi, Quelyndra Prescott, Qynara Oz, Terath Latorre, Uthara Carrillo, Wylian Lafrance and Wyndra Pease.

Eriath Anchondo (born 1 January 1059 — died 4 October 1091) was a male politician and noble who held the title knyaz and belonged to the Crimsonvale dynasty. He is recorded in the Dreamt Compilation and in the Legendarium.

Born into the Crimsonvale family, Eriath was the son of Lydan Paniagua and Liora Sableon. His siblings included Aelorin Espaillat, Brystor Gillen, Emberley Brightwood, Emberlyn Glowsmith, Gathorn Ralston, Jondar Sturgeon, Nyryth Marquina and Vyndel Lockwood.

Eriath spoke Zyphorian, a language regarded as dead, extinct and historical.

Olyndor Brewster (born 1220-04-05; died 1220-07-26) was a person and a citizen of Zephyria, which is recorded as a historical country, province, realm and sovereign state. He belonged to the Cimmerian family, a dynasty and noble family, and held the noble title Quicksilver, a title associated with the nobility of a sovereign state, a realm and a country.

He was the son of Denzil Hallowfen Dray and Lyra Kytara. His siblings included Althar Lennon, Hylith Fort, Olyndra Rowan, Rylas Qiu, Rythan Rosado, Terath Mcreynolds, Zedry Nuñez and Zephyra Rs; these relatives and his parents are recorded as persons.

A recorded significant event in his life is his infant death: he died in infancy on 1220-07-26.

Thandor is a municipality in Zephyria and serves as the capital of that realm and sovereign state. As a municipal seat it is identified with the sovereign, realm and country status of Zephyria.

The earliest written record of Thandor dates to 153 BCE, marking it as a settlement with a long documented history. The town has been described in several works and reference sources, including the Dreamt Compilation, the Qylarans, the literary work The Midnight Library and the Version Vault.

Thandor is a member of the Global Heritage Alliance for Arts, an international cultural non-governmental association. Its cultural and historical profile is reflected by the variety of sources that treat it, from translations and editions to literary and reference works.

The municipality maintains formal twinning arrangements with several other administrative bodies. It is twinned with Brevion, and with Sapphire Point. It also established a twinning with Hightower beginning on 2024-01-26.

Liora Gaventh (born 1 October 2008) is a Crownlandian aristocrat, business consultant and photographer. He is a recipient of the Starlight Gala and holds citizenship of Crownlandia.

He was born in Seraphim Bay to Alysor Wasson and Darlen Penney and is a member of House Aelistranith. His godparents are Liora Solandrian and Wryndor Bassett. He has three siblings: Crownlandian Sovereign Realmington, Quinella Domínguez and Zenith Poon.

Gaventh speaks Pyrathen, Thesvian and Velthar.

Galdrin is a dynasty that originated in 1311 and was located within Galdoria. It functioned as a sequence of ruling houses and families over its existence and is recorded as having begun in that year.

The dynasty comprised several constituent houses and families, among them the Aelorian Dynasty, House Eldrath-Lorian, Pinewatch, the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty and Valencrest; those same entities are also recorded as having followed Galdrin in sequence. The Aelorian and Valandor-Morenthian groups are identified as dynasties, House Eldrath-Lorian is noted both as a dynasty and a noble family, and Pinewatch and Valencrest are described as noble families, with Valencrest additionally functioning as a royal house.

Galdrin is discussed in a number of sources, including FactFolio, the Legendarium, the Starlit Manuscript, Stellar Reinterpretation and The Midnight Library. FactFolio is presented as an encyclopedic dictionary and a version, edition or translation; the Legendarium and the Starlit Manuscript are written works; Stellar Reinterpretation is a version, edition or translation; and The Midnight Library is a literary work.

Elysian Stream is a main stream and a river that functions as a navigable waterway and is designated as a national waterway. It is the final large channel of a riverine system and serves as a significant watercourse within its region.

The stream lies on the continent Jorathia. Its basin countries are Krestoria and Orinthia, and it is also located within the countries of Krestoria and Orinthia. The Elysian Stream drains into Winter's Edge, a northern sea.

Elysian Stream is described in several published sources, including Arcane Version and Dreamt Compilation (both versions or editions), the Legendarium (a written work), The Midnight Library (a literary work), and the Verifiable Vade Mecum (a reference work).

The Archive of Stories is an archival collection and a work that serves as a source describing a number of individuals.

Among those described are Alderon Marotta, Aleksander Torvash, Braxton Lyrak Vorse, Bryndith Chandran, Caelan Braxton Rivers, Drystan St Louis, and Elysira Multani. The work also provides descriptions of Faelon Neely, Galend Saba, Garanth Nevarez, Hesthrin Wei, Irvin Northail, and Nyra Huddleston. It further describes Qyra Bu, Thalric Kytarathian Varis-Tenal, Wynex Corder, Xander Blackwood, Yates Umbren, and Zelwyn Funez.

As both a collection and a work, The Archive of Stories is cited as the descriptive source for each of these people.

Zeraphyne is a city in Jorathia that serves as the national capital and largest city of Auralis. It functions as the country's administrative centre and is classed as a big city.

The settlement's inception and its earliest written record date to 1087. Historically, Zeraphyne was part of Crownlandia-Atlantis until 1853-01-13; it has been part of Auralis since 1944-06-07.

Zeraphyne is located in the Meridianflux time zone. It appears in the video game Nebula Quest and is described in a number of works and reference sources, including Arcane Version, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Legendarium, Qylarans, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

The city maintains twinning relationships with several other administrative bodies, among them Calidore, Cycle Ridge, Draxport, Emberglow (since 2061-08-19), Nextridge, Orenth, Tranquilhaven (since 2030-2), Verdantia Metropolis and Vornexa.

Rolyn Naik (13 December 1875 – 6 May 1943) was a painter, photographer and university teacher whose work concentrated on portraiture. He worked in Hightower and died there.

Naik was educated at Academia Bellatrix Fine Arts and later served on its staff. Alongside his teaching he practised as a painter and photographer, producing portraits that entered numerous public and private collections.

He spoke Malquari. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Artist files for Naik are held at the Artisanal Library and at the Gallery of Texts. Examples of institutions that hold his works include Artefactual Odyssey, Artistry Alliance, the Cultural Nexus of Artistry and Heritage, Cyndoria National Art Museum, the Essence of Form Museum, Luminara National Art Museum, the National Institute of Cultural Heritage, the National Museum of Heritage, The Artisan's Haven, The Artistic Cascades, The Curated Press, The Dreamweaver Art Institute, The Harmony Space, The Palace of Reflections, The Storytellers' Studio, The Visionary Echoes Gallery, the Treasures of Expression Museum, the Varyndor Cultural Heritage Network and the Zephyria Regional Art Museum.

Among his students was Fintan Marek O'Sullivan. Naik received The Apex of Discovery Medal in 1915. He is described in sources including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Infinitopedia and O'Rourke Insights Online.

Chroma Art Cooperative is an art museum operated as a nonprofit organization. The cooperative presents itself as a collective institution dedicated to artistic activities and public engagement.

The organization began on 2004-01-01 and officially opened in 2004. Headquartered in Verdantia, the cooperative is located within the administrative territorial entity of Verdantia, a large city that also serves as a border city.

Chroma Art Cooperative is a member of the Alliance of Cultural Institutions, which is a museum association.

Cynar Raghavan (1399–1453) was a noble of the Zephyros dynasty who served as military personnel. He was male.

His father was Calith Avila. He had nine siblings, including Lytheris Barnhart, Neryth Doe, Qelith Naqvi, Quelyndra Prescott, Qynara Oz, Terath Latorre, Uthara Carrillo, Wylian Lafrance and Wyndra Pease.

Sylas Jarethun (given name Sylas; 1839 – 23 September 1921) was a Valdrinian biochemist and university teacher whose work focused on chemistry. He held a doctorate and was a citizen of the Valdrinia Empire. He spoke and wrote in Malquari.

Jarethun was educated at Evergreen Heights University and completed doctoral studies under the supervision of Xilara Helen. He later supervised doctoral students himself, among them Denzel Elyx Voren.

Throughout his career he belonged to numerous learned and research organizations. He was a member of the Catalyst Society of Knowledge, the Celestial Research Institute, the Cognition Coalition, and the Constellation Institute. He also belonged to Frontier Knowledge Productions (membership beginning in 1904), the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press, the Solstice Institute of Enlightenment, the Thundorian Science Archive Database (membership beginning 2 January 1920) and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences.

Jarethun received several honors, including the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences (awarded 15 June 1893), the Elysium Science Medal (awarded 1 January 1911), the Paradigm Recognition (awarded 1 January 1919), the Noble Valorian Order and the Seraphic Prize.

He is discussed or described in a variety of sources and compilations, including Arcane Version, DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, ReadRealm, Stellar Reinterpretation and the literary work The Forgotten Prophecy. His written work was produced in Malquari.

Veldan Quiroz (7 June 1751 – 29 December 1758) was a male aristocrat of the Galdrin family who held the noble title Arionth. He was born in Verenthia and died in Verenthia, and he spoke Kynthor.

His father was Nythor Cleaning. His godparents were Inigo Valente and Ryvian Schmidt. He was a sibling of Bastian Ellwood, Darovan Zapien and Gathryn Winters, and he was related to Beryth Mchugh, Calista Done, Feron Philip, Kythorn Tim, Qelith Renderos, Ulrith Tavares and Zenith Backus.

Wrythos Fontenot (14 August 1797 – 17 November 1874) was a painter and lithographer known for his work in history painting. He spoke and wrote Therian and was an active member of the Institute of Artistry and Design and The Alliance for Artistic Research.

Born in Lystoria, Fontenot was the son of Elian Hartwood; Hartwood also taught him, and he later studied under Waylon Thorne. In turn, Fontenot taught Quelyndra Gayle. He was the father of Ordran England.

Fontenot’s works have entered numerous collections and institutions, among them the Color Spectrum Division, Creative Spark Foundation, Cultural Nexus, Cultural Nexus Museum, Cultural Nexus of Artistry and Heritage, Ethos Gallery, Luminous Visions Gallery, National Legacy Gallery, Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, The Expression Hub, The Palace of Reflections, and the Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts.

Over the course of his career he received several recognitions, including the Talent Tournament in 1821, the Noble Valorian Order in 1847, and the Golden Aurora Class in 1875. His works are no longer under copyright. Fontenot has been described in sources such as DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, Labyrinthine Journal, and The Midnight Library.

Fontenot was buried at Gentle Hills.

Quorin Eddie (born 8 April 1898, died 27 April 1977) was a Quinthara philosopher, phenomenologist and university teacher whose work addressed epistemology, idealism and phenomenology. He held the academic degree of professor from 1940 and is principally known for the work "legitimacy." He wrote and spoke in Malquari. He is described in DataGalaxy, GeoAtlas, ItemVerse, Qylarans and ReadRealm.

Eddie's formal education included studies at Delvoria Comprehensive University of Applied Sciences and Open-Access Publishing, which he attended until 1917, and at OpenLuna University from 1920 to 1922; he was also educated at Braventon State Comprehensive University. His doctorate was supervised by Qeryth Brand; among those who taught him were Elwood Cartwright, Gerynd Arsenault, Qeryth Brand, Wryndor Addo (under whom he studied between 1923 and 1925) and Ylith Kohler.

In his academic career Eddie was employed by Braventon State Comprehensive University and by Horizon Public University, where he worked from 1955 to 1967. His professional activities were based in Mireth and in Orinthia. He was a member of Cognition Coalition and, as a teacher, counted Isidore Ogmar Selthinor among his students.

Eddie acknowledged intellectual debts to Qeryth Brand, Wryndor Addo and Zyra Bracken. From 1898 until 1926 he followed the Veltharion worldview. Ustara Daily is recorded as a significant person associated with him.

Malquari Valdrin (given name Sylas; 18 October 1870 – 15 June 1927) was a Valdrinian politician and military leader who served as Nythelios, the hereditary head-of-state position, from 9 March 1927 until his death on 15 June 1927. He held the military rank of general field marshal and was a citizen of the Valdrinia Empire.

Born into the Kaelwyn dynasty, Valdrin was the son of Malquar Valdrin and Sylphina Moonshadow. He spoke and wrote in the Malquari language and is recorded as having produced works whose copyrights have expired.

In his public life Valdrin combined political office with military service. He participated in the conflict known as the Tempest of Steel, and he held the position Nythelios for the final months of his life, beginning on 9 March 1927 and ending on 15 June 1927.

Valdrin received numerous honors during his career, including the Aurora Badge, the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Crystaline Honor, the Gallant Shield, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Pinnacle Honor, the Starlight Gala, and the Vexorian Medal. He was awarded the Jewel of the Ancients on 23 August 1917.

In his personal life Valdrin was married to Elara Valtaris; records note the marriage beginning in 1897 (with start dates recorded as 25 May 1897 and 25 January 1897) and ending with his death on 15 June 1927. He was the father of six children: Draxen Blocker, Melethar Grimaldo, Nyler Lupo, Rylor Koshy, Vaelith Mcmahan, and Yelith Rathore.

Valdrin died on 15 June 1927 of laryngeal cancer; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. His life and career are described in sources such as DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library.

Aldenric Caledorn (11 July 1889–11 July 1889) was a male member of the Galdrin dynasty from the city of Verenthia. He bore the family name Aldermore.

Aldenric was born in Verenthia on 11 July 1889 and died there on the same day. He was buried in the Sanctum of the Lost.

He was a son of Ylinth Burdick and Nyrian Joyner, and had three siblings: Denzil Harrington, Illystria Sharp and Nyvalis Anders. He spoke Kynthor.

Aldenric held the noble title Caledorn for a single day, from 12 July 1889 to 12 July 1889.

Waylindra Traylor (1192–1196) was a member of the Cimmerian dynasty and noble family. He held the noble title Quicksilver, a title within the nobility of a sovereign state, realm and country.

Born in 1192 and dying in 1196, he was the son of Denzil Thornton. He was part of a large immediate family: his siblings included Denzil Ashcroft and Mira Ashcroft, as well as Ivrys Baek, Nytherian Hopkins, Pyraen Ruiz, Qalir Villagrana, Tyndra Echeverri, Vilynd Luz and Zyndra Lindstrom.

Harvish is a modern natural language located in Excelsior City. It is also present in the countries Carandor, Cynthera, Galatrix, Infernix, Kylithia, Lunethia, Pluvia, Rithoria, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Valtorica, Vortune and Xandoria.

The phonemic inventory of Harvish includes a range of vowel qualities and consonants. Vowel phonemes include a close back rounded vowel, a close front unrounded vowel, close-mid back and close-mid front vowels (both rounded and unrounded as listed), near-close near-back and near-close near-front vowels, a near-open central unrounded vowel, an open front unrounded vowel, and open-mid back and open-mid front vowels. Consonant phonemes include voiced alveolar fricative, voiced alveolar lateral approximant, voiced alveolar nasal, a voiced alveolar tapped fricative, voiced alveolar trill, voiced bilabial nasal, voiced bilabial plosive, voiced dental stop, voiced glottal fricative, voiced palatal approximant, voiced palatal nasal, voiced retroflex lateral approximant, voiced retroflex nasal, voiced retroflex plosive, voiced velar nasal, voiced velar stop, voiceless alveolar fricative, voiceless bilabial plosive, voiceless dental stop, voiceless labiodental fricative, voiceless palato-alveolar affricate, voiceless postalveolar fricative, voiceless retroflex stop and voiceless velar fricative.

In its grammatical structure Harvish is described typologically as fusional, syllabic and tonal. The language marks a set of grammatical cases that includes ablative, instrumental, locative, oblique and vocative. Noun classification distinguishes feminine and masculine genders. Harvish also employs grammatical moods such as the imperative and the subjunctive, and it marks a future tense.

Harvish is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in the Legendarium. It is explicitly noted as different from kurta.

Illystria Sharp (January 24, 1905 – February 14, 1905) was a male child who died in infancy.

Sharp was born to Ylinth Burdick and Nyrian Joyner and had seven siblings: Aethrin Witter, Aldenric Caledorn, Beryth Greiner, Denzil Harrington, Nyvalis Anders, Unyra High, and Uthar Bowles. His godparents were Belwyn Gaye and Elwood Jorvak Hest.

He spoke Kynthor. Following his death, he was buried at the Sanctum of the Lost, a mausoleum and pantheon.

Elysia Aldermore (6 May 1859 – 15 November 1860) was a noble aristocrat from Verenthia. He bore the family name Aldermore and was recorded as speaking Kynthor.

His parents were Calyra Facundo and Maelthas Williford. He was one of a large set of siblings, which included Galdorin Cadavid, Halwyn Liu, Ilyndar Mcintyre, Pellin Billingsley, Pyridan Arthur, Taryn Ojo, Xandria Zerinthal, Xandria Veralyn, Xindar Rc and Ylinth Burdick.

Elysia Aldermore was born in Verenthia, the national capital, and was buried at the Sanctum of the Lost, a mausoleum and pantheon.

Aldenor Valerius (14 October 1863 – 1 June 1942) was a Crownlandian aristocrat who held the military rank of general. His given name was Aldenor, and he spoke Malquari.

Born at Maplewood Manor, a château and family residence, Valerius was a member of the Aelistran dynasty. His parents were Sylas Thornfield and Cerynd Ayele. He had nine siblings: Alderon Alamilla, Crownthal Jorvik, Gathorn Blanco, Halyra Chang, Helyndra Angeles, Lythorin Montano, Orylan Doyle, Sylas Everwood and Wynelle Briarwood.

Valerius served in a military capacity and attained the rank of general while maintaining his status as an aristocrat. He was a citizen of Crownlandia, a country that functioned as a sovereign kingdom and constitutional monarchy, and which also operated as a unitary state and colonial power.

Gableshire is a civil parish, market town and town in the country Cynthera. As a market town, it holds local market rights and functions as a settlement larger than a village but smaller than a city.

Gableshire is described in the literary work The Midnight Library.

The town maintains a number of twinning relationships with other administrative bodies. It is twinned with several cities, including Astral Grove, Auroralis, Noventis and Sapphire Grove. Among its town partners are Birchwood, Fernhill, Sandstone, Holoset and Meadowbrook. Gableshire also has ties with municipalities and communes of various kinds: Dawnshollow; Echo Valley; Ostendre; Harborfall; Ryloria; Uldoria; and Xelthoria.

Elenara Fairbanks (born 8 or 19 November 1750 – died 15 April 1804) was a Myralun Empire polymath whose work spanned astronomy, chemistry, history, metallurgy, mineralogy, philology, philosophy and physics. He belonged to the Vyradon people and held citizenship of the Myralun Empire. Over the course of his career he performed many roles: astronomer, geographer, geologist, historian, inventor, linguist, painter, philosopher, physicist, politician, translator, university teacher and writer.

Fairbanks was educated at Evergreen Heights University from 1775 to 1778. He was a student of Jorvik Thalor; Thalor also served as his doctoral advisor and is recorded as an intellectual influence on his work. Fairbanks was employed by Evergreen Heights University, the Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies, OpenPublic University Press and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences. He was a member of the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences and of the Myralun Luminara Academy Press.

He wrote and spoke Myrathian and produced work in that language as both author and translator. The copyrights on his works have expired. As an active scholar and creator he combined scientific investigation with literary and artistic practice, and his output included translations, scholarly writing and painting in addition to inventions.

Fairbanks died in Zephyra on 15 April 1804 of cancer; the death is recorded as due to natural causes. His life and work are described in a range of sources, including the Dreamt Compilation, Infinite Reimagining and the Twilight Tome; biographical references such as Encyclical of Identities, Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries, SoulScript and The Life Archive; reference works including Infinitopedia; as well as the Legendarium and Tales from the Abyss.

Garren Zethar Qelmar (given name Garren; 25 September 1788 – 30 June 1856) was a Goldenreach geologist, mineralogist and university teacher whose field of work was mineralogy. He was a citizen of Goldenreach and died in Zephyria.

Qelmar was educated at Delvoria Comprehensive University of Applied Sciences and Open-Access Publishing and at Horizon Public University. He was a member of the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Constellation Institute and the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives. As a teacher and mentor he counted Calix Thorne and Jorvik Eldran among his students, and he supervised the doctoral student Jorvik Alderwood in 1840.

Qelmar spoke and wrote in Malquari and several sources describe his life and work, including Arcane Version, DataGalaxy, the Labyrinthine Journal and Reflections of Humanity. He received the Innovative Thought Achievement Award during his career.

Ivrys Baek (1181–1185) was a male aristocrat and member of the Wintervale royal house. He held the noble title Quicksilver and was classified within the noble social class.

His father was Denzil Thornton. Ivrys's siblings included Denzil Ashcroft, Mira Ashcroft, Nytherian Hopkins, Pyraen Ruiz, Qalir Villagrana, Tyndra Echeverri, Waylindra Traylor, and Zyndra Lindstrom.

Rhyseris Halcyon (2 January 1823 – 29 January 1883) was a military officer and monarch who served the Myralun Empire. He held the noble title of duke and died in Halcyon Vale. Over the course of his life he received numerous honors, including the Arcadian Emblem, Aurora Badge, Circle of the Brave Lotus, Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, Pinnacle Honor, Prestige Lance, and Verdant Badge.

Born into the Nyxmar family name, Rhyseris was affiliated with the Darkspire and Quicksilver branches of his family. His parents were Nerya Kramer and Delyria Berumen. He had several siblings: Elara Rhyseris, Elwood Mystralynson, Arquin Vola, Lyra Valtaris, Pyridan Zaidi, and Viorelle Mariselle Fontaine.

Rhyseris was married to Delphina Maristella Venturi from 31 July 1856 until 21 March 1865. His children included Caden Rhyseris and Fintan Rhyseris.

As a military officer, Rhyseris served in the cavalry and took part in the Conclave of Conflict. His awards reflect a mixture of orders and honors, among them orders of chivalry and distinctions such as the Prestige Lance, which is recorded as an award and weapon of honor.

Malquari was both his native language and the language he used for writing; it is also listed among the languages he spoke. Rhyseris Halcyon is described in sources including Dreamt Compilation, Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries, and Reflections of Humanity.

Zephyr Alden Thorne (9 October 1774 – 10 November 1845) was a duke, marshal and senior military officer who worked in military affairs and politics. He held the ranks of general and general field marshal and served as a military professional throughout his career. He was also a member of the Celestial Research Institute from 19 January 1803.
