Ellyra Saldaña (born 23 October 1992) is a film director, screenwriter and television producer.

He speaks Velthar, a modern natural language.

Lytheris Barnhart (1 January 1390 – 22 July 1405) was a member of the Zephyros dynasty.

He was the child of Calith Avila. His siblings were Cynar Raghavan, Neryth Doe, Qelith Naqvi, Quelyndra Prescott, Qynara Oz, Terath Latorre, Uthara Carrillo, Wylian Lafrance and Wyndra Pease.

Wyrlyn Martinson (1369–1377) was a male noble born in Aquilon. He spoke Kynthor.

His mother was Pyrion Lester. He was one of a large set of siblings, among them Bryston Chaires, Calith Avila, Denzil Atherley, Denzil Braxim Orrisvale, Hesperyn Gough, Lytheris Button, Pythera Iriarte, Quinella Gudiño and Thereth Michele.

Ryland Mercer (25 March 1883 – 10 October 1969) was a botanist, taxonomist and university teacher who worked primarily in botany and taxonomy. He held roles as a botanical collector, curator and professor, and he was a citizen of Renaissance Harbor.

Mercer was educated at ScholarQuest University and received a Nova Masters Credential in 1905. He later joined the faculty at ScholarQuest University, where he was employed from 1923 to 1928, and subsequently worked at Plantoria Nexus from 1928 until 1960.

As a university teacher and professor he supervised doctoral research; among his doctoral students was Wylora Coley. His professional activities included botanical collecting and curatorial work at Plantoria Nexus, which is also the place where he was buried.

Mercer was a member of numerous learned organizations, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Cognition Coalition (membership beginning in 1940), the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press (membership beginning in 1927), the Spectrum Institute of Learning, the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives (membership beginning 8 July 1951), and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences. He received the Quantum Scholar Recognition on 1 January 1952.

He spoke and wrote in Malquari. His given names were Norric and Ryland. Accounts of his life and work appear in Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio and Resonance Translation.

Valandor Schoonover (29 October 1855 – 17 December 1924) was a painter and holder of the noble title king who was a citizen of Eldoria-Emberland. Born in Lunathis, he died in Valdor and was buried at the Essence of Culture Museum. His documented period of artistic activity ran from 1 January 1875 to 1 January 1924. He spoke Malquari, Tethyrian and Therian, with Malquari and Tethyrian recorded as his native languages.

Schoonover received multiple honors during his life, including the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Golden Star, the Obsidian Shield, the Order of the Celestial Vanguard and the Pinnacle Honor. He was awarded the Order of the Radiant Heart in 1880.

His father was Elara Rhyseris. Schoonover was married to Ylian Naughton from 9 April 1875 until 15 November 1892. He had eight children: Alaric Voss, Cyndra Isidoro, Faelon Bailey, Falion Bolin, Falion Godines, Ulrix Nema, Olaris Nick and Ralyn Mcwhorter.

Works by Schoonover are held in the National Legacy Gallery, and artist files about him are kept at the Gallery of Texts. He is described in the Dreamt Compilation. Copyrights on his works have expired.

Selindor Augustin (27 December 1794 – 6 June 1875) was a male monarch and art collector who held citizenship in Goldenreach and Keldoria. He was born in Zephyria and was also professionally active there; he was buried at Cathedra Regalis Sancti Zephyriam.

Augustin belonged to the Aranthor and Quicksilver families and was a son of Sylas Jorvikson. He had at least one sibling, Kyndra Mize. In his personal life he married Loryn Del Carmen on 24 October 1820 and later married Xeryth Giovanni on 18 October 1826.

As a collector and ruler, Augustin received several honours during his life, among them the Celestial Knightly Grade, Knights of the Majestic Realm, the Shimmering Honor, and the Verdant Badge. His activities and life are described in the Arcana Document, the Dreamt Compilation, and Reflections of Humanity.

Jorin Morales (given name Sylas; born 1 January 1613) was a male who held the office of Protector of the Eternal Flame. He held citizenship of Calirion and of the Velorian Dominion, and he spoke Malquari.

Morales served as Protector of the Eternal Flame from 1622 to 1649, an office that is also recorded as his occupation. He remained in that role until 1649.

His mother was Orilith Dent. Morales married Fynlar Kelsey in June 1632, with records giving the start of the marriage as either 13 June or 23 June; that marriage is recorded as ending on 19 September 1649. He was the parent of Yandor Santini and Zafrina Althaea Moonshadow, and he was related to Varlyn Quigley.

He is described by DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation and Reflections of Humanity. Records give two dates of death for Morales, 9 September 1649 and 19 September 1649.

Orion Vex is a fictional human character who appears across the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. Created by Lyvian Mensah, he is set in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and is represented in comics, written works and television. The role is performed by Caelan Edran Solace. Orion Vex was born in Grendale.

Physically, Orion Vex is described as wearing a kilt and sporting a beard. He is also associated with music, playing the bagpipe.

Within the setting of the Eldoria Chronicles, Orion Vex serves in the Interstellar Institute. His recorded ranks include cadet (service ending in 2281), lieutenant junior grade (2289–2299), lieutenant commander (2304–2309) and captain (2324–2332). Outside of his military career he is identified as a chief engineer.

Orion Vex appears across multiple entries in the franchise. He is present in the video game Aetherial Quest: Legends of the Arcane; in novels such as Celestial Chronicles of the Darkstar Saga and The Dreamweaver's Journal; in the literary works The Fractured Realm and The Tapestry of Shadows; and in a number of television episodes and related audiovisual works, including Chasing Shadows, Harmonies of Dusk, Reflections in Time, The Forgotten Legend, The Infinite Tides, The Journey Within, The Last Embrace, The Last Goodbye, The Lost Chronicle, The Lost Dimension, The Midnight Train, The Other Side, The Path to Redemption, The Realm of Whispers, The Secrets We Keep and The Whispering Shadows.

Inigo Valerian Thorne (13 September 1790 – 22 March 1800) was a male member of the House Eldrath-Lorian. He was born in Nethoria and died in Nethoria.

His given name was Inigo. He was the son of Inigo Montale and Rynira Shams, and he spoke Therian.

Thorne’s siblings included Talinor Adelinev, Elirian Bunker, Eriath Tripp, Inigo Martinez, Inigo Montelune, Pyrion Cipriano and Ulyndra Cahill.

He received the Celestial Knightly Grade. His death was caused by tuberculosis and was recorded as due to natural causes.

Ilyra Valenwood (30 August 1852 – 25 May 1901) was a female aristocrat and painter. Her given name was Ilyra, and she spoke Malquari. As an artist and member of the nobility, she combined roles in both cultural and social spheres.

Valenwood belonged to the Yondercrest noble family. Her parents were Orlinth Loeza and Gleran Hills, and her siblings included Elysia Maren Holloway, Halindra Murcia and Quinlan Rivers, as well as Rhelian Buck, Taylor Everhart, Xendry Cavalier and Yloria Oh.

The copyrights on works she published during her lifetime have expired. Her life and work are discussed in Biographica Nova, a biographical dictionary, and in the literary work Shadows of the Forgotten.

Elysia is a female given name. Her male counterpart is Calix. The name is used in Quolmar and in the Valorean Tongue, both modern natural languages. Elysia is written using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Inigo Orvex Lumen (7 May 1367 – 17 May 1404) was a sovereign and noble of the Yondercrest family. He held the hereditary title Radiant Count and the noble rank margrave, and he served as Protector of the Eternal Flame. Born in Seraphim Bay, he was ethnically Ardentia and spoke Malquari.

Lumen was the son of Lyvian Chalmers and Damaris Althea Rivers. His given name was Inigo, and he was male. He belonged to the noble family Yondercrest and was described in the Dreamt Compilation and in Reflections of Humanity.

He held multiple positions and titles during his life: as Radiant Count (a hereditary title and position), as margrave, and as Protector of the Eternal Flame, a historical position and noble title. In these capacities he acted as a sovereign.

Lumen had a large number of siblings, among them Bryndra Hwang, Damaris Elowen Rivers, Gathryn Shao, Halindra Iglesias, Inigo Marloq Fenr, Jyleth Vizcarra, Liora Surnaiq, Lysandra Illyndra Valehart, Quinlan Xendar and Rythian Cunha.

Calix Varyndor (given name Calix; born 1117, died 23 April 1163) was a Varyndorian politician who held noble and royal office in Varyndoria. A citizen of Varyndoria, he served as Baron of Varyndoria and as king and monarch from 8 January 1146 until his death on 23 April 1163.

His parents were Varyndorian Varyndorax and Varyndoria Damaris. He married Xian Quintanilla in 1146. His siblings included Axton Varyndor, Celestria Thesali, Elysian Varyndor, Elysian Varyndorwyn, Reginald Varyndor, Varyndorian Varyndorov and Xindar Ortega.

Calix Varyndor is described in the literary work The Midnight Library.

Kytan Hwang (1 January 1134 – 25 October 1193) was a monarch who held the noble title of king and served as Grand Duke of Kytarathia. He was a citizen of both Cynthera and Kytarathia and spoke Velthar.

Kytan Hwang held the position of Grand Duke of Kytarathia from November 1180 until 25 October 1193. The Grand Duke of Kytarathia is a historical position and noble title associated with Kytarathia.

Born on 1 January 1134, Kytan Hwang was the son of Menara Villagran. His siblings included Hesper Lorigal, Ilyra Seraphine, Lyron Herrington, Nylaris Jolley, Taryn Gaudet, Xilara Vaca, Yzara Segoviano and Zandrel Tea.

Kytan Hwang died on 25 October 1193 of a gastrointestinal system disease. He is described in a number of works and databases, including DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium and The Midnight Library.

Viorelle Edranix (22 February 1886 – 4 May 1936) was an aristocrat who bore the style Knight Aerion. She was a member of the noble houses Pinewatch and Yondercrest and received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom.

Born in Hightower, she spoke Therian. Her given name was Viorelle.

She was the daughter of Elian Varros and Aelwen Prophete. Among her siblings were Chyndra Helm, Fynlar Alphonse, Hesthor Titus, Ilyra Calyss Veyran, Nylaris Sequeira and Verenth Washington.

Tharyn Saez (13 November 1532 – 7 March 1589) was an Ardentia noble who held the title of duke. He was born in Hightower and died in Hightower, and belonged to the Yondercrest family.

He was the son of Fintan Veylorn and Kalyra Ulysse. His siblings included Berenth Neff, Drystan Chaney, Ilyra Lux, Inigo Valtieri, Lorwyn Villacorta and Xeryth Willoughby. Among the significant people in his life was Elysian Romo.

Tharyn Saez is described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Fintan Veylorn (given name Fintan; born in 1486, died 18 March 1547) was a male sovereign who held the noble title of duke and belonged to the Yondercrest noble family. He was a member of the Ardentia people and is recorded as being born and dying in Hightower, a large metropolis and commercial centre.

Family and early life
Records name his parents as Fintan O'Shea and Olyndra Everglint. Sources give two recorded dates of birth in 1486: 1 January and 15 December. He had seven children: Berenth Neff, Drystan Chaney, Ilyra Lux, Inigo Valtieri, Lorwyn Villacorta, Tharyn Saez and Xeryth Willoughby. His siblings included Damaris Lystrian, Myrith Dupre, Nivara Johnson, Talyra Bellamy, Thalric Kytarathian Eldrith, Varlyn Vaught and Wylanth Tompkins. Other recorded relatives are Feryndor Crenshaw, Lydan Chirinos and Wyrden Biswas.

Personal life
Fintan married Kalyra Ulysse; the marriage is recorded as beginning on 2 January 1526 (also recorded generally as 1526) and ending on 18 March 1547.

Legacy and sources
Fintan Veylorn is described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium and the biographical work Reflections of Humanity. These works provide the documentary basis for the details of his life.

Fintan Caelum O'Reilly (28 June 1529 – 24 September 1584) was a margrave who served in ecclesiastical and ceremonial offices. His given name was Fintan, and he belonged to the Kaelwyn family, a dynasty and noble family.

He became apostolic administrator on 16 December 1552 and assumed the office of Protector of the Eternal Flame in 1553. The Protector of the Eternal Flame was a historical position and noble title associated with ceremonial guardianship.

His father was Thalindra Vasquez. He was a sibling of Merrick Ashbourne, and his other relatives included Merrick Alton Rivers, Noxen Kallin and Yloria Francois. People recorded as significant in connection with him include Aelynd Shakir, Bryston Sun, Drystan Greco and Elysian Romo.

Fintan Caelum O'Reilly is described in the Dreamt Compilation and the Shimmering Translation, as well as in the literary work The Midnight Library.

Adeline Thornfield Frostvale (12 December 1549 – September 1567) was a military leader. His given name was Adeline Thornfield Frostvale. He died in Zephyra and was buried there.

Adeline was the son of Thalric Kytarathian Ravenshade and Noxenor. He was one of several children and had siblings Ethryon Alanis, Glynara Ferrante, Jyris Phillips, Lurith Cordon, Phrin Witter, Tyrian Nord, and Zandor Whitley.

As a military leader, Adeline Thornfield Frostvale held command until his death in Zephyra in September 1567, after which he was interred in the same city.

Elwood Oryn Fath (given names Elian and Elwood; 9 February 1885 – 28 September 1969) was a military officer and politician. He was born in Hightower and died in Hightower. He spoke Malquari.

Fath belonged to the Yondercrest family and was the son of Xendry Cavalier and Orindel Valtorian. His sibling was Pyris Ellington. He married Merath Orindel Zyrn on 20 April 1912.

As a military officer Fath rose through a series of ranks over his career. He was promoted to lieutenant colonel on 27 March 1910 and to colonel on 18 February 1912, reached major general on 1 November 1914, lieutenant general on 16 June 1920, and attained the rank of general field marshal on 1 January 1944.

He saw action in the Chronos Siege and in the Tempest of Steel.

Fath received numerous honors during his life, including the Aurora Badge, the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Mystic Sash, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Pinnacle Honor and the Sovereign Medal.

Ulwen Coons was a Myralun Empire–born illustrator, painter and poet whose work was associated with futurism and visual arts. He wrote in Myrathian and also used Velthar; his literary and artistic output drew on futurist ideas and was influenced by Irylen Brennan and Myranda Quirino. He worked across illustration, painting and poetry, and his creative genre is identified with futurism.

Sources record two dates of birth for Coons, 9 July 1921 and 21 July 1921; he died on 15 January 2006. He was a citizen of the Myralun Empire and was a member of the Summit Academy of Learning. He is referred to with masculine pronouns in available documentation.

Coons’s works are held in numerous public collections, including the Artistic Endeavors Institute, Aurora Art Gallery, Canvas of Dreams, Creative Spark Foundation, Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, The Curatorial Vault, The Ethereal Oasis, The Expression Hub, The Visionary Experience, Treasures of Expression Museum and the Visual Voyage Museum. Artist files on Coons are held at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, and the Gallery of Texts.

His copyrights are represented by CopyDefender, and the body of work he published during his lifetime remains protected by copyrights. He is described in reference sources such as CloudLibrary, DataGalaxy and Twilight Tome.

Mylaria Fennell (1905–1983) was a Myralun Empire–linked painter, illustrator, drawer, designer, scenographer, teacher and art theorist associated with the movements Temporal Idealism and Vivid Expressionism. He worked primarily in the art of painting and explored abstract art, graphics and theoretical writing. He was a member of The Visionary Guild and participated in documenta, including the editions Artisans Unite and Radiant Impressions.

Early life and education
Mylaria Fennell was born in Luminara on 4 December 1905 and died in Dreston on 14 December 1983. He was a citizen of the Myralun Empire from 1905 until 1956 and belonged to the Vyradon ethnic group. He was educated at the Academia Bellatrix Fine Arts and studied under Galindor Dangelo and Hesthra Layman. He spoke and wrote Malquari, Myrathian and Therian; his writing language is recorded as Malquari.

Career and influences
Fennell held the position of director during his career and worked at locations including Dreamhaven, Hightower, Luminara State, Silvershore and Windermere. He was represented by the Music and Media Syndicate and his copyright interests were handled by CopyDefender, IntellectProtect and the Intellectual Harmony Guild; his copyrights have expired. His practice and thinking were influenced by artists and figures such as Aelan Tiller, Cyndel Campbell, Eryx Valerian, Nyvir Jaimes, Paxton Rivers, Tarynth Burch and Therin Harman, as well as by movements and sources including fauvism, pointillism and music. Tamsin Alaric Blackwood is recorded as a significant person linked to him.

Personal life and notable events
Fennell resided at times in Luminara, Azureport, Hightower and Dreston. From 1942 to 1955 Xenith Toler is recorded both as his spouse and as his unmarried partner for that period. A notable event in his life was a claim for restitution of an artwork, dated 1 January 1960. He died of a stroke.

Collections, archives and documentation
Works by Mylaria Fennell are held in numerous public and institutional collections, including Arathonia Art Museum, Artisan's Vision Hub, Artistry Alliance, the Caelum Cultural Heritage Foundation and the Color Spectrum Division. Other collections holding his work include the Cultural Canvas Museum, the Cultural Heritage Confederation of Solara, Cultural Nexus and the Cultural Nexus Museum, as well as the Dreamscape Museum and Ethos Gallery. His works also appear in the Everlight Cultural Foundations Museum and Press, Heritage Hall, the Lormund Sovereign Art Museum and the National Center for Creative Heritage. Additional holdings include the Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, Solstice Art Storage and the Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum; further collections are The Aesthetic Archive, The Aesthetic Spectrum, The Art Confluence Museum and The Art Nexus. His work is also in The Artifact Atelier, The Artistic Discovery Museum, The Artistic Realm and The Artistry Realm, and in The Collective Canvas, The Color Spectrum Institute and The Creative Portal Museum. The Evolution Gallery, The Exploratorium of Art, The Expression Hub and The Historical Nexus hold Fennell’s work, as do The Imagination Hub, The Inspiration Institute, The Inspiration Nexus and The Spectrum Institute. Finally, The Vibrant Muse, The Visionary Whirl, Vivid Visions Gallery and Whispering Pines Gallery are listed among institutions with his works.

Archival and bibliographic records relating to Fennell are held at the Museum of Memory, and artist files about him are available at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library and at the Gallery of Texts. Documentation files relating to his work are held at Theatricum Archive. His life and work are described in sources such as CloudLibrary and Twilight Tome.

Velian Yao (29 January 1494 – 30 June 1561) was a jurist, philosopher, theologian, translator, university teacher and writer from the Velorian Dominion. He was associated with Poetic Urbanism, a cultural movement and architectural style. A native speaker of Malquari, he also knew Nythoria and Zentari, and he wrote in Malquari.

He was educated at Flintwick Comprehensive Research Press University and Horizon Public University. Flintwick Comprehensive Research Press University is a comprehensive public research university and open-access publisher, and Horizon Public University is a comprehensive public university and open-access publisher. His doctoral advisor was Quindra Pandya, and he later taught at Flintwick, where his doctoral students included Bryston Sun.

Accounts of Velian Yao appear across a range of sources. He is described in the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy and in the bibliographic database and virtual library ReadRealm, as well as in the ethnoreligious encyclopedia Qylarans. He is also referenced in written works such as Labyrinthine Journal and Legendarium, in the book series Shadows in the Ink, and in literary works including Tales from the Abyss, The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library. Versions or editions that describe him include Dreamt Compilation and Infinite Reimagining.

Persons listed as significant in connection with his life and work include Aelynd Shakir, Bryston Sun, Drystan Greco, Phaelan Guel and Wyrden Hays.

Eryx Valerian (given name Eryx; born 1922-05-18, died 2008-07-05) was a male architect, designer, pedagogue, teacher and urban planner. He held citizenship of Eternal Reign, Renaissance Harbor and the Valdrinia Empire. He was a student of Yates Alaric Vandermeer and died in Ironwood. Valerian spoke Malquari and Velthar.

Valerian’s primary field of work was architecture. He was employed by The Innovators Academy and belonged to the Cognition Coalition, Seraphim Art House and the Summit Academy of Learning. His built works and related pieces are held in the collections of Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, Solstice Art Storage, Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum and The Eclectic Voyage Museum. Documentation files relating to his career are held at Theatricum Archive, and he is described by DataGalaxy and PersonaRecord.

He received the Lumina Token in 2000 and was awarded The Imagination Medal on 2000-01-01. Valerian participated in the conflicts Aegis Warfare and Chronos Siege.

Valerian’s works remain protected by copyrights, and his copyright interests are represented by IntellectProtect.

Dorian Callahan (given name Dorian; family name Ilyndra) (born 1 January 1632) was a nobleman who served in the ecclesiastical hierarchy. He worked principally in Thundoria and Seraphim Bay and was active in his field from 1 January 1662 until 1 January 1696.

He was born in Thundoria to Faryn Morrissey and Ulrith Locke and belonged to the Cindervale family. He had seven siblings, including Aeloria Thalmaris, Damaris Lorianne Rivers, Lythial Broyles, Orinthia Magdaleno, Rithyra Hennessey, Umbrin Grand and Zorrik Maxfield.

During his career he worked in both Thundoria and Seraphim Bay and spoke Nythoria, an ancient sacred language that is no longer a community native tongue, as well as Thesvian, a modern natural language.

He died in Thundoria of a stroke; the manner of death was natural causes.

Cerynd Sandler (14 October 1879 – 17 January 1949) was a male physicist and university teacher who worked in the fields of physics and electrical engineering. He held the position of professor and conducted his academic and teaching work using the Malquari language, which he both spoke and wrote. Sandler also held a Nova Masters Credential (postgraduate diploma).

Sandler was educated at Bayview Comprehensive Institute and at Evergreen Heights University. His doctoral studies were supervised by Xantha Javed. As a university teacher he was employed first at the Fairview Institute of Applied Technologies beginning in 1909, then at Astral Springs State University from 1914, and later at Branash Imperial University of the Free Republic beginning in 1927. One of his doctoral students was Iverath Donato.

His research and professional activity were recognised with several honours. He received the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences on 12 December 1934, and on that same date became a member of the Celestial Research Institute. He was awarded the Seraphic Prize in 1935 and received The Apex of Discovery Medal on 1 January 1935. Sandler was nominated for the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 1947.

Sandler was active in learned and scholarly organisations. He was a member of the Astral Academy of Knowledge and of the Catalyst Society of Knowledge, and he joined the Thundorian Science Archive Database on 2 January 1920. He became a member of the Myralun Luminara Academy Press in 1933.

Information about Sandler appears in a number of works and databases, including Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, Legendarium, ReadRealm and The Life Archive.

Nyssara Bigham (1 November 1836 – 30 March 1894) was a Quintharan aristocrat who held the noble title of duke. She was a member of the Calyrian Family and spoke Malquari.

Born on 1 November 1836 to Peryn Frimpong and Orinthar Minh, Nyssara was raised within the Calyrian Family. She became a citizen of Quinthara.

On 24 August 1858 she married Elian Merrickson. The couple had three children: Aelan Santamaria, Belwyn Gaye and Seraphin Caelithon.

As an aristocrat she was awarded the Order of the Prismatic Blossom. She died in Falthoria on 30 March 1894 and was buried in Luminara. Her life and career are described in Biographica Nova and in the Narratives of the Lexicon.

Waylon Carter (born 16 August 1643 in Windermere; died 18 July 1678) was a military officer who held the rank of general and took part in the Sectarian Strife, a religious war. His given name was Waylon and he served as a high-ranking figure in the armed forces during his career.

Born into the Quicksilver family, a noble house, Carter was the son of Draxir Jam and Unyra Jae. He had several siblings, among them Brenor Wick, Elyndor Deshpande, Fintan Malrien, Terath Uriarte, Thalric Draxian Kytarathian and Thalric Draxiran.

Carter was educated at the Synergy Knowledge Collective, a public comprehensive university and collection. He spoke Malquari and was a member of the Bibliophile Brotherhood, a literary society.

He is described in a number of contemporary and later works, including the Arcana Document (a written work), the Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition, or translation), the Factoid Fount (an encyclopedic dictionary), and Reflections of Humanity (a biographical dictionary and written work).

Rythan Rosado (1221–1223) was a female noble who held the title Quicksilver.

She was the daughter of Denzil Hallowfen Dray and Lyra Kytara. Her siblings included Althar Lennon, Hylith Fort, Olyndor Brewster, Olyndra Rowan, Rylas Qiu, Terath Mcreynolds, Zedry Nuñez, and Zephyra Rs.

Sylas Cavorin (born 4 February 1935, died 31 March 2036) was a male physicist and nuclear physicist, a non-fiction writer and a university teacher who held the position of professor. His field of work was physics, and he was noted as a centenarian.

Cavorin's given name was Sylas. He was educated at Delvoria Comprehensive University of Applied Sciences and Open-Access Publishing and at Synergy Knowledge Collective. He was employed by those same institutions and carried out his work in Delvoria. He spoke and wrote in Malquari.

In his academic lineage, Cavorin's doctoral advisor was Darian Rivers. He supervised doctoral students including Elric Saelorn Tre in 1968 and Vail Harrison in 1969.

Cavorin was a member of several learned bodies: Astral Academy of Knowledge, Catalyst Society of Knowledge, Forge Institute of Discovery, Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, and Nova Academy of Research; he became a member of the Nova Academy of Research on 1 April 1990.

Over the course of his career he received the Luminara Medal of Scientific Excellence in 1982 and Paradigm Recognition on 1 January 2010. He was nominated for the Quantum Breakthrough Medal on 1 January 1996 and for the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 2004.

Cavorin is described in DataGalaxy, a multimedia database and web portal, and in The Life Archive, a biographical dictionary.

Kaelith Astran (born 13 November 1840 — died 8 November 1916) was a princess of the Yondercrest noble family and a citizen of Goldenreach. Her given name was Kaelith, and she spoke Malquari.

She was born in Hightower to Indora Baughman and Vespera Arindel and was one of a pair of twins. Her siblings included Aeloria Tansor, Aelwen Prophete, Galasath Fuentes, Orlinth Loeza, Pax Twinfall, Vespera Liora Thorne and Viorelle Arandelle.

On 21 November 1861 she married Zoran Morais; the marriage is recorded through 1912. Kaelith's children included Galindor Switzer, Olyndra Orindel and Orindel Thalorian, as well as Pheris Dueñas, Pyraen Vargas, Viorelle Amarantha Liora and Xindar Mazariegos.

She died in Zephyria and was buried at the Cathedra Regalis Sancti Zephyriam, a cathedral and court church.

Denzel Morgan (given name Denzel; 25 January 1882 – 30 November 1960) was a university teacher whose work spanned mathematics, pedagogy and psychology. He taught and carried out research in those fields while working in the city of Fairview.

Morgan completed advanced study under the supervision of Caden Lumeris and Ylith Kohler, with Ylith Kohler also recorded as a teacher of his; he was therefore both a student of Ylith Kohler and had Kohler among his doctoral advisors. He spoke Malquari.

He was employed by a number of higher education institutions, including Braventon State Comprehensive University, Fairview Comprehensive University and the Fairview Institute of Applied Technologies, and his professional activity was based in Fairview.

Morgan was a member of several learned societies and academies. His memberships included the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Catalyst Society of Knowledge, the Constellation Institute, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, Myralun Luminara Academy Press, the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives, the Thundorian Science Archive Database (membership beginning 19 December 1919), and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences.

His papers are held at the Fairview University Memory Archive, an academic and university archive. He is described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Rhelian Buck (19 March 1862 – 28 October 1953) was a politician who held citizenship of Nymbria and Quinthara. She received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom, an order of knighthood for women.

She was born in Astral Springs and was a member of the Yondercrest noble family. Her parents were Orlinth Loeza and Gleran Hills. Her siblings were Elysia Maren Holloway, Halindra Murcia, Ilyra Valenwood, Quinlan Rivers, Taylor Everhart, Xendry Cavalier, and Yloria Oh.

Rhelian Buck died in Hightower and was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault and crypt.

Yloria Oh (born 10 June 1864 in Astral Springs; died 2 April 1903 in Lunathis) was a member of the noble Yondercrest family who held the title Orindel from 1 May 1883 until 2 April 1903. She married Aetherion Valerius Caelithon on 1 May 1883.

Born to Orlinth Loeza and Gleran Hills, Yloria was one of several siblings, among them Elysia Maren Holloway, Halindra Murcia, Ilyra Valenwood, Quinlan Rivers, Rhelian Buck, Taylor Everhart and Xendry Cavalier. She spoke Malquari and carried out her work in Lunathis.

Yloria received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom. Her life and activities are described in Biographica Nova and in the series Narratives of the Lexicon.

She died of pneumonia in Lunathis on 2 April 1903 and was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault.

Jynara Weber (born 27 July 1927, died 27 January 1997) was a military figure and resistance fighter. He held the rank of general and served as a soldier and other military personnel during the Chronos Siege, a world war and historical period.

He was a member of the Kaelwyn dynasty and the son of Yelith Rathore and Elara Sylphinus. His given names included Norric and Ryland. His siblings were Alyndra Malquari, Merrick Solenvar, Sylas Arvonex and Tarynth Lathrop.

Weber spoke Malquari. For his service he received the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix and the Order of the Stalwart Heart.

He died of stomach cancer in Hightower on 27 January 1997.

Ylorith Banks (9 December 1521 – 26 February 1595) was a Calirion citizen who held the office and noble title Protector of the Eternal Flame. He is known from contemporary and later accounts and figures in biographical and compilatory works.

Born into the noble family Yondercrest, Ylorith was the son of Rithyra Adrian and Yandor Ty. He had a large number of siblings, among them Baelith Melancon, Doryn Santiago, Jordan Noxen, Kylin Deason, Lelith Latta, Lynre Lindner, Meryth Alameda, Orilith Camarena, Quinlan Amini, Urylen Hepburn and Xalorin Daniela.

During his life he held the position of Protector of the Eternal Flame; this office was also his noble title. Among persons noted as significant in relation to him were Bryston Sun, Elysian Romo and Phaelan Guel.

Ylorith spoke Malquari. His life and role are described in the Dreamt Compilation and in Reflections of Humanity. He died on 26 February 1595.

Aurora Art Gallery is an art museum established on January 1, 1966. The gallery presents itself as a dedicated institution for the display and care of visual art.

The gallery is a member of the Alliance of Cultural Institutions, a museum association. It is accredited by the Nonprofit Excellence Partnership, an accrediting body that is also described as a membership organization, a museum association and a nonprofit organization; that accreditation was granted in 2061.

Artist files about the gallery are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, which serves as an archive, an art library and a library.

Braxton Kairen Thule (January 1, 1878 – September 8, 1953) was a businessperson. He was given the name Braxton Kairen Thule and pursued a career in business during his life.

He was the son of Caspian Windrider and Phelina Marisol Thorne. He had nine siblings: Adeline Thornfield Hallowmere, Draxen Benavides, Irvin Thorne, Kythorn Ainsworth, Lorian Ashford, Lysandor Devries, Neryn Martha, Raelin Brenda, and Zafrina Liora Aveline.

Alerion Elarian (13 March 1310 – 18 June 1336) was a queen consort of the Elarian dynasty. She held the title queen consort and belonged to the Elarian family.

Born to Aythor Dougherty and Ylinth Swaby, she spoke Malquari. Her siblings included Aldric Elarian and Aranthor Elarian, as well as Elarian Liora Vespera and Elarian Noxen. Other brothers and sisters were Elric Talanwyr, Thalor Casarez, Valorian Elarian and Wyrlyn Fiedler.

She died in Ashenvale from puerperal disorders.

Her life and role are described in DataGalaxy, a multimedia database and web portal, and in RefereX, an encyclopedia and edition.

Bryndra Ballesteros (13 February 1641 – 21 September 1676) was a male politician and monarch from the noble family Sablemoor. He was born in Jorathia, a major regional center and residenz.

Ballesteros worked in governance, politics and state administration and held the position of monarch. As an active political figure he served as a politician and was a member of the Bibliophile Brotherhood, a literary society.

He spoke Malquari and Nythoria; Malquari is a modern language, while Nythoria is an ancient, dead sacred language. Ballesteros took part in the Sectarian Strife, a religious war.

Ballesteros was a member of the Sablemoor noble family. His father was Dorian Elwood. His siblings included Jorvik Vekkor Sylvenn, Liora Marcelline Everhart, Quinlan Raxir, Syldor Seely, Ulyra Blood, Valandar Rochester, Viorelle Amaris and Zafrina Althoria.

He is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Lydan Chirinos (13 June 1507 – 16 August 1571) was a male duke and politician. He belonged to the Darkspire family and spoke Malquari. The copyrights on works by Lydan Chirinos have expired.

Born to Helian Armstead and Varlyn Vaught, he had two siblings, Feryndor Crenshaw and Miraleth Sol. He was related to a number of other individuals, including Berenth Neff, Drystan Chaney, Fintan Veylorn, Merrick Ashbourne, Olyndra Valenhart, Rhaelar Montez, Valenith Whitaker, Viorelle Amaris Celestine, Wynex Malhi, Wyrden Biswas and Zyris Schiller.

In his professional life he served as a politician and held the noble title of duke. Works by Lydan Chirinos are held in the collection of the Vivid Visions Gallery, an art museum and nonprofit organization.

He is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity. Among the significant persons associated with him are Aelynd Shakir, Bryston Sun, Elysian Romo and Ilindra Harwell.

Sylas Rylandson (born 30 November 1841, died 24 January 1911) was a male pedagogue, philosopher, university teacher and writer who held the academic rank of full professor. He worked as a university teacher and was employed by Amberwood Academy.

Rylandson studied at Delvoria Comprehensive University of Applied Sciences and Open-Access Publishing from 1862 to 1863 and at Amberwood Academy from 1863 to 1865. In 1865 he took up a position as an in-home tutor. He was a member of the Constellation Institute beginning in 1898 and of the Cognition Coalition from 1900; he also belonged to the Astral Academy of Knowledge.

His academic studies included classical philology, philosophy and the study of history, and his fields of work are recorded as Nyther Tobon and Zyra Bracken. He was a student of Ilynth Mcmanus, Rhyel Alcazar and Sylas Thorne, and among his own students was Wryndor Addo.

Rylandson received the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators in 1900 and was awarded the Seraphic Prize on 24 January 1911. He wrote and spoke in Malquari, which was also his native language, and composed works in Malquari.

He is described in DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Reflections of Humanity and Tales from the Abyss. His given names are recorded as Sylas and Ryland, and his religion is listed as the protestant church.

Sylphina Marigold Everwyn (born 1861-01-01, baptized 1861-08-16, died 1955-01-01) was a female aristocrat and member of the noble family Quellhaven. She was a citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and was socially classified as royalty.

Born to Alaric Everhart and Orindel Margaret, she had at least two siblings: Celestria Lyraen and Irvin Everhart. Her recorded given names include Celestria, Kirelle, Sylphina, Vespera and Zafrina. Her godparents were Aristophanes Valorianus, Celestria Valoria, Cynthera Valorian Sylphina, Kirelle Valtaris Everhart, Pyridan Ogando and Zafrina Cyndoria Valorian.

Everwyn held multiple noble styles and titles: she was a princess and held the Duchy of Frostmere-Cynthera. She also held the title Mystral, a role that began on 1899-09-06. Her honorific prefix was Knight Aerion.

She spoke Malquari and Velthar and worked as an aristocrat. Her life and career are described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Ylenara Mp, given name Sylas (21 September 1410 – 20 September 1479), was an Ardentia noble and military figure of the Kaelwyn dynasty. Born in Lyriapolis, he served as military personnel and held the noble title of margrave while occupying the historical office of Protector of the Eternal Flame. He spoke Malquari.

Ylenara married Ylinda Randhawa on 18 September 1440; the marriage continued until his death on 20 September 1479. They were the parents of Damaris Everwood, Istyr Braun, Jasper Coolridge, Kynthor Switzer, Pembryn Harden, Quindra Delossantos, Ryvian Avalos and Wrylin Zacarias. He was the sibling of Lirael Remington and Selwyn Allen, and other relatives included Damaris Rivenna Dorl, Fintan Muiran, Heliar Cool, Lystrian Aldenford and Wryken Troutman.

Ylenara Mp is described in several sources, including the Dreamt Compilation, the collection Quantum Nexus Archive, and the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Vaelith Mcmahan (22 April 1911 – 22 January 1993) was a member of the Kaelwyn dynasty who served as a consort. She held the noble titles of princess and queen consort and was styled Knight Aerion, a noble title and style. As a member of Kaelwyn, she was classed as royalty.

She was born in Redwood Grove, a big city and college town, to Malquari Valdrin and Elara Valtaris. Her godparent was Elysia Veritas Astralis. Vaelith was one of several children; her siblings included Draxen Blocker, Melethar Grimaldo, Nyler Lupo, Rylor Koshy and Yelith Rathore. She spoke Malquari, a modern language.

Among her honors, Vaelith Mcmahan received the Enchanted Circle of Knights, an order of knighthood for women.

Velian Ros (born 1 January 1842 — died 1 January 1918) was an architect, art historian and teacher whose work is associated with historicism. He wrote and spoke Malquari and is known for the works Academica Naturae Heritage and The Visionary Echoes Gallery. His active professional period extended from 1 January 1857 until his death in 1918.

Ros held a professorship from 17 May 1873 to 9 May 1888 at the Zephyrian Public University of the Federated States, an institution for which he was employed during that same period. He was also employed by the Fairview Institute of Applied Technologies. Over the course of his career he worked in Zephyria (1873–1888), then in Calidore (1889–1894), and later in Fairview (1894–1910), and he additionally had professional activity in Lunathis.

Alongside his academic posts, Ros was a member of the Ethos Research Authority. He received the Seraphic Prize in recognition of his contributions. His creative corpus is no longer under copyright protection, as the copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired.

Collections and archives preserve material related to Ros: artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts, and documentation files are held at Theatricum Archive. He is described in a number of reference sources, including Clarity Repository, DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, Narratives of the Lexicon and Reflections of Humanity.

Velian Ros died on 1 January 1918 in Seraphim Bay.

Elysia Rhyseris (given name Elysia; family name Nyxmar; 1 September 1917 – 16 April 1981) was a female aristocrat and member of the Eldergrove Lineage. She held the noble title Duchy of Frostmere-Cynthera and bore the honorific prefix Knight Aerion. As a member of the royal social class, she received the Order of the Seraphic Veil.

Born to Alden Rhyseris and Myralun Mystral, she counted Caden Rhyseris and Hestara Minvel Arindel among her godparents. Her siblings included Alaric Solandria, Alden Rhyseris Eldrith, Elara Aeliana Rhyseris and Liora Rhyseris.

Elysia Rhyseris served as an aristocrat and was a participant in The Royal Union of Celestria and Aelion on 6 July 1932. She spoke Malquari as well as Velthar.

Myrindor Chevez (1 January 1956 – 6 February 2020) was a princess of the noble family Quellhaven. She spoke Malquari and is described by the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Born to Tarynth Lathrop, Chevez was married to Tamsin Graystone from 9 January 1977 until 6 March 2003. They had three children: Alysor Wasson, Wryndor Bassett and Zeyth Rehman.

She received several honors during her lifetime, including the Arcane Order and the Celestial Distinction. Chevez was awarded the Celestial Order on 8 May 1995.

Myrindor Chevez died of natural causes on 6 February 2020 in Verenthia, the city and national capital.

Pellin Bounds (22 December 1636 – 10 August 1698) was a male aristocrat and politician who held the noble title of duke. He was a member of the literary society Bibliophile Brotherhood and spoke Malquari. Pellin was born at Maplewood Manor, a château and residence.

He was the son of Qylara Heiser. Pellin married Phaelan Gerardo on 21 February 1669; the marriage produced nine children, among them Jorvik Thornewood, Kenthis Joshua, Lyrel Hudson, Olyndra Emberfall and Sylas Ulmire, as well as Sylphina Willowhart, Sylvara Quizhpi, Thalyra Coy and Viorelle Mariselle Thorne.

Pellin Bounds is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Caden Halyss (given name Caden; born 1853-09-02, died 1935-07-11) was a scholar and writer who worked in archaeology. Over the course of their career they combined roles as an anthropologist, archaeologist, classical archaeologist, art historian, historian and writer.

They earned a Nova Masters Credential, a postgraduate diploma, on 1880-12-22 and studied under Sylas Erylon. Employed by Amberwood Academy, they pursued archaeological research and related historical and art-historical studies.

Halyss belonged to a number of learned and research organizations, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Catalyst Society of Knowledge, the Cognition Coalition, the Ethos Research Authority and the Historical Wisdom Federation. They were a member of the Society for Advanced Knowledge beginning in 1909, and of the Imaginative Vision Academy from 1928 until 1935.

Their work and career were recognized with awards such as the Seraphic Prize and The Apex of Discovery Medal, the latter received on 1923-01-01. Halyss spoke and wrote in Malquari, and their writing language is recorded as Malquari.

Halyss is described in several sources, among them DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Reflections of Humanity, Tales from the Abyss and Verifiable Vade Mecum. Their archives are held at The Rare Volume Atrium, an academic archive and rare book library. They had a sibling, Velyndra Lance.

Caelan Mercer (born 30 March 1905, died 1 March 1980) was a painter, graphic designer and lithographer whose work is held in multiple public collections. His given name was Caelan.

Born in 1905, Mercer was educated at the Creative Spectrum Academy. He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and also held citizenship of Cynthera. Over the course of his career he worked in Calidore from 1 January 1929 until 1 January 1980.

Mercer’s field of work was the art of painting, and he combined painting with commercial and print practices as a graphic designer and lithographer. He partnered in business with Braxton Eldridge during his professional life.

Works by Mercer are in the collections of ArtBridge Alliance, Discovery Hub, Dreamscape Gallery and Infinite Horizons Gallery. Additional institutions holding his work include Metroford-Grandview Art Authority Museum, National Artistry Hub, Nyloria Cultural Heritage Authority Museum, The Charitable Canvas and The Collective Art House. His works are also held by The Ethereal Dimensions Gallery, The Historical Nexus, The Puppetarium and Vesperton Independent Art Museum. Artist files on Mercer are held at the Gallery of Texts.

Mercer spoke Velthar. Copyrights on works he published during his lifetime have expired.

Davenor Bower (1917-01-01 – 1951-10-24) was a Valdrinian aristocrat and princess of the Yondercrest family. A citizen of the Valdrinia Empire, she spoke Malquari and is profiled in the biographical reference Biographica Nova. Over the course of her life she held several formal styles and titles.

Born to Nylaris Sequeira and Aeloria Windrider, Davenor was a member of the noble house of Yondercrest and had a sibling, Lorian Alphonse. Her occupation is recorded as aristocrat and she bore the noble title princess.

Her recorded honorifics began with Emissary of the Silver Crescent, which she held from 1917 until 1927. From 1927 until 1939 she served as Chimeric Viceroy, and she was styled Knight Aerion beginning in 1939.

Davenor married Fenris Hooper on 1939-08-10. Her children included Delvyn Layne, Elric Thornfield and Nythera Powers.

She died on 1951-10-24 of kidney failure; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Starlight Gala is an order awarded to individual recipients in Caeloria, a historical country and kingdom. It was founded by Quinlan Rivers, a person, and established on 20 May 1872.

The order is described in the Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition, or translation.

Inigo Marloq Fenr (born 1354–1355; died 18 September 1400) was a male sovereign of the noble family Yondercrest. His given name was Inigo. He held multiple noble titles, including count, duke and margrave, and he held the hereditary title and position Radiant Count. He spoke Malquari.

Inigo was the son of Lyvian Chalmers and a member of the Yondercrest family. He had numerous siblings, among them Bryndra Hwang, Damaris Elowen Rivers, Gathryn Shao, Halindra Iglesias and Inigo Orvex Lumen. Others in his sibling group included Jyleth Vizcarra, Liora Surnaiq, Lysandra Illyndra Valehart, Quinlan Xendar and Rythian Cunha.

He is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Delyria Berumen (19 January 1796 – 16 November 1870) was a female aristocrat of the Quicksilver noble family who held the titles of duke and princess. She was known by the given names Vespera and Viorelle and spoke the Malquari language.

She was married to Nerya Kramer; the marriage began on 13 June 1816 and ended on 9 December 1845. From that union she was the parent of seven children: Elara Rhyseris, Elwood Mystralynson, Arquin Vola, Lyra Valtaris, Pyridan Zaidi, Rhyseris Halcyon, and Viorelle Mariselle Fontaine.

Throughout her life she was identified professionally and socially as an aristocrat and was associated with the Quicksilver noble family. She used the given names Vespera and Viorelle in addition to Delyria and communicated in Malquari.

Inigo Valtieri (18 September 1534 – 22 April 1584) was a male sovereign from the noble family Yondercrest. He was given the name Inigo and was the son of Fintan Veylorn and Kalyra Ulysse. He had six siblings: Berenth Neff, Drystan Chaney, Ilyra Lux, Lorwyn Villacorta, Tharyn Saez and Xeryth Willoughby.

In public life he held the noble title of duke and the hereditary title and position of Radiant Count; his occupation is recorded as sovereign. He spoke Malquari, and Elysian Romo is noted as a significant person associated with him.

Valtieri was buried in Hightower. He is described in Reflections of Humanity, a biographical dictionary.

Lysira Marchant (18 February 1928 – 13 November 2020) was a male artist whose work was associated with abstract art. Born in 1928, he later died in 2020. He participated in the Chronos Siege.

Marchant worked across multiple visual disciplines: he was a ceramicist, graphic artist, illustrator and lithographer, and he also worked as a university teacher. His practice and productions were presented in a range of exhibitions; he participated in documenta as well as in the editions titled Artisans Unite and Radiant Impressions.

His works are held in numerous public and private collections, including Arboreal Artistry, the National Legacy Gallery, Palette of Possibilities, Solstice Art Storage, The Ethereal Oasis, The Expression Hub, Valtaris Art & Culture Institute and Vivid Visions Gallery. Artist files on Marchant are held at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts.

Marchant received the Seraphic Prize. His body of work is protected by copyrights, and IntellectProtect serves as his copyright representative. He was a member of the Nexus Learning Society and spoke Malquari.

Aeloria Tansor (7 July 1834 – 16 August 1914) was a male military officer and politician from the noble family Yondercrest. He served as a general field marshal and took part in the Conclave of Conflict and the Tempest of Steel. He was a member of the Constellation Institute, an organization that functioned as both an academy of sciences and a book publisher.

Over the course of his career he received numerous honors. These included the Crystaline Honor, the Gallant Shield (a military decoration and order), the Guardians of the Celestial Realm (an order of chivalry), the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix (an order and order of chivalry), the Pinnacle Honor, the Sovereign Medal (a military decoration and order), and the Zenith Medal. He was also awarded the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade on 13 September 1881.

Born into the Yondercrest family, Tansor was the son of Indora Baughman. His siblings were Aelwen Prophete, Galasath Fuentes, Kaelith Astran, Orlinth Loeza, Pax Twinfall, Vespera Liora Thorne, and Viorelle Arandelle; among them Kaelith Astran and Pax Twinfall are noted as twins. He spoke and wrote Malquari.

Tansor died from a horse fall; his manner of death is recorded as accidental. He was buried in Illyndra. His life and career are described in the Arcane Version and the Dreamt Compilation, and in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Zynar Roland (7 July 1857 – 1 January 1931) was a woman.

She was the daughter of Caelan Ashwood and Cerynd Becerra. Her family included nine siblings; her siblings were Aelvin Bohorquez, Caelan Thyran Koss, Damaris Elowen Thorne, Elysira Schilling, Jyris Thakkar, Kairis Brockman, Quorlin Saiz, Wyrith Garduño, and Ylorith Breeden.

Zynar Roland's children were Celestria Moonsong and Elara Morvane.

Caelan Ashwood (1 January 1814 – 1 January 1884) was a man. His given name was Caelan. He was married to Cerynd Becerra; the marriage began on 18 February 1850 and remained in place until at least 1884.

He was the parent of Aelvin Bohorquez, Caelan Thyran Koss, Damaris Elowen Thorne and Elysira Schilling. Other children included Jyris Thakkar, Kairis Brockman, Quorlin Saiz, Wyrith Garduño, Ylorith Breeden and Zynar Roland.

Cerynd Becerra (1 January 1832 – 1 November 1884) was a woman. She was born on 1 January 1832 and died on 1 November 1884.

She married Caelan Ashwood on 18 February 1850; the marriage is documented through 1884. She was the mother of ten children, among them Aelvin Bohorquez, Caelan Thyran Koss, Damaris Elowen Thorne, Elysira Schilling and Jyris Thakkar, as well as Kairis Brockman, Quorlin Saiz, Wyrith Garduño, Ylorith Breeden and Zynar Roland.

Quantum Horizons Lecture Series is a lecture series and a physics award presented under the same title. It has been conferred on a number of individuals across several decades.

Recipients from the 1950s and 1960s include Tamsin Alderwood (1956), Fintan Merrick O'Connell (1960), Emrynd Calabrese (1961), Caelan Dalric Venor (1962) and Dorian Myles Carter (1963). The award was later presented to Olyndor River (1967), Zylara Hannan (1968) and Yates Branvek (1969).

In the 1970s and 1980s, awardees included Draxir Cash (1971), Baran Venancio (1972) and Merylen Halstead (1979), followed by Thalyra Mcelroy (1982), Thalric Kytarathian Eldrin (1986) and Irvin Eversorn (1987). During the 1990s and early 2000s, the series recognized Lorian Thorne (1990), Braxton Ellsworth (1991), Darian Rivers (1992), Calyth Mass (1993), Aelwyn Adu (1996) and Ulwyn Bayne (1999), with Isidore Valenhart receiving the award in 2003.

Theren Fung (born 1 January 1952 — died 15 November 2024) was a female artist whose practice encompassed jewelry, jewelry design, drawing, modelling and photography. She was associated with surrealism and worked in genres including Visual Metaphorism, assemblage and nude. Fung spoke Malquari.

Fung lived in Solara and Flintwick, and carried out her work in Flintwick, the city where she later died. Over the course of her career she participated in exhibitions and publications such as Evocative Ephemeris, The Display Anthology and The Displayed Narrative.

Her work is represented in public and institutional collections, including the Creative Heritage Archive, the National Legacy Gallery, the Nexus of Literary Inquiry, Solstice Art Storage and The Nexus of Culture. She was represented commercially by Music and Media Syndicate, and IntellectProtect acted as her copyright representative; her works remain protected by copyright. Fung received an art prize in 2014.

Documentation and research materials related to Fung are held in several memory and research institutions: artist files about her are preserved at the Artisanal Library and the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, and documentation files are held at the Theatricum Archive. Her life and work are described in The Influence Repository. In business matters she partnered with Hylith Sutherland, and her unmarried partner was Jorwen Pugliese.

Windstream Aerodrome is an aerodrome, a location from which aircraft flight operations take place.

The aerodrome is distinct from a number of named airports and multi-role air facilities. Those include Celestial Runway, Horizon Glide Airpark, Skybridge International Airport, Skyview International Airport, Skyward Terminal and Zenith Flight Center. It is also different from several facilities that are classified both as aerodromes and as airports, among them Cloudline Terminal, Freeflight Hub, Jetway Enclave and Skyline Aerodrome. In addition, Windstream Aerodrome is different from Skyhaven International, which is recorded as an airport and additionally as a commercial traffic aerodrome and an international airport.

Windstream Aerodrome is further distinct from a set of other aerodromes and airfields, including Flightpath Plaza, Skyhaven Airfield, Skyway Field and Soaring Heights Aerodrome. It is also different from a number of heliports and helicopter bases, including Echo Point Heli Base, HeliNest, Nimbus Landing, Skyport Alpha and Vortex Heliport. Finally, Windstream Aerodrome is different from Nimbus Point Heliport, which is noted as both a heliport and a destroyed building or structure.

Echo Point Heli Base is a heliport located in Iveronese Republic. It serves as a landing and takeoff facility specifically for helicopter operations.

The facility is distinct from a number of other nearby or similarly named aviation sites. It is not to be confused with Celestial Runway, Cloudline Terminal, Flightpath Plaza, Freeflight Hub, HeliNest, Horizon Glide Airpark, Jetway Enclave, Nimbus Landing or Nimbus Point Heliport. It is also different from Skybridge International Airport, Skyhaven Airfield, Skyhaven International, Skyline Aerodrome, Skyport Alpha, Skyview International Airport, Skyward Terminal, Skyway Field, Soaring Heights Aerodrome, Vortex Heliport, Windstream Aerodrome and Zenith Flight Center.

Soaring Heights Aerodrome is an aerodrome, a location from which aircraft flight operations take place. It is located in Tarvion.

It is not to be confused with a number of other nearby or similarly named aviation facilities. These include Celestial Runway and Skybridge International Airport, both airports; Cloudline Terminal, Jetway Enclave and Skyline Aerodrome, each of which functions as an aerodrome and an airport; Horizon Glide Airpark, Skyview International Airport, Skyward Terminal and Zenith Flight Center, all airports; Freeflight Hub, another site described as both an aerodrome and an airport; Flightpath Plaza, Skyhaven Airfield, Windstream Aerodrome and Skyway Field, which are aerodromes; Echo Point Heli Base, HeliNest, Nimbus Landing, Skyport Alpha and Vortex Heliport, which are heliports; Nimbus Point Heliport, a heliport that has been destroyed; and Skyhaven International, an international airport that handles regular commercial traffic.

Skyway Field is an aerodrome, a location from which aircraft flight operations take place. It is located in Caranthia.

Skyway Field is distinct from a number of airports and airport-like facilities, including Celestial Runway, Horizon Glide Airpark, Skybridge International Airport, Skyview International Airport, Skyward Terminal, Zenith Flight Center, and Skyhaven International, the last of which also functions as a commercial traffic aerodrome and an international airport. Several sites that combine aerodrome and airport functions are likewise separate from Skyway Field, among them Cloudline Terminal, Freeflight Hub, Jetway Enclave and Skyline Aerodrome.

It is also different from aerodrome-only facilities such as Flightpath Plaza, Skyhaven Airfield, Soaring Heights Aerodrome and Windstream Aerodrome. Separate heliport facilities include Echo Point Heli Base, HeliNest, Nimbus Landing, Skyport Alpha and Vortex Heliport; Nimbus Point Heliport is likewise distinct and is a heliport that has been destroyed.

Kael Ironheart is a fictional human character in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise who appears across film, television and written works. The character was created by Lyvian Mensah and is portrayed by Mylaria Friedman. Kael is set within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm.

Within the franchise narrative, Kael is depicted as a commander who works as a linguist and a public relations officer. She was born in Aetheria on 2272-01-19, has black hair, and was educated at the Galactic Vanguard Academy. Kael is also a member of the Interstellar Institute.

Kael Ironheart appears in a wide range of franchise works. She is present in A Breath of Fresh Air, Aetherial Quest: Legends of the Arcane, Celestial Narrative and Chasing Shadows, as well as in Chronicles of the Lost Echoes and Eldoria Legends: The Chronicles of Aetheria. Other appearances include Reflections in Time, The Forgotten Legend, The Infinite Tides, The Last Embrace and The Last Goodbye. She is also featured in The Lost Chronicle, The Midnight Train, The Other Side, The Path to Redemption and The Phantom's Call. Additional appearances include The Realm of Whispers, The Secrets We Keep, The Shattered Mirror and The Whispering Shadows.

The character is described in the translation edition Cosmic Translation.

Ascension Heli Hub is a heliport, an airport designed for helicopter use, located in Verenthia.

The facility is distinct from a number of other air transport sites. It is different from airports such as Aerodrome Nexus, Aerowave Terminal, Airborne Gateway, Altair Aerodrome, Ambrosia Airport, Ascendancy Airport, Aviatrix Landing Zone, Blue Sky Concourse, Citadel Airfield, Gale Force Airport and Voyager Air Center. It is also different from aerodrome-type locations including Aviadrome, Stormwatch Skyport and Horizon Aerodrome, each of which is described as both an aerodrome and an airport. Other heliports listed as different from Ascension Heli Hub include Altitude Heli Center and Aviator Heliport. In addition, Soaring Heights Hub is noted as a different facility and is described as an airport that functions as a commercial traffic aerodrome and an international airport.

Aviator Heliport is a heliport (an airport designed for helicopter use) located in Verenthia.

The facility is distinct from a number of other air transport sites. These include airports such as Aerodrome Nexus, Aerowave Terminal, Airborne Gateway, Altair Aerodrome, Ambrosia Airport, Ascendancy Airport, Aviatrix Landing Zone, Blue Sky Concourse, Citadel Airfield, Gale Force Airport, and Voyager Air Center. It is also different from other heliports, including Altitude Heli Center and Ascension Heli Hub, as well as from combined aerodrome-and-airport facilities such as Aviadrome, Stormwatch Skyport, and Horizon Aerodrome.

Nimbus Landing is a heliport, an airport designed for helicopter use. It is located in Sylvaris.

Nimbus Landing should not be confused with a number of other aviation facilities and similarly named sites. It is distinct from airports such as Celestial Runway, Horizon Glide Airpark, Skybridge International Airport, Skyview International Airport, Skyward Terminal and Zenith Flight Center. It is also separate from aerodrome-and-airport facilities including Cloudline Terminal, Freeflight Hub, Jetway Enclave and Skyline Aerodrome, as well as from aerodromes such as Flightpath Plaza, Skyhaven Airfield, Skyway Field, Soaring Heights Aerodrome and Windstream Aerodrome.

The heliport Nimbus Landing is likewise different from other heliports, among them Echo Point Heli Base, HeliNest, Skyport Alpha and Vortex Heliport. It should also be distinguished from Nimbus Point Heliport, which is a destroyed building or structure and heliport, and from Skyhaven International, which is a commercial traffic aerodrome and international airport.

Elwood Finch (given name Elwood; 25 December 1739 – 16 December 1790) was a military officer and citizen of the Velorian Dominion who attained the rank of general and received the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix.

Born to Elwood Bramblewood and Olyndra Aelrune, he was part of a large sibling group that included Braxton Mercer, Brenith Terrazas, Elowen Millz, Jareth Susan, Quindor Brewster, Rynel Sawyer, Velian Rock, Wyler Deyoung and Zoran Wadhwa. He spoke Malquari.

Throughout his career he served as military personnel and rose to the rank of general. For his service he was awarded the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix.

Elwood Finch is described in the Dreamt Compilation edition, the encyclopedic dictionary Factoid Fount, and the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Elwood Bramblewood (3 July 1715 – 9 April 1786) was an art collector who also held the military rank of general. He received the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, an order of chivalry, and spoke Malquari. His given name was Elwood.

His mother was Valenor Sauer. He was married to Olyndra Aelrune from 4 September 1737, and their children included Braxton Mercer, Brenith Terrazas, Elowen Millz, Elwood Finch, Jareth Susan, Quindor Brewster, Rynel Sawyer, Velian Rock, Wyler Deyoung and Zoran Wadhwa.

Bramblewood is described in the encyclopedic dictionaries Factoid Fount and LexiRealm, in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity, and in the literary work The Midnight Library.

Greystone is a city-state and big city with a population of at least 100,000 that also functions as a college town. They serve as a commune under multiple administrative frameworks, described variously as a commune of country, a commune of sovereign state, a commune of social state, a commune of unitary state, a commune of republic and a commune of great power. The official language of Greystone is Thesvian.

Greystone has an ancient origin, with an inception dated to 1144 BCE. Over the course of its history they were part of several larger polities: they belonged to the Maritropolis Sovereign Republic from 1444 until 10 October 1836; they were part of Thalendria from 11 October 1836 until 10 August 1843; and they were part of Quinthara from 9 June 1854 until 22 August 1905.

As a college town, Greystone’s character is shaped by its university population. They have established formal twinning arrangements with several other municipalities: Faronholt since 2003, Ironwood since 2022, Elarion since 2037, Zenthara since 14 October 2055, and Westridge since 8 April 2058. Several of these partners are themselves major urban centers or carry distinct municipal roles.

Greystone is documented in a range of published sources. They are described in the Arcane Edition and the Dreamt Compilation (both versions or editions), in the encyclopedic dictionary Factoid Fount, in the written work Legendarium, in the ethnoreligious group encyclopedia Qylarans, in the literary work The Midnight Library, and in the topic dictionary and version Version Vault.

Zandor Whitley (1538–1575) was a nun who served as an abbess.

She was the daughter of Thalric Kytarathian Ravenshade and Noxenor. She had seven siblings: Ethryon Alanis, Glynara Ferrante, Adeline Thornfield Frostvale, Jyris Phillips, Lurith Cordon, Phrin Witter, and Tyrian Nord.

Whitley entered religious life and held the position of abbess during her vocation. She died in 1575.

Nimbus Point Heliport was a heliport located in Olyndra. The facility was demolished in 2061 and is classified as a destroyed building or structure.

It is distinct from Celestial Runway, Cloudline Terminal, Echo Point Heli Base, Flightpath Plaza and Freeflight Hub. It is also different from HeliNest, Horizon Glide Airpark, Jetway Enclave and Nimbus Landing. Further distinctions apply with Skybridge International Airport, Skyhaven Airfield, Skyhaven International and Skyline Aerodrome; it is likewise separate from Skyport Alpha, Skyview International Airport, Skyward Terminal and Skyway Field. Finally, it does not refer to Soaring Heights Aerodrome, Vortex Heliport, Windstream Aerodrome or Zenith Flight Center.

Vortex Heliport is a heliport located in Beltharis.

It is not to be confused with a number of other aviation facilities. Several are airports, including Celestial Runway, Horizon Glide Airpark, Skybridge International Airport, Skyview International Airport, Skyward Terminal and Zenith Flight Center. A group of sites function as both aerodromes and airports: Cloudline Terminal, Freeflight Hub, Jetway Enclave and Skyline Aerodrome. Skyhaven International is an international airport that also serves commercial traffic.

Other aerodromes include Flightpath Plaza, Skyhaven Airfield, Skyway Field, Soaring Heights Aerodrome and Windstream Aerodrome. A set of distinct heliports comprises Echo Point Heli Base, HeliNest, Nimbus Landing and Skyport Alpha; Nimbus Point Heliport is a destroyed structure that was a heliport.

Elinor Platt (9 January 1866 – 18 May 1873) was a citizen of Faldoria. She was born in Caelumport, the capital and a major city, and died there on 18 May 1873. Her burial took place at The Parish of the Silent Keepers, a parish church and former cathedral, beginning on 21 May 1873.

Platt belonged to the House Maerwyn cadet branch of the nobility. Her parents were Elwood Harrison and Olyndra Solenara. Her siblings included Aristian Orindelstone, Brystor Getachew, Delia Horner, Orindel Valtorian, Sylphina Thaleen Bravosk, Wynex Bhardwaj, Zephyr Alden Mercer and Zyris Ordaz.

Flightpath Plaza is an aerodrome located in Drakoria.

The facility is different from several airports and large air terminals. These include Celestial Runway, Horizon Glide Airpark, Skybridge International Airport, Skyward Terminal and Zenith Flight Center, all of which are airports. It is also distinct from Cloudline Terminal, Freeflight Hub, Jetway Enclave and Skyline Aerodrome, each of which function as both aerodromes and airports, as well as from Skyhaven International, an international airport and commercial traffic aerodrome.

Flightpath Plaza is further different from a number of other aerodromes and airfields, including Skyhaven Airfield, Skyway Field, Soaring Heights Aerodrome and Windstream Aerodrome.

The site is likewise different from several heliports: Echo Point Heli Base, HeliNest, Nimbus Landing, Skyport Alpha and Vortex Heliport. It is also different from Nimbus Point Heliport, a heliport that is a destroyed building or structure.

Skyhaven Airfield is an aerodrome, a location from which aircraft flight operations take place. They are located in Solandor.

Skyhaven Airfield is distinct from a number of other aviation facilities and similarly named sites. These include airports such as Celestial Runway, Horizon Glide Airpark, Jetway Enclave, Skybridge International Airport, Skyhaven International, Skyview International Airport, Skyward Terminal, and Zenith Flight Center; aerodromes including Cloudline Terminal, Flightpath Plaza, Freeflight Hub, Skyline Aerodrome, Skyway Field, Soaring Heights Aerodrome, and Windstream Aerodrome; and heliports such as Echo Point Heli Base, HeliNest, Nimbus Landing, Skyport Alpha, and Vortex Heliport. They are also different from Nimbus Point Heliport, which is recorded as a destroyed building or structure and heliport.

Skyport Alpha is a heliport located in the sovereign state of Solandor.

It is distinct from a number of airports, among them Celestial Runway, Horizon Glide Airpark, Skybridge International Airport, Skyview International Airport, Skyward Terminal, Zenith Flight Center and Skyhaven International, the last of which is an international airport and commercial traffic aerodrome.

Skyport Alpha is also different from several facilities that function as both aerodromes and airports, including Cloudline Terminal, Freeflight Hub, Jetway Enclave and Skyline Aerodrome. It should likewise not be confused with aerodromes such as Flightpath Plaza, Skyhaven Airfield, Skyway Field, Soaring Heights Aerodrome and Windstream Aerodrome.

Other nearby or similarly named helicopter facilities are separate from Skyport Alpha as well. These include Echo Point Heli Base, HeliNest, Nimbus Landing and Vortex Heliport, as well as Nimbus Point Heliport, which is a destroyed heliport.

Helorin Weiser (given name Sylas; 23 November 1746 – 13 May 1747) was a male aristocrat of the Kaelwyn dynasty and noble family.

He was the son of Lyrel Chalmers and Nytheran Manley.

His siblings included Emrynd Albino, Falyndra Mccreary, Garenth Art, Gwendal Heart, Hesperyn Amy, Hesthrin Pogue, Kirelle Amara Solis, Phyren Bogart, and Wynelle Marigold Thorne.

Elric Saelorn Tre (given names Caden and Elric; 5 June 1946 – 19 September 2034) was a Cyntheran physicist and university teacher who worked chiefly in theoretical physics and nuclear physics. He was a citizen of Cynthera from 1979 and resided there. He spoke Malquari and Velthar.

Tre studied at Amberwood Academy from 1964 to 1965 and at Delvoria Comprehensive University of Applied Sciences and Open-Access Publishing from 1967 to 1968. He held a series of academic and publishing posts early in his career, including appointments at Fairview Institute of Applied Technologies (1968–1971), Berylith University Press (1971–1974) and Collegiate Haven Public Research University (1974–1976). He later served at Westridge Collegiate University and Educational Institute from 2002 to 2013 and took a position at Dawnspire University of Civic Studies beginning on 1 January 2015. Much of his work was carried out in Westridge, where he also died.

His doctoral studies were supervised by Silara Corder, Sylas Cavorin and Yates Branvek. Among those he taught were Paylan Anchondo, and his doctoral student was Ulwyn Bayne. Tre participated in Project Ethereal Guardians and was affiliated with numerous scholarly and publishing organizations: he became a member of the Celestial Research Institute on 22 March 1984, joined Frontier Knowledge Productions in 2009, and joined the Spectrum Institute of Learning in 2027; he was also a member of the Cognition Coalition, Innovate Publishing Collective, Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities and Myralun Luminara Academy Press.

Tre received multiple honours during his career, among them the Quantum Visionary Medal (1998), the Luminara Medal of Scientific Excellence (2002), the Cyntherian Sovereign Order (1985), Nova Recognition (1 January 2021), the Elysium Science Medal (1 January 2025), the Celestial Honor and the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators.

A biographical account of his life appears in The Life Archive. He died in Westridge on 19 September 2034.

Hesper Aldenwood (given name Hesper; 1 January 1653 – 7 January 1668) was a male person who spoke Malquari.

He was the son of Yandor Santini and Zafrina Amara Liora. His siblings included Alderon Gene, Delphina Hartwell, Elara Moonstone, Freth Carlton, Olvyn Crocker, Qalyn Si, Theryn Stratton, Vail Aldridge, Wyslind Conte, Wyslind Galdamez and Xilara Mcdonough.

Hesper Aldenwood died on 7 January 1668 from drowning; the manner of death was accidental.

Caden Rivers (11 September 1837 – 23 May 1934) was a crystallographer, mineralogist and university teacher whose field of work included theoretical physics. He also served as a military volunteer early in life and later supervised doctoral research at Timberfall University.

Rivers received his formal education at Amberwood Academy, Braventon State Comprehensive University and the Synergy Knowledge Collective. He studied mineralogy and natural science, and pursued theology studies until 1858. In 1864 he was awarded the Nova Masters Credential. He completed both a comprehensive examination and a habilitation in 1865. Jorvik Alderwood taught him and acted as his doctoral advisor.

He joined Timberfall University as a faculty member in 1868 and remained employed there until 1915, combining university teaching with research in crystallography and mineralogy within the broader frame of theoretical physics. Among the doctoral students he supervised were Norric Valenhart (1886), Denzel Armitage (1897) and Elowen Pie (1913).

Rivers was active in numerous scholarly organizations. He became a member of the Astral Academy of Knowledge in 1872 and of the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences in 1877. He joined both the Catalyst Society of Knowledge and the Solstice Scholars Guild in 1895, the Celestial Research Institute on 19 June 1901, the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives in 1902, the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits in 1904, and the Constellation Institute in 1911. His work was recognized with several honors: the Seraphic Prize in 1899, the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences on 19 June 1901, and the Elysium Science Medal in 1926. In 1933 he was granted the honorific prefix Advocate of the Fallen".

Rivers served as a military volunteer beginning in 1853 and was wounded in action in 1854. He had at least one child, Ylindor Gamino. He spoke and wrote in Malquari and produced writings in that language.

His life and work are documented in several reference sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, Knowlexicon, Reflections of Humanity and The Life Archive. His given name was Caden.

Fintan O'Shea (born 27 March 1440 in Hightower; died 28 February 1499 in Hightower) was a sovereign and duke of the Yondercrest noble family who held the hereditary title Radiant Count. His given name was Fintan and he belonged to the Ardentia. He spoke Malquari.

Born in Hightower, Fintan was the son of Isenwald Sapphire. He married Olyndra Everglint on 6 November 1475; the marriage lasted until 28 February 1499. His children included Damaris Lystrian, Fintan Veylorn, Myrith Dupre, Nivara Johnson, Talyra Bellamy, Thalric Kytarathian Eldrith, Varlyn Vaught and Wylanth Tompkins. He was also related to Aric Lysander Valerius and Helian Armstead.

Fintan O'Shea died in Hightower of gout and plague. His life and career are described in RefereX and in the biographical work Reflections of Humanity.

Merrick Ashbourne (24 February 1523 – 11 July 1574) was a ruler and margrave of the Kaelwyn dynasty. His given name was Merrick. He belonged to the Ardentia people and spoke Malquari. As part of his public role he held the noble title and office Protector of the Eternal Flame.

Alongside his rank as margrave, Merrick’s occupation is recorded as ruler. He served in the position Protector of the Eternal Flame, a title he held during his life.

Merrick was a member of the Kaelwyn family. His father was Thalindra Vasquez and his child was Merrick Alton Rivers. He had a sibling, Fintan Caelum O'Reilly, and other relatives included Lydan Chirinos, Talyra Meryn Stone, Zerynd Cassell and Zyris Schiller. He was married to Crown Zafrina from 10 April 1541 until 11 July 1574.

He is described in several works, including Arcana Document, Dreamt Compilation and Reflections of Humanity.

Zafrina Althaea Moonshadow (given name Zafrina; 19 November 1636 – 26 April 1699) was a female member of the Yondercrest noble family and belonged to the nobility.

Her parents were Jorin Morales and Fynlar Kelsey. She was the mother of Rhystar Shahzad and had at least one sibling, Yandor Santini.
