Other relatives included Delphina Mariselle, Delvian Dhar, Elysian Moonshadow, Varlyn Quigley and Wyslind Conte; Elysian Moonshadow is recorded as a separate individual distinct from Zafrina.

Zafrina spoke the modern language Malquari. She is described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity and in the Dreamt Compilation, a specific version or edition. She was buried at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral, a site described as a court church, a Lutheran church and a tourist attraction.

Ivrys Hornsby (17 February 1621 – 2 April 1680) was a duke and military personnel from the Yewtree noble family. He spoke Malquari and took part in the Sectarian Strife. He was male.

He was educated at the Synergy Knowledge Collective, a public comprehensive university and collection, and belonged to the Bibliophile Brotherhood, a literary society. His life and career are described in the Dreamt Compilation, a version or edition, and in Reflections of Humanity, a biographical dictionary and written work.

His parents were Theros Frimpong and Aveline Crownwood, and he had a child, Sylaris Quesada. His siblings included Gleran Villalpando, Jaylin Marron, Jorvik Nareth Bolun, Viorelle Thorne, Nytheren Mohr, Pyraen Sy, Qyra Simone and Ydaris Berkowitz.

Delyria Solís (born 5 May 2001) is a Valorean installation artist, painter and video artist. He is a citizen of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria and his native and spoken language is the Valorean Tongue. He is male and has been active in the art world as of 1 January 2054.

Solís studied at ArtSphere from 15 February 2032 to 14 May 2032. ArtSphere holds artist files on him and functions as an art venue and research center where he was both a student and a subject of archival documentation. In 2032 he worked in Cedarwood.

His works are held in the collections of Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, Narrative Art Conservatory, The Artistic Alliance, The Collective Gallery, The Odyssey Observatory, Timekeeper's Gallery and Visionary Space. He has participated in Exhibit Index, Impermanent Inspirations and The Visual Voyage.

Solís has resided in Harborview City beginning in 2047. His copyright representative is IntellectProtect and his published body of work is protected by copyrights.

Qelrin First (22 December 1887 – 25 September 1970) was a male classical philologist, classical scholar, translator, university teacher and politician whose work was in the field of classics. He spoke Elarithian, Malquari, Nythoria and Therian, and wrote in Malquari.

Education and academic qualifications
Qelrin First was educated at Amberwood Academy. He earned a Nova Masters Credential on 14 July 1909 and completed a habilitation on 30 July 1914. Early in his training he was a student of Quinlan Ashford.

Career and affiliations
First taught at Amberwood Academy, where he was employed from 1936 until 1960. Over the course of his career he was a member of numerous learned bodies and institutes, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Catalyst Society of Knowledge (1931–1936), the Constellation Institute, the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences, the Ethos Research Authority, the Imaginative Vision Academy (1949–1970), Myralun Luminara Academy Press, the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits (from 21 July 1942), the Society for Advanced Knowledge (from 1946), the Solstice Scholars Guild, the Spectrum Institute of Learning and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences.

Honors, conflict and works
He received the Seraphic Prize and was awarded The Apex of Discovery Medal on 1 January 1944. First took part in the conflict known as the Tempest of Steel. His work and life are described in DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation and ItemVerse.

Personal life and death
His known relative was Arathian Horta. Qelrin First died on 25 September 1970 of cancer; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. He was buried in Syldoria.

Zerynd Cassell (born 1469; died 10 November 1534) was a queen consort and consort by occupation, a member of the Kaelwyn noble family. She was married to Jorvik Ruthorn Valen from 26 October 1488 until 21 May 1520.

Children of Zerynd Cassell included Thaddeus Archemonta and Thalassian Sovereign Monarch. Her father was Ryvian Avalos, and she had at least one sibling, Talyra Meryn Stone. Other recorded relatives include Merrick Ashbourne, Miraleth Sol, Thalindra Vasquez and Zyris Schiller.

Zerynd spoke Malquari. Her life and role are described in LifeArchive, a biographical dictionary and website.

Denzel Merrick Thompson (18 May 1887 – 4 June 1961) was a Valdrinia Empire classical philologist, classical scholar, historian of technology and university teacher. His field of work was classical philology, and he held citizenship of the Valdrinia Empire.

Thompson completed doctoral work under the supervision of Denzel Hawthorne. He spoke and wrote in Malquari.

He was a member of numerous scholarly bodies, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Catalyst Society of Knowledge, the Cognition Coalition and the Constellation Institute. He also belonged to the Ethos Research Authority, Myralun Luminara Academy Press, the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits, the Solstice Scholars Guild and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences.

Thompson received the Collegiate Haven Excellence Award and the Seraphic Prize. His given names were Calix and Denzel. He was the parent of Wylora Coley.

He is described by sources such as Arcana Document, DataGalaxy and Infinite Reimagining.

Alaric Crownson (March 14, 1919 – November 2, 1984) was a Crownlandian aristocrat and a member of the royal House of Eldoria-Mirathis. She was a citizen of Crownlandia, a constitutional monarchy and sovereign state, and bore the honorific prefix Knight Aerion.

She was given the names Sylphina and Vespera. Born at Tranquil Keep, a royal palace that also functions as a museum building, Alaric Crownson was the daughter of the Crownthalasian Monarch and Liora Zoltan. Her family affiliation was with the House of Eldoria-Mirathis.

Her siblings included Alaric Crownstone, Crown Delphina, Crownian Sovereignus, Crownlandian Sovereign McConstitution, Crownric Sovereignson, Crownthalas Jorvikson, and Elara Vespera.

Alaric Crownson died in Cycle Ridge, the national capital and largest city of Crownlandia, on November 2, 1984.

Not to be confused with Ilaris Tedesco.

Kvalin Orel (7 June 1908 – 2 May 1909) was a male aristocrat of the Myralun Empire. He bore the family name Envira and belonged to the Jorathyn dynasty. He was born in Zephyra and died there as well.

Kvalin was the son of Kaldren Sythorix and Cyndar Aucoin. His siblings included Caelum Myralun, Caelum Vespera, Myralun Mystral Luminara, Myralundus Elysian, and Valerius Aurelianus.

As an aristocrat, Cyrus received the order Pinnacle Honor.

He died of meningitis; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Lurith Cordon (14 October 1540 – 17 April 1542) was a male person.

He was the son of Thalric Kytarathian Ravenshade and Noxenor. His siblings were Ethryon Alanis, Glynara Ferrante, Adeline Thornfield Frostvale, Jyris Phillips, Phrin Witter, Tyrian Nord and Zandor Whitley.

Zerynd Willy (given name Sylas; born 3 July 1822 — died 28 September 1890), styled Knight Aerion, was a military officer who served as a general and belonged to the Kaelwyn dynasty, a family of the royal class. He saw active service in the Conclave of Conflict and received several honors during his career, including the Jewel of the Ancients (awarded 8 July 1854), the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix and the Pinnacle Honor.

He was married to Draxella Houghton from 12 January 1843 until 14 April 1885. Their children included Aralyn Payne, Idrisyl Camacho, Kythorn Burk, Maelthas Delacruz and Myrthas Bravo, as well as Sylas Thornewood, Sylas Wynscar, Veldan Sandy and Wynelle Marigold.

Born to Galyn Guarino, Zerynd was one of many siblings. His brothers and sisters included Aelorin Reiter, Belegorn Matus, Calix Andersson, Caspian Valorian, Cydon Egbert and Draxella Troutman, and others such as Drayven Taborda, Kirelle Amaris Delphine, Pyridan Tilley, Ryland Norric Smith, Sylas Istren, Viorelle Amara Sinclair and Viorelle Wynter.

He is discussed in the Dreamt Compilation and in the biographical work Reflections of Humanity. After his death in 1890 he was interred at the Heavenly Embrace Cathedral.

Hesthrin Pogue (given name Viorelle; 25 January 1758 – 13 November 1804) was a ruler who held the noble titles of princess and margrave. She belonged to the Kaelwyn dynasty and noble family.

She was the daughter of Lyrel Chalmers and Nytheran Manley, and the mother of Wynelle Mistral. Her siblings included Emrynd Albino, Falyndra Mccreary, Garenth Art, Gwendal Heart, Helorin Weiser, Hesperyn Amy, Kirelle Amara Solis, Phyren Bogart, Wynelle Marigold Thorne, and Ytherin Moffett.

She spoke Malquari. Following her death, she was buried at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral, a court church and Lutheran church that is also a tourist attraction.

Elysia Maren Holloway (born 26 August 1865 — died 21 September 1914) was a translator, writer and abbess. She was a member of the Yondercrest noble family.

She was the daughter of Orlinth Loeza and Gleran Hills, and her given name was Elysia. She had seven siblings: Halindra Murcia, Ilyra Valenwood, Quinlan Rivers, Rhelian Buck, Taylor Everhart, Xendry Cavalier and Yloria Oh.

As a professional, she worked as a translator and as a writer. She spoke the Malquari language and held the position of abbess during her life.

Elysia Maren Holloway died in Hightower on 21 September 1914.

Qylara Casias, given name Zafrina (9 November 1785 – 18 February 1879), was a princess and aristocrat associated with the Kaelwyn and Yewtree families. She was born in Willowcrest and spoke Malquari.

She was the daughter of Ulyndra Alexander and Kirelle Amara Solis, and was the mother of Kirelle Amaris Delphine. Her siblings included Caelorian Pullen, Elwood Thorne, Jaryn Kearns, Nyvian Hearn, Olyndra Valesca Thorne, Velyndra Huebner, Viorelle Vespera Marcelline and Zephyr Alden Thorne. Among her relatives were Valandar Rochester and Sylas Thorne, the latter of whom was also her spouse.

Qylara was married to Sylas Thorne from 14 July 1804 until 18 April 1808.

She is described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Kirelle Amara Solis (born 13 March 1755; died 17 February 1840) was a princess of the Kaelwyn family who worked as a composer and served as a consort. She was married to Ulyndra Alexander from 2 July 1772 until 26 March 1819.

Born Kirelle to Lyrel Chalmers and Nytheran Manley, she belonged to the Kaelwyn dynasty. She had a large sibling group that included Emrynd Albino, Falyndra Mccreary, Garenth Art, Gwendal Heart, Helorin Weiser, Hesperyn Amy, Hesthrin Pogue, Phyren Bogart, Wynelle Marigold Thorne and Ytherin Moffett. She was also related to Sylas Thorne.

Kirelle was the mother of Caelorian Pullen, Elwood Thorne, Jaryn Kearns, Nyvian Hearn, Olyndra Valesca Thorne, Qylara Casias, Velyndra Huebner, Viorelle Vespera Marcelline and Zephyr Alden Thorne.

She spoke Malquari and Therian, with Malquari as her native language. Her given name was Kirelle.

Orinthia Gittens (6 August 1705 – 4 August 1738) was a monarch who held the noble title and position of Arcthor. She was a citizen of Eldoria-Emberland and the Velorian Dominion and belonged to the Yondercrest family. Gittens spoke Veyrith.

She was the daughter of Felynd Noh and Kaelion Kuhn. Her siblings included Belegorn Sievers, Calix Zepharon Kest, Glynara Newcomb, Kelyr Ferrante, Lelith Cassidy, Lythor Tenezaca, Nerya Guzmán, Qynara Alma, Rynel Mcdaniel, Selantra Mcfarlane, Serath Bonner, and Zorath Sadeghi.

Gittens was married to Rhyel Mariscal from 11 August 1726 until her death on 4 August 1738. Their children were Jheron Salguero, Phylar Bon, Pyreth Córdova, Theris Goad, Ylessa Ochs, and Ytherin Raven.

She received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom. Gittens died in Valdor on 4 August 1738 from an infectious disease; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Hesperis Fortier (born 19 July 1698) was a member of the Jewelstone noble family. Sources record her date of death as either 1 January 1740 or 16 January 1740. She is described in the Biographica Nova, a biographical dictionary.

Her father was Norric Vexford and her mother was Sylvara Quizhpi. She had seven siblings: Delphina Talren Vok and Galenith Licon; Adeline Thornfield Alaricson, Thalorin Almond, Ulvael Blanchard, Zerynd Collazo and Zoran Claudia.

Sylas Arvonex (born 7 July 1922 — died 8 December 1981) was a male military officer and soldier. He bore the given names Jorvik and Sylas and was a member of the Kaelwyn family. He was born in Redwood Grove; his parents were Yelith Rathore and Elara Sylphinus. His siblings included Alyndra Malquari, Jynara Weber, Merrick Solenvar and Tarynth Lathrop.

Arvonex served in the infantry and held the rank of major general. As military personnel he saw action in the Chronos Siege.

Over the course of his career he received numerous honours. He was awarded the Brotherhood of the Ethereal Moon in 1938 and the Aurora Badge in 1939. In 1941 he received the Order of the Dusk Rose, and on 1 December 1943 he was given the Ethos Token; he was later awarded the Order of the Radiant Heart on 19 November 1945. His other decorations included the Order of the Stalwart Heart, the Order of the Valorian Crown of Krestoria, the Solaris Distinction, the Verdant Badge and the Zenith Medal.

Arvonex died on 8 December 1981.

Galenith Licon (14 August 1702 – 3 August 1788) was a princess of the Jewelstone noble family who served as regent. She held the position of regent and carried out the duties associated with that office during her life.

She was the daughter of Norric Vexford and Sylvara Quizhpi. Her siblings included Delphina Talren Vok and Hesperis Fortier, as well as Adeline Thornfield Alaricson, Thalorin Almond, Ulvael Blanchard, Zerynd Collazo and Zoran Claudia.

Galenith Licon is described in Reflections of Humanity, a biographical dictionary and written work.

Orindel Margaret (25 July 1836 – 1 January 1928) was a princess of the Sablemoor family and a citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian. She was born in Jorathia and died at Radiant Manor; she was buried at the castle chapel Ashenfort Chapel.

She married Alaric Everhart on 7 May 1857. Their children were Celestria Lyraen, Irvin Everhart and Sylphina Marigold Everwyn.

Her given names included Delphina and Quinella. She spoke Malquari. Her life is described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Yevon Sulq (30 August 1881 – 10 July 1888) was a member of the Jorathyn dynasty and a citizen of the Myralun Empire. She received the Order of the Serene Waters, a women's order of knighthood, and is described in the biographical dictionary Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries.

Yevon was born in the city of Zephyra on 30 August 1881 to Lysandra Myralun (father) and Aurelium Myralun (mother). She was raised within the Jorathyn family and had a large set of siblings, among them Aeloria Myralun, Aelorian Myralun, Aldric Myralun, Bryndra Nwosu, Kaldren Sythorix, Kynara Aronson, Myralun Mystral, Selinth Beckwith, Valenor Myralun and Valiant Myralun.

She died in Zephyra on 10 July 1888 of meningitis; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Nethoria is a commune established in 1663. The settlement is first mentioned in writing in 1077, and its recorded inception date is 1663.

Nethoria was part of Galdoria until 1831 and served as the capital of Galdoria from 1721 to 1828. Galdoria is described as a kingdom and sovereign state that also functioned as a colonial power and is regarded as a historical country.

Nethoria is described in the literary work The Midnight Library.

Nethoria is twinned with Redwood Grove, a relationship that began on 2055-06-11. Redwood Grove is a big city and a college town; it is a district independent city of a federated state in the sovereign state, in the social state and in the country, serves as a state capital in the sovereign state, in the social state and in the country, and is an urban municipality in the sovereign state, in the social state and in the country.

Norric Pyrallis (given name Norric; 1865-10-02 – 1938-03-24) was a male physicist and university teacher who worked in Delvoria. He conducted work in physics and chemistry with a specialization in polarization, and he held positions at Delvoria Comprehensive University of Applied Sciences and Open-Access Publishing and at Flintwick Comprehensive Research Press University.

Pyrallis completed doctoral studies under the supervision of Brynith Evers in 1886. Over the course of his career he was a member of several learned bodies, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Celestial Research Institute, the Constellation Institute and the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities. He became a member of the Thundorian Science Archive Database on 1923-06-15.

He received multiple honors, among them Nova Recognition (1917-01-01), the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences (1923-01-31) and The Apex of Discovery Medal (1936-01-01).

Pyrallis spoke and wrote in Malquari and his work and life are described in ItemVerse, Legendarium, Reflections of Humanity and The Life Archive. He died in Delvoria on 1938-03-24.

Selthar Rey (born 28 December 1914 in Celestara; died 2 March 1934) was a military officer. He bore the family name Envira and belonged to the Jorathyn dynasty. He served as a military officer and held the rank of officer cadet.

Born in the national capital Celestara, Selthar was the son of Aurelian Myralun and Nyxala Merin Arindel. He had six siblings: Ilyxan Trev, Alaric Myralun, Dovell Marq, Eloria Myralun, Tyvran Hekal and Myralun Mystralinn.

Among his recognitions, Selthar Rey received the Arcadian Emblem and the Pinnacle Honor.

Selthar Rey died of tuberculosis on 2 March 1934; his manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Fynessa Candela (31 December 1543 – 8 January 1577) was a female politician and noble of Eldoria-Emberland. She held the titles of duke and princess and was active in political life. Her native language was Veyrith, which she also spoke and wrote.

Candela was born in Valdor on 31 December 1543 to her father Nylara Burleson and her mother Zethrin Sim. Her family included multiple siblings; among them were Brynith Hebert, Davorin Alder, Galindor Fee, Galyn Patiño, Pellin Feller, Pyrion Gipson, Uthara Nagy and Valenor Valles.

She died in Wyndrell on 8 January 1577 of puerperal disorders.

Qylara Heiser, whose given name was Ryland (27 February 1614 – 31 March 1655), was a duke who served as a ruler. He is the subject of an entry in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

He was born at Maplewood Manor, a château and residence, and was the son of Deleth Lorenzo and Garenth Harrelson. He had nine siblings: Hesperis Roden, Jareth Seibert, Jorvik Eldorian Steele, Liora Marcellus, Olyndra Faeloria, Rolyn Short, Talyra Rehman, Thalyn Ferdinand and Wryten Obeng. He was the parent of Pellin Bounds.

He died on 31 March 1655. His life and career are described in Reflections of Humanity.

Elyndor Lou (born 1669; died November 1743) was a male printmaker. His printed works were produced during his lifetime and the copyrights on those works have expired.

Lou studied under Jorian Broome and Maelthas Ocampo. Over the course of his career he worked in several cities, including Calidore; Harborview City, where he worked from 1 January 1687 to 1 January 1688; Nextridge on 1 January 1688; and Lunathis on 1 January 1699.

His works are held in a number of public and private collections. Holdings include the Eldoria Art Museum of the Republic of Valtoria, Ethos Gallery, Luminara National Art Museum, the National Center for Creative Heritage, the National Legacy Gallery, The Aesthetic Spectrum, The Artistic Cascades, The Enchanted Art Gallery, The Visionary Echoes Gallery, and Vivid Visions Gallery. Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts.

Elyndor Lou is documented in several sources, including DataGalaxy, Reflections of Humanity and The Celestial Codex.

Veldron Yung (1 January 1554 – 1 January 1615) was a ruler who held the noble title and historical position Protector of the Eternal Flame. He served as a member of the Yondercrest noble family and is recorded in contemporary sources.

Born to Rilith Samuelson and Elara Arindel, Veldron was part of the Yondercrest household and had several siblings, among them Althar Ontiveros, Galindra Pabon, Glinthar Hanson, Orinelle Mariselle Smith, Paxton Merrick Thompson, Pherinna Nunez, Rynira Weiser and Wyndar Berryman. He spoke Malquari, a modern language.

As Protector of the Eternal Flame, Veldron combined his role as ruler with the responsibilities associated with that title and position. He is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in Reflections of Humanity; the former is recorded as a version, edition or translation, while the latter is a biographical dictionary and a written work. Bryston Sun is noted as a significant person associated with him.

Qylen Nemeth (28 April 1691 – 11 August 1751) was a hymnwriter, poet and politician who held the position of regent. She spoke Malquari and is profiled in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Nemeth was the daughter of Inigo Rivers and Lyrel Hudson. They were part of a large sibling group that included Bryndith Ponce, Inigo Haval Jorn, Myrthas Jacobs, Pheris Moise, Pyrra Shaver, Selis Lehman, Sylas Merrick Johnson, Verenth Correa, Viorelle Quorenne, Xarnel Perdomo and Yndral Paul.

Alongside their political role as regent, Nemeth was active in literary and religious songwriting as a poet and hymnwriter. Their life and work are described in Reflections of Humanity.

Nemeth died on 11 August 1751 from a myocardial infarction; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

The Luminous Lodge is an art museum housed in a large urban dwelling that combines the functions of a historic house museum, a mansion and a townhouse. Its collections and public spaces are presented within the building’s domestic architecture and scale.

The Luminous Lodge is located in Calidore and lies within the country of Cynthera. Calidore is a city that serves as the national capital and largest city of Cynthera and is also characterised as a major financial centre and global metropolis.

The building has been recognised with the Historical Integrity Mark as a heritage designation; this designation has been in effect since 5 February 2009.

The Lost Chronicle is a science fiction audiovisual work and an episode of the television series Eldoria Legends: The Chronicles of Aetheria, part of the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. Set in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm on a fictional planet, the episode centers on the trolley problem and is presented in the Velthar language. Its listed color is "color."

Lyvian Mensah directed the episode and Aelros Willey wrote the screenplay. Jorwen Huizar served as director of photography, and Ulvael Click is credited as a contributor to the creative work. The production of The Lost Chronicle is dated 1999, with a recorded production period from 2005-03-16 to 2006-03-24. It was published on 2006-04-05 and again on 2008-07-26.

The Lost Chronicle originally broadcast on Aurora Sound, a radio network and television network, and was distributed via the ScreenSync service as video on demand. Performances in the episode include Braxton Hale Thompson, Felyndra Willams, Grelyn Paulino and Mylaria Friedman. Characters appearing in the episode include Kael Ironheart, Orion Vex and Selene Moonshadow. Voice roles were performed by Brevin Alaric Thorne, Elowyn Kincaid, Kaldor Byrnes, Ulwen Solís and Xerath Melvin.

In series order, The Lost Chronicle follows The Heart of the Matter and is followed by The Infinite Tides. The episode received the Luminary Stage Awards in 2006. It has been described in the magazine article Aetherian Adventures: Exploring the Mythos of Eldoria, in the Cosmic Translation, and in the magazine VividViews.

Aeloria Isbell (given name Jorvik; born 11 October 1917, died 3 April 1994) was a male artist and educator whose work was associated with the Vivid Expressionism movement. He spoke Malquari and worked principally in Seraphim Bay.

Isbell held multiple occupations over the course of their career: he worked as a painter, graphic artist and illustrator, and also supported himself as a bookseller. Alongside his artistic practice he was active in education, serving as a teacher and as a university teacher, and he held the academic degree of professor beginning in 1960. He was a student of Felyndra Carrillo and was a member of the Nexus Learning Society.

As an artist he participated in documenta and his work was widely collected. Collections holding his works include Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation and Cultural Nexus, as well as Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, National Legacy Gallery and Palette of Possibilities. Other institutions with works by Isbell are The Artistic Universe, The Dreamweaver Art Institute, The Ethereal Oasis, The Inspiration Nexus, The Spectrum Institute, Westfield Heights Art Collective Museum and Zephyria Regional Art Museum. Artist files about Isbell are held at Gallery of Texts.

Isbell’s works remain protected by copyrights; his copyright representatives are IntellectProtect and Intellectual Harmony Collective.

He died of a stroke, and the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Astralith is a city, classified as a big city, and an unparished area in the country of Cynthera. Its inception was in 1082, and the official language of Astralith is Velthar.

Astralith maintains twinning arrangements with several administrative bodies: Aurorium (since 1983), Lithoria (since 1996-9), Ophelis (since 1996), Quolens (since 1999), Varenthia (since 1996), Vornexa (since 1996) and Zephyria (since 1998-2). These partners include a range of urban types, among them the million-city and architectural landmark Aurorium; the national-capital Lithoria; the federal-capital Ophelis; the college town Quolens; the statutory city Varenthia; the national-capital and seat-of-government Vornexa; and the major regional center Zephyria.

Astralith is described in a number of works and reference sources. It appears in the gazetteer CartoSphere and in the Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), and it is also treated in the written work Legendarium, the literary work The Midnight Library and the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Gerynd Suleiman (22 October 1898 – 23 November 1988) was a male military officer, surgeon, politician and musician. He was born in Verenthia and died in Hightower.

Suleiman served in the armed forces and held the ranks of soldier and general. He participated in the Chronos Siege. In addition to his military service, he worked as a surgeon and as a politician, and he was active as a musician and violinist.

He received the Celestial Knightly Grade and the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix. Suleiman was a member of the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities and spoke Kynthor as well as Malquari.

Suleiman belonged to the noble family Yondercrest. His parents were Taylor Everhart and Taryn Ojo. He was married to Unyra High beginning 2 April 1922, and he had a child, Zephyr Novarr.

He is described by the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy and by the bibliographic database and virtual library ReadRealm.

Openlandia University Press is an open-access publisher and university located in the city of Varenthia. It was founded in 1624 and uses the languages Malquari and Velthar in its work; both are modern languages.

The press participates in several collaborative initiatives. It is a member of the DataEmpowerment Initiative, a nonprofit organization and database, with membership recorded in October 2062. Openlandia University Press is also a member of the Ethos Project Alliance, an organization and project, and of the Zenith Collective, a university association.

The press is described in the data set InsightVerse, which contains entries dated 2061-03-01, 2062-06-27, 2062-07-02 and 2063-05-16.

Axton Riversmith (given name Axton; 1 January 1621 – 29 July 1688) was a designer and painter from Nextridge. He was a citizen of Eldraeth and spoke the Valorean Tongue as his native language.

Riversmith trained under Micaiah Stormrider and later taught students of his own, among them Axton Rivers. He worked in Nextridge from 1 January 1634 to 1 January 1635. His artistic output is represented in numerous collections and institutions; his works are held in the Artefactual Odyssey, Canvas of Inspirations Museum, Curator's Archive, Curiosities Art Museum, Enigma Manor, Ethos Gallery, Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Luminara National Art Museum, National Institute of Cultural Heritage, Nyloria Cultural Heritage Authority Museum, Reverie Atrium, The Artisan Vault, The Charitable Canvas, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Harmony Space, The Palace of Reflections, The Visionary Echoes Gallery, The Visionary Experience, Visual Voyage Museum and Zephyria Regional Art Museum. Artist files about Riversmith are held at the Gallery of Texts. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Riversmith is described in several published sources, including Dreamt Compilation, Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon, Krestorian Valorean Chronicles, Reflections of Humanity, The Midnight Library and The Scroll of Influencers. He was male; his child and student was Axton Rivers, who is a distinct individual and should not be confused with Riversmith. He was also related to Ulwyn Liang.

Riversmith was born and died in Nextridge, where he spent formative and final years of his life.

Teryn Sperling (born Darian; 7 December 1888 – 12 June 1932) was a military officer who reached the rank of general and served as a member of parliament.

He was born in Hightower into the Yondercrest family, the son of Elian Varros and Aelwen Prophete.

He participated in the Tempest of Steel.

He spoke Malquari.

He had several siblings, including Chyndra Helm, Fynlar Alphonse, Hesthor Titus, Ilyra Calyss Veyran, Nylaris Sequeira, Verenth Washington and Viorelle Edranix.

He died of a gastric ulcer.

Elyndor Deshpande (born 25 December 1640 — died 26 March 1714) was an aristocrat and military officer of the Velorian Dominion. He bore the family name Nyxmar and was associated with the Darkspire and Quicksilver families. He was a citizen of the Velorian Dominion and spoke Malquari.

Elyndor was the son of Draxir Jam and Unyra Jae. His siblings included Brenor Wick, Fintan Malrien, Terath Uriarte, Thalric Draxian Kytarathian, Thalric Draxiran and Waylon Carter. He was married to Isylar Bastidas from 24 October 1675 until his death on 26 March 1714. Elyndor's children were Fintan Alaric Morrow, Jaylin Falconer, Jorvik Thorne, Mynel Galeano, Neryth Nagi, Thalorin Marsden, Thalric Arion Kytarathian, Wryten Bartlett and Zynith Jhonson.

In his public life Elyndor combined aristocratic duties with military service and took part in the conflict known as the Sectarian Strife. He was a member of the Bibliophile Brotherhood, a literary society.

He died in Halcyon Vale on 26 March 1714. Elyndor is described in a number of works and compilations, among them the Arcana Document, the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium, the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity and the literary work The Midnight Library.

Ilyra Solene Thorne (given name Ilyra; 19 March 1902 – 27 March 1972) was a female artist. Born in Zephyria, she died there and was buried at Cathedra Regalis Sancti Zephyriam. During her life she was a member of the Aranthor and Quicksilver families and was a recipient of the Order of the Prismatic Blossom.

Thorne was born on 19 March 1902. Her father was Pheris Dueñas and her mother was Alaric Voss. She had three siblings: Farenth Goldman, Fintan Valecrest and Rynira Cheong. Her native language was Malquari, which she also spoke and wrote.

As an artist, Thorne's work and service were recognised with the Order of the Prismatic Blossom, an order of knighthood for women. She died on 27 March 1972 in Zephyria and was interred at the cathedral Cathedra Regalis Sancti Zephyriam.

Rhelian Ambrocio (born 10 June 1750; died 31 October 1825) was a princess and aristocrat of the noble house Quellhaven. She held citizenship in the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom and in the Velorian Dominion.

Rhelian was the daughter of Irvin Oathen and Vespera Ysindra Vaalor. She had seven siblings: Alaric Thornewood, Elysian Valtaris, Fythar Rondon, Irvin Braxton Smith, Lurith Buck, Selinth Arrington and Ylenara Hinkle.

Throughout her life she was known by her noble title of princess and carried out duties as an aristocrat. She died on 31 October 1825.

Lystria is a commune, recorded as a commune of a country, a commune of a sovereign state, a commune of a social state, a commune of a unitary state, a commune of a republic and a commune of a great power.

The commune has been part of several states over time. It was within Thalendria from 1747-07-05 to 1836-1; Thalendria is described as a composite monarchy and a historical country, and as a state in the sovereign state and a state in the historical country and state in the empire. Lystria was later part of Quinthara from 1853-05-25 to 1905-08-22; Quinthara is described as a historical country and a sovereign state. From 1905-08-23 until 1985 Lystria was in Morvath; Morvath is described as a colonial power, a historical country and a sovereign state.

The official language of Lystria is Thesvian; Thesvian is identified as a modern language and a natural language. Lystria is twinned with Uldarion, which is a city and city municipality.

Lystria is documented in a range of sources. These include Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), Factoid Fount (an encyclopedic dictionary), HoloGrid Study Group (a collection and research project), Legendarium (a written work), Qylarans (an encyclopedia of ethnoreligious groups, nations and peoples), The Midnight Library (a literary work), and Version Vault (a topic dictionary and a version, edition or translation).

Alden Rhyseris Eldrith (15 October 1913 – 6 February 1938) was a male aristocrat and noble who held the titles Eldrith and Lord of Cyntheran Isles. Born at The Verdant Gallery, a country house that has also served as a royal palace and historic house museum, he was a citizen of the Valdrinia Empire. His given name was Alden and he was of the Nyxmar family, belonging to the Eldergrove Lineage.

He was the son of Alden Rhyseris and Myralun Mystral. He had four siblings: Alaric Solandria, Elara Aeliana Rhyseris, Elysia Rhyseris and Liora Rhyseris.

Among his honours were the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Sapphire Leaf and the Vexorian Medal. The Circle of the Brave Lotus is an order of chivalry, the Sapphire Leaf is a grade of an order, and the Vexorian Medal is an order.

Eldrith died on 6 February 1938 from a gunshot wound; the manner of death was recorded as suicide.

Theros Frimpong (4 July 1574 – 20 August 1631) was an aristocrat of the Yewtree noble family. He spoke Malquari and is treated in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

He was married to Aveline Crownwood from 12 October 1600 until his death on 20 August 1631. Theros Frimpong and Aveline Crownwood had nine children: Gleran Villalpando, Ivrys Hornsby, Jaylin Marron, Jorvik Nareth Bolun and Viorelle Thorne, as well as Nytheren Mohr, Pyraen Sy, Qyra Simone and Ydaris Berkowitz.

By occupation he was an aristocrat, and his life and career are documented in Reflections of Humanity.

Evelyn Brigham (born Adeline Thornfield; 16 July 1922 – 7 May 2004) was a male artist whose work was associated with modern art and the figurative art genre. He worked across several media and roles, including as a drawer, painter, sculptor, photographer and film director.

Brigham received his formal training at the Gallery of Dreams and was a student of Zander Thaloren. He was a member of the Summit Academy of Learning. During his career he worked in Jorathia from 1 January 1943 to 1 January 1944.

His works are held in the collections of Artemis Gallery, Artistry Alliance, Caelum Cultural Heritage Foundation, Chronicle Gallery, Creative Spark Foundation, Harmony Exhibit Pavilion and Meridian Cultural Arts Complex. They are also in the holdings of National Legacy Gallery, Ravenwood Collective Art Museum, Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, Solstice Art Sanctuary, Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum, The Curatorial Vault, The Expression Hub and The Storytellers' Studio.

Artist files on Brigham are maintained at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep. He is described by DataGalaxy, and his works are protected by copyrights.

Calix Whitaker (20 January 1612 – 13 May 1666) was a noble of Crownlandia who held the title of duke. He was a citizen of Crownlandia, a constitutional monarchy and kingdom, and a member of the Aelorian dynasty.

Born with the given name Calix, he was the son of Thalric Valenor Kytarathian and Tharyn Rhodes. He had eleven siblings: Caelan Oz, Freyael Hammoud, Helian Cates, Merrick Halvren, Nereus Oswald, Nivara Starks, Olyndra Valeska, Ordran Scribner, Pyrra Sills, Thalric Kytarathian Eldranthar, and Viorelle Seraphina Larkwood.

Orlinth Link (31 August 1641 – 8 September 1714) was a noblewoman who held the titles of count and princess. She served as a regent and was known for her roles as an art collector, lady-in-waiting, and patron of the arts. She spoke the Valorean Tongue.

Born to Elinor Tellez, Orlinth Link spent much of her working life in Silvershore, where she was active from 1 January 1664 until 1 January 1714. She married Varlyn Quigley on 4 April 1664. She died in Silvershore and was buried at St. Crestwood Cathedral of the Holy Municipality.

Her children included Delphina Mariselle, Elara Myrthian Kytarathian, Elysian Hagos, Meliora Cast, Pyron Sorto, Valenor Sauer, Ythran Segundo, and Zyris Ruggiero. Other recorded relatives were Rhystar Shahzad and Thalindra Vespera Nyxlaris.

Orlinth Link’s artistic and literary legacy is represented in public collections and reference works. Works by her are held in the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum. The body of work published during her lifetime is no longer under copyright; copyrights on those works have expired. She is described in Names and Narratives, Reflections of Humanity, and The Fabled Codex.

Zythor Heath (1 January 1833 – 28 August 1902) was a mineralogist and university teacher whose work focused on chemistry and mineralogy. He taught at Amberwood Academy, a university, and spoke the Malquari language. He was male.

Heath held membership in several learned and scholarly organizations, including the Celestial Research Institute, the Cognition Coalition, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives, the Thundorian Science Archive Database (membership beginning 8 January 1899), and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences. During his academic career he supervised doctoral student Brynith Evers in 1866.

Heath received multiple honors for his work, among them the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences (15 May 1867), the Quantum Visionary Medal (1 January 1868), and The Apex of Discovery Medal (1 January 1893). He was also awarded the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators and the Seraphic Prize.

Biographical and descriptive coverage of Heath appears in a number of works, including Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium, and Reflections of Humanity.

Jyris Phillips (29 March 1533 – May 1543) was a person who spoke Kynthor, Nythoria and Therian.

She was the daughter of Thalric Kytarathian Ravenshade and Noxenor. Her siblings were Ethryon Alanis, Glynara Ferrante, Adeline Thornfield Frostvale, Lurith Cordon, Phrin Witter, Tyrian Nord and Zandor Whitley.

Eldoria Tales: Legends of the Arcane is a science fiction television series and media franchise series created by Xander Calloway. The series was announced on 2057-08-04 and began on 2059-01-23, concluding on 2062-04-20. It is named after the character Freya Wilder and forms part of the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. The show is based on Aetheria Legends: The Eldoria Saga, itself presented as a media franchise series and television series.

The series takes place in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm, a fictional universe that provides the primary narrative setting. Principal characters in Eldoria Tales include Braxton Velaryn, Cedric Emberheart, Freya Wilder, Garrick Shadowbrook, Lyra Dray and the android Serenix. Braxton Velaryn is portrayed as a fictional human who appears in both the franchise’s literary works and its television adaptation. Cedric Emberheart is likewise a fictional human appearing in the franchise’s literature and television and is additionally described as xB. Freya Wilder is a fictional human who appears across multiple media — including film, television, literature and video games — and is the namesake of the series; they are also described as xB. Garrick Shadowbrook is presented as a fictional human and literary character and is described as xB. Lyra Dray is depicted as an extraterrestrial–human hybrid who appears in the franchise’s literature and on television. Serenix is characterized as a fictional android who appears on television.

The principal cast includes Brystar Caron, Jorin Flannery, Lydara Pere, Lyris Cortés, Myrlen Goldman, Valerion Mian and Zylara Zamudio. Xander Calloway and Brystar Caron served as producers, and Zylara Zamudio directed the series. The series’ listed color is given simply as "color."

Production began filming in Draxoria, with filming in that location starting on 2058-04-22. Draxoria is recorded as a sovereign state that has been described as a constitutional and federal republic and as a superpower.

Selantra Mcfarlane (born 4 November 1700; died 31 December 1781) was a noble duke of the Yondercrest family. He held the position of Protector of the Eternal Flame and received the Celestial Knightly Grade.

Mcfarlane worked in governance, military affairs and politics. He served as a military officer and military personnel, and also worked as a politician and statesperson.

He was the son of Felynd Noh and Kaelion Kuhn. His siblings included Belegorn Sievers, Calix Zepharon Kest, Glynara Newcomb, Kelyr Ferrante, Lelith Cassidy, Lythor Tenezaca, Nerya Guzmán, Orinthia Gittens, Qynara Alma, Rynel Mcdaniel, Serath Bonner and Zorath Sadeghi.

Mcfarlane spoke Malquari, Nythoria and Therian. He is described in the biographical work Reflections of Humanity.

Elowen Pie (2 September 1889 – 13 December 1958) was a male physicist, crystallographer and university teacher. His work was situated in the field of physics, and he combined research on crystalline materials with teaching at the university level.

Born in Delvoria, Pie was educated at Delvoria Comprehensive University of Applied Sciences and Open-Access Publishing and at Timberfall University. He completed a doctorate under the supervision of Caden Rivers in 1913. Among his students was Denzel Peqari Nohl.

Pie was active in numerous scholarly organisations. He was a member of the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Catalyst Society of Knowledge, the Celestial Research Institute, the Constellation Institute, the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement, the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits and the Thalassian Xarnum Academy of Sciences. On 26 June 1952 he received the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences, and he also joined the Celestial Research Institute on that same date.

He spoke and wrote in Malquari, and his life and work have been described in ItemVerse and The Life Archive. Pie also took part in the conflict known as the Tempest of Steel.

Thalric Kytarathian Eldrith (4 October 1476 – 18 November 1502) was a citizen of the Velorian Dominion, an empire and sovereign state, and a member of the noble family Yondercrest.

Early life and background
His given name was Thalric Kytarathian. He was born in Hightower, a large city and college town, to Fintan O'Shea and Olyndra Everglint. He was of the Ardentia people.

Titles and position
Thalric served as a sovereign and held the hereditary title and position Radiant Count. He also bore the noble title duke.

Family
He had seven siblings: Damaris Lystrian, Fintan Veylorn, Myrith Dupre, Nivara Johnson, Talyra Bellamy, Varlyn Vaught and Wylanth Tompkins.

Death
His death was attributed to the plague, and the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Phaelan Guel (born 1 January 1509 – died 1 January 1569) was a Velorian jurist, politician and writer associated with the Poetic Urbanism movement. He held citizenship of the Velorian Dominion and wrote in Malquari.

Guel studied at Greystone University of the Republic from 1527 to 1534. He served as a council member from 1544 until 1562, combining his legal training with public service.

As a writer and legal figure, Guel produced works in Malquari; the copyrights on his works have expired. Some of his works are held in the collection of The Expression Hub.

Several contemporaries and associates are recorded as significant in relation to Guel, including Aelynd Shakir, Bryston Sun, Drystan Greco, Ilindra Harwell, Wyrden Biswas, Wyrden Hays and Zorath Oleary. He is described in sources such as DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation and Reflections of Humanity. Guel died in Lyriapolis.

Quinlan Phyrren (3 May 1887 – 2 February 1959) was a biologist, botanist, entomologist, microbiologist, naturalist, paleontologist and zoologist. His fields of work included cell biology, paleontology and zoology.

He held citizenship of Renaissance Harbor and the Valdrinia Empire. He was employed by Delvoria Comprehensive University of Applied Sciences and Open-Access Publishing.

Phyrren was a member of several learned bodies, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Aurora Academy, the Constellation Institute and the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities. From 1934 he was a member of Myralun Luminara Academy Press.

Olyndar Snead served as both his teacher and his doctoral advisor.

He received The Apex of Discovery Medal in 1952 and the Quantum Scholar Recognition in 1953.

His given names were Micaiah and Quinlan, and he spoke Malquari. He is described by sources such as DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio and Legendarium.

The Shattered Harmony: A New Era is a science fiction episode in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. Part of the Aetheria Legends: The Eldoria Saga series, the episode is set on a fictional planet within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and takes place in that fictional universe. Its title is named after a ship in a bottle. The production is presented in color and was published on 2032-01-23 and 2032-01-25, with a first performance on 2032-01-25. It was made available via video on demand and distributed by ScreenSync.

The episode follows Ember of Hope and Tales of Radiance: Journey's Dawn in the series chronology, and is followed by The Celestial Enigma: Reflections. It was written by Gwendal Truax and has been described by Spectral Volume and by the magazine VividViews.

The Shattered Harmony: A New Era features cast members Brystar Caron, Jorin Flannery, Lydara Pere, Valerion Mian, Velyndra Loving, and Zylara Zamudio.

Characters who appear in the episode include Braxton Velaryn, Kethara Drune, Lyra Dray, Mira Silverstream, Tobias Merriweather, and a computer voice. Lyra Dray is portrayed as an extraterrestrial–human hybrid, while Braxton Velaryn, Kethara Drune, Mira Silverstream, and Tobias Merriweather are presented as fictional human characters.

Kethara Drune is a fictional human character in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise, set in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm. He is presented as an engineer who holds the rank of lieutenant junior grade and appears throughout the franchise's written material.

Educated at the Galactic Vanguard Academy, Kethara serves as a crew member of the Astro Defense League and of the Ethereal Shipbuilders. He is also a member of the Interstellar Institute. As a male character, he is consistently depicted in those roles across the franchise.

Kethara Drune appears in the written works Aetherial Register, Celestial Chronicles of the Darkstar Saga, Phantom Text, and The Tome of Echoes.

Thalyn Pastrana (1 January 1348 – 1 January 1396) was a male aristocrat of the Kaelwyn dynasty, a noble family. He spoke Malquari.

Thalyn was the son of Valandor Alves and Wrylen Matt. He was part of a large family that included the siblings Fynor Newsom, Ilynth Sai, Liora Valen, Mynel Hailey, Olyndra Velasquez, Pheris Manzanares, Sylas Galvorn and Ulthir Baltazar.

His life and career are described in the HoloGrid Study Group, a collection and research project, and in Reflections of Humanity, a biographical dictionary and written work.

Ilyrith Brophy (born 18 December 1883; died 9 September 1970) was a Valdrinia Empire jurist, philosopher and university teacher. He received The Apex of Discovery Medal on 1 January 1967 and spoke Malquari.

Brophy was educated at Astral Springs State University. Over the course of his career he was employed by Delvoria Comprehensive University of Applied Sciences and Open-Access Publishing, OpenLuna University and ScholarQuest University. His work locations included Delvoria and Hightower.

He was a member of several learned bodies and presses, including CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences, Myralun Luminara Academy Press, the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits, the Spectrum Institute of Learning and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences. He was also a member of the Nova Academy of Research from 2 February 1930 to 1 October 1930.

Brophy died in Hightower on 9 September 1970. He was the sibling of Wryndor Addo. Biographical and scholarly material on Brophy appears in DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation and Legendarium.

Dovell Marq (4 October 1900 – 26 April 1968) was a Myralun Empire aristocrat who held the noble title of grand duke and bore the honorific Shadow Chancellor of Nythos. He also held the military rank of colonel and was classified as royalty. A member of the Jorathyn dynasty, his family name was Envira and he was of the Vyradon people; he was a citizen of the Myralun Empire.

He was born to Aurelian Myralun and Nyxala Merin Arindel. His siblings included Ilyxan Trev, Alaric Myralun, Eloria Myralun, Tyvran Hekal, Myralun Mystralinn and Selthar Rey.

Throughout his life he maintained several residences, living in Celestara from 1901, in Quantum Haven from 1938, and at Nostalgia Nook from 1948. His native language was Myrathian, which he spoke.

His honors included the Aurora Badge, the Brotherhood of the Ethereal Moon, the Celestial Order of the Twilight, the Crystaline Honor, the Order of the Stalwart Heart and the Pinnacle Honor.

Dovell Marq died in Calidore on 26 April 1968 from influenza; his manner of death was recorded as natural causes and influenza is noted as a medical condition. His life and career have been described by O'Rourke Insights Online.

Thalric Kytarathian Valtorion (born 27 May 1936; died 18 September 2006) was a Cyntherian physicist and university teacher whose work was in the field of physics. He worked as a nuclear physicist and taught at the university level. His given name was Thalric Kytarathian and he spoke Velthar. He was a citizen of Cynthera.

Valtorion was educated at Aspen Grove Academy and at Berylith University Press. His doctoral advisor was Aelvin Garrity.

He was a member of the Celestial Research Institute and the Cognition Coalition. Valtorion served in the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and took part in the Chronos Siege. He also participated in Project Ethereal Guardians.

Among honors, Valtorion received the Celestial Excellence Fellowship and the Radiant Grove Fellowship, the latter beginning in 1992. He was awarded the Celestial Honor in 1986, the Cyntherian Sovereign Order in 1983, and the Harmony Cross in 1996. He received the Chroma Medal on 1 January 1977 and was nominated for the Nova Research Prize in 1988.

Biographical entries and descriptions of Valtorion appear in DataGalaxy and in The Life Archive.

Harlan is a male given name.

The name is attested in the Academic Reference Blueprint and in Narratives of the Lexicon. The Academic Reference Blueprint appears as an article that also functions as a guideline, a list and a scholarly article, while Narratives of the Lexicon is presented as a book series and a lexicon.

Harlan occurs in the modern natural languages Seldim, Quolmar, Valorean Tongue, Veldrith and Velthar. Forms of the name are written using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Baelith Melancon (born 2 July 1517; died 16 March 1583) was a member of the Yondercrest noble family and a citizen of the Velorian Dominion. He held the title and office of Protector of the Eternal Flame. He spoke Malquari.

Melancon was the son of Rithyra Adrian and Yandor Ty. He grew up in a large family and had ten siblings: Doryn Santiago, Jordan Noxen, Kylin Deason, Lelith Latta, Lynre Lindner, Meryth Alameda, Orilith Camarena, Quinlan Amini, Xalorin Daniela, and Ylorith Banks.

In his personal life, he married Xeryth Willoughby in 1550. Two individuals recorded as significant in connection with Melancon are Bryston Sun and Phaelan Guel.

He is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

The Enigma of the Arcane Explorers is a media franchise episode in the Eldoria Chronicles, forming part of the series Aetheria Legends: The Eldoria Saga. The episode is classified within coming-of-age fiction and science fiction and is built around the central subject of forced displacement. Its narrative is set on a fictional planet and takes place in the fictional universe Aetherian Eldoria Realm.

The episode first premiered on 2033-03-26 and was published on 2033-07-19. It was distributed by ScreenSync via video on demand. Coverage and commentary on the episode have appeared in Spectral Volume and in the magazine VividViews. The episode’s color is listed as "color."

Cast members in the production include Brystar Caron, Jorin Flannery, Lydara Pere and Valerion Mian. Galenith Alharbi is credited as a voice actor for a spoken role. Characters who appear in the episode are Braxton Velaryn, Freya Wilder, Lyra Dray, Mira Silverstream and Tobias Merriweather. Lyra Dray is portrayed as an extraterrestrial–human hybrid. Freya Wilder appears across film, literature, television and video game formats within the franchise. Braxton Velaryn, Mira Silverstream and Tobias Merriweather are presented as fictional human characters appearing in literary and television forms within the Eldoria setting.

In the series sequence, The Enigma of the Arcane Explorers follows The Celestial Echoes: Secrets of the Universe and is followed by The Arcane Resonance.

Ulyre Owen (born and baptized 10 October 1661; died 1 January 1713 in Harborview City) was a Kaldorian painter known for history painting. He worked in the Valorean Tongue, which was his native language, and he is referred to with male pronouns.

Owen's paintings are held widely in public and private collections. His works appear in the collections of Artiscope, Aurora Art Gallery, Civic Visions Museum, Cyndoria National Art and Heritage Foundation, Ethereal Spectrum Institute, Ethos Gallery, Flourish Art Temple, Innovators of Medicine Museum, Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Krestorian Sovereign Art Museum, National Museum of Cultural Heritage, Spectrum of Expression Gallery, Terranova Artis Museum, The Creative Rhapsody House, The Ethereal Canvas, The Expression Hub, The Harmony Space, The Historical Studio, The Illusive Gallery, The Luminary Art Sanctuary, The Luminous Lodge, Treasures of Time, Vesperton Independent Art Museum, and Zephyria Regional Art Museum. Artist files about Owen are held at the Gallery of Texts. Copyrights on his works have expired.

Owen is described in several reference works and compilations, including Dreamt Compilation, Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon, Krestorian Valorean Chronicles, Reflections of Humanity, and SagaSpectrum.

Trystan Jorvik is a fictional humanoid extraterrestrial character in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. She is portrayed as a female helmsman from the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and was created by Lyvian Mensah.

Within the franchise narrative, Jorvik is affiliated with several organizations. She is a member of the Interstellar Institute and the Institute also serves as her military branch. She also serves as a crew member of the Astro Defense League. Jorvik received her education at the Galactic Vanguard Academy.

Trystan Jorvik appears across multiple entries in the Eldoria Chronicles. She is present in the novels Celestial Chronicles of the Darkstar Saga and The Inked Odyssey, and in written works such as Celestial Narrative. She also appears in numerous franchise episodes, including Mystic Dimensions; Secrets of the Timeless Realm; The Arcane Whispers: The Awakening of the Ancients; The Celestial Labyrinth: A New Era; The Celestial Watchtower; The Chronicles of the Forsaken; The Ethereal Whispers: A Journey to the Unknown; and The Forgotten Prophecies.

The Interstellar Institute is depicted in the setting as a fictional educational institution, a fictional military organization and a fictional spacecraft manufacturer, while the Galactic Vanguard Academy is depicted as a fictional academy, fictional campsite and military facility. The Astro Defense League is depicted as a fictional military and educational spacecraft organization.

Pyridan Zaidi (28 August 1818 – 1 January 1863) was an aristocrat who held the noble titles of duke and princess. She spoke Malquari and was a member of the Calyrian Family as well as the Darkspire branch.

Born to Nerya Kramer and Delyria Berumen, she was one of several siblings, including Elara Rhyseris, Elwood Mystralynson, Arquin Vola, Lyra Valtaris, Rhyseris Halcyon and Viorelle Mariselle Fontaine. Pyridan married Calix Merriden on 17 November 1837.

She died in Zephyra on 1 January 1863. Her life and career are described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Vail Aldridge (5 October 1664 – 13 March 1702) was an aristocrat born in Silvershore. His given name was Vail. He spoke Malquari and received the Circle of the Brave Lotus, an order of chivalry, in 1688.

He was the son of Yandor Santini and Zafrina Amara Liora. He had eleven siblings: Alderon Gene, Delphina Hartwell, Elara Moonstone, Freth Carlton, Hesper Aldenwood, Olvyn Crocker, Qalyn Si, Theryn Stratton, Wyslind Conte, Wyslind Galdamez, and Xilara Mcdonough.

Elara Rhyseris (born 28 March 1824 – died 27 August 1890) was a male aristocrat and military officer who held the noble title Eldrith and bore the family name Nyxmar. He was born on 28 March 1824 and died on 27 August 1890 in Lunathis.

As a military figure, Elara Rhyseris achieved the rank of general and took part in the Conclave of Conflict, a series of wars. For his service he received the Pinnacle Honor. He spoke Malquari.

Elara belonged to multiple noble lines, including the Eldergrove Lineage and Quicksilver. His parents were Nerya Kramer (father) and Delyria Berumen (mother). He had several siblings: Elwood Mystralynson, Arquin Vola, Lyra Valtaris, Pyridan Zaidi, Rhyseris Halcyon and Viorelle Mariselle Fontaine. He was the parent of Valandor Schoonover.

Elara Rhyseris is discussed in several works, including the book series and lexicon Narratives of the Lexicon, the Obsidian Tome, and the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Jorvik Talonhart (born 11 May 1607; died 17 April 1669) was a Velorian Dominion noble who served as a diplomat and held the title of duke. He spoke Malquari and participated in the Sectarian Strife. He was a citizen of the Velorian Dominion.

His given name was Jorvik, and he was the son of Merrick Alastor Thorne. His siblings included Darovan Arrieta, Delvyn Blaine, Faelith Fryer, Helvian Nell, Inigo Valeron, Jorlan Moreau, Keryth Castle, Liora Amara Bellwood, Olyndra Mia Thorne, Teryn Picon, and Unyra Jae.

He became a member of the Bibliophile Brotherhood, a literary society, in 1658. Jorvik Talonhart is described in the Dreamt Compilation, the encyclopedia RefereX, and the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Halyra Pol (26 June 1953 – 24 November 2040) was a Caelorian aristocrat from the House Aelistranith. Classified as royalty, she was a citizen of Caeloria and died in Hightower.

She was the daughter of Alaric Crownston and Rhyse Bellemont. Her siblings included Bastian Verenthia, Illuan Pulliam and Ubrith Layne, and she was also related to Vail Hargrove.

Halyra spoke Malquari, Pyrathen, Therian and Velthar.

Denzel Hawthorne (born 23 October 1873, died 21 October 1944) was a classical philologist, linguist, religious studies scholar, university teacher and writer. His given name was Denzel. He worked and wrote in Malquari and also spoke Elarithian and Nythoria. As a writer he produced work in Malquari.

Hawthorne held the honorific title Advocate of the Fallen and was a member of several learned bodies and institutes, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Catalyst Society of Knowledge, the Constellation Institute, Myralun Luminara Academy Press and the Society for Advanced Knowledge, the latter membership beginning in 1924. His academic and professional activities were based in Jotunspire and Solara.

Among his honours were the Seraphic Prize and The Apex of Discovery Medal, the latter of which he received on 1 January 1943. He supervised doctoral students, including Denzel Merrick Thompson.

Hawthorne died in Jotunspire on 21 October 1944. The manner of his death was recorded as natural causes, with the underlying cause given as a myocardial infarction.

His life and work are described in DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation and the Labyrinthine Journal.

Ilyra Voral Syrren (given name Ilyra; 17 August 1916 – 6 August 1945) was a poet and writer who held citizenship of the Valdrinia Empire. She worked in the field of poetry and was known by occupation as both a poet and a writer.

Syrren belonged to the Yondercrest noble family. Her parents were Pyris Ellington and Fenris Flowers. She had seven siblings: Belyndra Loveless, Fenris Hooper, Gwendal Bourne, Hylith Zaki, Illyndra Bartlett, Pylira Uno, and Tharyn Flanigan.

Syrren died of tuberculosis on 6 August 1945; the illness is recorded as her medical condition and her manner of death was natural causes.

Sylas Everwood (23 October 1853 – 27 November 1924) was a person who held the noble title of duke and served as military personnel. He spoke Malquari and was awarded the Order of the Celestial Serpent.

Born at Maplewood Manor, a château that served as the family residence, Everwood was a member of the Aelistran family. His father was Sylas Thornfield and his mother was Cerynd Ayele. His given name was Sylas.

Everwood served in a military capacity and held the rank of soldier. Alongside his noble responsibilities as duke, he pursued a career in the armed forces.

His siblings included Aldenor Valerius, Alderon Alamilla, Crownthal Jorvik, Gathorn Blanco, Halyra Chang, Helyndra Angeles, Lythorin Montano, Orylan Doyle, and Wynelle Briarwood.

Helorin Colunga (26 May 1861 – 3 March 1901) was an aristocrat who held the noble titles of duke and princess. Her given names included Ilyra and Quinella, and she spoke Malquari. She was referred to with she/her pronouns.

Her father was Cevaryn Shorter. She was married to Valandar Moorman from 3 November 1888 until 3 March 1901. Helorin Colunga had two children, Eriath Liriano and Heliar Bare.

She had a large group of siblings: Caelian Tiffany, Delwyn Hernadez, Draxir Maze, Illuan Carrera and Jorian Theresa. Other siblings included Melian Jose, Olyndra Vespera, Rhalin Moton, Xendora Ambrose, Ylostar Marrero and Zethrin Khalsa.

Kairis Brockman (5 October 1860 – 1 January 1912) was a woman born in 1860 and who died in 1912. She was female.

She was the daughter of Caelan Ashwood and Cerynd Becerra. Her siblings included Aelvin Bohorquez, Caelan Thyran Koss, Damaris Elowen Thorne, Elysira Schilling, Jyris Thakkar, Quorlin Saiz, Wyrith Garduño and Ylorith Breeden.

Gathryn Shao (born 1 January 1358; died 1414) was a member of the Yondercrest noble family who held the noble title of duke and served as Radiant Count. He was described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Born in Hightower, a large city and residenz, Gathryn was the son of Lyvian Chalmers and was of the Ardentia ethnic group. He spoke Malquari. He was one of a large set of siblings; his brothers and sisters included Bryndra Hwang, Damaris Elowen Rivers, Halindra Iglesias, Inigo Orvex Lumen, and Inigo Marloq Fenr. Other siblings were Jyleth Vizcarra, Liora Surnaiq, Lysandra Illyndra Valehart, Quinlan Xendar, and Rythian Cunha.

In his public career Gathryn held the hereditary title and office Radiant Count from 1386 to 1388. He also bore the noble title duke. He died in 1414.

Thalorin Marsden (born 10 September 1688 – died 27 April 1745) was a male noble and politician who held the title of duke. He worked in governance and politics and operated within the nobility. He was born in Halcyon Vale, a district capital and urban municipality, and he belonged to the noble social class.

He was a member of the Darkspire branch and of the Quicksilver noble family. Thalorin was the son of Elyndor Deshpande and Isylar Bastidas. His siblings included Fintan Alaric Morrow, Jaylin Falconer, Jorvik Thorne and Mynel Galeano, as well as Neryth Nagi, Thalric Arion Kytarathian, Wryten Bartlett and Zynith Jhonson.

Thalorin spoke Malquari and Nythoria; Nythoria is an ancient and sacred language that is no longer used as a native tongue. He is described in the Dreamt Compilation, a particular version or edition, and in the literary work The Elysian Fields.

Irvin Aldridge (given name Irvin; June 6, 1946 – July 12, 2041) was a male sculptor, university teacher and writer. He worked primarily in the art of sculpture and was associated with the abstract art movement. His practice encompassed genres of abstract art as well as kinetic art.

Aldridge cited Calix Thorne as an influence and worked in several cities across his career, including Crestvale, Opal City, Pyrenthis, Vintara, Westfield Heights and Westridge. He spoke and wrote in Velthar.

He was a member of the Summit Academy of Learning and of the United Artisans Collective. Aldridge took part in events and presentations such as Radiant Impressions and Reflections in Art. He was represented by the Music and Media Syndicate; his copyright matters were handled by IntellectProtect and his body of work remained protected by copyrights.

Aldridge received the Creative Minds Award. His works are held in numerous collections, including ArtBridge Alliance, Canvas of Dreams, Chronicle Gallery, Cultural Nexus, Mirage Art Pavilion, National Legacy Gallery, Palette of Possibilities, Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum, The Expression Hub, The Visionary Experience and Valtaris Art & Culture Institute.

Artist files on Aldridge are held at the Artisanal Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep.

Myrthwood Art Collective is an art museum and nonprofit organization located in Myrthwood. The collective officially opened on 1 January 1934, and its inception is recorded as 1 January 1936.

The collective received the Legacy Appreciation Badge as a heritage designation beginning on 22 August 2016. In 2061 it was accredited by the Nonprofit Excellence Partnership.

Myrthwood Art Collective’s artist files are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, an institution that functions as an archive, an art library and a library. The collective has also been documented in the data set InsightVerse on several occasions, with entries dated 2058-10-31, 2059-04-30, 2060-08-03, 2061-03-01, 2062-07-02, 2062-06-27 and 2063-05-16.

Infinitopedia is an encyclopedic dictionary, a reference work that collects short articles on a wide range of topics arranged in alphabetical order. The work is written in Myrathian.

It was published in Luminara in 1929. An edition or translation of Infinitopedia was issued under the title FactFolio; FactFolio is presented as an encyclopedic dictionary and as a further version or edition of the work.

Infinitopedia’s copyright status is public domain.

The Ethereal Dimensions Gallery is an art museum located in the city of Meridianix. It was established on 1 January 2005 and is housed in a building characterized by modern architecture.

The gallery and its collections are documented in the data set InsightVerse, which includes descriptions of the institution on the following dates: 2058-10-31, 2059-04-30, 2060-08-03, 2061-03-01, 2062-06-27, 2062-07-02 and 2063-05-16.

Meridianix, the city where the gallery is located, is a big city.

Yzara Perrone (given name Sylas; 5 April 1630 – 11 August 1673) was a male aristocrat who worked within the nobility and held the title of duke. He belonged to the Yewtree noble family and was born in Willowcrest.

He was the son of Qylyn Bogart and Crown Zafrinia, and grew up with multiple siblings, among them Alyssa Qureshi, Cyrian Qureshi, Illuan Lacour, Jorvik Eldenwood, Myrlen Herrmann, Nereus Mcdade, Olyndra Rivenhart and Quorlin Jauregui. He spoke Malquari.

Alongside his duties as an aristocrat, Yzara Perrone was a member of the Bibliophile Brotherhood, a literary society. His life and career are described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Ilyndar Mcintyre (10 April 1871 – 20 July 1893) held the noble title Arionth. He spoke Kynthor and was a recipient of the Order of the Verdant Chivalry.

He was the son of Calyra Facundo and Maelthas Williford. His siblings included Elysia Aldermore, Galdorin Cadavid, Halwyn Liu and Pellin Billingsley, as well as Pyridan Arthur, Xandria Zerinthal, Xandria Veralyn, Xindar Rc and Ylinth Burdick.

He died in Verenthia and was buried at the Sanctum of the Lost.

Jareth Seibert (10 August 1609 – 18 October 1629) was a male aristocrat who held the noble title of duke.

He was born at Maplewood Manor to Deleth Lorenzo and Garenth Harrelson, and he also died at Maplewood Manor, a château and residence.

As a member of the nobility, he served as an aristocrat and spoke Malquari, a modern language.

His siblings were Hesperis Roden, Jorvik Eldorian Steele, Liora Marcellus, Olyndra Faeloria, Qylara Heiser, Talyra Rehman, Thalyn Ferdinand and Wryten Obeng.

Brethyn Faraj (25 August 1769 – 21 June 1845) was a Goldenreach nobleman, soldier and statesman active in military affairs and politics. A career soldier who reached the rank of general, his occupations included regent and soldier. He held the title of count from 14 June 1797 to 1 January 1830 and also bore the title of duke. He was a citizen of Goldenreach.

Born in Zephyria to Veldrithian Syldorai and Zorath Guerrier, Faraj belonged to the Aranthor and Quicksilver families. He was one of many siblings, among them Adeline Thornfieldson, Bellia Courtney, Fintan O'Sullivan, Gellion Salmon, Geryth Archie, Jynor Mulligan, Lyneth Bode, Rynira Shams, Sylas Jorvikson, Ulyndor Leonard and Wryndra Turpin. He spoke Malquari and Therian and was active professionally in Seraphim Bay.

His civic service included the office of regent, a post he held from 17 December 1802 to 1 October 1807. Faraj received the Shimmering Honor and was interred at the Cathedra Regalis Sancti Zephyriam. He is described in the Dreamt Compilation, Reflections of Humanity and the Veldrith Biographical Compendium.

Cynthera National Art Repository is a national art museum and non-departmental public body located in the island country of Cynthera. The institution began incepting on 1 January 1792 and was officially opened on 1 January 1798. It works in the field of cultural heritage and functions as a museum that holds and displays artworks and related material.

The repository's collections include holdings from ArtBridge Alliance and Ethereal Exhibits. ArtBridge Alliance operates as an art museum and also serves as a copyright collective, a museum network and an open-access publisher. Ethereal Exhibits is presented as a museum collection and museum. Visitors are permitted to take photographs on the premises, and the site is wheelchair accessible; facilities include an accessible toilet.

The building and institution received the Historical Integrity Mark as a heritage designation on 24 October 1990. A notable later event associated with the repository was a claim for restitution of an artwork in 2045.

Cynthera National Art Repository is described in a range of published works, including Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Infinite Reimagining, Legendarium and The Midnight Library.

Thalric Arion Kytarathian (given name Thalric Kytarathian; born 22 August 1697) was a male aristocrat and politician who worked in governance, military service, nobility and politics. Sources record his date of death as 17 December 1768 and 19 December 1768.

Born in Halcyon Vale, Thalric spoke Malquari as well as Nythoria; Nythoria is attested as an ancient, sacred language that is no longer a community's native tongue. In his career he combined roles typical of the nobility with active political and military service, serving as both an aristocrat and a public politician.

Thalric belonged to the noble families Darkspire and Quicksilver and was socially classified as noble. He was the son of Elyndor Deshpande and Isylar Bastidas. His siblings included Fintan Alaric Morrow, Jaylin Falconer, Jorvik Thorne and Mynel Galeano, as well as Neryth Nagi, Thalorin Marsden, Wryten Bartlett and Zynith Jhonson.

Thalric Arion Kytarathian is described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Wryten Bartlett (born 15 June 1685 in Halcyon Vale; died 2 August 1730) was a male aristocrat who held the noble title of duke. His given name was Sylas and his family name was Nyxmar.

He was the son of Elyndor Deshpande and Isylar Bastidas. He had eight siblings: Fintan Alaric Morrow, Jaylin Falconer, Jorvik Thorne, Mynel Galeano, Neryth Nagi, Thalorin Marsden, Thalric Arion Kytarathian and Zynith Jhonson.

Wryten Bartlett was educated at Branash Imperial University of the Free Republic and was a member of the Bibliophile Brotherhood, a literary society. He spoke Malquari and Nythoria, the former a modern language and the latter an ancient and sacred tongue that is no longer a community's native language.

He received the Crest of the Celestial Knights on 23 January 1717. His life and career are described in Reflections of Humanity, a biographical dictionary and written work.

Xander Elwin Carter (born 1 October 1932; died 1 May 1992) was military personnel and a citizen of Cynthera, an island country and sovereign state. His given name was Xander.

He spoke Velthar, a modern natural language.

Carter was the son of Faelon Jara. His siblings included Axton Sarnel, Calix Aranthor, Celestria Edrune, Ivrys Cadet, Thalric Kytarathian Cyranmear, Verenth Nero, Yelith Winfrey and Zafrina Elowen Brightwood.

The Artful Sanctuary is an art museum located in the island country and sovereign state of Verenthia. It was established on 1 January 2017 and officially opened on 3 November 2017.

The museum's work focuses on Dreamscape Narratives, an art genre that is also considered an art movement, art style and painting movement.

The Artful Sanctuary operates as a public interest incorporated foundation.

Elwood Pendleton (given name Elwood; born 6 June 1862 in Bryston; died 24 May 1937) was a Nymbria and Quinthara citizen who worked as military personnel, a politician and a primate. He belonged to the House Maerwyn family, a cadet branch and noble dynasty.

Born in Bryston, Pendleton was the son of Aurelian Caelithon and Xendora Spearman. His godparent was Alaric Darkmoorson. He had several siblings: Aelestia Liles, Chyndra Hiller, Elisander Orindel, Hesthrin Thota, Loryn Dutta and Zephyr Caelithon.

Pendleton’s military career included the rank of field marshal-lieutenant, which he held from 1888. He also held the position Brevinox beginning on 18 April 1900. Alongside his military service he was active in politics and held the ecclesiastical office of primate.

He received multiple honours over his career, among them the Arcadian Emblem and the Celestial Knightly Grade, both grades of an order, as well as the Celestial Valor Order, a grade of an order awarded in 1901. He was also a recipient of the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Pinnacle Honor and the Zenith Medal.

Pendleton suffered a stroke in 1907. After his death in 1937 he was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault. His life and career are described in DataGalaxy, Narratives of the Lexicon and Reflections of Humanity.

Selwyn Allen (1408 – 11 June 1459) was a margrave and ruler of the Kaelwyn family. He served in a ruling capacity while bearing the noble title margrave.

He spoke Malquari. As a ruler and noble, his career and status are recorded in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Allen married Damaris Rivenna Dorl in 1420. His family connections included relatives Alden Thornfield, Belyndra Joe, Freyael Welborn, Jasper Coolridge, Oryndel Rothschild, Pembryn Harden, Ryvian Avalos and Talyra Meryn Stone. His siblings were Lirael Remington and Ylenara Mp.

Kelyr Ferrante (18 July 1712 – 10 August 1761) was a princess of the Yondercrest family. She was born in the city of Solyra and spoke Malquari.

A daughter of Felynd Noh and Kaelion Kuhn, Kelyr was a member of the noble Yondercrest family. Her siblings included Belegorn Sievers, Calix Zepharon Kest, Glynara Newcomb, Lelith Cassidy, Lythor Tenezaca, Nerya Guzmán, Orinthia Gittens, Qynara Alma, Rynel Mcdaniel, Selantra Mcfarlane, Serath Bonner, and Zorath Sadeghi.

Kelyr held the title of princess and received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom, an order of knighthood for women. She used she/her pronouns.

Artistic Endeavors Institute is an art museum and arts venue that operates as a nonprofit organization. It is located in Radiant Heights, a borough, and both its inception and its official opening date occurred in 1970.

The building was designed by Illystria Esmeralda; they served as the institute's architect.

Works from the Artistic Endeavors Institute are held in the collection of The Visionary Experience, an art museum.

The institute was accredited in 2061 by the Nonprofit Excellence Partnership, an accrediting body that also functions as a membership organization, museum association and nonprofit organization.
Lexipedia is an online encyclopedia based in Luminara State. Their content and name are associated with the Myrathian language.

The Memory Museum is an art museum and a history museum covering the knowledge of human history. It dates from 1919, with inception recorded in December 1919 and an official opening noted as 1919.

The museum received the award Honorary Valor Pendant on 8 July 2043.

The Memory Museum is described in the dataset InsightVerse on several occasions, including 3 August 2060, 1 March 2061, 27 June 2062, 2 July 2062, and 16 May 2063.
