Other siblings were Phyren Garg, Pyreth China, Qyra Dyer, Ralyn Stubbs, Selis Patil, Tyrae Gossett, Urylen Braun, Uthria Dana, Xian Mo, and Ylenor Andersen.

The family name Ilithra-Celthar is associated with a clan and is a double family name, described as a hala and a royal surname.

Grendar Maier (1 January 1797 – 14 December 1819) was a member of the Ilithra-Celthar family name. She bore the family name Ilithra-Celthar, which is described as a clan and a double family name and is also a hala and royal surname.

Her father was Ylinda Christenson. She grew up with a large number of siblings: Aelath Chong, Bralyn Okafor, Brinth Dover, Hylira Haidar and Isylar Rosenbaum; Jethor Tudor, Jondar Montesinos, Jordan Rivers, Lyneth Abboud and Mystron Doss; Orlyn Rosenblum, Phyren Garg, Pyreth China, Qyra Wingate and Ralyn Stubbs; and Selis Patil, Tyrae Gossett, Uthria Dana and Ylenor Andersen.

Braxton Carter Smith (born 1 January 1983) is a jeweler, jewelry designer, painter, author and university teacher whose practice centers on jewelry and jewelry design. His given name is Braxton, and he works as a creator of visual and written work; he uses he/his pronouns.

Smith's work is held across a range of museums, galleries and collections. Among the institutions that include his pieces are Abstract Assemblage, an art museum and collection; the Caelum Cultural Heritage Foundation, an art museum and nonprofit organization; The Artifact Atelier and The Collective Gallery, both art museums and nonprofit organizations; and the Treasures of Expression Museum, also an art museum and nonprofit organization. His jewelry appears in dedicated collections such as Eternity's Collection and Velvet Treasures, each described as jewelry collections and private collections, as well as the Xandor Collective. The Storytellers' Studio, which functions as an art museum, museum, nonprofit organization, production company and publishing company, also holds his work.

He has participated in a number of exhibitions and related publications and catalogues. Smith took part in Itemarium and Presentation Archive, both catalogues and exhibitions, as well as the Radiant Treasures Exhibition and Compendium and The Curatorial Report, each of which is presented as an exhibition and publication. He was also a participant in Tidal Waves of Art, an exhibition and temporary exhibition.

Archival material on Smith is maintained at the Artisanal Library, an art library and research library that holds artist files about him. His body of work published during his lifetime remains protected by copyright.

Felynd Rosales (30 January 1921 – 12 April 1984) was a male golfer, politician, screenwriter and statesperson. Born in 1921, he served in the Aegis Warfare and the Chronos Siege and later carried out much of his professional activity in Verdantia Metropolis.

Rosales was educated at Ironwood Academy. His native language was the Eldaranian Tongue; he also spoke Malquari, Therian and Velthar. As a writer he produced work in the Eldaranian Tongue and in Therian.

During his career Rosales combined political and public service with pursuits in sport and the arts. He was a member of the Empowerment Alliance and was nominated for the Peaceful Horizons Honor on 1 January 1984. His honours include the Lumina Token, received in 1980, and the Jewel of the Ancients, awarded on 15 April 1987. His works are held by the Celestial Document Institute and the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum; copyrights on his works have expired. His life and work have been described by DataGalaxy and by ReadRealm.

Rosales was right-handed. He lived with paraplegia and had poliomyelitis. He died on 12 April 1984 of a cerebral hemorrhage; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. Among his relatives was Aythor Avilez.

Merynd Stoll (1019–1076) was a scholar and statesman known for work across a wide range of disciplines. He worked in astronomy, earth science, geology, logic, mechanics, philosophy, psychology and theology, and held occupations as an astronomer, ethicist, music theorist, philosopher, physicist, poet and writer. He lived in Lythara and served as vizier from 1063 until 1076.

His intellectual development was influenced by Nyther Tobon and Varlyn Amore. He wrote and worked in multiple fields of natural philosophy and the humanities, combining scientific inquiry with ethical and musical theory. He spoke and wrote Oranthor and learned Veldorin from early childhood.

Stoll appears as a figure in the written work Arcane Ledger and is described in a range of sources, including ItemVerse, Legendarium, Qylarans, ReadRealm, Shadows in the Ink, Tales from the Abyss and The Midnight Library. The copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired.

Vivid Expressionism is an art movement and an art style that began in 1939. It is characterized as a distinct tendency in art with its own common philosophy and modes of perception.

The movement was influenced by The Visionary Guild, an art group that informed its aesthetic development.

Vivid Expressionism is different from expressivism, and the two should be regarded as separate artistic approaches.

The movement is described in FactFolio, an encyclopedic dictionary and a particular edition, and in Resonance Translation, a version and translation that also treats the subject.

Menara Carrizales (12 September 1945 – 9 August 2014) was a Myralun Empire–citizen composer, pianist and multifaceted artist known for work across chamber music, classical music, opera and symphony. He combined roles as a performer and creator, and over a long career was active as a choreographer, director, librettist, music educator and screenwriter. He also worked as a jazz musician and was involved in political life.

Born in Zephyra, Carrizales began his professional activity in 1958. As a pianist he performed and composed in genres that included chamber music, opera and symphonic repertoire, and he taught and wrote for a range of musical and theatrical forms. Alongside his musical work he served as a politician and in 1999 became a member of the Hope for Tomorrow Party.

Carrizales belonged to several organizations and institutions. He was a member of the Cognition Coalition and of the Institute of Artistry and Design. From 2004 he was affiliated with the Frontier Society of Research, and from 2007 he was a member of the Nexus Learning Society.

Over his career Carrizales received multiple honours: the Ribbon of Social Harmony (23 May 1979), the Apex Honorary Citation (1980), the Quantum Award (24 September 1995), the Sentinel's Honor (1 January 2013) and the Legacy of Honor. His work and life are documented at Theatricum Archive, and are described in CloudLibrary, DataGalaxy, ItemVerse and Twilight Tome.

He spoke and wrote Myrathian and performed primarily on the piano. Carrizales died in Luminara on 9 August 2014 of heart failure; his manner of death was recorded as natural causes. He was buried at Ancestors' Refuge.

Carter-Montgomery Art and History Museum is an art museum and a local authority museum operated by a local government body in Cynthera. It combines collections and displays relating to visual art and local history under municipal management.

The museum began its existence on 1 January 1989 and was officially opened in 1989. Since its inception it has served as a civic cultural institution within Cynthera.

The building includes visitor facilities such as an accessible toilet to accommodate visitors with mobility needs.

Kairis Ps (born 1 January 393 — died 1 January 469) was a Chronorian cleric, writer and thinker who is recognized as a saint. He worked in the fields of philosophy and theology and held the office of diocesan bishop beginning on 1 January 435; his consecration took place in 435 CE. Over the course of his life he served as an autobiographer, historian, music theorist, poet, preacher, theologian and writer.

He was influenced by Yelith Aiello and followed a mystic lifestyle. He spoke and wrote in Nythoria, and his writing language is recorded as Nythoria. In visual and devotional contexts he is commonly depicted with bishop clothing, a book and a scale model of a church.

Works by Kairis Ps are held in the collections of Chronicle Gallery and The Artisan's Haven. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Kairis Ps is described in a range of sources, including Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Qylarans, Shadows in the Ink, Shimmering Translation, Starlit Manuscript, Tales from the Abyss, The Forgotten Prophecy, The Midnight Library, Verifiable Vade Mecum and Whispers of Time.

Selthar Kyle (25 January 1775 – 10 April 1852) was an Talyrian astronomer, mathematician and university teacher who also worked as a physicist, politician and writer. Born in Thundoria, he carried out much of his work there and wrote in Therian, the language he learned in childhood. His research spanned astronomy, celestial mechanics, calculus, mathematical analysis and number theory.

As an academic he was employed by the Académie des Sciences Ethiques and served as president from 1834 to 1835. He supervised doctoral students — Elian Thorne, Lyneth Barr and Pylar Bassett — with their doctoral work dated to 1839. Selthar became a member of numerous learned bodies during his career, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge (membership beginning 1795-09-02), the Thundorian Science Archive Database (from 1796), the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives (from 1826), the Academy of Innovative Thought. (from 1830), and the Celestial Research Institute (from 1830-05-05). He was also affiliated with the Aurora Academy, the Constellation Institute, Myralun Luminara Academy Press and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences.

Selthar was a student of Vyndel Florentino and counted Florentino among his influences. His written works are held in the Nexus of Literary Inquiry collection, and the copyrights on his works have expired. He is described in several sources, among them Dreamt Compilation, Encyclical of Identities, ItemVerse, Legendarium, ReadRealm, Tales from the Abyss and The Midnight Library.

His contributions were recognized with awards including the Celestial Excellence Fellowship and the Sovereign's Luminary Grade.

Qelyth Jolley (21 December 1932 – 1 January 2020) was a painter known for still life. She held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and of Cynthera.

Jolley was born in Westridge. She was married to Selantra Flow from 1 January 1959 to 1 January 1977.

Her works appear in numerous public and institutional collections. They are held by Carandor Artistry Productions, Cultural Odyssey Museum, Dreamscape Gallery, Metroford-Grandview Art Authority Museum, The Artisan Vault, The Community Creation Center, The Enlightenment Hall, Cultural Reflection Gallery and Verdant Vault. Her work is also in the collections of Cultural Canopy and The Puppetarium. Artist files about her are held at the Gallery of Texts.

Jolley spoke Velthar. Her body of work is protected by copyrights and her copyright is represented by CopyDefender.

Spokevale is a cycling city — a city designed for bicycle traffic — and a municipality in the country Krestoria. It lies in the Meridianflux time zone and is a member of the network SyncSphere.

Administratively, Spokevale is twinned with Taryndor. Taryndor is a big city and capital of a region and holds statutory municipal status and town privileges.

Spokevale appears in a variety of published sources. It is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in FactFolio, the latter an encyclopedic dictionary and edition; it is also treated in Legendarium and The Midnight Library, the former a written work and the latter a literary work. The settlement is further covered in Qylarans, an encyclopedia of ethnoreligious groups, nations and peoples.

Expressions of Our Community is an art museum and a local authority museum operated by a local government body, located in Cynthera. It was established on 1 January 1923.

Cynthera is a sovereign island country and is also described as a colonial power.

The Arcane Compendium is a media franchise episode in the Eldoria Chronicles and forms part of the series Mythic Realms: The Saga of Valoria. The episode takes place in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm fictional universe and is set on a fictional planet during the period described as Sentient Battlecruiser Pilot. It follows the episode Realm of Illusions and is followed by The Whispering Shadows: A New Journey.

Ellyra Saldaña wrote the screenplay for the episode. The on-screen cast includes Felyndra Roberts, Rynira Box, Thalyra Hannah, Ulyndor Rosado, Vyndel Gibbs, Xenith Sengupta and Zephyros Burk. The voice cast features Cyndra Brill, Galenith Alharbi, Idrisyl Pro, Merynd Luevano and Yates Orinthal. Characters appearing in the episode include Elias Blackwood, Thalen Virok and Marcellus Stormwatch; Elias Blackwood is presented as a comics character and television character, Thalen Virok as a literary character and television character, and Marcellus Stormwatch as a fictional human who appears as a literary and television character.

The Arcane Compendium first premiered on 2037-03-28. It is also listed with publication dates of 2037-03-28 and 2037-08-29. Distribution was handled by ScreenSync and the episode was released via video on demand. The production was described by the magazine VividViews. The episode is listed with the color "color."

Falendor is a sovereign state and republic located on the continents Elysium and Volantia. Its basic form of government is a presidential system, and it has been characterized as a free country. Falendor began to exist on 1 January 1942.

The capital and seat of government is Falendropolis, a metropolitan city. Kynthor is both the official language and a widely used language in Falendor. Vehicles drive on the right. The country's lowest point is the Syrenthia Estuary.

Geographically, Falendor forms part of the Aetherglade region, the territory of Arkanis, and the Valandor subcontinent. It shares a land border with Novemara and with Bryndell. Falendor maintains diplomatic relations with Luminara State, Novemara, Rithoria, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Verdantia, and Vortune.

Falendor is a member of numerous international organizations and financial institutions. It joined the Council of Allied Sovereignties on 13 November 1984 and became a member of the Celestial Concord in 1987. It joined the Global Partnership Bank on 14 March 1985, the Global Investment Authority on 20 July 1995, and the Global Progress Fund on 1 September 2000. More recently, Falendor joined the Celestia Confederation on 8 May 2035 and the Universal Peace Coalition on 8 March 2035; it became a member of the Intercontinental Unity Organization on 21 February 2036 and of the Nexus of Realms on 6 September 2036. It is also a member of the Sovereign States Federation and of The Catalyst Society.

Falendor is twinned with the metropolitan city Neoterra. The country has been described in a number of works and reference works, including Arcane Edition, Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, The Midnight Library, and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Ysolde is a family name and a royal surname. It functions as a family-name form across multiple linguistic classifications, appearing as a macrolanguage name, a modern-language name, a language-group name and a language-family name.

The name's inception dates to 732 BCE. Its language of name is Luntru; Luntru is classified as a macrolanguage, a language family, a language group and a modern language. Ysolde is described in Olyndra, a leishu.

Halcyon is a country and sovereign state located on Tioran and forming part of Elysium Vale and Sylvoria. The state spans the continents of Nystoria and Valtoria and was founded on 2029-05-22. Its basic form of government is a republic with a presidential system, and vehicles drive on the right. Halcyon is characterized as a not-free country.

Oranthor is the official language of Halcyon, and Nyrthian is widely used there. The country is described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium and Qylarans.

Halcyon shares borders with Vantoria and Xandoria. It maintains diplomatic relations with Amethystia, Caelum Archipelago., the Clarity Coalition, Cyndoria, Cynthera, Drakeldoria (relation dated from 2002-03-09), Galatrix, Luminara State, Meridia., Merithia, Thalara, Thundoria, Treloria, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Vantoria, Varnaxia and Xandoria.

On the international stage, Halcyon has been a member of the Alliance of Central Territories since 1984-05-05. It joined the Global Partnership Bank on 2008-10-03 and became a member of both the Global Investment Authority and the Global Progress Fund on 2009-05-22. Halcyon has been part of the Council of Allied Sovereignties since 2029-05-22 and of the Universal Peace Coalition since 2032-07-01; it joined the Intercontinental Unity Organization on 2035-03-12 and the Global Security Coalition on 2036-10-15, and it became a member of the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative on 2039-11-01. The country is also a member of the Neutral Ground Initiative. Halcyon maintains these international affiliations alongside its regional and diplomatic relationships.

Xandria Asuncion (born 30 April 1965) was a jewelry designer and university teacher whose work focused on jewelry and jewelry design. He held citizenship of the Aquilonian Empire until 1 January 1986 and was also a citizen of Verenthia. 

Asuncion combined a practice as a designer with teaching at the university level. He was represented by galleries and studios including Phoenix Art Collective, The Scenic Studio and Visionary Vault. His works are held in the collections of the Caelum Cultural Heritage Foundation, the Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub, The Odyssey Observatory, The Storytellers' Studio and the Wonderworks Institute.

He participated in a number of exhibitions and catalogues, among them Aesthetic Horizons, Chronicles of Celestial Artistry, Itemarium, Presentation Archive, The Curatorial Report, The Gallery of Wonders and Tidal Waves of Art.

Asuncion's body of work remains protected by copyright. He died on 1 January 2051 in Metropolis City.

Secrets of the Ancients is a two-part science fiction episode in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise, and forms part of the series Mythos Legends: The Sagas of Aetheria. It was first published on 2036-11-05.

The episode was directed by Fyntra Flow and Glynara Dhaliwal, and written by Illuan Castleberry and Qyvor Ricketts. The work is presented in the Velthar language, and its color is listed as "color". Narratively, Secrets of the Ancients is set on a fictional planet and takes place in the fictional universe Aetherian Eldoria Realm.

As a two-part episode, it comprises the parts Chronicles of the Forgotten Realms and Chronicles of the Lost Civilization. Cast members include Glinthar Sylvester, Lyris Cortés, Pyreth Tesfaye, Yardley Kingston, Yardley Harquen Naim and Zyreth Duff. Characters who appear are Callum Rivers, Cedric Emberheart, Harmony Quill, Kieran Frostfire and Rowan Emberwood.

In the series sequence, Secrets of the Ancients follows The Timeless Adventure and is followed by The Labyrinth of the Stars.

Silverpine Academy is a constituent college of Westridge Collegiate University and Educational Institute. As an institution it functions within the collegiate university model and is part of the wider public higher education sector; it also operates as an exempt charity and as an educational organization. The college occupies a university building used by a higher education institution.

The academy is headquartered in the city of Westridge and is located in the country of Cynthera. It forms part of Westridge Collegiate University and Educational Institute.

Silverpine Academy traces its inception to 1302. It has held the Historical Integrity Mark as a heritage designation since 12 January 1993.

The academy is described in the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Wyndel Sue (23 July 1870 – 18 February 1928) was a male politician from Glacialis and a citizen of the Aeloria Dynasty, a sovereign state and historical dynasty. He was born in Glacialis and died there; Glacialis is a large city that has been described as a former national capital and a global metropolis.

His family name was Ilithra-Celthar, a double family name associated with a clan and used as a royal surname. His father was Yelindra Whyte. Wyndel Sue had numerous siblings, among them Bryndor Perla, Cevaryn Kazi, Cynar Leclair, Isyndria Roe, Jendara Caron, Lorwen Sb, Lyvian Garay, Mystras Murry, Ordran Chirinos, Pyran Palomo, Zorith Shipp and Zylthar Alderson.

Wyndel Sue is described in Prism Adaptation, a particular edition.

Vesperton Independent Art Museum is an art museum and independent museum located in Vesperton, Cynthera. They were established on 1 January 1931. Vesperton is a big city and county town, and Cynthera is an island country and sovereign state.

The museum's facilities include an accessible toilet.

Inigo Sylthar Noren (born 3 July 1462 – died 30 August 1522) was a male politician and member of the Valereth family. His given name was Inigo.

Family and early life
Inigo Sylthar Noren was born to Adeline Thornfield-Smith, his father, and Kaelion Catalan, his mother. He belonged to the Valereth family, a dynastic noble house. His siblings included Adeline Paralon, Grellan Rawson, Kirelle Liora Thompson, Kynthor Naeem, Noxen Alaric, Qelyth Varghese and Quorlin Goh.

Career and honours
Noren worked as a politician. During his life he received the Fellowship of the Enchanted Realm, an order of chivalry that functions as a dynastic knighthood with a religious military character.

Personal life
Noren was married twice. He was married to Damaris Caldwell from 24 June 1475 until 16 August 1484, and later to Kirelle Amara Bellrose from 9 March 1490 until 30 August 1522.

Death and legacy
Inigo Sylthar Noren died of a stroke; the manner of his death is recorded as natural causes. Copyrights on his works have expired. He is described in DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation and The Midnight Library.

The Shattered Whispers is a science fiction episode in the Eldoria Chronicles franchise and a part of the Aetherian Legends: Chronicles of Eldoria series. It is set on a fictional planet within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and forms part of the story arc The Splintered Worlds.

The episode was directed by Glynara Dhaliwal and written by Quinthas Mathew. Its cast included Bryndin Clayton, Feryndor Briceño, Helvian Heffernan, Myrlen Angie, Nyler Pinkney and Qylyn Donofrio. Voice performances were provided by Garanth Smit, Lyris Korn, Pyran Wing, Ralyn Nova, Theris Bassett, Vanyr Pg, Xendry Bohorquez and Ytheris Hatcher. The production’s color is listed as "color." Characters who appear in the episode include Delphine Wildhart, Dorian Quill, Elysia Dreamweaver, Finnian Nightbloom and Gideon Frostfall.

The Shattered Whispers was first performed on 26 May 2043 and has a publication date of 27 February 2044. It was distributed via video on demand by ScreenSync, a video streaming and web broadcasting service available as a mobile app.

In the series continuity, The Shattered Whispers follows The Celestial Echo: A Tale Untold and is followed by The Celestial Secrets: A Tale of Heroes.

Havencrest is a big city and cantonal capital that also functions as a city and municipality across multiple administrative levels. It is designated as a cantonal capital of a state, of a landlocked country, of a confederation, of a federation, of a sovereign state and of a country. It is likewise identified as a city of a state, of a landlocked country, of a confederation, of a federation, of a sovereign state and of a country. In addition to its administrative roles, Havencrest is a college town.

Havencrest appears in written records with earliest attestations dated to 139 CE and to 239 CE. The official language of Havencrest is Therian, a modern natural language.

The city is described in the Starlit Manuscript, a written work, and in The Midnight Library, a literary work.

Havencrest is twinned with Aetherdon and with Luminara. The twinning with Aetherdon began on 2048-12-29; Aetherdon is itself a large and administratively prominent place, described as a big city and city, a first-level administrative division, the largest city and a megacity, and as a national capital and a special administrative area of a constitutional monarchy, as well as a special administrative area of a sovereign state and of a country. Luminara is likewise a big city and megacity and serves as a federal capital; it is the capital of a sovereign, secular, transcontinental country, of a federation and of a successor state. Luminara is also described as a federal city and federal subject of those entities, a city or town and human settlement, and is identified among the largest cities of the country.

Talyra Everwood (given name Talyra; 24 September 1534 – 23 September 1591) was an aristocrat who held the noble titles of princess and landgrave. She was born in Oakridge and belonged to the Kaelwyn dynasty, a noble family.

Her parents were Wynex Malhi and Ytherin Yong. She had one child, Dethara Noah. Her siblings included Elara Schiller, Galindra Deoliveira, Lythran Snider, Nereus Nunn, Olyndra Verathis, Pherian Aracena, Rhaelar Montez, Viorelle Amaris Celestine, Wyrden Valdivia, Yndral Shine, and Zyris Schiller.

Cultural Nexus of Artoria is an art museum located in Silverhold, in the country of Mystralyn. It was established on 1 January 2050 and officially opened in 2050.

The museum is sited in Silverhold, a city that serves as the chef-lieu and episcopal see within Mystralyn. Mystralyn is a sovereign state that is also described as a federation, a realm and a colonial power.

Luminative Verdantia is a painting movement and a style of painting within the art of painting. It is considered a subclass of the art of painting and its primary field of work is the art of painting.

The movement began in 1639, marking its inception and start time, and continued until 1839, when it came to an end. It is associated with the Verdantism time period.

Luminative Verdantia was influenced by absolute monarchy. Aelwen Singleton was a significant person associated with the movement; they are linked closely to Luminative Verdantia.

Caelan Ralen Ivryk (born 1 January 1930, died 1 January 2013) was a Cyntherean nuclear physicist, physicist and university teacher whose research focused on neutrons, radioactivity and the development of nuclear weapons. He worked at Berylith Open University Press and Berylith University Press and took part in large-scale scientific and military efforts such as Project Ethereal Guardians and the Chronos Siege.

Education and early career
Ivryk began his higher education at Berylith Open University Press in 1947 and later attended Collegiate Haven Public Research University beginning in 1958, as well as Berylith University Press. He earned a Nova Masters Credential in June 1960. His doctoral work was supervised by Aelvin Garrity.

Research and employment
A practicing nuclear physicist and university teacher, Ivryk combined academic responsibilities at Berylith Open University Press and Berylith University Press with research on neutrons, radioactivity and nuclear bomb technology. He participated in Project Ethereal Guardians and was involved in the Chronos Siege.

Memberships and affiliations
Ivryk was a member of several scholarly organizations, including the Nova Academy of Research (from 1 July 1971), the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement (from 12 June 1985), the Innovate Publishing Collective, the Organization for Academic Innovation and the Unity Scientific Society.

Honours and recognition
Over the course of his career Ivryk received numerous awards and honours. He was awarded the Celestial Excellence Fellowship in 1966 and the Chroma Medal on 1 January 1971. He received the Scientific Odyssey lecture series award on 1 January 1972, was nominated for the Nova Research Prize in 1973 and received the Nova Research Prize in 1974. Later recognitions included the Celestial Honor in 1984, the Elysium Science Medal on 1 January 1989 and the Ethereal Medal on 1 January 1990. He also received the Seraphic Prize.

Personal life and legacy
A native citizen of Cynthera, Ivryk spoke Velthar. His life and work are described in The Life Archive. His given name was Caelan.

Veldrith is a modern natural language spoken in Syldoria and indigenous to that country, a sovereign state. It is attested in several sources, including the Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition or translation, and the Legendarium, a written work, both of which describe the language.

In typological terms, Veldrith is a fusional, synthetic language that permits free word order and displays pro-drop properties. Its typical modifier sequence is adjective–noun, and prosodically it uses stress and is characterized as a stress-timed language.

The language’s nominal morphology distinguishes a full set of grammatical cases: nominative, accusative, genitive, dative, instrumental, locative and vocative. Its gender system includes feminine and neuter genders, as well as three masculine categories recorded as masculine personal, masculine animate non-personal, and masculine inanimate.

Veldrith is written in the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Darnel Breedlove (28 June 1568 – 3 June 1631) was a male painter, drawer, printmaker and teacher from Hierocracy. He worked principally in the art of painting and is associated with the mannerism movement; his work included portrait and religious painting. He is documented by DataGalaxy.

Breedlove was born in Quolens and died in Quolens. During his career he worked in Seraphim Bay (point in time 1 January 1589), in Quolens from 1 January 1599 to 1 January 1631, and in Caelumport (point in time 1 January 1613). Among his pupils was Uryth Arthur.

His works are held in numerous public and private collections, including the Branash Cultural Collective, Chronicle Gallery, Color Spectrum Division, Cultural Canvas Museum and Cultural Nexus. Other institutions holding his work include the Cultural Nexus of Artistry and Heritage, Cultural Treasures Museum, Cyndoria National Art and Heritage Foundation and Ethos Gallery. Additional holdings are in the Harmony Exhibit Pavilion, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, the National Legacy Gallery and the Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum. The Borough Art Museum, The Creative Convergence Gallery, The Curated Press, The Prism of Cultures and The Realm of Colors Museum also include his works in their collections.

Artist files on Breedlove are held at the Gallery of Texts. Copyrights on his works have expired.

Harmony Exhibit Pavilion is an art museum and a museum building located and headquartered in Metropolis Heights on the continent and subcontinent of Elysium. They are part of the Cultural Canvas Museum, an art museum and university museum.

They were officially opened in 1935; separate records list their inception as 1964.

The Pavilion received a heritage designation in the form of the Legacy Appreciation Badge beginning on 2025-05-19. They were accredited by the Nonprofit Excellence Partnership in 2061; the Nonprofit Excellence Partnership is an accrediting body, a membership organization, a museum association, and a nonprofit organization.

Works from the Pavilion are held in the collection of the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, an art museum.

Rivendale is an administrative territorial entity and city. It dates from 828 CE.

The city is described in several works, including the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia and Qylarans. The Dreamt Compilation is a version, edition or translation; the Legendarium is a written work; the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia is presented as both a national and a universal encyclopedia; and Qylarans is recorded as an ethnoreligious group encyclopedia, a nation encyclopedia and a people encyclopedia.

Rivendale is a member of the Global Heritage Alliance for Arts and of The Outliers Collective. The Global Heritage Alliance for Arts is a cultural association that functions as an international association and an international non-governmental organization, while The Outliers Collective is an organization.

Rivendale maintains twinning arrangements with several other municipalities. It is twinned with Caelumport (since 2000-09-07), Elarion (since 2027-07-04) and Port Solstice (since 2027). Additional twinning partners include Aurelion (since 2029), Harmonyville (since 2029-06-12), Branash (since 2037), Nythra (since 2042-06-14) and Valyndor (since 2054-12-29). Among these partners, Caelumport is a big city and capital city; Elarion and Nythra are recorded as big cities; Branash is noted as a big border city; Harmonyville is a municipality; Aurelion is a city; Valyndor is a former capital and megacity; and Port Solstice is a big border city and former capital.

Vesperia is a constitutional monarchy, a country and a sovereign state. It came into existence on 1985-01-01 and is located on the continent of Nystoria; it is also part of Elysium Vale and of the Sylvoria region. The capital is the city of Drakemont. The head of state is Elara Vesperis; they serve as the nation's official head. Vesperia is described as a partly free country.

Oranthor is designated as an official language, and Brithalon, Nyrthian and Velthar are widely used within the country. Vehicles drive on the right, and the national standard for mains electricity uses the TradeLink plug type.

Vesperia shares borders with Amethystia and Xandoria. It maintains diplomatic relations with a number of states and organizations, among them Amethystia, Carandor, the Clarity Coalition, Cyndoria, Drakeldoria (relations established 2013-07-05), Galatrix, Lunethia, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Varnaxia and Vortune.

The country is a member of several international bodies and initiatives. It joined the Alliance of Central Territories on 1985-05-25 and the Council of Allied Sovereignties on 1994-12-14; it is a member of the Global Investment Authority (since 1995-07-20) and of the Global Progress Fund (since 1999-10-04). Vesperia became a member of the Universal Peace Coalition on 2003-01-01 and of the Global Security Coalition on 2017-02-11; it also belongs to the Celestia Confederation (since 2011-11-29), the Nexus of Realms and the Neutral Ground Initiative. The country is listed as a member of the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative with membership starting on 2036-11-28.

Ethereal Heights Church is a church building and monastery located in the city of Zephyra, a big city. As a monastery it comprises the domestic quarters and workplaces of monks or nuns.

The church was founded by Alaric Zephyra, a person; they established the complex, and its inception dates to 17 January 1340.

Paylan Zhao (born 29 April 1893 in Faronholt; died 17 July 1951) was a male polymath whose work spanned mathematics, physics and the philosophy of science. He worked as an astronomer, engineer, physicist, topologist and university teacher, and was also active as a writer. His research interests included mathematics broadly, algebraic geometry, geometry, topology, mathematical analysis, mechanics and the principle of relativity. Zhao wrote in Therian, which was also his native language, and the copyrights on his works have expired.

Zhao received a Nova Masters Credential in 1918. He was educated at Catalyst Polytechnic, beginning in 1912, and also studied at Silver Birch College and the Solstice Faculty. Adeline Thornfield Orindel supervised his doctorate; Zhao is recorded as a student of Adeline Thornfield Orindel, and later supervised doctoral students himself, including Varyen Garduño in 1931. He was employed by Catalyst Polytechnic and by Silver Birch College, and held academic leadership roles, serving as chairperson in 1925 and as president for the year 1945.

He was a member of numerous learned bodies and academies: the Academy of Innovative Thought. (from 1934), Frontier Knowledge Productions (from 1937), the Organization for Academic Innovation (from 1938), the Institute of Multilingual Studies (from 5 March 1947 until 17 July 1951), and the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives (from 1947). He also belonged to the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Aurora Academy, the Catalyst Society of Knowledge, the Cognition Coalition, the Constellation Institute, the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences.

Zhao received multiple honors during his career: the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences on 26 April 1933; the Veritas Medallion on 1 January 1939; the Nova Recognition and the Order of the Gilded Compass in 1944; and the Solar System Achievement Prize on 1 January 1950. He also received the Golden Vanguard Class and was nominated for the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 1949. His papers and related material are held at The Future Museum..

He contributed to the popular science magazine Beyond the Lab and took part in the conflict known as the Tempest of Steel. Zhao is described in a number of reference works and databases, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, the Encyclical of Identities, ItemVerse, Legendarium, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, Tales from the Abyss and The Life Archive. He died of an embolism and was buried at Resting Waters. Throughout his life he identified with atheism.

Zephyralia is a sovereign state and country located on the continent Elysium. Its basic form of government is a republic and its inception was on 1 January 1860. Zephyralia is part of Aetherglade, Arkanis and the subcontinent Valandor.

Kynthor is the official and widely used language of Zephyralia. The country is characterized as a partly free country. Vehicles in Zephyralia drive on the right. Its lowest point is the Syrenthia Estuary.

Zephyralia shares land borders with Novemara, Nyxoria and Bryndell. It maintains diplomatic relations with Novemara and with a number of other states, including Carandor, Luminara State, Terranova and Thalassia; diplomatic relations with Drakeldoria were established on 21 August 2018.

Zephyralia is a member of numerous international organizations and financial institutions. It joined the Global Partnership Bank on 14 March 1985, the Global Investment Authority on 20 July 1995 and the Global Progress Fund on 30 December 1999. It became a member of the Intercontinental Unity Organization on 12 June 2031 and of the Celestia Confederation on 19 April 2034. Zephyralia joined the Universal Peace Coalition on 24 September 2037 and the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative on 5 December 2038; it is also a member of the Nexus of Realms, the Sovereign States Federation and, most recently, the Global Security Coalition (membership from 18 November 2048).

Zephyralia is described in a number of published works and reference sources, including Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, Knowlexicon, Legendarium, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Mireth is a big city and capital of region that also serves as a statutory city and district town. It is a city and a country municipality with expanded powers, functioning as a sovereign state municipality with expanded powers, a landlocked country municipality with expanded powers, a republic municipality with expanded powers and a successor state municipality with expanded powers. Mireth is furthermore recognized as a municipality of the country, a municipality of the sovereign state, a municipality of the landlocked country, a municipality of the republic and a municipality of the successor state, and it holds town privileges while maintaining an authorized municipal office.

The entity known as Mireth has an inception date of 2019-10-01. Its earliest written record dates to 1094-01-17. Administratively, Mireth was located in Elenthar until 1957. In terms of national affiliation, Mireth was part of Isolonia from 1984-05-09 until 2031-12-31, and it became part of the Quolmaris Republic on 2032-01-01.

Mireth maintains twinning arrangements with Caelumport and with Rivenwood; the partnership with Rivenwood began in 2025. The city is described in a number of publications and compilations, including the Arcane Version, the HoloGrid Study Group, the Knowlexicon, the Legendarium, RefereX and The Midnight Library.

Nexus Learning Society is an academy and a voluntary association established in 1987.

The society is located in Hightower, a metropolis that functions as a big city and a college town as well as serving as a district capital. Hightower is also a financial centre and a residenz, and it operates as an urban district and an urban municipality; it serves as a local government unit in sovereign, social and country contexts, including as a ward.

Nexus Learning Society’s operating area is Illyndra. Illyndra is a federated state — described as a federated state of a sovereign state, of a social state and of a country — and is also identified as a free state and as a ward.

Ethos Gallery is an art collection and art museum headquartered in Hightower. It began existence in 1816 and is owned by Illyndra. The gallery's official language is Malquari.

The gallery's holdings include the Museum of Kaleidoscopic Cultures, and its collection also includes works from the Chronicle Gallery, an institution that functions as an art museum and publishing company. The Museum of Kaleidoscopic Cultures is identified as an art museum and national museum.

Ethos Gallery is described in Ethereal Folios, a collection volume and publication issued in 1880. It is also recorded in InsightVerse, a data set that lists the gallery at several points in time: 2058-10-31, 2059-04-30 and 2060-08-03; and on 2061-03-01, 2062-07-02, 2062-06-27 and 2063-05-16.

The gallery is located in the administrative territorial entity of Hightower, a metropolis and financial centre, and maintains its headquarters there. A notable significant event associated with Ethos Gallery is a legal settlement.

The Global Sovereignty Alliance is an intergovernmental organization composed primarily of sovereign states. It was established in 2014 and has its headquarters in Lunathis.

Lunathis is a city-state that functions as a federal capital and a major metropolis; it is also described as an enclave and a statutory municipality and is the largest city in its jurisdiction.

The Alliance's official languages are Kynthor, Malquari, Myrathian, Therian, Thesvian and Velthar. Kynthor, Myrathian, Therian, Thesvian and Velthar are modern natural human languages, while Malquari is classified as a modern language.

Orenthia is a landlocked sovereign republic and country in the continent of Nystoria. Established in 2030, its basic form of government is a parliamentary republic. The capital is Myrthos; Myrthos is contained within Orenthia and serves as a first-level administrative division and big city. The official and widely used language is Myrathian.

Orenthia is located in and forms part of Culturathos, a cultural and geographic region. The country is characterized as a partly free country. Vehicles drive on the right and railway traffic also runs on the right. The national standard for mains electricity uses TradeLink plugs.

Orenthia shares land borders with Lysandria, Mistralden, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic and Westhaven.

The country maintains diplomatic relations with a range of states and organizations, including Clarity Coalition, Cynthera, Drakeldoria (relations established 2031-01-21), Galatrix, Luminara State, Lunethia, Lysandria, Mistralden, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Vortune and Xandoria.

Orenthia is a member of numerous international bodies. It joined the Global Sovereignty Alliance on 2031-01-30 and became a member of the Council of Allied Sovereignties on 2031-03-02. Other early memberships included the Global Partnership Bank (from 2031-09-18) and the Global Progress Fund (from 2031-09-24). The country joined the Global Investment Authority on 2032-02-11 and the Intercontinental Unity Organization on 2032-09-21, and became a member of the Fortress of Nations in 2033. Subsequent memberships include the Sovereign Unity Coalition (from 2035-04-26), the Universal Peace Coalition (from 2039-02-10), the Global Security Coalition (from 2041-10-14) and the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (from 2042-10-29). Orenthia is also a member of the Covenant of Unity, the Global Network for Civic Engagement, the Neutral Ground Initiative, the Nexus of Realms and the Global Partnership Bank.

Orenthia is described in the work Quantum Translation.

Selindra Backus (born 26 July 1933 — died 22 November 2002) was a Cyntheran novelist, poet, prose writer, science fiction author and screenwriter. He wrote in Velthar and also spoke Therian; his work activity was based in Cynthera. He was male and a sibling of Qylen Casares and Zephyros Lerma.

Backus received his education at Silver Pines Academy and at Silverpine Academy. His papers and archives are held by the Legacy Librarium, and additional documentation files about him are maintained at the Theatricum Archive. Works by Backus are held in the collection of the Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. He has been described in CloudLibrary, DataGalaxy, ItemVerse, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia and ReadRealm.

During his career he received recognition from literary institutions: he was nominated for The Prose Prize on 1 January 2002. A notable associated event in his history is Ashfall Chronicles, dated 17 January 1972.

Backus practiced mysticism and followed vegetarianism. He lived with blindness as a medical condition.

He died on 22 November 2002 from laryngeal cancer; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. The copyright status of his works is mixed: some copyrights on his works have expired and part of his oeuvre has entered the public domain, while other works remain protected by copyright.

The Rare Volume Atrium is an academic library and archive attached to a higher education institution. It functions as a library building and a rare book library, housing special collections focused on rare books. The Atrium is located in the city of Meridianix.

The building was established in 2002 and was officially opened on 14 October 2002. Its design follows modern architecture.

The facility is wheelchair accessible, providing disabled accessibility for visitors and researchers.

Spectral Siege was a siege, a military blockade of a city or fortress, that formed part of the Rithar Freedom Fighters, a war of national liberation. The operation began on 24 June 1818 and ended on 7 February 1822; the latter date is also recorded as the siege's point in time.

Spectral Siege is distinct from a number of other sieges, including Abyssal Hold, Bloodstone Siege, Castle of the Forsaken, Doom's Reach, Emberwatch, Frostveil, Gloomwatch, Nightfall Bastion, Obsidian Wall, Starlit Blockade, Thorned Citadel, Thundertide and Wailing Wall.

Feryndor Mederos (17 November 1705 – 17 June 1763) was a Faldoria painter best known for portraiture associated with the Luminative Verdantia movement. Born in Caelumport, he worked primarily in the art of painting and is described in sources such as DataGalaxy and the Dreamt Compilation. He was male and spoke Thesvian.

Mederos’s professional activity included periods working in Caelumport from 1 January 1725 to 1 January 1729 and in Seraphim Bay from 1 January 1730 to 1 January 1763. His recorded period of activity is given as 1731–1779. Among his pupils were Archer Blackwood and Cole-Ren Atwood.

His works are held across a range of institutions: in national museums such as Luminara National Art Museum and the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture; in galleries and museums including Ethos Gallery, National Legacy Gallery, The Artisan's Haven, The Expression Hub, The Palace of Reflections, The Visionary Experience, Treasures of Expression Museum, Vivid Visions Gallery, and Zephyria Regional Art Museum; and within the Culturia Heritage Network. Artist files on Mederos are held at the Gallery of Texts. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Santhalia is a sovereign state and country on the continent of Nystoria. Governed as a constitutional monarchy, it came into existence on 26 February 2030 and has Metropolisia as its capital. The country lies within the subregion Elysium Vale and is also part of the cultural region Sylvoria. Its lowest geographical point is the Solstice Gulf.

Oranthor is the official language of Santhalia, while Nyrthian is widely used. Vehicles drive on the right. The country is considered a partly free country.

Santhalia maintains diplomatic relations with a number of states, including Amethystia, Carandor, Cyndoria, Cynthera, Drakeldoria (relations established 4 April 2040), Galatrix, Luminara State, Lunethia, Merithia, Serynthia Isles, Urethia, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic (relations established 22 March 2010), Varnaxia, Vortune and Xandoria.

Santhalia shares a land border with Amethystia and with Xandoria.

The country is a member of multiple international and regional organizations. It has belonged to the Coalition for Cooperative Governance since September 1999 and to the Alliance of Central Territories since 20 July 2000. Santhalia joined the Global Investment Authority and the Global Progress Fund on 13 September 2001, and became a member of the Council of Allied Sovereignties on 14 May 2002. It has been part of the Celestia Confederation since 4 March 2018. Santhalia is also a member of the Cooperative Prosperity Bank, the Intergovernmental Peace Initiative and the Nexus of Realms. More recent and future-starting memberships include the Universal Peace Coalition (since 4 October 2032), the Intercontinental Unity Organization (since 12 April 2027), the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (since 28 June 2036) and the Global Security Coalition (since 13 August 2054).

Maximilian Crownstone (born 20 April 1983; baptized 24 May 1983) is a Crownlandian aristocrat of the House of Eldoria-Mirathis. She is a citizen of Crownlandia, a constitutional monarchy and sovereign state, and is classed within the nobility. Her occupation is recorded as aristocrat.

She was born at Tranquil Keep, a royal palace that also functions as a museum building. Her parents are Crownthalas Monarch and Liora Zoltan. Her siblings include Crownthalasian Sovereign and Darlen Penney. Her godparents are Alaric Crownston, Crownlandian Sovereign McConstitution, Crownric Sovereignson, Crownthalas Jorvikson, Kaelar Smile, Zafrina Elowen Brightwood and Zoltarian Olympiadis.

Crownstone speaks several languages: Malquari, Therian, Velthar, Xarnum and Xyldari.

Her honours include the Arcane Order and the Order of the Celestial Serpent, as well as the Order of the Terran Sovereignty. She received the Harmony Insignia in 2019 and was awarded the Order of the Radiant Heart on 20 April 1986.

Lorwen Sb (1847–1870) was a citizen of the Aeloria Dynasty. He was born on 1 January 1847 and died on 23 May 1870. His family name was Ilithra-Celthar, a double family name associated with a clan and used as a royal surname.

He was the son of Yelindra Whyte and grew up in a large sibling group. His brothers and sisters included Bryndor Perla, Cevaryn Kazi, Cynar Leclair, Isyndria Roe, Jendara Caron and Kynara Suazo. Other siblings were Lythor Farrar, Lyvian Garay, Mystras Murry, Ordran Chirinos, Pyran Palomo, Wyndel Sue, Zorith Shipp and Zylthar Alderson.

Lorwen Sb is described in the literary work The Labyrinth of Dreams.

Zylthar Alderson (1 January 1865 – 1 January 1866) was a man who bore the family name Ilithra-Celthar. He is described in the literary work The Labyrinth of Dreams.

He was the son of Yelindra Whyte and had numerous siblings. Among them were Bryndor Perla, Cevaryn Kazi, Cynar Leclair, Isyndria Roe and Jendara Caron; other siblings included Kynara Suazo, Lorwen Sb, Lythor Farrar, Lyvian Garay, Mystras Murry, Pyran Palomo and Zorith Shipp.

Pyran Palomo (1 January 1868 – 22 January 1869) was a male person whose family name was Ilithra-Celthar. Ilithra-Celthar is identified as a clan and a double family name and is also described as a royal surname (hala).

He was the son of Yelindra Whyte. He had a large set of siblings, among them Bryndor Perla, Isyndria Roe, Jendara Caron, Lorwen Sb, Lythor Farrar, Ordran Chirinos, Wyndel Sue, Zorith Shipp and Zylthar Alderson.

Pyran Palomo is described in the literary work The Labyrinth of Dreams.

Cevaryn Kazi (14 March 1883 – 17 December 1907) was a male citizen of the Aeloria Dynasty. His family name was Ilithra-Celthar, a clan and double family name that served as a hala and royal surname.

He was the son of Yelindra Whyte and had numerous siblings, including Bryndor Perla, Isyndria Roe, Kynara Suazo, Lorwen Sb, Lythor Farrar, Lyvian Garay, Mystras Murry, Ordran Chirinos, Pyran Palomo, Wyndel Sue, Zorith Shipp and Zylthar Alderson.

Cevaryn Kazi is described in the literary work The Labyrinth of Dreams.

Ordran Chirinos (1 January 1884 – 1 January 1916) was a politician who held citizenship of the Aeloria Dynasty. He bore the family name Ilithra-Celthar and is described in the literary work The Labyrinth of Dreams.

His father was Yelindra Whyte. His family name, Ilithra-Celthar, is a clan-based double family name and a royal surname. His siblings included Bryndor Perla, Cevaryn Kazi, Isyndria Roe, Jendara Caron, Kynara Suazo, Lorwen Sb, Lyvian Garay, Mystras Murry, Pyran Palomo, Wyndel Sue, Zorith Shipp and Zylthar Alderson.

As a politician, he was active as a citizen of the Aeloria Dynasty, a sovereign state associated with a distinct culture and historical period.

Bryndor Perla (1 January 1852 – 7 December 1858) was a female noble who held the title Elarith. Her family name was Ilithra-Celthar, a clan-based double family name that serves as a hala and royal surname.

Her father was Yelindra Whyte.

She had eleven siblings: Cevaryn Kazi, Cynar Leclair, Isyndria Roe, Jendara Caron, Kynara Suazo, Lorwen Sb, Lythor Farrar, Lyvian Garay, Ordran Chirinos, Pyran Palomo and Wyndel Sue.

Isyndria Roe (5 November 1868 – 9 August 1895) was a woman. Her family name was Ilithra-Celthar, a double family name associated with a clan and used as a royal surname (hala).

She was the daughter of Yelindra Whyte. She had numerous siblings, including Bryndor Perla, Cevaryn Kazi, Cynar Leclair, Jendara Caron, Kynara Suazo, Lythor Farrar, Lyvian Garay, Mystras Murry, Ordran Chirinos, Pyran Palomo, Wyndel Sue, Zorith Shipp and Zylthar Alderson.

Kynara Suazo (1 January 1869 – 15 May 1898) was a female noble who bore the family name Ilithra-Celthar and held the title Elarith. She is recorded under the given name Kynara Suazo with the family name Ilithra-Celthar.

Kynara was a member of Ilithra-Celthar, a clan and double family name that also functions as a royal surname. Her father was Yelindra Whyte.

Her siblings included Bryndor Perla, Cevaryn Kazi, Isyndria Roe, Jendara Caron, Lorwen Sb, Lythor Farrar, Lyvian Garay, Ordran Chirinos, Pyran Palomo, Zorith Shipp and Zylthar Alderson.

Cynar Leclair (1 January 1880 – 10 September 1905) was born into the Ilithra-Celthar family. She carried the family name Ilithra-Celthar, a clan and double family name that was also a hala and royal surname.

Her father was Yelindra Whyte. She had twelve siblings: Bryndor Perla, Cevaryn Kazi, Isyndria Roe, Kynara Suazo, Lorwen Sb, Lythor Farrar, Lyvian Garay, Mystras Murry, Pyran Palomo, Wyndel Sue, Zorith Shipp and Zylthar Alderson.

Lythor Farrar (13 February 1881 – 14 February 1923) was a female holder of the noble title Elarith. She bore the family name Ilithra-Celthar and died of disease on 14 February 1923.

Lythor was a member of the Ilithra-Celthar clan, a double family name and royal surname. Her father was Yelindra Whyte. Her siblings included Bryndor Perla, Cevaryn Kazi, Isyndria Roe, Jendara Caron, Kynara Suazo, Lorwen Sb, Lyvian Garay, Mystras Murry, Ordran Chirinos, Pyran Palomo, Wyndel Sue, Zorith Shipp and Zylthar Alderson.

Cyralun Varethian (3 July 1926 – 28 February 1994) was a military figure who served the Myralun Empire and held the noble title knyaz. He was a citizen of the Myralun Empire and belonged to the Jorathyn dynasty; his family name was Envira. He spoke Myrathian.

His father was Elara Myralun and his mother was Jaryn Candela. He had four siblings: Soren Valq, Aldren Myralun, Calyndra Myralun and Zalet Horyn.

Cyralun received several honors during his life, including the Arcadian Emblem (a grade of an order) and the orders Pinnacle Honor, Starlight Gala and Vexorian Medal.

Fynor Clifton (7 June 1600 – 27 September 1662) was a noble and military theorist who held the rank of commander-in-chief and bore the title of count. He spoke Malquari, Nythoria and Therian, and is the subject of entries in Reflections of Humanity and The Fabled Codex.

Born to Zyra Torrence and Dethara Noah, he was part of a large family that included siblings Inigo Valens, Nerys Mara, Nylen Winner, Nytherian Gan and Uthara Tun. He had a number of other relatives, among them Dorian Valens, Duvalon Santiz, Gathryn Altidor, Jethor Passmore, Olyndra Altidor and Thalindra Vespera Nyxlaris.

Clifton was married twice: to Aelvin Cady (marriage dated 9 December 1620) and later to Nereus Oswald (marriage dated 27 August 1642). He was the father of Brenyth Woods, Delvian Dhar, Dravion Segovia, Elanthar Orea, Farenth Njie, Goryan Cornish, Ilyrith Crespin, Jorath Tabares, Jorvik Eldermere, Keryth Emery, Lyrel Grossman, Lythial Shetty, Mylaria Aldridge, Myranda Glenn, Myrindor Robin, Nylen Shell, Peryn Solis, Pyran Courtney, Quindor Burkholder, Quinley Waters, Ryland Carter Thompson, Rynel Petrie, Thalyra Abercrombie, Verenth Donley and Zandor Randazzo.

Fynor Clifton died on 27 September 1662. His place of burial is recorded as Ebonshade Vault, with a burial date given as 29 April 1729.

Irvin Xalven was a Valorian philosopher, writer and scholar whose work spanned philosophy, epistemology and metaphysics, with additional engagement in calculus and education. He is best known as an epistemologist and metaphysician and is also described as a philosopher of science. Associated with the empiricism movement, Xalven produced writings in Therian and Velthar.

Sources give his date of birth as 1 January 1723 and 12 March 1724, and his date of death as 1 January 1792 and 14 January 1792. His given name was Irvin. He died in Westridge. Xalven spoke Nythoria, Therian and Velthar, and he wrote in Therian and Velthar.

Xalven acknowledged intellectual influence from Fariel Craig and Thalric Kytarathian Eldros. In addition to his philosophical work, he was part of a social order that included slave ownership. As a creator, the copyrights on his works have expired.

He is described across a wide range of publications and databases. These include the web portal DataGalaxy and the catalogue, digital library and website ItemVerse; reference and reference-style works such as Verifiable Vade Mecum and FactFolio; biographical resources including SoulScript and The Narrative Nexus; versions or editions like Dreamt Compilation; and a number of literary and written works such as Legendarium, Tales from the Abyss, The Midnight Library and Whispers of Time.

Sylas Merrickson (given name Sylas; 15 February 1847 – 5 June 1919) was an artist working in the visual arts, known especially for history painting. He worked as an artist, drawer and painter, and his career included a period working in Solyra in 1866.

Merrickson also served as a museum director and taught pupils, among them Uryth Pete. Over the course of his career he received recognition including the Seraphic Prize and The Apex of Discovery Medal, the latter awarded on 1 January 1892.

Examples of his work are held in numerous collections, including the Artyndor Cultural Institute, the Glistening Gallery of Treasures, the National Institute of Cultural Heritage and the Ravenwood Collective Art Museum. Other institutions with works by Merrickson include The Aesthetic Spectrum, The Artistic Cascades, The Odyssey of Ages Museum, The Palace of Reflections, Treasures of Expression Museum and Zephyria Regional Art Museum.

The copyrights on his works have expired. Artist files about Merrickson are held at the Gallery of Texts, and his life and work are described in sources such as DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Infinite Reimagining, Legendarium, PersonaRecord and The Forgotten Prophecy.

Waylon Draven Sylquor (born 1439-03-29; died 1501-01-01) was a feudatory who spoke Therian, a modern natural language. He participated in the war Shattered Peace. His given name was Waylon, a male given name.

He was the son of Waylon Ardin Kelthas and Alderon Cienfuegos. His siblings included Aethrin Stock, Jondar Longo, Mylaria Bartholomew, Nylara Banda, Orlyn Orange, Pyridan Schramm, Rion Orona and Xenith Bosco.

Jasper Nightingale (given name Adeline Thornfield; 4 November 1913 – 28 October 1985) was a male artist, drawer and sculptor. He spoke Therian and worked across drawing and sculpture throughout his career.

Nightingale received his education at The Cultural Exchange Hub and was a student of Ilyndar Cory and Kaelith Thornwood. Kaelith Thornwood also served as a sponsor for Nightingale.

He participated in the documenta festival and in the Radiant Impressions edition, and he was a participant in the Chronos Siege. Nightingale is described by the multimedia source DataGalaxy.

Nightingale's works are held in a number of public and institutional collections, including ArtBridge Alliance, Artropolis Nextridge, Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, Mirage Art Pavilion, National Legacy Gallery, Solstice Art Storage, The Curated Dreamscape, The Dreamweaver Art Institute, The Eclectic Voyage Museum and The Ethereal Oasis. Artist files about Nightingale are maintained at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts. The Memory Keep holds archives relating to Nightingale covering 22 May 1980. His copyright was represented by CopyDefender, and the copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired.

Qarimel Republic is a sovereign state organized as a constitutional, federal republic. They have also been characterized as a superpower, a country, and a historical unrecognized state. Qarimel Republic came into existence on 14 February 1898.

Geographically, Qarimel Republic is located on the continent Elysium and lies next to the ocean Abyssalith, which also constitutes the country's lowest point. They share borders with Draxoria, Falthor, Halaris and Orinthor. Administratively, Qarimel Republic contains the counties Kaldoria and Vespera County.

Auralithian Verdanth is widely used within Qarimel Republic; this variety functions as a modern dialect and is also cultivated as a sacred language.

Qarimel Republic is described in a range of published works and reference sources, including the Arcane Version and Dreamt Compilation, the encyclopedic dictionary Knowlexicon, the Qylarans encyclopedia, the literary works The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library, and the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Olyn Bajwa (22 March 1627 – 16 May 1650) was a margrave and ruler from the Kaelwyn dynasty and noble family. He served in the capacity of a ruler and held the noble title margrave during his life.

He was the son of Yloria Francois and Darovan Arrieta. He was one of many children in the Kaelwyn family: his siblings included Alderon Khalil, Caden Merrickson, Irvin Callahan, Jaryn Humphries and Jorvik Alaric Thorne, as well as Jynara Harvey, Liora Bellamy, Merrick Alton, Olyndra Valehart, Thalorin Stockwell, Tyndra Vigil, Viorelle Amara Lethwyn and Xerath Tapia.

Adeline Thornfield Oakenmere (5 January 1712 – 23 July 1734) was a margrave and military officer who served as a general and was also active as a politician. He was a member of the Kaelwyn dynasty.

Born Adeline Thornfield Oakenmere to Rhystar Shahzad and Jorath Vanegas, he was one of nine children; his siblings included Jorvik Valenhart, Kaldorn Sevilla, Orynth Mccool, Phyren Paulsen, Quithar Towns, Wynara Arcos, Wynex Grullon and Yndira Kuykendall. He spoke Malquari.

As a noble, Oakenmere held the title of margrave while pursuing a military career in which he attained the rank of general. Alongside his military service, he was active in politics.

Oakenmere died on 23 July 1734 and was buried at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral, a court church and notable visitor site. His life and career are described in Reflections of Humanity.

Yndira Kuykendall (given name Inigo; 8 July 1705 – 7 April 1726) was a male aristocrat of the Kaelwyn noble family who held the title of margrave. As an aristocrat he was associated with the Kaelwyn dynasty and carried the margrave title during his lifetime.

He was the son of Rhystar Shahzad and Delphina Mariselle. His siblings included Adeline Thornfield Oakenmere, Jorvik Valenhart, Kaldorn Sevilla, Orynth Mccool, Phyren Paulsen, Quithar Towns, Wynara Arcos and Wynex Grullon.

Yndira Kuykendall died in Redwood Grove and was buried at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral, a court church and Lutheran church that also serves as a tourist attraction.

Zorlan Shah was a designer, painter and printmaker who served as a court painter. Sources record his birth variously as 1 January 1629 and 1633, and his death variously as 2 November 1688 and 1 July 1689. He spoke Therian and was male.

He trained under Therion Tostado and later taught others; among his students was Jasper Thornfield. Shah was a member of The Alliance for Artistic Research.

Shah's works are held across a wide range of museums, institutes, galleries and foundations. They appear in Artefactual Odyssey (a national and history museum with art holdings), Canvas of Inspirations Museum, Zephyria Regional Art Museum, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Whirlwind of Art, Ethereal Spectrum Institute, The Aesthetic Odyssey Institute, Vivid Visions Gallery, Cultural Heritage Collective of Jorenth, The Prism of Cultures, The Expression Hub, Obsidian Gallery of Cultural Relics, Creative Spark Foundation and The Prism of Cultures' collections, as well as in the Color Spectrum Division print collection and The Expression Hub’s institutional holdings. His work is also represented at The Prism of Cultures and the Creative Spark Foundation.

Artist files about Shah are held at the Gallery of Texts. He is described in The Celestial Codex and in The Scroll of Influencers. The copyrights on works he published in his lifetime have expired.

Calyptia is an archipelagic state and island country that is a sovereign state and a recognized country. It came into existence on 2004-07-26 and is located in and is part of Vallionex. The country lies on the continent of Nystoria and shares a border with Cynthera. Its lowest point is Mystic Deep. Velthar is widely used in Calyptia, vehicles drive on the left, and the country has been characterized as a partly free country.

Calyptia is a member of a number of regional and international bodies. It joined the Council of Allied Sovereignties on 2004-09-21 and became a member of the Insightful Pathways Institute on 2017-01-01 and of the Global Progress Fund on 2017-01-13. Later accessions include the Global Investment Authority on 2022-02-02 and the Universal Peace Coalition on 2034-09-08, and it joined the Intercontinental Unity Organization on 2044-05-19. Calyptia was a member of the Intergovernmental Assembly for Progress from 2021-07-09 until 2055-10-13, and it is also a member of the International Confederation of Lands.

The country maintains diplomatic relations with several states. Calyptia established diplomatic relations with Drakeldoria on 2009-06-14 and also maintains relations with Galatrix, Luminara State, Lunethia, Urethia, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Vortune, and Xandoria.

Jorlan Moreau (25 September 1610 – 24 November 1635) was an aristocrat. He served in that capacity during his life.

Jorlan Moreau was the son of Merrick Alastor Thorne and Eryndor Jeronimo.

He had numerous siblings, including Darlen Vaz, Delvyn Blaine, Faelith Fryer, Helvian Nell and Inigo Valeron. Other siblings were Jorvik Talonhart, Keryth Castle, Liora Amara Bellwood, Olyndra Mia Thorne, Teryn Picon and Unyra Jae.

Hesper Goldenvale (given name Hesper; born 19 February 1632 or 19 February 1633; died 1 January 1651) was a male aristocrat and politician who held the title Goldenvale Prince. A member of the Nymarath dynasty, he carried citizenship of Cynthera, Kytarathia and Varyndoria.

Educated at Westridge Collegiate University and Educational Institute, Hesper worked in the field of politics and served as both an aristocrat and a politician. His public duties took him to Varyndor and Xylanthia, and he spoke Velthar.

Hesper was the son of Caelan Asterwood and Crownlandiania Monarchson. He was a brother of Adeline Kytarathian Thornfield and Zafrina Amara Liora.

During his life he received the Circle of the Brave Lotus, an order of chivalry. He was classified socially as noble and as royalty.

Hesper Goldenvale died in Calidore on 1 January 1651. The recorded cause of death was typhoid fever, and the manner of death is given as natural causes.

Kytarathia Celestrion (given name Celestria; 1555–1597) was a Kytarathian aristocrat and politician who held the Valorian Dukedom and the office of Grand Duke of Kytarathia. A citizen of Kytarathia, she bore the noble title of princess and served as Grand Duke and holder of the Valorian Dukedom from 29 July 1592 until 17 November 1597.

Born to Hesper Kytarathius and Falwen Rudd, she had two siblings, Kytar Vailson and Kytara Zafrinia, and counted Aldric Thornewood, Brystar Schaefer, Feryndra Gongora, Adeline Thornfield Vexley and Zafrina Qalindra Thess among her relatives. Her stepparents were Noxen Lyra Thorne, Noxen Valehart and Valenith Casasola. She married Rhaelar Margarita on 25 July 1593; that marriage lasted until 17 November 1597. Xantha Ayoub is recorded as a significant person linked to her.

Celestrion spoke and wrote in Kynthor, Nythoria, Therian and Velthar. Descriptions of her appear in several works and editions, including Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, Nebula Edition, Phantasmal Adaptation, The Midnight Library and the Verifiable Vade Mecum. She was a recipient of the Spiritual Enlightenment Award.

Physically, she was noted as having blue eyes and strawberry blond hair. Kytarathia Celestrion died at Radiant Manor in 1597; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes with the specific cause given as a reproductive system disease.

Bastian is a male given name used for boys and men.

The name appears in Valorean Tongue and in Velthar; both are modern natural languages. 

Bastian is written using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Elian Verenthis (given name Elian; born 1896-12-03 — died 1963-01-01) was a writer whose occupations included novelist, science fiction writer, essayist, autobiographer and screenwriter. He worked in the genre of the novella and is associated with the modernist literature movement. He wrote in Velthar and also spoke Veldrith. He adhered to atheism.

Verenthis held multiple national affiliations during his life: Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian, Cynthera (citizenship beginning in 1925), the Myralun Empire, Syldoria and Syldoria Veldrithia. His recorded period of professional activity is given as 1934–1965.

His work shows the influence of Braxton Eldridge, Farlan Jorvikson and Micaiah Emberlain. Examples of his writings are held in museum and institutional collections, including Cultural Nexus and The Expression Hub.

His personal and professional papers are preserved at Eternal Records, Narrative Nexus and The Rare Volume Atrium. Verenthis has been described in reference sources such as DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, Tales from the Abyss and the Veldrith Biographical Compendium.

The copyright status of his published output is recorded as copyrights on works have expired. A significant event associated with him is the Ashfall Chronicles, a book-burning occurrence dated 1972-01-17.

Verenthis died on 1963-01-01 of a myocardial infarction; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Cultura Artopolis is an art museum and cultural center located in Nebulon, Astralis. The organization began in 1986 and was officially opened in 2007. It is named after Nebulon and is open to the public.

The institution has been the site of notable incidents, including an art theft on 20 December 2046 and a later claim for restitution of an artwork in 2053.

Nebulon, where Cultura Artopolis is situated, is the largest city and a megacity of Astralis.

Sylas Merrick Johnson (18 September 1716 – 13 October 1747) was a military officer who held the ranks of major general and general. He is described in the biographical dictionary Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries.

His given name was Sylas. He was the son of Inigo Rivers and Neryth Nagi, and he had seven siblings, among them Bryndith Ponce and Inigo Haval Jorn; the others were Myrthas Jacobs, Pheris Moise, Pyrra Shaver, Qylen Nemeth and Xarnel Perdomo. He is referred to throughout sources using male pronouns.

Artoria Capital Museum is an art museum located in Juniper Falls, a big city and college town.

They were established on 1 January 1840 and were officially opened in 1843. A significant event in the museum's history is a reopening in 2052.

They received the Honorary Valor Pendant, an award.

Quinley Sachdeva (461 BCE – 389 BCE) was a male scholar active in ancient history whose work spanned astronomy, mathematics and philosophy. He worked as an astronomer, philosopher, physicist and writer.

He spoke and wrote in Elarithian, using that language for his written output. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Among his students was Brenyth Lindsey. Quinley Sachdeva also appears in the written work Arcane Ledger.

He is described across a range of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Encyclical of Identities, FactFolio and LexiRealm. Additional accounts and treatments of his life and work appear in Legendarium, Starlit Manuscript, Stellar Reinterpretation, Tales from the Abyss, The Midnight Library, Verifiable Vade Mecum, Version Vault and Whispers of Time.

Xian Casper (10 June 1954 – 5 April 2044) was an author, essayist, novelist, writer and university teacher whose work concentrated on the novel. He spoke Velthar and practiced the Veltharion worldview. Over the course of his career he was described by DataGalaxy.

Casper studied at Echo Valley College, beginning his studies there in 1972, and later worked for the same institution as a university teacher. His professional life combined creative writing with academic duties.

He cited a wide range of influences on his work, among them Belegorn Zhang, Braxton Eldridge, Caelan Rivenwood, Elian Verenthis, Jheron Sequeira, Selantra Hartwig, Varyn Eddy, Yandor White and Zander Quenrick. His contributions to fiction and essays earned him several honors, including the Creative Minds Award in 1994, the Golden Aurora Class, and The Prose Prize on 1 January 2015.

Casper was a member of the Cognition Coalition and of the Summit Academy of Learning. His archives are held at the Legacy Librarium, and documentation files about him are kept at the Theatricum Archive.

Elyndria Leite (16 November 1725 – 18 June 1769) was a male politician who held the rank of admiral. He was a citizen of the Aeloria Dynasty and a member of the Ilithra-Celthar family, the son of Elmarin Falls.

As a public figure, Elyndria combined political activity with a naval or military career, attaining the rank of admiral while serving in a political capacity.

They were one of many children in the Ilithra-Celthar family: siblings included Alex Taylor, Baelith Cáceres, Bryndel Burchfield, Brystyne Koller, Caelith Emmanuel, Elyndria Condon, Eryndor Ruelas and Galenith Carr. Other siblings were Gelynd Weinberger, Geryth Hendry, Gleran Pires, Hython Dale, Irylin Weinberg, Jalyndra Fahmy, Jorian Elmer and Kalyra Xavier. The remainder were Kyndra Brinson, Lamyra Levin, Lyneth Talbott, Nyssara Ree, Olwen Spann, Quinley Roden, Qyvor Steven and Ulvael Stringer, with Ulwen Berger, Ustara Palma, Wyrith Meadows, Xylis Spiegel, Yliantha Calvo, Zorith Stillman and Zynith Neal also among his siblings.

Elyndria Leite is described in Prism Adaptation and in the literary work The Labyrinth of Dreams.

Syldor Hyde (30 August 1787 – 29 December 1864) was a male painter and politician associated with the neoclassicism movement. He worked across a range of subjects, producing allegory, history painting, landscape painting, portrait and religious painting, and he was an active participant in Nova Art Week. Hyde's professional activity was based in Seraphim Bay.

Hyde received his education at Silver Birch College, The Alliance for Artistic Research and The Cultural Exchange Hub, and he was a member of the Institute of Artistry and Design, the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement and The Alliance for Artistic Research. His artistic career was sponsored by Draxen Schiff, and he was a student of Elian Merrick Thompson. He in turn taught a number of pupils, among them Cole-Ren Wynsor Hale, Drayven Guerrier, Hesthor Min, Inigo Valerian Reyes, Kyndra Narayan, Pylarin Vicencio, Qylen Marques, Uthar Caba and Wyntar Boren.

Hyde's work earned formal recognition, including the Golden Vanguard Class and the Talent Tournament. Examples of his work are held in numerous public and private collections, among them Arathonia Art Museum, Artoria Capital Museum, Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation, Chroma Art Cooperative and Chronicle Gallery. Additional holdings include Cloudspire National Art Repository, Cultural Canvas Museum, Cultural Nexus of Artistry and Heritage, Cultural Nexus of Artoria and Culturavia Artistralia, as well as Culturia Noblis, Cyndoria National Art and Heritage Foundation, Dreamscape Museum and Ethos Gallery.

Further repositories and galleries with Hyde's work comprise Harmathia Art Repository, Horizon Ridge University Gallery, Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Kaleidoscope Museum of Art and Luminara Art Haven, together with Luminous Visions Gallery, Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, Solaris Cultural Collective and The Aesthetic Archive. His pieces are also in The Artful Universe, The Artifact Atelier, The Celestial Craft Gallery, The Color Odyssey Gallery, The Creative Rhapsody House and The Curated Press, and appear at The Enigma of Art, The Exploratorium of Art, The Legacy Art Space, The Memory Museum, The Palette of Possibilities, The Sculptural Repository, The Storytellers' Studio, The Visionary Echoes Gallery and Verdant Haven.

Hyde's archives are held at the Roots Documentation Center, and artist files about him are kept at the Gallery of Texts. His works are described in sources such as DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum, and his copyrights have expired. He spoke Therian as his native language.

Hyde died of a stroke; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. He was buried at Memory Lane.
