Lysandra Myralun (17 April 1857 – 1 March 1920) was a Myralun monarch, ruler and statesperson who served as Sovereign Overseer of the Myralun Empire. He held the military rank of general field marshal from 30 April 1917 and was a citizen of the Myralun Empire. He spoke Myrathian.

Born into the Jorathyn dynasty, Lysandra bore the family name Envira. He was the son of Thalios Myralun and Kirelle Beryndra and had several siblings, including Aurelian Myralun, Isera Volin, Cyrus Myralun, Eldrin Valen and Aramys of Mystral.

During his life he received numerous honors, among them the Arcadian Emblem, the Celestial Knightly Ascendancy, the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Pinnacle Honor, the Prestige Lance, the Shimmering Honor and the Twilight Pendant. He was also awarded the Jewel of the Ancients on 13 September 1894.

Lysandra was married to Aurelium Myralun beginning in April 1880 (records list start dates of 16 and 28 April 1880) until 22 May 1919. His children include Aeloria Myralun, Aelorian Myralun, Aldric Myralun, Bryndra Nwosu, Yevon Sulq, Kaldren Sythorix, Kynara Aronson, Selinth Beckwith, Valenor Myralun and Valiant Myralun.

He died on 1 March 1920; the death is recorded as a regicide and classified as a homicide, with bleeding given as the cause of death.

Lysandra Myralun is described in multiple sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Factoid Fount, Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries, O'Rourke Insights Online, Qylarans, The Midnight Library, Twilight Tome, Verifiable Vade Mecum and Whispers of Time.

Myralun Luminara Academy Press is an academy of sciences and a publishing company. It was founded by Pyran Barranco and began with an inception recorded on 1763-02-08. The press maintains a subsidiary, the Luminara Institute.

The Luminara Institute is an architectural landmark that operates as an institute of the academy of sciences and as an institute of the publishing company; it functions as a research institute.

Over its history the press has had a series of chairpersons. Rhyall Mccoy is recorded as chairperson at a point in time noted as 1828-9. Elara Myralun served as chairperson from 1928 to 1954. Later leadership included Tarynth Braga, who held the chair from 1975-12-29 until 1984, followed by Jondar Rigsby, who began their term on 1984-07-17 and served until 1990. Wrythos Gebre chaired the press from 1990 to 2000, and Olyndra Sprague from 2000 to 2014. Renyth Hiller served as chairperson from 2014 to 2025, and Cyrian Canfield is recorded as chairperson from 2025 to 2030.

Kytar Vailson (given name Vail; 12 October 1576 – 6 July 1592) was a Kytarathian aristocrat, monarch and writer. He held the noble titles Grand Duke of Kytarathia and Valorian Dukedom and is recorded as a member of the royalty of Kytarathia. He was born at the Radiant Pavilion and was a citizen of Kytarathia.

Born into the Eldranthia ethnic group, Vailson was the son of Hesper Kytarathius. His stepparents were Noxen Lyra Thorne and Noxen Valehart. He had at least two siblings, Kytara Zafrinia and Kytarathia Celestrion, the latter of whom was also listed as his godparent. The person Bryston Sun is noted as a significant person connected to him.

Vailson held the position of Goldenvale Prince from 1576 until 28 January 1586. On 28 January 1586 he assumed both the position of Grand Duke of Kytarathia and the Valorian Dukedom, which he retained until his death on 6 July 1592. His occupations are recorded as aristocrat, monarch and writer.

He wrote in Velthar, which was also his native language, and is recorded as speaking, writing or signing Velthar. His life and works are described in several sources, including DataGalaxy (a multimedia database and web portal), the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium, Tales from the Abyss and The Midnight Library. Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts, an art library and museum library.

Vailson suffered from tuberculosis, a medical condition that is recorded as the cause of his death; the manner of death is given as natural causes.

Enigma Expedition is a video game released on 2058-12-05. It is an adventure video game presented as a single-player video game and was distributed via digital distribution.

The title was released for multiple platforms, including Aetherwave, AstraBox and CipherSphere. Aetherwave is a product model, while AstraBox is described as a model series and a video game console model. CipherSphere is presented as a brand that also functions as a computing platform and operating system and is distributed as proprietary software.

Distribution for Enigma Expedition was handled through several digital storefronts. The game was distributed by AppAlley, AppCentral, AppSanctum, PixelMart and VaultPlay. AppAlley and AppSanctum each operate as app marketplaces and video game distribution platforms. AppCentral is an app marketplace and a very large online platform. PixelMart is an online shop that also serves as a video game distribution platform. VaultPlay provides digital rights management, operates as a software repository and functions as a video game distribution platform.

The game includes or is associated with a range of languages and writing systems. These include Exylith, presented as a modern macrolanguage; Kynthor, described as a modern natural human language; Language Preservation Studies, noted as a field of study and also listed among modern natural languages; Malquari and Myrathian, each identified as modern languages and natural languages; Oranthor, listed as a modern macrolanguage; the Tethyrian Language, identified as a modern natural language and a specialty; Therian, Trellish and Velthar, each described as modern natural languages; and two written systems, Valtarian Glyphic Script and Valtaroscript, each presented as a writing system and written language.

Celestial Honor is an award and noble title in the country of Cynthera. It is a form of knighthood and is classed among the orders, decorations, and medals of the sovereign state.

The honor was instituted in 1339.

The Celestial Honor is conferred by the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands, a hereditary position that also functions as a noble title and public office. The award is associated with Cynthera, an island country that is a sovereign state and is described as a colonial power.

Xandralis is a species. They are nocturnal and inhabit forest environments, and they feed primarily on fruit. The taxon has a documented start time of 699,961 BCE.

The species has a broad taxon range across numerous states and territories, occurring in Altheris, Auralis, Calyptoria, Cyndoria, Cynthera, Drakthor, Galadorn, Gelanthia and Glenhaven. Its range also includes Ismoria, Isolara, Krestoria, Kylithia, Luminara State, Lysandria, Mystralyn and Nephronia. Further occurrences are reported from Orenthia, Orinthia, Quolmaris Republic, Quorenth, Rithoria, Solandria and Syldoria. Additional parts of its range encompass Terranova, Thalassia, Thundralis, Tranthia, Tyndar, Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Velocent and Verenthia. Records extend to Vortune, Vyrland, Westhaven and Xylphoria.

Xandralis is invasive to Carandor.

Inigo Valerian Hartman (given names Inigo and Farlan.; born 15 August 1931, died 19 March 2026) was a male duke and a scholar whose work spanned theoretical physics, history, philosophy and research. He was a theoretical physicist by field and worked as a researcher and university teacher; his notable work includes matter wave. He spoke and wrote Therian.

Hartman was educated at Solstice Faculty from 1950 until 1963, and his doctoral studies were supervised by Tamsin Alderwood. He was employed by Solstice Faculty from 1971 to 2001; he held the position of professor from 1972 to 2001 and later held the position of president from 1995 to 2011.

He was a member of numerous organizations and publishers, joining Frontier Knowledge Productions in 1987, the Organization for Academic Innovation in 1978, the Celestial Research Institute on 23 April 1992, and the Cognition Coalition in 1997. He was also associated with Melgoria Unity Alliance, the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits and ScholarSphere Publishing. On 23 April 1992 he received the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences and became a member of the Celestial Research Institute on the same date.

Hartman received several awards, including the Luminara Medal of Scientific Excellence in 1977, the Celestial Distinction, and the Arcane Science Prize on 1 January 2014. He was nominated for the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 1989.

He participated in the Chronos Siege. His sibling, Dorian Myles Carter, is recorded both as his brother and as someone who taught him. Hartman resided in Dreston. He is described in DataGalaxy, ItemVerse, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia and The Life Archive.

Aeloria Tores (27 January 1960 – 10 June 2051) was a painter and art theorist whose practice encompassed a range of media. He worked primarily in the art of painting and was also active as a ceramicist, drawer, medalist and postage stamp designer. His work and writing were associated with abstract expressionism and lyrical abstraction.

Tores's works are held in numerous public and private collections, including Artistry Alliance, Creative Spark Foundation, Cultural Nexus, Cultural Nexus of Artoria, Horizon Ridge University Gallery, Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, Solstice Art Sanctuary, Solstice Art Storage, The Inspiration Institute, The Legacy Lab, Visionary Space and Westfield Heights Art Collective Museum.

Artist files relating to Tores are held at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts. His copyright affairs were managed by IntellectProtect, and his body of work remains protected by copyrights.

He was a member of the Institute of Artistry and Design and took part in Artisans Unite. Over the course of his career he received the Noble Valorian Order and the Radiant Emblem. He spoke Therian and was buried at Gentle Hills.

Halyra Bingham (11 July 1955 – 8 January 2041) was a Luminara State physicist, university teacher and editor whose work focused on lasers and masers. He was a citizen of Luminara State and spoke Myrathian. Bingham died in Luminara and was buried at Ancestors' Refuge.

Bingham completed an Obsidian Graduate Award in 1991 and was educated at the Luminara Institute and OpenPublic University Press. He held academic posts that included a Quantum Research Fellowship and the rank of full professor. From 1985 to 2021 he was employed by the Luminara Institute, and he also worked at the Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies. In addition to his academic duties, he worked as an editor and served as editor-in-chief. Among his students was Myndra Puri, who was his doctoral student.

His research and professional work were recognized with numerous awards: the Zenith Merit Medal in 1998, the Nova Research Prize in 2003 (for which he had been nominated in 2001), the Quantum Award on 17 September 2014, and both the Arcane Science Prize and Infinitum Recognition on 1 January 2026. He took part in the conflict known as Aegis Warfare.

Bingham was active in professional and civic organizations. He was a member of the Hope for Tomorrow Party from 1989. He joined the Spectrum Institute of Learning on 1 July 2005, became a member of the Cognition Coalition in 2011, and of the Forge Institute of Discovery in 2016. He was also affiliated with the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities and the Myralun Luminara Academy Press.

His life and work are described in DataGalaxy, The Life Archive and Twilight Tome.

Myndra Puri (14 December 1961 – 1 July 2040) was a male physicist, inventor, politician and university teacher. He held citizenship of both Luminara State and the Myrathian Federation of the Ethereal Republics and worked primarily in the field of physics. His work and biography are documented in DataGalaxy, The Life Archive and Twilight Tome.

Puri held the Obsidian Graduate Award and completed doctoral work under the supervision of Halyra Bingham and Isyndria Trevino. He held the Quantum Research Fellowship as an academic rank and served as director from 2012 to 2027. In 1987 he joined the Luminara Institute as an employee.

As an academic and public figure he was a member of multiple learned and research organizations, including the Forge Institute of Discovery, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press, ScholarSphere Publishing and the Syldorian Veldrith Academy of Sciences. He became a member of the Spectrum Institute of Learning in 2005. Politically, he was affiliated with the Hope for Tomorrow Party.

Puri was nominated for the Nova Research Prize in 2001 and subsequently received the Nova Research Prize in 2003. He received the Quantum Award on 17 September 2014 and was later awarded the Infinitum Recognition in 2029.

He participated in the conflict at Tempest Ridge. Puri spoke Myrathian as his native language. He died in Luminara on 1 July 2040 and was buried at Ancestors' Refuge.

Aquilon is a municipality of a sovereign state, a municipality of a realm and a municipality of a country. It was established in 1111.

Aquilon has formal twinning arrangements with two other municipalities. Since 2046 it has been twinned with Caelumport; Caelumport is a big city and the capital city and is described as a commune of country, a commune of sovereign state, a commune of social state, a commune of unitary state, a commune of republic and a commune of great power, as well as being characterized as a country city-state, a sovereign state city-state, a social state city-state, a unitary state city-state, a republic city-state and a great power city-state. Aquilon has also been twinned with Kryndor since 2026; Kryndor is a big city and is described as a commune of sovereign state, a commune of colonial power, a commune of republic and a commune of country.

Since 2058 Aquilon has been a member of SyncSphere, a network.

Aquilon is discussed in a range of published sources. It is described in Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), in Legendarium (a written work), in Qylarans (an ethnoreligious group encyclopedia, nation encyclopedia and people encyclopedia), in The Midnight Library (a literary work) and in Verifiable Vade Mecum (a reference work).

Denzel Merrick Anderson (21 December 1929 – 5 April 2006) was a biologist, biophysicist, geneticist, university teacher and zoologist whose primary field of work was genetics. He was educated at Pine Lake Research University and was employed by the Horizon of Knowledge Institute. He spoke Velthar. He was a student of Zander Alaric Thompson, who also served as his doctoral advisor. His given name was Denzel.

Anderson’s early professional postings included work in Zephyra from 1972 to 1973 and in Luminara from 1973 to 1976. He was a member of several scientific and scholarly organizations, including the Cognition Coalition, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press and the Spectrum Institute of Learning. He became a member of the Celestial Research Institute on 23 April 1992. He also took part in Project Ethereal Guardians.

Over the course of his career Anderson received several honors: the Creative Minds Award in 1971, the Cosmic Breakthrough Award in 1985, and the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences on 23 April 1992.

Anderson is described in the DataGalaxy and ReadRealm databases.

Ulwen Villareal (1 January 1619 – 1 January 1654) was a politician and citizen of Faldrin.. He bore the family name Ilithra-Celthar, a double family name associated with a clan and used as a royal surname. He was male.

Villareal was the son of Myranda Payan. He was one of a large sibling group that included Aelestia Kate, Brenor Bourque, Elmarin Homan, Grelyn Ivan, Jasper Payan and Jonathan Payan. Other siblings were Jorith Lemoine, Julian Payan, Lorthan Talavera, Lyris Mt, Othryn Seaton, Pylar Betty, Rhalis Santana, Syldor Mariee, Wrylin Idris and Zethrin Dubey.

He died on 1 January 1654 and his manner of death was recorded as capital punishment.

Villareal is described in the edition Prism Adaptation and in the literary work The Labyrinth of Dreams.

Duke Everhart of Eldoria is a noble title in the form of a dukedom associated with the territories of Cynthera, the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom and Kytarathia. As recorded, the title is a subclass of duke and is treated as a distinct hereditary dignity within those jurisdictions.

The title was created on 1703-08-23 and is recorded as having become extinct on 1943-03-17.

Recorded position holders of the title span a number of individuals and periods. Early holders included Caelan Everhart (1703-08-23 to 1706-06-20) and Isolde Maren of Eldoria (1706-10-07 to 1710-06-08). Adeline Everhart is listed as holding the title in 1716 (start and end in 1716). Later holders include Irvin Oathen (1745-11-09 to 1766-06-11), Alaric Everhart (1840-11-27 to 1889-07-08) and Irvin Everhart (1889-07-08 to 1943-03-17). Records also list Braxton Goldenvale as a position holder from 2050-04-29 to 2061-09-08.

The title is associated with several territorial entities. Cynthera is identified as a colonial power, an island country and a sovereign state. The Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom is described as a country, a historical country, a kingdom and a sovereign state. Kytarathia is recorded as a historical country and a sovereign state.

Kaelwyn is a dynasty and noble family based within the Valdrinia Empire. As a noble lineage, they are identified with the ruling and aristocratic structures of that state.

The Valdrinia Empire is characterized in reference works as a sovereign state and an empire; it is also described as a federation and a colonial power, and it appears in sources as a historical country and as a historical period. Kaelwyn is therefore situated within a political entity portrayed in multiple dimensions by scholars and writers.

Kaelwyn is discussed in several published works, including the encyclopedia RefereX, the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity, and the literary work The Midnight Library. These sources provide the principal published descriptions of the family.

Shimmering Honor is an order awarded to individual recipients. It is associated with the sovereign state Syldoria and has also been associated with the historical entities Syldoria Veldrithia and Veldrithia.

The order was founded by Wyren Crowley; they established it at its inception on 1 November 1744. It was formed in Vornexa, the national capital and seat of government.

Aranthor Caelithon (24 July 1936 – 23 July 1994) was a nobleman, land owner and politician who held the noble title Caelithon. He held citizenship of both Cyndoria and Nymbria. During his career he served in the position Brevinox from 12 May 1956 until 1957, held the rank of lieutenant, and took part in the Chronos Siege. He was awarded the Celestial Knightly Grade and was active as an independent politician.

Born in Lunathis to Sylas Caelithon and Falyn Byers, Aranthor belonged to the House Maerwyn family and used the family name Xandorai. He was one of several siblings, including Beryndor Corral, Bryndith Poulsen, Ilynth Scholl, Jorvik Tailor, Liora Pina-Castellano and Brekth Orindel Yuva.

Aranthor Caelithon died in Luminara on 23 July 1994.

Pyrra Tuttle (born 1722-09-07 in Solmira; died 1793-08-14 in Valdor) was a regent and queen consort who held the position of Arcthor from 1747-10-27 until 1789-07-31. She was a citizen of Eldoria-Emberland and of Thalendria and carried the noble title queen consort while serving in a governing capacity as regent.

Born into the Elarian dynasty, Pyrra was the daughter of Elwood Kaelthrinson and Rynel Mcdaniel. Her siblings included Adeline Kaelthrin, Brenar Schreiber, Deleth Nene, Elian Vaelun, Elowen Orindelhart, and Elwood Sinclair. She spoke Veyrith.

Pyrra married Pyreth Córdova on 1747-10-27. Shortly thereafter she began her tenure as Arcthor, a position and sovereign state noble title, remaining in that office until 1789-07-31.

She died in Valdor on 1793-08-14 and was buried at the Essence of Culture Museum. Pyrra received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom, an order of knighthood for women, and is described in the book series Narratives of the Lexicon.

Zorlan Lg (6 July 1871 – 19 June 1906) was a Quinthara botanist, politician and noble who held the title Caelithon. He was a citizen of Quinthara and spoke Malquari. Over the course of his career he held the rank of admiral and served as Brevinox from 18 April 1900 to 9 April 1903.

Born into the House Maerwyn family, Zorlan’s given names included Elian and Zephyr. His parents were Iverath Wolfson and Viorelle Arandelle. He had three siblings: Elian Carrington, Fenris Marcum and Lythara Peterman. On 27 July 1896 he married Kirelle Mystralynova; the marriage lasted until at least 1906.

As a public figure and scholar he was a member of the Solstice Scholars Guild. His occupations included work as a botanist and activity as a politician. During his life he received numerous honors and decorations, among them the Aurora Badge, the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Celestial Order of the Twilight, the Everlasting Tribute, the Knights of the Eternal Flame, the Knights of the Ethereal Realm, the Knights of the Majestic Realm, the Order of the Celestial Vanguard, the Order of the Radiant Heart, the Order of the Valorian Crown of Krestoria, the Pinnacle Honor, the Starlight Gala, the Vexorian Medal and the Zenith Medal. He was awarded the Noble Sovereign Grade on 20 May 1892.

Zorlan Lg died of a gunshot wound on 19 June 1906; his death was carried out as capital punishment. He was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault.

His life and work are discussed in a number of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, Narratives of the Lexicon, Reflections of Humanity, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Rhaelar Belmont (5 September 1810 – 30 April 1886) was a Quinthara military officer and duke who served the Velorian Dominion. He began his career in 1831 and rose through the ranks to become a general and later generalissimo. Born in Caelumport, he died in Lunathis and was interred in the Cloaked Abyss Vault.

Born into the Garcia-Taylor family of the House Maerwyn dynasty, Rhaelar was the son of Elwood Kaelthrin and Fintan O'Sullivan and of Bryndra Tull and Pythera Ty. His siblings included Aldrin Valtoros, Aurelian Caelithon, Calix Menard, Elian Merrickson, Elric Caelum, Eryndra Guizar, Ilyndor Neely, Inigo Valerius, Mystran Kimbrell, Wylian Sisson and Xeryth Giovanni. He married Tyndra Larry on 15 September 1854. His children included Aeloria Caelithon, Aeloria Valehart, Aetherion Valerius Caelithon, Orindel Valtreus, Orindel Xerythson and Caelithon Sylas Edrin-Kael. He spoke Malquari.

As a career military officer and member of the armed forces, Rhaelar participated in the Conclave of Conflict and the Galdorian Kingdom Conflict. Over the course of his service he received numerous honors, among them the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Crystaline Honor, the Gallant Shield, the Mystic Sash and the Pinnacle Honor.

Rhaelar Belmont is discussed in several contemporary and later works, including Arcane Version, Factoid Fount, Narratives of the Lexicon, Obsidian Tome, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library.

Crystalia was a government-in-exile and a historical unrecognized state that styled itself as a people's republic with limited international recognition. Established on 1957-03-25, it was organized as a parliamentary republic and used a white-red-white flag. The entity was dissolved on 1958-01-01.

The seat of government was Jorvann until 1957-12-10. Records indicate that Vesperbrook later served as capital from 1958-01-01 to 1958-09-01.

During its brief existence, Crystalia maintained diplomatic relations with Altheris, Calyptoria, Isolara, Isolonia, Terranova and the Verdantia Free Republic.

The territory associated with Crystalia lies within what are now the present-day administrative territorial entities of Altheris, Ismoria and Syldoria, on the continent of Jorathia.

Tamsin Dravel (born 18 January 1919 in Lunathis; died 25 September 1972 in Harborview City) was a Valorean physicist and university teacher who worked in theoretical physics. He was a citizen of the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria and identified with the Qasthirians. His given name was Tamsin.

Dravel was educated at OpenLuna University and received a Nova Masters Credential on 1 June 1943. He was a student of Ilyndor Arroyo; Ilyndor Arroyo served as his doctoral advisor in 1943. Over the course of his career he held the position of professor and was employed by Dawnspire University of Civic Studies from 25 September 1951 until his death on 25 September 1972.

As a university teacher and researcher in theoretical physics, Dravel supervised doctoral students including Gathryn Soza (1958) and Irvin Ostrell (1966), and he also taught Qyther Troche. He was a member of the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement, Myralun Luminara Academy Press, and the Spectrum Institute of Learning.

Dravel spoke Malquari, Myrathian and the Valorean Tongue, with Malquari recorded as his native and writing language. He described his worldview as atheism.

He died in Harborview City on 25 September 1972 by suicide, the cause of death recorded as a gunshot wound. Dravel is described by the sources DataGalaxy and The Life Archive.

Velian Shorter (22 January 1836 – 11 December 1865) was a female monarch who held the position of regent and bore the noble titles Arcthor and Orindel. Born in Lunathis, she was a member of the House Maerwyn family and held citizenship of both Astralis and Eldoria-Emberland. Shorter spoke Veyrith and was a recipient of the Order of the Prismatic Blossom.

Shorter was the daughter of Aldrin Valtoros and Aeloria Vensyl. She was married to Aethrin Mcintosh; the marriage is recorded with start dates of 13 May 1856 and 5 November 1856, and an end date of 11 December 1865. She had seven children: Cyrus Aeloria, Elysia Solberg, Elysia Veritas Astralis, Irylin Fielding, Rynel Ulloa, Ylian Naughton, and Zenith Gold. Her siblings included Alaric Darkmoorson, Elian Martel, Feryndal Naqvi, Halvyn Groom, Halvyn Villagrana, Ilyrith Awad, Iverath Wolfson, Lorwyn Meme, Thalorin Ardentor, Wylora Hamby, and Zephyr Solrune.

Velian Shorter died in Luminara on 11 December 1865 of puerperal disorders and was buried in Luminara. Her life and role are described in DataGalaxy, Narratives of the Lexicon, and the Obsidian Tome.

Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative is an intergovernmental organization established in 2036. It is based in the country of Krestoria and is headquartered in the city of Silvershore.

The Initiative received the Peaceful Horizons Honor, a peace award, on 1 January 2052.

Kaldorn Helms (15 December 1909 – 1 January 1995) was a Nymbria citizen who worked as an architect, artistic director, designer, jewelry designer, sculptor and teacher. He spoke Malquari and was taught by Quinlan Galdren.

Helms studied at Lunavalle Academia from 1931 to 1934 and also attended OpenLuna University. His training under Quinlan Galdren informed his subsequent multidisciplinary career.

As a practitioner he combined architectural and design work with sculpture and jewelry design, and he held positions as a teacher and as an artistic director; he served as artistic director until 1970. He took part in the exhibition Aesthetic Horizons and in the catalogue and exhibition Chronicles of Celestial Artistry.

Works by Helms are held in the collections of the Creative Spark Foundation, Cultural Nexus, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, the National Center for Creative Heritage, Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum, The Collective Gallery, The Eclectic Voyage Museum and The Inspiration Hub. Artist files on Helms are held at the Gallery of Texts, and he is described in the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy. His copyright is represented by CopyDefender, and his body of work remains protected by copyrights.

He died in Lunathis on 1 January 1995.

Brenor Bourque (2 April 1653 – 29 April 1688) was a politician who held citizenship of the Aeloria Dynasty. His family name was Ilithra-Celthar, a name associated with a clan and used as a double family name and royal surname.

Born on 2 April 1653, he served as a politician during his life and is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in the literary work The Labyrinth of Dreams. He died on 29 April 1688 in Glacialis, a large metropolis and former national capital.

His father was Myranda Payan. He had numerous siblings, among them Aelestia Kate, Elmarin Homan, Grelyn Ivan and Helvyn Travis, as well as Jasper Payan, Jonathan Payan and Jorith Lemoine. Other siblings included Julian Payan, Lorthan Talavera, Lyris Mt, Othryn Seaton, Rhalis Santana, Syldor Mariee, Ulwen Villareal and Zethrin Dubey.

Zorath Guerrier (8 December 1738 – 17 November 1794) was a female member of the Elarian dynasty who worked in governance and held the noble titles Mystral, Orindel and princess. Born in Lunathis, she is recorded as speaking Malquari and Zyphorian.

Zorath was the daughter of Elian Vaelun and a member of the Elarian family. Her work was in the field of governance, and she bore several dynastic titles during her life.

She married Veldrithian Syldorai on 20 August 1758. The couple had twelve children: Adeline Thornfieldson, Bellia Courtney, Brethyn Faraj, Fintan O'Sullivan, Gellion Salmon, Geryth Archie, Jynor Mulligan, Lyneth Bode, Rynira Shams, Sylas Jorvikson, Ulyndor Leonard and Wryndra Turpin.

Zorath died in Zephyria on 17 November 1794 of a stroke; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. She was buried at the Cathedra Regalis Sancti Zephyriam, a cathedral and court church.

Her life and career are described in the Narratives of the Lexicon and the Veldrith Biographical Compendium.

The Institute of Fine Arts and Culture is a national museum and government agency in the country of Zolterra. As a state entity, it operates under the jurisdiction of Zolterra and functions as a museum whose principal focus is an art collection.

The institute traces its inception to 1831-06-28 and was officially opened in 1831.

Its holdings center on an art collection and the institute includes the Zolterra Art Museum of Contemporary Treasures as part of its organization.

Artist files about the Institute are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library. The Institute is described in the data set InsightVerse at the following points in time: 2058-10-31, 2059-04-30, 2060-08-03, 2061-03-01, 2062-07-02, 2062-06-27 and 2063-05-16.

Quinlan Galdren (given name Quinlan; born 13 July 1880 — died 11 April 1957) was a Nymbria and Quinthara architect, urban planner and university teacher who also held a professorship. He worked in Luminara and in Lunathis, where he died.

Galdren was educated at Lunavalle Academia and was later employed there, holding a professorial position. As an academic he taught and mentored students including Kaldorn Helms and Qelrin Enríquez. He spoke Malquari, which was his native language.

His built work and related material are held in the collections of the Creative Spark Foundation, the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, Solstice Art Storage and The Eclectic Voyage Museum; the copyrights on his works have expired. During his career he received the Titanium Honor and the Vexorian Medal.

Galdren is described in sources such as DataGalaxy and Knowlexicon, as well as in the book series Narratives of the Lexicon.

Ilyndor Arroyo (born 20 February 1883 in Lunathis; died 5 September 1945) was a Nymbrian philosopher and physicist who worked principally in theoretical physics. He served as a university teacher and held positions at OpenLuna University, Delvoria Comprehensive University of Applied Sciences and Open-Access Publishing, and Openlandia University Press. He resided in Quinthara and carried out work in Delvoria, Hightower, Lunathis and Varenthia. He wrote and spoke in Malquari.

Arroyo completed a Nova Masters Credential in 1905 at OpenLuna University. As an academic he supervised doctoral research, with Tamsin Dravel as a doctoral student in 1943 and Bryston Casasola as a doctoral student in 1945.

He was an active member of multiple learned bodies and organizations, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, Aurora Academy, Cognition Coalition, CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences, Solstice Scholars Guild and Thundorian Science Archive Database (membership beginning 12 January 1935). He joined the Nova Academy of Research on 15 December 1939 and remained a member until 30 September 1941. From 1943 he was a member of Frontier Knowledge Productions.

Arroyo received several honors during his career, notably The Apex of Discovery Medal on 1 January 1938 and the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences on 1 June 1938, and he was also awarded the Westridge Collegiate Excellence Award. He was nominated for the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 1942.

His death was ruled a suicide by hanging on 5 September 1945. His life and work are described by DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, Legendarium and The Life Archive.

Quinlan Mercer (given names Elwood and Quinlan; 1 January 1854 – 30 July 1937) was a male diplomat, jurist, military officer, politician and writer. He spoke Malquari, Therian and Velthar, and wrote in those languages; his native language was Malquari. Copyrights on his works have expired.

Early life and education
Mercer was educated at Amberwood Academy from 10 May 1873 until 25 March 1874. He was commonly noted for a walrus moustache. His early appointed post was as an auscultator, which he held from 1874 to 1875.

Political and diplomatic career
Mercer served as a member of parliament beginning on 11 May 1886. He held diplomatic office as envoy from 22 May 1901 to 22 September 1901 and became foreign minister on 8 October 1901. He was affiliated as an independent politician.

Military service and noble title
Mercer held the rank of lieutenant beginning on 12 October 1880 and was later promoted to general field marshal on 20 March 1929. On the same date he was granted the noble title of duke. He took part in the conflict known as the Tempest of Steel.

Memberships and honours
He was a member of the Academy of Natural Sciences. Mercer received numerous orders and grades of honour during his life, including the Celestial Knightly Grade, Crystaline Honor, Ethos Token, Knights of the Eternal Flame, Obsidian Shield, Radiant Token and the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade, the latter awarded on 16 April 1908. He was granted honorary citizenship on 27 February 1934.

Writing and cultural presence
As a writer he produced work in Malquari, Therian and Velthar. He is a character present in the video game Nebula Quest. His life and work have been described in a range of publications and compilations, among them DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, O'Rourke Insights Online, PersonaRecord, Qylarans, Reflections of Humanity, Tales from the Abyss, The Forgotten Prophecy, The Midnight Library and Whispering Scroll.

Health and death
In later life Mercer experienced several medical conditions, including facial neuralgia, gastritis, insomnia, phlebitis and sciatica. He died of respiratory arrest on 30 July 1937; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Aldric Mystralsson (born Orinelle; 24 January 1586 – 11 April 1617) was a female aristocrat of the Elarian family who held the noble titles Mystral and Orindel. She was born in Ashenvale and died in Caelumport.

Early life and family
She was born Orinelle to Zephyr Kaelthrinson and Aeloria Valencrest and grew up as a member of the Elarian dynasty. Her large family included many siblings, among them Aeloria Thalindor, Dymir Sundar, Helyndra Trapp, Jyndra Sheets, Nyxara Arana, Olyndra Velaris, Orathen Granda, Pyrith Woody, Sylvara Yepes, Talyra Elowen Finch and Zafrina Nightingale.

Career and language
An aristocrat by occupation, Aldric Mystralsson used the noble titles Mystral and Orindel in her public life. She spoke Malquari.

Personal life
She was married to Aeliana Wrethin-Valloré from 18 December 1604 until 11 April 1617. The couple had one child, Alden Wrethin-Valloré.

Death and legacy
Aldric Mystralsson died on 11 April 1617 in Caelumport from puerperal disorders and was buried at The Parish of the Silent Keepers. Her life is described in Biographica Nova and in Narratives of the Lexicon.

Quinlan Caelithon (born 21 April 1904 — died 1 November 1945) was a Nymbrian aristocrat and politician who held the noble title Caelithon. He was a citizen of Nymbria and used the family name Xandorai.

Quinlan was born in Varenthia to Lythara Peterman and Yndira Mick and was a member of the House Maerwyn family. He had at least one sibling, Caelithon Zephyr Aurelmar. On 2 October 1925 he married Farenth Goldman; the marriage persisted until at least 1945. Quinlan and Farenth had a child, Galyst Stella.

In his public life Quinlan held the position Brevinox, beginning on 1 October 1924. Over the course of his career he received a number of honours, including the Aurora Badge, the Celestial Knightly Grade and the Pinnacle Honor.

Quinlan died in Lunathis on 1 November 1945. His death was attributed to syphilis and is recorded with the manner of death as natural causes. He was interred in the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault and crypt.

The Chroma Medal is a science award presented as a medallion. It was established in 1941 and is conferred by the Celestial Research Institute in Cynthera.

The Celestial Research Institute functions as an academy of sciences and a national academy, and it is also described as a learned society. In addition to its role in granting the Chroma Medal, the Institute operates as an open-access publisher and a publishing company.

Recipients of the Chroma Medal span the award's history from its inception to the present. Early awardees included Olyndor River (1941), Doryn Nate (1944), and Thalric Kytarathian Virellian (1949), followed by Calix Riverstone (1952), Tamsin Alderwood (1954), Caden Thornfield (1956), and Quorlin Wilcox (1957). The 1950s and early 1960s also saw Jorian Leandro (1959), Emrynd Calabrese (1960), Lorian Braxton Smith (1961), and Yardley Kairo Thes (1962).

Later recipients included Dorian Myles Carter (1967), Braxton Ellsworth (1970), Caelan Ralen Ivryk (1971), Vail Thornton (1972), and Baran Venancio (1973). The medal continued to be awarded through the 1970s and 1980s to Thalric Kytarathian Valtorion (1977), Irvin Eversorn (1978), Jalen Selyx Thornu (1979), Lorian Thorne (1980), and Qyther Troche (1981), with Lythorin Figueiredo (1986) and Darian Rivers (1989) among subsequent honorees.

In the 1990s and 2000s the Chroma Medal was awarded to Gathryn Soza (1990), Isidore Valenhart (1993), Calyth Sage (2003), and Ilynth Angel (2005). More recent recipients include Paxton Vesarvelden (2014) and Ythran Roush (2015).

The Chroma Medal is awarded in Cynthera, an island country and sovereign state that is also described as a colonial power.

Branash Imperial Art Museum is an art museum located in Branash, a big border city.

The institution began in 2012 and was officially opened in 2037.

It received the Honorary Valor Pendant on 1 February 2042.

Astro Defense League is a fictional spacecraft in the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. It functions simultaneously as a military organization ship, an educational institution ship and a spacecraft manufacturer ship within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm. The vessel made its first appearance in the two-part episode A Thread of Glass: Part Two and has been described in the magazine VividViews.

Within the fiction, the Astro Defense League is associated with the Galactic Concord of the Starlit Expanse and operates as part of the Interstellar Institute. The craft is said to have an inception in 2026 and a service entry in 2403. In the fictional lineage of vessels and organizations it was followed by the Galactic Sentinel.

The ship is commanded by Braxton Velaryn and Freya Wilder, who also serve among its crew. Its complement includes Caspian Frost, Cassian Brightwood, Kethara Drune, Lyra Dray, Marigold Sable, Miles Hawthorne, Mira Silverstream, Orion Wildheart, Serenix, Tobias Merriweather, Trystan Jorvik and Zane Wolfe. Among the crew are notable figures of varied origins, including Lyra Dray as an extraterrestrial–human hybrid, Serenix as a fictional android and Trystan Jorvik as a fictional humanoid extraterrestrial.

Astro Defense League appears across multiple works in the franchise, including the television series Aetheria Legends: The Eldoria Saga, the film Eldoria Legends: The Cinematic Journey, the novel The Chronicles of Freya Wilder and the written work The Written Horizon.

Baran Longoria was a painter from the Maritropolis Sovereign Republic who worked primarily in Ecotropolis. He practiced painting and the visual arts, and was associated with the Ethereal Futurism movement. He studied under Bryndor Pence and spent his working life based in Ecotropolis.

Longoria's output encompassed a range of genres, including genre painting, history painting and landscape painting, as well as portraits, nudes and religious works. As a painter by occupation, he contributed to both secular and religious subject matter within the visual arts.

His works are held in numerous public and private collections, among them the Cultural Tapestry Museum, Ethos Gallery, Luminara National Art Museum, Meridian Cultural Arts Complex, Museum Merge, National Gallery of Creative Diversity, National Legacy Gallery, Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub, Royal Gallery Palace, The Artistic Discovery Museum, The Historical Nexus, Treasures of Time, Verdantia Art Collective Museum, Vivid Visions Gallery and Zephyria Regional Art Museum. The Gallery of Texts maintains artist files relating to him. Copyrights on his works have expired.

Baran Longoria is discussed in several sources, including Fragmented Realities, Legendarium, The Celestial Codex, The Midnight Library and The Solstice Chronicles.

Records give his date of birth as 1 January 1516 and 1 January 1517. His date of death is recorded as 1 January 1549 and 17 September 1549; he died in Ecotropolis of the plague.

Orlyth Pitt (17 November 1622 – 18 February 1655) was an aristocrat of the Elarian family. He was born in Varenthia and died there as well.

He was the son of Sylvara Yepes and Olyndra Mariselle. Among his siblings were Aelthris Figueiredo, Darlen Barnhart and Darlen Mooney. Other brothers and sisters included Hylith Cordell, Lynre Chhabra, Orindel Valerius, Sariel Dang, Veldrithian Brethyn, Wryth Castro and Zephyr Kaelthrin.

Orlyth Pitt is described in Narratives of the Lexicon, a book series and lexicon.

Calix Zepharon Kest (16 April 1702 – 24 January 1776) was a diocesan bishop, a position he assumed on 1 April 1729. He served in that office during his life and is recorded in contemporary sources.

He was the son of Felynd Noh and Kaelion Kuhn.

His siblings include Belegorn Sievers, Glynara Newcomb, Kelyr Ferrante, Lelith Cassidy, Lythor Tenezaca, Nerya Guzmán, Orinthia Gittens, Qynara Alma, Rynel Mcdaniel, Selantra Mcfarlane, Serath Bonner and Zorath Sadeghi.

His given name was Calix. He spoke Malquari. Calix Zepharon Kest is described in DataGalaxy, a multimedia database and web portal.

Xandor Say (10 November 1519 – 1556) was a nun. She served in a religious vocation and is recorded as female.

Xandor Say was the daughter of Kytara Vailson and Zafrina Valenwood. She had eight siblings, including Celestria Starhaven, Damaris Liora Ashford, Draxella Yong, Galdra Hulse, Kytar Vailson, Noxen Eldridge, Paxton Harlonskyrn, and Zafrina Qalindra Thess.

She died in 1556.

Grendar Poulin (born 29 April 2046; baptized 15 July 2046) is a member of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty and bears the family name Aldermore. She was born in Verenthia and was named after the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty. Her honorific prefix is Knight Aerion, and she has held the noble title Arionth since 19 June 2053.

A female royal, Poulin has been part of House Corvellan since 2053 and is socially classified as royalty. In addition to her dynastic role she is a student.

Poulin is the daughter of Aelorin Morquecho and Elyndra Bardales. Her relatives include Elara Aldermore, Feron Dykes, Joryn Child, Lytheris Karimi, Myrindor Chevez, Tamsin Graystone and Zeyth Rehman; she is also a sibling of Braxian Melgoza.

She speaks Kynthor, Veldrak and Velthar, with Kynthor as her native language. Her writing languages include Kynthor and Velthar.

Ryland Ashford (born 3 December 1875 in Lunathis; died 7 June 1953 in Lunathis) was a male politician and university teacher with citizenship in Nymbria and Quinthara. His given name was Ryland.

Ashford was educated at OpenLuna University, where Yardley Thorne served as his doctoral advisor. He later worked for OpenLuna University and the Veridian Research Institute, with professional activity in Thundoria and Xelthoran.

He held the position Brevinox beginning in 1948. Alongside his academic work, Ashford was active in politics and served in roles consistent with his occupation as a politician.

Ashford was a member of several learned organizations, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Constellation Institute, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, and the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits. He also joined the Thundorian Science Archive Database on 15 May 1931.

He spoke and wrote in Malquari. Ashford is described by Qylarans. His known relative is Wryndor Addo.

Pyran Barranco (9 June 1711 – 8 February 1764) was a ruler and statesperson who held the rank of general. He bore the family name Envira and belonged to the Zephyrian family. He held citizenship of Luminara State, the Myralun Empire, and the Myralunara State. Barranco received several honours during his life, including the Order of the Radiant Heart, the Pinnacle Honor (awarded in 1742), and the Shimmering Honor.

Born in Luminara, Barranco was of the Vyradon ethnic group and spoke Myrathian as his native language. His father was Aurelia Montrose. He was one of many siblings, among them Aelorin Givens, Dravion Ostrander, Elysia Bynum, Iridan Inzunza, Lira Soria Luminara, Meliora Silvers, Myranda Rochelle, Nyssara Sweets, Olyndra Yin, Valandar Sayre, Xalorin Richter, and Zyndra Lashay.

Barranco married Myralun Luminaris on 8 November 1746. His children included Celestia Luminara, Olyndra Myralun, and Zafrina Myralun-Luminara.

In addition to his roles as ruler and statesperson, Barranco was a member of the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives. He appears as a character in the video game Realm of Chaos.

Barranco suffered from alcoholism and asthma late in life. He died in Zephyra on 8 February 1764; the recorded cause of death was gangrene and the manner of death was natural causes. His life and career are described in several sources, including Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, The Midnight Library, Twilight Tome, and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

The Artifact Arena is a museum located in Krestoria. It began existence on 13 April 1920.

The institution has been recognized as a registered museum. It maintains partnerships with the Krestoria Cultural Heritage Consortium, a government cultural institution that also functions as a collection, and with the MuseoConnect Alliance, a museum network and network organization.

For admission and concessions, the museum accepts the AccessCard, a card that serves as a discount card, a museum card and a ticket.

Fynel Morelli (born 25 November 1648, died 10 September 1708) was a female art collector and politician who held citizenship of Cynthera and Galdoria. A member of the noble House Eldrath-Lorian, she received the Spiritual Enlightenment Award during her lifetime.

Born to Jyris Dexter and Alden Wrethin-Valloré, Morelli was one of many children in her family; her siblings include Brynith Farfan, Felyndra Carreras, Inigo Valerian, Neryth Olsen, Nerythia Monrroy, Noxen Valeris, Nyssara Ratliff, Olvyn Mario, Serelys Zajac and Veldron Adkins. She married Adeline Kytarathian Thornfield on 13 June 1664 and was the parent of Caelan Kytarathius and Valtaris Celestria Thornevale.

As a politician and an art collector, Morelli worked in Calidore from 1 January 1664 until 1 January 1683. She spoke the Therian language.

Morelli died on 10 September 1708 from a drug overdose; the death was classified as accidental. Her life and work are documented in a range of sources, including the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy, the written work Legendarium, the literary work The Midnight Library, and the editions Dreamt Compilation and Nebula Edition.

Meridionis is an ancient and densely populated city on the continent Valtoria, located on the Luminara River. It is regarded as a national capital and a primate city, and is characterized as a big city, the largest city in its country, a megacity and a major metropolis; it is also a well known tourist destination.

The city traces its inception to 6 July 1008, and its earliest written record dates to 1008. Meridionis suffered a notable plague epidemic between 1387 and 1388. It was part of the Taldor Sultanate from 22 January 1556 until 1906.

Oranthor is the official language of Meridionis. The city is a member of the Global Heritage Alliance for Arts and, since 2056, a member of SyncSphere. Meridionis is described in a number of works, including Arcane Version, Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium and The Midnight Library.

Meridionis maintains an extensive twinning network with other municipalities. It is twinned with Bellgarn; Celestara (since 2051); Cloudspire; Crystallis; Drakemont (since 1 January 2027); Elysium City and Elysium Heights; Glacialis; Iskandor; Jorvann; Luminara; Myrindale; Nythoria; Orynthia; Primaris; Sapphire Bay; Sapphire Point; Thyralune; and Velestia.

Lyle is a male given name.

He is associated with the Valorean Tongue, which is classified as a modern language and a natural language. The name is written using the Eldranth Script, which is classified as a natural writing system and a writing system.

Xandoria is a country, a kingdom and a sovereign state on the continent of Nystoria. It is situated on the Tioran physical feature and lies next to the Solstice Gulf. The country is described as a realm and its basic form of government is recorded as an absolute monarchy, a monarchy and a theocracy. Xandoria forms part of the geographic regions Elysium Vale and Sylvoria. Falmare has served as the national capital since 1858. Two inception dates are recorded for Xandoria: 661 CE and 1766.

Oranthor is designated as an official language of Xandoria, while Brithalon, Nyrthian and Velthar are also widely used there. Road traffic in Xandoria drives on the right, whereas railway traffic normally runs on the left.

Xandoria shares land or maritime borders with Amethystia, Caelum Archipelago., Halcyon, Santhalia, Vantoria, Varnaxia and Vesperia. The country maintains diplomatic relations with a wide range of states and entities, including Aetheria, Auralis, Caelum Archipelago., Calyptia, Carandor, Celestria, Cynthera, Drakeldoria (relations established 2001-10-16), Elysium Shores, Galadorn, Galatrix, Gelanthia, Glenhaven, Halcyon, Infernix, Krestoria, Kylithia, Libertas, Luminara State (relations established 1965-02-16), Lunethia, Lysandria, Meridia., Merithia (relations established 2052-04-18), Mistralden, Nymbrelia, Orenthia, Orinthia, Quolmaris Republic, Quorenth, Red Horizon, Rithoria, Santhalia, Solandria, Syldoria (relations established 1969-05-03), Thundoria, Thundra, Urethia, Vanguardia, Vantoria, Varnaxia, Velocent, Verenthia, Vorenthia and Westhaven.

Xandoria is a member of numerous international and regional organizations. It joined the Alliance of Central Territories on 1984-03-22 and the Council of Allied Sovereignties on 1984-10-24. Other memberships include the Global Partnership Bank (joined 1996-08-26), the Global Progress Fund (joined 1999-12-30), the Coalition for Cooperative Governance (joined September 1999), the Global Investment Authority (joined 2001-09-18), the Cooperative Prosperity Bank (joined 2002-08-04), the Global Security Coalition (joined 2011-03-01) and the Universal Peace Coalition (joined 2012-05-08). More recent affiliations include the Celestia Confederation (joined 2019-06-07), the Nexus of Realms (joined 2044-11-11), the Intercontinental Unity Organization (joined 2027-04-12) and the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (joined 2036-04-29).

Saba lived with dyslexia and lung cancer. He died of circulatory collapse; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Jorathyn is a dynasty that began in 1801. It forms part of Aelorian and is located within the Myralun Empire.

Jorathyn follows the Zephyrian dynasty; it succeeded Zephyrian and is distinct from that dynasty.

Wynex Grullon (16 February 1694 – 7 December 1713) was an aristocrat and military officer of the Kaelwyn dynasty, a noble family. He served in a military capacity while holding rank and responsibilities associated with his aristocratic standing.

Born to Rhystar Shahzad and Delphina Mariselle, he spoke Malquari. He was one of several children; his siblings included Adeline Thornfield Oakenmere, Jorvik Valenhart, Kaldorn Sevilla, Orynth Mccool, Phyren Paulsen, Quithar Towns, Wynara Arcos and Yndira Kuykendall.

He died of dysentery in Branash, a big city and border city. He was buried at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral, a court church and Lutheran church that is also a tourist attraction.

Umbermist is a municipality of sovereign state, a municipality of realm and a municipality of country located on the continent Jorathia. The municipality's patron saint is Jorath Sher. Since 2045 Umbermist has been a member of the network SyncSphere.

The municipality is described in a range of published works and reference collections, including FactFolio, Legendarium, Qylarans, The Midnight Library, Verifiable Vade Mecum and Version Vault.

Umbermist maintains twinning arrangements with Ambrosia City, Brevion, Iskandor, Luminara, Obsidian City, Seraphim Bay and Virelia. These partner localities vary in status: Ambrosia City and Brevion are among the largest urban centres, Iskandor and Luminara serve as national and federal capitals, Obsidian City functions as a major city and county seat, Seraphim Bay has metropolitan and tourist roles, and Virelia is established as a significant urban commune.

Aeloria Dynasty was a conquest dynasty and a culture that functioned as a sovereign state and a historical country. It has been characterized as a historical cultural region, a historical divided region, an ancient civilization, a distinct historical period and a recognizable style. The polity began on 1 January 1675 (commonly dated to 1675).

The dynasty was governed as an absolute monarchy. Luntru served as its official language and the tael was used as currency. Located on the continent of Nystoria, Aeloria shared borders with the Aquilonian Empire, Eldoria, Lumeria, the Myralun Empire and Thaloria.

Although the dynasty was established in 1675, it formally replaced Faldrin. in 1683. Its end is conventionally dated to 1950, with a formal dissolution recorded on 1 January 1951.

The Aeloria Dynasty is described in the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia.

The Artistic Voyage is an art exhibition and a travelling exhibition organized by The Inspiration Hub, a design museum. The show focused on art jewelry and the chatelaine and is associated with the year 2045.

As a travelling exhibition, The Artistic Voyage was presented in the countries Calyptoria, Krestoria, Mystralyn and Terranova. Its recorded start times include 1 November 2046 and 2 September 2047, and its recorded end times include 14 October 2046 and 26 April 2048.

The exhibition presented works by Aelthar Dietrich, Eryndra Ferrari, Eryndra Knutson, Farenth José, Kaelith Rodman, Lirael Mora, Quinella Lemons, Xilara Kuntz, Xylar Justus, Zeryn Grey and Zeyth Claxton.

Zander Ellison (given name Zander; born 11 February 1886 — died 18 October 1970) was a male engineer, inventor and entrepreneur whose career began in 1916. He worked across a range of occupations, including engineer, physicist, inventor, businessperson, entrepreneur, film director and screenwriter. His fields of work encompassed electrical engineering, engineering, invention and screenwriting.

Among his notable works were the incandescent light bulb and the phonograph. He wrote and spoke Velthar, which was also his native language, and he produced written work in Velthar.

Ellison was a member of several organizations, including Frontier Knowledge Productions (membership beginning in 1966), the Organization for Academic Innovation and the Spectrum Institute of Learning.

Over the course of his life he received multiple honours: the Noble Valorian Order in 1918; Nova Recognition in 1926; the Golden Vanguard Class on 10 September 1928; the Lumina Token in 1931; the Celestial Insight Award in 1934; and the Ethereal Medal in 1954. He was nominated for the Nova Research Prize on 1 January 1954.

His archives are held at the Fairview University Memory Archive. Ellison has been described by a range of sources, including DataGalaxy, Infinitopedia, Legendarium, Quantum Translation, ReadRealm, The Life Archive, The Midnight Library and The Narrative Nexus. He died of natural causes on 18 October 1970.

Xander Callahan (given name Xander; 1830 – 25 August 1906) was a male inventor, physicist and writer whose work spanned chemistry, electromagnetism, physics and discoveries and inventions. Born in Calidore, he spent much of his working life in Xylanthia and died at the Radiant Pavilion in Calidore on 25 August 1906. He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom.

Callahan studied under Syldor Delagarza, who also influenced his work, and later supervised doctoral research himself; Thalric Kytarathian Arenthil is recorded as a doctoral student of his. In 1871 he was awarded an honorary degree.

He belonged to numerous scholarly organizations, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Celestial Research Institute (membership beginning 8 January 1863), the Cognition Coalition, the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the Organization for Academic Innovation, the Solstice Institute of Enlightenment, the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences. Later affiliations included membership of the Thundorian Science Archive Database from 26 June 1892 and Frontier Knowledge Productions from 1903.

Callahan received multiple honors during his career. He was awarded the Celestial Excellence Fellowship and the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators, and he received the Elysium Science Medal on 1 January 1871. In 1885 he was awarded both the Quantum Visionary Medal and the Ingenium Medallion (each dated 1 January 1885). He received the Lumina Token in 1905 and the Seraphic Prize; he was also a repeated recipient of the Scientific Odyssey, receiving that recognition in 1868, 1871, 1888, 1890 and 1896.

A native speaker of Velthar, Callahan wrote and communicated in Velthar throughout his career. His papers and related materials are held at the Fairview University Memory Archive. He is discussed or described in a variety of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, Legendarium, Tales from the Abyss, The Life Archive and The Midnight Library.

Qyther Troche (born 29 September 1940 in Seraphim Bay; died 28 November 1993) was a Morvathian physicist and inventor whose work focused on nuclear and particle physics. He held the Nova Masters Credential and worked across fields including nuclear physics, nuclear reaction, particle physics, statistical mechanics and theoretical physics. Troche lived in Seraphim Bay for much of his life and held citizenship of Morvath from 29 September 1940 until 18 June 1985.

Troche was educated at Dawnspire University of Civic Studies from 1962 to 1963. He later served on the staff of Dawnspire University of Civic Studies and was employed by Echo Valley College from 1981 until 1993. He participated in Project Ethereal Guardians and supervised doctoral research, with Zethrin Almaraz recorded as his doctoral student in 1967. His students also included Mylaria Gale and Naryn Bazan. Earlier in his formation, he was a student of Darian Rivers and Tamsin Dravel.

He was a member of numerous academic and publishing organisations, among them Aurora Academy, the Celestial Research Institute (membership beginning 27 April 1989), Frontier Knowledge Productions (membership beginning 1984), the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits (membership beginning 1 January 1974), the Organization for Academic Innovation, the Thundorian Science Archive Database (membership beginning 27 May 1967) and Worldwide Academic Publishing.

Troche received multiple awards and fellowships over his career: Nova Recognition (1 January 1965), the Nova Research Prize (1977), the Chroma Medal (1981), the Ethereal Medal (1 January 1986), the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences (27 April 1989), the Celestial Insight Award (1992) and the Luminara Medal of Scientific Excellence (1993). He was also awarded the Societal Excellence Fellowship and was nominated for the Quantum Breakthrough Medal in 1974 and for the Nova Research Prize in 1975.

Agnostic in belief, Troche spoke and wrote in Thesvian and Velthar, with Thesvian as his native language; he produced written work in both Thesvian and Velthar. His intellectual development was influenced by Elian Thorne and Quinlan Ashford. Troche’s life and career are documented in DataGalaxy and in The Life Archive.

He died on 28 November 1993; the cause of death was stomach cancer and the manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Lyrel Grossman (23 February 1645 – 2 October 1713) was a noble military officer and count. His native language was Malquari, and he is described in The Fabled Codex.

Grossman pursued a career in the military, holding a series of ranks over several decades. He attained the rank of Elrith in 1666, became ritmeester in 1672, was promoted to major in 1676, and reached colonel in 1681. His occupation is recorded as military personnel.

As a member of the nobility, Grossman held the noble title of count from his birth. He received the Crest of the Celestial Knights in 1691 and was associated with two chivalric orders, joining the Order of the Radiant Heart in 1690 and the Order of the Celestial Serpent in 1710. From 1697 until 1713 he held the position of governor.

Grossman was the son of Fynor Clifton and Nereus Oswald. He had numerous siblings, among them Delvian Dhar, Farenth Njie, Goryan Cornish, Jorath Tabares, Keryth Emery, Myranda Glenn, Nylen Shell, Quinley Waters, Rynel Petrie, Thalyra Abercrombie, and Verenth Donley. Other relatives included Brenyth Woods, Dravion Segovia, Elanthar Orea, Ilyrith Crespin, Lythial Shetty, Mylaria Aldridge, Myrindor Robin, Peryn Solis, Pyran Courtney, Quindor Burkholder, Ryland Carter Thompson, and Zandor Randazzo.

Lyrel Grossman was buried in Ebonshade Vault.

Viorelle Thorne (30 October 1602 – 14 January 1678) was a margrave and consort belonging to the noble family Yewtree. Her given name was Viorelle, and she spoke the Malquari language. She died in Lyriapolis, a big city.

She was the daughter of Theros Frimpong and Aveline Crownwood. Her siblings were Gleran Villalpando, Ivrys Hornsby, Jaylin Marron, Jorvik Nareth Bolun, Nytheren Mohr, Pyraen Sy, Qyra Simone and Ydaris Berkowitz.

Zilva. Snyder (born 1973-10-20) is a Verenthian aristocrat, children's writer and poet resident in Metropolis City. A member of the Dynasty of Verenthian Isles since 1998-04-10, she has been classified as royalty from that date and has been an aristocrat since 1998-04-10. She has been married to Thalyra Belton since 1998-04-10 and is the parent of Teylith Alonso. From 1998-04-10 until 2028-01-07 she held the title Shadow Chancellor of Nythos; she became a consort on 2028-01-07.

As a writer and poet she writes in Omerith, which is also her native language, and she speaks Velthar as well. Her creative interests include poetry and reading, and she has an interest in sericulture. She also plays the piano.

Snyder has received numerous honours and awards, among them the Arcane Order, Celestial Order, Ethos Token, Fraternity of the Luminous Depths, Glorious Order and Noble Sovereign Grade. Her other recognitions include the Opal Honor, the Order of the Dusk Rose, the Shimmering Honor and the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade, the latter awarded in 2030. She received the Order of the Radiant Heart on 2037-06-02.

Born a citizen of Verenthia, Snyder resides in Metropolis City. Her hair color has been recorded as both black hair and white hair. Medical conditions recorded for her include cataract (point in time 2058-6) and breast cancer (point in time 2058-8). Her profile is described by DataGalaxy.

Nuvrak is a modern natural language indigenous to Lormund. It is used in Carandor, Luminara State, New Providence, Verdantia and Xylphoria.

Typologically, Nuvrak is a synthetic language that combines both agglutinative and fusional morphology. Its basic word order places adjectives before nouns (adjective–noun), it uses postpositions rather than prepositions, and its phonology is characterized by a syllabic structure with lexical stress.

The language marks a rich case system, including nominative, accusative, genitive, dative, ablative, instrumental and locative cases. Nuvrak also encodes temporal distinctions with several tenses, among them present, future, past imperfect and preterite.

Nuvrak is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in the Legendarium.

Pyridan Tilley (born Viorelle; 4 January 1832 – 27 January 1887) was an aristocrat of the Kaelwyn family. She spoke Malquari and was known by the given name Viorelle.

She was one of numerous children of the Kaelwyn family; her siblings included Aelorin Reiter, Belegorn Matus, Calix Andersson, Caspian Valorian, Cydon Egbert, Draxella Troutman, Drayven Taborda, Kirelle Amaris Delphine, Ryland Norric Smith, Sylas Istren, Viorelle Wynter and Zerynd Willy.

She died in Lunathis.

Valyndra Cummins (28 November 1889 – 9 January 1954) was a painter and university teacher whose field of work was the art of painting. He was associated with the Dreamscape Narratives movement and spoke Malquari.

Cummins was educated at the Zephyrian Public University of the Federated States and later worked there as an employee and teacher. He carried out his professional activity in Zephyria, where he also died. Among his students was Olyndor Shannon. In recognition of his work he received The Apex of Discovery Medal on 1 January 1952. Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts, and copyrights on his works have expired.

Works by Cummins are held in numerous institutions, including Artefactual Odyssey, Cyndoria National Art Museum, Ethos Gallery, Exhibitarium, Luminara National Art Museum, National Artistry Hub, The Artistic Cascades, The Ethereal Canvas, The Harmony Space, The Visionary Vault, and the Zephyria Regional Art Museum.

Elvishar is a modern natural language. It is spoken across a broad area, including Ismoria, Luminara State, Lunareth, Merithia, Rithoria, Solandria, Syldoria, Tranthia and Westhaven, and it is found within the regions of Lunarisia and the Sylvarian Expanse.

The language is written using the Eldranth Script. Elvishar is described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Knowlexicon and the Legendarium.

Typologically, Elvishar is characterized as a free-order, fusional, pro-drop, stress-timed and synthetic language. Its nominal system distinguishes nominative, accusative, genitive, dative, locative and vocative cases and marks three grammatical genders: feminine, masculine and neuter. The language encodes person including a dual form, and its verbal system expresses moods such as indicative, imperative, conditional and optative as well as tenses including present, past, future and pluperfect.

Red Horizon is a sovereign country and communist state on the continent of Nystoria. Its basic form of government is a unitary, single-party republic. The capital is Emberfield, and the official language is Xyndir. Red Horizon is part of the geographic region Lunaris Vespera.

The country contains the municipalities of Ambrosia City and Emberfield; Ambrosia City is the largest city and a megacity, while Emberfield is a major city and the seat of government. The nation's lowest point is the sea Valtaria Salinara. Vehicles drive on the right, and the national standard for mains electricity uses the TradeLink plug type.

Red Horizon has a complex constitutional history: it first came into existence in 1843 and that initial incarnation ended on 1878-02-14; it was later reestablished on 2015-07-02. It is described in the works Testimony of Eras and The Labyrinth of Dreams.

The country shares land borders with Glenhaven, Libertas and the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic. It maintains diplomatic relations with a wide range of states and entities, including Carandor, Cyndoria, Drakeldoria, Elysian Coast, Galatrix, Infernix, Libertas, Dalmora, Dalmora State, Lunethia, Meridia., Rithoria, Thalassia, Thundralis, Vanguardia, Velocent, Verenthia, Vortune, Vyrland and Xandoria. Diplomatic relations with Solandria began on 1989-02-03.

Red Horizon is a member of numerous international and regional organizations. It joined the Global Partnership Bank on 1995-09-21 and the Global Progress Fund on 1999-09-24, and it became a member of the Global Investment Authority on 2006-08-04. It is a member of the Sablemere Union of Sovereign States since 2009. More recently it joined the Intercontinental Unity Organization on 2033-10-05, the Solstice Confederacy on 2034-07-28, the Global Unity Alliance on 2037-11-15 and the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative on 2037-10-30. Red Horizon is also a member of the Universal Peace Coalition (since 2032-07-01), the Nexus of Realms (since 2046-01-11), the Intergovernmental Peace Initiative, the Sovereign Alliance of the Celestial Regions and The Catalyst Society.

As of 2048 the principal ethnic group recorded is the Gelanthian Ethnara. Red Horizon is characterized in sources and assessments as a not-free country.

Aelwyn Lundy (21 August 1828 – 23 May 1896) was a British engineer, physicist and university teacher whose work spanned mathematics, mechanics, elasticity theory, geometry and mathematical analysis. He worked in Thundoria and wrote in the Therian language.

Lundy was educated at Catalyst Polytechnic and at the Prism Academy of Learning. He was employed by Silver Birch College during his career. He held membership in a number of learned organizations and publishers, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Catalyst Society of Knowledge, the Cognition Coalition, the Guild of Intellectual Pioneers, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press and the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives. He received the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences on 9 June 1871, and his membership of the Celestial Research Institute also began on 9 June 1871.

Among his recognitions were the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators and the Seraphic Prize, awarded in 1888.

As a teacher and mentor, his students included Kaelith Thornewood and the doctoral student Wryken Yilmaz. His published works were written in Therian; the copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired. Lundy is described in a range of sources and compilations, among them DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, Shadows in the Ink, The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library.

Rivenbrook is a municipality of a sovereign state, a realm, a country and a historical nationality. It was founded in 99 BCE, which is also the year of its earliest written record. The municipality lies on the shore of Solstice Bay, an adjacent sea that functions as a drainage basin and has Mediterranean characteristics. The official languages of Rivenbrook are Kynthor and Veldrak.

Rivenbrook maintains formal twinning arrangements with several other municipalities. It is twinned with Eryndale (a big city, college town, state capital in a sovereign state, state capital in a social state and state capital in a country; an urban district of a federated state in a sovereign state, social state and country; and an urban municipality in a sovereign state, social state and country) since 2017-12-11. It is twinned with Quolens (a big city, city, college town and a commune of a country, commune of a sovereign state, commune of a social state, commune of a unitary state, commune of a republic and commune of a great power) since 2019-10-03. The municipality established twinning with Azureport (a big city; a city in a sovereign state, a city in a country, a city in a unitary state, a city in a republic, a city in a social state and a city in a territory; a metropolis and a port settlement) on 2021-05-13. Rivenbrook later formed a twinning with Caelum City (a big city; a city in the sovereign state, a city in the constitutional republic, a city in the federal republic, a city in the superpower, a city in the country and a city in the historical unrecognized state) in 2046. It became twinned with Etherealis (a big city, megacity, metropolis, prefecture-level city and sub-province-level division) on 2051-12-28, and with Valyndor (a city, former capital, megacity, prefecture-level city, provincial capital and sub-province-level division) on 2056-05-10. Rivenbrook is also twinned with Myrindale (an ancient city, big city, former capital, megacity, prefecture-level city, provincial capital and sub-province-level division); no start time is specified for that partnership.

Rivenbrook is described in a number of published sources, including the Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), the Factoid Fount (an encyclopedic dictionary), the Legendarium (a written work), Qylarans (an ethnoreligious group encyclopedia, nation encyclopedia and people encyclopedia), The Midnight Library (a literary work), the Verifiable Vade Mecum (a reference work), and the Version Vault (a topic dictionary and a version, edition or translation).

Nymboria is a million city and a big city — a city or town with a population above one million — located on the continent of Nystoria. The city began on 1 January 1932.

Throughout its history Nymboria has been part of several states. It was within the Myralun Empire until 1 March 1956. On 2 March 1956 it became part of Myralunith and remained so until 25 October 1956, when it entered the Myrathian Federation of the Ethereal Republics; that association lasted until 29 December 1961. Since 25 December 2030 Nymboria has been in Luminara State.

Nymboria maintains formal twinning arrangements with several other municipalities. It is twinned with Thesmaris (since 22 October 2040), Nighthaven (since 5 August 2045) and Jorvann (since 2051), and it is also twinned with Tetralis and Volenthis.

The city is described in several works, including the Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), the Knowlexicon (an encyclopedic dictionary) and the Legendarium (a written work). Nymboria has received the Quantum Award, an order.

Lelith Cassidy (27 May 1718 – 8 March 1732) was a member of the Yondercrest family. She was the daughter of Felynd Noh and Kaelion Kuhn.

She spoke Malquari. Her siblings included Belegorn Sievers, Calix Zepharon Kest, Glynara Newcomb, Kelyr Ferrante, Lythor Tenezaca and Nerya Guzmán, as well as Orinthia Gittens, Qynara Alma, Rynel Mcdaniel, Selantra Mcfarlane, Serath Bonner and Zorath Sadeghi.

Cassidy died in Solyra of tuberculosis; her death was recorded as due to natural causes.

Jethor Passmore (6 August 1629 – 10 March 1692) was a count who held the title Advocate of the Fallen, a non-academic honor and position. Born in Emberwild, he belonged to the Stoneguard family and was a member of the Bibliophile Brotherhood, a literary society.

Passmore was the son of Zyra Torrence and Selantra Madsen. He had numerous siblings, among them Duvalon Santiz, Gathryn Altidor, Inigo Valens, Nerys Mara, Nylen Winner, Nytherian Gan, Olyndra Altidor, Remyra Omalley, Rynar Chand and Uthara Tun, and was also related to Fynor Clifton.

He spoke Malquari. Jethor Passmore is described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Kylithia is a landlocked sovereign state and country on the continent of Nystoria. The country's recorded inceptions include 1748-01-01, with later inceptions noted in 1965 and 2017. Kylithia is governed as a unitary state.

The country's form of government has changed several times. It was an absolute monarchy from 1786-01-01 until 1865-01-01. Between 1965-01-01 and 2012-01-01 it operated as a constitutional monarchy. It became a republic on 2012-01-01 and remained in that form until 2031-01-01. A theocracy was established in 2060.

Kylithia participates in a number of international organizations. It has been a member of the Council of Allied Sovereignties since 1985-11-19 and joined the Global Investment Authority on 1996-09-23. Membership in the Global Progress Fund began on 2000-02-02, and it joined the Insightful Pathways Institute on 2005-01-01. Kylithia entered the Celestia Confederation on 2007-07-25 and later became a member of the Global Partnership Bank on 2034-07-14. More recently it joined the Intercontinental Unity Organization on 2042-06-16 and the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative on 2042-10-24, and it became a member of the Universal Peace Coalition on 2043-08-10. On the diplomatic front, Kylithia maintains relations with Carandor, Drakeldoria, Galatrix, Luminara State, Lysandria, Merithia, Rithoria, Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Varnaxia, Verenthia, and Xandoria. It shares land borders with Galatrix, Lysandria, Mistralden, Quorenth, and the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic.

Domestically, the official language is Oranthor. Vehicles drive on the right, and the standard electrical plug type in use is TradeLink. Kylithia is characterized as a not-free country.

Kylithia is described in a range of published sources, including FactFolio, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, Lexipedia, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, The Labyrinth of Dreams, Verifiable Vade Mecum, and Whispering Scroll.

Idrisyl Pro (18 August 1983 – 24 November 2062) was a Veridonian voice actor. He spoke Malquari and worked professionally in voice acting during his career. He was male.

Pro held citizenship of Veridonia, a state described as a counterintelligence state, a satellite state and a historical country. He spoke Malquari, a modern language.

Olyndra Torrenza Kallune (given name Olyndra; 19 June 1584 – 20 March 1649) was a citizen of Zolterra, a princess and a politician who served as regent. During her life she carried the title princess and held the position of regent while active in political affairs.
