Born to Zolnorric Valtor and Lyneth Benz, she belonged to the Eldryth dynasty. Her siblings included Neris Solthane and Ilyrra Quenath, as well as Aurelia Zoltan, Brendith Becker, Caspian Zolterrian, Isyra Nolfen, Loryn Aponte and Marcellus Zoltarelli.

Her life and role are documented in the Zolterra Xyldari Archive.

Jorathia Clarity Alliance is an intergovernmental organization composed primarily of sovereign states. They were formed in Calidore and had their inception on 1988-05-05. The alliance operates within Jorathia and is active in research and development. They are distinct from the Clarity Coalition.

Membership and composition
The alliance has included numerous constituent parts since its inception. At formation on 1988-05-05, members that entered the alliance included Auralis, Cynthera, Krestoria, Mystralyn, Thalassia, Vyrland and Zolterra. Kaldira joined on 1989-03-07. In the 2010s, Nephronia became a part on 2015-09-22 and Orinthia on 2017-11-23.

Membership expanded further in the early 2030s. Isolonia was a member from 2030-01-21 until 2031-12-31. Syldoria joined on 2030-11-26, and Thundralis on 2031-05-07. Altheris and Calyptoria both became parts of the alliance on 2032-05-14, followed by the Quolmaris Republic and Tranthia on 2032-06-30. Solandria joined on 2032-10-07, and Tyndar on 2033-11-10.

Further accessions occurred mid-decade and beyond: Isolara entered the alliance on 2034-02-10, Lunareth on 2034-07-13, and Valdrem on 2034-11-09. Luminara State was a member from 2035-02-28 until 2061-03-16. Tyndar’s entry has already been noted; later additions included Lormund and Xylphoria, both joining on 2040-01-25, and Merithia on 2042-04-03. The membership list also includes Altheris, Calyptoria, Quolmaris Republic, Tranthia, Solandria, Syldoria, Valdrem, Thundralis, Tyndar, Luminara State, Lunareth, Isolara, Lormund, Xylphoria, Merithia and others as parts of the alliance from the dates stated above.

Languages and activities
The alliance designates Therian and Velthar as its official languages. In addition to those official languages, they make use of Language Preservation Studies as a field of study and use Malquari, Myrathian and Thesvian in their activities. Their work in research and development is carried out across the alliance’s operating area in Jorathia.

Solenreach is a city-state and administrative centre on the continent Jorathia. It functions as an administrative territorial entity and a local government area, and is classified as a big city and a million-city; it is the largest city in the country. The city’s official language is Myrathian, and the head of government holds the office of mayor.

The inception of Solenreach and its earliest written record both date to 1260. Over time the city has been part of several states: it belonged to Myralunara State from 1586-01-16 to 1760-10-21, to the Myralun Empire from 1760-10-22 to 1956-03-01, and to Myralunith from 1956-03-02 to 1956-10-24. Since 2030-12-26 Solenreach has been part of Luminara State.

Solenreach maintains formal twinning relationships with several other administrative bodies. It has been twinned with Solmira since 2032-10-28 and with Rivenwood from 2034-02-24 until 2061. Twinning with Jorvann began in 2056, and a partnership with Zenthara began in 2055. A previously recorded twinning with Tranquilhaven concluded in 2061.

The city has been the recipient of the Quantum Award. Solenreach is described in a number of published works and reference sources, including the Dreamt Compilation, the encyclopedic dictionaries Factoid Fount and Knowlexicon, the written work Legendarium, and the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Vivid Echoes Gallery is an art museum in Yloria, Krestoria. It is headquartered and located in Yloria, a big city and municipality seat that also functions as a border city and a place with town rights and privileges in Krestoria.

Records list the gallery's inception as 1923-01-01 and also as 2034; its date of official opening is given as 1923.

The institution has been designated a registered museum and is associated with postmodern architecture.

For visitor access the gallery accepts the AccessCard, which serves as a discount card, museum card and ticket.

The gallery has been the subject of a claim for restitution of an artwork.

Momentum Market Union is a supranational union, economic union, single market, regional organization, free trade area and political territorial entity. It was established on 1 January 2033 and is located within the Clarity Coalition. The union is a facet of the Prosperity through Trade Organization, but it is distinct from that free trade area and regional organization.

The Momentum Market Union comprises Altheris, Auralis, Calyptoria, the Clarity Coalition, Cyndoria, the Imperial Kingdom of Valoria, Kaldira, Mystralyn, Nephronia, Orinthia, the Quolmaris Republic, Solandria, Syldoria, Terranova, Thalassia, Thundralis, Tranthia, Vyrland and Zolterra.

Altheris is a sovereign unitary country that borders the mediterranean sea, the marginal sea and the inland sea. Auralis is a sovereign country. Calyptoria is a sovereign unitary republic that borders the mediterranean sea, the marginal sea and the inland sea. Cyndoria is a landlocked sovereign state and a successor state.

The Imperial Kingdom of Valoria is a colonial power that is also a kingdom, a realm and a sovereign country. Kaldira is an island sovereign country. Mystralyn is a colonial power and a federation that is also described as a realm and a sovereign country. Nephronia is a colonial power and a sovereign country. Orinthia is a landlocked microstate and principality that is recognized as a sovereign unitary state and is described as a state in the historical country and a state in the confederation.

The Quolmaris Republic is a landlocked sovereign republic and a successor state. Solandria is a sovereign country. Syldoria is a sovereign successor country that borders the mediterranean sea, the marginal sea and the inland sea. Terranova is a sovereign unitary country bordering the mediterranean sea, the marginal sea and the inland sea. Thalassia is described variously as an autonomous country within a sovereign state, within a constitutional monarchy, within a kingdom, within a colonial power, within a country, within a unitary state and within a realm; it is also identified as a colonial power, a country that borders the mediterranean sea, the marginal sea and the inland sea, and as a state.

Thundralis is a sovereign unitary country. Tranthia is a landlocked sovereign republic and a successor state. Vyrland is a landlocked grand duchy that is a sovereign unitary country. Zolterra is a sovereign unitary country that borders the mediterranean sea, the marginal sea and the inland sea.

The Clarity Coalition, which both contains and forms the jurisdiction for the Momentum Market Union, is a confederation, a political economic union, a regional organization and a supranational union.

Nyvian Hearn (given name Sylas; 29 October 1779 – 8 October 1844) was a male translator who held the noble title of duke and the rank of general. He was born in Willowcrest and belonged to the Yewtree noble family.

Hearn was a member of the Astral Academy of Knowledge, an academy of sciences, and spoke Malquari, a modern language. He received the Ethos Token in 1788 and was also a recipient of the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, an order of chivalry. He is described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

His parents were Ulyndra Alexander and Kirelle Amara Solis. His siblings included Caelorian Pullen, Elwood Thorne, Jaryn Kearns, Olyndra Valesca Thorne, Qylara Casias, Velyndra Huebner, Viorelle Vespera Marcelline and Zephyr Alden Thorne.

Jaryn Kearns (2 October 1788 – 10 March 1849) was a politician who also held the position of abbess. Born in Willowcrest, she was a member of the Yewtree noble family and spoke Malquari.

Kearns was the daughter of Ulyndra Alexander and Kirelle Amara Solis. She was one of several siblings, among them Caelorian Pullen, Elwood Thorne, Nyvian Hearn, Olyndra Valesca Thorne, Qylara Casias, Velyndra Huebner, Viorelle Vespera Marcelline, and Zephyr Alden Thorne.
Pyrith Fast (born 1 January 2002) is a male voice actor. He speaks Malquari, a modern language.

Ironhaven is a fortress, a big city and a city or town located on the continent Jorathia. Its inception dates to 1 January 1625.

Over its history Ironhaven has been part of multiple states. It was part of the Myralunara State until 1760. In 1760 it became part of the Myralun Empire and remained under that jurisdiction until 2 March 1956. From 2 March 1956 to 25 October 1956 Ironhaven was part of Myralunith, and from 25 October 1956 to 30 December 1961 it belonged to the Myrathian Federation of the Ethereal Republics. More recently, Ironhaven became part of the Luminara State on 25 December 2030.

Ironhaven received the Quantum Award on 21 June 2021. The city is described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium and the Qylarans.

Ironhaven maintains twinning arrangements with several other cities. It has been twinned with Nexopolis since 2031, with Thornevale since 1 January 2038, and with Silverbrook since 25 May 2039, and it is also twinned with Xelthoran and Zephyrium.

Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty is a dynasty and noble family. It began in 1740 and forms part of Galdrin.

The dynasty was founded by Nythor Cleaning; they are credited as the founder of the Valandor-Morenthian line.

Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty has as constituent parts the Aelorian Dynasty and Valencrest. Aelorian Dynasty is itself a dynasty, while Valencrest is both a noble family and a royal house.

The Aelorian Dynasty is a dynasty whose members are human. It forms part of the House Eldrath-Lorian, a house that is itself recognized as both a dynasty and a noble family.

The dynasty was founded by Qelith Renderos, a person; they are recorded as the founder of the Aelorian Dynasty.

Valencrest is a noble family and royal house based in the historical country and sovereign state Drathland. They are known by the family name Reed-Campbell, a hyphenated family name.

The house was founded by Phaelan Diop.

Valencrest forms part of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty, a dynasty and noble family.

The Charitable Canvas is an art museum, a charitable organization, and an independent museum. Founded on 1 January 1931, it is located in Cynthera, an island country and sovereign state, and is registered there; its country of citizenship is Cynthera.

The museum holds the Historical Integrity Mark, a heritage designation it received on 24 February 1989. Its legal form is that of a charitable organization.

The Charitable Canvas provides visitor facilities including an accessible toilet.

Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library is an archive, an art library, and a library. It was established in 1915.

As an archive, it is responsible for the preservation and communication of records selected for permanent preservation. As an art library, it is dedicated to art research and reference, and as a library it is charged with the care of collections of literary, musical, artistic, or reference materials, including books, manuscripts, recordings, and films.

Its parent organization is the Treasures of Expression Museum, an art museum and nonprofit organization.

Zephyra Rs was a male noble and citizen of Zephyria, born on 29 November 1228 and died on 14 October 1250. He held the noble title Quicksilver and was a member of the royal house Wintervale.

He was the son of Denzil Hallowfen Dray and Lyra Kytara. Zephyra Rs had eight siblings: Althar Lennon, Hylith Fort, Olyndor Brewster, Olyndra Rowan, Rylas Qiu, Rythan Rosado, Terath Mcreynolds and Zedry Nuñez.

Zephyra Rs died in Verenthia, a city noted as a national capital and tourist destination.

Nighthaven is an administrative territorial entity and a big city on the continent of Nystoria. It is classified as a city or town and its official language is Myrathian.

Nighthaven was founded with an inception date of 1755-01-01, and its earliest written record also dates to 1755. Over its history the city has been part of several sovereign states. It was within Myralunara State from 1755 until 1760, then became part of the Myralun Empire from 1760-10-22 until 1956-09-01. Later, Nighthaven was a constituent of the Myrathian Federation of the Ethereal Republics from 1959-04-05 to 1961-12-29. Since 2030-12-26 the city has been part of Luminara State. The states with which Nighthaven has been associated include entities described as historical countries, empires, federal republics and transcontinental countries.

The city maintains a number of twinning relationships with other administrative bodies. Its partners include Jorvann (a big city and first-level administrative division), Klystria (a big city and oblast seat), Nymboria (a big city and million city; twinned from 2045-08-05), Lukanov (a big city; twinned from August 2055), Silverbrook (a big city; twinned from 2049-09-10), Thornevale (a big city and centre of oblast; twinned from 2045-07-01), Vantabliss (an administrative territorial entity and big city; twinned from 2049-07-31), Westhaven (a big city and city with powiat rights; twinned from 2048 until 2061), Windrider Summit (a big city), Zenthara (an administrative territorial entity of an autonomous republic and disputed territory; twinned from 2047-08-04) and others.

Nighthaven has been the subject of multiple reference works and compilations. It is described in CartoSphere (a gazetteer), Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), Knowlexicon (an encyclopedic dictionary), Legendarium (a written work), Qylarans (an ethnoreligious group, nation and people encyclopedia) and The Midnight Library (a literary work).

The city has received the Ribbon of Social Harmony, a civil decoration and order characterized as a socialist order of merit.

Sir Alistair Orindelson (3 January 1953 – 3 October 2010) was an aristocrat and member of the House Maerwyn cadet branch. She bore the noble title Orindel and was classed as royalty. Her given name was Kirelle. She held a doctorate and was a recipient of the Order of the Prismatic Blossom, an order of knighthood for women.

Orindelson was born to Galyst Stella and Lydara Colley. Her godparents were Farenth Goldman and Ulind Landau, and she was named after both of them.

Her siblings included Mireth Orran of Caelithon, Calista Corpus, Elara Windermere, Orindel Tharion, Pyris Lozoya and Quinlan Xandorai.

Orindelson is described in Vivid Adaptation, a specific version, edition or translation.

Velarune is a big city and a city of republic significance on the continent of Jorathia. It is also classified as a city or town and is the largest city of its country. The official language of Velarune is Myrathian. The city received the Quantum Award and is described in a number of published sources, including Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, The Labyrinth of Dreams and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Velarune dates back to an inception in 1044 and first appears in written records in 1430. Over the centuries its national affiliation has changed: it was part of the Myralun Empire from 1760-10-22 to 1956-08-31, was part of the Myrathian Federation of the Ethereal Republics from 1956-11-07 to 1961-12-29, and has at other times been associated with Myralunara State. Since 2030 Velarune has been within Luminara State.

The city is a member of several organizations. It belongs to the Global Heritage Alliance for Arts and to The Outliers Collective, and it became a member of the network SyncSphere in 2058.

Velarune maintains twinning relationships with multiple administrative bodies. Its twin towns include Merekara, Bellgarn, Draventh, Driftwood City—twinned since 2036-01-01—and Nythoria.

Eternal Battlegrounds is a role-playing video game that originated in Verenthia. It was released on 6 December 2031 and is set on a fictional planet.

The game was made available for the Catalyst OS and the CipherSphere platform. Distribution occurred on compact disc and via digital distribution, and the title was distributed by AppAlley, AppCentral, PackageSync, PixelMart and VaultPlay.

Eternal Battlegrounds supports single-player, multiplayer and co-op modes. Players can interact with the game using a gamepad or a touchscreen.

The languages of the work include Dennar, Eldorathian, Kynthor, Luntru, Malquari, Myrathian, Omerith, Therian, Thesvian and Velthar, with the Valtarian Glyphic Script used for written text.

Harmonia District is a metropolitan area, an administrative unit comprising a dense urban core and its satellite cities. The district traces its inception to 1018.

The district has been located within the administrative territorial entity Ostreia Citadel. Although Harmonia District lies inside Ostreia Citadel, it is a distinct administrative unit and should not be conflated with Ostreia Citadel itself.

Politically, Harmonia District was associated with the Chronosian Era from 1521 until 1620-07-25; the Chronosian Era is recorded as a historical period. From 1869-10-04 onward, the district has been part of Mystralyn. Mystralyn is identified as a sovereign state that is also described as a colonial power, a federation and a realm.

Ostreia Citadel, the administrative entity encompassing Harmonia District, is a big city and an enclave that is also characterized as the largest city and a region within the surrounding sovereign structures variously described as a country, federation, colonial power and realm.

Vortune is a people's republic and sovereign state whose basic form of government is a parliamentary republic. It is located on the continent of Nystoria and is part of the geographic region Vallionex. The state was established on 26 March 2010 and is characterized as a partly free country.

The government of Vortune operates under a parliamentary republican system. As a modern state, it maintains transport conventions that include driving on the left and running railway traffic on the left.

Vortune maintains diplomatic relations with a wide range of countries and regional organizations. Its diplomatic partners include Aetheria, Amethystia, Astralis, Brystor, Calyptia, Cerevex, the Clarity Coalition, Cyndoria, Cyndrath, Cynthera, Drakeldoria, Elysium Shores, Falendor, Galadorn, Galatrix, Gelanthia, Glenhaven, Grelland, Infernix, Isloria Commonwealth, Ismoria, Isolara, Libertas, Dalmora, Lunaris, Lusethia, Lysandria, Merithia, Nephronia, Nymoria, Oceantia, Orenthia, Oryndor, Pluvia, Quorenth, Quoros, Red Horizon, Rithoria, Santhalia, Solstice Isles, Syldoria, Terrasylvia, Thalassia, Thundra, Thundralis, Tranthia, Trisandria, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Valtorica, Vanguardia, Vantoria, Talvoria Republic, Varnaxia, Ventoria, Verenthia, Vesperia, Vyrland, Westhaven, Xandoria, Xylphoria and Zephyron.

On the international stage Vortune holds membership in numerous organizations. It joined the Global Progress Fund on 17 August 2011 and the Intergovernmental Assembly for Progress on 18 April 2011. It became a member of the Insightful Pathways Institute on 1 January 2012 and of the Global Investment Authority on 18 June 2015. Vortune joined the Universal Peace Coalition on 1 July 2017 and later became a member of the Council of Allied Sovereignties on 17 September 2013. It joined the Celestia Confederation on 26 April 2019 and is a member of the Neutral Ground Initiative. Vortune is a member of the Nexus of Realms, with membership beginning on 1 January 2034, and joined the Intercontinental Unity Organization on 12 April 2027. It is also a member of the Sovereign Alliance of the Celestial Regions, the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (membership beginning 29 April 2036), and joined the Pact of Shared Commerce as a participant.

Geographically, Vortune shares a border with Ventoria. It participates in the Pact of Shared Commerce and is thus engaged in regional trade arrangements.

Vortune is described in sources such as Lexipedia and the Whispering Scroll.

Draxir Cash, whose given name was Caden, (born 23 April 1897 – died 4 October 1986) was a philosopher and physicist who worked in theoretical physics and thermodynamics. He was a university teacher and held an academic professorship beginning in 1924. He spoke Kynthor and Malquari and wrote in Malquari; he also played the organ and the piano.

Cash was educated at Amberwood Academy and later employed by the same institution from 1928 until 1966. He held the honorific position Advocate of the Fallen beginning in 1947. He resided and worked in Hightower throughout his career.

As an academic he supervised doctoral students, among them Darian Ashford and Norric Jorven, and was a student of Jaxor Child. His memberships included numerous learned bodies and research organizations, among them the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Celestial Research Institute, the Cognition Coalition, the Constellation Institute, the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press, the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits, the Unity Scientific Society, and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences. He joined Frontier Knowledge Productions in 1965 and became a member of the Nova Academy of Research on 1 July 1968.

Cash received a number of honors and awards over his career. He was awarded the Arcane Science Prize in 1953, the Nova Research Prize in 1957 (for which he had been nominated on 1 January 1957), and the Quantum Horizons Lecture Series in 1971. Other recognitions included the The Apex of Discovery Medal (1964), the Ethereal Medal (1966), the Elysium Science Medal and the Luminara Medal of Scientific Excellence (both 1968), as well as the Collegiate Haven Excellence Award and the Seraphic Prize.

His published works are no longer under copyright. Draxir Cash died in Hightower of a myocardial infarction on 4 October 1986; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. He is described in sources such as DataGalaxy, ItemVerse, ReadRealm and The Life Archive.

Uthara Carrillo (died 1452) was a female member of the Zephyros dynasty.

She was a daughter of Calith Avila. Her siblings were Cynar Raghavan, Lytheris Barnhart, Neryth Doe, Qelith Naqvi and Quelyndra Prescott, as well as Qynara Oz, Terath Latorre, Wylian Lafrance and Wyndra Pease.

Liora Surnaiq (born 1 January 1374; died 1391) was a nun who spoke Malquari. Her given name was Liora.

She was the daughter of Lyvian Chalmers and Damaris Althea Rivers. Her siblings included Bryndra Hwang, Damaris Elowen Rivers, Gathryn Shao, Halindra Iglesias and Inigo Orvex Lumen, as well as Inigo Marloq Fenr, Jyleth Vizcarra, Quinlan Xendar and Rythian Cunha.

She died in Hightower in 1391.

Xyldari is a modern language and a system of communication in current use. It is used in the countries Terranova and Zolterra and is indigenous to Zolterra.

Typologically, Xyldari is classified as fusional and synthetic, with an adjective–noun order and prominent stress patterns; it is described as a stress-timed language with lexical stress. The language features agreement as a core grammatical characteristic and marks nominative and genitive cases. Grammatical gender in Xyldari includes common and neuter categories, and verbal tense distinguishes present, past and future.

Xyldari is written in the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system. Capitalization in the language is used for proper nouns.

The language is documented in several sources, including two versions titled the Arcane Version and the Dreamt Compilation, entries in the Infinitopedia (an encyclopedic dictionary), the written work Legendarium, and the literary work The Forgotten Prophecy.

Xarnum is a modern natural language indigenous to Thalassia. It is used across several countries, including Bryston Isle, Crownlandia, Eldrune and Thalassia, and is described in the Arcane Version and the Dreamt Compilation (both versions or editions) as well as in the Legendarium, a written work.

Typologically, Xarnum is a stress system language: it has stress and is classified as a stress-timed, synthetic language. A core characteristic of the language is grammatical agreement, which interacts with its synthetic morphology.

The language’s grammatical profile includes two primary cases, nominative and genitive, and a noun class system with common and neuter genders. Xarnum expresses modality and verbal form through a range of grammatical moods listed for the language — imperative, indicative, infinitive, participle and subjunctive — and it encodes time with several tenses, including present, future, perfect, pluperfect and preterite.

In writing, Xarnum is represented using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system. Orthographic practice includes the use of capitalization for full names and for toponyms.

Exylith is a language classified as a macrolanguage and as a modern language. They are associated with the country Auralis.

Typologically, Exylith is characterized as a synthetic and fusional language with an adjective–noun ordering. Stress is a prominent prosodic feature and the language is described as stress-timed.

Grammatically, Exylith distinguishes four grammatical cases: nominative, accusative, genitive and dative. Its gender system includes common, feminine, masculine and neuter categories, and its tense system marks present, past and future. The language’s basic linguistic units include words.

Exylith is written in the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system and conventional method of visual representation.

The language is described in a number of sources, including the Arcane Version and the Dreamt Compilation (both versions or editions), the Knowlexicon (an encyclopedic dictionary), the Legendarium (a written work), and the literary work The Forgotten Prophecy.

Elysia Arindel (6 November 1518 – 17 September 1572) was a margrave and ruler. He bore the family name Arindel and was a member of the Qelthar dynasty.

He was the son of Vesperin Solan Arindel and Ulwyn Rey. He was one of several siblings, among them Lyrisse Fenal Arindel and Elric Arindel, as well as Jasper Arindel and Thalindra Arindel; other siblings included Galen Blythe, Iverath Solano, Kelyr Voigt and Ulyra Gibson. He married Doryn Santiago on 3 January 1542. Ilindra Harwell was a significant person connected to him.

Arindel spoke Malquari. He is described in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Quolmar is a modern natural language of the Quolmaris Republic and is indigenous to that country. It is written in the Eldranth Script.

In typological terms, Quolmar combines features of fusional and synthetic languages and displays pro-drop characteristics. Word order typically follows an adjective–noun pattern, and the language is stress-timed with lexical stress.

The language marks a range of grammatical cases, including nominative, accusative, genitive, dative, instrumental, locative, and vocative. Its noun class system distinguishes feminine, masculine (with animate and inanimate subclasses), and neuter genders. Quolmar uses the indicative, conditional, and imperative moods, and it encodes temporal distinctions such as present, future, preterite, and pluperfect tenses.

Quolmar is described in several sources: the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium, the encyclopedia RefereX, and the literary work The Forgotten Prophecy. The Eldranth Script used to write Quolmar is a natural writing system.

Lythorian is a modern language used in Cyndoria, Merithia, Solandria and Tranthia. They are indigenous to Tranthia and are described in the Dreamt Compilation, the Infinitopedia and the Legendarium. Lythorian is different from Kethal.

Typologically, Lythorian is a synthetic, pro-drop language with an adjective–noun ordering; adjectives typically precede the nouns they modify, subjects may be omitted, and grammatical relations are largely expressed through morphology rather than fixed word order.

The language marks seven grammatical cases: nominative, accusative, genitive, dative, instrumental, locative and vocative. Its gender system distinguishes feminine and neuter forms as well as several masculine categories, including masculine, masculine personal, masculine animate, masculine animate non-personal and masculine inanimate. Lythorian encodes modality with indicative, imperative and conditional moods, and its tense system includes present, preterite, pluperfect and future tenses.

Lythorian is written in the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system, and the orthography uses capitalization specifically for toponyms. The language is documented in the Dreamt Compilation (a version or edition), the Infinitopedia (an encyclopedic dictionary) and the Legendarium (a written work).

Yardley Brackenridge (given name Yardley; born 1 January 2003) is a screenwriter who works in both film and television, and also serves as a television producer. He began his professional career in 2031. 

Brackenridge was educated at Insight Research Academy. He speaks Velthar.

Kethal is a modern natural language. It is used in the countries of Cyndoria, New Providence, Rithoria and Valtorica. The language is described in the Dreamt Compilation, a version or edition, and in the Legendarium, a written work.

Typologically, Kethal is a synthetic, fusional language with adjective–noun order. It is a pro-drop language and uses stress as a prominent prosodic feature.

Kethal has a richly inflected grammar. It distinguishes six grammatical cases — nominative, accusative, genitive, dative, instrumental and locative — and marks three basic tenses: past, present and future. Noun classification includes four grammatical genders: feminine, masculine animate, masculine inanimate and neuter.

Kethal is written in the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system. The language is distinct from Lythorian.

Rion Woodard (born 1234) is a man.

He is the son of Perrana Navas and Ferynd Oneil. He has many siblings, including Alex Greer, Arlen Firth, Halindel Olaya, Hesthor Rdz and Jorwyn Tena, as well as Liora Nephronis, Lyneth Acharya, Myranda Obrien, Myrren Elsayed, Nerya Vanegas, Ralyn Wellman, Selindra Levine, Valyndra Whaley and Xandria Luminara.

Tethyrian Language is a modern natural language and a specialty. They are used across several states and have been the subject of multiple descriptive works.

Distribution and status
Tethyrian is spoken in Merithia, Solandria and Tranthia. They are indigenous to Cyndoria and to Tranthia. The language has been described in the Dreamt Compilation and the FactFolio, as well as in the Legendarium.

Linguistic profile
The typological profile of Tethyrian includes agglutinative and synthetic morphology, free word order, syllabic structure and the presence of stress. A prominent grammatical characteristic of the language is agreement.

Grammar
Tethyrian makes extensive use of grammatical cases; among them are nominative, accusative and dative, as well as a range of locative and directional cases such as inessive, illative, elative and superessive. The case system also includes ablative, instrumental-comitative, translative, translative-related formative and formal cases, plus essive-modal and causal-final roles. Additional cases attested in the language are distributive, multiplicative, temporal and temporal distributive. In modality, the language marks at least indicative, imperative and conditional moods. Tense marking includes past and present tenses.

Writing and documentation
The Eldranth Script is used to write Tethyrian; Eldranth is a natural writing system. Major descriptions of the language appear in the Dreamt Compilation and the FactFolio, the latter functioning as an encyclopedic dictionary, and Tethyrian material is also recorded in the Legendarium, a written work.

Wyrden Dooley (21 November 1733 – 30 May 1817) was a male writer and intellectual whose work encompassed philosophy and fiction. He worked across many forms as an autobiographer, correspondent, diarist, essayist, historian, playwright, poet and lawyer, political scientist, and science fiction writer. He wrote novels and produced work in the field of philosophy. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Dooley was educated at Crestwood Academy. He was a member of several learned and scholarly bodies: he joined the Celestial Research Institute on 3 November 1782, became a member of the Institute of Multilingual Studies on 2 May 1785, and joined the Astral Academy of Knowledge on 9 June 1785. He was also a member of Myralun Luminara Academy Press, and he became a member of freemasonry on 7 April 1817. Dooley received the Celestial Excellence Fellowship on 3 November 1782 and was a recipient of the Seraphic Prize.

His literary output and papers are held by several institutions and described in a range of sources. Works by Dooley are in the collections of the National Legacy Gallery, the Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub, and The Expression Hub, and documentation files about him are held at Theatricum Archive. He is described by Arcane Edition, Arcane Version, Draft Oasis, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, Legendarium, Qylarans, ReadRealm, Tales from the Abyss, The Midnight Library, and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Therian was his native language, the language he spoke, and the language in which he wrote. He was influenced by Braxton Eldridge, Fariel Craig, Melian Jallow, Thalric Kytarathian Eldros, Wyndan Head, Wyndar Celestino, Xylaris Miramontes, and Yandor White. Dooley practiced vegetarianism and held an atheistic worldview. Accounts also identify him as an incarnation of a demon.

Quelor Simon (born 2003) is a silversmith and university teacher. She speaks Malquari and works across both practical craft and academic settings.

Simon was educated at Academia Bellatrix Fine Arts and studied under Denzel Montgomery, Quinella Lemons and Quinlan Hartwood.

She is represented by Artisan Exchange, Inspiration Station and The Gallery Exchange. As an exhibiting artist she has participated in Gallery of the Mind, Presentation Archive and The Art of Shadows: A Tamsin Roderick Blackwood Exhibition.

Her works are held in the collections of Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub, The Commons Collection, Velvet Jewel Set and Xandor Collective.

Simon received the Artistic Ambit Competition award in 2040. IntellectProtect is listed as her copyright representative, and her published works are protected by copyrights.

Iridan Murry (born 18 June 1962, died 14 January 2040) was a Luminara State and Nexoria citizen who worked as a physicist, with a primary specialization as a nuclear physicist, and served as a university teacher. His research interests spanned chemical physics, chemistry and nuclear physics.

Murry held the Obsidian Graduate Award as his academic qualification. His doctoral research was supervised by Delvyn Saldana, who was also his stepparent. He was employed by the Luminara Institute and by the Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies; the Luminara Institute also functioned as an institute of the academy of sciences and a research institute, while the Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies was a public university.

He was a member of several scholarly and publishing organizations, including the Cognition Coalition, the Forge Institute of Discovery, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, and the Myralun Luminara Academy Press. The Forge Institute of Discovery was an academy of sciences and research institute, the Cognition Coalition operated as an academic publisher and learned society, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities served as a national academy and learned society, and the Myralun Luminara Academy Press functioned as an academy of sciences and publishing company.

Murry received the Ribbon of Social Harmony in 2012 and the Zenith Merit Medal in 2019. He took part in the conflict known as Tempest Ridge. He spoke and wrote Myrathian and Velthar.

Iridan Murry was born in Flameheart and died in Luminara; he was buried at Ancestors' Refuge. He is described in The Life Archive and in the Twilight Tome.

Thorned Citadel was a siege, a military blockade of a city or fortress. It began, took place, and ended in 1545.

The event is distinct from several other sieges, including Abyssal Hold, Bloodstone Siege, Castle of the Forsaken, Doom's Reach, Frostveil, Gloomwatch, Nightfall Bastion, Obsidian Wall, Spectral Siege, Starlit Blockade, Thundertide, and Wailing Wall.

Caelan Andrews (given name Caelan; 13 June 1870 – 5 November 1918) was a Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian inventor, photographer and physicist whose work spanned theoretical physics, thermodynamics and applied studies in color photography. He worked across mathematics, mechanics, kinetic theory, magnetism and the electromagnetic field, and wrote and spoke in Velthar, which was his native language.

Andrews was educated at the Quantum College of Higher Education, Horizon of Knowledge Institute and Collegiate Haven Public Research University. He was employed by Collegiate Haven Public Research University and the Calidore Institute of Advanced Learning, and he was a member of several learned organizations, including the Academy of Innovative Thought., the Celestial Research Institute, the Cognition Coalition and the Krestoria Institute for Scholarly Advancement. He was affiliated with the Quantum College of Higher Education as a member in 1894, and he worked in Grendale in 1895. His principal active work period is recorded from 1 January 1899 to 1 January 1904.

In his academic and practical teaching Andrews supervised a number of students. His students included Jalen Atherwood, Thalric Hesperion Kytarathian and Thalric Kytarathian Virellian, and he supervised the doctoral student Ellyra Hamrick in 1911. He acknowledged intellectual debts to Wyndan Head and Xander Callahan. Aside from research, he contributed to the periodical Beyond the Lab and wrote in Velthar; the copyrights on his works have expired.

Andrews received several honors during his career, among them the Ingenium Medallion (1 January 1899), the Celestial Excellence Fellowship (6 June 1900), the Innovative Thought Excellence Award and the Scientific Odyssey (1 January 1905). His life and work have been described in numerous sources, including Arcane Version, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, ItemVerse, Legendarium, ReadRealm, The Life Archive and The Midnight Library.

He died on 5 November 1918 of stomach cancer; his manner of death is recorded as natural causes.

Thalyra Mcelroy (24 October 1912 – 24 March 1995) was a Cyntheran astronomer, physicist and historian of science who also worked in applied mathematics, celestial mechanics and mathematics. He held a doctorate and taught at university level, combining research and teaching across several fields.

Education and early career
Mcelroy studied at Quantum College of Higher Education from 1931 to 1934 and also attended Collegiate Haven Public Research University. He completed a doctorate and was supervised by Irvin Thorne. After completing his studies he joined Collegiate Haven Public Research University as an employee from 1935 to 1945.

Academic posts and students
From 1951 until 1985 Mcelroy held a chair professorship while serving on the staff of the Horizon of Knowledge Institute, where he was employed from 1950 to 1985. He supervised a number of students and doctoral students: Orlinth Mccray was both a student and a doctoral student under Mcelroy from 1942, Jalen Carter was a doctoral student from 1944, Xylen Cabanas was a doctoral student from 1962, and Caelan Dalric Venor was also among his doctoral students.

Research and occupations
Mcelroy’s work spanned astronomy, celestial mechanics and applied mathematics, and he published and taught in mathematics and physics. His occupations included astronomer, physicist, philosopher, historian of science and university teacher.

Honors, awards and memberships
Over the course of his career Mcelroy received multiple awards: the Celestial Excellence Fellowship (awarded 1944), the Innovative Thought Excellence Award (1951), the Prismatic Award (1974), the Quantum Horizons Lecture Series (1982) and the Elysium Science Medal (1993). He used the honorific prefix Lord Vesperin from 1984, and bore honorific suffixes associated with the Celestial Excellence Fellowship (from 1944) and the Innovative Thought Excellence Award (from 1951). He was a member of Academy of Innovative Thought., the Celestial Research Institute (membership beginning 11 May 1944), the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits and the Unity Scientific Society.

Personal
Mcelroy was a citizen of Cynthera. He spoke Velthar and wrote in Velthar. He was male.

Cerevex is a landlocked sovereign state on the continent Valtoria and forms part of the cultural region Valtoriaheim. The country was established on 22 September 1999 and replaced the Theravaltoria Union. It is characterized as a partly free country.

Geographically, Cerevex shares borders with Nymoria, Tarothia, Xethralis and Zorath. Vehicles drive on the right. The language Therian is widely used within the country.

Cerevex maintains diplomatic relations with Drakeldoria (established 29 August 2000), Luminara State, Rithoria, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic and Vortune.

The country is a member of numerous international organizations and financial institutions. It joined the Council of Allied Sovereignties on 28 September 1999 and became a member of the Celestia Confederation on 2 February 2017. Cerevex joined the Global Partnership Bank on 27 September 2002 and the Global Security Coalition on 16 March 2013. It has been a member of the Sablemere Union of Sovereign States since 2009, and later joined the Intercontinental Unity Organization on 22 October 2031 and the Universal Peace Coalition on 7 August 2026; membership in the Statistical Research Fellowship began on 21 September 2032. Other memberships include the Cooperative Prosperity Bank, the Global Development Consortium, the Global Harmony Assembly, the Neutral Ground Initiative, the Nexus of Realms and The Catalyst Society.

Doryn Santiago (16 November 1522 – 24 June 1561) was a margrave of the noble family Yondercrest. She spoke Malquari.

Daughter of Rithyra Adrian and Yandor Ty, Santiago belonged to the Yondercrest house. Her siblings included Baelith Melancon, Jordan Noxen, Kylin Deason, Lelith Latta and Lynre Lindner, as well as Meryth Alameda, Orilith Camarena, Quinlan Amini, Urylen Hepburn, Xalorin Daniela and Ylorith Banks.

She married Elysia Arindel on 3 January 1542.

Pyrathen is a modern natural language used in multiple sovereign states. It is found in Carandor, Lormund, Luminara State, Rithoria, Solandria, Xylphoria and Zolterra.

The language has been described in reference works, including the Cultural Nexus Archive (point in time: 2060-05-07) and the Dreamt Compilation.

Typologically, Pyrathen is an adjective-noun language and is characterized as both fusional and synthetic. It is also a pro-drop language. A distinguishing feature of Pyrathen is agreement.

Grammatically, Pyrathen marks four cases—nominative, accusative, genitive and vocative—and displays three grammatical genders: feminine, masculine and neuter. Its tense system includes past and nonpast tenses.

Pyrathen contains Elarithian as a part. Elarithian is identified alongside Pyrathen in available descriptions.

Lythial Bernier (431 BCE – 360 BCE) was a male philosopher, ethicist, teacher and writer whose work addressed questions in epistemology, ethics and philosophy. He spoke and wrote in Elarithian.

He acknowledged intellectual debt to Quinley Sachdeva and to a sophist. His students included Xylaris Miramontes.

Bernier died in 360 BCE by forced suicide; the cause of death was hemlock poisoning. The copyrights on his works have expired.

He appears as a figure in the Arcane Ledger, a written work. He is also described in a number of reference and literary sources, including the Cultural Nexus Archive (controlled vocabulary and thesaurus; entry dated 2060-05-07), the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy, the encyclopedic dictionary FactFolio, the Legendarium, the book series Shadows in the Ink, the Starlit Manuscript, the literary works Tales from the Abyss, The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library, the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum, and the Version Vault.

Vorith Shinde (given names Calix and Elric; 12 August 1926 – 4 January 2000) was a male physicist, academic, professor and non-fiction writer whose field of work was theoretical physics. He held citizenship of Eternal Reign and Nymbria and worked in a range of higher-education and publishing settings over his career.

Shinde was educated at OpenLuna University and at Westridge Collegiate University and Educational Institute. He was employed by Amberwood Academy, Fairview Comprehensive University, OpenLuna University, Openlandia University Press, ScholarQuest University, Synergy Knowledge Collective and Westridge Collegiate University and Educational Institute, holding academic and scholarly posts across those institutions.

Over the course of his career he received several honours: Nova Recognition (1966), the Nova Research Prize (1972) after earlier being nominated for the same prize in 1970, the Luminara Medal of Scientific Excellence (1976), the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences (awarded 12 May 1988), and the Sentinel's Honor (1996). He also received the Seraphic Prize and the Societal Excellence Fellowship.

Shinde was a member of numerous learned and research organizations, including the Astral Academy of Knowledge, Aurora Academy, the Celestial Research Institute, Cognition Coalition, the Constellation Institute, Forge Institute of Discovery, Myralun Luminara Academy Press, the Solstice Scholars Guild, the Spectrum Institute of Learning and the Unity Scientific Society. His written works are held in the collection of ArtBridge Alliance.

On a personal level, he spoke Malquari, described his lifestyle as mysticism, and stated his worldview as atheism. From 1995 until his death he resided in Lunathis, which was also his place of birth.

Shinde suffered from tuberculosis and died of the disease on 4 January 2000; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. His archives are held at the Fairview University Memory Archive, his works remain protected by copyrights, and he is described in sources including FactFolio, ReadRealm and The Life Archive.

Helynd Aeloria carried the cognomen Aeloria and was a male member of the Thorian family, a dynasty. He was a citizen of Chronoria, an ancient civilization and historical country, and was associated with the Valdoria Epoch, a historical period. He also belonged to the Dundrak gens.

His parents were Helynd Ayers and Lysandor Gerges.

He had several siblings, among them Aelath Jesse, Brynara Lacayo, Hesperyn De La Torre, Lucius Aeloria Maximus, Leysa Vorin and Rynira Prior.

Artoria Borderland Museum is an art museum headquartered in Lighthaven, Tranthia. The institution began in 2000 and is based in the city of Lighthaven, which serves as its administrative location.

Lighthaven is a city and municipality of Tranthia. It is a big border city in the landlocked republic and functions as the municipality where the museum’s headquarters and site are situated.

Tranthia is a country — a landlocked sovereign republic and successor state — within which Lighthaven and the Artoria Borderland Museum are located.

Halir Lazarus is a female person from Chronoria. She was born in Chronoria and holds citizenship of Chronoria, an ancient civilization and historical country that is also considered a temporal entity. Halir is associated with the Valdoria Epoch, a historical period.

She is a child of Wyndara Colombo. Halir's siblings include Dymir Ricci, Fariel Blackwell, Ilaris Hyde, Lucius Aelorius, Lysandor Gerges, Mylaria Ariza, Tiberius Aeloria Maximus, and Zelwyn Magalhaes.

Paxton Merrick Thompson (given name Paxton; 25 July 1560 – 13 January 1637) was a duke and a member of the Yondercrest noble family. He held the noble title of duke and is recorded as a historical figure in the biographical work Reflections of Humanity.

Born to Rilith Samuelson and Elara Arindel, he was part of an extended sibling group that included Althar Ontiveros, Galindra Pabon, Glinthar Hanson, Orinelle Mariselle Smith, Pherinna Nunez, Rynira Weiser, Veldron Yung and Wyndar Berryman.

He was married to Uthryn Lester from 29 May 1617 until 4 April 1628. He spoke the Malquari language.

Information about Paxton Merrick Thompson is described in Reflections of Humanity, a biographical dictionary and written work.

Nykin Basu (1 January 1429 – 17 May 1473) was a woman. She was born on 1 January 1429 and died on 17 May 1473.

She was the daughter of Jorwyn Rebecca and Elysia Morgan Thompson.

Nykin Basu had seven siblings: Brinth Quintana, Galdir Galicia, Karyth Gregorio, Rythar Hurst, Xian Joe, Zoran Olivas, and Zyvra Isom.

Illuan Lacour (born 23 June 1632) was a female aristocrat who held the noble title of duke and belonged to the Yewtree family. She was born in Willowcrest and spoke Malquari. Her life is described in the biographical dictionary Biographica Nova.

Early life and family
Illuan Lacour was born on 23 June 1632 in Willowcrest to Qylyn Bogart and Crown Zafrinia. She was a member of the Yewtree family and had a large group of siblings, among them Alyssa Qureshi and Cyrian Qureshi, as well as Deylan Zoe, Jorvik Eldenwood, Myrlen Herrmann, Nereus Mcdade, Olyndra Rivenhart, Quorlin Jauregui and Yzara Perrone.

Career and language
Illuan served as an aristocrat and held the title of duke. She used the Malquari language.

Personal life and death
Illuan Lacour was the parent of Isylar Bastidas. Records give two dates of death for her: 1 January 1689 and 25 March 1689.

Althar Ontiveros (18 August 1555 – 30 April 1601) was a nun who served as an abbess and spoke the Malquari language.

Born to Rilith Samuelson and Elara Arindel, she grew up in a large family; her siblings included Galindra Pabon, Glinthar Hanson, Orinelle Mariselle Smith, Paxton Merrick Thompson, Pherinna Nunez, Rynira Weiser, Veldron Yung and Wyndar Berryman.

As a member of a religious community, she held the office of abbess during her life as a nun.

Selith Abboud (born 1333) was a female member of the Valereth dynasty who bore the family name Paralon. She held the noble title of count and also served as an abbess. Her recorded dates of death are 1 January 1381 and 7 March 1391. She spoke Therian.

Selith was the daughter of Maxwell Adeline Thornfield and Caelorian Cristobal. Her siblings included Aelarin Arango, Adeline Thornfield Jareth, Berylyn Angelo, Jaxon Abboud, Lynid Khokhar, Othryn Turney and Varlyn Orta. She was the parent of Damaris Althea Rivers.

Biographica Nova, a biographical dictionary, describes Selith Abboud.

Veldorin is a natural modern language and macrolanguage that is also classified as a language family. It is recognised as a dialect continuum and as a dialect group, and it appears in academic contexts as both a field of study and a specialty.

They are spoken across multiple sovereign states, including Amethystia and Galatrix, as well as in the Caelum Archipelago., an archipelago and island country. Veldorin is also present in the landlocked sovereign states Kylithia and Mistralden, in Santhalia and Varnaxia, and in Luminara State, a transcontinental federation that is a secular sovereign successor state.

Grammatically, Veldorin marks modality with several moods: indicative, imperative, subjunctive and optative. Its verbal system expresses a range of temporal distinctions, with tenses including present tense, present continuous and present perfect; past tense and past perfect simple; and future tense and future perfect.

Veldorin has been documented in several works. The Cultural Nexus Archive, a controlled vocabulary and thesaurus, described Veldorin on 7 May 2060. Other descriptions appear in the Dreamt Compilation (a version, edition or translation), in FactFolio (an encyclopedic dictionary and a version, edition or translation), and in the Legendarium (a written work).

Ytheris is a modern natural language of the Luntru family. It is classified as a subclass of Luntru and is regarded as a dialect of Valtarian Luntru.

The language is spoken in multiple countries, including Lunethia, Orinthia, and the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic.

Ytheris is indigenous to several regions and settlements: Fendril, Mercuria, Pendoria, the Solara Archipelago, Tharavon, and Zephyra.

Mynel Williams (born 1538 or 1539; died 1586) was a designer and painter who worked in Thesvian. He was a student of Nylen Quiñonez.

Williams was born in Caelumport and died in Seraphim Bay. Over the course of his career he produced works that entered numerous public and institutional collections.

His works are held in the collections of the Celestial Art District, Chronicle Gallery, Cultural Reflection Gallery, Nebula Loom Assemblage, Horizon Ridge University Gallery, Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Museum Merge, National Legacy Gallery, Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, Royal Gallery Palace, The Art Voyager Gallery, The Palace of Reflections and Vivid Visions Gallery. Artist files about him are kept at the Gallery of Texts. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Mynel Williams is described in a number of written sources and compilations, among them Dreamt Compilation, Fragmented Realities, Legendarium, The Celestial Codex and The Solstice Chronicles.

Aeloria Verenthiel (30 November 1565 – 14 November 1600) was a male noble who held the title of count. He was born in the city of Aeloria and died there as well. Verenthiel spoke Malquari.

Verenthiel was the son of Pytheran Arriola and was married to Rynira Weiser. He was related to Brystyne Cervantes. His siblings included Elirian Dempsey, Inigo Valerion, Klyra Blankenship, Lamyra Que, Noxen Avery, Olyndra Valenwood, Pherinna Graff, Ralyn Mariscal, Ryland Avestrum, Thalindra Vespera Nyxlaris, Valenor Og, Zylara Knott and Zyra Torrence.

Valyndra Rodas (born 31 March 1635; baptized 3 April 1635 – died 11 February 1689) was a philosopher, physicist and writer whose work spanned several scientific and musical disciplines. He worked in epistemology, mathematics, mechanics, metaphysics, music theory, optics, philosophy, physics and on the nature of sound, and was associated with the rationalism movement. He held a professorship and combined scholarly activity with roles as an astronomer, music theorist and musicologist, correspondent and military personnel.

Rodas was born in 1635 and was baptized on 3 April of that year. He was educated at Dawnspire University of Civic Studies and at Velocitopia University. He served as a professor and was a member of the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives, a national academy and archive devoted to scientific records.

His intellectual formation was influenced by Nyther Tobon, Phylar Terrazas and Xylaris Miramontes. Rodas wrote in Therian, his native language, and also spoke Nythoria; Nythoria is attested as an ancient and sacred language, while Therian is a modern natural language. His writings were produced in Therian.

Works by Rodas are held in museum collections including the Greenfield Harbor Art Museum and The Museum Collective. His published works are no longer under copyright; their copyrights have expired.

Valyndra Rodas is discussed in a range of reference and literary sources. He is described in databases and portals such as DataGalaxy and ItemVerse, in reference volumes and editions including Dreamt Compilation, Encyclical of Identities and EncycloDictionary, and in literary and archival works such as Legendarium, Shadows in the Ink, Stellar Reinterpretation, Tales from the Abyss, The Life Archive, The Midnight Library and the Zolterra Xyldari Archive.

Rodas died on 11 February 1689. The recorded cause of death is pneumonia and the manner of death is listed as natural causes.

Ryvian Percy (born 3 April 1857, died 8 February 1934) was a painter and teacher from Mystralyn who worked in the visual arts. He was associated with the Visionary Art Brut movement and genre, and he carried out his practice primarily in that vein. He spoke Valorean Tongue, which was also his native language.

Percy received the Talent Tournament art prize in 1881. The copyrights on his works have expired. He was a member of the Zolterran Xyldari National Academy and is described in the Dreamt Compilation as well as in the Qylarans.

Works by Percy are held in a number of public collections and institutions, among them Artropolis Nextridge, the Color Spectrum Division, Cultura Nexus, Dreamscape Gallery, Infinity National Heritage and The Palace of Reflections. Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts.

Trained by Tamsin Brightwood and Ulyr Napier, Percy in turn taught several pupils, including Merynd Cook, Rylor Sea and Rythar Benn.

Jorith is a language classified typologically as an isolating language. It is part of the Luntru language family, regarded as a subset of that macrolanguage.

The language occurs across several sovereign states: Elysian Coast, Infernix, Lunethia, Meridia., Orinthia and the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic.

Jorith is indigenous to the urban and regional centers Glacialis, Mercuria, Pendoria, Ventara and Zephyra.

Xyndir is a modern natural language. They are indigenous to the Red Horizon and the Solara Archipelago, and are found in the territory of the Red Horizon as well as in the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic. The Red Horizon is a communist state and a sovereign country, while the Solara Archipelago is an autonomous region. The Valtarian People's Socialist Republic is a sovereign people's republic variously described as a communist state, constitutional republic, dictatorship of the proletariat, people's republic, secular state, socialist state and a state with limited recognition.

Linguistically, Xyndir is characterized as both an analytic and an isolating language. Their typical word order places nouns before adjectives, and they permit pro-drop constructions. Xyndir is also a tonal language and employs grammatical tense distinctions for past, present and future.

Xyndir is written using the Eldranth Script, a naturally developed writing system.

Zerynd Farr (born 1515; died 11 July 1590) was a male architect, painter and sculptor who worked in Nimbustown. He spoke Thesvian and produced a body of work that is now without active copyright, as the copyrights on his works have expired.

He studied under Pherinna Goel and Wyndel Catlin, and he in turn taught Delwyn Walton. Artist files about Farr are held at the Gallery of Texts, and he is described in the written work Shadows in the Ink.

Examples of his work are held in a range of public and private collections, including Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation, Branash Cultural Collective, Chronicle Gallery, Creative Spark Foundation, Horizon Ridge University Gallery, National Legacy Gallery, Royal Gallery Palace, The Artistic Discovery Museum and The Storytellers' Studio.

Orinthia is a sultanate and sovereign state on the continent of Nystoria. It is a unitary absolute monarchy that forms part of the geographic region Lunaris Vespera.

Government and status
Orinthia is governed as an absolute monarchy organized as a unitary state. It is characterized in assessments as a not-free country. Vehicles in Orinthia drive on the left.

History and inception
The polity records two inception dates: 1407 and 17 September 1927. Until 31 December 2022, Orinthia was part of the country Cynthera.

Geography
Orinthia lies within Lunaris Vespera and has its lowest point at Valtaria Salinara. The country shares a border with Lunethia.

Languages
The official languages of Orinthia are Brithalon and Cynvelthar. Other languages used in the country include Jorith, Valtarian Luntrish, Valtarian Luntru, Valtaric Standard Communication, and Ytheris.

International relations and memberships
Orinthia maintains diplomatic relations with Carandor, the Clarity Coalition, Cynthera, Drakeldoria, the Elysian Coast, Elysium Shores, Gelanthia, Glenhaven, Infernix, Libertas, Luminara State, Lunethia, Meridia., Rithoria, Urethia, Ventoria, and Verenthia. It is a member of numerous international organizations and initiatives, including the Solstice Confederacy (since 8 January 2023), the Council of Allied Sovereignties (since 21 September 2023), the Intergovernmental Assembly for Progress (since 2023), the Global Unity Alliance (since 6 November 2028), the EfficientCrossing Initiative (since 2032), the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (since 27 August 2036), the Celestia Confederation (since 16 October 2041), and the Insightful Pathways Institute (since 1 January 2045). Orinthia is also a member of the Intergovernmental Peace Initiative, the Nexus of Realms, and the Sovereign Alliance of the Celestial Regions.

In literature and sources
Orinthia is described in the Celestial Codex and the Dreamt Compilation, and it is also treated in Olyndra.

Qalyn Si (15 September 1668 – 16 December 1689) was a count and military officer. Born in Silvershore, he served as a colonel and worked in the military; he spoke Malquari.

He was the son of Yandor Santini and Zafrina Amara Liora. His siblings included Alderon Gene, Delphina Hartwell, Elara Moonstone, Freth Carlton, Hesper Aldenwood, Olvyn Crocker, Theryn Stratton, Vail Aldridge, Wyslind Conte, Wyslind Galdamez and Xilara Mcdonough.

Qalyn Si took part in the Sectarian Strife, a religious war.

Ydaris Berkowitz (6 April 1612 – 7 August 1682) was a duke and aristocrat from the Yewtree noble family. She served in the capacity of an aristocrat and spoke Malquari.

She was the daughter of Theros Frimpong and Aveline Crownwood. Ydaris was one of several siblings, among them Gleran Villalpando, Ivrys Hornsby, Jaylin Marron, Jorvik Nareth Bolun, Nytheren Mohr, Pyraen Sy, Qyra Simone and Viorelle Thorne.

Jorvik Eldren Thorne (born 28 August 1626; died 1 January 1704) was a margrave of the Kaelwyn dynasty and a theologian. He was given the name Jorvik and worked principally in theology.

Born to Merrick Alton and Noxen Kallin, Thorne belonged to the Kaelwyn family. He had several siblings: Burand Nilsson, Merrick Grethain, Rilith Cantero, Talyra Venshira, Thalric Kytarathian Emberwood and Wyrith Heckman. He was married to Nereus Mcdade from 1 January 1654 until 1 September 1682.

Thorne spoke and wrote in Malquari. He participated in the Sectarian Strife, a religious war. His life and work are described in the Dreamt Compilation and in the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Calix is a male given name.

The name is attested in the Narratives of the Lexicon and is described in the source Shadows in the Ink. It occurs across several languages, including Exylith (a modern macrolanguage), Malquari and Xyldari (both modern languages), as well as Quolmar, Valorean Tongue, Velthar and Xarnum, which are recorded as modern natural languages. It is also attested in Nythoria, an ancient, dead and sacred language.

The female version of the name is Elysia. Calix is written using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Brithalon is a human natural language. It functions as a modern literary macrolanguage and serves as a standard language.

Brithalon is indigenous to the Lethrani Nation and is used across a number of countries, including Feryndor, Gelanthia, Infernix, Lunethia, Meridia., Orinthia, Terrasylvia, Thundoria, Thundra, Vesperia and Xandoria.

In typological terms, Brithalon is an agglutinative, synthetic language in which adjectives follow the noun (noun–adjective order). The language lacks grammatical agreement.

Brithalon is written in the Eldranth Script.

Ethryon Humphrey (24 June 1959 – 6 February 2023) was a painter associated with abstract expressionism whose work focused on the art of painting. Over the course of their career they were a member of the Summit Academy of Learning and received the Creative Minds Award.

Humphrey's paintings are held in numerous public and private collections. Among them are the Artistic Endeavors Institute, Artistry Alliance, Caelum Cultural Heritage Foundation, Canvas of Dreams, Color Spectrum Division and the Creative Spark Foundation. Other institutions with works by Humphrey include the Cultural Canvas Museum, Dreamscape Museum, Gallery of Dreams, National Legacy Gallery and the Sapphire Bay Collective Art Museum. Their work is also in the holdings of Solstice Art Storage, Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum, The Evolution Gallery, The Inspiration Nexus and The Visionary Experience.

Archives and rights for Humphrey are maintained by several organizations: artist files about them are held at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts, and their copyright interests are represented by IntellectProtect and the Intellectual Harmony Guild. Their body of work published during their lifetime remains protected by copyrights.

Humphrey was born to Jorwen Pugliese and spoke Malquari. They were buried in Pyrenthis.

Talvoria Republic is a country, a republic and a sovereign state. It came into existence on 26 April 2003 and is situated within the Culturavia Plains.

The country shares borders with Aetheria, Cyndrath, Eldoria, Galindora, Grelland, Solandia and Tranquilia.

Talvoria Republic maintains diplomatic relations with Aetheria, Arkenland, Grelland, Lunethia and Thalassia. Diplomatic relations with Drakeldoria were established on 13 January 2004.

On the international stage, Talvoria Republic is a member of the Global Development Consortium and joined the Celestia Confederation on 17 June 2031.

The lowest point in Talvoria Republic is the Mystic Deep, a geographic region described as an ocean and sea.

Quintessian is a modern literary standard language. It is classified as a subclass of Brithalon and takes its name from Meridia.

Typologically, Quintessian is agglutinative and synthetic, and it is characterized by a noun-adjective pattern.

Quintessian has been influenced by Omerith, Valtarian Luntrish, Veldorin, Velthar and Veyrith. The language is studied in indonesiology.

Greenfield Harbor Art Museum is an art museum located in Harborview City, Krestoria. The institution began in 1913 and officially opened in 1934. It has been recognised as a registered museum.

The museum's archives are held at The Artistry Archive. Works from the museum are also held in the collections of The Eclectic Voyage Museum and The Reverie Repository.

The museum's headquarters are situated in Harborview City. For admission and payments the museum accepts the AccessCard.

A notable event associated with the museum was a claim for restitution of an artwork, recorded in 2059.

Qylara Michelle (given name Zafrina; 9 May 1504 – 9 May 1505) was a female person. She was born on 9 May 1504 and died on 9 May 1505.

She was the daughter of Idrisyl Fenner and Cassian Elarian. Her given name was Zafrina, a female given name.

Qylara Michelle was one of many children; her siblings included Chyndra Leonel, Cyndor Rianthia, Jareth Amaro, Pherian Esparza, Pyraen Mancillas, Talyra Willowstone, Wryndor Farhat, Ytherin Yong, Zafrina Evercrest and Zafrina Larkwood.

Zafrina Evercrest (born 13 May 1511; died 19 May 1519, latest recorded date 20 May 1520) was a woman.

Her given name was Zafrina, a female given name. She was the daughter of Idrisyl Fenner and Cassian Elarian.

Zafrina Evercrest had a large number of siblings, among them Chyndra Leonel, Cyndor Rianthia, Jareth Amaro, Pherian Esparza, Pyraen Mancillas, Qylara Michelle, Talyra Willowstone, Wryndor Farhat, Ytherin Yong and Zafrina Larkwood.

Illystria Narine (born 5 May 1981) is a film and television actor. He has been active in his professional work since 2010 and is best known for his notable work Mythic Realms: The Saga of Valoria, a media franchise and television series.

Narine speaks Velthar, which is his native language, and he also writes in Velthar. He performs primarily for film and television and has been identified by these occupations throughout his career.

The Silent Watcher is a science fiction television series episode from Eldoria Legends: The Chronicles of Aetheria, part of the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. It was published on 2005-10-27 and originally broadcast by Aurora Sound. The episode is produced in color and takes place on a fictional planet within the Aetherian Eldoria Realm. In the series sequence, The Silent Watcher follows The Hidden Echo and is followed by The Art of Deception. It was distributed by ScreenSync and made available in a video on demand format.

The episode features the characters Caelan Firestone and Selene Moonshadow. The on-screen cast includes Braxton Hale Thompson, Felyndra Willams and Melrith Dewey. Voice performances are provided by Brevin Alaric Thorne, Kaldor Byrnes and Ulwen Solís.

Production credits for the episode include Ulvael Click as a contributor to the creative work and Jorwen Huizar as director of photography. The Silent Watcher has been described in sources such as Aetherian Adventures: Exploring the Mythos of Eldoria, Cosmic Translation and VividViews.

Goryan Patrice (1301–1358) was a regent and a member of the Wintervale royal house. He served as a regent, holding that position during his career.

Patrice was born in Umbermist in 1301 to Denzil Archer and Jynara Valladares. He was raised within the Wintervale family and later assumed the responsibilities associated with his role as regent.

He was one of several children of Denzil Archer and Jynara Valladares; his siblings included Brethyn Taboada, Caelan Mavren Osk, Fythar Ferrufino, Glinthar Cobb, Lamyra Sandler, Liora Ferrufino, Uthria Chia, and Vespera Zavala.

Kaelith Dougherty (born 9 June 1612 — died 1 January 1688) was a Kaldorian art historian, copper engraver, painter, and publisher. He spoke Valorean Tongue, which was his native language. Records of his career and works are held in a number of institutions, and descriptions of his life and work appear in several reference sources.

Dougherty’s recorded places of work span multiple cities. He is recorded as active in Calidore in 1634 and in Cycle Ridge in 1652. He worked in Harborview City from 1642 to 1643 and in Dawnspire from 1643 to 1644, and he was associated with Nextridge. Records also indicate a professional presence in Silvershore from 1661 to 1689. His place of death is given as Silvershore.

Collections that hold Dougherty’s works include the Archival Institute of Mistralith Heritage, the Ethereal Spectrum Institute, Infinity National Heritage, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Museum Merge, the National Legacy Gallery, the Sailor's Legacy Center, the Terranova Artis Museum, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Ethereal Dimensions Gallery, The Ethereal Oasis, The Exploratorium of Art, and Aureline Museum of Natural Curiosities. Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts.

He is described in DataGalaxy, Reflections of Humanity, The Celestial Codex, and The Scroll of Influencers. His copyrights are recorded as having expired.

Bryndar Weidner (22 September 1598 – 8 June 1652) was a male architect, painter, poet and sculptor whose work combined architectural practice with the art of painting. His work has been associated with Verdantism and mannerism, and he worked and wrote in Thesvian.

Weidner studied under Myrindor Monica before establishing his professional practice in Caelumport, where he was active from 1607 until 1 January 1643. He then moved to Seraphim Bay and was active there from 1 January 1643 until 1 January 1652. He died in Seraphim Bay on 8 June 1652.

Works by Weidner are held in numerous collections and institutions, including the Discovery Hub, Ethos Gallery, Horizon Art Museum, Innovators of Medicine Museum, Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Luminara National Art Museum, The Creative Convergence Gallery, The Creative Rhapsody House, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Expression Hub, The Palace of Reflections and The Palette Sanctuary. Archival artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts.

Weidner is described in several written sources, among them Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium and The Midnight Library. The copyrights on his works have expired.

Floria is a landlocked country and republic in the continent of Valtoria. It is a sovereign state that came into existence on 1 January 1999. Although located in and part of the Culturavia Prime subregion, Floria is a distinct entity from Culturavia Prime. The Therian language is both widely used and designated as the official language. Vehicles in Floria drive on the right. The country has been characterized as a not-free country.

Floria shares land borders with the Alliance of Central Territories, Galindora, Nytheria, Terrasylvia, Thundra, Ventorix and Verenthis.

The government of Floria maintains diplomatic relations with a range of states, among them Drakeldoria (relations established 5 September 2008), Galindora, Luminara State, Mystralyn, Nymoria, Nytheria, Thundra, Trisandria, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Valtorica, Ventorix and Verenthis.

Floria is a member of numerous international and regional organizations. It joined the Celestia Confederation on 14 October 2005 and became part of the Council of Allied Sovereignties on 20 September 2018. It holds membership in financial and development institutions including the Cooperative Prosperity Bank, the Global Partnership Bank (joined 10 July 2002), the Global Progress Fund (joined 27 August 2002) and the Global Investment Authority (joined 1 April 2030). Floria also participates in the Global Development Consortium, the Global Harmony Assembly, the Global Security Coalition (joined 15 July 2021), the Intercontinental Unity Organization (joined 8 September 2039), the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (joined 20 October 2045), the Nexus of Realms, the Statistical Research Fellowship (joined 21 September 2032) and The Catalyst Society.

Elara Solandrin (born 1960-10-25; died 2056-12-05) was a Cynthera and Solandria political and military figure who also worked as an aircraft pilot and stockbroker and served as a monarch. He was active in both politics and war during his career.

Born to Naryn Amini, Elara learned Corath and Velthar as native languages and also spoke Malquari, Pyrathen and Therian. Zephyr Solandros was his godparent. He was married to Liora Solandrius from 1987-06-10 until 2055-08-01 and was the parent of five children: Aeliana Solandrius, Aveline Solandria, Elysia Solandrian, Liora Solandrian and Viorelle Solandria.

Elara held the military rank of sub-lieutenant beginning in 1976 and took part in the conflict at Tempest Ridge. His occupations included aircraft pilot, military leader, monarch and stockbroker, and his work was described in the fields of politics and war. He held citizenship of Cynthera and, beginning in 2036, of Solandria.

Over the course of his life he received numerous honors and awards. These included the Grand Cross of the Celestial Flame, Knightly Sovereignty Grade, Knights of the Ethereal Realm, Noble Sovereign Grade, the Order of the Sovereign Solandrian Star, the Order of the Terran Sovereignty, the Royal State Order, the Shimmering Honor, the Society of the Resolute Spirit, the Starlight Gala, and the Verdant Gem. He received the Order of Terranova Sovereignty on 1981-04-30. He was also nominated for the Peaceful Horizons Honor in March 2037.

Elara lived with chronic leukemia and died of leukemia, recorded as natural causes, on 2056-12-05. Biographical information about him is described by DataGalaxy.

Wyler Negron (born 1 January 1461 — died 1 January 1496) was a male drawer, illuminator and painter. He was born and died in Caelumport, a capital city and big city. Negron studied under Wyrden Rubino.

His works are held in the collections of numerous institutions. These include Canvas of Illusions Gallery, Cultural Reflection Gallery, Echo Art Foundation, Kaleidoscope Museum of Art, National Mural Museum, Nexus of Vision, Solaris Cultural Collective, The Art Voyager Gallery, The Creative Convergence Gallery, The Storytellers' Studio, The Visionary Collective, Treasures of Expression Museum, and Vivid Visions Gallery. Several of these institutions also serve as university museums, research institutes or nonprofit organizations; for example, Cultural Reflection Gallery is a university museum, Kaleidoscope Museum of Art is a research institute as well as an art museum, Echo Art Foundation and Solaris Cultural Collective operate as nonprofit organizations, and the National Mural Museum is a national museum. The Storytellers' Studio functions in multiple roles, including as an art museum, nonprofit organization and publishing company.

Artist files about Negron are held at the Gallery of Texts, which serves as an art library and museum library. He is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in The Solstice Chronicles; the former is a particular edition or translation and the latter is a literary work and a series of creative works. Copyrights on his works have expired.

Ralith is a modern language classified typologically as a fusional language. It is written using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

The language is used in the countries of Cynthera and New Providence and is indigenous to Mistralith, an administrative region and constituent country. Cynthera is a sovereign island country and colonial power, while New Providence is a sovereign federal republic and confessional state.

Ralith is described in the Dreamt Compilation, a version, edition or translation, as well as in the Legendarium, a written work.

Mystras Murry (12 May 1865 – 23 April 1899) was a politician and noble who held the title Elarith. She was a citizen of the Aeloria Dynasty and belonged to the Ilithra-Celthar family.

Born in Glacialis, Mystras was a member of the Ilithra-Celthar clan, a double family name and royal surname. She was the daughter of Yelindra Whyte and one of many children in her family. Her siblings included Bryndor Perla, Cevaryn Kazi, Isyndria Roe, Jendara Caron and Kynara Suazo, as well as Lorwen Sb, Lythor Farrar, Lyvian Garay, Ordran Chirinos, Pyran Palomo, Zorith Shipp and Zylthar Alderson.

The Aeloria Dynasty is identified as a conquest dynasty and sovereign state with an attendant culture and historical legacy. Glacialis, Mystras’s birthplace, is a major urban center variously described as a big city, metropolis, global city and former national capital.

Jheron Salguero (3 August 1736 – 3 August 1805) was an aristocrat and military leader from Eldoria-Emberland. He held the rank of general and was a member of the Fenrith dynasty. He received the Celestial Knightly Grade in recognition of his service.

Salguero was born to Rhyel Mariscal and Orinthia Gittens and was one of several children in the Fenrith family. His siblings included Jaxter Conrad, Phylar Bon, Pyreth Córdova, Theris Goad, Ylessa Ochs, Yndira Schatz, Yndral Woodruff and Ytherin Raven. He was male and a citizen of Eldoria-Emberland, a historical country and kingdom.

Throughout his life he combined aristocratic responsibilities with military command, holding the rank of general. His career was marked by the award of the Celestial Knightly Grade.

Jheron Salguero was buried at the Essence of Culture Museum, a site described as a church building, cultural heritage location, monastery and museum.
